abstract: Retinal organoids represent a promising regenerative strategy for restoring vision in retinal degenerative diseases, but the capacity of host cone bipolar cells in the primate macula to rewire with transplanted photoreceptors has not been established. In this study, we transplanted genome-edited ISL1-/- human retinal organoids lacking ON-bipolar cells into an acute laser-induced macular photoreceptor ablation non-human primate model. Using immunohistochemistry, ultrastructural imaging, and focal macular electroretinography, we demonstrate that host rod and cone bipolar cells actively extend dendrites toward grafted photoreceptors and form synaptic contacts, with evidence of functional signal transmission in a subset of transplanted eyes. Longitudinal, per-eye analyses revealed that host ON-bipolar responses improved in two of four eyes with ISL1-/- graft by up to 21.6% and remained stable for up to 2 years post transplantation. Moreover, OFF-pathway connectivity showed potential progressive maturation, with delayed increase in d-wave after 13 months in one of those eyes. These findings provide the first demonstration of long-term anatomical host-graft synaptic integration in the primate macula, establishing that central cone bipolar circuits retain the capacity for durable rewiring with human stem-cell-derived grafts. Our results highlight ISL1-/- retinal organoids as a promising approach for central vision restoration in macular degeneration.
abstractZh: 视网膜类器官代表了一种有前景的再生策略，用于恢复视网膜退行性疾病中的视力，但灵长类黄斑中宿主视锥双极细胞与移植的光感受器重新建立连接的能力尚未得到证实。在本研究中，我们将缺乏ON-双极细胞的基因组编辑ISL1-/-人视网膜类器官移植到急性激光诱导的黄斑光感受器消融的非人灵长类模型中。通过免疫组织化学、超微结构成像和局部黄斑视网膜电图，我们证明宿主视杆和视锥双极细胞主动向移植的光感受器延伸树突并形成突触接触，且在部分移植眼中观察到功能性信号传递的证据。纵向、逐眼分析显示，在四只眼中，有两只眼的宿主ON-双极细胞反应在移植ISL1-/-移植物后改善了高达21.6%，并在移植后长达2年内保持稳定。此外，OFF通路连接显示出潜在进行性成熟，其中一只眼在13个月后d波延迟增加。这些发现首次证明了灵长类黄斑中长期解剖学上的宿主-移植物突触整合，确立了中央视锥双极细胞回路保留着与人类干细胞来源移植物进行持久重连的能力。我们的结果强调了ISL1-/-视网膜类器官作为黄斑变性中央视力恢复的一种有前景的方法。

abstract: Cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) are the leading cause of death worldwide, with significant attention focused on the development of therapeutic drugs and research into pathogenic mechanisms. In the real world, cardiotoxicity induced by multiple factors commonly exists and is closely associated with cardiovascular diseases. Traditional toxicity testing models (such as animal experiments and two-dimensional cell cultures) have limited clinical translation value due to species differences, inability to simulate the complex microenvironment of the human body, and cellular interactions. Cardiac organoids, as an emerging three-dimensional (3D) culture platform, possess 3D structure, multicellular composition, organ-specific functions, and self-organizing capabilities, which can highly mimic the physiological and pathological characteristics of the heart, providing a more precise humanized model for the study of cardiovascular disease mechanisms, drug development, and toxicity assessment. This paper systematically reviews the construction strategies of cardiac organoids and their application progress in toxicology: Firstly, it explores the construction standards and technical optimization of cardiac organoids, focusing on human-engineered heart tissue (hEHT) models and various cardiac organoid models that mimic the human heart, with particular attention to their unique characteristics, utility, and limitations. Secondly, through bibliometric analysis using CiteSpace, it reveals research hotspots and trends in cardiac organoid applications for toxicology, specifically by extracting collaboration networks, conducting co-citation analysis, and co-occurrence analysis. Finally, it summarizes specific applications of cardiac organoids in toxicology, including drug toxicity assessment, environmental pollutant toxicity evaluation, cardiac developmental toxicity studies, disease model construction, and multi-organ cascade studies for systemic toxicity assessment.
abstractZh: 心血管疾病（CVDs）是全球死亡的主要原因，治疗药物的开发和致病机制的研究受到广泛关注。在现实世界中，多种因素引起的心脏毒性普遍存在，并与心血管疾病密切相关。传统的毒性测试模型（如动物实验和二维细胞培养）由于物种差异、无法模拟人体复杂的微环境和细胞相互作用，其临床转化价值有限。心脏类器官作为一种新兴的三维（3D）培养平台，具有三维结构、多细胞组成、器官特异性功能和自组织能力，能够高度模拟心脏的生理和病理特征，为心血管疾病机制研究、药物开发和毒性评估提供了更精确的人源化模型。本文系统综述了心脏类器官的构建策略及其在毒理学中的应用进展：首先，探讨了心脏类器官的构建标准和技术优化，重点关注人工程化心脏组织（hEHT）模型和多种模拟人类心脏的类器官模型，特别关注其独特特征、实用性和局限性。其次，通过使用CiteSpace进行文献计量分析，揭示了心脏类器官在毒理学中应用的研究热点和趋势，具体通过提取合作网络、进行共被引分析和共现分析。最后，总结了心脏类器官在毒理学中的具体应用，包括药物毒性评估、环境污染物毒性评价、心脏发育毒性研究、疾病模型构建以及用于全身毒性评估的多器官级联研究。

abstract:
Background

CDK4 alterations are common in lung adenocarcinoma, but recent clinical trials only demonstrated modest therapeutic responses to CDK4/6 inhibitors. The mechanism of CDK4/6 inhibitor resistance has not been fully characterized.Methods

Patient-derived organoids and cell lines were tested for their sensitivity to CDK4/6 inhibitors. The drug resistance mechanism relating to stemness pathway was tested by in-vitro and in-vivo assays. Screening of small molecule library was performed to explore potential therapeutic agents that could potentiate the efficacy of CDK4/6 inhibitors.Results

CDK4/6 inhibitors could inhibit the growth of lung adenocarcinoma patient-derived organoids and cell lines, and its drug resistance was associated with HES1 overexpression. We identified the vital role of HES1 in promoting cancer cell stemness through SOX9 upregulation via the phosphorylation of transcription factor STAT3. Inhibition of HES1 impaired lung cancer spheroid formation, reduced stemness marker expression, and enhanced the sensitivity of the spheroids towards the CDK4/6 inhibitor palbociclib. Knockdown of SOX9 recapitulated the functional effect of HES1 inhibition, confirming its role as a downstream effector mediating the stemness properties of lung cancer cells. Screening of small molecules revealed VR23 as a potent HES1 inhibitor, and it could suppress lung cancer growth and patient-derived organoids in a synergistic manner with palbociclib in-vitro and in-vivo. Moreover, the pSTAT3 inhibitor napabucasin could also afford synergy with palbociclib as well, further confirming the therapeutic vulnerability conferred by the HES1-pSTAT3-SOX9 pathway in potentiating CDK4/6 inhibitors.Conclusions

Our findings revealed a signalling pathway in which lung adenocarcinoma regulates stemness and tumourigenesis through HES1, and the targeting of this pathway by VR23 or napabucasin supports further preclinical development for CDK4/6 inhibitor combination therapy.

背景

CDK4变异在肺腺癌中常见，但最近的临床试验仅显示CDK4/6抑制剂具有适度的治疗反应。CDK4/6抑制剂耐药机制尚未完全阐明。方法

CDK4/6抑制剂可抑制肺腺癌患者来源类器官和细胞系的生长，其耐药性与HES1过表达相关。我们确定了HES1通过转录因子STAT3的磷酸化上调SOX9从而促进癌细胞干性的关键作用。抑制HES1损害了肺癌球体形成，降低了干性标志物表达，并增强了球体对CDK4/6抑制剂palbociclib的敏感性。敲低SOX9重现了HES1抑制的功能效应，证实了其作为介导肺癌细胞干性特性的下游效应因子的作用。小分子筛选揭示VR23是一种有效的HES1抑制剂，在体外和体内均能与palbociclib协同抑制肺癌生长和患者来源类器官。此外，pSTAT3抑制剂napabucasin也能与palbociclib产生协同作用，进一步证实了HES1-pSTAT3-SOX9通路在增强CDK4/6抑制剂疗效方面所提供的治疗脆弱性。结论

我们的发现揭示了一条信号通路，肺腺癌通过HES1调节干性和肿瘤发生，而通过VR23或napabucasin靶向该通路支持CDK4/6抑制剂联合治疗的进一步临床前开发。

abstract: Patient-derived organoids (PDOs) have emerged as physiologically relevant three-dimensional (3D) culture systems that closely mimic the molecular and histological features of the human endometrium and associated malignancies. Owing to their complex pathophysiology and limited treatment options, gynaecological cancers and benign disorders such as endometriosis and adenomyosis continue to pose serious challenges to women's health. This review highlights how PDO technology is changing the face of modelling gynaecological diseases, testing responses to drugs, and preparing personalised treatment, focussing on the mechanistic aspects of tumour evolution, hormone responsiveness, and chemoresistance, and the recent developments in PDO-based disease modelling in ovarian, endometrial, and endometriosis-related cancers. The predictive capability and translational value of PDO systems can be further improved by incorporating organ-on-a-chip platforms, CRISPR/Cas9 genome editing, and multiomics profiling. These biobanking programmes and microfluidic advances will permit longitudinal analyses as well as high-throughput screenings for targeted therapies against inhibitors of PARP, PI3K-AKT, and hormonal pathways. Although several technical challenges, such as low sample heterogeneity, a lack of stromal-epithelial interactions, and financial burdens, exist, PDOs have emerged as promising platforms for precision oncology, fertility preservation, and regenerative medicine research. In summary, this review presents the ability of PDO models to bridge the gap between preclinical research and clinical translation and potentially revolutionise personalised gynaecological medicine.
abstractZh: 患者来源类器官（PDOs）已成为生理相关的三维（3D）培养系统，能密切模拟人类子宫内膜及相关恶性肿瘤的分子和组织学特征。由于其复杂的病理生理学和有限的治疗选择，妇科癌症以及子宫内膜异位症和子宫腺肌病等良性疾病继续对女性健康构成严重挑战。本综述重点介绍PDO技术如何改变妇科疾病建模、药物反应测试和个性化治疗准备的格局，重点关注肿瘤演变、激素反应性和化疗耐药的机制方面，以及基于PDO的卵巢癌、子宫内膜癌和子宫内膜异位症相关癌症疾病建模的最新进展。通过整合器官芯片平台、CRISPR/Cas9基因组编辑和多组学分析，可以进一步提高PDO系统的预测能力和转化价值。这些生物样本库项目和微流控进展将允许纵向分析以及针对PARP、PI3K-AKT和激素通路抑制剂的高通量靶向治疗筛选。尽管存在一些技术挑战，如样本异质性低、缺乏基质-上皮相互作用和经济负担，但PDOs已成为精准肿瘤学、生育力保存和再生医学研究的有前景平台。总之，本综述展示了PDO模型弥合临床前研究与临床转化之间差距的能力，并有可能彻底改变个性化妇科医学。

abstract: Oligodendrogliomas (ODGs) are slow-growing tumors with poorly defined biology. Here, we identify SMPD3, encoding neutral sphingomyelinase 2 (nSMase2), as a negative regulator of ODG progression via extracellular vesicle (EV) biogenesis and autocrine-paracrine signaling. High SMPD3 expression correlates with longer survival in ODG and low-grade glioma patients. SMPD3 knockdown in patient-derived BT54 and BT88 cells increases proliferation, enhances BT88 invasion in cerebral organoids, and accelerates BT88-tumor growth in mouse xenografts and chick CAM assays. Patient tumors display abnormal non-neoplastic glial proliferation and a ribosome-rich transcriptional signature in tumor-associated oligodendrocytes. Concordantly, ODG-derived EVs, enriched in ribosomal proteins, suppress astrocyte proliferation. Pharmacological inhibition of nSMase2 (GW4869) or ribosome biogenesis (Rbin1, diazaborine) increases ODG cell proliferation while reducing protein synthesis. Blocking EV synthesis amplifies ribosome inhibition effects, whereas exogenous EVs attenuate them. Thus, SMPD3-mediated EV signaling and ribosomal stress converge to regulate ODG proliferation, establishing SMPD3 as a key regulator and potential therapeutic target.
abstractZh: 少突胶质细胞瘤（ODGs）是生长缓慢的肿瘤，其生物学特性尚不明确。在此，我们确定SMPD3（编码中性鞘磷脂酶2，nSMase2）通过细胞外囊泡（EV）生物发生和自分泌-旁分泌信号传导，作为ODG进展的负调控因子。SMPD3高表达与ODG和低级别胶质瘤患者的更长生存期相关。在患者来源的BT54和BT88细胞中敲低SMPD3会增加增殖，增强BT88在脑类器官中的侵袭，并加速小鼠异种移植和鸡胚绒毛尿囊膜（CAM）试验中BT88肿瘤的生长。患者肿瘤表现出异常的非肿瘤性胶质细胞增殖，以及肿瘤相关少突胶质细胞中富含核糖体的转录特征。一致地，ODG来源的EV富含核糖体蛋白，抑制星形胶质细胞增殖。药理学抑制nSMase2（GW4869）或核糖体生物发生（Rbin1、地唑硼烷）会增加ODG细胞增殖，同时减少蛋白质合成。阻断EV合成会放大核糖体抑制效应，而外源性EV则减弱这些效应。因此，SMPD3介导的EV信号传导和核糖体应激共同调节ODG增殖，确立SMPD3为关键调控因子和潜在治疗靶点。

abstract: Bladder cancer (BC) exhibits high inter- and intra-patient heterogeneity, limiting the efficacy of standard treatments and underscoring the need for personalized therapeutic models. We established patient-derived organoids (PDOs) from 31 clinical BC specimens, achieving an 80.65% success rate. These organoids preserved distinct morphological subtypes: solid, hollow, and mixed and retained stable proliferative capacity. Histological and molecular analyses confirmed that PDOs recapitulated key features of the parental tumors, including a hybrid basal-luminal phenotype with elevated CD44, GATA3, and LGR5 expression, and peripheral localization of CK20 and Uroplakin 3 A (UPK3A), indicating structural polarity and urothelial differentiation. Functional drug screening of early-passage PDOs revealed heterogeneous responses to standard-of-care (SOC) agents, cisplatin and gemcitabine, as well as the EGFR/HER2 inhibitor lapatinib. Notably, lapatinib enhanced chemosensitivity in a dose-dependent manner, even at reduced concentrations of standard agents. The most effective combinatorial regimens significantly impaired organoid viability and architecture, suggesting a synergistic effect. Drug response variability across PDO lines correlated with patient-specific clinical features, including tumor grade and recurrence status. These results demonstrate that BC PDOs faithfully model tumor heterogeneity and offer a robust platform for individualized drug response profiling. Our findings support the utility of PDOs for preclinical drug evaluation and precision oncology, particularly in identifying effective combination therapies such as lapatinib-enhanced chemotherapy.
abstractZh: 膀胱癌（BC）表现出高度的患者间和患者内异质性，限制了标准治疗的有效性，并凸显了对个性化治疗模型的需求。我们从31例临床膀胱癌标本中建立了患者来源类器官（PDOs），成功率达80.65%。这些类器官保留了不同的形态亚型：实心型、空心型和混合型，并维持了稳定的增殖能力。组织学和分子分析证实，PDOs重现了亲本肿瘤的关键特征，包括具有CD44、GATA3和LGR5高表达的基底-腔面混合表型，以及CK20和Uroplakin 3 A（UPK3A）的外周定位，表明结构极性和尿路上皮分化。对早期传代PDOs的功能性药物筛选揭示了对标准治疗（SOC）药物顺铂和吉西他滨以及EGFR/HER2抑制剂拉帕替尼的异质性反应。值得注意的是，拉帕替尼以剂量依赖性方式增强化疗敏感性，即使在标准药物浓度降低的情况下也是如此。最有效的联合方案显著损害了类器官的活力和结构，表明存在协同效应。不同PDO系之间的药物反应差异与患者特定的临床特征相关，包括肿瘤分级和复发状态。这些结果表明，膀胱癌PDOs忠实地模拟了肿瘤异质性，并为个体化药物反应分析提供了稳健的平台。我们的研究结果支持PDOs在临床前药物评估和精准肿瘤学中的实用性，特别是在识别有效联合疗法（如拉帕替尼增强化疗）方面。

abstract:
Background

Colorectal cancer remains a significant health challenge. Filgotinib is a selective JAK1 inhibitor approved for the treatment of inflammatory diseases. However, its anti-tumor effects and underlying mechanisms in colorectal cancer (CRC) remain unexplored.Methods and results

In this study, cell viability and proliferation were assessed by CCK‑8, crystal violet, and EdU assays. Mitochondrial membrane potential was evaluated using JC‑1 staining. Transcriptome sequencing (RNA‑seq) was performed on RKO cells treated with Filgotinib, followed by GO and KEGG pathway enrichment analyses. Protein expression was examined by Western blot. The effect of Filgotinib was further validated in three human CRC patient‑derived organoids (PDOs). Filgotinib at concentrations near the IC50 (14 µM for HCT116, 10 µM for RKO, 14 µM for LoVo) reduced cell viability and proliferation, as shown by CCK‑8, crystal violet, and EdU assays. Western blot analysis confirmed reduced JAK1 and STAT3 protein expression after Filgotinib treatment compared with the control. Filgotinib induced mitochondrial‑dependent apoptosis, evidenced by increased green fluorescence in the JC‑1 assay. Transcriptomic profiling of RKO cells treated with 10 µM Filgotinib for 48 h identified 1,151 upregulated and 862 downregulated genes. GO analysis revealed enrichment in terms related to chromatin structure, nucleotide binding, and metabolic processes. KEGG analysis highlighted activation of the p53 signaling pathway and suppression of oncogenic pathways including VEGF and TNF signaling. At the protein level, Filgotinib treatment increased the expression of p21 (a key p53 pathway effector) and cleaved caspase-3 compared with the control group. Furthermore, treatment of human CRC-derived PDOs with Filgotinib (≥ 10 µM) for 48 h resulted in organoid disintegration.Conclusions

Our study demonstrates that Filgotinib exerts direct anti-tumor effects in CRC by triggering apoptosis, activating the p53 pathway, and inhibiting pro-survival VEGF and TNF pathways. These findings support its potential as a targeted therapeutic agent for CRC.
abstractZh:
背景

结直肠癌仍然是一个重大的健康挑战。非戈替尼是一种选择性JAK1抑制剂，被批准用于治疗炎症性疾病。然而，其在结直肠癌（CRC）中的抗肿瘤作用及其潜在机制尚未被探索。方法与结果

在本研究中，通过CCK-8、结晶紫和EdU实验评估了细胞活力和增殖。使用JC-1染色评估线粒体膜电位。对非戈替尼处理的RKO细胞进行了转录组测序（RNA-seq），随后进行了GO和KEGG通路富集分析。通过Western blot检测蛋白表达。非戈替尼的作用在三个人类CRC患者来源的类器官（PDOs）中得到了进一步验证。接近IC50浓度（HCT116为14 µM，RKO为10 µM，LoVo为14 µM）的非戈替尼降低了细胞活力和增殖，如CCK-8、结晶紫和EdU实验所示。Western blot分析证实，与对照组相比，非戈替尼处理后JAK1和STAT3蛋白表达降低。非戈替尼诱导线粒体依赖性凋亡，JC-1实验中绿色荧光增加证明了这一点。用10 µM非戈替尼处理RKO细胞48小时的转录组分析鉴定出1,151个上调基因和862个下调基因。GO分析显示与染色质结构、核苷酸结合和代谢过程相关的术语富集。KEGG分析强调了p53信号通路的激活以及包括VEGF和TNF信号在内的致癌通路的抑制。在蛋白水平上，与对照组相比，非戈替尼处理增加了p21（p53通路的关键效应因子）和裂解的caspase-3的表达。此外，用非戈替尼（≥10 µM）处理人类CRC来源的PDOs 48小时导致类器官解体。结论

我们的研究表明，非戈替尼通过触发凋亡、激活p53通路以及抑制促生存的VEGF和TNF通路，在CRC中发挥直接的抗肿瘤作用。这些发现支持其作为CRC靶向治疗药物的潜力。

abstract:
Background

The Kids Eye Biobank collects biospecimens, images, and clinical data from pediatric ophthalmology patients for future research use. A broad informed consent model is used; participants have opt-in choices, which include the creation of cell lines/organoids, use of whole genome sequencing (WGS) data, sharing resources with industry, and receiving future communications. This study aimed to characterize participant consent preferences and investigate associations between participant characteristics and their consent preferences.Methods

Participant demographics, diagnosis, and consent preferences were abstracted from the Kids Eye Biobank's records. Variables were analyzed using descriptive statistics and chi-square test. Patient engagement methods were used throughout the study.Results

Between January 2020 and April 2025, 391 patients were approached and 342 (87%) enrolled. Of the enrolled participants, 265 (78%) had a substitute decision-maker, and 205 (60%) were diagnosed with a malignant neoplasm affecting the eye. Demographic data were available for 273 (80%) participants; 50% were boys/men, 48% identified as belonging to a visible racial minority, and 67% reported a religious affiliation. Participants with malignant neoplasms opted in more to the use of WGS data and to the sharing of WGS data and cell lines/organoids with industry (p p p = 0.002) compared with White participants.Conclusion

Informed consent preferences may be influenced by participant diagnosis and/or race. These findings may help the Kids Eye Biobank tailor its communication strategies and diversify its participant population.
abstractZh:
背景

儿童眼科生物样本库收集儿科眼科患者的生物样本、图像和临床数据，以供未来研究使用。采用广泛知情同意模式；参与者有选择加入的选项，包括建立细胞系/类器官、使用全基因组测序（WGS）数据、与行业共享资源以及接收未来通讯。本研究旨在描述参与者的同意偏好，并调查参与者特征与其同意偏好之间的关联。方法

从儿童眼科生物样本库的记录中提取参与者的人口统计学特征、诊断和同意偏好。使用描述性统计和卡方检验分析变量。整个研究过程中使用了患者参与方法。结果

在2020年1月至2025年4月期间，接触了391名患者，其中342名（87%）入组。在入组参与者中，265名（78%）有替代决策者，205名（60%）被诊断为影响眼睛的恶性肿瘤。273名（80%）参与者的人口统计学数据可用；50%为男孩/男性，48%自认为属于可见的少数族裔，67%报告有宗教信仰。患有恶性肿瘤的参与者更倾向于选择使用WGS数据以及与行业共享WGS数据和细胞系/类器官（p p p = 0.002）相比，白人参与者。结论

知情同意偏好可能受参与者诊断和/或种族的影响。这些发现可能有助于儿童眼科生物样本库调整其沟通策略并使其参与者群体多样化。

abstract:
Introduction

Alzheimer's Disease (AD) affects more than 57 million people, yet drug development faces high failure rates due to the limited translational validity of conventional models. This review analyzes how 3D (three-dimensional) systems provide a technical validation platform that more accurately replicates the human brain microenvironment.Areas covered

This review analyzes the evolution of 3D culture systems, including spheroids, organoids, hydrogels, and microfluidics. A comprehensive literature search was conducted in PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and ScienceDirect, covering publications from January 2014 to March 2026. The analysis synthesizes evidence on the capacity of these models to reproduce beta-amyloid (β-amyloid) aggregation and tau hyperphosphorylation, while exploring the integration of artificial intelligence to optimize compound screening.Expert opinion

3D models serve as high-fidelity biological filters that complement current preclinical methodologies, improving early identification of toxicities and therapeutic efficacy. Their strategic integration and technical standardization are essential steps to refine predictive accuracy and optimize the transition to clinical trials.
abstractZh:
引言

阿尔茨海默病（AD）影响超过5700万人，然而由于传统模型的转化有效性有限，药物开发面临高失败率。本综述分析了三维（3D）系统如何提供一个更准确地复制人脑微环境的技术验证平台。涵盖领域

本综述分析了3D培养系统的演变，包括球体、类器官、水凝胶和微流控。在PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science和ScienceDirect中进行了全面的文献检索，涵盖2014年1月至2026年3月的出版物。分析综合了这些模型在重现β-淀粉样蛋白（β-amyloid）聚集和tau过度磷酸化方面的证据，同时探讨了人工智能的整合以优化化合物筛选。专家意见

3D模型作为高保真生物过滤器，补充了当前的临床前方法，改善了毒性和治疗效果的早期识别。其战略整合和技术标准化是提高预测准确性和优化向临床试验过渡的关键步骤。

abstract: Hematologic patient-derived organoids (PDOs) reconstruct human bone marrow and lymph node microenvironments in 3D, preserving malignant cell states, clonal diversity, and clinically relevant drug responses. Leukemia PDOs artificially mimic the complex bone marrow niche and cytokine dependencies. Lymphoma PDOs recapture immune-stromal interactions and enable testing of targeted and immunotherapies, including bispecific antibodies and chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cells. Multiple myeloma PDOs model the bone marrow microenvironment and maintain plasma tumor cell survival cues that drive drug resistance. Across preclinical models, PDOs outperform 2D cultures, spheroids, and xenografts in mechanistic and translational resolution. Converging regulatory support and National Institutes of Health investment position hematologic PDOs as frontline platforms for functional precision oncology. This review highlights current systems, disease-specific advances, quality standards, and future directions.
abstractZh: 血液系统患者来源类器官（PDOs）在三维空间中重建人类骨髓和淋巴结微环境，保留恶性细胞状态、克隆多样性以及临床相关的药物反应。白血病PDOs人工模拟复杂的骨髓微环境和细胞因子依赖性。淋巴瘤PDOs重新捕获免疫-基质相互作用，并能够测试靶向治疗和免疫疗法，包括双特异性抗体和嵌合抗原受体（CAR）T细胞。多发性骨髓瘤PDOs模拟骨髓微环境，并维持驱动耐药性的浆细胞肿瘤细胞存活信号。在临床前模型中，PDOs在机制和转化分辨率上优于二维培养、球体和异种移植模型。监管支持和美国国立卫生研究院投资的汇聚，使血液系统PDOs成为功能性精准肿瘤学的前沿平台。本综述重点介绍当前系统、疾病特异性进展、质量标准和未来方向。

abstract: Atherosclerosis has traditionally been considered a lipid-driven disease. However, emerging evidence highlights the central role of inflammation in the development of atherosclerosis. Multiple cell types, including endothelial cells, macrophages, and other immune cells, interact within lesions to form a chronic inflammatory microenvironment. Unhealthy lifestyle, smoking and metabolic disorders like hyperlipidemia, hyperglycemia, and their derived pro-atherogenic products drive vascular inflammation. Recent evidence reveals that high-sensitivity C-reactive protein surpasses LDL-cholesterol in predicting future cardiovascular risk. Combining lipid-lowering with anti-inflammatory therapies significantly reduces event recurrence, underscoring the need for targeted drugs. Promising results have emerged from trials of anti-inflammatory agents. Statins and other lipid-lowering drugs also exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. However, cholesterol-independent strategies face challenges like infection risk from immunosuppression, requiring extensive safety evaluation. Enhancing intrinsic resilience mechanisms is a promising alternative in combating vascular inflammation and atherosclerosis. High-throughput screening accelerates drug development, while induced pluripotent stem cell-derived vascular organoids better simulate human atherosclerosis pathobiology, improving preclinical predictions. Research on organ interaction networks and trained immunity offers novel therapeutic targets. In this comprehensive review, we provide a state-of-the-art synthesis of the drivers, mechanisms, and potential therapies of atherosclerosis by targeting inflammation, with an aim to reducing residual cardiovascular risk in the post-statin era.
abstractZh: 动脉粥样硬化传统上被认为是一种脂质驱动的疾病。然而，新出现的证据强调了炎症在动脉粥样硬化发展中的核心作用。多种细胞类型，包括内皮细胞、巨噬细胞和其他免疫细胞，在病变内相互作用，形成慢性炎症微环境。不健康的生活方式、吸烟以及高脂血症、高血糖等代谢紊乱及其衍生的促动脉粥样硬化产物驱动血管炎症。近期证据显示，高敏C反应蛋白在预测未来心血管风险方面优于低密度脂蛋白胆固醇。将降脂与抗炎治疗相结合可显著减少事件复发，凸显了靶向药物的必要性。抗炎药物的试验已出现有前景的结果。他汀类药物和其他降脂药物也表现出抗炎特性。然而，不依赖胆固醇的策略面临免疫抑制带来的感染风险等挑战，需要广泛的安全性评估。增强内在韧性机制是对抗血管炎症和动脉粥样硬化的一个有前景的替代方案。高通量筛选加速了药物开发，而诱导多能干细胞衍生的血管类器官更好地模拟人类动脉粥样硬化病理生物学，改善了临床前预测。关于器官相互作用网络和训练免疫的研究提供了新的治疗靶点。在这篇全面综述中，我们提供了通过靶向炎症来治疗动脉粥样硬化的驱动因素、机制和潜在疗法的前沿综合，旨在降低他汀时代后的残余心血管风险。

abstract: Colorectal adenoma is a major precancerous lesion of colorectal cancer (CRC). The adenoma-carcinoma sequence is a multistep progression to CRC caused by the accumulation of genetic mutations. However, the non-genetic mechanisms underlying this process remain largely unknown. In this study, organoids were established from colorectal adenomas patients. Some organoids showed heterogeneity in the proliferative potential of single cells, which is regulated by non-genetic mechanisms. IGF2BP3 was identified as a differentially expressed gene associated with different growth patterns. IGF2BP3 modulated MYC expression levels in positive and negative directions, enabling high proliferative capacity and preventing MYC-induced cell death. IGF2BP3 affected tumorigenicity of mouse adenomas in vivo. Intratumoral heterogeneity in the growth potential is acquired at the precancerous stage of colorectal carcinogenesis, and IGF2BP3 is important for regulating MYC levels. These findings suggested a gatekeeping mechanism in the early stages of carcinogenesis.
abstractZh: 结直肠腺瘤是结直肠癌（CRC）的主要癌前病变。腺瘤-癌序列是由基因突变积累导致的向CRC进展的多步骤过程。然而，这一过程中非遗传机制在很大程度上仍不清楚。在本研究中，从结直肠腺瘤患者中建立了类器官。一些类器官在单细胞增殖潜力方面表现出异质性，这种异质性受非遗传机制调控。IGF2BP3被鉴定为与不同生长模式相关的差异表达基因。IGF2BP3正向和负向调节MYC表达水平，从而赋予高增殖能力并防止MYC诱导的细胞死亡。IGF2BP3在体内影响小鼠腺瘤的致瘤性。生长潜力的瘤内异质性在结直肠癌发生的癌前阶段获得，而IGF2BP3对调节MYC水平至关重要。这些发现提示了癌变早期阶段的守门机制。

abstract: The tyrosine kinase receptor RET is altered by genetic fusions in a subset of non-small cell lung cancers (NSCLCs). To determine if we can generate organoids with lung cancer features in this context, we used two iPSC lines overexpressing oncogenic RET-M918T and RET-C634Y mutations. Lung progenitor cells (LPCs) were generated after 18 days of culture, followed by air-liquid interface cultures giving rise to alveolar structures expressing SFTPC, TTF-1, MUC1, and CK5/6 at day +38. Transplantation of LPCs into NOD/SCID mice generated tumors harboring bronchial structures, ciliated cells, goblet cells, and the squamous cell carcinoma marker p40. Single-cell RNA sequencing analyses allowed us to determine the major genes involved with response or resistance to Selpercatinib, a major inhibitor targeting RET-altered lung cancers. These findings show that the iPSC-derived preclinical model can recapitulate some features of NSCLC and has significant potential for identifying new therapeutic targets in RET-inhibitor-refractory lung cancers.
abstractZh: 酪氨酸激酶受体RET在部分非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）中因基因融合而发生改变。为了确定在此背景下能否生成具有肺癌特征的类器官，我们使用了两种过表达致癌性RET-M918T和RET-C634Y突变的iPSC细胞系。经过18天培养后生成肺祖细胞（LPCs），随后进行气液界面培养，在第+38天产生表达SFTPC、TTF-1、MUC1和CK5/6的肺泡结构。将LPCs移植到NOD/SCID小鼠体内，产生了含有支气管结构、纤毛细胞、杯状细胞和鳞状细胞癌标志物p40的肿瘤。单细胞RNA测序分析使我们能够确定与Selpercatinib（一种靶向RET突变肺癌的主要抑制剂）反应或耐药相关的主要基因。这些发现表明，iPSC衍生的临床前模型可以重现NSCLC的某些特征，并在识别RET抑制剂难治性肺癌的新治疗靶点方面具有显著潜力。

abstract: Patient-derived tumor organoids (PDTOs) are vital for precision oncology, but standard drug screening methods, including adenosine triphosphate (ATP) assays, are destructive and prevent longitudinal monitoring. Optical coherence tomography (OCT) offers non-destructive 3D imaging, capturing morphological features and tissue attenuation characteristics via the optical attenuation coefficient (OAC). Here, we propose a non-destructive evaluation framework for tumor organoids that fuses OAC and multi-dimensional morphological features. Using intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (iCCA) PDTOs treated with icaritin, we found that OAC exhibited a significant dose-dependent increase (up to 32.8% at 80 μM compared to control), accompanied by a morphological transition of cystic organoids into solid phenotypes. By integrating these features via K-means++ clustering and principal component analysis, we constructed a relative growth score. This fusion score correlated strongly with the ATP gold standard (Pearson correlation coefficient r = 0.938), outperforming a morphology-only model (r = 0.906). Furthermore, independent experiments with first-line chemotherapeutics (e.g., 5-Fluorouracil, Gemcitabine) and combinatorial regimens indicated the model's potential generalizability (r = 0.887). This method overcomes the limitations of destructive, single-metric evaluations, providing a quantitative and non-destructive platform for high-throughput drug screening and personalized treatment decision-making.
abstractZh: 患者来源的肿瘤类器官（PDTOs）对于精准肿瘤学至关重要，但标准的药物筛选方法，包括三磷酸腺苷（ATP）检测，具有破坏性，无法进行纵向监测。光学相干断层扫描（OCT）提供非破坏性的三维成像，通过光学衰减系数（OAC）捕获形态学特征和组织衰减特性。在此，我们提出了一种融合OAC和多维形态学特征的非破坏性肿瘤类器官评估框架。使用icaritin处理的肝内胆管癌（iCCA）PDTOs，我们发现OAC表现出显著的剂量依赖性增加（与对照组相比，在80 μM时增加高达32.8%），同时伴随囊性类器官向实性表型的形态学转变。通过K-means++聚类和主成分分析整合这些特征，我们构建了一个相对生长评分。该融合评分与ATP金标准强相关（Pearson相关系数r = 0.938），优于仅基于形态学的模型（r = 0.906）。此外，使用一线化疗药物（如5-氟尿嘧啶、吉西他滨）和联合方案的独立实验表明该模型具有潜在的普适性（r = 0.887）。该方法克服了破坏性、单一指标评估的局限性，为高通量药物筛选和个性化治疗决策提供了一个定量且非破坏性的平台。

title: Integrated Screening Cascades for Ion-Channel Drug Discovery: Linking Structure, Electrophysiology, Safety Pharmacology, and Human-Relevant Models.
titleZh: 离子通道药物发现的整合筛选级联：连接结构、电生理学、安全药理学和人类相关模型。

authors: Seo Y.
affiliations: Department of Physiology, Dongguk University College of Medicine, Gyeongju 38066, Republic of Korea.
abstract: Ion channels are validated drug targets, but they remain difficult to study as their pharmacology is influenced by rapid gating, conformational state transitions, cell-type-specific expression, and narrow safety margins. Recent advances in cryo-electron microscopy, structure-based in silico screening, machine-learning-guided prioritization, optical high-throughput screening, automated patch-clamp electrophysiology, and human-relevant organoid or microphysiological system (MPS) models are transforming this field. In this expanded review, we examine how these modalities can be integrated into a hybrid discovery pipeline that begins with computational triage, proceeds through scalable functional screening and state-aware electrophysiological validation, and concludes with multi-channel safety de-risking and translational analysis in complex human models. We also discuss disease-associated channel remodeling in cancer and inflammatory disorders, with an emphasis on transient receptor potential channels, voltage-gated potassium channel 1.3 (Kv1.3), Piezo channels, transmembrane protein 16A/anoctamin-1 (TMEM16A/ANO1), chloride channels, and proarrhythmic safety risks. Additionally, we highlight unresolved challenges, including bias in artificial intelligence models, incomplete conformational sampling, assay interference, organoid heterogeneity, and regulatory acceptance of MPS platforms. This review proposes a staged decision framework in which computational prioritization, scalable functional screening, direct electrophysiological confirmation, safety pharmacology, DMPK assessment, and disease-relevant human models serve as complementary filters rather than competing platforms for the identification of selective and translatable ion-channel therapeutics.
abstractZh: 离子通道是经过验证的药物靶点，但由于其药理学受快速门控、构象状态转换、细胞类型特异性表达和狭窄安全范围的影响，它们仍然难以研究。冷冻电子显微镜、基于结构的计算机筛选、机器学习引导的优先级排序、光学高通量筛选、自动化膜片钳电生理学以及人类相关类器官或微生理系统（MPS）模型的最新进展正在改变这一领域。在这篇扩展综述中，我们探讨了如何将这些模式整合到一条混合发现管线中，该管线从计算分流开始，经过可扩展的功能筛选和状态感知的电生理学验证，最后在复杂的人类模型中进行多通道安全去风险化和转化分析。我们还讨论了癌症和炎症性疾病中与疾病相关的通道重塑，重点关注瞬时受体电位通道、电压门控钾通道1.3（Kv1.3）、Piezo通道、跨膜蛋白16A/anoctamin-1（TMEM16A/ANO1）、氯通道以及致心律失常安全风险。此外，我们强调了未解决的挑战，包括人工智能模型中的偏差、不完整的构象采样、测定干扰、类器官异质性以及MPS平台的监管接受度。本综述提出了一个分阶段决策框架，其中计算优先级排序、可扩展功能筛选、直接电生理学确认、安全药理学、DMPK评估和疾病相关人类模型作为互补的过滤器，而非竞争平台，用于识别选择性和可转化的离子通道治疗药物。

abstract: The development of physiologically relevant human model systems that recapitulate tissue architecture and cell-state dynamics remains a major challenge in studying breast development and early events in carcinogenesis. Conventional two-dimensional cultures and many three-dimensional systems fail to capture the structural organization and microenvironmental cues that define the human mammary gland. Here, we describe a reproducible method for generating three-dimensional human breast organoids from primary epithelial cells embedded within a defined hydrogel matrix composed of type I collagen, laminin, fibronectin, and hyaluronic acid. This system supports the progression of single cells through key stages of mammary morphogenesis, including progenitor expansion, epithelial patterning, and the formation of terminal ductal lobular unit-like structures, as well as the emergence of a mesenchyme-like compartment, over a 21-day culture period. We provide a step-by-step protocol for hydrogel preparation, cell seeding and culture conditions. The method is compatible with high-content imaging and quantitative analysis of organoid number, size distribution, and architectural complexity. This platform enables mechanistic studies of epithelial plasticity and environmental perturbations, providing a scalable and biologically relevant system for investigating early tissue-level changes associated with breast cancer risk.
abstractZh: 开发能够重现组织结构与细胞状态动态的生理相关人类模型系统，仍是研究乳腺发育及癌变早期事件的主要挑战。传统的二维培养和许多三维系统无法捕捉定义人类乳腺的结构组织和微环境线索。在此，我们描述了一种可重复的方法，用于从嵌入由I型胶原、层粘连蛋白、纤连蛋白和透明质酸组成的明确水凝胶基质中的原代上皮细胞生成三维人类乳腺类器官。该系统支持单细胞经历乳腺形态发生的关键阶段，包括祖细胞扩增、上皮模式形成以及末端导管小叶单位样结构的形成，并在21天的培养期内出现间充质样区室。我们提供了水凝胶制备、细胞接种和培养条件的逐步方案。该方法与高内涵成像以及类器官数量、大小分布和结构复杂性的定量分析兼容。该平台能够进行上皮可塑性和环境扰动的机制研究，为研究与乳腺癌风险相关的早期组织水平变化提供了一个可扩展且生物学相关的系统。

title: Zebrafish as a translational platform for investigating multi-organ pharmacological interactions of traditional Chinese medicine.

abstract: The advancement of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) requires model systems capable of dissecting its multi-component, multi-target pharmacology in a rapid and systematic manner. This review presents the zebrafish as a versatile in vivo pharmacological platform for modern TCM research, not merely a screening tool. We synthesize its recent applications across cardiovascular, neuropsychiatric, metabolic, and oncological diseases, emphasizing how optical transparency and genetic tractability enable real-time quantification of multi-target interactions - for instance, dose-dependent heart rate changes, neutrophil migration distances, and tumor fluorescence intensities - thereby linking molecular pathways to whole-organism phenotypic outcomes. A dedicated section critically evaluates its role in mechanistic safety assessment, moving beyond descriptive toxicology toward elucidation of adverse outcome pathways. We then identify current limitations where the zebrafish's potential is underutilized, such as in resolving the spatiotemporal dynamics of herbal formula compatibility. Finally,we propose "zebrafish-plus" paradigms integrating organoids, single-cell multi-omics, and AI-driven phenotypic analytics. These frameworks are designed to generate testable mechanistic hypotheses and perform early efficacy/safety profiling, while explicitly recognizing that all zebrafish-derived findings require rigorous validation in mammalian models before clinical interpretation.
abstractZh: 中药（TCM）的发展需要能够快速、系统地解析其多组分、多靶点药理学特性的模型系统。本综述将斑马鱼定位为现代中药研究中一种多功能、体内药理学平台，而不仅仅是筛选工具。我们综合了斑马鱼在心血管、神经精神、代谢和肿瘤疾病中的最新应用，强调其光学透明性和遗传可操作性如何实现多靶点相互作用的实时定量——例如，剂量依赖性心率变化、中性粒细胞迁移距离和肿瘤荧光强度——从而将分子通路与整个生物体的表型结果联系起来。专门章节批判性地评估了其在机制性安全性评估中的作用，超越了描述性毒理学，转向阐明不良结局通路。随后，我们指出了当前斑马鱼潜力未被充分利用的局限性，例如在解析草药配方相容性的时空动态方面。最后，我们提出了“斑马鱼+”范式，整合类器官、单细胞多组学和人工智能驱动的表型分析。这些框架旨在生成可检验的机制假说并进行早期疗效/安全性评估，同时明确认识到所有源自斑马鱼的发现均需在哺乳动物模型中进行严格验证，方可进行临床解读。

abstract: HER2-positive tumors persist as a formidable therapeutic challenge despite advances in targeted agents, chemotherapy, and immunotherapy. Recently, messenger RNA (mRNA) vaccines have emerged as promising avenues for the treatment of advanced tumors and their recurrence, although their clinical application remains challenging. Herein, we developed lipid nanoparticle (LNP)-encapsulated nucleoside-modified mRNA vaccines encoding the modified extracellular domain (ECD) sequence from rat HER2 (rHER2 ECD mRNA-LNP) and human HER2 (hHER2 ECD mRNA-LNP). While both vaccines elicited effective tumor inhibition, the hHER2 ECD mRNA-LNP demonstrated superior prophylactic and therapeutic efficacy in vivo, and successfully induced potent, antigen-restricted cytotoxicity against human patient-derived organoids (PDOs) ex vivo. Mechanistically, it enhances both humoral and T cell responses, and reprograms CD8+ tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs) by reducing exhaustion, promoting effector maturation, and inducing memory T cells. Specifically, a reduction in naive-like T cell clusters coupled with an elevation in cycling T cell clusters underpins the vaccine's efficacy. Furthermore, HER2 epitope-specific T cell receptor β-chain variable/joining (Trbv/Trbj) combinations and complementarity-determining region 3 (CDR3) motifs were identified as key contributors to the antigen-specific tumoricidal activity. Crucially, combining the hHER2 ECD mRNA-LNP vaccine with programmed cell death-1 (PD-1) immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) achieves superior antitumor efficacy compared to vaccine monotherapy. Moreover, combining the hHER2 ECD mRNA-LNP vaccine with standard chemoradiotherapy effectively potentiates the therapeutic efficacy against HER2-positive tumors. These findings highlight a promising agent for oncology and suggest that modified HER2 ECD mRNA-LNPs represent a viable and highly effective therapeutic strategy against HER2-positive malignancies.
abstractZh: 尽管靶向药物、化疗和免疫治疗取得了进展，HER2阳性肿瘤仍然是一个艰巨的治疗挑战。近年来，信使RNA（mRNA）疫苗已成为治疗晚期肿瘤及其复发的一种有前景的途径，尽管其临床应用仍面临挑战。在此，我们开发了脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）包裹的核苷修饰mRNA疫苗，编码来自大鼠HER2（rHER2 ECD mRNA-LNP）和人HER2（hHER2 ECD mRNA-LNP）的修饰胞外域（ECD）序列。虽然两种疫苗均能有效抑制肿瘤，但hHER2 ECD mRNA-LNP在体内表现出优越的预防和治疗效果，并成功诱导了针对人患者来源类器官（PDOs）的强效、抗原限制性细胞毒性（体外）。机制上，它增强了体液和T细胞反应，并通过减少耗竭、促进效应成熟和诱导记忆T细胞来重编程CD8+肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞（TILs）。具体而言，幼稚样T细胞簇的减少与循环T细胞簇的升高共同支撑了疫苗的疗效。此外，HER2表位特异性T细胞受体β链可变/连接（Trbv/Trbj）组合和互补决定区3（CDR3）基序被确定为抗原特异性肿瘤杀伤活性的关键贡献者。至关重要的是，将hHER2 ECD mRNA-LNP疫苗与程序性细胞死亡-1（PD-1）免疫检查点阻断（ICB）联合使用，与疫苗单药治疗相比，可获得更优的抗肿瘤疗效。此外，将hHER2 ECD mRNA-LNP疫苗与标准放化疗联合使用，可有效增强对HER2阳性肿瘤的治疗效果。这些发现突显了一种有前景的肿瘤治疗药物，并表明修饰的HER2 ECD mRNA-LNPs代表了一种针对HER2阳性恶性肿瘤的可行且高效的治療策略。

title: An intestinal cell atlas and organoid model for the threespine stickleback
titleZh: 三刺鱼肠道细胞图谱与类器官模型

authors: Padhiar AA, Nouri A, Keller S, Reinhardt E, Milligan-McClellan K, Carrier R, Steinel NC, Bolnick DI, Rodgers ML.
abstract: The intestine plays a crucial role in physiology, nutrition, and immune function, but intestinal anatomy and cell types have yet to be fully characterized in many fish species, the most diverse group of vertebrates. To address this gap, we characterized the structure and composition of the intestine of threespine stickleback (  Gasterosteus aculeatus ), an emerging model teleost in biological research. Using histology, myeloperoxidase staining, single-cell RNA sequencing, and RNA  in situ hybridization, we defined major intestinal epithelial, immune, stromal, and stem/progenitor populations. Goblet cells were abundant in proximal and hindgut, while myeloperoxidase-positive granulocytes were evenly distributed throughout the intestine. To facilitate future experimental studies of stickleback intestinal function, we also developed the first intestinal organoid culture from stickleback and show that these cultures recapitulate epithelial architecture and retain expression of canonical intestinal epithelial markers. This organoid platform enables future functional studies of mucosal immunity, host-microbe interactions, and intestinal physiology in stickleback and related teleosts. Together, our integrated approach provides a comprehensive cell atlas and a novel experimental model for studying digestive and immune functions in threespine stickleback.
abstractZh: 肠道在生理、营养和免疫功能中起着至关重要的作用，但在许多鱼类——这一最多样化的脊椎动物类群中，肠道的解剖结构和细胞类型尚未被完全表征。为弥补这一空白，我们对三刺鱼（Gasterosteus aculeatus）——一种新兴的生物学研究模式硬骨鱼——的肠道结构和组成进行了表征。利用组织学、髓过氧化物酶染色、单细胞RNA测序和RNA原位杂交技术，我们定义了主要的肠道上皮、免疫、基质和干/祖细胞群体。杯状细胞在近端和后肠中丰富，而髓过氧化物酶阳性的粒细胞在整个肠道中均匀分布。为了促进未来对三刺鱼肠道功能的实验研究，我们还开发了首个来自三刺鱼的肠道类器官培养体系，并证明这些培养物能够重现上皮结构并保留典型肠道上皮标志物的表达。该类器官平台使得未来对三刺鱼及相关硬骨鱼的黏膜免疫、宿主-微生物互作和肠道生理的功能研究成为可能。总之，我们的综合方法为研究三刺鱼的消化和免疫功能提供了全面的细胞图谱和一种新型实验模型。

authors: Schäfer P, Corna A, Kurth T, Hain V, Schön A, Ferguson S, Cojocaru A, Rabesandratana O, Allan L, Decembrini S, Arias JER, Goureau O, Santos-Ferreira T, Zeck G, Ader M.
abstract:
ABSTRACT

  Cell replacement represents a potential treatment modality for retinal disorders characterized by photoreceptor loss. However, photoreceptor replacement approaches have not been clinically established. To take this forward, the main goal of this study was to systematically compare human photoreceptors of different ages and identify those that enable functional integration into the degenerative retina. Donor cells were isolated from iPSC-derived retinal organoids generated by a GMP-compliant protocol at differentiation days 120, 150, or 200 and transplanted subretinally into cone photoreceptor function loss 1 (Cpfl1) recipients, an inherited mouse model of cone degeneration. While younger photoreceptors showed slightly improved transplantation outcomes, donor photoreceptors of all culture stages displayed long-term survival, cone identity, structural integration into the host retina, and tight interactions with host Müller glia, including formation of a continuous outer limiting membrane. Transplanted photoreceptors showed signs of advanced maturation, including correct polarization with generation of apical inner- and outer segments, while basal synapses were formed with host bipolar cells. Electrophysiological assessment of host retinal ganglion cells revealed light-evoked responses in transplant-containing regions, providing evidence for functional incorporation of human photoreceptors into the mouse neuro-retinal circuitry. Thus, GMP-compliant human iPSC-derived photoreceptors are stable over a wide range of differentiation stages and constitute a robust cell source for retinal transplantation and functional repair. The findings provide important prerequisites for the development of standardized procedures towards clinical translation of photoreceptor replacement in the retina. Significant statement

  Cell transplantation represents a potential therapy for retinal dystrophies. However, conditions allowing stable functional integration and maturation of donor photoreceptors have not been defined. We systematically compared GMP-compliant iPSC-derived photoreceptors of different culture times after transplantation into a retinal degeneration mouse model. Photoreceptors of all ages showed structural integration and advanced maturation in close interaction with host Müller glia and bipolar cells, allowing restoration of light-driven responses. Thus human photoreceptors isolated from retinal organoids represent a robust source for clinical development of cell replacement in the diseased retina.
abstractZh:
摘要

  细胞替代代表了以光感受器丧失为特征的视网膜疾病的一种潜在治疗方式。然而，光感受器替代方法尚未在临床上确立。为了推进这一进程，本研究的主要目标是系统比较不同年龄的人类光感受器，并确定那些能够功能性整合到退行性视网膜中的光感受器。供体细胞从由符合GMP规范的方案生成的分化第120、150或200天的iPSC来源视网膜类器官中分离，并视网膜下移植到视锥细胞功能丧失1（Cpfl1）受体小鼠中，这是一种遗传性视锥细胞变性小鼠模型。虽然较年轻的光感受器显示出略微改善的移植结果，但所有培养阶段的供体光感受器均表现出长期存活、视锥细胞特性、与宿主视网膜的结构整合以及与宿主Müller胶质细胞的紧密相互作用，包括形成连续的外界膜。移植的光感受器显示出晚期成熟的迹象，包括正确的极性化并生成顶端内节和外节，而基底侧突触与宿主双极细胞形成。对宿主视网膜神经节细胞的电生理评估显示，在含有移植物的区域存在光诱发反应，为人类光感受器功能性整合到小鼠神经视网膜回路中提供了证据。因此，符合GMP规范的人类iPSC来源光感受器在广泛的分化阶段中保持稳定，构成视网膜移植和功能性修复的稳健细胞来源。这些发现为开发标准化程序以推动光感受器替代在视网膜中的临床转化提供了重要先决条件。重要声明

  细胞移植代表了视网膜营养不良的一种潜在疗法。然而，允许供体光感受器稳定功能性整合和成熟的条件尚未明确。我们系统比较了移植到视网膜变性小鼠模型后不同培养时间的符合GMP规范的iPSC来源光感受器。所有年龄的光感受器均显示出结构整合和晚期成熟，并与宿主Müller胶质细胞和双极细胞密切相互作用，从而恢复光驱动反应。因此，从视网膜类器官中分离的人类光感受器代表了在病变视网膜中进行细胞替代临床开发的稳健来源。

title: Gene expression identifies regional central nervous system vulnerability to heat
titleZh: 基因表达揭示中枢神经系统对热的区域易感性
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Pagni S, Bouchama A, Sisodiya SM.
abstract: Heat-related illness is an increasing global health threat, with heatstroke representing its most severe form and frequently causing cerebellar injury characterised by selective Purkinje neuron loss. The molecular basis of this regional vulnerability remains unclear. Here, we integrated transcriptomic data from human heat exposure experiments, patients with heatstroke, primary human neurons, and cortical organoids to define conserved responses to heat stress and investigate determinants of cerebellar susceptibility. Across datasets, heat stress induced a highly conserved transcriptional programme dominated by suppression of ribosome biogenesis, RNA processing, translation, and metabolic pathways, consistent with reduced biosynthetic and energy-demanding activity. Mapping these signatures to human brain atlases revealed that the cerebellum showed the lowest enrichment of downregulated genes, while heatstroke exhibited a distinct regional transcriptional pattern compared with experimental heat exposure. At the cellular level, granule and Purkinje neurons showed the strongest association with heat-responsive gene suppression. Purkinje-enriched genes were linked to synaptic organisation, neurotransmission, membrane excitability, and ion transport. Connectivity Map analysis identified compounds predicted to reverse the heatstroke transcriptional signature, including the mTOR inhibitor KU-0063794. These findings identify a conserved molecular response to heat stress and suggest that selective Purkinje vulnerability reflects intrinsic metabolic and electrophysiological properties rather than preferential activation of canonical heat-shock pathways.
abstractZh: 热相关疾病是一个日益严重的全球健康威胁，其中热射病是其最严重的形式，常导致小脑损伤，特征为选择性浦肯野神经元丢失。这种区域易感性的分子基础仍不清楚。在此，我们整合了来自人体热暴露实验、热射病患者、原代人神经元和皮层类器官的转录组数据，以定义对热应激的保守反应并研究小脑易感性的决定因素。跨数据集，热应激诱导了一个高度保守的转录程序，主要特征是抑制核糖体生物发生、RNA加工、翻译和代谢通路，与减少生物合成和能量需求活动一致。将这些特征映射到人脑图谱显示，小脑在下调基因富集方面最低，而热射病与实验性热暴露相比表现出独特的区域转录模式。在细胞水平上，颗粒神经元和浦肯野神经元与热反应基因抑制的关联最强。浦肯野富集基因与突触组织、神经传递、膜兴奋性和离子转运相关。Connectivity Map分析确定了预测可逆转热射病转录特征的化合物，包括mTOR抑制剂KU-0063794。这些发现确定了对热应激的保守分子反应，并提示选择性浦肯野易感性反映了内在代谢和电生理特性，而非经典热休克通路的优先激活。

abstract: Osteonecrosis of the femoral head (ONFH) is a progressive, multifactorial bone disease characterized by ischemia-induced osteocyte death, microenvironmental imbalance, and failed tissue regeneration. According to recent advances in pathophysiological understanding, vascular injury, oxidative stress, and inflammatory storms form a pathogenic cascade leading to osteogenic dysfunction, adipogenic lineage drift of mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs), and epigenetic alterations that exacerbate bone degeneration. Despite improvements in early detection, traditional interventions-including bisphosphonates, hyperbaric oxygen therapy, and surgical decompression-have limited efficacy, particularly in the mid-to-late stages. This review systematically synthesizes emerging regenerative approaches across three domains: (1) Cellular and molecular therapies: Autologous MSC transplantation, exosomes, and apoptotic extracellular vesicles restore osteogenesis, modulate immunity, and promote angiogenesis, while gene-editing technologies such as CRISPR/Cas9 enhance MSC functionality. (2) Nanobiomaterial synergy: Enzyme-mimetic nanozymes and multifunctional polymeric scaffolds improve lesion targeting, reactive oxygen species clearance, and microenvironmental regulation. (3) Advanced bioengineering: Organoid models and 3D-bioprinted living joint prostheses enable the integration of vascularization, mechanical support, and precise drug delivery, representing transformative strategies in personalized repair. Together, these innovations highlight a future paradigm shift from passive support to active, mechanism-targeted regeneration, offering new hope for structural and functional reconstruction in ONFH. Multidisciplinary integration-bridging materials science, stem cell biology, and digital medicine-will be essential for successfully developing functional cures.
abstractZh: 股骨头坏死（ONFH）是一种进行性、多因素骨病，其特征为缺血诱导的骨细胞死亡、微环境失衡以及组织再生失败。根据病理生理学理解的最新进展，血管损伤、氧化应激和炎症风暴形成致病级联反应，导致成骨功能障碍、间充质干细胞（MSCs）的成脂谱系偏移以及加剧骨退化的表观遗传改变。尽管早期检测有所改进，传统干预措施——包括双膦酸盐、高压氧治疗和手术减压——疗效有限，尤其是在中晚期。本综述系统综合了三个领域的emerging再生方法：（1）细胞和分子疗法：自体MSC移植、外泌体和凋亡细胞外囊泡恢复成骨、调节免疫并促进血管生成，而CRISPR/Cas9等基因编辑技术增强MSC功能。（2）纳米生物材料协同：模拟酶的纳米酶和多功能聚合物支架改善病灶靶向、活性氧清除和微环境调节。（3）先进生物工程：类器官模型和3D生物打印活体关节假体实现血管化、机械支持和精确药物递送的整合，代表个性化修复的变革性策略。总之，这些创新突显了从被动支持向主动、机制靶向再生的未来范式转变，为ONFH的结构和功能重建提供了新希望。多学科整合——连接材料科学、干细胞生物学和数字医学——对于成功开发功能性治愈方法至关重要。

abstract:
Background

Cervical cancer remains a leading cause of cancer-related mortality in women, with high-risk HPV types (16, 18, 31, 33, 45, 52, and 58) playing a key role in its development. Platinum-based chemotherapy is standard for recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer, but platinum resistance remains a major challenge. The link between HPV infection and platinum resistance is not well understood. Tumor organoids offer a physiologically relevant model for investigating drug resistance mechanisms in cervical cancer.Results

We successfully established 37 cervical cancer organoids (CCOs), with 27 expanded for characterization and drug sensitivity testing. CCOs recapitulated the biomarker expression patterns and genomic features of their corresponding tissues. Drug sensitivity assays revealed increased cisplatin/carboplatin resistance in the non-HPV16 high-risk HPV CCOs subgroup, compared to HPV-negative CCOs. Single-cell RNA sequencing identified diverse cellular populations within CCOs, with platinum-resistant CCOs showing enhanced DNA repair, activation of the PI3K/AKT pathway, and suppressed apoptotic signaling. We also found that the PI3K/AKT inhibitor BYL719 enhanced the response to cisplatin and carboplatin in non-HPV16 high-risk HPV CCOs but not in HPV-negative CCOs.Conclusions

Cervical cancer organoids faithfully replicate the histopathological and genomic characteristics of their parental tumors, demonstrating their potential as preclinical models for studying cancer progression and drug resistance. Our findings suggest that the non-HPV16 high-risk HPV infections may contribute to increased platinum resistance through enhanced DNA repair mechanisms, increased PI3K/AKT activation and suppressed apoptosis, providing new insights for personalized cervical cancer treatment. The PI3K/AKT inhibitor BYL719 may serve as a potential therapeutic adjunct to enhance platinum efficacy in those patients with platinum-resistant cervical cancer.
abstractZh:
背景

宫颈癌仍然是女性癌症相关死亡的主要原因，高危型HPV（16、18、31、33、45、52和58型）在其发展中起关键作用。铂类化疗是复发或转移性宫颈癌的标准治疗，但铂耐药仍然是一个重大挑战。HPV感染与铂耐药之间的联系尚不完全清楚。肿瘤类器官为研究宫颈癌耐药机制提供了生理相关的模型。结果

我们成功建立了37个宫颈癌类器官（CCOs），其中27个扩增用于表征和药物敏感性测试。CCOs重现了其对应组织的生物标志物表达模式和基因组特征。药物敏感性测定显示，与HPV阴性CCOs相比，非HPV16高危型HPV CCOs亚组对顺铂/卡铂的耐药性增加。单细胞RNA测序鉴定了CCOs内的多种细胞群体，铂耐药CCOs显示出增强的DNA修复、PI3K/AKT通路激活和凋亡信号抑制。我们还发现，PI3K/AKT抑制剂BYL719增强了非HPV16高危型HPV CCOs对顺铂和卡铂的反应，但在HPV阴性CCOs中没有这种效果。结论

宫颈癌类器官忠实地复制了其亲本肿瘤的组织病理学和基因组特征，展示了其作为研究癌症进展和耐药性的临床前模型的潜力。我们的研究结果表明，非HPV16高危型HPV感染可能通过增强DNA修复机制、增加PI3K/AKT激活和抑制凋亡来促进铂耐药性的增加，为个性化宫颈癌治疗提供了新的见解。PI3K/AKT抑制剂BYL719可能作为潜在的辅助治疗手段，增强铂类耐药宫颈癌患者对铂类药物的疗效。

abstract:
Background

Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR)-T cell therapies have revolutionized the landscape of cancer treatment, particularly in hematological malignancies. However, their successful translation to solid tumors remains limited by several barriers, including immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment and on-target/off-tumor toxicity. One promising strategy to enhance efficacy of CAR-T cells is the rational selection of tumor-specific antigens coupled with engineering strategies that incorporate localized immune modulation, such as CAR-T cells secreting immune checkpoint-blocking anti-PD-L1 scFv.Methods

To better model therapeutic responses, we established a dynamic real-time autologous co-culture platform integrating colorectal cancer (CRC) patient-derived organoids (PDOs) and CAR-T cells to assess infiltration, persistence, and cytotoxicity ex vivo. Although early clinical trials of mesothelin (MSLN)-directed CAR-T cells have demonstrated high safety, their anti-tumor efficacy remains modest, highlighting the need for improved constructs. Therefore, we engineered anti-MSLN-CAR4-T cells using fully human anti-MSLN scFv linked to a triple costimulatory backbone (CD28, 4-1BB, and CD27) fused to CD3ζ, and anti-MSLN-CAR5-T cells, incorporating an additional anti-PD-L1 scFv.Results

Both CAR4- and CAR5-T cells exhibited comparable cytotoxic efficacy against MSLNHigh/PD-L1High autologous PDOs. However, only anti-MSLN-CAR5-T cells were able to sustain potent killing activity against PD-L1High PDOs with high IFN-γ/cytolytic cytokine production at a low effector-to-target ratio (5:1), reflecting improved resilience to PD-L1-mediated suppression.Conclusions

Finally, our 14-day ex vivo CRC-PDOs/CAR-T platform provides a promising rapid and translational tool for tumor-associated antigen validation, streamlined PDO isolation, autologous CAR-T cytotoxicity testing, and personalized immunotherapy optimization in solid tumors.
abstractZh:
背景

嵌合抗原受体（CAR）-T细胞疗法已经彻底改变了癌症治疗的格局，尤其是在血液系统恶性肿瘤中。然而，其在实体瘤中的成功转化仍然受到多种障碍的限制，包括免疫抑制性肿瘤微环境和靶向/脱靶毒性。增强CAR-T细胞疗效的一种有前景的策略是合理选择肿瘤特异性抗原，并结合整合局部免疫调节的工程策略，例如分泌免疫检查点阻断性抗PD-L1单链可变区片段（scFv）的CAR-T细胞。方法

为了更好地模拟治疗反应，我们建立了一个动态实时自体共培养平台，整合了结直肠癌（CRC）患者来源类器官（PDOs）和CAR-T细胞，以离体评估浸润、持久性和细胞毒性。尽管间皮素（MSLN）靶向CAR-T细胞的早期临床试验已显示出高安全性，但其抗肿瘤疗效仍然有限，凸显了改进构建体的必要性。因此，我们使用完全人源抗MSLN scFv，连接至包含CD28、4-1BB和CD27的三重共刺激骨架，并融合CD3ζ，构建了抗MSLN-CAR4-T细胞；以及抗MSLN-CAR5-T细胞，其额外整合了抗PD-L1 scFv。结果

CAR4-和CAR5-T细胞对MSLN高表达/PD-L1高表达的自体PDOs均表现出相当的细胞毒性效力。然而，只有抗MSLN-CAR5-T细胞能够在低效靶比（5:1）下，对PD-L1高表达PDOs维持强效杀伤活性，并产生高水平的IFN-γ/溶细胞性细胞因子，反映出其对PD-L1介导的抑制具有更强的抵抗力。结论

最后，我们为期14天的离体CRC-PDOs/CAR-T平台为实体瘤中的肿瘤相关抗原验证、简化PDO分离、自体CAR-T细胞毒性测试以及个性化免疫治疗优化提供了一个有前景的快速且可转化的工具。

abstract: Renal cell carcinoma (RCC) has been known as highly malignant and resistant to standard therapy due to its immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment and aberrant VEGF-mediated angiogenesis. To overcome these therapeutic limitations, here we assessed the therapeutic efficacy of an oncolytic adenovirus (oAd) co-expressing Interleukin-12 (IL-12) and a short hairpin RNA against VEGF (shVEGF) in combination with immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs). The oAd/IL12/shVEGF induced RCC-specific cancer cell death in vitro and 3D bioprinted model, leading to greater anti-tumor effect compared with oAd-GMCSF. Furthermore, it potentiates anti-tumor efficacy in RCC orthotopic tumor model. The potent antitumor effect induced by combination of oAd/IL12/shVEGF with anti-PD1 was due to CD4 + or CD8 + T cell- or NK cell-mediated antitumor immune response and effective inhibition of tumor-associated neovascularization. Collectively, oAd/IL12/shVEGF can be a potent strategy to overcome current limitations in conventional RCC therapy by converting the cold tumor microenvironment to an inflamed state to sensitize refractory tumors to ICIs.
abstractZh: 肾细胞癌（RCC）因其免疫抑制性肿瘤微环境和异常的VEGF介导的血管生成而被认为是高度恶性且对标准治疗耐药的肿瘤。为克服这些治疗局限性，我们在此评估了共表达白细胞介素-12（IL-12）和靶向VEGF的短发夹RNA（shVEGF）的溶瘤腺病毒（oAd）联合免疫检查点抑制剂（ICIs）的治疗效果。oAd/IL12/shVEGF在体外和3D生物打印模型中诱导了RCC特异性癌细胞死亡，与oAd-GMCSF相比产生了更强的抗肿瘤效果。此外，它在RCC原位肿瘤模型中增强了抗肿瘤疗效。oAd/IL12/shVEGF与抗PD1联合诱导的强效抗肿瘤作用归因于CD4+或CD8+T细胞或NK细胞介导的抗肿瘤免疫反应以及对肿瘤相关新生血管形成的有效抑制。总之，oAd/IL12/shVEGF通过将冷肿瘤微环境转化为炎症状态，使难治性肿瘤对ICIs敏感，可能成为克服当前常规RCC治疗局限性的有效策略。

abstract: Mitochondria have evolved a specialized mitochondrial unfolded protein response (UPRmt) to maintain proteostasis and promote recovery under stress. Studies in simple organisms have shown that UPRmt activation in glial cells supports proteostasis through beneficial non-cell-autonomous communication with neurons. However, the role of mitochondrial stress responses in the human brain remains unclear. To address this gap, we investigated the cell-type-specific effects of mitochondrial proteotoxic stress using human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived neuronal and glial cultures, as well as brain organoids. Here we show that mitochondrial proteotoxic stress induces metabolic rewiring in human microglia, marked by depletion of S-adenosylmethionine and lipid remodeling, ultimately leading to a senescent phenotype. Using human neuronal-glial tricultures and microglia-containing brain organoids, we identified the specific contributions of microglia to brain senescence and mitochondrial stress-driven neurodegenerative processes. UPRmt activation disrupts microglial communication with neighboring cells, triggering inflammatory signaling and impairing proteostasis. Together, these findings reveal how impaired mitochondrial proteostasis alters intercellular networks and identify a critical role for the UPRmt in neurodegenerative disease pathogenesis.
abstractZh: 线粒体进化出专门的线粒体未折叠蛋白反应（UPRmt）以维持蛋白质稳态并在应激下促进恢复。对简单生物体的研究表明，胶质细胞中UPRmt的激活通过有益的、非细胞自主的与神经元的通讯来支持蛋白质稳态。然而，线粒体应激反应在人脑中的作用仍不清楚。为弥补这一空白，我们使用人诱导多能干细胞来源的神经元和胶质细胞培养物以及脑类器官，研究了线粒体蛋白毒性应激的细胞类型特异性效应。在此我们表明，线粒体蛋白毒性应激诱导人小胶质细胞的代谢重编程，其特征是S-腺苷甲硫氨酸耗竭和脂质重塑，最终导致衰老表型。利用人神经元-胶质细胞三培养物和含小胶质细胞的脑类器官，我们确定了小胶质细胞对脑衰老和线粒体应激驱动的神经退行性过程的具体贡献。UPRmt激活破坏小胶质细胞与邻近细胞的通讯，触发炎症信号并损害蛋白质稳态。总之，这些发现揭示了线粒体蛋白质稳态受损如何改变细胞间网络，并确定了UPRmt在神经退行性疾病发病机制中的关键作用。

abstract: Soman is a potent organophosphorus nerve agent (OPNA) that exerts its toxicity by irreversibly inhibiting acetylcholinesterase (AChE) via rapid aging. Nevertheless, the pathogenic mechanisms responsible for cognitive deficits following subacute soman exposure are poorly defined, representing a significant unmet medical need due to the absence of effective adjunctive treatments. Combined metabolomic and proteomic profiling reveals that ferroptosis-a regulated cell death process driven by lipid peroxidation-is implicated in cognitive decline following soman exposure. We developed a ferroptosis inhibitor Ferrostatin-1 (Fer-1, 2 mg/kg) treatment plan (2 mg/kg Fer-1 30 min before being subjected to soman challenge for 14 days) that effectively ameliorated soman-induced cognitive deficits and neuronal injury. Furthermore, our findings revealed that Fer-1 administration significantly suppressed AA mediated-neuroinflammatory and lipid peroxidation via ACSL4/GPX4 regulation, and restored redox imbalance by modulating the SLC7A11/GPX4 axis and glutamate-glutamine metabolism. Meanwhile, Fer-1 mitigated iron dyshomeostasis by attenuating NCOA4/FTH1-mediated ferritinophagy. Importantly, Fer-1 restored both mitochondrial respiration and dynamics. This was achieved by reversing soman-induced deficits in ATP synthesis and complexes I-III activity (linked to impaired Fe-S cluster biogenesis) and by regulating the expression of DRP1, OPA1, and MFN2 proteins. Finally, Pharmacodynamic evaluations demonstrated that both ACSL4 inhibitors and iron chelators effectively inhibited ferroptosis in the brain organoid model, suggesting their potential as neuroprotective agents. Collectively, our study demonstrated that subacute soman exposure-induced ferroptosis plays an important role in the development and progression of cognitive impairment, and inhibition of ferroptosis may be a potential therapeutic approach to prevent soman-induced cognitive impairment.
abstractZh: 索曼是一种强效的有机磷神经毒剂（OPNA），通过快速老化不可逆地抑制乙酰胆碱酯酶（AChE）而发挥其毒性。然而，亚急性索曼暴露后认知缺陷的致病机制尚不明确，由于缺乏有效的辅助治疗，这代表了一个重大的未满足医疗需求。结合代谢组学和蛋白质组学分析揭示，铁死亡——一种由脂质过氧化驱动的调节性细胞死亡过程——与索曼暴露后的认知衰退有关。我们制定了一种铁死亡抑制剂Ferrostatin-1（Fer-1，2 mg/kg）治疗方案（在索曼攻击前30分钟给予2 mg/kg Fer-1，持续14天），该方案有效改善了索曼诱导的认知缺陷和神经元损伤。此外，我们的研究结果表明，Fer-1给药通过ACSL4/GPX4调节显著抑制了AA介导的神经炎症和脂质过氧化，并通过调节SLC7A11/GPX4轴和谷氨酸-谷氨酰胺代谢恢复了氧化还原平衡。同时，Fer-1通过减弱NCOA4/FTH1介导的铁蛋白自噬来缓解铁稳态失调。重要的是，Fer-1恢复了线粒体呼吸和动力学。这是通过逆转索曼诱导的ATP合成和复合物I-III活性缺陷（与Fe-S簇生物合成受损相关）以及调节DRP1、OPA1和MFN2蛋白的表达来实现的。最后，药效学评估表明，ACSL4抑制剂和铁螯合剂在脑类器官模型中均能有效抑制铁死亡，表明它们具有作为神经保护剂的潜力。总的来说，我们的研究表明，亚急性索曼暴露诱导的铁死亡在认知障碍的发生和发展中起着重要作用，抑制铁死亡可能是预防索曼诱导的认知障碍的潜在治疗策略。

abstract: We developed a pan-cancer patient-derived organoid (PDO) platform comprising 220 PDOs from 191 patients across 15 cancer types to advance functional precision oncology. Comprehensive characterization demonstrated high fidelity to parent tumors, with 93% histopathology concordance, 80% median genomic concordance for driver mutations, and a 0.85 median gene expression correlation. Expression profiles remained largely stable over 10 passages, ensuring reproducibility for long-term screening. Clonality analysis showed that 85% of dominant tumor clones were preserved, with genomic concordance directly reflecting clonal similarity. Even PDOs with lower concordance retained key oncogenic drivers, validating their utility as disease models. Functional assays revealed that 58% of PDOs from patients ineligible for US Food and Drug Administration-approved poly(adenosine 5'-diphosphate-ribose) polymerase inhibitors were sensitive to talazoparib, linked to DNA damage repair alterations. Furthermore, combination screens identified agents that overcome resistance, particularly in TP53-mutant models. Our platform enables the investigation of targeted therapies and molecular drivers of drug sensitivity, providing translational insights for personalized treatment beyond current biomarker guidelines.
abstractZh: 我们开发了一个泛癌症患者来源类器官（PDO）平台，包含来自191名患者的220个PDO，覆盖15种癌症类型，以推进功能性精准肿瘤学。全面表征显示与亲本肿瘤的高度保真度，组织病理学一致性为93%，驱动基因突变的中位基因组一致性为80%，基因表达相关性中位数为0.85。表达谱在10代内基本保持稳定，确保了长期筛选的可重复性。克隆性分析显示，85%的优势肿瘤克隆得以保留，基因组一致性直接反映了克隆相似性。即使一致性较低的PDO也保留了关键致癌驱动因素，验证了其作为疾病模型的有效性。功能分析显示，58%不符合美国食品药品监督管理局批准的聚（腺苷5'-二磷酸核糖）聚合酶抑制剂使用条件的患者的PDO对talazoparib敏感，这与DNA损伤修复改变相关。此外，联合筛选确定了能够克服耐药的药物，特别是在TP53突变模型中。我们的平台能够研究靶向治疗和药物敏感性的分子驱动因素，为超越当前生物标志物指南的个性化治疗提供转化见解。

title: Spheroids and organoids to study long noncoding RNAs in cancer: how they could replace animal models.

abstract: Spheroids, organoids, and further three-dimensional cellular models represent an intermediate stage of supra-cellular complexity between monolayered cell cultures and animal models. In the present review, we identified conditions in which spheroids and organoids could replace animal models in biomedical research, using long noncoding RNA (lncRNA) research in cancer as a study object. In tumor spheroids and patient-derived organoids, chemosensitivity can be enhanced through therapeutic overexpression or silencing of specific lncRNAs (depending on the lncRNA and context), which then decreases spheroid/organoid size or formation efficiency. These outcomes consistently mimic observations in xenograft mouse models, in which the same lncRNA intervention decreases tumor volume. Therefore, as a proxy of tumor growth assessment, animal models could be largely replaced with spheroids or organoids, taking advantage of their inexpensiveness and patient-specific features, respectively. The use of animal models could be restricted to bystander or pleiotropic effects, such as the assessment of parameters including metastasis and survival rates.
abstractZh: 球体、类器官以及进一步的三维细胞模型代表了单层细胞培养与动物模型之间的一个超细胞复杂性的中间阶段。在本综述中，我们以癌症中的长链非编码RNA（lncRNA）研究为对象，确定了球体和类器官在生物医学研究中可以替代动物模型的条件。在肿瘤球体和患者来源的类器官中，通过治疗性过表达或沉默特定lncRNA（取决于lncRNA和背景），可以增强化疗敏感性，从而降低球体/类器官的大小或形成效率。这些结果与异种移植小鼠模型中的观察结果一致，在后者中，相同的lncRNA干预会减小肿瘤体积。因此，作为肿瘤生长评估的替代指标，动物模型可以在很大程度上被球体或类器官所替代，分别利用其成本低廉和患者特异性的特点。动物模型的使用可以仅限于旁观者效应或多效性效应，例如评估转移和生存率等参数。

abstract: B cells in the human immune system (HIS) mice exhibit weak responses to external antigens, characterized by insufficient antigen-specific B cell proliferation, low antibody titers, and a lack of differentiation into effector B cell subsets. We hypothesize that this failure is due to the absence of second signals provided by T cells following BCR stimulation. To address this, we developed an organoid screening system using HIS mouse splenocytes to identify missing signals. A combination of IL-4, IL-10, IL-21 together with CD40L was found to drive potent B cell proliferation and differentiation. Further organoid-based screening revealed that TNF-α and CpG synergistically promoted IgG class-switch, and that temporal separation of expansion and differentiation signals enhanced B cell responses. Translating these findings in vivo, CpG-adjuvanted vaccination followed by sequential i.v. delivery of expansion and differentiation cytokine mixtures induced antigen-specific B cell expansion, B cell differentiation, and IgG class-switch in HIS mice without affecting non-specific B cells. Sorting RBD-specific B cells from immunized mice yielded recombinant antibodies with high binding affinity and neutralizing activity against SARS-CoV-2 pseudovirus. Our study establishes a spleen organoid platform for screening factors that influence B cell responses in HIS mice and provides a generalizable strategy to obtain fully human antibodies for therapeutic development.
abstractZh: 人免疫系统（HIS）小鼠中的B细胞对外部抗原表现出弱反应，其特征是抗原特异性B细胞增殖不足、抗体滴度低以及缺乏向效应B细胞亚群的分化。我们假设这种失败是由于BCR刺激后T细胞提供的第二信号缺失所致。为了解决这个问题，我们开发了一种使用HIS小鼠脾细胞的类器官筛选系统来识别缺失的信号。发现IL-4、IL-10、IL-21与CD40L的组合能够驱动强烈的B细胞增殖和分化。进一步的基于类器官的筛选揭示，TNF-α和CpG协同促进IgG类别转换，并且扩增和分化信号的时间分离增强了B细胞反应。将这些发现转化为体内实验，CpG佐剂疫苗接种后依次静脉注射扩增和分化细胞因子混合物，在HIS小鼠中诱导了抗原特异性B细胞扩增、B细胞分化和IgG类别转换，而不影响非特异性B细胞。从免疫小鼠中分选RBD特异性B细胞，获得了对SARS-CoV-2假病毒具有高结合亲和力和中和活性的重组抗体。我们的研究建立了一个脾脏类器官平台，用于筛选影响HIS小鼠B细胞反应的因素，并提供了一种获得用于治疗开发的全人源抗体的通用策略。

abstract: Intravesical therapies are the mainstay of bladder cancer (BCa) management, but their efficacy is limited by toxicities and recurrences. While CAR T cell therapy has shown promise in hematologic malignancies, its application in solid tumors is limited by poor trafficking and on-target off-tumor toxicities. Here, we identify and validate MUC16 as a clinically relevant target for BCa, noting enriched expression in tumors recalcitrant to existing therapies. We engineered a second-generation mesothelin-based CAR (MSLN-28z) and demonstrated robust activity across multiple BCa cell lines and patient-derived tumor organoids. Intravesical delivery of MSLN-28z CAR T cells in xenograft BCa models conferred superior tumor control compared with intravenous transfer, while attenuating systemic T cell engraftment. Intravesical adoptive transfer uncouples local antitumor efficacy from potential systemic toxicity-a feature conserved across several T cell immunotherapies with on-target off-tumor activity. Collectively, these findings substantiate MUC16 as a therapeutic candidate and validate intravesical delivery as a platform for T cell immunotherapies in the management of organ-confined BCa.
abstractZh: 膀胱内治疗是膀胱癌（BCa）管理的主要手段，但其疗效受到毒性和复发的限制。尽管CAR T细胞疗法在血液系统恶性肿瘤中显示出前景，但其在实体瘤中的应用受到不良运输和靶向非肿瘤毒性的限制。在此，我们确定并验证MUC16作为BCa的临床相关靶点，注意到在现有疗法难以治疗的肿瘤中表达富集。我们设计了一种第二代基于间皮素的CAR（MSLN-28z），并在多个BCa细胞系和患者来源的肿瘤类器官中证明了其强大的活性。在异种移植BCa模型中，膀胱内递送MSLN-28z CAR T细胞与静脉输注相比，能实现更好的肿瘤控制，同时减弱全身性T细胞植入。膀胱内过继转移将局部抗肿瘤功效与潜在的全身毒性解耦——这一特征在几种具有靶向非肿瘤活性的T细胞免疫疗法中保守。总的来说，这些发现证实了MUC16作为治疗候选靶点，并验证了膀胱内递送作为器官局限性BCa管理中T细胞免疫疗法的平台。

title: Myokines in exercise‑mediated bone homeostasis: Molecular signaling mechanisms and therapeutic implications for bone disorders (Review).
titleZh: 运动介导的骨稳态中的肌因子：分子信号机制及对骨骼疾病的治疗意义（综述）

abstract: Skeletal muscle functions as an endocrine organ, secreting myokines that mediate interorgan communication with bone. Exercise‑induced myokines regulate bone homeostasis by orchestrating osteoblast differentiation, osteoclastogenesis, and osteocyte mechano‑sensing through key signaling pathways, including the Wnt/β‑catenin, mitogen‑activated protein kinase, phosphatidylinositol‑3‑kinase/AKT, nuclear factor kappa B and transforming growth factor‑beta/bone morphogenetic protein pathways. The present review provides a critical synthesis of the current evidence and proposes a conceptual framework for the tripartite muscle‑bone‑immune axis, which has not been systematically integrated into previous reviews. Emerging evidence highlights a tripartite muscle‑bone immune axis, wherein myokines modulate immune cells within the bone niche, with dysregulation contributing to age‑related osteoporosis and sarcopenia. Methodological innovations such as multi‑omics, single cell and spatial transcriptomics, organ‑on‑a‑chip platforms, and artificial intelligence are accelerating discovery. The present review synthesizes current knowledge on myokine mediated muscle‑bone crosstalk and evaluates the therapeutic implications for bone disorders.
abstractZh: 骨骼肌作为内分泌器官，分泌肌因子，介导与骨骼的器官间通讯。运动诱导的肌因子通过关键信号通路，包括Wnt/β-连环蛋白、丝裂原活化蛋白激酶、磷脂酰肌醇-3-激酶/AKT、核因子κB和转化生长因子-β/骨形态发生蛋白通路，协调成骨细胞分化、破骨细胞生成和骨细胞机械感知，从而调节骨稳态。本综述对当前证据进行了批判性综合，并提出了三方肌肉-骨骼-免疫轴的概念框架，该框架尚未被系统整合到以往的综述中。新兴证据强调三方肌肉-骨骼-免疫轴，其中肌因子调节骨微环境中的免疫细胞，其失调与年龄相关的骨质疏松症和肌少症有关。方法学创新，如多组学、单细胞和空间转录组学、器官芯片平台和人工智能，正在加速发现。本综述综合了关于肌因子介导的肌肉-骨骼串扰的当前知识，并评估了对骨骼疾病的治疗意义。

title: Patient cerebral organoids capture Alzheimer’s disease proteomic biomarkers and drug targets
titleZh: 患者脑类器官捕获阿尔茨海默病的蛋白质组学生物标志物和药物靶点
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Thomson S, Li XC, Walker S, Tang TC, Graham ME, Olechnowicz SW, Bowden R, Global Neurodegeneration Proteomics Consortium, Waugh KA, Slawson C, Burns JM, Swerdlow RH, Wilkins HM, Shvetcov A, Finney CA.
abstract:
ABSTRACT

  Patient iPSC-derived cerebral organoids are a leading human model of Alzheimer’s disease, yet their proteome has never been benchmarked against human disease. Clinical cohorts now nominate thousands of biomarkers and drug targets across three proteomic platforms, and whether patient organoids capture these candidates is unknown. Here, we profile AD and control cerebral organoids containing neurons, astrocytes, and microglia on the three platforms driving clinical discovery, mass spectrometry, SomaScan, and Olink, in both conditioned media and lysate. Benchmarked against 121 studies and clinical cohorts of over 17,000 plasma, CSF, and cortex samples, patient organoids detect almost every nominated candidate and reproduce the disease-associated change in roughly one in four of the most reproducible. This convergence spans plasma, CSF, and cortex, and extends to synaptic, mitochondrial, and proteostatic biology. We provide the first multi-platform reference proteome of a patient-derived AD model, establishing it as a translationally relevant system for studying AD.
abstractZh:
摘要

  患者诱导多能干细胞来源的脑类器官是阿尔茨海默病的领先人类模型，然而其蛋白质组从未与人类疾病进行过基准比较。临床队列现已在三个蛋白质组学平台上提名了数千种生物标志物和药物靶点，而患者类器官是否能捕获这些候选物尚不清楚。在此，我们对包含神经元、星形胶质细胞和小胶质细胞的AD和对照脑类器官进行了分析，使用了推动临床发现的三个平台：质谱法、SomaScan和Olink，分别检测条件培养基和裂解液。与121项研究和超过17,000份血浆、脑脊液及皮层样本的临床队列进行基准比较后，患者类器官几乎检测到所有提名的候选物，并在约四分之一最可重复的候选物中重现了疾病相关的改变。这种趋同跨越血浆、脑脊液和皮层，并延伸至突触、线粒体和蛋白质稳态生物学。我们提供了患者来源AD模型的第一个多平台参考蛋白质组，确立其作为研究AD的转化相关系统。

title: Modeling and validation of parallel co-flows layer widths in open-capillary trigger valve systems
titleZh: 开放毛细触发阀系统中平行共流层宽度的建模与验证
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Caira T, Tokihiro JC, Shaposhnikov A, Whitten JM, Su X, Shin A, Robertson IH, Nicholson TM, Olanrewaju AO, Berthier E, Theberge AB, Berthier J.
abstract: Control of fluids is a hallmark of microfluidic systems and fundamental for the successful application of microfluidic devices. Trigger valves use geometric features to autonomously control the release of fluids in microfluidic devices. Our previous work has adapted geometries used in closed trigger valve systems to enable use in open systems, allowing for open microfluidic devices with up to three trigger valves. Here, we focus on the parallel co-flows produced by sequential release of trigger valves and present a model that predicts their layer widths as a function of the geometric characteristics of the different side channels of each trigger valve. We show layered co-flows with widths as low as 50 microns. Additionally, we expand the use of trigger valves in open microfluidic devices by incorporating 1) varied step heights, 2) devices with up to seven trigger valves, and 3) use of varied fluids and plastics. To validate the implementation and use of these trigger valves in open systems, we have developed a theoretical framework to compare predicted outcomes (i.e., fluid travel distance, velocity, and layering width) with our experimental values. This theoretical work offers applications in various fields, including hydrogel patterning for 3D cell culture, organ-on-a-chip models, at-home sample preparation, and autonomous microfluidic systems for biosensing.
abstractZh: 流体控制是微流控系统的标志性特征，对于微流控设备的成功应用至关重要。触发阀利用几何特征自主控制微流控设备中流体的释放。我们先前的工作已调整封闭触发阀系统中使用的几何结构，使其能够应用于开放系统，从而允许具有多达三个触发阀的开放微流控设备。在此，我们聚焦于触发阀顺序释放产生的平行共流，并提出了一个模型，该模型根据每个触发阀不同侧通道的几何特征预测其层宽度。我们展示了宽度低至50微米的分层共流。此外，我们通过纳入1）变化的台阶高度，2）具有多达七个触发阀的设备，以及3）使用不同流体和塑料，扩展了触发阀在开放微流控设备中的应用。为了验证这些触发阀在开放系统中的实现和使用，我们开发了一个理论框架，将预测结果（即流体行进距离、速度和分层宽度）与我们的实验值进行比较。这项理论工作为各个领域提供了应用，包括用于3D细胞培养的水凝胶图案化、器官芯片模型、居家样本制备以及用于生物传感的自主微流控系统。

title: Targeting Cellular Pseudo-Senescence to Overcome PARP inhibitors Resistance in  BRCA1  -Mutated Breast Cancer
titleZh: 靶向细胞伪衰老以克服BRCA1突变乳腺癌中的PARP抑制剂耐药性
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Tian Z, Chatla S, Indulkar S, Kim D, Wei X, Liao Y, Yang D, Pompetti A, Calendo G, Wang C, Edmonston TB, Lou Z, Skorski T, Wang L, Huang J.
abstract:
Poly (ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) inhibitors (PARPi) are a mainstay therapy for homologous recombination (HR)-deficient cancers; however, resistance remains a major clinical challenge. Previously, through a genome wide CRISPR screen, we identified  ZNF251 haploinsufficiency as a novel driver of PARPi resistance. In  BRCA1 -mutant (  BRCA1 mut ) cells,  ZNF251 deficiency led to HR hyperactivation, conferring PARPi resistance that could be reversed by RAD51 inhibition. In this study, we further show that  ZNF251 deficiency induces replication stress and a pseudo-senescence state, in which cells exhibit molecular and phenotypic markers of senescence while retaining proliferative capacity. Because senomorphic and senolytic therapies can target senescent cells, we tested whether these approaches could overcome PARPi resistance in  ZNF251 -deficient breast cancer cells. Critically, targeting this senescence-like state with either senomorphic agents, such as cytokine inhibitors, or senolytic agents, such as BCL-2 and BCL-XL inhibitors, overcame PARPi resistance  ex vivo and  in vivo . Importantly, pseudo-senescence was also observed in other PARPi-resistant contexts driven by HR hyperactivation, including  53BP1 - and  Shieldin -mutant cells, suggesting that it may represent a broader mechanism underlying PARPi resistance in breast cancer. Furthermore, in two olaparib-resistant,  BRCA -mutant triple-negative breast cancer organoid models, treatment with DT2216, a BCL-XL–targeting PROTAC, sensitized both models to olaparib. Together, our work defines a novel pathway linking HR hyperactivation, replication stress, and pseudo-senescence, and positions both senomorphic and senolytic therapies as promising strategies to overcome PARPi resistance in  BRCA1 mut breast cancer.  Highlights

  ZNF251 deficiency drives PARP inhibitor resistance through HR hyperactivation, replication stress, and pseudo-senescence in  BRCA1 -mutant breast cancer.  Senomorphic and senolytic therapies overcome PARP inhibitor resistance  in vitro ,  in vivo , and in patient-derived organoid models.  Pseudo-senescence represents a shared vulnerability of HR-hyperactivated PARPi-resistant cancers and can be therapeutically targeted.
abstractZh: 聚（ADP-核糖）聚合酶（PARP）抑制剂（PARPi）是同源重组（HR）缺陷型癌症的主要治疗手段；然而，耐药性仍然是一个主要的临床挑战。此前，通过全基因组CRISPR筛选，我们确定ZNF251单倍剂量不足是PARPi耐药的一个新驱动因素。在BRCA1突变（BRCA1 mut）细胞中，ZNF251缺失导致HR过度激活，赋予PARPi耐药性，而这种耐药性可通过RAD51抑制逆转。在本研究中，我们进一步表明，ZNF251缺失诱导复制应激和伪衰老状态，在这种状态下，细胞表现出衰老的分子和表型标志物，同时保留增殖能力。由于衰老形态调节剂和衰老细胞清除剂疗法可以靶向衰老细胞，我们测试了这些方法是否能够克服ZNF251缺陷乳腺癌细胞中的PARPi耐药性。关键的是，用衰老形态调节剂（如细胞因子抑制剂）或衰老细胞清除剂（如BCL-2和BCL-XL抑制剂）靶向这种衰老样状态，在离体和体内均克服了PARPi耐药性。重要的是，在由HR过度激活驱动的其他PARPi耐药情境中，包括53BP1和Shieldin突变细胞，也观察到伪衰老，这表明它可能代表了乳腺癌中PARPi耐药的更广泛机制。此外，在两种奥拉帕尼耐药、BRCA突变的三阴性乳腺癌类器官模型中，使用DT2216（一种靶向BCL-XL的PROTAC）治疗，使两种模型对奥拉帕尼敏感。总之，我们的工作定义了一条连接HR过度激活、复制应激和伪衰老的新途径，并将衰老形态调节剂和衰老细胞清除剂疗法定位为克服BRCA1突变乳腺癌中PARPi耐药的有前景策略。亮点：ZNF251缺陷通过HR过度激活、复制应激和伪衰老驱动BRCA1突变乳腺癌中的PARP抑制剂耐药性。衰老形态调节剂和衰老细胞清除剂疗法在体外、体内和患者来源的类器官模型中克服PARP抑制剂耐药性。伪衰老是HR过度激活的PARPi耐药癌症的一个共同脆弱点，可以作为治疗靶点。

abstract: Efficient regeneration of the alveolar epithelium is essential for restoring lung function after injury, yet the mechanisms that govern alveolar type II cell (AT2) behavior remain insufficiently defined. Here, we identify the m⁶A RNA demethylase Alkbh5 as a pivotal regulator of AT2 cell activation and lineage progression. Conditional deletion of Alkbh5 in AT2 cells markedly enhances their proliferation and differentiation across diverse lung injury contexts-including fibrotic (bleomycin), inflammatory (LPS), mechanical (pneumonectomy), and oxidative (BHT) insults. Loss of Alkbh5 increases m⁶A modification on Amphiregulin (Areg) transcripts, stabilizing its mRNA and elevating Areg expression specifically within transitional AT2 populations. The resulting amplification of EGFR signaling drives accelerated AT2-to-AT1 differentiation and epithelial repair. Supplementation of recombinant Areg phenocopies the regenerative effects of Alkbh5 deletion, whereas Areg neutralization abrogates these responses, establishing Areg as a key downstream effector of Alkbh5. Importantly, ALKBH5 ablation or pharmacologic inhibition in human ESC-derived alveolar organoids similarly promote proliferation, differentiation, and AREG upregulation, demonstrating evolutionary conservation of this regulatory axis. Together, our findings reveal an Alkbh5-Areg-EGFR circuit that orchestrates alveolar epithelial regeneration and suggest new therapeutic opportunities for enhancing lung repair following injury.
abstractZh: 肺泡上皮的有效再生对于损伤后肺功能的恢复至关重要，然而调控肺泡II型细胞（AT2）行为的机制仍未被充分阐明。在此，我们确定m⁶A RNA去甲基化酶Alkbh5是AT2细胞激活和谱系进展的关键调控因子。在AT2细胞中条件性敲除Alkbh5可显著增强其在多种肺损伤情境下的增殖和分化，包括纤维化（博来霉素）、炎症（LPS）、机械性（肺切除）和氧化性（BHT）损伤。Alkbh5的缺失增加了双调蛋白（Areg）转录本上的m⁶A修饰，稳定其mRNA并在过渡性AT2群体中特异性上调Areg表达。由此导致的EGFR信号放大加速了AT2向AT1的分化和上皮修复。补充重组Areg可模拟Alkbh5缺失的再生效应，而Areg中和则消除这些反应，从而确立Areg为Alkbh5的关键下游效应因子。重要的是，在人类ESC来源的肺泡类器官中，ALKBH5的敲除或药物抑制同样促进增殖、分化和AREG上调，表明该调控轴在进化上具有保守性。总之，我们的发现揭示了一个协调肺泡上皮再生的Alkbh5-Areg-EGFR回路，并为增强损伤后肺修复提供了新的治疗机会。

abstract: Background/Objectives: Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains one of the leading causes of cancer-related morbidity and mortality worldwide. Despite advances in treatment, outcomes for advanced CRC remain unsatisfactory due to uncontrolled proliferation, metastasis, and recurrence. This study investigated the anti-cancer effects of KMU-11342, an indolin-2-one-based multi-protein kinase inhibitor with previously reported anti-inflammatory properties, in human colorectal cancer models. Methods: The anti-cancer effects of KMU-11342 were evaluated in colorectal cancer cells and further investigated in three-dimensional (3D) spheroid and patient-derived organoid models. Cell proliferation, migration, apoptosis, and cell cycle progression were assessed. Kinase activity profiling and molecular docking analyses were performed to identify potential targets and characterize the underlying signaling pathways. Results: KMU-11342 significantly inhibited the proliferation and migration of CRC cells. It reduced CRC cell density by 58.9% and 83.3% at 0.5 and 1 μM, respectively. These effects were accompanied by G2/M cell cycle arrest and apoptotic cell death. In 3D models, spheroid formation was markedly reduced and stemness-related characteristics were diminished. Patient-derived CRC organoids also showed decreased viability, exhibiting 38.6% and 77.4% reductions at 1 and 2 μM, respectively. These effects were observed in a dose-dependent manner in both two-dimensional (2D) and 3D colorectal cancer models. Kinase activity profiling and molecular docking analyses identified glycogen synthase kinase 3 beta (GSK3β) and cyclin-dependent kinase 1 (CDK1) as potential mediators of the anti-cancer effects of KMU-11342 through the p53/nuclear factor kappa B (NF-κB) and FoxO1 signaling axes, respectively. Conclusions: KMU-11342 exhibits potent anti-tumor activity against CRC through suppressing proliferation, migration, and stemness in both 2D and 3D models, including patient-derived organoids. Its effects may be mediated, at least in part, through modulation of GSK3β and CDK1 via the p53/NF-κB and FoxO1 signaling pathways.
abstractZh: 背景/目的：结直肠癌（CRC）仍然是全球癌症相关发病率和死亡率的主要原因之一。尽管治疗取得了进展，但由于不受控制的增殖、转移和复发，晚期CRC的预后仍不理想。本研究调查了KMU-11342（一种基于吲哚-2-酮的多蛋白激酶抑制剂，先前报道具有抗炎特性）在人类结直肠癌模型中的抗癌效果。方法：在结直肠癌细胞中评估了KMU-11342的抗癌效果，并进一步在三维（3D）球状体和患者来源的类器官模型中进行了研究。评估了细胞增殖、迁移、凋亡和细胞周期进程。进行了激酶活性谱分析和分子对接分析，以确定潜在靶点并表征相关信号通路。结果：KMU-11342显著抑制了CRC细胞的增殖和迁移。在0.5和1 μM浓度下，它分别将CRC细胞密度降低了58.9%和83.3%。这些效应伴随着G2/M细胞周期阻滞和凋亡性细胞死亡。在3D模型中，球状体形成显著减少，干性相关特征减弱。患者来源的CRC类器官也显示出活力下降，在1和2 μM浓度下分别降低了38.6%和77.4%。这些效应在二维（2D）和3D结直肠癌模型中均呈剂量依赖性。激酶活性谱分析和分子对接分析确定糖原合酶激酶3β（GSK3β）和细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶1（CDK1）分别是KMU-11342通过p53/核因子κB（NF-κB）和FoxO1信号轴发挥抗癌作用的潜在介质。结论：KMU-11342在2D和3D模型（包括患者来源的类器官）中通过抑制增殖、迁移和干性，表现出对CRC的强效抗肿瘤活性。其效应可能至少部分通过p53/NF-κB和FoxO1信号通路调节GSK3β和CDK1来介导。

title: Neurotoxic Effects of Aromatic Organophosphate Flame Retardants Revealed by Lipidomic Analysis in Human Brain Organoids.
