abstract: Cellular adaptive volume regulation is essential for maintaining metabolic homeostasis and supporting survival, yet its role in desmoplastic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) remains incompletely understood. Through comprehensive bioinformatic and functional studies, we identified LRRC8A, the core subunit of volume-regulated anion channels (VRAC), as a central regulator linking volume homeostasis to PDAC progression. Beyond its established role in osmotic stress responses, genetic silencing or pharmacological inhibition of LRRC8A revealed its critical function in proliferation-associated volumetric expansion during S-phase. Functional validation through in vitro proliferation assays, in vivo xenograft models, and patient-derived pancreatic cancer organoids (PDO) demonstrated that LRRC8A critically drives PDAC progression. Mechanistically, LRRC8A coordinates plasma membrane dynamics, cortical cytoskeletal organization, membrane-delimited oncogenic signaling (KRAS/EGFR), and nucleolar ribosome biogenesis to support volumetric expansion during S phase. Co-immunoprecipitation coupled with mass spectrometry identified that LRRC8A forms complexes with Caveolin 1 (CAV1). Disruption of LRRC8A leads to decreased CAV1 protein levels, impaired activation of KRAS and EGFR oncogenic signaling, and suppressed ribosome biogenesis and global protein synthesis. Reciprocally, CAV1 knockdown or cholesterol depletion using lovastatin destabilized LRRC8A in plasma membrane, resulting in reduced cortical F-actin organization, oncogenic signaling and biosynthetic activity, indicating that LRRC8A and CAV1 are mutually stabilized and depend on cholesterol-rich membrane microdomains for proper integration and function. Furthermore, disruption of LRRC8A-CAV1 axis through LRRC8A inhibition or cholesterol depletion potently suppressed PDO growth in vitro. Collectively, our work establishes the LRRC8A-CAV1 complex as a key coordinator of biosynthetic expansion and a promising therapeutic target in pancreatic cancer.
abstractZh: 细胞适应性体积调节对于维持代谢稳态和支持生存至关重要，但其在促结缔组织增生性胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）中的作用仍不完全清楚。通过全面的生物信息学和功能研究，我们确定了体积调节阴离子通道（VRAC）的核心亚基LRRC8A是连接体积稳态与PDAC进展的中心调节因子。除了其在渗透应激反应中的既定作用外，LRRC8A的基因沉默或药理学抑制揭示了其在S期增殖相关的体积扩张中的关键功能。通过体外增殖实验、体内异种移植模型和患者来源的胰腺癌类器官（PDO）进行的功能验证表明，LRRC8A关键地驱动PDAC进展。机制上，LRRC8A协调质膜动力学、皮层细胞骨架组织、膜限定的致癌信号（KRAS/EGFR）和核仁核糖体生物发生，以支持S期的体积扩张。免疫共沉淀结合质谱分析确定LRRC8A与Caveolin 1（CAV1）形成复合物。LRRC8A的破坏导致CAV1蛋白水平降低，KRAS和EGFR致癌信号激活受损，以及核糖体生物发生和全局蛋白质合成受抑制。相反，CAV1敲低或使用洛伐他汀进行胆固醇耗竭使质膜中的LRRC8A不稳定，导致皮层F-肌动蛋白组织、致癌信号和生物合成活性降低，表明LRRC8A和CAV1相互稳定，并依赖于富含胆固醇的膜微域进行正确的整合和功能。此外，通过LRRC8A抑制或胆固醇耗竭破坏LRRC8A-CAV1轴，可有效抑制PDO在体外的生长。总的来说，我们的工作确立了LRRC8A-CAV1复合物作为生物合成扩张的关键协调因子，并作为胰腺癌的一个有前景的治疗靶点。

abstract: The p.Pro23His (c.68C > A; P23H) mutation leads to autosomal dominant retinitis pigmentosa (adRP). Here, we reprogrammed adRP patient fibroblasts in human induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs) using Sendai virus. We then generated two mutated hiPSC clones and three isogenic controls using CRISPR/Cas9. All five hiPSC lines express pluripotency genes and are able to differentiate into the three germ layers as well as retinal organoids. Altogether, these hiPSCs constitute unique biological tools to elucidate mechanisms of adRP linked to the RHO-P23H mutation.
abstractZh: p.Pro23His（c.68C > A；P23H）突变导致常染色体显性视网膜色素变性（adRP）。在此，我们使用仙台病毒将adRP患者成纤维细胞重编程为人类诱导多能干细胞（hiPSCs）。随后，我们利用CRISPR/Cas9生成了两个突变hiPSC克隆和三个同基因对照。所有五个hiPSC细胞系均表达多能性基因，并能够分化为三个胚层以及视网膜类器官。总之，这些hiPSCs构成了独特的生物学工具，用以阐明与RHO-P23H突变相关的adRP机制。

title: Dissecting residual disease in spheroids reveals pan-cancer persistence signatures and a therapeutic window for oncolytic viruses.
titleZh: 解析球体中的残留疾病揭示泛癌持久性特征和溶瘤病毒的治疗窗口。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Fauveau C, Lawendy E, Deforges J, Cochin S, Moreau B, Balloul JM, Erbs P, Jain S, Laverny G, PERSIST-SEQ Consortium.
affiliations: Transgene, 67400 Illkirch-Graffenstaden, France.
Institute of Genetics and Molecular and Cellular Biology (IGBMC), 67404 Illkirch-Graffenstaden, France.
CNRS UMR 7104, 67404 Illkirch-Graffenstaden, France.
Inserm U1258, 67404 Illkirch-Graffenstaden, France.
University of Strasbourg, 67404 Illkirch-Graffenstaden, France.
abstract: Drug resistance remains a major burden in clinical care, often emerging from a subpopulation of cells in a drug-tolerant state. In this study, we aimed to characterize the transcriptional features of persistent non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) cells following cisplatin-pemetrexed chemotherapy and explore the therapeutic potency of oncolytic viruses to eliminate these cells. We established a 3D spheroid model of NSCLC and applied long-term chemotherapy to induce a reversible, non-proliferative persistent state associated with lower sensitivity to treatment. Single-cell RNA sequencing coupled with comparative analysis of multiple human datasets sheds light on a core transcriptional signature of persistence. This signature was enriched in patient-derived minimal residual disease (MRD) datasets, highlighting the clinical relevance of persistent preclinical models. Furthermore, transcriptomic analyses suggested a vulnerability of persister cells to oncolytic viruses, a finding validated in spheroid and patient-derived organoids. Altogether, these results define a conserved persistence signature and support the use of virotherapy as a promising option to target MRD.
abstractZh: 耐药性仍然是临床护理中的主要负担，通常源于处于药物耐受状态的细胞亚群。在本研究中，我们旨在表征非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）细胞在顺铂-培美曲塞化疗后持续存在的转录特征，并探索溶瘤病毒消除这些细胞的治疗潜力。我们建立了NSCLC的3D球体模型，并应用长期化疗诱导可逆的、非增殖性的持续状态，该状态与对治疗敏感性降低相关。单细胞RNA测序结合多个人类数据集的比较分析揭示了持久性的核心转录特征。该特征在患者来源的微小残留病（MRD）数据集中富集，突出了持久性临床前模型的临床相关性。此外，转录组分析表明持久性细胞对溶瘤病毒存在脆弱性，这一发现在球体和患者来源的类器官中得到了验证。总之，这些结果定义了保守的持久性特征，并支持使用病毒疗法作为靶向MRD的有前景的选择。

title: AF6 orchestrates macrophage polarization via JAK2-STAT3 signaling and supports intestinal regeneration by stimulating stem cell proliferation.
titleZh: AF6通过JAK2-STAT3信号通路协调巨噬细胞极化，并通过刺激干细胞增殖支持肠道再生。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Jian T, Dong X, Kong J, Wang X, Qi M, Zhan L, Zhuang L.
affiliations: Shanghai Institute of Nutrition and Health, Shanghai Institutes for Biological Sciences, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Shanghai, China.
State Key Laboratory of Systems Medicine for Cancer, Shanghai Cancer Institute, Renji Hospital Affiliated to Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine, Shanghai, China.
Yiwu Central Hospital, the Affiliated Yiwu Hospital of Wenzhou Medical University, Yiwu, China.
abstract:
Introduction

Macrophages play a central role in regulating intestinal inflammation, resolution, and tissue repair. However, the upstream regulators that govern their polarization during colitis remain poorly defined.Methods

In this study, we used a dextran sulfate sodium (DSS)-induced colitis model to investigate the role of the scaffold protein AF6 in colitis pathogenesis.Results

We identify AF6 as a key regulator that promotes pro-inflammatory macrophage polarization and exacerbates colitis. Mechanistically, AF6 expression promoted JAK-STAT3 complex formation. In turn, its deletion in macrophages resulted in impaired JAK-STAT3 signaling pathway and a shift away from pro-inflammatory M1 polarization. Furthermore, the AF6-deficient macrophages were determined to also promote epithelial regeneration through enhanced IL-10 production and downstream activation of Wnt/β-catenin signaling in intestinal organoids culture.Discussion

Thus, our study defines a therapeutically amenable AF6-JAK2-STAT3 axis that controls macrophage-driven pathogenesis in colitis, revealing a novel strategy to break the cycle of inflammation and impaired repair.
abstractZh:
引言

巨噬细胞在调节肠道炎症、消退和组织修复中发挥核心作用。然而，在结肠炎期间调控其极化的上游调节因子仍知之甚少。方法

在本研究中，我们使用葡聚糖硫酸钠（DSS）诱导的结肠炎模型来研究支架蛋白AF6在结肠炎发病机制中的作用。结果

我们确定AF6是促进促炎性巨噬细胞极化并加重结肠炎的关键调节因子。机制上，AF6表达促进了JAK-STAT3复合物的形成。反过来，在巨噬细胞中删除AF6导致JAK-STAT3信号通路受损，并偏离促炎性M1极化。此外，确定AF6缺陷的巨噬细胞还通过增强IL-10的产生和下游Wnt/β-catenin信号通路的激活，在肠道类器官培养中促进上皮再生。讨论

因此，我们的研究定义了一个可治疗的AF6-JAK2-STAT3轴，该轴控制结肠炎中巨噬细胞驱动的发病机制，揭示了一种打破炎症和修复受损循环的新策略。

title: Establishing Murine Intestinal Organoids to Study Nutrient- and Tastant-Evoked Gut Signaling.
titleZh: 建立小鼠肠道类器官以研究营养素和味觉物质诱发的肠道信号传导。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Kumar P, Ziegler F, Behrens M.
affiliations: Leibniz Institute for Food Systems Biology at the Technical University of Munich, 85354 Freising, Germany.
abstract: Background/Objectives: Numerous studies have investigated the responses of the gastrointestinal tract to tastants, particularly in specialized enteroendocrine and other chemosensory cells. However, many of these investigations used various taste stimuli often at high concentrations or relied on immortalized cell lines or heterogeneous cell populations, which can limit their physiological relevance and reproducibility. To establish a stable, physiologically representative model system for consistently investigating gut epithelial responses to tastants, our study developed 3D murine intestinal organoids (MIOs). Methods: Murine intestinal organoids were generated from isolated intestinal crypts and cultured under defined conditions to maintain epithelial differentiation. Organoids were stimulated with selected nutrients and tastants, and downstream signaling responses were assessed using hormone secretion assays. Results: The 3D MIO culture system was successfully established, providing a robust in vitro platform for studying extraoral bitter sensing and release of the enteroendocrine hormone cholecystokinin. Moreover, 5 mM denatonium benzoate and 30 mM L-glutamic acid specifically induced cholecystokinin secretion in MIOs, whereas other bitter or non-bitter stimuli did not. Conclusions: Murine intestinal organoids provide a stable model for studying nutrient- and tastant-evoked signaling in the gut. This approach enables precise investigation of underlying mechanisms and may advance our understanding of gut chemosensation and metabolic regulation.
abstractZh: 背景/目标：大量研究调查了胃肠道对味觉物质的反应，特别是在特化的肠内分泌细胞和其他化学感觉细胞中。然而，许多这些研究使用了各种味觉刺激物，通常浓度较高，或依赖于永生化细胞系或异质细胞群体，这可能限制了其生理相关性和可重复性。为了建立一个稳定、生理代表性的模型系统，以一致地研究肠道上皮对味觉物质的反应，我们的研究开发了三维小鼠肠道类器官（MIOs）。方法：从分离的肠道隐窝生成小鼠肠道类器官，并在确定的条件下培养以维持上皮分化。用选定的营养素和味觉物质刺激类器官，并通过激素分泌测定评估下游信号反应。结果：成功建立了3D MIO培养系统，为研究口外苦味感知和肠内分泌激素胆囊收缩素的释放提供了一个稳健的体外平台。此外，5 mM苯甲酸地那铵和30 mM L-谷氨酸特异性诱导MIOs中胆囊收缩素的分泌，而其他苦味或非苦味刺激物则没有。结论：小鼠肠道类器官为研究肠道中营养素和味觉物质诱发的信号传导提供了一个稳定的模型。该方法能够精确研究潜在机制，并可能增进我们对肠道化学感觉和代谢调节的理解。

title: Appendiceal Mucinous Neoplasms and Pseudomyxoma Peritonei: Current Classification and the Role of Intraperitoneal Chemotherapy.
titleZh: 阑尾黏液性肿瘤与腹膜假性黏液瘤：当前分类及腹腔内化疗的作用。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Giordano WG, Musumeci G, Nasso E, Briguglio A, Macrì F, D'Ascola A, Ieni A, Macrì A.
affiliations: Department of Human Pathology of the Adulthood and Developing Age "Gaetano Barresi", Section of Pathology, University of Messina, 98122 Messina, Italy.
General and Emergency Surgery Unit, Azienda Ospedaliera Universitaria "G. Martino"-Messina, 98125 Messina, Italy.
Department of Clinical and Experimental Medicine, Policlinic "G. Martino", University of Messina, 98122 Messina, Italy.
abstract: Appendiceal mucinous neoplasms (AMNs) are a rare but clinically significant category of gastrointestinal tumors, ranging from low-grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm (LAMN), the main precursor of pseudomyxoma peritonei (PMP), to high-grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm (HAMN), poorly differentiated and signet-ring-cell adenocarcinomas, and goblet cell adenocarcinoma. Although current WHO and PSOGI classifications provide well established diagnostic criteria, controversies persist regarding the biological behavior and prognostic significance of the most aggressive subtypes and the relationship between HAMN and mucinous adenocarcinoma. While appendectomy is sufficient for localized LAMN, cytoreductive surgery with hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy (CRS/HIPEC) is the treatment of choice for peritoneal dissemination This review integrates the histopathological and molecular classification of AMN and PMP with the evolution of intraperitoneal chemotherapy. Key findings indicate that KRAS and GNAS mutations are central drivers of mucin overproduction and peritoneal spread, that tumor grade and mucin cellularity remain the strongest prognostic determinants, and that the evidence supporting HIPEC and PIPAC derives largely from observational rather than randomized data. As a novel insight, we highlight the emerging role of patient-derived organoids as translational models for functional drug testing. Progress will depend on integrating molecular characterization, critical appraisal of intraperitoneal therapies, and organoid-based testing to advance individualized treatment for peritoneal surface malignancies.
abstractZh: 阑尾黏液性肿瘤（AMNs）是一类罕见但具有临床意义的胃肠道肿瘤，范围从低级别阑尾黏液性肿瘤（LAMN）（腹膜假性黏液瘤（PMP）的主要前体）到高级别阑尾黏液性肿瘤（HAMN）、低分化腺癌、印戒细胞腺癌以及杯状细胞腺癌。尽管目前的WHO和PSOGI分类提供了公认的诊断标准，但对于最具侵袭性亚型的生物学行为和预后意义，以及HAMN与黏液腺癌之间的关系，仍存在争议。虽然阑尾切除术足以治疗局限性LAMN，但肿瘤细胞减灭术联合腹腔热灌注化疗（CRS/HIPEC）是腹膜播散的首选治疗方法。本综述整合了AMN和PMP的组织病理学和分子分类与腹腔内化疗的演变。关键发现表明，KRAS和GNAS突变是黏液过度产生和腹膜播散的核心驱动因素，肿瘤分级和黏液细胞丰富度仍是最强的预后决定因素，支持HIPEC和PIPAC的证据主要来自观察性研究而非随机数据。作为一个新的见解，我们强调患者来源类器官作为功能性药物测试的转化模型的 emerging 作用。进展将依赖于整合分子特征、对腹腔内治疗的批判性评估以及基于类器官的测试，以推进腹膜表面恶性肿瘤的个体化治疗。

title: Examining Action Potential Waveform Diversity in Neuronal Populations of Midbrain Organoid Models
titleZh: 检查中脑类器官模型神经元群体中的动作电位波形多样性
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Ondriš J, Zimmermann A, Ferrante D, Schwamborn JC.
abstract: Over the last decade, pre-clinical research has witnessed the advancement of human induced pluripotent stem-cell derived 3D brain organoid models and their differentiation into specific brain regions. In the realm of Parkinson’s disease research, development of midbrain-specific organoids has enabled studies of this neurodegenerative disorder in patient derived 3D organoid models that attempt to recapitulate the human brain complexity. Within this line of research, neural functionality of the organoid models is established through electrophysiology. As a novel methodological approach, this study aimed to establish whether clustering of electrophysiological activity originating from midbrain organoids would aid in identifying different types of action-potential waveforms exhibited by neurons within the organoid model. Long-term extracellular electrophysiological recordings were conducted by use of a multi-electrode array device. The local field potential signal was spike-sorted, and the extracted putative neuron units were clustered into groups of spike waveform profiles. After establishing this methodological analysis pipeline, the clusters of waveform types were further analyzed in terms of electrophysiology. Results revealed that the clustering approach was successful at identifying three types of spike waveforms categories. Furthermore, it was proposed that one spike waveform profile potentially originated from dopaminergic neurons, which were one on the neural cells populating the organoid models. Overall, this study has successfully established a new methodological clustering approach to analyze electrophysiological data recoded from 3D organoid models in the context of Parkinson’s disease modelling and organoid model development research.
abstractZh: 在过去十年中，临床前研究见证了人类诱导多能干细胞来源的3D脑类器官模型及其向特定脑区分化的发展。在帕金森病研究领域，中脑特异性类器官的开发使得在患者来源的3D类器官模型中研究这种神经退行性疾病成为可能，这些模型试图重现人脑的复杂性。在这一研究方向上，类器官模型的神经功能通过电生理学得以确立。作为一种新颖的方法学途径，本研究旨在确定对源自中脑类器官的电生理活动进行聚类是否有助于识别类器官模型内神经元表现出的不同类型的动作电位波形。通过使用多电极阵列设备进行了长期细胞外电生理记录。对局部场电位信号进行了尖峰排序，并将提取的推定神经元单元聚类为尖峰波形轮廓组。在建立这一方法学分析流程后，进一步从电生理学角度分析了波形类型的聚类。结果显示，聚类方法成功识别了三种尖峰波形类别。此外，提出一种尖峰波形轮廓可能源自多巴胺能神经元，这些神经元是构成类器官模型的神经细胞之一。总体而言，本研究成功建立了一种新的方法学聚类方法，用于分析从3D类器官模型记录的电生理数据，在帕金森病建模和类器官模型开发研究背景下具有重要意义。

title: A colorectal cancer organoid-CAF co-culture chip for drug screening and personalized therapy
titleZh: 结直肠癌类器官-CAF共培养芯片用于药物筛选和个性化治疗
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Xiao R, Wang Z, Zhou Y, Ding D, Wang J, Liu J, Wang Y, Liu Q, Ai X.
abstract: The tumor microenvironment (TME) plays a critical role in cancer progression and therapeutic response, with cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) being a key stromal component. Conventional tumor organoid models lack TME elements, and existing co-culture systems have limitations in recapitulating dynamic, multidimensional interactions. Here, we developed a novel dynamic co-culture chip (BAC) to better model the TME and investigate CAF-tumor cell crosstalk. Using this platform, we established a non-contact co-culture model of patient-derived colorectal cancer cells and CAFs. The resulting model closely recapitulated the morphological and molecular characteristics of the original patient tumors. Compared with tumor organoids cultured alone, the co-culture system exhibited significantly higher resistance to the clinically common chemotherapeutics 5-fluorouracil and oxaliplatin. Moreover, the presence of CAFs promoted tumor recurrence. Notably, drug responses in the co-culture model showed superior concordance with clinical outcomes relative to both organoid-only and animal models. Transcriptomic profiling under different culture conditions provided further insights into the mechanisms driving CAF-mediated interactions. These findings demonstrate that the BAC-based tumor organoid-CAF co-culture model serves as a more accurate platform for predicting drug responses, investigating TME-dependent mechanisms, and guiding personalized cancer therapy.
abstractZh: 肿瘤微环境（TME）在癌症进展和治疗反应中起着关键作用，其中癌症相关成纤维细胞（CAFs）是重要的基质成分。传统的肿瘤类器官模型缺乏TME成分，现有的共培养系统在重现动态、多维相互作用方面存在局限性。在此，我们开发了一种新型动态共培养芯片（BAC），以更好地模拟TME并研究CAF-肿瘤细胞之间的相互作用。利用该平台，我们建立了患者来源的结直肠癌细胞与CAFs的非接触共培养模型。所得模型密切重现了原始患者肿瘤的形态学和分子特征。与单独培养的肿瘤类器官相比，共培养系统对临床常用化疗药物5-氟尿嘧啶和奥沙利铂表现出显著更高的耐药性。此外，CAFs的存在促进了肿瘤复发。值得注意的是，共培养模型中的药物反应与临床结果的一致性优于仅类器官模型和动物模型。不同培养条件下的转录组分析进一步揭示了驱动CAF介导相互作用的机制。这些发现表明，基于BAC的肿瘤类器官-CAF共培养模型是预测药物反应、研究TME依赖性机制和指导个性化癌症治疗的更准确平台。

title: Autoreactive antibody production by intrarenal B cells in mouse kidney allograft rejection
titleZh: 小鼠肾移植排斥反应中肾内B细胞产生的自身反应性抗体
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Sayin I, Jeong JC, Ghosh D, Durgam SS, Oien JB, Nelson AJ, Yin D, Sage PT, Tambur AR, Clark MR, Torcasso MS, Chong AS.
abstract: Antibody-mediated rejection (AMR) is a major cause of kidney allograft failure, with donor HLA-specific antibodies (DSA) recognized as primary drivers of AMR pathology. However, a significant proportion of AMR diagnoses lack detectable DSA, thus implicating DSA-independent mechanisms. In support, we previously reported on the accumulation of autoreactive B cells in rejecting renal biopsies, which raised the possibility that autoreactive IgG produced within the allograft contributes to graft pathology. In this study, we used mouse models to show that rejecting kidney allografts preferentially promoted a breach in autoreactive B cell tolerance, leading to the local production of autoreactive antibodies. Notably, autoreactive IgG responses were uncoupled from DSA production, indicative of distinct regulation. Organoid cultures confirmed that autoantibody production was observed in the rejecting kidney, whereas DSAs were produced in both the lymph node and graft. Intrarenal B cells expressing Nur77 were enriched for autoreactivity, consistent with  in situ antigen recognition. Finally, autoreactive antibodies are pathogenic, since inhibiting autoantibody production with transient anti-IL-15 and CTLA-4Ig led to preserved kidney allografts. These unique features of  in situ autoantibody responses may be relevant to diverse diseases with chronic tissue inflammation beyond transplantation.
abstractZh: 抗体介导的排斥反应（AMR）是肾移植失败的主要原因，供体HLA特异性抗体（DSA）被认为是AMR病理的主要驱动因素。然而，相当比例的AMR诊断缺乏可检测的DSA，因此提示存在不依赖DSA的机制。支持这一点的是，我们先前报道了排斥性肾活检中自身反应性B细胞的积累，这提出了移植物内产生的自身反应性IgG可能有助于移植物病理的可能性。在本研究中，我们使用小鼠模型证明，排斥性肾移植物优先促进自身反应性B细胞耐受性的破坏，导致局部产生自身反应性抗体。值得注意的是，自身反应性IgG反应与DSA产生脱钩，表明存在不同的调控。类器官培养证实，在排斥的肾脏中观察到自身抗体产生，而DSA在淋巴结和移植物中均产生。表达Nur77的肾内B细胞富含自身反应性，与原位抗原识别一致。最后，自身反应性抗体具有致病性，因为用短暂的抗IL-15和CTLA-4Ig抑制自身抗体产生可保护肾移植物。原位自身抗体反应的这些独特特征可能与移植以外的多种慢性组织炎症疾病相关。

title: Region-specific molecular regulatory programs define epithelial identity, progenitor states, and mucus homeostasis in human distal airways
titleZh: 区域特异性分子调控程序定义人类远端气道的上皮身份、祖细胞状态和黏液稳态
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Murano H, Stevens NC, Dang H, Nakano S, Cawley AM, Wisniewski ZY, Crisp G, Mitchell E, Singh A, Damodaran S, Reidel B, Gutay MI, Sun L, Hasegawa K, Williams AB, Immormino RM, Gilmore RC, Morton LC, Furusho M, Asakura T, Mikami Y, Whitlow T, Miyashita N, Lee-Ferris RE, Quinney NL, Boyles SE, Cholon DM, Chua M, Kato T, Fulcher L, Matsui H, Chen G, Livraghi-Butrico A, Gentzsch M, Schworer SA, Button B, Kesimer M, Tata PR, Hagood JS, Pryhuber GS, O’Neal WK, Randell SH, Boucher RC, Okuda K.
abstract: Small distal airways differ from proximal large airways in structure, airflow dynamics, and epithelial composition, and represent a central site of muco-obstructive lung disease pathogenesis. However, due in part to their inaccessibility, the molecular mechanisms that establish regional epithelial identity and govern mucociliary defense in distal airway epithelia remain poorly defined. Here, we integrate transcriptomic, secretomic, and chromatin accessibility analyses of matched primary human large and small airway epithelial cultures to define region-specific regulatory networks. We identify distal airway-specific transcriptional and chromatin programs required for maintaining epithelial identity and mucus homeostasis. Loss of NKX2-1 impairs distal airway secretory cell (DASC) differentiation and shifts mucus properties toward a disease-associated state. Lineage-resolved organoid assays identify an NKX2-1-high distal airway basal cell population with hybrid basal-secretory features as a selective progenitor for DASCs. Collectively, these findings establish a molecular framework for distal airway epithelial biology and define mechanisms regulating region-specific mucociliary host defense.
abstractZh: 小型远端气道在结构、气流动力学和上皮组成上与近端大气道不同，并且是黏液阻塞性肺病发病机制的核心部位。然而，部分由于其难以接近，建立区域上皮身份和控制远端气道上皮黏液纤毛防御的分子机制仍不明确。在此，我们整合了匹配的原代人大小气道上皮培养物的转录组学、分泌组学和染色质可及性分析，以定义区域特异性调控网络。我们识别了维持上皮身份和黏液稳态所需的远端气道特异性转录和染色质程序。NKX2-1的缺失损害远端气道分泌细胞（DASC）的分化，并将黏液特性转向疾病相关状态。谱系分辨的类器官实验确定了一个NKX2-1高表达的远端气道基底细胞群体，具有基底-分泌混合特征，是DASC的选择性祖细胞。总的来说，这些发现为远端气道上皮生物学建立了分子框架，并定义了调控区域特异性黏液纤毛宿主防御的机制。

abstract:
Background

Alcohol consumption has been associated with an increased dementia risk, including Alzheimer's disease (AD). However, the direct impact on human neuronal systems remains insufficiently characterized.Methods

We used human induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSC)-derived cortical neurons, spheroids, and cerebral organoids exposed to physiologically relevant ethanol concentrations for seven days. We assessed neuronal maturation, dendritic morphology, and electrophysiological activity, alongside molecular and functional markers related to AD pathology.Results

Chronic ethanol exposure impaired cortical neuronal maturation and network activity and reduced dendritic complexity in human iPSC-derived cortical neurons. Notably, ethanol exposure induced an amyloidogenic shift characterized by increased amyloid-beta (Aβ)-related processing. These changes were consistently observed across both 2D cortical neurons and 3D cerebral organoid models.Conclusion

Our findings indicate that chronic alcohol exposure disrupts neuronal maturation and promotes Alzheimer's disease-related pathology in human iPSC-derived neuronal models. This study highlights the value of human iPSC-based platforms for investigating the cellular impact of lifestyle-associated risk factors in neurodegenerative disease.
abstractZh:
背景

饮酒与痴呆风险增加有关，包括阿尔茨海默病（AD）。然而，对人类神经元系统的直接影响仍未得到充分表征。方法

我们使用人诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）来源的皮层神经元、球体和大脑类器官，暴露于生理相关浓度的乙醇中七天。我们评估了神经元成熟、树突形态和电生理活动，以及与AD病理相关的分子和功能标志物。结果

慢性乙醇暴露损害了人iPSC来源的皮层神经元的皮层神经元成熟和网络活动，并减少了树突复杂性。值得注意的是，乙醇暴露诱导了淀粉样蛋白生成转变，其特征是淀粉样蛋白-β（Aβ）相关加工增加。这些变化在2D皮层神经元和3D大脑类器官模型中均一致观察到。结论

我们的研究结果表明，慢性酒精暴露破坏了神经元成熟，并在人iPSC来源的神经元模型中促进了阿尔茨海默病相关病理。这项研究强调了基于人iPSC的平台在调查生活方式相关风险因素对神经退行性疾病的细胞影响方面的价值。

abstract:
Background

Pancreatic diseases, including diabetes, pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, pancreatitis, and cystic fibrosis, impose a substantial clinical burden and are challenging to model using conventional experimental systems. Pancreatic organoids provide physiologically relevant three-dimensional models that recapitulate the key structural and functional features of the human pancreas. This review summarizes recent advances in pancreatic organoid and organoid-on-a-chip technologies, focusing on their applications in pancreatic disease modeling, therapeutic screening, and potential relevance to personalized treatment.Main text

This review discusses the construction of pancreatic organoids and pancreatic organoid-on-a-chip platforms, including key culture parameters and practical strategies for model establishment. The applications of pancreatic organoids in modeling pancreatic cancer, diabetes, pancreatitis, and cystic fibrosis are reviewed. In addition, the role of patient-derived organoids in therapeutic screening and their potential integration into personalized treatment workflows are evaluated. The enabling role of artificial intelligence in pancreatic organoid research is also discussed, followed by an overview of the current challenges and future perspectives.Conclusion

Pancreatic organoid-based platforms are promising tools for pancreatic disease modeling and therapeutic evaluation. Addressing the current limitations of cellular complexity, vascularization, reproducibility, and scalability is essential for expanding their research and clinical utility.
abstractZh:
背景

胰腺疾病，包括糖尿病、胰腺导管腺癌、胰腺炎和囊性纤维化，给临床带来了沉重的负担，并且使用传统实验系统难以建模。胰腺类器官提供了生理相关的三维模型，能够重现人类胰腺的关键结构和功能特征。本综述总结了胰腺类器官和芯片上类器官技术的最新进展，重点关注它们在胰腺疾病建模、治疗筛选以及个性化治疗潜在相关性中的应用。正文

本综述讨论了胰腺类器官和胰腺芯片上类器官平台的构建，包括关键的培养参数和模型建立的实用策略。综述了胰腺类器官在胰腺癌、糖尿病、胰腺炎和囊性纤维化建模中的应用。此外，还评估了患者来源类器官在治疗筛选中的作用及其在个性化治疗流程中的潜在整合。还讨论了人工智能在胰腺类器官研究中的赋能作用，随后概述了当前的挑战和未来前景。结论

基于胰腺类器官的平台是胰腺疾病建模和治疗评估的有前景的工具。解决当前在细胞复杂性、血管化、可重复性和可扩展性方面的局限性，对于扩大其研究和临床实用性至关重要。

abstract: Organoids and microphysiological systems (MPS) constitute relevant in vitro (patho)physiological models, complementary to two-dimensional (2D) cell cultures and animal studies, by recapitulating in vivo three-dimensional (3D) tissue microenvironments outside the human body. Advanced microtechnologies enable electro-mechanical stimulation of cell activity and the recording of electrophysiological signals for dynamic and continuous, label-free monitoring of these models. Consequently, the extension from 2D cultures to organoids and MPS necessitates a corresponding transition from planar 2D-microelectrode arrays (MEAs) to 3D MEAs to assess the electrical activity of complex 3D tissue networks. In this review, we outline recent advances in the 3D MEA landscape and elaborate on future trends of 3D MEA-integrated multifunctional platforms, highlighting challenges and opportunities.
abstractZh: 类器官和微生理系统（MPS）构成了相关的体外（病理）生理模型，补充了二维（2D）细胞培养和动物研究，通过在人体外重现体内三维（3D）组织微环境。先进的微技术能够对细胞活动进行电-机械刺激，并记录电生理信号，以实现对这些模型的动态、连续、无标记监测。因此，从2D培养扩展到类器官和MPS，需要相应地平面2D微电极阵列（MEAs）向3D MEAs的转变，以评估复杂3D组织网络的电活动。在这篇综述中，我们概述了3D MEA领域的最新进展，并详细阐述了3D MEA集成多功能平台的未来趋势，强调了挑战和机遇。

title: Replicative senescence of neural progenitors induces astrocyte senescence in 2D cultures and human midbrain organoids
titleZh: 神经祖细胞的复制性衰老在二维培养和人中脑类器官中诱导星形胶质细胞衰老
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Cora V, Ferrante D, Lu-Yang N, Jarazo J, Zagare A, Schwamborn JC, Bolognin S.
abstract: Astrocyte senescence (astrosenescence) has emerged as a potential mechanism through which ageing may progressively impair glial homeostatic neuronal support and render the brain more vulnerable to neurodegenerative diseases such as Parkinson’s disease (PD). Yet human experimental models that specifically recapitulate astrosenescence within a PD-relevant genetic background are lacking. Here, we applied passage-induced replicative exhaustion to human iPSC-derived neuroepithelial stem cells (NESCs) from a healthy donor and LRRK2-G2019S PD patients to establish an  in vitro midbrain ageing model. Extended passaging induced senescence-associated changes in NESCs, including reduced proliferative capacity, decreased cleaved caspase 3 (CC3) and telomerase mRNA expression, and DNA damage response (DDR) activation, while preserving differentiation potential. Astrocytes derived from aged progenitors showed an increase in SA-β-gal activity, loss of Lamin B1, DDR activation, and an altered mitochondrial morphology. In human midbrain organoids (hMOs), passage-induced ageing was associated with astrocyte-specific DDR activation and lipidomic remodelling. A multi-modal integrative analysis further revealed that, despite the variable penetrance of individual senescence-associated markers across lines, passage condition constitutes the primary discriminant of the collective cellular state, supporting the view that replicative senescence as a biological program is detectable only when individual readouts are aggregated across modalities. Together, this work establishes a human iPSC-based platform recapitulating key features of cellular senescence in both healthy and LRRK2-G2019S contexts and provides an  in vitro platform to investigate the contribution of astrosenescence to PD-related neurodegeneration.
abstractZh: 星形胶质细胞衰老（星形胶质衰老）已成为一种潜在机制，通过该机制，衰老可能逐渐损害胶质细胞的稳态神经元支持，并使大脑更容易受到帕金森病（PD）等神经退行性疾病的影响。然而，缺乏专门在PD相关遗传背景下重现星形胶质衰老的人类实验模型。在此，我们应用传代诱导的复制性耗竭于来自健康供体和LRRK2-G2019S PD患者的人iPSC来源的神经上皮干细胞（NESC），以建立体外中脑衰老模型。延长传代诱导了NESC中与衰老相关的变化，包括增殖能力降低、裂解的caspase 3（CC3）和端粒酶mRNA表达减少，以及DNA损伤反应（DDR）激活，同时保留了分化潜能。源自衰老祖细胞的星形胶质细胞表现出SA-β-gal活性增加、Lamin B1丢失、DDR激活以及线粒体形态改变。在人中脑类器官（hMO）中，传代诱导的衰老与星形胶质细胞特异性DDR激活和脂质组重塑相关。多模态整合分析进一步揭示，尽管各细胞系中个体衰老相关标志物的外显率存在差异，传代条件构成了集体细胞状态的主要判别因素，支持了复制性衰老作为一种生物程序仅在个体读数跨模态聚合时才可检测的观点。总之，这项工作建立了一个基于人iPSC的平台，在健康和LRRK2-G2019S背景下重现了细胞衰老的关键特征，并提供了一个体外平台来研究星形胶质衰老对PD相关神经退行性变的贡献。

title: Microfluidic Platform for Drug Response Profiling in NSCLC Patient-Derived Organoids
titleZh: 微流控平台用于非小细胞肺癌患者来源类器官的药物反应分析
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Luan Q, Rahnama A, Pulido I, Raspini M, Zhou J, Shimamura T, Papautsky I.
abstract: Tumor models that recapitulate 3D architecture are essential for understanding how cellular organization and microenvironmental interactions govern therapeutic response in human cancers. Here, we developed a microfluidic microphysiological system that enables controlled and scalable culture and drug testing of non-small cell lung cancer spheroids and patient-derived organoids. The platform integrated U-shaped microwells with dual-channel loading to support de novo spheroid formation, efficient trapping of pre-formed spheroids, and loading of intact organoids with reduced size heterogeneity. Tumor spheroids and organoids maintained high viability and structural integrity during long-term on-chip culture, and constrained microscale confinement produced ellipsoidal geometries that deviate from idealized spherical assumptions. Baseline genotype-dependent responses to KRAS G12C and EGFR inhibitors were preserved across agarose and microfluidic formats, establishing a validated reference state. Building on this baseline, fibroblast- and endothelial-derived cues consistently attenuated responses to targeted therapies across conditioned media, mixed co-culture, and spatially organized configurations. Resistance phenotypes converged on a dominant role for paracrine signaling, while increasing architectural complexity primarily enhanced morphological fidelity rather than altering therapeutic response. These findings establish a microphysiological framework that decouples tumor-intrinsic drug sensitivity from microenvironment-mediated modulation, enabling the systematic evaluation of paracrine resistance mechanisms in NSCLC.
abstractZh: 能够重现三维结构的肿瘤模型对于理解细胞组织和微环境相互作用如何调控人类癌症的治疗反应至关重要。在此，我们开发了一种微流控微生理系统，能够对非小细胞肺癌球体和患者来源的类器官进行可控且可扩展的培养和药物测试。该平台集成了U形微孔和双通道加载，支持从头形成球体、高效捕获预形成的球体以及加载完整类器官，并减少了尺寸异质性。肿瘤球体和类器官在芯片上长期培养期间保持了高活力和结构完整性，而受限的微尺度约束产生了偏离理想球形假设的椭球几何形状。基线基因型依赖的KRAS G12C和EGFR抑制剂反应在琼脂糖和微流控格式中保持一致，建立了验证的参考状态。在此基线基础上，成纤维细胞和内皮细胞来源的信号在条件培养基、混合共培养和空间组织配置中持续减弱了对靶向治疗的反应。耐药表型汇聚于旁分泌信号的主导作用，而增加结构复杂性主要增强了形态保真度，而非改变治疗反应。这些发现建立了一个微生理框架，将肿瘤内在药物敏感性与微环境介导的调节解耦，从而能够系统评估非小细胞肺癌中的旁分泌耐药机制。

title: Dual HER2/HER3 Targeting with Antibody-Drug Conjugates Reveals a Novel Therapeutic Strategy for HER2-Mutant Lobular Breast Cancer
titleZh: 双HER2/HER3靶向抗体药物偶联物揭示HER2突变型小叶性乳腺癌的新治疗策略
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Liu JB, Cao Y, Chang AC, Jaehne R, Brown DD, Waltermire H, Tseng D, Jeselsohn RM, Nader-Marta G, Hooda J, Foldi J, Balic M, Lee AV, Oesterreich S.
abstract: Activating HER2 mutations are significantly enriched in both primary and metastatic invasive lobular breast cancer (ILC), with large public datasets of primary breast tumors linking them to a worse prognosis in ILC. Despite their oncogenic role, no FDA-approved therapies currently target HER2-mutant breast cancers. While the HER2-directed antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) has shown efficacy in HER2-mutant non-small cell lung cancer, its activity in HER2-mutant ILC remains unknown. Using the Caris real-world database, one of the largest cohorts with survival data in advanced breast cancers, we confirmed that HER2 mutations are more prevalent in advanced ILC than in invasive breast cancer of no special type (NST) tumors, are associated with worse survival in both histologies, yet predict improved response to T-DXd across subtypes, highlighting the need for mutation-directed, histology-informed therapies. Using endogenous HER2-mutant ILC cell lines (UACC3133-S310F, BCK4-L755S) and CRISPR-engineered isogenic ILC models with clinically relevant HER2 mutations (S310F, V777L), we found these mutations drive HER2/HER3 hyperactivation and downstream signaling, conferring increased sensitivity to HER2 tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs) and T-DXd. Mechanistically, HER2 mutants showed enhanced receptor ubiquitination, internalization, and lysosomal degradation upon T-DXd treatment, explaining the observed drug sensitivity. While combining T-DXd with neratinib or the HSP90 inhibitor ganetespib yielded synergistic effects in long-term growth assays, accompanied by increased HER2 ubiquitination, the concurrent hyperactivation of HER3 in HER2-mutant cells suggested that co-targeting HER3 could provide an effective alternative strategy. Accordingly, HER2-mutant ILC exhibited enhanced sensitivity to the HER3-directed ADC patritumab deruxtecan (P-DXd) or LJM716, a HER3-targeting antibody. We further uncovered a previously unrecognized mechanism of P-DXd beyond HER3 ligand blockade and payload delivery: P-DXd promotes HER2/HER3 association, increases HER2 ubiquitination, and enhances T-DXd internalization, resulting in potent synergy with T-DXd. Mechanistically, we identified HER3 extracellular domains I and II as essential for P-DXd binding and for mediating P-DXd-induced HER2/HER3 association, establishing a structural basis for this activity.  In vivo , both T-DXd and P-DXd suppressed UACC3133 and BCK4 xenograft growth, with combination therapy trending toward greater efficacy and prevented regrowth of tumors.  Extending these findings beyond HER2-mutant ILC, combination treatment with T-DXd and P-DXd demonstrated synergistic activity across multiple breast cancer models, including (i) HER2-amplified NST patient-derived organoids (PDOs) harboring hotspot HER2 mutations, (ii) HER2-wild-type NST PDOs with clinically intrinsic or acquired T-DXd resistance, and (iii) isogenic HER2-mutant ILC PDOs with experimentally induced resistance after prolonged T-DXd exposure. Collectively, these findings support HER2 as an actionable target in HER2-mutant ILC and position T-DXd-based regimens, particularly in combination with HER3 inhibition, as a promising therapeutic strategy for this underserved patient population.
abstractZh: 激活型HER2突变在原发性和转移性浸润性小叶性乳腺癌（ILC）中均显著富集，大型原发性乳腺肿瘤公共数据集将其与ILC的不良预后相关联。尽管具有致癌作用，但目前尚无FDA批准的疗法针对HER2突变型乳腺癌。虽然靶向HER2的抗体药物偶联物（ADC）trastuzumab deruxtecan（T-DXd）在HER2突变型非小细胞肺癌中显示出疗效，但其在HER2突变型ILC中的活性仍未知。利用Caris真实世界数据库（晚期乳腺癌中最大的具有生存数据的队列之一），我们确认HER2突变在晚期ILC中比在非特殊类型浸润性乳腺癌（NST）肿瘤中更普遍，与两种组织学类型的较差生存相关，但预测各亚型对T-DXd的反应改善，强调了需要针对突变指导、组织学信息化的治疗。使用内源性HER2突变ILC细胞系（UACC3133-S310F，BCK4-L755S）和CRISPR工程化的同基因ILC模型（具有临床相关HER2突变S310F、V777L），我们发现这些突变驱动HER2/HER3过度激活和下游信号传导，赋予对HER2酪氨酸激酶抑制剂（TKIs）和T-DXd的敏感性增加。机制上，HER2突变体在T-DXd处理后表现出增强的受体泛素化、内化和溶酶体降解，解释了观察到的药物敏感性。虽然将T-DXd与neratinib或HSP90抑制剂ganetespib联合在长期生长试验中产生协同效应，并伴随HER2泛素化增加，但HER2突变细胞中HER3的并发过度激活表明，共同靶向HER3可能提供有效的替代策略。相应地，HER2突变型ILC对靶向HER3的ADC patritumab deruxtecan（P-DXd）或HER3靶向抗体LJM716表现出增强的敏感性。我们进一步发现了P-DXd超越HER3配体阻断和载荷递送的先前未识别的机制：P-DXd促进HER2/HER3结合，增加HER2泛素化，并增强T-DXd的内化，导致与T-DXd的强效协同作用。机制上，我们确定HER3胞外结构域I和II对于P-DXd结合以及介导P-DXd诱导的HER2/HER3结合至关重要，为此活性建立了结构基础。在体内，T-DXd和P-DXd均抑制UACC3133和BCK4异种移植瘤的生长，联合治疗趋向于更大的疗效并防止肿瘤再生长。将这些发现扩展到HER2突变型ILC之外，T-DXd和P-DXd的联合治疗在多种乳腺癌模型中显示出协同活性，包括（i）携带热点HER2突变的HER2扩增NST患者来源类器官（PDOs），（ii）具有临床内在或获得性T-DXd耐药的HER2野生型NST PDOs，以及（iii）在长期T-DXd暴露后实验诱导耐药的同基因HER2突变ILC PDOs。总的来说，这些发现支持HER2作为HER2突变型ILC的可操作靶点，并将基于T-DXd的方案，特别是与HER3抑制联合，定位为这一服务不足患者群体的有前景的治疗策略。

title: Dynamic suspension culture enhances scalable maturation of hiPSC-derived cartilage organoids for regenerative medicine
titleZh: 动态悬浮培养增强hiPSC衍生软骨类器官的可扩展成熟，用于再生医学
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Mazzini G, Houtman E, Hoolwerff Mv, Janssen M, Sayedipour S, Hajmousa G, Kieltyka RE, Mahdad RR, Ramos YF, Meulenbelt I.
abstract:
Background

  Cartilage tissue engineering requires scalable culture strategies to produce high-quality organoids. Human induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs) provide a renewable source of chondrogenic cells. However, conventional static 3D culture limits tissue maturation, reproducibility, and scalability. Dynamic culture systems may help overcome these limitations, although their application for hiPSC-derived cartilage maturation remains poorly explored. Methods

  In this study, we established and validated a dynamic suspension bioreactor culture platform (CERO, OLS) for scalable maturation of hiPSC-derived chondroprogenitor cells (hiCPCs) into cartilage organoids populated by biomimetic human induced chondrocytes (hiCHOs). Key culture parameters, including aggregate preparation strategy, agitation speed, and maturation duration, were systematically evaluated. Cartilage maturation under dynamic and conventional static culture conditions was assessed by histology and immunohistochemistry, biochemical assays, organoid size measurements, and gene expression (RT-qPCR). In addition, the functional integration of optimized organoids was evaluated in a human osteochondral explant model. Results

  Pre-formed manually picked hiCPC aggregates showed improved cartilage formation compared with single-cell seeding or pelleted aggregates in the bioreactor. Dynamic suspension culture promoted increased construct growth, enhanced ECM deposition, and a more favourable cartilage-associated molecular phenotype compared with static culture. HiCHO organoids matured under dynamic suspension conditions displayed increased sulphated glycosaminoglycan and proteoglycan deposition together with higher expression of cartilage-associated genes  ACAN ,  COMP ,  MGP , and  COL2A1 . Although prolonged static maturation alone supported continued cartilage development, introducing dynamic suspension culture during later maturation stages further reinforced favourable molecular and matrix-associated features. Importantly, hiCHO organoids generated under optimized dynamic culture conditions successfully filled human cartilage defects and established matrix continuity with surrounding native tissue in a human osteochondral  ex vivo explant model.  Conclusions

  This study shows that dynamic suspension culture is an effective and scalable strategy for maturation of hiPSC-derived cartilage organoids. Consequently, this approach supports reproducible neo-cartilage production and allows functional testing in human tissue models. These findings support the use of dynamic culture systems for cartilage repair and  in vitro/ex vivo cartilage research.
abstractZh:
背景

  软骨组织工程需要可扩展的培养策略来生产高质量的类器官。人类诱导多能干细胞（hiPSCs）提供了软骨形成细胞的可再生来源。然而，传统的静态3D培养限制了组织成熟、可重复性和可扩展性。动态培养系统可能有助于克服这些限制，尽管其在hiPSC衍生软骨成熟中的应用仍鲜有探索。方法

  在本研究中，我们建立并验证了一个动态悬浮生物反应器培养平台（CERO, OLS），用于将hiPSC衍生的软骨祖细胞（hiCPCs）可扩展地成熟为由仿生人类诱导软骨细胞（hiCHOs）填充的软骨类器官。系统评估了关键培养参数，包括聚集体制备策略、搅拌速度和成熟持续时间。通过组织学和免疫组织化学、生化测定、类器官大小测量和基因表达（RT-qPCR）评估了动态和常规静态培养条件下的软骨成熟情况。此外，在人类骨软骨外植体模型中评估了优化类器官的功能整合。结果

  预成型的手工挑选的hiCPC聚集体在生物反应器中比单细胞接种或沉淀聚集体显示出更好的软骨形成。与静态培养相比，动态悬浮培养促进了构建体生长的增加、ECM沉积的增强以及更有利的软骨相关分子表型。在动态悬浮条件下成熟的HiCHO类器官显示出增加的硫酸化糖胺聚糖和蛋白聚糖沉积，以及更高的软骨相关基因ACAN、COMP、MGP和COL2A1的表达。尽管仅延长静态成熟时间也能支持持续的软骨发育，但在后期成熟阶段引入动态悬浮培养进一步增强了有利的分子和基质相关特征。重要的是，在优化动态培养条件下生成的hiCHO类器官成功填充了人类软骨缺损，并在人类骨软骨离体外植体模型中与周围天然组织建立了基质连续性。结论

  本研究表明，动态悬浮培养是hiPSC衍生软骨类器官成熟的一种有效且可扩展的策略。因此，这种方法支持可重复的新软骨生产，并允许在人类组织模型中进行功能测试。这些发现支持使用动态培养系统进行软骨修复和体外/离体软骨研究。

title: CCL3 promotes oxaliplatin resistance in gastric cancer via CCR5-mediated tumor cell survival and macrophage M2 polarization.
titleZh: CCL3通过CCR5介导的肿瘤细胞存活和巨噬细胞M2极化促进胃癌对奥沙利铂的耐药性。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Cheng X, Qin Z.
affiliations: Endoscopy Center, Minhang Hospital Affiliated to Fudan University, Shanghai, 201100, China.

abstract: Although oxaliplatin (Oxa)-based chemotherapy is a standard treatment for gastric cancer (GC), its clinical efficacy is frequently limited by the development of Oxa resistance. Chemokine CCL3 is linked to tumor growth, which can result in tumor-immune interactions and treatment resistance. This work examined the function of CCL3 in Oxa resistance in macrophages, patient-derived organoids (PDO), and GC cells. Differential expression, weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA), PPI network, and ROC analysis were performed on the GSE128967 dataset. Oxa-resistant GC cell lines (MKN45/Oxa, SGC7901/Oxa) and PDOs were used to evaluate the function of CCL3 by siRNA knockdown and overexpression. To evaluate CCL3-driven macrophage polarization and its effect on Oxa sensitivity, THP-1-derived macrophages were co-cultured with GC cells. Cell viability, migration/invasion, and expression of CCL3, CCR1/CCR5, and M1/M2 markers were examined by Transwell assays, qRT-PCR, CCK-8, and Western blot. WGCNA highlighted an FOLFOX-related yellow module, from which CCL3 emerged as a hub gene with the highest prognostic accuracy. CCL3 was upregulated in Oxa-resistant GC cells and PDOs. CCL3 knockdown reduced cell migration, invasion, and PDO formation under Oxa treatment, whereas overexpression enhanced resistance. CCL3-overexpressing GC cells promoted M2 polarization of co-cultured macrophages, which in turn further increased Oxa resistance in GC cells. Mechanistically, CCR5 mediated CCL3-induced chemoresistance and macrophage M2 polarization. The CCL3/CCR5 axis drives Oxa resistance in GC by boosting tumor cell survival and fostering immunosuppressive M2 macrophages. Targeting this pathway may offer a strategy to overcome chemoresistance in GC.
abstractZh: 尽管基于奥沙利铂（Oxa）的化疗是胃癌（GC）的标准治疗方法，但其临床疗效常常因Oxa耐药性的发展而受限。趋化因子CCL3与肿瘤生长相关，可导致肿瘤-免疫相互作用和治疗耐药。本研究探讨了CCL3在巨噬细胞、患者来源类器官（PDO）和GC细胞中Oxa耐药性中的作用。对GSE128967数据集进行了差异表达、加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）、PPI网络和ROC分析。使用Oxa耐药的GC细胞系（MKN45/Oxa、SGC7901/Oxa）和PDO，通过siRNA敲低和过表达评估CCL3的功能。为评估CCL3驱动的巨噬细胞极化及其对Oxa敏感性的影响，将THP-1来源的巨噬细胞与GC细胞共培养。通过Transwell实验、qRT-PCR、CCK-8和Western blot检测细胞活力、迁移/侵袭以及CCL3、CCR1/CCR5和M1/M2标志物的表达。WGCNA突出显示了一个与FOLFOX相关的黄色模块，其中CCL3作为预后准确性最高的枢纽基因出现。CCL3在Oxa耐药的GC细胞和PDO中上调。在Oxa处理下，CCL3敲低减少了细胞迁移、侵袭和PDO形成，而过表达则增强了耐药性。过表达CCL3的GC细胞促进了共培养巨噬细胞的M2极化，这反过来又进一步增加了GC细胞对Oxa的耐药性。机制上，CCR5介导了CCL3诱导的化疗耐药和巨噬细胞M2极化。CCL3/CCR5轴通过促进肿瘤细胞存活和 fostering 免疫抑制性M2巨噬细胞来驱动GC中的Oxa耐药性。靶向该通路可能为克服GC中的化疗耐药提供一种策略。

title: Effects of LATS1/2 kinases inhibition on lung epithelial cells in a regeneration model.
titleZh: LATS1/2激酶抑制在再生模型中对肺上皮细胞的影响

abstract: Research focused on studying Hippo signaling up- and downregulation in a model of mouse lung cell regeneration. The cell-specific role of the activation and inhibition of Hippo signaling is demonstrated at the cellular level within the context of a unified bronchoalveolar lung organoid model. We used pharmacological modulators of Hippo pathway components-TRULI and verteporfin. The findings revealed that inhibition of Lats1/2 kinases via TRULI leads to different levels of Hippo gene expression for different lung cell types. The inhibition of Lats1/2 kinases enhances cell proliferation in the bronchiolar epithelium, while verteporfin suppresses it. However, no changes in the cellular composition of the bronchiolar epithelium (except ciliated cells) were observed with either TRULI or verteporfin. Inhibition of Lats1/2 kinases in the alveolar epithelium leads to a decrease in type 2 alveolocytes and alters their differentiation trajectories. The results demonstrate a cell-specific influence of Hippo modulation on the lung cells and may prove useful for the development of novel therapeutic approaches for the treatment of respiratory pathologies.
abstractZh: 本研究聚焦于在小鼠肺细胞再生模型中研究Hippo信号通路上调和下调。在统一的支气管肺泡肺类器官模型背景下，于细胞水平上展示了Hippo信号通路激活和抑制的细胞特异性作用。我们使用了Hippo通路组分的药理学调节剂——TRULI和维替泊芬。研究结果显示，通过TRULI抑制Lats1/2激酶可导致不同肺细胞类型中Hippo基因表达水平的不同变化。Lats1/2激酶的抑制增强了支气管上皮中的细胞增殖，而维替泊芬则抑制了这种增殖。然而，使用TRULI或维替泊芬均未观察到支气管上皮细胞组成的变化（纤毛细胞除外）。在肺泡上皮中抑制Lats1/2激酶会导致2型肺泡细胞减少，并改变其分化轨迹。结果表明，Hippo信号调节对肺细胞具有细胞特异性影响，这可能有助于开发治疗呼吸系统疾病的新型治疗方法。

title: From mice to humans-divergent strategies for intestinal homeostasis and regeneration.
titleZh: 从小鼠到人类——肠道稳态与再生的不同策略。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Ishikawa K, Sugimoto S, Sato T.
affiliations: Department of Integrated Medicine and Biochemistry, Keio University School of Medicine, Tokyo, Japan.
Department of Gastroenterology, Keio University School of Medicine, Tokyo, Japan.
Keio University Health Center, Tokyo, Kanagawa, Japan.
abstract: The intestinal epithelium is maintained by stem cells that balance self-renewal and differentiation to sustain homeostasis and enable regeneration after injury. Recent advances-including organoid culture, genome editing, orthotopic xenotransplantation, and somatic mutation-based analysis-have created new opportunities to investigate intestinal stem cell (ISC) dynamics in humans. These studies have revealed striking species-specific differences: whereas mouse LGR5+ ISCs divide daily and are chemo-sensitive, human colonic LGR5+ stem cells are predominantly slow-cycling and chemo-resistant. Consistent with this reduced cycling, human ISCs accumulate somatic mutations more slowly than those of mice. Across mammals, ISC proliferation rates inversely correlate with lifespan, a relationship thought to minimize mutation accumulation and reduce cancer risk, in line with Peto's paradox. Regenerative responses in both mice and humans can involve fetal-like reprogramming driven by YAP and other signaling pathways, yet the extent of species differences in intestinal regenerative capacity remains unclear. This review synthesizes current insights into ISC kinetics, injury responses, and evolutionary adaptations, highlighting the need for human-focused studies to bridge translational gaps and guide regenerative medicine strategies.
abstractZh: 肠道上皮由干细胞维持，这些干细胞平衡自我更新和分化，以维持稳态并在损伤后实现再生。最近的进展——包括类器官培养、基因组编辑、原位异种移植和基于体细胞突变的分析——为研究人类肠道干细胞（ISC）动力学创造了新的机会。这些研究揭示了显著的物种特异性差异：小鼠LGR5+ ISCs每天分裂且对化疗敏感，而人类结肠LGR5+干细胞主要处于慢周期状态且对化疗耐药。与这种减少的周期一致，人类ISCs积累体细胞突变的速度比小鼠慢。在哺乳动物中，ISC增殖率与寿命呈负相关，这种关系被认为是为了最小化突变积累并降低癌症风险，符合佩托悖论。小鼠和人类的再生反应都可能涉及由YAP和其他信号通路驱动的胎儿样重编程，但肠道再生能力物种差异的程度仍不清楚。本综述综合了关于ISC动力学、损伤反应和进化适应的当前见解，强调需要以人类为重点的研究来弥合转化差距并指导再生医学策略。

title: Endothelial Cell Phenotypic Plasticity in Atherosclerosis.
titleZh: 动脉粥样硬化中内皮细胞表型可塑性。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Alonso-Herranz L, Albarrán-Juárez J.
affiliations: Atherosclerosis Research Unit, Department of Clinical Medicine, Aarhus University, Aarhus, Denmark.
Steno Diabetes Center Aarhus, Aarhus University Hospital, Aarhus, Denmark.
Atherosclerosis Research Unit, Department of Clinical Medicine, Aarhus University, Aarhus, Denmark. jalbarran@clin.au.dk.
abstract: Atherosclerosis, the leading cause of cardiovascular death worldwide, is initiated by endothelial cells (ECs) dysfunction and sustained by maladaptive vascular remodeling. Far from being a uniform barrier, the endothelium is highly heterogeneous and phenotypically plastic. A central manifestation of this plasticity is endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EndMT), a dynamic continuum in which ECs progressively lose their endothelial identity and acquire mesenchymal, pro-fibrotic traits that contribute to every stage of atherosclerotic lesion development. This chapter reviews how atherogenic cues, including disturbed blood flow, oxidative stress, inflammation, and extracellular matrix stiffening, trigger EndMT, and how convergent signaling networks, notably TGF-β, together with Wnt/β-catenin, Notch, NF-κB/STAT3, and epigenetic regulators such as HDAC9, drive this process. These pathways are counterbalanced by protective mechanisms, including FGF and KLF2/KLF4 signaling, which help maintain endothelial homeostasis. We summarize evidence from in situ co-staining, genetic lineage tracing, epigenetic fate mapping, and single-cell multi-omics approaches, which collectively reveal distinct disease-associated EC subpopulations. We also review the in vitro, organ-on-a-chip, and murine models used to dissect EC plasticity. Finally, we discuss therapeutic and precision medicine strategies aimed at selectively reprogramming pathogenic endothelial states to promote plaque stabilization while preserving vascular integrity.
abstractZh: 动脉粥样硬化是全球心血管死亡的主要原因，由内皮细胞功能障碍引发，并由适应不良的血管重塑所维持。内皮远非均匀的屏障，而是高度异质且具有表型可塑性的。这种可塑性的一个核心表现是内皮-间质转化，这是一个动态连续过程，其中内皮细胞逐渐失去其内皮特性，并获得间质、促纤维化特征，这些特征有助于动脉粥样硬化病变发展的每个阶段。本章回顾了致动脉粥样硬化因素（包括紊乱的血流、氧化应激、炎症和细胞外基质硬化）如何触发内皮-间质转化，以及汇聚的信号网络（特别是TGF-β，连同Wnt/β-catenin、Notch、NF-κB/STAT3）和表观遗传调控因子（如HDAC9）如何驱动这一过程。这些通路受到保护性机制（包括FGF和KLF2/KLF4信号传导）的平衡，这些机制有助于维持内皮稳态。我们总结了原位共染色、遗传谱系追踪、表观遗传命运图谱和单细胞多组学方法的证据，这些方法共同揭示了不同的疾病相关内皮细胞亚群。我们还回顾了用于剖析内皮细胞可塑性的体外、器官芯片和小鼠模型。最后，我们讨论了旨在选择性重编程致病性内皮状态以促进斑块稳定同时保持血管完整性的治疗和精准医学策略。

abstract: ➢ The relationship between the gastrointestinal tract and joint diseases has garnered increased attention over recent decades, leading to the introduction of the gut-joint axis concept. ➢ Infections at sites such as joints and the spine may originate endogenously from the gut microbiome. ➢ The idea of microbial translocation through a compromised epithelial barrier, resulting in the circulation of pathogens or their byproducts, and the idea of immune cell-mediated transport of pathogens to various sites are gaining further attention. ➢ By understanding the interaction between the immune system and gut microbiota, potential therapeutic strategies, such as the use of organoids, can be developed to restore the gut barrier integrity, to replenish gut microbiota, and to provide biodiversity. ➢ To better understand the mechanisms linking gut health and joint diseases, future basic-science research and well-designed clinical trials, exploiting advanced next-generation sequencing techniques, are needed.
abstractZh: ➢ 胃肠道与关节疾病之间的关系在近几十年来受到越来越多的关注，从而引入了肠-关节轴的概念。➢ 关节和脊柱等部位的感染可能内源性来源于肠道微生物组。➢ 微生物通过受损的上皮屏障发生易位，导致病原体或其副产物进入循环，以及免疫细胞介导的病原体转运至不同部位的观点，正受到越来越多的关注。➢ 通过理解免疫系统与肠道微生物群之间的相互作用，可以开发潜在的治疗策略，例如使用类器官，以恢复肠道屏障完整性、补充肠道微生物群并提供生物多样性。➢ 为了更好地理解肠道健康与关节疾病之间的关联机制，需要利用先进的下一代测序技术进行未来的基础科学研究和设计良好的临床试验。

abstract: RNA-binding proteins (RBPs) are emerging as crucial regulators in cancer, but the development of therapeutic strategies targeting RBPs remains limited. Here, through chemical proteomics approaches, we identify DIQ01 as a novel small-molecule inhibitor of KH-type splicing regulatory protein (KHSRP), an RBP that is aberrantly hyper-expressed in human tumors and plays an essential role in proliferation, metastasis, and tumor progression. DIQ01 specifically binds to the KH3 and KH4 domains (Phe358 as the key residue) of KHSRP, inhibiting its interaction with mRNAs. Furthermore, the binding of DIQ01 diminishes the PRMT5-mediated arginine methylation of KHSRP, a post-translational modification required for its oncogenic activity. Mechanistically, transcriptomic and proteomic profiling suggested that DIQ01 functionally inactivates KHSRP, triggering destabilization and downregulation of its target PLK1 mRNA. This leads to S-phase arrest, DNA damage, and apoptosis in HCT116 cells. Both in vitro and in vivo studies, including CRC xenograft and patient-derived organoid models, demonstrate that DIQ01 exhibits potent antitumor efficacy with minimal systemic toxicity. Our findings underscore the innovative approach of concurrently targeting the RNA-binding function of an RBP and its post-translational modification, highlighting DIQ01's unique mechanism and significant translational potential as a targeted cancer therapy.
abstractZh: RNA结合蛋白（RBPs）正逐渐成为癌症中的关键调控因子，但针对RBPs的治疗策略开发仍然有限。在此，通过化学蛋白质组学方法，我们鉴定出DIQ01为KH型剪接调控蛋白（KHSRP）的一种新型小分子抑制剂，KHSRP是一种在人类肿瘤中异常高表达的RBP，在增殖、转移和肿瘤进展中发挥重要作用。DIQ01特异性结合KHSRP的KH3和KH4结构域（Phe358为关键残基），抑制其与mRNA的相互作用。此外，DIQ01的结合减少了PRMT5介导的KHSRP精氨酸甲基化，这是一种其致癌活性所必需的翻译后修饰。机制上，转录组和蛋白质组分析表明，DIQ01功能上使KHSRP失活，触发其靶标PLK1 mRNA的不稳定化和下调。这导致HCT116细胞发生S期阻滞、DNA损伤和凋亡。体外和体内研究，包括结直肠癌异种移植和患者来源的类器官模型，均证明DIQ01表现出强效的抗肿瘤疗效，且全身毒性极小。我们的发现强调了同时靶向RBP的RNA结合功能及其翻译后修饰的创新方法，突出了DIQ01的独特机制和作为靶向癌症疗法的显著转化潜力。

abstract: Human pluripotent stem cell (hPSC)-derived alveolar organoids (ALOs) have emerged as a powerful tool for modeling human lung development and disease, and accelerating respiratory drug discovery. However, achieving the functional maturation of ALOs remains challenging. Polydopamine (PDA) is a mussel-inspired polyphenolic biomaterial with antioxidant and adhesive properties that can be deployed as surface coatings and nanoparticles (NPs) in cell culture systems. Here, we integrate PDA coatings and NPs sequentially in a stage-adaptive manner throughout the hPSC-derived ALOs differentiation system and study their contributions to ALOs maturation. Our results demonstrated PDA coating yielded more anterior foregut endoderm (AFE) spheroids by strengthening the interaction between Matrigel and substrate. Bulk RNA-seq revealed enrichment of cell-cell and cell-extracellular matrix interactions by PDA. The subsequent incorporation of PDA NPs in Matrigel at lung progenitor cells (LPCs) stage significantly mitigated reactive oxygen species (ROS) accumulation and enhanced LPCs generation. Functionally, AT2 cells in ALOs exhibit characteristic lysosome-to-lamellar body (LB) maturation due to the traffic of internalized PDA NPs to endolysosome. Transcriptomics further indicated enrichment of endocytic-phagosome and epithelium development pathways by PDA treatment. Together, our study establishes a stage-adaptive-integrated PDA strategy throughout hPSC-to-ALOs differentiation and demonstrates that PDA robustly enhances ALOs maturation and secretory function.
abstractZh: 人多能干细胞（hPSC）来源的肺泡类器官（ALOs）已成为模拟人类肺部发育和疾病以及加速呼吸系统药物发现的强大工具。然而，实现ALOs的功能成熟仍然具有挑战性。聚多巴胺（PDA）是一种受贻贝启发的多酚生物材料，具有抗氧化和粘附特性，可作为表面涂层和纳米颗粒（NPs）应用于细胞培养系统。在此，我们在hPSC来源的ALOs分化系统中，以阶段性自适应方式依次整合PDA涂层和NPs，并研究它们对ALOs成熟的贡献。我们的结果表明，PDA涂层通过增强Matrigel与基底之间的相互作用，产生了更多的前肠内胚层（AFE）球体。批量RNA-seq显示，PDA富集了细胞-细胞和细胞-细胞外基质相互作用。随后在肺祖细胞（LPCs）阶段将PDA NPs掺入Matrigel中，显著减轻了活性氧（ROS）积累并增强了LPCs的生成。功能上，ALOs中的AT2细胞表现出特征性的溶酶体至板层体（LB）成熟，这是由于内化的PDA NPs运输至内溶酶体所致。转录组学进一步表明，PDA处理富集了内吞-吞噬体及上皮发育通路。总之，我们的研究建立了贯穿hPSC至ALOs分化的阶段性自适应整合PDA策略，并证明PDA显著增强ALOs的成熟和分泌功能。

abstract: Cystic fibrosis (CF) is a genetic disorder caused by dysfunction of the CFTR chloride ion channel. Progress in molecular understanding and therapy development relies on advanced cellular models and robust assays for evaluating CFTR function. This review traces the evolution of in vitro models, from primary and immortalized cell lines to patient-specific induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) and complex three-dimensional systems. These advanced models, including air-liquid interface (ALI) cultures, organoids, and microfluidic organ-on-a-chip platforms, enable recapitulation of tissue architecture, cellular heterogeneity, and key pathological features such as impaired mucociliary clearance and chronic inflammation. A critical component of CF research is the accurate functional assessment of CFTR activity. We compare established high-resolution techniques (patch-clamp, Ussing chamber) with high-throughput screening assays, including fluorescence quenching of halide-sensitive YFP assay and organoid swelling tests. The article provides a framework for choosing the most appropriate CFTR functional assay tailored to specific research goals.
abstractZh: 囊性纤维化（CF）是一种由CFTR氯离子通道功能障碍引起的遗传性疾病。分子理解和治疗开发的进展依赖于先进的细胞模型和稳健的检测方法来评估CFTR功能。本综述追溯了体外模型的演变，从原代和永生化细胞系到患者特异性诱导多能干细胞（iPSCs）和复杂的三维系统。这些先进模型，包括气-液界面（ALI）培养、类器官和微流控器官芯片平台，能够重现组织架构、细胞异质性以及关键病理特征，如黏液纤毛清除受损和慢性炎症。CF研究的一个关键组成部分是准确评估CFTR活性。我们比较了成熟的高分辨率技术（膜片钳、尤斯室）与高通量筛选检测方法，包括卤化物敏感YFP检测的荧光淬灭和类器官肿胀试验。本文为根据特定研究目标选择最合适的CFTR功能检测方法提供了一个框架。

abstract: Bladder cancer is the most prevalent malignancy of the urinary tract; nevertheless, its progression and treatment continue to pose substantial challenges. While the molecular mechanisms underlying bladder cancer progression remain unknown, the Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway has established roles in cancer progression. In this study, we investigated the contribution of BCL9(L) (coactivators of β-catenin) to bladder cancer progression and evaluated the therapeutic potential of disrupting the β-catenin/BCL9(L) complex. We demonstrate that BCL9L exerts oncogenic effects on the proliferation and invasion of bladder cancer cells and the knockdown of BCL9 also reduced the proliferation, migration, and invasion of bladder cancer cells, suggesting similar oncogenic roles. Pharmacological inhibition of the β-catenin/BCL9(L) complex using ZW4864 suppresses a subset of Wnt/β-catenin targets in bladder cancer cells, indicating the inhibition of canonical Wnt signaling. We show ZW4864 has an inhibitory effect on the proliferation, migration, and invasion of bladder cancer cells and impedes the growth and formation of multicellular bladder cancer organoids. These findings demonstrate the crucial role of BCL9 and BCL9L in bladder cancer progression and highlight the β-catenin/BCL9(L) axis as a promising therapeutic target.
abstractZh: 膀胱癌是泌尿系统最常见的恶性肿瘤；然而，其进展和治疗仍然面临巨大挑战。虽然膀胱癌进展的分子机制尚不清楚，但Wnt/β-catenin信号通路在癌症进展中已确立作用。在本研究中，我们探讨了BCL9(L)（β-catenin的共激活因子）对膀胱癌进展的贡献，并评估了破坏β-catenin/BCL9(L)复合物的治疗潜力。我们证明BCL9L对膀胱癌细胞的增殖和侵袭具有致癌作用，而敲低BCL9也减少了膀胱癌细胞的增殖、迁移和侵袭，表明其具有相似的致癌作用。使用ZW4864对β-catenin/BCL9(L)复合物进行药理学抑制，可抑制膀胱癌细胞中一部分Wnt/β-catenin靶基因，表明经典Wnt信号传导受到抑制。我们显示ZW4864对膀胱癌细胞的增殖、迁移和侵袭具有抑制作用，并阻碍多细胞膀胱癌类器官的生长和形成。这些发现证明了BCL9和BCL9L在膀胱癌进展中的关键作用，并强调β-catenin/BCL9(L)轴是一个有前景的治疗靶点。

abstract:
Background

Long-term proton pump inhibitor (PPI) use is associated with increased intestinal disease risk, but its damaging mechanisms remain unclear.Methods

Mice were administered rabeprazole (Rab) for 4 weeks before dextran sulfate sodium (DSS) or ionizing radiation (IR) injury. We employed RNA sequencing, metabolomics, and metagenomics, evaluated intestinal stem cell (ISC) function, and used organoids for validation.Results

Long-term Rab induced small intestinal mucosal injury and exacerbated DSS/IR-induced damage, manifesting as crypt/villus atrophy and reduced ISC numbers. Mechanistically, Rab downregulated the Wnt pathway and impaired mucosal defense and regeneration. Microbiota involvement was indicated by fecal transplantation. Integrated metagenomic and metabolomic analyses revealed that Rab induced intestinal dysbiosis and reduced ileal bile acids, particularly 7-ketolithocholic acid (7KLCA) and chenodeoxycholic acid (CDCA). Faecalibaculum rodentium supplementation restored ISC self-renewal by converting CDCA to 7KLCA. In vitro, 7KLCA activated Wnt signaling to rescue Rab-induced stem cell impairment. In vivo, both 7KLCA and Gly-β-MCA (intestinal FXR antagonists) suppressed the FXR-FGF15 axis, restored the expression of hepatic bile acid synthesis enzymes, and promoted epithelial repair, thereby mitigating DSS-induced injury.Conclusions

Chronic PPI use impairs ISC self-renewal by disrupting the microbiota-7KLCA-Wnt axis. F. rodentium or 7KLCA supplementation ameliorates PPI-induced effects, highlighting a microbe-metabolite axis as a pivotal mechanism and potential therapies for PPI-associated intestinal damage.
abstractZh:
背景

长期使用质子泵抑制剂（PPI）与肠道疾病风险增加相关，但其损伤机制尚不清楚。方法

小鼠在葡聚糖硫酸钠（DSS）或电离辐射（IR）损伤前给予雷贝拉唑（Rab）4周。我们采用RNA测序、代谢组学和宏基因组学，评估肠道干细胞（ISC）功能，并使用类器官进行验证。结果

长期Rab诱导小肠黏膜损伤，并加重DSS/IR引起的损伤，表现为隐窝/绒毛萎缩和ISC数量减少。机制上，Rab下调Wnt通路，损害黏膜防御和再生。粪便移植表明微生物群参与。整合宏基因组和代谢组分析显示，Rab诱导肠道菌群失调，并减少回肠胆汁酸，特别是7-酮石胆酸（7KLCA）和鹅去氧胆酸（CDCA）。补充Faecalibaculum rodentium通过将CDCA转化为7KLCA恢复ISC自我更新。体外，7KLCA激活Wnt信号以挽救Rab诱导的干细胞损伤。体内，7KLCA和Gly-β-MCA（肠道FXR拮抗剂）均抑制FXR-FGF15轴，恢复肝脏胆汁酸合成酶的表达，促进上皮修复，从而减轻DSS诱导的损伤。结论

长期使用PPI通过破坏微生物-7KLCA-Wnt轴损害ISC自我更新。F. rodentium或7KLCA补充可改善PPI诱导的效应，突显微生物-代谢物轴作为PPI相关肠道损伤的关键机制和潜在治疗策略。

abstract:
Background

Tumor heterogeneity and the complexity of the tumor microenvironment (TME) drive therapeutic resistance in lung cancer, highlighting the critical need for experimental models that faithfully recapitulate tumor-stroma-immune interactions.Methods

We developed patient-specific lung cancer tumoroid (LCT) models by integrating lung cancer organoids (LCOs), cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) and immune cells isolated from single tumor tissue sources using a modular, transwell-based culture platform. The model supports cryopreservation and reproducible reconstruction of cellular components. Multimodal assessments, including histological characterization, dose-response pharmacologic profiling, immune profiling, and transcriptomic analyses, were performed across diverse co-culture configurations to evaluate patient-specific TME features and treatment-associated responses.Results

The LCT models successfully recapitulated key structural and cellular features of native TMEs, demonstrating high reproducibility across patient samples. Functional analyses revealed tumor-intrinsic heterogeneity in responses to chemotherapy and chemo-immunotherapy. CAF integration altered therapeutic responses and was associated with reduced immune activation and cytotoxic efficacy in selected models, suggesting stromal contributions to treatment resistance. Transcriptomic analyses showed that reconstructed TMEs preserved patient-specific stromal and immune programs associated with therapeutic responsiveness, including transcriptional features linked to clinical outcomes in independent immunotherapy-treated cohorts.Conclusions

This patient-specific LCT model provides a scalable and translationally relevant approach for the ex vivo reconstruction of native TMEs, facilitating the functional interrogation of tumor-stroma-immune interactions. By capturing heterogeneous stromal responses, this platform offers a valuable tool for investigating therapeutic resistance and supports the further development of precision immune-oncology and patient-tailored therapeutic strategies in lung cancer.
abstractZh:
背景

肿瘤异质性和肿瘤微环境（TME）的复杂性驱动肺癌的治疗耐药性，凸显了对能够忠实重现肿瘤-基质-免疫相互作用的实验模型的迫切需求。方法

我们通过整合来自单一肿瘤组织来源的肺癌类器官（LCOs）、癌症相关成纤维细胞（CAFs）和免疫细胞，使用模块化、基于transwell的培养平台，开发了患者特异性肺癌肿瘤类器官（LCT）模型。该模型支持冷冻保存和细胞组分的可重复重建。我们进行了多模式评估，包括组织学表征、剂量反应药理学分析、免疫分析和转录组分析，涵盖不同的共培养配置，以评估患者特异性TME特征和治疗相关反应。结果

LCT模型成功重现了天然TME的关键结构和细胞特征，在患者样本中表现出高可重复性。功能分析揭示了肿瘤内在的化疗和化学免疫治疗反应异质性。CAF整合改变了治疗反应，并在选定模型中与免疫激活和细胞毒性功效降低相关，提示基质对治疗耐药的贡献。转录组分析显示，重建的TME保留了与治疗反应性相关的患者特异性基质和免疫程序，包括与独立免疫治疗队列中临床结果相关的转录特征。结论

这种患者特异性LCT模型为体外重建天然TME提供了一种可扩展且具有转化相关性的方法，促进了肿瘤-基质-免疫相互作用的功能研究。通过捕获异质性基质反应，该平台为研究治疗耐药性提供了有价值的工具，并支持肺癌精准免疫肿瘤学和患者定制治疗策略的进一步开发。

abstract: Abnormal accumulation of Poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase 1 (PARP1) promotes cancer progression, yet its stabilization mechanisms remain unclear. Here, we identify E3 ubiquitin ligase tripartite motif-containing 21 (TRIM21) as a PARP1-binding partner. PARP1 interacts directly with TRIM21 via its 662-908 domain, while the PRY-SPRY domain of TRIM21 is essential for this binding. TRIM21 facilitates PARP1 polyubiquitination at residue K654, leading to its degradation. In small cell lung cancer (SCLC), TRIM21 is significantly downregulated, and its tumor-suppressive function is partly mediated through the degradation of PARP1, supporting genomic stability. Additionally, the PI3K/AKT pathway transcriptionally suppresses TRIM21 via transcription factor STAT5A, thereby stabilizing PARP1. Importantly, combining the PI3K/AKT inhibitor PKI-587 with the PARP inhibitor BMN673 synergistically inhibits tumor growth across multiple SCLC models, including cell lines, patient-derived organoids, and xenograft models. Collectively, our findings define a "PI3K/AKT-STAT5A-TRIM21-PARP1" axis critical for SCLC progression and propose its dual inhibition as a promising therapeutic strategy.
abstractZh: 聚（ADP-核糖）聚合酶1（PARP1）的异常积累促进癌症进展，但其稳定机制仍不清楚。在此，我们确定E3泛素连接酶三基序蛋白21（TRIM21）为PARP1的结合伙伴。PARP1通过其662-908结构域与TRIM21直接相互作用，而TRIM21的PRY-SPRY结构域对此结合至关重要。TRIM21促进PARP1在K654残基处的多泛素化，导致其降解。在小细胞肺癌（SCLC）中，TRIM21显著下调，其肿瘤抑制功能部分通过降解PARP1介导，从而支持基因组稳定性。此外，PI3K/AKT通路通过转录因子STAT5A转录抑制TRIM21，从而稳定PARP1。重要的是，将PI3K/AKT抑制剂PKI-587与PARP抑制剂BMN673联合使用，在多种SCLC模型中（包括细胞系、患者来源的类器官和异种移植模型）协同抑制肿瘤生长。总的来说，我们的发现定义了一个对SCLC进展至关重要的“PI3K/AKT-STAT5A-TRIM21-PARP1”轴，并提出其双重抑制作为一种有前景的治疗策略。

abstract: Branching morphogenesis is a fundamental process governing pulmonary development, epithelial differentiation, and functional maturation. Here, we report a multilevel branching lung organoid (BLO) model generated from primary tip epithelial cells using a robust, chemically defined protocol. These BLOs exhibit characteristic dendritic architectures with proximodistal patterning and alveolar-sac-like structures. Time-resolved single-cell RNA sequencing reveals that BLOs comprise both proximal airway and distal alveolar epithelial populations and recapitulate the developmental trajectories of lung epithelial lineages in vitro. Live-cell imaging further demonstrates that the spatial organization and branching dynamics of BLOs closely resemble those of native murine pulmonary epithelium in vivo. Upon transplantation into bleomycin-injured murine models, BLO-derived cells further mature and ameliorate pulmonary fibrosis. Together, these findings establish BLOs as a powerful platform for investigating lung branching morphogenesis, epithelial lineage specification and regeneration.
abstractZh: 分支形态发生是调控肺发育、上皮分化和功能成熟的基本过程。在此，我们报告了一种利用稳健、化学成分明确的方案，由原代顶端上皮细胞生成的多级分支肺类器官（BLO）模型。这些BLO表现出特征性的树状结构，具有近端-远端模式和肺泡囊样结构。时间分辨单细胞RNA测序揭示，BLO包含近端气道和远端肺泡上皮细胞群，并在体外重现了肺上皮谱系的发育轨迹。活细胞成像进一步表明，BLO的空间组织和分支动力学与体内天然小鼠肺上皮高度相似。在移植到博来霉素损伤的小鼠模型后，BLO来源的细胞进一步成熟并减轻肺纤维化。总之，这些发现确立了BLO作为研究肺分支形态发生、上皮谱系特化和再生的强大平台。
