abstract: Several genes guide inner ear development, and mutations in these genes can cause malformations that result in congenital hearing loss. However, the contribution of noncoding regulatory elements remains largely unclear. This study investigates the function of distal enhancer elements in the transcriptional regulation of GDF6, a gene implicated in cochlear development. Using mouse models with targeted deletions, human inner ear organoids, and CRISPR interference (CRISPRi), we identified a downstream regulatory interval harboring a developmental enhancer required to maintain GDF6 expression during otic epithelial maturation and cochlear morphogenesis. Deletion of this regulatory region or targeting of CRISPRi-based repressors to these regions resulted in decreased GDF6 expression, failure of otic-epithelium development, and prevention of hair cell-like differentiation, reflecting cochlear aplasia observed in patients with corresponding genomic deletions. These findings highlight the contribution of long-range regulatory elements to auditory development and illustrate how their disruption contributes to human deafness.
abstractZh: 多个基因指导内耳发育，这些基因的突变可导致畸形，进而引起先天性听力损失。然而，非编码调控元件的贡献在很大程度上仍不清楚。本研究探讨了远端增强子元件在GDF6（一个与耳蜗发育相关的基因）转录调控中的功能。通过使用靶向缺失的小鼠模型、人内耳类器官和CRISPR干扰（CRISPRi），我们鉴定了一个下游调控区间，该区间含有一个发育增强子，对于维持耳囊上皮成熟和耳蜗形态发生过程中的GDF6表达是必需的。删除该调控区域或靶向CRISPRi阻遏物至这些区域，导致GDF6表达降低、耳囊上皮发育失败以及毛细胞样分化受阻，这反映了在具有相应基因组缺失的患者中观察到的耳蜗发育不全。这些发现强调了长程调控元件对听觉发育的贡献，并说明了它们的破坏如何导致人类耳聋。

title: Label-Free Live Cell Type Prediction by Integrating Raman Spectroscopy and Machine Learning
titleZh: 无标记活细胞类型预测：拉曼光谱与机器学习集成
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Lita A, Zannat NE, Muley H, Siminea N, Spinu S, Sjoberg J, Paun A, Nikulin Y, Herold-Mende C, Petre I, Larion M.
abstract: Coherent Raman spectroscopy enables label-free biochemical fingerprinting of live cells with subcellular resolution. We previously developed a machine learning framework capable of classifying glioma FFPE tissues using Raman spectral signatures. To accelerate live cell acquisition, we previously developed RADAR (Raman Spectral Analysis Using Deep Learning for Artifact Removal), a method that increases imaging speed by an order of magnitude while preserving spectral integrity. By integrating high-speed Raman imaging with supervised machine learning, we aimed to define unique biochemical fingerprints specific to cell type. We hypothesized that intrinsic biochemical composition alone is sufficient to distinguish cellular identity and tumor subtype. To test this, we generated metabolic maps of diverse brain-derived cell types—including astrocytoma, oligodendroglioma, and glioblastoma cells—using coherent Raman spectroscopy at single-cell resolution. Patient-derived brain tumor cell lines representing genetically heterogeneous backgrounds were analyzed. Samples were stratified by IDH1 mutation status (IDH1-mutant and IDH1–wild-type) and histologically classified as oligodendroglioma or astrocytoma. Raman spectral data were acquired from 286 live single cells across the two principal molecular classes, with further subdivision into two histologic subtypes within the IDH1-mutant group. Classification was performed using an XGBoost model with shallow tree depth (1–3), a 20% held-out test set, and grouped, stratified 5-fold cross-validation to control for sample-level bias. The machine learning framework distinguished IDH1-mutant from IDH1–wild-type cells with a ROC–AUC of 0.78 and further discriminated IDH1-mutant astrocytoma from oligodendroglioma cells with a ROC–AUC of 0.81. Feature importance analysis demonstrated that separation between IDH1-mutant and IDH1–wild-type cells was driven primarily by Raman peaks associated with protein amide bands, total NADH, unsaturated fatty acids, and heme-related vibrational modes. Within the IDH1-mutant class, discrimination between oligodendroglioma and astrocytoma was driven by lipid-rich vesicle signatures, protein/polyamide amide bands, and lipid-associated spectral features. Together, these findings support the feasibility of label-free, machine learning–assisted Raman profiling to resolve clinically relevant glioma subtypes at single-cell resolution. This scalable analytical framework provides a translational platform for investigating metabolic heterogeneity, therapeutic response, co-culture systems, and patient-derived organoid models.
abstractZh: 相干拉曼光谱能够以亚细胞分辨率对活细胞进行无标记生化指纹分析。我们此前开发了一个机器学习框架，能够利用拉曼光谱特征对胶质瘤FFPE组织进行分类。为了加速活细胞采集，我们此前开发了RADAR（基于深度学习的拉曼光谱伪影去除分析），该方法在保持光谱完整性的同时将成像速度提高了一个数量级。通过将高速拉曼成像与监督机器学习相结合，我们旨在定义特定于细胞类型的独特生化指纹。我们假设仅凭内在生化组成就足以区分细胞身份和肿瘤亚型。为了验证这一点，我们使用相干拉曼光谱在单细胞分辨率下生成了多种脑来源细胞类型（包括星形细胞瘤、少突胶质细胞瘤和胶质母细胞瘤细胞）的代谢图谱。分析了代表遗传异质性背景的患者来源脑肿瘤细胞系。样本按IDH1突变状态（IDH1突变型和IDH1野生型）分层，并根据组织学分类为少突胶质细胞瘤或星形细胞瘤。从两个主要分子类别的286个活单细胞中采集了拉曼光谱数据，并在IDH1突变组内进一步细分为两个组织学亚型。使用XGBoost模型进行分类，树深度较浅（1-3），使用20%的留出测试集，并采用分组、分层5折交叉验证以控制样本水平偏差。机器学习框架区分IDH1突变型与IDH1野生型细胞的ROC-AUC为0.78，并进一步区分IDH1突变型星形细胞瘤与少突胶质细胞瘤细胞，ROC-AUC为0.81。特征重要性分析表明，IDH1突变型与IDH1野生型细胞之间的分离主要由与蛋白质酰胺带、总NADH、不饱和脂肪酸和血红素相关振动模式相关的拉曼峰驱动。在IDH1突变类内，少突胶质细胞瘤与星形细胞瘤的区分由富含脂质的囊泡特征、蛋白质/聚酰胺酰胺带和脂质相关光谱特征驱动。总之，这些发现支持无标记、机器学习辅助的拉曼分析在单细胞分辨率下解析临床相关胶质瘤亚型的可行性。这一可扩展的分析框架为研究代谢异质性、治疗反应、共培养系统和患者来源类器官模型提供了一个转化平台。

title: Stromal Prostaglandin is a Dominant Spatial Regulator of Cell-fate Plasticity in Colorectal Cancer
titleZh: 基质前列腺素是结直肠癌细胞命运可塑性的主要空间调节因子
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Molyneux C, O’Sullivan R, Mulholland-Illingworth EJ, Moore JW, Li N, Vlckova P, Amirkhah R, Dobric A, Crampsie S, Wilkinson A, Langley J, Alonso ML, Campbell A, Claus J, Krishnaswamy S, Dunne PD, Leedham S, Tape CJ.
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) tumours with high stromal content have a worse outcome, but the mechanisms governing this are unclear. Using high-throughput single-cell perturbation analysis of CRC patient-derived organoids (PDOs) and cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) we find that epithelial cells with high stromal-communication potential are marked by the transcriptional co-repressor  DACH1 . To define the causal regulators of stromal-epithelial signalling, we developed a novel CRISPR screening platform to perturb the CAF secretome and measure epithelial stem cell responses at single-cell resolution. Intercellular CRISPR screening and full factorial ligand analysis revealed that stromal Prostaglandin E2 (PGE  2 ) is a dominant regulator of CRC cell-fate plasticity. Stromal PGE  2 converts  DACH1 + epithelia from a chemosensitive proliferative colonic stem cell (proCSC) fate into a chemorefractory and prometastatic revival colonic stem cell (revCSC) fate. PGE  2 -driven epithelial transdetermination is rapid and reversible, providing an acute mechanism for stromal-driven plasticity in CRC tumours. Genetic and pharmacological inhibition of stromal COX2 inhibits epithelial plasticity, trapping CRC epithelia in an anti-metastatic and chemosensitive proCSC fate.  PTGS2 + CAFs support a spatially resolved revCSC to proCSC plasticity gradient in human CRC tumours marked by increasing  DACH1 expression. These results reveal that stromal prostaglandin is a dominant spatial regulator of poor-prognosis cell-fates and may explain the benefit of anti-COX therapies in both preventing and treating CRC.
abstractZh: 具有高基质含量的结直肠癌（CRC）肿瘤预后较差，但控制这一现象的机制尚不清楚。通过对CRC患者来源的类器官（PDOs）和癌症相关成纤维细胞（CAFs）进行高通量单细胞扰动分析，我们发现具有高基质通讯潜力的上皮细胞以转录共抑制因子DACH1为标志。为了确定基质-上皮信号传导的因果调节因子，我们开发了一种新型CRISPR筛选平台，以扰动CAF分泌组并在单细胞分辨率下测量上皮干细胞反应。细胞间CRISPR筛选和全因子配体分析揭示，基质前列腺素E2（PGE2）是CRC细胞命运可塑性的主要调节因子。基质PGE2将DACH1+上皮细胞从化学敏感性的增殖性结肠干细胞（proCSC）命运转变为化学难治性和促转移的复兴结肠干细胞（revCSC）命运。PGE2驱动的上皮转决定是快速且可逆的，为CRC肿瘤中基质驱动的可塑性提供了急性机制。基质COX2的遗传和药理学抑制可抑制上皮可塑性，将CRC上皮细胞困在抗转移和化学敏感性的proCSC命运中。PTGS2+ CAFs在人类CRC肿瘤中支持空间分辨的revCSC到proCSC的可塑性梯度，以DACH1表达增加为标志。这些结果表明，基质前列腺素是预后不良细胞命运的主要空间调节因子，并可能解释抗COX疗法在预防和治疗CRC中的益处。

title: Modeling the MRD state reveals the insomnia of chemotherapy-tolerant persister clones
titleZh: 模拟MRD状态揭示化疗耐受性持续存在克隆的失眠现象
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Hata K, Sato T, Fukawa Y, Yotsumata H, Mizuguchi Y, Ishimaru N, Harada H, Ohteki T.
abstract: Regardless of the success of clinical surgery, disseminated tumor cells (DTCs) can persist in distant organs, with a fraction surviving chemotherapy, which can result in minimal residual disease (MRD), a relevant reservoir for metastatic relapse. Yet, the cellular states that enable the survival and outgrowth of MRD remain poorly defined. Here, using a patient-derived tongue cancer organoid (TCO) model, we recapitulated the key features of chemotherapy-tolerant DTCs by culturing TCOs under growth-factor deprivation and chemotherapeutic stress conditions that mimic the metastatic tissue environment. Clonal-level analyses revealed a distinct subset of cells that retained proliferative capacity without entering a therapy-induced cytostatic state (hereafter referred to as cycling persisters, CPs). CPs exhibited coordinated activation of the IFN signaling pathway, Xenobiotic metabolism, and inflammatory signaling pathways, defining a transcriptional and metabolic program that enables sustained proliferation of CPs under the poor conditions. Consistently, a cell population with similar features was identified in metastatic tissues from patients. Longitudinal clonal tracking demonstrated that early metastatic recurrence is more likely driven by CPs, suggesting a novel mechanism that differs from the prevailing view that relapse arises from reactivation of dormant non-CPs. Our findings highlight a critical therapeutic oversight in relapse prevention.
abstractZh: 尽管临床手术成功，播散性肿瘤细胞（DTCs）仍可持久存在于远处器官中，其中一部分能够存活过化疗，这可能导致微小残留病（MRD），这是转移性复发的重要储存库。然而，使MRD能够存活和生长的细胞状态仍知之甚少。在此，我们使用患者来源的舌癌类器官（TCO）模型，通过在模拟转移性组织环境的生长因子剥夺和化疗应激条件下培养TCO，重现了化疗耐受性DTCs的关键特征。克隆水平分析揭示了一个独特的细胞亚群，该亚群保留了增殖能力，而未进入治疗诱导的细胞静止状态（以下称为循环持续存在细胞，CPs）。CPs表现出干扰素信号通路、外源物代谢和炎症信号通路的协调激活，定义了一个转录和代谢程序，使CPs能够在恶劣条件下持续增殖。一致地，在患者的转移性组织中鉴定出具有相似特征的细胞群体。纵向克隆追踪表明，早期转移性复发更可能由CPs驱动，这提出了一种不同于主流观点的新机制，即复发源于休眠的非CPs的再激活。我们的发现强调了复发预防中一个关键的治疗疏忽。

title: Ex Vivo  Culture of Patient-Derived Primary, Metastatic, and Post-Mortem Lung Cancer Reveals Targetable States of EMT and Metabolic Plasticity
titleZh: 患者来源的原发性、转移性和死后肺癌的离体培养揭示了可靶向的EMT状态和代谢可塑性
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Acevedo-Acevedo S, Ackerman HD, Rubio VY, Hackel N, Carr CL, Miranda KA, Baldwin JR, Reiser M, Lockhart JH, Lui A, Stewart PA, Yu X, Wright GM, Alontaga AY, Koomen JM, Nguyen DT, Sawyer WG, DeNicola GM, Boyle T, Cress WD, Haura EB, Flores ER.
abstract:
SUMMARY

  Lung cancer is a highly heterogeneous disease and remains the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. While mouse models and patient-derived organoids have advanced our understanding of lung cancer, key interactions within the tumor microenvironment (TME) remain poorly characterized. We developed microtumor models from lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) and small cell lung cancer (SCLC) using mouse and patient samples, including surgical resections and rapid autopsy specimens. Microtumors preserve structural, cellular, and molecular features of the native TME, enabling mechanistic studies of tumor progression  ex vivo . Multi-omics analyses of LUAD microtumors revealed progression-associated changes, including increased epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) and metabolic reprogramming toward fatty acid synthesis. Pharmacologic inhibition of fatty acid synthesis through ACC1/2 reduced proliferation in patient-derived microtumors, identifying a targetable vulnerability. This platform provides a robust system for studying tumor progression, therapeutic response, and resistance mechanisms in lung cancer, including culturing postmortem specimens that are not accessible in current models.
abstractZh:
摘要

  肺癌是一种高度异质性的疾病，仍然是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因。虽然小鼠模型和患者来源的类器官推进了我们对肺癌的理解，但肿瘤微环境（TME）内的关键相互作用仍未被充分表征。我们利用小鼠和患者样本（包括手术切除和快速尸检标本）开发了来自肺腺癌（LUAD）和小细胞肺癌（SCLC）的微肿瘤模型。微肿瘤保留了天然TME的结构、细胞和分子特征，使得能够在离体条件下进行肿瘤进展的机制研究。对LUAD微肿瘤的多组学分析揭示了与进展相关的变化，包括上皮-间质转化（EMT）增加和向脂肪酸合成的代谢重编程。通过ACC1/2对脂肪酸合成的药理学抑制减少了患者来源微肿瘤的增殖，确定了一个可靶向的脆弱性。该平台为研究肺癌的肿瘤进展、治疗反应和耐药机制提供了一个稳健的系统，包括培养当前模型中无法获得的死后标本。

title: An Open-Source Platform Enabling Continuous, Low-Flow Control for Long-Term Operation in Biotechnology Systems
titleZh: 一个开源平台，实现生物技术系统中长期运行的连续低流量控制
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Oli SM, Rastaghi H, Walp K, Akindipe B, Oyeniran T, Patel Y.
abstract: Abstract  Precise, programmable control of fluid flow over extended periods is essential for biotechnology applications, including continuous microbial culture, organ-on-chip systems, and dynamic cell-signaling experiments. Here, we introduce an open-source platform that enables continuous, low-flow control and long-term operation in biotechnology setups. The platform integrates hardware, firmware, and software into a unified system that allows users to define, execute, and adjust programmable flow behaviors. A reconfigurable pumping module supports two operating modes: continuous-motor operation for stable medium-to-high flow rates (> 85 µL/min) and positional-motor operation for low-flow conditions (1.5–85 µL/min), enabling compatibility with microfluidic applications. An integrated graphical user interface supports constant, pulsed, and oscillatory flow profiles, scheduled experiments, and external control scripts. We validate the platform through flow characterization and long-term bacterial culture experiments in microfluidic chambers, demonstrating stable programmable operation at 1.5 µL/min over multi-day periods.
abstractZh:
摘要
在生物技术应用中，长时间精确、可编程的流体流动控制至关重要，包括连续微生物培养、器官芯片系统和动态细胞信号传导实验。在此，我们介绍一个开源平台，该平台能够在生物技术装置中实现连续、低流量控制和长期运行。该平台将硬件、固件和软件集成到一个统一系统中，允许用户定义、执行和调整可编程的流动行为。一个可重构的泵模块支持两种操作模式：连续电机操作，用于稳定的中高流量（> 85 µL/min）；以及位置电机操作，用于低流量条件（1.5–85 µL/min），从而与微流体应用兼容。一个集成的图形用户界面支持恒定、脉冲和振荡流动曲线、预定实验和外部控制脚本。我们通过流动表征和微流体室中的长期细菌培养实验验证了该平台，展示了在1.5 µL/min下多天稳定可编程操作。

abstract: Liver organoids are emerging as human-relevant three-dimensional in vitro systems for chemical safety assessment, however, their application value depends on their ability to generate decision-ready evidence within clearly defined context-of-use (CoU). Here, we review the biological fidelity, quality assessment, exposure characterization, and validation requirements of liver organoids across three CoUs: (1) hazard screening and identification, (2) mechanistic elucidation of hazard, and (3) quantitative risk assessment support. Within this CoU framework, we review recent advances in liver organoids and their applications to chemical safety assessment, highlighting models that already provide useful evidence and those where implementation remains partial or inconsistent. Based on this review, we discuss the major barriers to broader regulatory adoption, which include insufficient biological implementation, limited reproducibility, insufficient exposure characterization, and a lack of harmonized performance criteria and standardization frameworks. By evaluating liver organoids in relation to clearly defined decision questions rather than generalized technological promise, this review clarifies their current contributions, explains why their contributions remain CoU-dependent, and outlines key priorities for developing decision-ready liver organoid platforms for next-generation chemical safety assessment.
abstractZh: 肝脏类器官正逐渐成为用于化学品安全评估的具有人类相关性的三维体外系统，然而，其应用价值取决于其在明确定义的使用情境（CoU）内生成可用于决策的证据的能力。在此，我们回顾了肝脏类器官在三种CoU中的生物学保真度、质量评估、暴露表征和验证要求：（1）危害筛选和识别，（2）危害机制阐明，以及（3）定量风险评估支持。在此CoU框架内，我们回顾了肝脏类器官的最新进展及其在化学品安全评估中的应用，重点介绍了已经提供有用证据的模型以及那些实施仍不完整或不一致的模型。基于此回顾，我们讨论了更广泛监管采用的主要障碍，包括生物学实现不足、可重复性有限、暴露表征不足以及缺乏统一的性能标准和标准化框架。通过将肝脏类器官与明确定义的决策问题而非泛化的技术前景相关联进行评估，本综述阐明了它们当前的贡献，解释了为何其贡献仍依赖于CoU，并概述了开发用于下一代化学品安全评估的决策就绪型肝脏类器官平台的关键优先事项。

abstract: Rare eye diseases of the cornea and ocular surface (REDs) remain a clinical challenge owing to their low prevalence, heterogeneous presentation, and limited therapeutic options. As REDs mechanisms are often complex, preclinical models are essential to advance mechanistic understanding and support the development of targeted treatments. This review provides a comprehensive overview of the experimental platforms currently available to study REDs, including in vitro models such as primary and engineered cell systems, coculture approaches, and emerging 3D organoid technologies. In addition, we summarize in vivo strategies ranging from surgically induced models to genetic and transgenic systems that reproduce the relevant ocular phenotypes. By comparing the strengths, limitations, and translational value of these complementary approaches, this review offers an integrated perspective on how preclinical modeling can be optimized to investigate REDs pathophysiology. Furthermore, we highlight how emerging tools-such as organ-on-chip platforms and artificial intelligence-assisted analytics-may enhance model fidelity and accelerate the identification of effective therapeutic strategies.
abstractZh: 罕见角膜和眼表疾病（REDs）由于患病率低、表现异质且治疗选择有限，仍然是临床挑战。由于REDs的机制通常复杂，临床前模型对于推进机制理解和支持靶向治疗开发至关重要。本综述全面概述了目前可用于研究REDs的实验平台，包括体外模型，如原代和工程细胞系统、共培养方法以及新兴的3D类器官技术。此外，我们总结了从手术诱导模型到复制相关眼部表型的遗传和转基因系统的体内策略。通过比较这些互补方法的优势、局限性和转化价值，本综述提供了关于如何优化临床前建模以研究REDs病理生理学的综合视角。此外，我们强调了新兴工具——如器官芯片平台和人工智能辅助分析——如何可能增强模型保真度并加速有效治疗策略的识别。

title: Discovery and characterization of a hydroxypyridone-3-carboxamide analog as an antiviral lead against orthopoxviruses.
titleZh: 羟吡啶酮-3-甲酰胺类似物的发现与表征：一种针对正痘病毒的抗病毒先导化合物
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Pant A, Jagtap A, Xie J, Brahim Belhaouari D, Xie W, Mahoney JP, Dsouza L, Wang Z, Aboezz ZR, Farkas T, Wang Z, Yang Z.
affiliations: Department of Veterinary Pathobiology, College of Veterinary Medicine & Biomedical Sciences, Texas A&M University, College Station, Texas, USA.

abstract: Orthopoxviruses remain a persistent global health concern due to the ongoing circulation of mpox, the possibility of the re-emergence of smallpox, and the threats posed by many poxviruses that infect animals and/or humans. The limited availability of antiviral drugs, the unproven efficacy in humans, and the emergence of resistant mutants underscore the need for new and better therapeutics. In this study, we identify and characterize ZW-2038, a hydroxypyridone-3-carboxamide analog, as an antiviral compound against vaccinia virus (VACV), monkeypox virus (MPXV), and cowpox virus (CPXV). Discovered through a focused in-house small-molecule screen, ZW-2038 exhibited low micromolar potency and high selectivity in primary human fibroblasts. The compound also reduced viral replication under physiomimetic conditions, including human and monkey intestinal organoids (enteroids) and ex vivo mouse lung tissue models. Mechanistically, ZW-2038 suppresses VACV DNA replication and downstream post-replicative gene expression, albeit without inhibiting MPXV resolvase (Mpr) in vitro. These findings, along with in vitro safety profiling and mice pharmacokinetics studies, characterize ZW-2038 as a promising, yet suboptimal antiviral lead against orthopoxviruses, warranting future development.
abstractZh: 正痘病毒由于猴痘的持续流行、天花重新出现的可能性以及许多感染动物和/或人类的痘病毒所构成的威胁，仍然是一个持续的全球健康问题。抗病毒药物的有限可用性、在人类中未经证实的疗效以及耐药突变体的出现，凸显了对新的和更好的治疗药物的需求。在本研究中，我们鉴定并表征了ZW-2038，一种羟吡啶酮-3-甲酰胺类似物，作为针对痘苗病毒（VACV）、猴痘病毒（MPXV）和牛痘病毒（CPXV）的抗病毒化合物。通过一项有针对性的内部小分子筛选发现，ZW-2038在原代人成纤维细胞中表现出低微摩尔效力和高选择性。该化合物还在生理模拟条件下减少了病毒复制，包括人和猴肠道类器官（肠类器官）以及离体小鼠肺组织模型。在机制上，ZW-2038抑制VACV DNA复制及下游复制后基因表达，尽管在体外不抑制MPXV解离酶（Mpr）。这些发现，连同体外安全性评估和小鼠药代动力学研究，将ZW-2038表征为一种有前景但尚非最优的针对正痘病毒的抗病毒先导化合物，值得未来进一步开发。

title: TYRP1 defines a proliferative melanoma cell subpopulation, driving malignant progression and therapy resistance via the GPNMB-Notch1-SOX10/MITF axis.
titleZh: TYRP1定义了一个增殖性黑色素瘤细胞亚群，通过GPNMB-Notch1-SOX10/MITF轴驱动恶性进展和治疗耐药。

abstract:
Background

Tumor cell heterogeneity contributes to melanoma progression, therapeutic resistance, and clinical outcome variability. However, the identity and functional role of specific proliferative subpopulations remain incompletely understood. This study aims to characterize TYRP1-positive melanoma cells and elucidate their role in tumor proliferation, signaling regulation, and treatment response.Methods

We analyzed single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data from primary and metastatic melanoma samples to identify transcriptionally distinct tumor cell subtypes. Functional validation of TYRP1-positive cells was performed using patient-derived organoids, TYRP1-overexpressing melanoma cell lines (A375, SK-MEL-28), and xenograft mouse models. The downstream molecular mechanisms were investigated through gene expression profiling, siRNA-mediated knockdown, recombinant protein treatment, and pathway inhibition assays. Therapeutic responses were assessed using dabrafenib and pembrolizumab treatments.Results

TYRP1 marked a transcriptionally distinct melanoma subpopulation associated with poor patient survival. TYRP1-high organoids and cell lines exhibited significantly enhanced proliferation in vitro and accelerated tumor growth in vivo, without increased metastatic capacity. Mechanistically, TYRP1 induced expression of GPNMB, which activated Notch1 signaling and subsequently upregulated SOX10 and MITF. These transcription factors formed a positive feedback loop with TYRP1 that maintained the proliferative phenotype. GPNMB or Notch1 inhibition disrupted this loop and suppressed tumor growth. Importantly, TYRP1-overexpressing tumors demonstrated resistance to immune checkpoint blockade but increased sensitivity to dabrafenib, suggesting distinct therapeutic vulnerabilities.Conclusions

Our findings identify TYRP1 as a marker of a highly proliferative melanoma subpopulation that promotes tumor progression through the GPNMB-Notch1-SOX10/MITF axis. The TYRP1-SOX10-MITF feedback loop represents a key driver of melanoma proliferation and a potential biomarker for stratifying therapeutic response, offering a novel avenue for precision treatment in melanoma.
abstractZh:
背景

肿瘤细胞异质性 contributes to 黑色素瘤进展、治疗耐药和临床结局的变异性。然而，特定增殖亚群的身份和功能作用仍不完全清楚。本研究旨在表征TYRP1阳性的黑色素瘤细胞，并阐明其在肿瘤增殖、信号调控和治疗反应中的作用。方法

我们分析了来自原发性和转移性黑色素瘤样本的单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据，以识别转录上不同的肿瘤细胞亚型。使用患者来源的类器官、TYRP1过表达的黑色素瘤细胞系（A375、SK-MEL-28）和异种移植小鼠模型对TYRP1阳性细胞进行了功能验证。通过基因表达谱分析、siRNA介导的敲低、重组蛋白处理和通路抑制实验研究了下游分子机制。使用达拉非尼和帕博利珠单抗治疗评估治疗反应。结果

TYRP1标记了一个转录上不同的黑色素瘤亚群，与患者生存期差相关。TYRP1高表达的类器官和细胞系在体外表现出显著增强的增殖能力，在体内加速肿瘤生长，但未增加转移能力。机制上，TYRP1诱导GPNMB表达，进而激活Notch1信号，随后上调SOX10和MITF。这些转录因子与TYRP1形成正反馈回路，维持增殖表型。抑制GPNMB或Notch1可破坏该回路并抑制肿瘤生长。重要的是，TYRP1过表达的肿瘤对免疫检查点阻断表现出耐药性，但对达拉非尼的敏感性增加，提示了不同的治疗脆弱性。结论

我们的研究结果确定TYRP1是高度增殖性黑色素瘤亚群的标志物，该亚群通过GPNMB-Notch1-SOX10/MITF轴促进肿瘤进展。TYRP1-SOX10-MITF反馈回路是黑色素瘤增殖的关键驱动因素，也是分层治疗反应的潜在生物标志物，为黑色素瘤的精准治疗提供了新途径。

title: Therapeutic Applications of Induced Pluripotent Stem Cell Technology in Kidney Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
titleZh: 诱导多能干细胞技术在肾脏疾病中的治疗应用：系统评价与荟萃分析。

abstract:
Introduction

Kidney disease is a major global health burden with limited regenerative treatment options. Induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) offer patient-specific pluripotency and the potential to generate renal cells and organoids, making them a promising approach for kidney repair.Methods

A systematic literature search was conducted in PubMed, ScienceDirect, Web of Science, and Cochrane Library for peer-reviewed studies investigating the therapeutic application of iPSCs in kidney disease up to February 2026. Risk of bias was assessed using the SYRCLE tool. Random effects meta-analyses were performed, and subgroup and meta-regression analyses were conducted to explore potential sources of heterogeneity.Result

In this search, 23 preclinical studies encompassing 372 animals met the inclusion criteria, and no eligible human trials were identified. iPSC-based therapy was associated with reduced mortality (OR = 0.17; 95% CI: 0.05-0.52; p = 0.002) and improvements in blood urea nitrogen, serum creatinine, and histological injury scores. Subgroup and meta-regression analyses suggested that therapeutic response was influenced by biological factors, including cell type, disease model, delivery route, and treatment conditions. Notably, stronger effects were observed in acute kidney injury models and with direct iPSC-based interventions. However, substantial heterogeneity was observed across most renal outcomes (I 2 > 90%), indicating considerable variability among studies.Conclusion

iPSC-based therapy demonstrates beneficial effects in experimental kidney disease, particularly in acute models. However, the high degree of heterogeneity, potential risk of bias, and limited safety data constrain the reliability and generalizability of these findings. Further optimization of therapeutic strategies and rigorous long-term safety evaluations are required to support clinical translation.
abstractZh:
引言

肾脏疾病是全球主要的健康负担，再生治疗选择有限。诱导多能干细胞（iPSCs）提供患者特异性的多能性，并具有生成肾细胞和类器官的潜力，使其成为肾脏修复的有前景的方法。方法

在PubMed、ScienceDirect、Web of Science和Cochrane Library中进行了系统的文献检索，以查找截至2026年2月研究iPSCs在肾脏疾病中治疗应用的同行评审研究。使用SYRCLE工具评估偏倚风险。进行了随机效应荟萃分析，并进行了亚组和元回归分析以探索异质性的潜在来源。结果

在本次检索中，23项临床前研究（涵盖372只动物）符合纳入标准，未发现符合条件的人体试验。基于iPSC的治疗与死亡率降低（OR = 0.17；95% CI：0.05-0.52；p = 0.002）以及血尿素氮、血清肌酐和组织学损伤评分的改善相关。亚组和元回归分析表明，治疗反应受生物学因素影响，包括细胞类型、疾病模型、给药途径和治疗条件。值得注意的是，在急性肾损伤模型和直接基于iPSC的干预中观察到更强的效果。然而，大多数肾脏结局存在显著异质性（I² > 90%），表明研究间存在相当大的变异性。结论

基于iPSC的治疗在实验性肾脏疾病中显示出有益效果，尤其是在急性模型中。然而，高度异质性、潜在的偏倚风险以及有限的安全性数据限制了这些发现的可靠性和普适性。需要进一步优化治疗策略并进行严格的长效安全性评估，以支持临床转化。

title: Organ-on-a-chip as a next-generation tool in drug development: A bibliometric and patent analysis.
titleZh: 器官芯片作为药物开发中的下一代工具：文献计量与专利分析。

abstract: Organ-on-a-chip (OoC) platforms are microengineered systems that combine microfluidic control with living cells to emulate the physiological functions of human tissues and organs in vitro. OoC has become a transformative tool in pharmaceutical research, offering unprecedented capabilities for predicting drug efficacy, pharmacokinetics, and toxicity with human-relevant precision. This study presents a comprehensive scientometric and patent landscape analysis of OoC studies in pharmaceutical sciences spanning 2008-2025. Using CiteSpace, we mapped 1,786 publications to identify influential authors, landmark works, and temporal shifts in thematic focus. Keyword burst and clustering analyses reveal emerging frontiers in multi-organ integration, disease modeling, and drug screening. Patent data indicate a rapid expansion since 2016, led by China and the United States, underscoring a translational trajectory from fundamental research to applied biotechnology. These findings delineate the evolving intellectual and technological framework of organ-on-a-chip research in drug development and highlight future priorities in multi-organ systems, biomaterials optimization, and clinical translation.
abstractZh: 器官芯片（OoC）平台是微工程系统，结合微流体控制与活细胞，在体外模拟人体组织和器官的生理功能。OoC已成为药物研究中的变革性工具，以前所未有的能力预测药效、药代动力学和毒性，并具有人体相关精度。本研究对2008-2025年间药物科学领域的OoC研究进行了全面的科学计量和专利景观分析。使用CiteSpace，我们绘制了1,786篇出版物，以识别有影响力的作者、里程碑式作品以及主题焦点的时序变化。关键词突发和聚类分析揭示了多器官整合、疾病建模和药物筛选中的新兴前沿。专利数据表明自2016年以来快速扩张，由中国和美国引领，突显了从基础研究到应用生物技术的转化轨迹。这些发现描绘了器官芯片研究在药物开发中不断发展的知识和技术框架，并强调了多器官系统、生物材料优化和临床转化方面的未来优先事项。

abstract: Pediatric movement disorders (PMDs) are genetically and phenotypically heterogeneous neurodevelopmental and neurodegenerative conditions for which disease-modifying therapies remain limited, in part due to the poor translational relevance of traditional animal and cellular models. Recent advances in complex patient-derived in vitro systems, including regionally patterned neuronal cultures, organoids, assembloids, and microfluidic platforms, enable the study of human disease while preserving the patient's inherent genetic background. These models facilitate direct examination of pathogenic mechanisms, circuit-level dysfunction and therapeutic strategies, thereby offering new opportunities to advance precision medicine. This review synthesizes recent progress in patient-derived neural models relevant to PMDs, highlighting emerging technologies that increase biological and physiological complexity, and discusses key technical and translational challenges.
abstractZh: 儿科运动障碍（PMDs）是遗传和表型异质性的神经发育和神经退行性疾病，其疾病修饰疗法仍然有限，部分原因是传统动物和细胞模型的转化相关性较差。近年来，复杂的患者来源体外系统取得了进展，包括区域模式化的神经元培养、类器官、组装体和微流控平台，这些系统能够在保留患者固有遗传背景的同时研究人类疾病。这些模型有助于直接检查致病机制、回路水平功能障碍和治疗策略，从而为推进精准医学提供新的机会。本综述综合了与PMDs相关的患者来源神经模型的最新进展，重点介绍了增加生物学和生理学复杂性的新兴技术，并讨论了关键的技术和转化挑战。

abstract: Erythropoietin (EPO), a glycoprotein hormone conventionally associated with erythropoiesis, has emerged as a versatile macromolecule with substantial therapeutic potential in tissue engineering and regenerative medicine. Beyond its role in red blood cell production, EPO displays pleiotropic effects, including angiogenesis, neuroprotection, anti-apoptosis, immunomodulation, and cell survival, making it a suitable agent for tissue repair and regeneration. This review explores EPO's biological characteristics and its integration into tissue-engineered constructs through innovative approaches such as scaffold immobilization, hydrogel encapsulation, and genetically modified cells for localized delivery. EPO has shown remarkable efficacy in regenerating diverse tissues, including bone, cartilage, neural, cardiac, dental, and skin, and in promoting wound healing. Additionally, its applications extend to advanced fields such as organoid development, immune modulation, and cancer research, further highlighting its versatility. Nevertheless, challenges such as maintaining EPO's bioactivity, achieving controlled and sustained delivery, and mitigating systemic or off-target effects remain significant barriers. Furthermore, its dual role in cancer biology necessitates a deeper understanding of its effects on tumor growth and immunity. Future advances in biomaterials and precision medicine could optimize EPO-based delivery systems to enable personalized therapeutic solutions. EPO stands poised to revolutionize tissue engineering, thus bridging laboratory innovation and clinical applications.
abstractZh: 促红细胞生成素（EPO）是一种传统上与红细胞生成相关的糖蛋白激素，现已作为一种多功能大分子出现，在组织工程和再生医学中具有巨大的治疗潜力。除了在红细胞生成中的作用外，EPO还表现出多效性效应，包括血管生成、神经保护、抗凋亡、免疫调节和细胞存活，使其成为组织修复和再生的合适药剂。本综述探讨了EPO的生物学特性及其通过创新方法（如支架固定、水凝胶封装和基因修饰细胞用于局部递送）整合到组织工程构建体中的情况。EPO在再生多种组织（包括骨、软骨、神经、心脏、牙科和皮肤）以及促进伤口愈合方面显示出显著的功效。此外，其应用扩展到类器官开发、免疫调节和癌症研究等先进领域，进一步凸显了其多功能性。然而，诸如维持EPO的生物活性、实现可控和持续递送以及减轻全身性或脱靶效应等挑战仍然是重大障碍。此外，其在癌症生物学中的双重作用需要更深入地理解其对肿瘤生长和免疫的影响。未来生物材料和精准医学的进步可以优化基于EPO的递送系统，以实现个性化治疗解决方案。EPO有望彻底改变组织工程，从而弥合实验室创新与临床应用之间的差距。

abstract: Gene expression analyses of postmortem brains have identified hundreds of dysregulated genes in schizophrenia (SCZ) and bipolar disorder (BD). Lactate accumulation and reduced brain pH are also consistently reported in these disorders. As increased TGFB expression has been implicated in major psychiatric diseases and lactic acid induces TGFB2 upregulation in metabolic diseases, we hypothesized that lactate-induced brain acidosis may drive widespread gene dysregulation through TGFB2 activation. In our previous microarray studies, increased TGFB2 expression was observed in postmortem brains of SCZ and BD patients, while pathway analyses suggested a key role for TGFB2 in the dysregulation of other genes, particularly astrocytic genes. TGFB2 itself also exhibited promoter DNA hypomethylation in postmortem brains of these patients. Here, while brain pH was lower in SCZ and BD patients, we investigated the effects of pH alteration on the expression and promoter DNA methylation of TGFB2 and TGFB2-correlated genes in iPSC-derived neurons, astrocytes, and brain organoids (brainoids). Cultures were treated with lactic acid, HCl, bicarbonate, or NaOH to alter culture medium pH by ±0.4 units, and gene expression and promoter DNA methylation were evaluated by qPCR analyses. In our reanalysis of postmortem brain microarray data, nearly 80% of dysregulated genes, together with TGFB2, exhibited inverse correlations with brain pH. Lactic acid treatment induced increased expression and promoter DNA hypomethylation of TGFB2 and several correlated genes in astrocytes and brainoids, whereas bicarbonate and NaOH treatments showed opposite effects. These findings suggest that lactate-mediated brain acidosis may contribute to TGFB2 upregulation and widespread gene dysregulation implicated in SCZ and BD pathogenesis. Therapeutic interventions targeting lactic acid accumulation or TGFB2 hyperexpression may mitigate disease-associated brain gene dysregulation.
abstractZh: 对死后大脑的基因表达分析已鉴定出精神分裂症（SCZ）和双相情感障碍（BD）中数百个失调基因。乳酸积累和脑pH降低在这些疾病中也 consistently 被报道。由于TGFB表达增加与主要精神疾病有关，且乳酸在代谢疾病中诱导TGFB2上调，我们假设乳酸诱导的脑酸中毒可能通过TGFB2激活驱动广泛的基因失调。在我们之前的微阵列研究中，观察到SCZ和BD患者死后大脑中TGFB2表达增加，而通路分析提示TGFB2在其他基因（尤其是星形胶质细胞基因）失调中起关键作用。TGFB2本身在这些患者的死后大脑中也表现出启动子DNA低甲基化。在此，虽然SCZ和BD患者的脑pH较低，我们研究了pH变化对iPSC来源的神经元、星形胶质细胞和脑类器官（brainoids）中TGFB2及TGFB2相关基因表达和启动子DNA甲基化的影响。培养物用乳酸、HCl、碳酸氢盐或NaOH处理，使培养基pH改变±0.4个单位，并通过qPCR分析评估基因表达和启动子DNA甲基化。在我们对死后大脑微阵列数据的重新分析中，近80%的失调基因与TGFB2一起表现出与脑pH的负相关。乳酸处理在星形胶质细胞和脑类器官中诱导TGFB2及若干相关基因的表达增加和启动子DNA低甲基化，而碳酸氢盐和NaOH处理则显示相反效果。这些发现表明，乳酸介导的脑酸中毒可能有助于TGFB2上调和与SCZ和BD发病机制相关的广泛基因失调。针对乳酸积累或TGFB2过度表达的治疗干预可能减轻疾病相关的脑基因失调。

title: Integrated Single-Cell and Bulk Transcriptomic Analysis Reveals an Endothelial Gene Signature Shaping EndMT and Prognosis in Hepatocellular Carcinoma.

abstract:
Background

Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is one of the most prevalent malignant tumors of the liver, with increasing incidence and mortality rates globally. This study investigates the role of endothelial cells (ECs) in the progression of HCC, particularly focusing on the process of endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EndMT) and its underlying molecular mechanisms.Methods

We utilized single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) and multiomics analyses to explore the involvement of ECs in HCC and their transformation mechanisms. The study emphasized the potential application of EC-related genes (ECRGs) in prognostic evaluation for HCC patients. Furthermore, HCC organoids were utilized to validate the functional relevance of selected ECRGs.Results

ECs play a critical role in the progression of HCC, particularly through mechanisms related to EndMT and its influence on patient prognosis. We identified 19 key ECRGs that are pivotal to the initiation and development of HCC and constructed a robust prognostic model using LASSO regression analysis. Notably, this gene signature effectively stratifies HCC subtypes and reveals significant differences in immune cell infiltration and immune checkpoint gene expression among EC-related prognostic groups, underscoring its potential relevance in guiding immunotherapy, sorafenib therapy, and transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) outcomes. Furthermore, the coculture system of HCC and vascular organoids successfully mimicked the EndMT process, revealing spatial colocalization of three ECRGs-MPZL2, KITLG, and PCDH1-with established EndMT markers, suggesting their potential as therapeutic targets in tumor-associated endothelial plasticity.Conclusions

This study emphasizes ECs' role in HCC progression and how EndMT affects prognosis. HCC organoids revealed ECRGs linked to EndMT, like MPZL2, KITLG, and PCDH1, as potential therapeutic targets.
abstractZh:
背景

肝细胞癌（HCC）是最常见的肝脏恶性肿瘤之一，全球发病率和死亡率不断上升。本研究探讨内皮细胞（ECs）在HCC进展中的作用，特别关注内皮-间质转化（EndMT）过程及其潜在分子机制。方法

我们利用单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）和多组学分析来探索ECs在HCC中的参与及其转化机制。研究强调了EC相关基因（ECRGs）在HCC患者预后评估中的潜在应用。此外，利用HCC类器官验证了选定ECRGs的功能相关性。结果

ECs在HCC进展中发挥关键作用，特别是通过与EndMT相关的机制及其对患者预后的影响。我们确定了19个关键的ECRGs，它们对HCC的发生和发展至关重要，并使用LASSO回归分析构建了一个稳健的预后模型。值得注意的是，该基因特征有效地对HCC亚型进行分层，并揭示了EC相关预后组之间免疫细胞浸润和免疫检查点基因表达的显著差异，强调了其在指导免疫治疗、索拉非尼治疗和经动脉化疗栓塞（TACE）结果方面的潜在相关性。此外，HCC和血管类器官的共培养系统成功模拟了EndMT过程，揭示了三个ECRGs——MPZL2、KITLG和PCDH1——与已建立的EndMT标志物的空间共定位，表明它们作为肿瘤相关内皮可塑性治疗靶点的潜力。结论

本研究强调了ECs在HCC进展中的作用以及EndMT如何影响预后。HCC类器官揭示了与EndMT相关的ECRGs，如MPZL2、KITLG和PCDH1，作为潜在的治疗靶点。

title: Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury: Molecular Mechanisms and Therapeutic Interventions.
titleZh: 缺血再灌注损伤：分子机制与治疗干预。

abstract: Ischemia-reperfusion injury (IRI) is a common pathological process underlying cardiovascular events, organ transplantation, and shock resuscitation. Its paradox is that restoration of blood flow, while essential for tissue survival, can itself intensify cellular stress and amplify tissue damage. This review delineates the cross-organ mechanistic cascade of IRI, beginning with metabolic collapse, adenosine triphosphate (ATP) depletion, and ionic dysregulation during ischemia, and progressing to reperfusion-driven mitochondrial dysfunction, oxidative and nitrosative stress, and activation of regulated cell death programs. We further highlight how sterile inflammation evolves into a coordinated endothelial-immune-coagulation interaction network centered on neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs), which couple microvascular obstruction with inflammatory signaling to promote immunothrombosis and propagate injury locally and to distant organs. Despite major advances in mechanistic insight, translation into effective therapies remains inconsistent, largely due to phenotypic heterogeneity, narrow therapeutic windows, and the lack of real-time biomarkers that capture pathway activity. Future progress will require a systems-level, cross-organ framework for immune remodeling, with particular emphasis on targetable NET-driven immunothrombotic phenotypes. Biomarker-guided precision stratification, multimodal data integration, ex vivo machine perfusion platforms, and organoid-based human models may enable mechanism-aligned trials and shift therapy from macroscopic reperfusion toward microvascular stabilization and cellular repair.
abstractZh: 缺血再灌注损伤（IRI）是心血管事件、器官移植和休克复苏中常见的病理过程。其悖论在于，恢复血流虽然对组织存活至关重要，但本身可能加剧细胞应激并放大组织损伤。本综述阐述了IRI的跨器官机制级联，从缺血期间的代谢崩溃、三磷酸腺苷（ATP）耗竭和离子失调开始，进展到再灌注驱动的线粒体功能障碍、氧化和亚硝化应激，以及调节性细胞死亡程序的激活。我们进一步强调了无菌性炎症如何演变为以中性粒细胞胞外陷阱（NETs）为中心的协调的内皮-免疫-凝血相互作用网络，该网络将微血管阻塞与炎症信号传导耦合，促进免疫血栓形成，并在局部和远处器官传播损伤。尽管在机制理解方面取得了重大进展，但转化为有效疗法仍不一致，这主要是由于表型异质性、狭窄的治疗窗口以及缺乏捕获通路活性的实时生物标志物。未来的进展将需要系统级、跨器官的免疫重塑框架，特别强调可靶向的NET驱动的免疫血栓形成表型。基于生物标志物的精准分层、多模态数据整合、离体机器灌注平台和类器官人源模型可能有助于实现机制对齐的试验，并将治疗从宏观再灌注转向微血管稳定和细胞修复。

abstract: Fetiform teratoma (FT) and fetus-in-fetu (FIF) represent a spectrum of rare retroperitoneal masses containing organoid structures. While FIF is classically defined by the presence of a vertebral axis, FT lacks this organized skeletal development. Distinguishing between these entities is critical given the malignant potential associated with FT, estimated at approximately 10%. We report a case of a 5-month-old male presenting with a large (12 cm) retroperitoneal mass and elevated alpha-fetoprotein (AFP 56.8 IU/mL; age-matched reference <7 IU/mL). Macroscopically, the resected tumor featured a distinct rudimentary digitiform projection with a nail bed. Histopathology demonstrated extensive organoid differentiation, including gastrointestinal loops with muscular layers, respiratory epithelium, and well-formed pancreatic parenchyma and adrenal cortex. Despite the complex organogenesis and limb-like morphology, the absence of a vertebral column or ossified long bones supported a diagnosis of mature cystic teratoma with fetiform features (FT) over FIF. This report highlights the diagnostic ambiguity within the "gray zone" of these lesions and emphasizes the role of axial skeletal organization and serum AFP levels as complementary tools for classification and oncologic surveillance.
abstractZh: 胎儿样畸胎瘤（FT）和胎中胎（FIF）代表了一类罕见的腹膜后肿块，其中包含类器官结构。虽然FIF的经典定义是存在脊柱轴，但FT缺乏这种有组织的骨骼发育。鉴于FT相关的恶性潜能（估计约为10%），区分这些实体至关重要。我们报告一例5个月大男性患儿，表现为一个大的（12厘米）腹膜后肿块和升高的甲胎蛋白（AFP 56.8 IU/mL；年龄匹配参考值<7 IU/mL）。肉眼观察，切除的肿瘤具有一个明显的原始指状突起，带有甲床。组织病理学显示广泛的类器官分化，包括具有肌层的胃肠道袢、呼吸道上皮，以及形成良好的胰腺实质和肾上腺皮质。尽管存在复杂的器官发生和肢体样形态，但缺乏脊柱或骨化的长骨支持诊断为成熟囊性畸胎瘤伴胎儿样特征（FT），而非FIF。本报告强调了这些病变“灰色地带”中的诊断模糊性，并强调了轴向骨骼组织和血清AFP水平作为分类和肿瘤学监测的互补工具的作用。

abstract: Focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (FSGS) is a major cause of nephrotic syndrome and end-stage kidney disease (ESKD). Many cases are attributable to pathogenic variants in podocyte-related genes, such as inverted formin 2 (INF2). However, no specific treatment exists for hereditary FSGS, and experimental platforms that faithfully model podocyte injury remain limited. Therefore, in this study, we developed an injury model by generating induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) from a patient with INF2-associated FSGS and differentiating them into kidney organoids. Podocytes were validated by immunofluorescence staining for podocyte-specific markers. We induced podocyte injury in this model using puromycin aminonucleoside (PAN) in a dose-dependent manner. Injury severity was quantified by measuring podocalyxin fluorescence intensity. Cyclosporine A (CsA) or voclosporin (VCS) was administered as a 1-h pretreatment before PAN exposure to evaluate their podocyte-protective effects. The kidney organoids exhibited well-defined podocyte marker expression, confirming successful differentiation. PAN exposure caused a significant and concentration-dependent reduction in podocalyxin fluorescence, indicating robust induction of podocyte injury in organoids harboring the INF2 variant. Pretreatment with CsA or VCS significantly attenuated PAN-induced podocyte injury and preserved podocyte marker expression. CsA and VCS reduced podocyte injury to similar extents. In conclusion, we established a patient-specific kidney organoid model of INF2-associated FSGS that reliably recapitulated podocyte vulnerability to toxic injury. This platform demonstrated that calcineurin inhibitors, including the novel agent VCS, exert direct podocyte-protective effects in a genetic FSGS background and provide a practical system for mechanistic studies and therapeutic screening.
abstractZh: 局灶节段性肾小球硬化（FSGS）是肾病综合征和终末期肾病（ESKD）的主要原因。许多病例归因于足细胞相关基因的致病变异，如倒置形成素2（INF2）。然而，遗传性FSGS尚无特异性治疗方法，且能够忠实模拟足细胞损伤的实验平台仍然有限。因此，在本研究中，我们通过从一名INF2相关FSGS患者生成诱导多能干细胞（iPSCs）并将其分化为肾脏类器官，建立了一个损伤模型。通过免疫荧光染色验证足细胞特异性标志物。我们使用嘌呤霉素氨基核苷（PAN）以剂量依赖性方式在该模型中诱导足细胞损伤。通过测量足糖蛋白（podocalyxin）荧光强度来量化损伤严重程度。在PAN暴露前给予环孢素A（CsA）或伏环孢素（VCS）预处理1小时，以评估其对足细胞的保护作用。肾脏类器官表现出明确的足细胞标志物表达，证实分化成功。PAN暴露导致足糖蛋白荧光显著且浓度依赖性降低，表明在携带INF2变体的类器官中足细胞损伤被强力诱导。CsA或VCS预处理显著减轻了PAN诱导的足细胞损伤，并保留了足细胞标志物的表达。CsA和VCS在减轻足细胞损伤方面效果相似。总之，我们建立了一个INF2相关FSGS的患者特异性肾脏类器官模型，该模型可靠地重现了足细胞对毒性损伤的易感性。该平台证明，钙调神经磷酸酶抑制剂，包括新型药物VCS，在遗传性FSGS背景下发挥直接的足细胞保护作用，并为机制研究和治疗筛选提供了实用系统。

abstract:
Background

Cardiac organoids (COs) derived from induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) constitute a three-dimensional microphysiological system that more faithfully recapitulates the structural and functional complexity of human heart tissues compared to traditional two-dimensional cultures or animal models. Therefore, it highlights the significance of iPSC-derived COs in providing more precise platform for assessing drug cytotoxicity, cardiac functional toxicity, developmental toxicity, and therapeutic efficacy in disease models.Methods

Human iPSCs, after generation from somatic cells using reprogramming factors, were differentiated into COs using dynamic culture system. COs were characterized by cell composition, structure, spontaneous beating, electrophysiological properties. Furthermore, drug cytotoxicity was evaluated by assessing cell viability and lactate dehydrogenase release after exposure of COs to doxorubicin. Cardiac functional toxicity was assessed by monitoring changes in beating after exposure to different compounds. In addition, developmental toxicity was tested using thalidomide. Finally, cardioprotective drug efficacy was evaluated based on the construction of myocardial infarction (MI) and cardiac hypertrophy (CH) models.Results

The reprogrammed iPSCs have successfully generated COs with complex structure and function. Myocardial toxicity induced by anthracycline drugs was faithfully reproduced in organoids. This work also examined the effects of isoproterenol, MYK461, E-4031, and nifedipine on cardiac beating. Long-term exposure to thalidomide triggered abnormal atrial-ventricular differentiation in COs. In MI model, cyclosporine A exerted cardioprotective effects by downregulating apoptosis and inflammation. In CH model, on the other hand, apocynin outperformed metoprolol in alleviating Ang II-induced cardiac hypertrophy.Conclusions

This study establishes an efficient and stable method for generating uniform and functionally mature COs by utilising dynamic culture systems. Also, we proposes a reliable approach for drug-induced cardiotoxicity assessment and efficacy evaluation on the organoid platform, offering a multipurpose and cutting-edge tool for cardiac drug development.
abstractZh:
背景

由诱导多能干细胞（iPSCs）衍生的心脏类器官（COs）构成了一种三维微生理系统，与传统二维培养或动物模型相比，能更真实地再现人类心脏组织的结构和功能复杂性。因此，它突显了iPSC来源的COs在提供更精确平台以评估药物细胞毒性、心脏功能毒性、发育毒性以及疾病模型中的治疗效果方面的重要性。方法

使用重编程因子从体细胞生成人iPSCs后，通过动态培养系统将其分化为COs。通过细胞组成、结构、自发搏动、电生理特性对COs进行了表征。此外，通过暴露于多柔比星后评估细胞活力和乳酸脱氢酶释放来评价药物细胞毒性。通过监测暴露于不同化合物后搏动的变化来评估心脏功能毒性。此外，使用沙利度胺测试发育毒性。最后，基于心肌梗死（MI）和心脏肥大（CH）模型的构建，评估了心脏保护药物的疗效。结果

重编程的iPSCs成功生成了具有复杂结构和功能的COs。蒽环类药物诱导的心肌毒性在类器官中得到了忠实再现。这项工作还检查了异丙肾上腺素、MYK461、E-4031和硝苯地平对心脏搏动的影响。长期暴露于沙利度胺触发了COs中异常的心房-心室分化。在MI模型中，环孢素A通过下调凋亡和炎症发挥心脏保护作用。另一方面，在CH模型中，夹竹桃麻素在缓解Ang II诱导的心脏肥大方面优于美托洛尔。结论

本研究建立了一种利用动态培养系统生成均匀且功能成熟的COs的高效稳定方法。同时，我们提出了一种在类器官平台上进行药物诱导心脏毒性评估和疗效评价的可靠方法，为心脏药物开发提供了一种多用途且前沿的工具。

abstract: Cartilage is an avascular and aneural connective tissue vital for joint function, yet its limited intrinsic regenerative capacity poses significant challenges for treating injuries and degenerative diseases such as osteoarthritis (OA). Conventional models-including animal studies, cell lines, and primary chondrocyte cultures-exhibit considerable limitations in accurately replicating the native cartilage microenvironment, species-specific relevance, and differentiation potential. Recently, cartilage organoids have emerged as transformative tools that closely emulate the architecture, cellular heterogeneity, and extracellular matrix (ECM) properties of native cartilage, thereby offering a physiologically relevant platform for investigation. This review systematically examines the mechanisms governing chondrogenesis, including chondrocyte differentiation and matrix synthesis, as well as the construction of cartilage disease models. We focus on recent advances in cartilage organoid research, covering cultivation techniques, structural and functional characteristics, and diverse characterization methodologies. Furthermore, we highlight their applications in simulating pathological features of cartilage diseases, drug screening, toxicity testing, and gene therapy exploration. Current technological limitations-such as challenges in vascularization and mechanical strength-are discussed, together with future directions for developing multifunctional organoids and associated ethical and clinical considerations. This review aims to provide insights into the translational potential of cartilage organoids in regenerative medicine and disease modeling.
abstractZh: 软骨是一种无血管、无神经的结缔组织，对关节功能至关重要，但其内在再生能力有限，给治疗损伤和骨关节炎（OA）等退行性疾病带来了重大挑战。传统模型——包括动物研究、细胞系和原代软骨细胞培养——在准确复制天然软骨微环境、物种特异性和分化潜能方面存在显著局限性。近年来，软骨类器官已成为变革性工具，能够紧密模拟天然软骨的结构、细胞异质性和细胞外基质（ECM）特性，从而为研究提供生理相关平台。本综述系统探讨了调控软骨形成的机制，包括软骨细胞分化和基质合成，以及软骨疾病模型的构建。我们重点关注软骨类器官研究的最新进展，涵盖培养技术、结构和功能特征以及多种表征方法。此外，我们强调了它们在模拟软骨疾病病理特征、药物筛选、毒性测试和基因治疗探索中的应用。本文讨论了当前的技术局限性——如血管化和机械强度方面的挑战——以及开发多功能类器官的未来方向和相关伦理及临床考虑。本综述旨在为软骨类器官在再生医学和疾病建模中的转化潜力提供见解。

abstract:
Introduction

CDK4-selective inhibitors are emerging as promising anticancer agents. Relative to dual CDK4/6 inhibitors, CDK4-selective inhibitors have the potential to retain efficacy while improving tolerability. However, the therapeutic value and mechanistic consequences of selectively targeting CDK4 in prostate cancer remain largely undefined. Here, we investigated the anti-tumour activity and mode of action of the CDK4 inhibitors AU2-94 and atirmociclib across diverse prostate cancer models.Methods

Antiproliferative activity was assessed in a panel of AR-driven and AR-independent prostate cancer cell lines spanning hormone-sensitive and castration-resistant states. Efficacy was further evaluated in organoids derived from patient-derived xenografts and in xenograft mouse models. Biochemical and molecular analyses were performed to evaluate CDK4 selectivity, RB pathway engagement, transcriptional reprogramming, and downstream effects on cell-cycle regulation, and resistance-associated programmes. AU2-94 was also tested in combination with standard-of-care therapies (enzalutamide and docetaxel) and the PI3K inhibitor alpelisib.Results

AU2-94 exhibited greater selectivity for CDK4 compared with atirmociclib. AU2-94 suppressed proliferation across prostate cancer models irrespective of AR status and retained activity in aggressive and therapy-resistant settings. In RB-proficient in vitro models, AU2-94 reduced RB phosphorylation, attenuated E2F1-dependent transcriptional outputs, activated AR signalling, and decreased expression of proliferation-associated factors such as FOXM1. In vivo, AU2-94 inhibited the growth of both AR-driven (LNCaP) and AR-independent (PC3) xenografts and suppressed RB pathway signalling. Moreover, AU2-94 demonstrated additive or synergistic effects when combined with enzalutamide, docetaxel, or alpelisib that were associated with reinforced cell-cycle blockade and suppression of resistance-associated signalling.Conclusion

These findings establish selective CDK4 inhibition as a therapeutically active and mechanistically rational strategy in prostate cancer and support AU2-94 as a candidate for further preclinical and clinical development, including in combination regimens for advanced and therapy-resistant disease.
abstractZh:
引言

CDK4选择性抑制剂正逐渐成为有前景的抗癌药物。与双重CDK4/6抑制剂相比，CDK4选择性抑制剂有可能在保持疗效的同时提高耐受性。然而，在前列腺癌中选择性靶向CDK4的治疗价值和机制后果在很大程度上仍未明确。在此，我们研究了CDK4抑制剂AU2-94和atirmociclib在多种前列腺癌模型中的抗肿瘤活性和作用方式。方法

在涵盖激素敏感性和去势抵抗状态的AR驱动和AR非依赖性前列腺癌细胞系中评估了抗增殖活性。在源自患者来源异种移植物的类器官和异种移植小鼠模型中进一步评估了疗效。进行了生化和分子分析，以评估CDK4选择性、RB通路参与、转录重编程以及对细胞周期调控和耐药相关程序的下游效应。AU2-94还与标准治疗药物（恩杂鲁胺和多西他赛）以及PI3K抑制剂alpelisib联合进行了测试。结果

AU2-94对CDK4的选择性高于atirmociclib。AU2-94在前列腺癌模型中抑制增殖，与AR状态无关，并在侵袭性和难治性环境中保持活性。在RB功能正常的体外模型中，AU2-94降低了RB磷酸化，减弱了E2F1依赖性转录输出，激活了AR信号传导，并降低了FOXM1等增殖相关因子的表达。在体内，AU2-94抑制了AR驱动（LNCaP）和AR非依赖性（PC3）异种移植物的生长，并抑制了RB通路信号传导。此外，AU2-94与恩杂鲁胺、多西他赛或alpelisib联合使用时表现出相加或协同效应，这些效应与增强的细胞周期阻滞和耐药相关信号传导的抑制有关。结论

这些发现确立了选择性CDK4抑制作为前列腺癌中一种具有治疗活性和机制合理性的策略，并支持AU2-94作为进一步临床前和临床开发的候选药物，包括用于晚期和难治性疾病的联合治疗方案。

abstract: Human midbrain organoids (hMOs) derived from induced pluripotent stem cells provide a powerful system to model disorders involving dopamine (DA) dysfunction, including Parkinson's disease (PD) and neuropsychiatric conditions. However, current differentiation protocols still fall short in recapitulating early specification, substantia nigra pars compacta (SNpc)-like identity, and the functional maturation of vulnerable DA neurons. Here, we established a differentiation strategy that combines tri-phasic WNT modulation with dynamic bioreactor culture to generate hMOs enriched in SNpc-like DA neurons. This approach significantly increases the yield of TH⁺/GIRK2⁺ and TH⁺/ALDH1A1⁺ DA neurons and promotes enhanced synaptic maturation, robust electrophysiological activity, and elevated DA release. Single-cell transcriptomics revealed that this strategy drives the emergence of SOX6+/GIRK2+ SNpc-like neurons, accompanied by upregulation of synaptic, metabolic, and maturation programs, alongside reduced cell stress and apoptotic signaling. Importantly, hMOs demonstrated vulnerability upon exposure to α-synuclein preformed fibrils, resulting in aggregate formation and DA neuron degeneration, supporting their use as a human model of PD-relevant pathology. Overall, this system provides a scalable and physiologically relevant approach to investigate molecular mechanisms underlying neurodegeneration and DA-related disorders.
abstractZh: 由诱导多能干细胞衍生的人类中脑类器官（hMOs）为模拟涉及多巴胺（DA）功能障碍的疾病（包括帕金森病（PD）和神经精神疾病）提供了强大的系统。然而，目前的分化方案在重现早期特化、黑质致密部（SNpc）样身份以及脆弱DA神经元的功能成熟方面仍存在不足。在此，我们建立了一种将三相WNT调节与动态生物反应器培养相结合的分化策略，以生成富含SNpc样DA神经元的hMOs。该方法显著提高了TH⁺/GIRK2⁺和TH⁺/ALDH1A1⁺ DA神经元的产量，并促进了增强的突触成熟、稳健的电生理活性和升高的DA释放。单细胞转录组学揭示，该策略驱动SOX6⁺/GIRK2⁺ SNpc样神经元的出现，同时伴随突触、代谢和成熟程序的上调，以及细胞应激和凋亡信号的减少。重要的是，hMOs在暴露于α-突触核蛋白预形成原纤维时表现出脆弱性，导致聚集体形成和DA神经元变性，支持其作为PD相关病理的人类模型的用途。总体而言，该系统为研究神经退行性疾病和DA相关疾病背后的分子机制提供了一种可扩展且生理相关的方法。

abstract:
Background

The effect of alcohol consumption on IBD remains inconclusive, potentially due to the overlooked role of alcohol metabolism.Objective

We aimed to investigate the potential modifying role of alcohol metabolic capacity in the associations.Design

A prospective cohort study (n=455 417) was used for association analysis between alcohol consumption and IBD risk using Cox proportional hazards regression. An acetaldehyde burden score, using genetic variants of alcohol dehydrogenase and aldehyde dehydrogenase validated by expression quantitative trait loci and proteomic data, was constructed to test effect modification. Genetic and metabolomic analyses, along with mice and human-derived colonic organoid experiments, were conducted to strengthen causal inference.Results

The inverse association between alcohol and IBD risk was mainly attributable to red wine. Among individuals with low burden, reflecting low acetaldehyde generation and high acetaldehyde metabolism, per SD increase in red wine consumption (equivalent to 59.4 g/week of pure alcohol intake) was associated with a 20% (95% CI 7% to 31%) reduced Crohn's disease risk, whereas a 38% (95% CI 13% to 70%) increased risk among those with high burden. Genetic and metabolomic analyses further revealed harmful effects of acetaldehyde and protective effects of acetate. In vivo and in vitro experiments further confirmed these effects and showed that modulation of aldehyde dehydrogenase activity significantly altered colitis outcomes.Conclusion

Acetaldehyde metabolism burden modifies susceptibility to alcohol-related IBD and emphasises the importance of considering individual differences in alcohol metabolism when developing precision prevention strategies for IBD.

背景

饮酒对IBD的影响仍无定论，可能是因为酒精代谢的作用被忽视。目的

我们旨在探讨酒精代谢能力在饮酒与IBD关联中的潜在修饰作用。设计

采用前瞻性队列研究（n=455 417），使用Cox比例风险回归分析饮酒与IBD风险之间的关联。构建了乙醛负担评分，该评分使用乙醇脱氢酶和乙醛脱氢酶的遗传变异，并通过表达数量性状位点和蛋白质组学数据验证，以检验效应修饰。进行了遗传和代谢组学分析，以及小鼠和人源结肠类器官实验，以加强因果推断。结果

饮酒与IBD风险之间的负相关主要归因于红葡萄酒。在低负担个体中，反映低乙醛生成和高乙醛代谢，红葡萄酒消费每增加一个标准差（相当于每周纯酒精摄入量增加59.4克），与克罗恩病风险降低20%（95% CI 7%至31%）相关，而在高负担个体中，风险增加38%（95% CI 13%至70%）。遗传和代谢组学分析进一步揭示了乙醛的有害作用和醋酸盐的保护作用。体内和体外实验进一步证实了这些效应，并表明调节乙醛脱氢酶活性可显著改变结肠炎结局。结论

乙醛代谢负担改变了酒精相关IBD的易感性，并强调了在制定IBD精准预防策略时考虑个体酒精代谢差异的重要性。

title: Comparative Analysis of Classical and Emerging Experimental Animal Models of Liver Injury: A Comprehensive Review.
titleZh: 经典与新兴实验性肝损伤动物模型的比较分析：一项全面综述。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Salman IN, Jabbar RK, Emad I, Hassan ZAA, Harbi AM, Khudhair AY, Hussein MAM, Hamid AM, Al Amir MA, Ali MW, Khalifa MM.
affiliations: Department of Pharmacy, Alamal College for Specialized Medical Sciences, Karbala, Iraq.
Department of Anesthesia Techniques, Al-Safwa University College, Karbala, Iraq.
Pharmacology and Toxicology Department, College of Pharmacy, University of Baghdad, Baghdad, Iraq.
Pharmaceutical Medicinal Chemistry & Drug Design Department, Faculty of Pharmacy (Boys), Al-Azhar University, Nasr City, Cairo, Egypt.
abstract: Liver injury remains a significant global health concern with diverse etiologies including drug-induced hepatotoxicity, chemical exposure, and metabolic disorders. Despite decades of research using animal models of liver injury, several critical gaps remain unaddressed in the literature. First, while individual models have been well described, there is no comprehensive, comparative framework that simultaneously evaluates classical hepatotoxin models, dietary models, and emerging systems (e.g., humanized mice, inflammation-sensitized models, organoids) side-by-side. This fragmentation forces researchers to consult multiple disparate sources, leading to inconsistent model selection and reduced reproducibility. Second, the translational validity of these models-particularly for idiosyncratic drug-induced liver injury (iDILI), non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH), and herb-induced liver injury (HILI)-remains poorly benchmarked against human disease. Third, there is no evidence-based decision framework that guides researchers toward the most appropriate model for a given mechanistic or therapeutic question (e.g., "Which model best recapitulates mitochondrial hepatotoxicity?" or "How can I model immune-mediated DILI?"). Fourth, recent advances in omics technologies (single-cell RNA sequencing, spatial transcriptomics, proteomics) and humanized platforms have not been systematically integrated into traditional model comparisons. This review aims to close these four gaps by providing a side-by-side comparative analysis of 18 distinct animal models across 12 parameters (induction method, injury pattern, mechanism, species/strain differences, time course, regenerative response, advantages, limitations, translational relevance, cost, throughput, and ethical considerations), mapping each model to its closest human disease correlate with explicit discussion of similarities and limitations, proposing a practical, decision-tree-based model selection framework and integrating emerging technologies (humanized mice, CRISPR screens, organoids) into the classical landscape. Understanding the distinctive features of each model is essential for translational relevance and reproducibility in hepatotoxicity research.
abstractZh: 肝损伤仍然是一个重大的全球健康问题，其病因多样，包括药物性肝毒性、化学物质暴露和代谢性疾病。尽管数十年来使用肝损伤动物模型进行了研究，但文献中仍存在几个关键空白。首先，虽然各个模型已被充分描述，但缺乏一个全面的、比较性的框架，能够同时并排评估经典肝毒素模型、饮食模型和新兴系统（如人源化小鼠、炎症致敏模型、类器官）。这种碎片化迫使研究人员查阅多个不同的来源，导致模型选择不一致和可重复性降低。其次，这些模型的转化有效性——特别是针对特异质性药物性肝损伤（iDILI）、非酒精性脂肪性肝炎（NASH）和草药相关性肝损伤（HILI）——与人类疾病的基准比较仍然不足。第三，缺乏一个基于证据的决策框架，来指导研究人员针对特定的机制或治疗问题选择最合适的模型（例如，“哪个模型最能重现线粒体肝毒性？”或“我如何模拟免疫介导的药物性肝损伤？”）。第四，组学技术（单细胞RNA测序、空间转录组学、蛋白质组学）和人源化平台的最新进展尚未被系统地整合到传统的模型比较中。本综述旨在通过以下方式弥合这四个空白：对18种不同的动物模型在12个参数（诱导方法、损伤模式、机制、物种/品系差异、时间进程、再生反应、优势、局限性、转化相关性、成本、通量和伦理考量）上进行并排比较分析，将每个模型映射到其最接近的人类疾病对应物，并明确讨论相似性和局限性，提出一个实用的、基于决策树的模型选择框架，并将新兴技术（人源化小鼠、CRISPR筛选、类器官）整合到经典格局中。理解每个模型的独特特征对于肝毒性研究中的转化相关性和可重复性至关重要。

title: Roles of Metastasis Associated Fibroblasts in Paclitaxel Resistance of Brain Metastatic Tumor Cells: Evaluation in Metastatic Organoids.
titleZh: 转移相关成纤维细胞在脑转移肿瘤细胞紫杉醇耐药中的作用：在转移性类器官中的评估。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Siahi M, Kamalabadi-Farahani M, Atashi A.
affiliations: Department of Biology, Damghan Branch, Islamic Azad University, Damghan, Iran.

abstract:
Background

Some breast cancer patients experience the devastating effects of brain metastases. The metastasis-associated fibroblasts (MAFs), the most abundant cells in the metastatic microenvironment, have an important role in chemoresistance. The MAFs' roles in paclitaxel resistance of brain metastatic tumor cells were evaluated in metastatic organoids.Methods

Brain metastatic cells, known as 4T1B, were isolated and expanded from the brains of cancerous mice. Alginate-based metastatic organoids were prepared from the culture of 4T1B and 3T3 fibroblasts in an alginate solution. Cytotoxic activity of paclitaxel against 4T1B in 3D (3-Dimensional) culture was evaluated by MTT. For molecular analysis, real-time PCR was done.Results

Our results proved that in brain metastatic organoids, fibroblasts cause a significant increase in paclitaxel resistance. Molecular analysis showed that the expression level of α-smooth muscle actin (α-SMA) increased in MAF compared to normal fibroblasts. Surprisingly, the expression level of fibroblast-specific protein 1 (FSP-1) decreased compared to normal fibroblasts.Conclusion

Here, we reveal the pivotal roles of MAFs in chemoresistance and discuss their molecular properties. Our approach involves exploring various therapeutic techniques to comprehend MAFs and presenting therapeutic perspectives for metastatic cancer treatment.
abstractZh:
背景

一些乳腺癌患者经历了脑转移的毁灭性影响。转移相关成纤维细胞（MAFs）是转移微环境中最丰富的细胞，在化疗耐药中具有重要作用。在转移性类器官中评估了MAFs在脑转移肿瘤细胞紫杉醇耐药中的作用。方法

从患癌小鼠的大脑中分离并扩增了脑转移细胞，称为4T1B。通过在藻酸盐溶液中培养4T1B和3T3成纤维细胞，制备了基于藻酸盐的转移性类器官。通过MTT法评估了紫杉醇在3D（三维）培养中对4T1B的细胞毒性活性。对于分子分析，进行了实时PCR。结果

我们的结果证明，在脑转移类器官中，成纤维细胞导致紫杉醇耐药性显著增加。分子分析显示，与正常成纤维细胞相比，MAF中α-平滑肌肌动蛋白（α-SMA）的表达水平增加。令人惊讶的是，与正常成纤维细胞相比，成纤维细胞特异性蛋白1（FSP-1）的表达水平下降。结论

在这里，我们揭示了MAFs在化疗耐药中的关键作用，并讨论了它们的分子特性。我们的方法涉及探索各种治疗技术以理解MAFs，并为转移性癌症治疗提供治疗视角。

abstract: The complexity of tumors cannot be accurately simulated by current tumoroid models. One of these limitations is poor vascularization in current tumor models, particularly the lack of tumor-specific blood vessels. Therefore, it is challenging to have a thorough discussion of many in vitro studies regarding the tumor vascular environment. To overcome this limitation, this study combines tumoroid and microfluidic technologies to develop a vascularized tumoroid-on-a-chip. This physiologically relevant colorectal tumoroid-on-a-chip enables self-assembly of tumor-associated vasculature and provides stable perfusion. It has the potential to better simulate the complex vascular environment of colorectal cancer, allowing for more accurate assessment. This study confirms the effectiveness of this model and verifies the variation in the response of tumoroid-on-a-chip models from different patients to FOLFOX plus bevacizumab. It also tests the sensitivity of several small-molecule anti-angiogenic drugs. These validations provide preliminary evidence supporting the reliability of the model and its potential utility in the future.
abstractZh: 当前肿瘤类器官模型无法准确模拟肿瘤的复杂性。其中一个限制是当前肿瘤模型中血管化不良，尤其是缺乏肿瘤特异性血管。因此，在许多关于肿瘤血管环境的体外研究中，进行深入讨论具有挑战性。为克服这一限制，本研究结合肿瘤类器官和微流控技术，开发了一种血管化肿瘤芯片。这种生理相关的结直肠肿瘤芯片能够实现肿瘤相关血管的自组装，并提供稳定的灌注。它有可能更好地模拟结直肠癌的复杂血管环境，从而实现更准确的评估。本研究证实了该模型的有效性，并验证了来自不同患者的肿瘤芯片模型对FOLFOX联合贝伐珠单抗的反应差异。它还测试了几种小分子抗血管生成药物的敏感性。这些验证提供了初步证据，支持该模型的可靠性及其未来的潜在用途。

title: Reduction of PALS1/Nok disrupts retinal lamination through altered cell positioning while preserving photoreceptor self-organization capacity
titleZh: PALS1/Nok的减少通过改变细胞定位破坏视网膜分层，同时保留光感受器自组织能力
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Aparicio G, Zolessi FR.
abstract: The vertebrate neural retina is composed of several neuronal types that precisely organize into layers, with photoreceptors facing the outer surface and the projection neurons, retinal ganglion cells, at the innermost layer. This organization, essential for its function, is established during early development through a complex process involving cell-cell interactions such as adhesion. In the case of photoreceptors, two adhesion complexes, based on the adhesive proteins Cadherin2 and Crumbs, appear essential for their correct localization at the outer nuclear layer (ONL). We here aimed at better characterizing the role of the scaffolding protein PALS1, a central component of the Crumbs complex. Through a validated  pals1a /  nok morpholino knockdown strategy in zebrafish embryos, we demonstrate that its reduced expression causes photoreceptor progenitors to initially disperse as actively migrating cells, to then coalesce into cell groups around the central retina. They eventually start polarizing, forming rosette-like structures with the apical border towards the inside. Conversely, in organoids derived from uncommitted neuroepithelial retinal progenitors, PALS1 deficiency causes an inversion of their localization from internal rosette-like structures to an organized superficial layer. In both conditions, photoreceptors show signs of polarization, with apical borders towards the inside of rosettes in wild-type organoids, to surface-directed apical borders in morphants. Altogether, our results support previous observations of the pivotal function of the Crumbs complex in ONL formation, but also indicate that either the Crumbs complex, or PALS1 itself, are central for the delicate balance in differential cell adhesion partly responsible for retinal lamination.
abstractZh: 脊椎动物神经视网膜由多种神经元类型组成，这些神经元精确地组织成层，光感受器面向外表面，而投射神经元（视网膜神经节细胞）位于最内层。这种组织对其功能至关重要，是在早期发育过程中通过涉及细胞间相互作用（如粘附）的复杂过程建立的。对于光感受器而言，基于粘附蛋白Cadherin2和Crumbs的两个粘附复合物似乎对其在外核层（ONL）的正确定位至关重要。我们在此旨在更好地表征支架蛋白PALS1（Crumbs复合物的核心成分）的作用。通过在斑马鱼胚胎中采用经过验证的pals1a/nok吗啉代寡核苷酸敲低策略，我们证明其表达减少导致光感受器祖细胞最初作为活跃迁移细胞分散，随后在中央视网膜周围聚集成细胞群。它们最终开始极化，形成玫瑰花结样结构，顶端边界朝向内部。相反，在源自未定型神经上皮视网膜祖细胞的类器官中，PALS1缺乏导致其定位从内部玫瑰花结样结构倒置为有组织的表层。在两种条件下，光感受器均显示出极化迹象，野生型类器官中顶端边界朝向玫瑰花结内部，而在形态发生素敲低体中顶端边界朝向表面。总之，我们的结果支持了先前关于Crumbs复合物在ONL形成中关键作用的观察，但也表明Crumbs复合物或PALS1本身对于部分负责视网膜分层的差异细胞粘附的微妙平衡至关重要。

title: Servo-Actuated 3D-Printed Disposable Microvalves for Automated, Scalable Organoid Culture in Standard Incubators
titleZh: 伺服驱动的3D打印一次性微阀，用于标准培养箱中自动化、可扩展的类器官培养
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Zeraatkar M, Ehrlich D, Hernandez S, Schweiger HE, Pessoa de Melo M, Wachtel E, Ozcakir D, Seiler ST, Voitiuk K, Rosen Y, Josephson C, Mostajo-Radji MA, Haussler D, Salama SR, Teodorescu M.
abstract: Automation of organoid and cell culture processes is essential for achieving scalable and standardized experimentation in regenerative medicine and stem cell research. However, existing microfluidic platforms often rely on complex setups, limiting their integration within standard incubator environments. To address these challenges, we developed a compact, scalable multi-well platform featuring 3D-printed, servo-actuated disposable microvalves for fully automated media and drug exchange. This design eliminates the need for external pressure sources and control channels, providing a simplified and cost-effective solution for organoid culture. The platform integrates an internet-connected microscopy module with a motorized XYZ stage, allowing continuous, real-time imaging of individual wells directly within the incubator. It supports precise and reliable fluid handling under physiological conditions, improving throughput, reproducibility, and accessibility. We validate the platform through bench-top testing and in both mouse and human organoid models. Morphological analysis, immunohistochemistry (IHC), and qPCR demonstrate comparable viability, growth, and gene expression profiles between automated and manual culture conditions. These results establish a robust and scalable framework for fully automated organoid culture, offering a simplified and accessible alternative to conventional microfluidic systems with broad applications in regenerative medicine, drug discovery, and scalable biological screening. abstractZh: 类器官和细胞培养过程的自动化对于在再生医学和干细胞研究中实现可扩展和标准化的实验至关重要。然而，现有的微流控平台通常依赖于复杂的设置，限制了它们在标准培养箱环境中的集成。为了应对这些挑战，我们开发了一个紧凑、可扩展的多孔平台，配备3D打印、伺服驱动的一次性微阀，用于全自动的培养基和药物交换。这种设计消除了对外部压力源和控制通道的需求，为类器官培养提供了一种简化和成本效益高的解决方案。该平台集成了一个带电动XYZ载物台的互联网连接显微镜模块，允许在培养箱内直接对单个孔进行连续、实时的成像。它支持在生理条件下精确可靠的流体处理，提高了通量、可重复性和可及性。我们通过台式测试以及在小鼠和人类类器官模型中验证了该平台。形态学分析、免疫组织化学（IHC）和qPCR表明，自动化培养和手动培养条件之间的活力、生长和基因表达谱相当。这些结果为全自动类器官培养建立了一个稳健且可扩展的框架，为传统微流控系统提供了一种简化和可及的替代方案，在再生医学、药物发现和可扩展的生物筛选中具有广泛的应用。摘要图

abstract: The potential for fibrosis across most organ systems may stem from connections to wound healing and the widespread presence of vascular endothelium. Endothelial cells (ECs) and angiogenesis have been heavily implicated in many organ-specific fibrotic conditions, but little has been established in terms of how EC phenotype governs tissue healing vs. fibrosis. Here, we examined a murine lung injury model enabling EC lineage tracing and observed the invasion of aberrant ECs from the bronchial microvasculature following injury, along with concurrent densification of surrounding extracellular matrix fibers. To investigate mechanisms governing their appearance, we established a microphysiological system of human microvessels embedded within a tunable stromal matrix and found that heightened fiber density drives endothelial to mesenchymal transition to promote aberrant tip EC (ATEC) invasion into the matrix. ATECs remained adherent to fibrotic matrix and possessed a pro-inflammatory phenotype that secretes TGF-β2. Mechanistically, we identify ATEC formation was gated by destabilization of EC adherens junctions upon adhesion to fibrous matrix and associated regulation of TGF-β signaling through a novel VE-cadherin - TGF-βR2 interaction. Altogether, this work identifies how enhanced fiber density associated with fibrogenesis regulates EC phenotype to generate pro-inflammatory ATECs and suggests new contributions of ECs to fibrotic progression.
abstractZh: 大多数器官系统的纤维化潜力可能源于与伤口愈合的联系以及血管内皮的广泛存在。内皮细胞（ECs）和血管生成已在许多器官特异性纤维化疾病中被大量涉及，但关于EC表型如何调控组织愈合与纤维化之间的平衡，目前知之甚少。在此，我们研究了一种能够进行EC谱系追踪的小鼠肺损伤模型，观察到损伤后来自支气管微血管的异常EC侵入，同时伴随周围细胞外基质纤维的致密化。为了探究其出现机制，我们建立了一个将人微血管嵌入可调基质的人体微生理系统，发现纤维密度增加驱动内皮-间质转化，促进异常尖端EC（ATEC）侵入基质。ATECs仍粘附于纤维化基质，并具有分泌TGF-β2的促炎表型。机制上，我们确定ATEC的形成受EC粘附连接在粘附于纤维基质时的不稳定化以及通过新型VE-钙黏蛋白-TGF-βR2相互作用对TGF-β信号传导的相关调控所门控。总之，这项工作揭示了与纤维发生相关的纤维密度增加如何调控EC表型以产生促炎性ATECs，并提示ECs在纤维化进展中的新贡献。

title: A Practical Gut-On-Chip Workflow for Imaging-Based Assessment of Epithelial Barrier Dynamics During E. coli Co-Culture.
titleZh: 一种用于大肠杆菌共培养期间基于成像的上皮屏障动力学评估的实用肠道芯片工作流程。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Chiang SW, Yang CY, Chen GY.
affiliations: Division of Colorectal Surgery, Department of Surgery, Taichung Veterans General Hospital, Taichung, Taiwan.
Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University, Hsinchu, Taiwan.
Institute of Intelligent Bioelectrical Engineering, College of Electrical and Computer Engineering, National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University, Hsinchu, Taiwan.
