abstract: Neuroendocrine prostate cancer (NEPC) is a lethal subtype of prostate cancer (PCa) that emerges under androgen deprivation and is associated with therapeutic resistance. The contribution of volume-regulated anion channels (VRACs) to this process remains poorly understood. This study identified leucine-rich repeat-containing 8 subunit D (LRRC8D), a VRAC subunit, as the only family member consistently downregulated in NEPC and associated with neuroendocrine (NE)-like features. LRRC8D downregulation was accompanied by suppression of swelling-activated VRAC currents, increased synaptophysin (SYP) expression, decreased cisplatin sensitivity, and neurosecretory remodeling. Conversely, LRRC8D overexpression enhanced cisplatin-induced apoptosis, reduced colony formation, and suppressed tumor growth in xenograft models, including under cisplatin treatment. Consistent alterations in LRRC8D and SYP expression were also observed in enzalutamide-resistant patient-derived organoids. Mechanistically, RE1-silencing transcription factor (REST) promoted LRRC8D transcription. Functional analyses further demonstrated that CAV-1 acted upstream of LRRC8D, and LRRC8D negatively regulated STAT3 activation. Together, these findings indicate that LRRC8D influences PCa phenotype and platinum responsiveness, and implicate a regulatory axis involving LRRC8D and CAV-1/STAT3 signaling in NE-associated features of advanced PCa. Functional analyses further showed that CAV-1 acted upstream of LRRC8D, and LRRC8D negatively regulated STAT3 activation. Together, these findings indicate that LRRC8D influences PCa phenotype and platinum responsiveness and implicate a regulatory axis involving LRRC8D and CAV-1/STAT3 signaling in NE-associated features of advanced PCa.
abstractZh: 神经内分泌前列腺癌（NEPC）是前列腺癌（PCa）的一种致命亚型，在雄激素剥夺条件下出现，并与治疗耐药性相关。体积调节阴离子通道（VRACs）在这一过程中的作用仍知之甚少。本研究将富含亮氨酸重复序列的8亚基D（LRRC8D），一种VRAC亚基，鉴定为在NEPC中唯一持续下调的家族成员，并与神经内分泌（NE）样特征相关。LRRC8D下调伴随着肿胀激活的VRAC电流的抑制、突触素（SYP）表达增加、顺铂敏感性降低以及神经分泌重塑。相反，LRRC8D过表达增强了顺铂诱导的凋亡，减少了集落形成，并在异种移植模型中抑制了肿瘤生长，包括在顺铂治疗下。在恩扎卢胺耐药的患者来源类器官中也观察到LRRC8D和SYP表达的一致变化。机制上，RE1沉默转录因子（REST）促进了LRRC8D的转录。功能分析进一步表明，CAV-1作用于LRRC8D的上游，而LRRC8D负调控STAT3的激活。总之，这些发现表明LRRC8D影响PCa的表型和铂类药物反应性，并提示涉及LRRC8D和CAV-1/STAT3信号通路的调控轴在晚期PCa的NE相关特征中发挥作用。功能分析进一步表明，CAV-1作用于LRRC8D的上游，而LRRC8D负调控STAT3的激活。总之，这些发现表明LRRC8D影响PCa的表型和铂类药物反应性，并提示涉及LRRC8D和CAV-1/STAT3信号通路的调控轴在晚期PCa的NE相关特征中发挥作用。

title: Engineering immune-competent hair follicle microphysiological systems: from organoid assembly to dynamic immune modelling.
titleZh: 构建免疫胜任的毛囊微生理系统：从类器官组装到动态免疫建模。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Qu H, Tong L, Lou Q, Qing L, Tao M, Luo H.
affiliations: Zhejiang Chinese Medical University, Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China.

abstract: Hair follicle organoids (HF organoids) have progressed from simple epithelial-mesenchymal aggregates to spatially organized follicle-like structures and skin-hair follicle composite models. However, most current systems still focus on follicular morphogenesis and structural reconstruction, with limited capacity to recapitulate the immune, vascular, neural, and dynamic regulatory features of the native hair follicle (HF) microenvironment. This limitation is particularly relevant to immune-mediated hair disorders, such as alopecia areata, lichen planopilaris, and frontal fibrosing alopecia, in which immune privilege (IP) collapse, inflammatory infiltration, hair follicle stem cell (HFSC) niche damage, and tissue remodelling are central pathological events. In this Review, we discuss the transition from structurally oriented HF organoids towards immune-competent hair follicle microphysiological systems (HF-MPS). We summarize the structural basis of HF engineering, define immune competence as a functional state involving IP maintenance, immune-cell regulation of HF cycling and regeneration, and controllable inflammatory injury, and examine engineering strategies including local immune microenvironment control, compartmentalized culture, dynamic perfusion, vascularized and innervated interfaces, and quantitative monitoring. We further discuss applications in disease modelling, dynamic drug evaluation, patient-derived platforms, and regenerative medicine, while highlighting evidence boundaries and technical limitations. Immune-competent HF-MPS should be viewed as evolving human-relevant platforms rather than mature replacements for existing models.
abstractZh: 毛囊类器官（HF类器官）已从简单的上皮-间充质聚集体发展为空间组织的毛囊样结构和皮肤-毛囊复合模型。然而，目前大多数系统仍侧重于毛囊形态发生和结构重建，在重现天然毛囊（HF）微环境的免疫、血管、神经和动态调控特征方面能力有限。这一局限性尤其与免疫介导的毛发疾病相关，如斑秃、毛发扁平苔藓和额部纤维性脱发，在这些疾病中，免疫豁免（IP）崩溃、炎症浸润、毛囊干细胞（HFSC）生态位损伤和组织重塑是核心病理事件。在本综述中，我们讨论了从结构导向的HF类器官向免疫胜任的毛囊微生理系统（HF-MPS）的转变。我们总结了HF工程的结构基础，将免疫胜任定义为涉及IP维持、免疫细胞对HF循环和再生的调控以及可控炎症损伤的功能状态，并探讨了工程策略，包括局部免疫微环境控制、分区培养、动态灌注、血管化和神经支配界面以及定量监测。我们进一步讨论了在疾病建模、动态药物评估、患者来源平台和再生医学中的应用，同时强调了证据边界和技术局限性。免疫胜任的HF-MPS应被视为不断演进的人源相关平台，而非现有模型的成熟替代品。

title: Advances in oral disease models: a mini-review of developments from 2015 to 2025.
titleZh: 口腔疾病模型的进展：2015年至2025年发展的迷你综述。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Huang J, Le-Tran J, Kobayashi NS, Kobayashi Y, Shimizu E.
affiliations: School of Graduate Studies, Newark Health Science Campus, Rutgers, Newark, NJ, United States.
Department of Oral Biology, Rutgers School of Dental Medicine, Rutgers, Newark, NJ, United States.
abstract: Oral diseases represent one of the most widespread global health burdens, affecting billions of people worldwide, causing pain, disability, and substantial treatment costs. Despite their prevalence, progress in prevention and therapy has been limited, in part, by experimental models that do not fully capture the complexity of the oral biological and environmental landscape. Over the past decade, however, major advances in model development have expanded the possibilities for studying oral disease. This mini-review summarizes advances from 2015 to 2025, focusing on caries and endodontic infections, gingivitis and periodontitis, peri-implantitis, mucosal disorders, oral and oropharyngeal cancers, and salivary gland diseases. Recent innovations include saliva-derived biofilm systems that reproduce ecological transitions, organ-on-chip systems that replicate fluid dynamics, and patient-derived organoids and xenografts that preserve clinical characteristics. In parallel, immune-integrated models now allow direct interrogation of host responses to pathogens. Separate from these experimental platforms, advanced analytical and computational approaches, including single-cell profiling, spatial transcriptomics, radiomics, and artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted image analysis, are increasingly linking molecular signatures with structural and functional disease outcomes. Together, these experimental models and complementary analytical tools mark a shift from reductionist approaches toward dynamic, patient-relevant frameworks that better capture the complexity of oral diseases. Remaining challenges include modeling chronic disease progression, incorporating viral and autoimmune components, and improving reproducibility through standardization across platforms. Addressing these limitations will be important for translating next-generation experimental models into clinically meaningful advances in oral health care.
abstractZh: 口腔疾病是最普遍的全球健康负担之一，影响全球数十亿人，导致疼痛、残疾和巨额治疗费用。尽管其普遍性，预防和治疗的进展有限，部分原因是实验模型未能完全捕捉口腔生物和环境景观的复杂性。然而，在过去十年中，模型开发的重大进展扩大了研究口腔疾病的可能性。本迷你综述总结了2015年至2025年的进展，重点关注龋病和牙髓感染、牙龈炎和牙周炎、种植体周围炎、黏膜疾病、口腔和口咽癌以及唾液腺疾病。最近的创新包括再现生态转变的唾液来源生物膜系统、复制流体动力学的器官芯片系统，以及保留临床特征的患者来源类器官和异种移植物。与此同时，免疫整合模型现在允许直接探究宿主对病原体的反应。除了这些实验平台，先进的分析和计算方法，包括单细胞分析、空间转录组学、放射组学和人工智能辅助图像分析，越来越多地将分子特征与结构和功能疾病结果联系起来。总之，这些实验模型和互补的分析工具标志着从还原论方法向动态、患者相关框架的转变，更好地捕捉口腔疾病的复杂性。剩余的挑战包括模拟慢性疾病进展、纳入病毒和自身免疫成分，以及通过跨平台标准化提高可重复性。解决这些限制对于将下一代实验模型转化为口腔保健的临床有意义进展至关重要。

abstract: Unlike humans, dogs do not exhibit menopause; instead, they experience a continuous, age-associated decline in reproductive function, making uterine aging a cumulative and lifelong process. Consequently, age-associated molecular changes in the canine endometrium result from prolonged and repeated physiological exposures. Despite the physiological importance of uterine aging in dogs, representative in vitro models that capture age-dependent molecular features remain limited. Herein, we established a canine endometrial organoid (CEO) biobank comprising samples from 21 donors across diverse age groups and clinical backgrounds. We conducted transcriptomic analyses and compared organoids derived from young and aged donors (n = 4 per group) to identify age-associated differentially expressed genes and enriched biological pathways. We found that CEOs retain transcriptional profiles specific to individual donor dogs under standardized culture conditions, exhibiting clear segregation by chronological age. Organoids from aged donors exhibited enrichment of pathways associated with extracellular matrix remodeling and cell-cell adhesion, accompanied by altered expression of genes associated with epithelial barrier integrity and oxidative stress responses. These results indicate that CEOs reflect age-associated molecular differences in the canine endometrium in vitro. This biobank provides a physiologically relevant platform for assessing endometrial aging in dogs and supports future research for identifying molecular indicators of age-associated uterine changes under controlled experimental conditions.
abstractZh: 与人类不同，犬不会经历更年期；相反，它们会经历与年龄相关的生殖功能持续下降，使得子宫衰老成为一个累积且终生的过程。因此，犬子宫内膜中与年龄相关的分子变化是长期和重复生理暴露的结果。尽管子宫衰老在犬中具有生理重要性，但能够捕捉年龄依赖性分子特征的代表性体外模型仍然有限。在此，我们建立了一个犬子宫内膜类器官（CEO）生物样本库，包含来自21名不同年龄组和临床背景的捐赠者的样本。我们进行了转录组分析，并比较了来自年轻和年老捐赠者（每组n=4）的类器官，以识别与年龄相关的差异表达基因和富集的生物学通路。我们发现，在标准化培养条件下，CEO保留了每个捐赠犬特有的转录谱，并按实际年龄清晰分离。来自年老捐赠者的类器官表现出与细胞外基质重塑和细胞-细胞粘附相关的通路富集，同时伴有与上皮屏障完整性和氧化应激反应相关基因的表达改变。这些结果表明，CEO在体外反映了犬子宫内膜中与年龄相关的分子差异。该生物样本库为评估犬子宫内膜衰老提供了一个生理相关的平台，并支持在受控实验条件下识别与年龄相关的子宫变化的分子指标的未来研究。

title: TGF-β1-induced differentiation enhances chemotherapy response in metastatic colorectal cancer organoids
titleZh: TGF-β1诱导的分化增强转移性结直肠癌类器官的化疗反应
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Fletcher SJ, Pizzini L, Catalano I, Palmiero M, Galvagno F, Borgato S, Grassi E, Bertotti A, Primo L, Trusolino L, Puliafito A.
abstract:
ABSTRACT

  Background

  In metastatic colorectal cancer, systemic therapies frequently fail, partly due to underlying phenotypic plasticity rooted in pre-existing multi-type cell populations. Intratumoral lineage hierarchies within colorectal tumors require renovated efforts to decode growth principles, design rational therapeutic approaches, and accurately interpret drug response. Understanding the cell-state dynamics of untreated tumors and the degree of cell responsiveness to exogenous stimuli is therefore crucial to improving currently underwhelming therapeutic outcomes. Methods

  Here, we leveraged patient-derived organoids established from hepatic metastases of colorectal cancer patients to deconstruct population hierarchies by combining single-cell transcriptomics with single-molecule RNA fluorescent in situ hybridization. Computational frameworks were used to identify independent gene modules. We then employed flow cytometry analysis to track cytokine-induced population shifts using a cell surface marker, validating our findings through bulk RNA analysis, functional assays, and viability assays in response to oxaliplatin. Results

  Our data substantiate the existence of a dual population configuration within untreated metastatic colorectal cancer organoids with diverse genetic backgrounds. Gene modules detected via single-cell transcriptomics delineate a stem-like (LGR5+) and a differentiated-like (KRT20+) population that fluctuate dynamically over time. Spatially and temporally resolved, single-cell level analysis through single molecule FISH captures the inherent stochasticity in cell fate decisions revealing surprising phenotypic variability even across different organoids derived from the same patient. By using GABRA2 as a surface marker we track the emergence of differentiated cells over the course of time and investigate the respective roles of TGF-β1 and IL-6 in the differentiation of organoids. Our findings indicate that IL-6 exerts no major effect within our cell autonomous setting. In stark contrast, TGF-β1 triggered cell cycle arrest and differentiation, while simultaneously reducing clonogenic capacity and significantly amplifying the cytotoxic potency of oxaliplatin. Conclusions

  Our findings provide evidence of the dual Stem and Differentiated population hierarchy in metastatic colorectal cancer organoids, and demonstrate how this axis can be effectively hijacked by TGF-β1 to suppress tumor growth. Our results suggest that further mechanistic exploitation of this cell-autonomous, tumor-suppressive arm of TGF-β1 signalling could open unappreciated therapeutic windows in advanced colorectal cancer.
abstractZh:
摘要

  背景

  在转移性结直肠癌中，系统性治疗经常失败，部分原因是由于预先存在的多类型细胞群体所导致的潜在表型可塑性。结直肠肿瘤内的谱系层次需要重新努力来解码生长原理、设计合理的治疗方法，并准确解释药物反应。因此，了解未治疗肿瘤的细胞状态动态以及细胞对外源刺激的反应程度，对于改善目前不尽人意的治疗结果至关重要。方法

  在此，我们利用从结直肠癌患者肝转移灶建立的患者来源类器官，通过结合单细胞转录组学和单分子RNA荧光原位杂交来解构群体层次。使用计算框架来识别独立的基因模块。然后，我们采用流式细胞术分析，利用细胞表面标志物追踪细胞因子诱导的群体变化，并通过批量RNA分析、功能测定和针对奥沙利铂的活力测定来验证我们的发现。结果

  我们的数据证实了在具有不同遗传背景的未治疗转移性结直肠癌类器官中存在双重群体结构。通过单细胞转录组学检测到的基因模块描绘了一个干细胞样（LGR5+）和一个分化样（KRT20+）群体，它们随时间动态波动。通过单分子FISH进行的空间和时间分辨的单细胞水平分析捕捉到了细胞命运决定中固有的随机性，揭示了即使来自同一患者的不同类器官之间也存在惊人的表型变异性。通过使用GABRA2作为表面标志物，我们追踪了分化细胞随时间出现的动态，并研究了TGF-β1和IL-6在类器官分化中的各自作用。我们的发现表明，在我们的细胞自主环境中，IL-6没有产生重大影响。与此形成鲜明对比的是，TGF-β1触发了细胞周期停滞和分化，同时降低了克隆形成能力，并显著增强了奥沙利铂的细胞毒性效力。结论

  我们的发现提供了转移性结直肠癌类器官中干细胞和分化双重群体层次的证据，并证明了TGF-β1如何有效利用这一轴来抑制肿瘤生长。我们的结果表明，进一步机制性利用TGF-β1信号传导的这一细胞自主、肿瘤抑制臂，可能为晚期结直肠癌开辟未被认识的治疗窗口。

title: Preeclampsia-derived small extracellular vesicles disrupt blood-brain barrier integrity and activate glial cells in vitro.
titleZh: 子痫前期来源的小细胞外囊泡在体外破坏血脑屏障完整性并激活胶质细胞。

abstract: Structural and functional integrity of the blood-brain barrier (BBB) is crucial for maintaining brain homeostasis. Preeclampsia, characterized by new-onset hypertension and endothelial dysfunction in pregnancy, often involves BBB disruption and neurological complications. Small extracellular vesicles (sEVs) have emerged as potential drivers of BBB disruption during preeclampsia; however, their impact on maternal brain health, particularly at the cellular level, remains understudied. Here, the effect of preeclampsia-derived sEVs on BBB integrity and cellular responses of brain endothelial cells, microglia and astrocytes was investigated. Circulating sEVs were isolated from plasma of healthy women and women with late-onset preeclampsia and studied in human-based mono-, bi- or tri-culture models using transwell and microfluidic (BBB-on-a-chip) systems. In these models, EV-associated signals were detected within brain endothelial cells consistent with intracellular uptake and trafficking. EV-derived cargo was detected in cells on the abluminal side of the endothelial layer, suggesting possible transfer across the barrier, although the underlying mechanism remains unclear. Exposure to preeclampsia-derived sEVs (PE-sEVs) was also associated with changes in brain endothelial cell protein composition and subcellular localization, accompanied by functional alterations of BBB properties, including increased permeability. Finally, astrocytes and microglia responded to PE-sEV exposure, as evidenced by increased IBA1 and GFAP expression, IL-6 release, and enhanced astrocyte migration. These findings suggest that circulating sEVs, including those of placental origin, may be involved in maternal brain alterations in preeclampsia potentially through effects on BBB integrity and glial activation. This may indicate the possible relevance of circulating sEVs as biomarkers and in the pathophysiology of the disease. KEY POINTS: Preeclampsia is a pregnancy-related condition involving high blood pressure and endothelial dysfunction, and is often associated with disruption of the blood-brain barrier (BBB) and neurological complications. Circulating small extracellular vesicles (sEVs) normally increase during pregnancy but are further elevated in preeclampsia, and may carry inflammatory cargo to the maternal brain. Using in vitro models, including an organ-on-a-chip, composed of human brain endothelial cells, microglia and astrocytes, this study examined how sEVs from healthy and preeclamptic pregnancies affect BBB properties, and glial activation. Results support the notion that preeclampsia-derived sEVs increase BBB permeability, traverse the endothelial layer, and induce glial responses including microglial activation and astrocyte reactivity by increased IL-6 release and cellular motility. The observed alterations may link placental dysfunction to maternal cerebrovascular injury, highlighting sEVs as potential modulators of brain damage in preeclampsia and as promising diagnostic or therapeutic targets.
abstractZh: 血脑屏障（BBB）的结构和功能完整性对于维持大脑稳态至关重要。子痫前期以妊娠期新发高血压和内皮功能障碍为特征，常伴有血脑屏障破坏和神经系统并发症。小细胞外囊泡（sEVs）已被认为是子痫前期中血脑屏障破坏的潜在驱动因素；然而，它们对母体大脑健康的影响，尤其是在细胞水平上的影响，仍研究不足。本研究探讨了子痫前期来源的sEVs对血脑屏障完整性以及脑内皮细胞、小胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞细胞反应的影响。从健康女性和晚发型子痫前期女性的血浆中分离循环sEVs，并在基于人的单培养、双培养或三培养模型中使用transwell和微流控（芯片上的血脑屏障）系统进行研究。在这些模型中，在脑内皮细胞内检测到与EV相关的信号，与细胞内摄取和转运一致。在内皮细胞层基底侧细胞中检测到EV来源的货物，提示可能穿过屏障进行转移，尽管其潜在机制尚不清楚。暴露于子痫前期来源的sEVs（PE-sEVs）也与脑内皮细胞蛋白组成和亚细胞定位的变化相关，并伴有血脑屏障功能特性的改变，包括通透性增加。最后，星形胶质细胞和小胶质细胞对PE-sEV暴露有反应，表现为IBA1和GFAP表达增加、IL-6释放增多以及星形胶质细胞迁移增强。这些发现表明，循环sEVs（包括胎盘来源的sEVs）可能通过影响血脑屏障完整性和胶质细胞激活参与子痫前期母体大脑的改变。这可能表明循环sEVs作为生物标志物以及在该疾病病理生理学中的潜在相关性。要点：子痫前期是一种与妊娠相关的疾病，涉及高血压和内皮功能障碍，常与血脑屏障（BBB）破坏和神经系统并发症相关。循环小细胞外囊泡（sEVs）在妊娠期间通常增加，但在子痫前期中进一步升高，并可能携带炎症货物到母体大脑。本研究使用体外模型，包括由人脑内皮细胞、小胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞组成的器官芯片，检查了来自健康妊娠和子痫前期妊娠的sEVs如何影响血脑屏障特性和胶质细胞激活。结果支持子痫前期来源的sEVs增加血脑屏障通透性、穿过内皮层，并通过增加IL-6释放和细胞运动性诱导胶质反应，包括小胶质细胞激活和星形胶质细胞反应性。观察到的变化可能将胎盘功能障碍与母体脑血管损伤联系起来，突出sEVs作为子痫前期脑损伤的潜在调节因子以及作为有前景的诊断或治疗靶点。

abstract: Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) infection has been associated with gastric carcinogenesis by activating different signaling pathways. In gastric cancer cells, H. pylori promotes the stabilization of HIF-1α (hypoxia inducible factor 1α), a transcription factor associated with the expression of several genes involved in cellular adaptation. We previously showed that HIF-1α regulates endosomal trafficking via activation of the small GTPase Rab5, which in turn activates downstream signaling pathways involved in tumor progression, such as the WNT/β-catenin pathway. Here, we explored the possibility that H. pylori infection activates this signaling mechanism in gastric cells, uncovering the guanine exchange factor ALS2 as a novel target induced by this bacterium. H. pylori infection increased ALS2 levels in a HIF-1α-dependent manner, leading to Rab5 activation during bacterial infection, thereby allowing sustained β-catenin signaling via endosomal sequestration of GSK3β. Rab5-GTP pulldown assays in MKN74 and AGS gastric cancer cells showed that bacterial infection induced Rab5 activation, which depended on HIF-1α stabilization, as indicated by siRNA and pharmacological inhibition approaches. Interestingly, we found that H. pylori infection upregulated the Rab5 activator ALS2 at both the mRNA and protein levels in a HIF-1α-dependent manner. These observations were further confirmed in patient-derived tumor organoids, as bacterial infection recapitulated ALS2 induction ex vivo. Moreover, ALS2 was required for H. pylori-induced Rab5 activation, early endosome enlargement, and downstream β-catenin signaling, as shown by shRNA-mediated knockdown of endogenous ALS2. Taken together, these observations uncover a novel pathway induced by H. pylori in gastric cells, which involves the HIF-1α/ALS2/Rab5/β-catenin signaling axis.
abstractZh: 幽门螺杆菌（H. pylori）感染通过激活不同的信号通路与胃癌发生相关。在胃癌细胞中，H. pylori促进HIF-1α（缺氧诱导因子1α）的稳定化，HIF-1α是一种与多种参与细胞适应的基因表达相关的转录因子。我们之前的研究表明，HIF-1α通过激活小GTP酶Rab5来调节内体运输，进而激活参与肿瘤进展的下游信号通路，如WNT/β-catenin通路。在此，我们探讨了H. pylori感染激活胃细胞中这一信号机制的可能性，并发现鸟嘌呤交换因子ALS2是该细菌诱导的新靶点。H. pylori感染以HIF-1α依赖的方式增加ALS2水平，导致细菌感染期间Rab5的激活，从而通过内体隔离GSK3β维持β-catenin信号传导。在MKN74和AGS胃癌细胞中进行的Rab5-GTP pull-down实验表明，细菌感染诱导Rab5激活，该激活依赖于HIF-1α的稳定化，这一点通过siRNA和药理学抑制方法得到证实。有趣的是，我们发现H. pylori感染以HIF-1α依赖的方式在mRNA和蛋白质水平上调Rab5激活因子ALS2。这些观察结果在患者来源的肿瘤类器官中得到了进一步证实，因为细菌感染在体外重现了ALS2的诱导。此外，通过shRNA介导的内源性ALS2敲低，表明ALS2是H. pylori诱导的Rab5激活、早期内体增大和下游β-catenin信号传导所必需的。综上所述，这些观察结果揭示了H. pylori在胃细胞中诱导的一条新通路，涉及HIF-1α/ALS2/Rab5/β-catenin信号轴。

abstract: Malaria remains a major global health threat, causing substantial clinical and socioeconomic burdens in endemic regions. Despite important advances in control strategies, progress is increasingly challenged by antimalarial drug resistance, widespread insecticide resistance, diagnostic escape, and adaptive changes in vector behavior. In this context, robust experimental models are essential to improve understanding of parasite biology, host-pathogen interactions, and therapeutic responses. Murine malaria models remain central to preclinical research because they are accessible, genetically tractable, cost-effective, and well suited to controlled studies of immunity, pathophysiology, transmission, and drug efficacy. Continuous refinement of these models through parasite and host genetic engineering, including transgenic parasites and modified or humanized mouse strains, has further expanded their experimental value. However, murine models do not fully reproduce human malaria. Key interspecies differences in parasite biology, antigenic variation, cytoadherence, tissue tropism, placental structure, blood-brain barrier interactions, and disease kinetics limit direct translation, particularly for severe, cerebral, placental, and relapsing malaria caused by Plasmodium falciparum and Plasmodium vivax. These limitations underscore the need for complementary human-relevant platforms. Micro physiological systems are emerging as a critical addition to the malaria research toolbox. Spheroids offer scalable three-dimensional models for medium-throughput studies; organoids reproduce essential structural and functional features of human tissues such as the liver, brain, placenta, and vasculature; and organ-on-chip systems incorporate flow, shear stress, and multicellular interfaces to better model sequestration, endothelial activation, barrier dysfunction, liver-stage infection, and drug responses. Rather than replacing murine models, these technologies complement them by bridging the gap between reductionist in-vitro assays and human disease biology, while supporting the principles of replacement, reduction, and refinement. This narrative review examines the current landscape of murine malaria models, their major contributions and translational limitations, and the growing importance of micro physiological systems, with their limitations, in next-generation malaria research.
abstractZh: 疟疾仍然是一个重大的全球健康威胁，在流行地区造成沉重的临床和社会经济负担。尽管控制策略取得了重要进展，但抗疟药物耐药性、广泛的杀虫剂耐药性、诊断逃逸以及媒介行为的适应性变化日益挑战着进展。在此背景下，稳健的实验模型对于加深对寄生虫生物学、宿主-病原体相互作用和治疗反应的理解至关重要。小鼠疟疾模型仍然是临床前研究的核心，因为它们易于获取、遗传上可操作、成本效益高，并且非常适合对免疫、病理生理学、传播和药物疗效进行受控研究。通过寄生虫和宿主基因工程（包括转基因寄生虫以及修饰或人源化小鼠品系）对这些模型的持续改进，进一步扩展了其实验价值。然而，小鼠模型并不能完全再现人类疟疾。寄生虫生物学、抗原变异、细胞黏附、组织嗜性、胎盘结构、血脑屏障相互作用和疾病动力学方面的关键种间差异限制了直接转化，特别是对于由恶性疟原虫和间日疟原虫引起的重症、脑型、胎盘型和复发性疟疾。这些局限性凸显了对互补性人类相关平台的需求。微生理系统正作为疟疾研究工具箱中的重要补充而兴起。球状体为中等通量研究提供了可扩展的三维模型；类器官再现了人类组织（如肝脏、大脑、胎盘和血管）的基本结构和功能特征；器官芯片系统整合了流动、剪切应力和多细胞界面，以更好地模拟隔离、内皮激活、屏障功能障碍、肝期感染和药物反应。这些技术并非取代小鼠模型，而是通过弥合还原论体外测定与人类疾病生物学之间的差距来补充它们，同时支持替代、减少和优化原则。本叙述性综述审视了小鼠疟疾模型的当前格局、其主要贡献和转化局限性，以及微生理系统（及其局限性）在下一代疟疾研究中日益增长的重要性。

abstract:
Background

Colorectal cancer (CRC) is the third most common cancer. The use of immunotherapy for cancer has become widespread in recent decades and adaptive and innate checkpoints can be simultaneously targeted for enhanced immunotherapy. An herbal formula, SH003 has beneficial effects against multiple cancers. However, the anti-CRC efficacy of SH003 through dual targeting of adaptive and innate checkpoints, PD-L1/CD47 remain to be investigated.Methods

We used two types of CRC patient-derived organoids (PDOs) and two types of CRC cell lines, and analyzed PD-L1 and CD47 expression levels with quantitative real-time PCR, Western blot, flow cytometry assays, and immunofluorescence staining. The cytotoxicity, proliferation, and apoptosis analysis were applied to clarify the regulatory effects on CRC growth. T cell immunity was analyzed through a co-culture system of CRC cell lines and T cells, as well as in in vivo CRC model.Results

SH003 reduced the growth of CRC PDOs, leading to morphological changes and decreases in ATP and Ki67 levels. SH003 inhibited the mRNA and protein expression of both PD-L1 and CD47 though the regulation of c-Myc in CRC PDOs. In addition, SH003 suppressed VEGF, TNF-α, and IL-1β in CRC PDOs. This effect was validated in experiments of CRC cell lines, revealing that SH003 suppressed both PD-L1 and CD47 expression increased by IFN-γ stimulation via the regulation of c-Myc and reduced CRC progression. SH003 also enhanced the T cell-mediated killing of CRC cells with increased IL-2 production. In an in vivo CRC model, SH003 inhibited tumor growth while reducing both PD-L1, CD47, and c-Myc expression and increasing CD8+ T cell infiltration.Conclusions

Our investigation demonstrated that SH003 served as a novel CRC immunotherapy by the dual targeting of adaptive and innate checkpoints, PD-L1/CD47 via the regulation of c-Myc signaling, highlighting that SH003 may be an effective herbal candidate drug for the treatment of CRC.
abstractZh:
背景

结直肠癌（CRC）是第三大常见癌症。近几十年来，免疫疗法在癌症治疗中广泛应用，同时靶向适应性及固有免疫检查点可增强免疫治疗效果。草药复方SH003对多种癌症具有有益作用。然而，SH003通过双重靶向适应性及固有免疫检查点PD-L1/CD47的抗结直肠癌疗效仍有待研究。方法

我们使用了两种结直肠癌患者来源的类器官（PDOs）和两种结直肠癌细胞系，并通过实时定量PCR、Western blot、流式细胞术和免疫荧光染色分析了PD-L1和CD47的表达水平。应用细胞毒性、增殖和凋亡分析来阐明对结直肠癌生长的调节作用。通过结直肠癌细胞系与T细胞的共培养系统以及体内结直肠癌模型分析了T细胞免疫。结果

SH003减少了结直肠癌PDOs的生长，导致形态学变化以及ATP和Ki67水平的降低。SH003通过调节c-Myc抑制了结直肠癌PDOs中PD-L1和CD47的mRNA和蛋白表达。此外，SH003抑制了结直肠癌PDOs中VEGF、TNF-α和IL-1β的表达。这一效应在结直肠癌细胞系实验中得到验证，表明SH003通过调节c-Myc抑制了IFN-γ刺激诱导的PD-L1和CD47表达，并减少了结直肠癌的进展。SH003还增强了T细胞介导的结直肠癌细胞杀伤，并增加了IL-2的产生。在体内结直肠癌模型中，SH003抑制了肿瘤生长，同时降低了PD-L1、CD47和c-Myc的表达，并增加了CD8+ T细胞的浸润。结论

我们的研究表明，SH003通过调节c-Myc信号通路双重靶向适应性及固有免疫检查点PD-L1/CD47，作为一种新型结直肠癌免疫疗法，凸显了SH003可能成为治疗结直肠癌的有效草药候选药物。

abstract: Cigarette smoke (CS) imposes continuous oxidative and electrophilic stress that disrupts cellular homeostasis in the lung. While acute smoking exposure induces transient antioxidant responses, how the epithelial system adapts to chronic smoke remains poorly defined. Here we developed a chronic whole CS extract (WCSE) model that integrates both gaseous and particulate fractions to reproduce the complexity of long-term smoking exposure. Using bronchial epithelial cells and human lung organoids, we demonstrate that chronic WCSE exposure induces a coordinated redox-mitochondrial adaptation, supporting survival under persistent oxidative stress. Chronically exposed cells (T-B2B) exhibited reduced apoptosis, enhanced S-phase entry and fragmented but functionally preserved mitochondria characterized by a stable membrane potential and restrained reactive oxygen species accumulation. Whole-exome sequencing revealed oxidative mutational signatures in two-dimensional and organoid models, linking chronic oxidative adaptation with tobacco-associated genomic imprints. Mechanistically, NRF2 activity was sustained through post-translational stabilization and nuclear accumulation independent of KEAP1, accompanied by activated pAKT and suppressed pGSK3β activity. Human lung organoids recapitulated these adaptations, showing enlarged morphology, reduced apoptosis and nuclear NRF2 accumulation, consistent with a stress-tolerant, clonally persistent phenotype. Together, these findings establish a chronic WCSE platform that models early epithelial adaptation to CS and uncovers NRF2-dependent redox remodeling as a key mechanism of long-term survival in smoking-related pulmonary injury.
abstractZh: 香烟烟雾（CS）持续施加氧化和亲电应激，破坏肺部的细胞稳态。虽然急性吸烟暴露会诱导短暂的抗氧化反应，但上皮系统如何适应慢性烟雾仍知之甚少。在此，我们开发了一种慢性全香烟烟雾提取物（WCSE）模型，该模型整合了气相和颗粒相成分，以重现长期吸烟暴露的复杂性。利用支气管上皮细胞和人肺类器官，我们证明慢性WCSE暴露诱导协调的氧化还原-线粒体适应，支持在持续氧化应激下的生存。慢性暴露的细胞（T-B2B）表现出凋亡减少、S期进入增强以及碎片化但功能保留的线粒体，其特征是稳定的膜电位和受限的活性氧积累。全外显子组测序揭示了二维和类器官模型中的氧化突变特征，将慢性氧化适应与烟草相关的基因组印记联系起来。机制上，NRF2活性通过翻译后稳定化和核积累得以维持，且不依赖KEAP1，同时伴有pAKT激活和pGSK3β活性抑制。人肺类器官重现了这些适应，表现出形态增大、凋亡减少和NRF2核积累，与应激耐受、克隆持续的表型一致。总之，这些发现建立了一个慢性WCSE平台，模拟了上皮对CS的早期适应，并揭示了NRF2依赖的氧化还原重塑作为吸烟相关肺损伤中长期生存的关键机制。

title: Will there ever be an in vitro assay that is predictive for human hepatotoxicity?
titleZh: 是否会有能够预测人类肝毒性的体外检测方法？
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Thompson DC.
affiliations: , Chesterfield, Missouri, USA. d_thompson_0801@proton.me.
abstract: Advances in novel alternative methods (NAMs)-including in silico modeling, hepatic co-cultures, 3D models such as spheroids and organoids, and microphysiological liver platforms-have greatly improved our ability to study human hepatic biology and reduce reliance on animal testing. However, whether such systems can predict human hepatotoxicity remains doubtful. Low-incidence, idiosyncratic liver injury typically arises from patient-specific factors and complex immune interactions that are not captured in simplified or genetically limited in vitro settings. Temporal constraints, limited biomarker diversity, and inconsistent validation further hinder predictive claims. Even a "perfect" in vitro liver model would still represent the biology of a single donor, comparable to a clinical study with one subject. These systems are invaluable for mechanistic and metabolic investigations but should be regarded as investigative-not predictive-tools for hepatotoxicity risk assessment.
abstractZh: 新型替代方法（NAMs）的进展——包括计算机模拟、肝细胞共培养、3D模型如球体和类器官，以及微生理肝脏平台——极大地提高了我们研究人类肝脏生物学的能力，并减少了对动物试验的依赖。然而，这些系统能否预测人类肝毒性仍存疑问。低发生率的特发性肝损伤通常源于患者特异性因素和复杂的免疫相互作用，这些在简化或基因有限的体外环境中无法捕捉。时间限制、有限的生物标志物多样性以及不一致的验证进一步阻碍了预测性声明。即使是“完美”的体外肝脏模型，也仍代表单个供体的生物学特性，相当于一项只有一名受试者的临床研究。这些系统对于机制和代谢研究具有不可估量的价值，但应被视为研究性工具，而非预测性工具，用于肝毒性风险评估。

abstract:
Background

The efficacy of chemo-immunotherapy in gastric cancer (GC) is limited by heterogeneous resistance and the lack of predictive biomarkers. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying concurrent intrinsic chemoresistance and extrinsic immunosuppression remain poorly understood.Methods

We performed integrative analysis of single-cell RNA sequencing and bulk transcriptomic datasets from GC cohorts to identify key regulators of chemo-immunotherapy resistance. The functional role of activating transcription factor 4 (ATF4) was validated in GC cell lines, patient-derived organoids (PDOs), and patient-derived xenograft (PDX) models. Mechanistic investigations employed chromatin immunoprecipitation sequencing, RNA-seq, and multiplex immunofluorescence to elucidate the ATF4-HSPA9-DNA damage response (DDR) axis. Clinical relevance was assessed in GC patients treated with 5-fluorouracil (5-FU) monotherapy and those receiving combination 5-FU plus anti-PD-1 therapy.Results

We identify integrated stress-response transcription factor ATF4 as a key regulator of dual resistance. Mechanistically, ATF4 transcriptionally upregulates HSPA9 to activate the DDR, which promotes both intrinsic chemoresistance and extrinsic immunosuppression. ATF4 overexpression reduces 5-FU sensitivity and induces CD8+ T cell exhaustion in PDOs and PDX models. Clinically, low ATF4 expression correlates with improved survival in GC patients receiving chemo-immunotherapy.Conclusions

These findings establish the ATF4-HSPA9 axis as a dual-function therapeutic target and predictive biomarker in GC chemo-immunotherapy. This axis bridges DNA damage repair-mediated chemoresistance and T cell exhaustion, providing a strategy to overcome resistance to 5-FU and PD-1 blockade.
abstractZh:
背景

胃癌（GC）化疗免疫治疗的疗效受到异质性耐药和缺乏预测性生物标志物的限制。然而，内在化疗耐药和外在免疫抑制同时发生的分子机制仍知之甚少。方法

我们对来自GC队列的单细胞RNA测序和批量转录组数据集进行了整合分析，以识别化疗免疫治疗耐药的关键调控因子。激活转录因子4（ATF4）的功能作用在GC细胞系、患者来源类器官（PDOs）和患者来源异种移植（PDX）模型中得到了验证。机制研究采用了染色质免疫沉淀测序、RNA-seq和多重免疫荧光技术来阐明ATF4-HSPA9-DNA损伤反应（DDR）轴。临床相关性在接受5-氟尿嘧啶（5-FU）单药治疗和接受5-FU联合抗PD-1治疗的GC患者中进行了评估。结果

我们确定整合应激反应转录因子ATF4是双重耐药的关键调控因子。机制上，ATF4转录上调HSPA9以激活DDR，从而促进内在化疗耐药和外在免疫抑制。ATF4过表达降低5-FU敏感性，并在PDOs和PDX模型中诱导CD8+ T细胞耗竭。临床上，低ATF4表达与接受化疗免疫治疗的GC患者更好的生存率相关。结论

这些发现确立了ATF4-HSPA9轴作为GC化疗免疫治疗中双重功能的治疗靶点和预测性生物标志物。该轴桥接了DNA损伤修复介导的化疗耐药和T细胞耗竭，为克服5-FU和PD-1阻断耐药提供了策略。

title: OrgLine: A versatile pipeline for organoid morphometry using detector-guided prompts.

abstract: Patient-derived organoids are increasingly being used in disease modeling, clinical research, drug development, and precision medicine. However, capturing complex organoid behaviors in dense three-dimensional culture environments remains challenging for manual workflows, and bright-field images often contain background artifacts that complicate quantitative analysis. To address this gap, we developed OrgLine, a quantitative analysis pipeline for organoids. Built on a large, curated bright-field image dataset, it couples a detector with a prompt-guided segmentation module. OrgLine recognizes organoids in bright-field images, supports quantitative characterization of morphological phenotypes across developmental stages, and enables accurate instance segmentation for downstream morphometric assessment. Together, these capabilities support more automated and quantitative organoid cultivation workflows.
abstractZh: 患者来源的类器官越来越多地用于疾病建模、临床研究、药物开发和精准医学。然而，在密集的三维培养环境中捕捉复杂的类器官行为对人工操作流程仍具挑战性，且明场图像常包含背景伪影，使定量分析复杂化。为弥补这一空白，我们开发了OrgLine，一种用于类器官的定量分析流水线。基于大型精选明场图像数据集，它结合了检测器与提示引导的分割模块。OrgLine能识别明场图像中的类器官，支持跨发育阶段形态表型的定量表征，并实现精确的实例分割以用于下游形态测量评估。这些能力共同支持更自动化和定量的类器官培养工作流程。

title: Designing complex organoids through developmental principles.
titleZh: 通过发育原理设计复杂类器官。

abstract: Principles of developmental biology have inspired efforts for directed differentiation of human pluripotent stem cells (hPSCs), leading to the first generation of organoids that are now well established as models of human development and disease. However, first-generation organoid models were missing many cell types that would be needed to study normal and pathological processes. Here, we discuss how designing next-generation organoids with increased cellular complexity has been possible by better reproducing developmental processes in play during organogenesis in vivo. We focus on recent conceptual and technical advances in reconstructing appropriate cellular diversity in organoids, dissecting the importance of tissue-tissue interactions and specialized cell addition, and how engineering technologies can further enhance our ability to control how cells are brought together to mimic human development in vitro.
abstractZh: 发育生物学的原理启发了人类多能干细胞（hPSCs）定向分化的努力，促成了第一代类器官的产生，这些类器官现已作为人类发育和疾病的模型得到广泛应用。然而，第一代类器官模型缺少许多研究正常和病理过程所需的细胞类型。在此，我们讨论了如何通过更好地再现体内器官发生过程中的发育过程，设计具有更高细胞复杂性的下一代类器官。我们重点关注在类器官中重建适当细胞多样性的最新概念和技术进展，剖析组织间相互作用和特化细胞添加的重要性，以及工程技术如何进一步增强我们控制细胞组合方式的能力，以在体外模拟人类发育。

abstract: Tumor microenvironment-responsive nanomedicines offer significant advantages in enhancing treatment specificity and minimizing systemic toxicity. Nevertheless, the therapeutic efficacy of single-modality treatments is often limited by tumor heterogeneity, necessitating the development of multimodal nanoplatforms capable of leveraging multiple tumor microenvironment characteristics for efficient synergistic therapy. In this study, a multifunctional nanocomposite comprising cobalt zeolitic imidazolate framework-67-encapsulated Au nanodendrites coloaded with tirapazamine is developed for tumor-selective therapy. To address the inherent limitations of traditional preclinical models, human healthy and colorectal cancer organoids are utilized as advanced in vitro assessment platforms. Mechanistic studies revealed that multibranched Au nanodendrites disrupt cellular membrane integrity, whereas the acidic condition induces the degradation of the cobalt zeolitic imidazolate framework-67, facilitating targeted drug release. These combined actions synergistically amplify intracellular reactive oxygen species generation and disrupt mitochondrial membranes, leading to the selective elimination of tumor cells. This work presents a highly efficient, tumor microenvironment-responsive nanotherapeutic platform and demonstrates the critical value of organoid-based evaluation systems in advancing the clinical translation of targeted nanomedicines.
abstractZh: 肿瘤微环境响应性纳米药物在提高治疗特异性和最小化全身毒性方面具有显著优势。然而，单一疗法的治疗效果常受肿瘤异质性限制，因此需要开发能够利用多种肿瘤微环境特征进行高效协同治疗的多模态纳米平台。本研究开发了一种多功能纳米复合材料，由包封金纳米树枝的钴沸石咪唑酯框架-67共载替拉扎明组成，用于肿瘤选择性治疗。为解决传统临床前模型的固有局限性，采用人类健康及结直肠癌类器官作为先进的体外评估平台。机制研究表明，多分支金纳米树枝破坏细胞膜完整性，而酸性条件诱导钴沸石咪唑酯框架-67降解，促进靶向药物释放。这些协同作用共同放大细胞内活性氧的产生并破坏线粒体膜，导致肿瘤细胞的选择性消除。本研究提出了一种高效的肿瘤微环境响应性纳米治疗平台，并展示了基于类器官的评估系统在推进靶向纳米药物临床转化中的关键价值。

title: EP300 promotes bladder cancer cell migration through SNAI2.
titleZh: EP300通过SNAI2促进膀胱癌细胞迁移。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Zhang Q, He C, Hong Y, Huang T, Deng S, Peng C, Wang H, Guo C.
affiliations: Yunnan Key Laboratory of Cell Metabolism and Disease, Center for Life Sciences, School of Life Sciences, Yunnan University, Kunming, China.

abstract: EP300, a frequently mutated transcriptional coactivator in bladder cancer, has been demonstrated to positively correlate with malignancy in various cancers. Highly aggressive bladder cancers are often associated with muscle-invasive progression, a process closely linked to the epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) capability of bladder cancer. Here, we performed immunohistochemical staining on bladder cancer tissues and adjacent normal tissues obtained from radical cystectomy to validate the positive association between EP300 and bladder cancer malignancy. We observed that A485, a small-molecule inhibitor of EP300, significantly inhibited cell migration in multiple bladder cancer cell lines (SW780, T24, RT4 and 5637) both in scratch wound healing and Transwell assays. Additionally, take the advantage of organoid-3D culture system, A485 disrupted the formation of inter-organoids connecting tubular structures in T24 cell line, while A485 also disrupted the organoid migration from matrix out-toward the non-matrix region both in SW780 and 5637 cell lines. In in vivo experiment, A485 showed a trend toward inhibiting BBN-induced bladder cancer invasion in mice. Bulk RNAseq analysis revealed that A485 commonly downregulated SNAI2-related signaling pathways across multiple bladder cancer cell lines. Furthermore, western blotting confirmed that A485 significantly reduced the global level of acetylation of histone H3 at lysine 27 (H3K27ac) as well as SNAI2 expression in T24 and SW780 cell lines. Indeed, overexpression of SNAI2 enhanced the migratory capacity of bladder cancer cells via Transwell assay. Collectively, our findings demonstrate that EP300 promoted bladder cancer cell migration via up-regulating SNAI2, targeting EP300 could be a potential therapeutic strategy to inhibit the process of bladder cancer invasion.
abstractZh: EP300是膀胱癌中频繁突变的转录共激活因子，已被证明与多种癌症的恶性程度正相关。高侵袭性膀胱癌常与肌层浸润性进展相关，这一过程与膀胱癌的上皮-间质转化（EMT）能力密切相关。在此，我们对根治性膀胱切除术获得的膀胱癌组织和癌旁正常组织进行了免疫组织化学染色，以验证EP300与膀胱癌恶性程度之间的正相关性。我们观察到，EP300的小分子抑制剂A485在多种膀胱癌细胞系（SW780、T24、RT4和5637）中，通过划痕愈合实验和Transwell实验均显著抑制了细胞迁移。此外，利用类器官-3D培养系统，A485破坏了T24细胞系中类器官间连接的管状结构的形成，同时A485也破坏了SW780和5637细胞系中类器官从基质向非基质区域的迁移。在体内实验中，A485显示出抑制BBN诱导的小鼠膀胱癌侵袭的趋势。批量RNAseq分析显示，A485在多种膀胱癌细胞系中普遍下调了SNAI2相关信号通路。此外，蛋白质印迹证实，A485显著降低了T24和SW780细胞系中组蛋白H3第27位赖氨酸乙酰化（H3K27ac）的总体水平以及SNAI2的表达。确实，通过Transwell实验，SNAI2的过表达增强了膀胱癌细胞的迁移能力。总之，我们的研究结果表明，EP300通过上调SNAI2促进膀胱癌细胞迁移，靶向EP300可能是抑制膀胱癌侵袭过程的潜在治疗策略。

title: Comparative Assessment of Cartilage Quality in Human Induced Chondrocytes (hiCHOs) and Primary Articular Chondrocytes (hACs) Following Fibronectin-Based Selection.
titleZh: 基于纤连蛋白筛选的人诱导软骨细胞（hiCHOs）与原发性关节软骨细胞（hACs）软骨质量比较评估。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Mazzini G, Tuerlings M, van der Stap V, Boone I, Mahdad R, Ramos YFM, Meulenbelt I.
affiliations: Department of Biomedical Data Sciences, Section Molecular Epidemiology, Leiden University Medical Center, Leiden, The Netherlands.
Department of Orthopaedics, Alrijne Hospital, Leiderdorp, The Netherlands.
abstract: BackgroundCell-based cartilage repair is limited by loss of chondrogenic potential during in vitro expansion. Fibronectin (FN)-based selection may enrich progenitor-like cells with better matrix-forming ability, but its long-term effect on ECM production by hiPSC-derived chondroprogenitors (hiCPCs), their derived chondrocytes (hiCHOs), and primary articular chondrocytes (hACs) from lesioned or preserved areas remains unclear.MethodsWe here compared cartilage ECM formation by hiCPCs/hiCHO's and hACs, with or without FN selection, over extended passaging using 3D organoids. Histology and quantitative image analysis were performed to assess tissue quality across passages.ResultsChondrogenicity in hiCPCs transiently improved early-stage ECM production upon FN-based selection, but accelerated loss of chondrogenicity was seen in later passages. This was evidenced by diminished matrix staining and structural degradation from passage 4 onward. In contrast, hACs from both preserved and lesioned cartilage maintained stable matrix-forming ability across passages, independent of FN-based selection.ConclusionFN-based selection does not preserve long-term chondrogenicity in hiCHOs and may even impair it during extended culture. In contrast, primary cell sources, regardless of cartilage integrity, demonstrate greater and robust chondrogenic capacity without requiring progenitor enrichment. These findings highlight the intrinsic ability of hACs and question the utility of FN-based selection in cartilage tissue engineering.
abstractZh: 背景基于细胞的软骨修复受限于体外扩增过程中软骨形成潜力的丧失。基于纤连蛋白（FN）的筛选可能富集具有更好基质形成能力的前体样细胞，但其对hiPSC来源的软骨祖细胞（hiCPCs）、其衍生的软骨细胞（hiCHOs）以及来自病变或保留区域的原发性关节软骨细胞（hACs）的细胞外基质（ECM）产生的长期影响仍不清楚。方法我们在此比较了hiCPCs/hiCHOs和hACs在有无FN筛选的情况下，经过长期传代培养形成软骨ECM的能力，使用3D类器官。通过组织学和定量图像分析评估各传代的组织质量。结果hiCPCs在FN筛选后早期阶段ECM产生短暂改善，但在后期传代中观察到软骨形成能力的加速丧失。这从第4代开始表现为基质染色减弱和结构降解。相比之下，来自保留和病变软骨的hACs在各传代中均保持稳定的基质形成能力，与FN筛选无关。结论FN筛选不能保持hiCHOs的长期软骨形成能力，甚至可能在长期培养中损害它。相反，原代细胞来源，无论软骨完整性如何，都表现出更强且稳健的软骨形成能力，无需祖细胞富集。这些发现突出了hACs的内在能力，并对FN筛选在软骨组织工程中的效用提出了质疑。

title: Minimal essential requirements for neural tube self-organisation
titleZh: 神经管自组织的最小必要要求
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Stuart HT, Costantini E, Wang J, Krammer T, Delas MJ, Melchionda M, Cornwall-Scoones J, Schmauss G, Lendl T, Ishihara K, Rand D, Sáez M, Tanaka EM, Briscoe J.
abstract: The reliable generation of diverse cell types in precise proportions is essential for the formation of functional tissues during embryonic development. Three-dimensional organoid models derived from pluripotent stem cells (PSCs) provide powerful systems for identifying principles governing tissue self-organisation. Neural tube organoids (NTOs), initiated from single PSCs with a pulse of retinoic acid (RA), self-organise into structures containing floorplate cells that secrete SHH morphogen to pattern adjacent neural tissue. Yet, how the initial cellular diversity arises and how appropriate cell-type proportions are allocated has remained unclear. Here, using time-resolved single-cell transcriptomics, quantitative immunofluorescence, and dynamical systems modelling we show that RA triggers a transient co-expression state of the transcription factors PAX6 and FOXA2 from which cells asynchronously resolve into two opposing fates: PAX6⁺ neural precursors and FOXA2⁺ floorplate precursors. PAX6 and FOXA2 are both necessary and sufficient to reconstitute self-organisation, establishing these transcription factors as key determinants of emergent tissue pattern. Rather than operating as a simple feed-forward system in which cells are guided solely by RA, feedback between the alternative cell fates, mediated by BMP signalling from floorplate precursors, determines cell type proportions and ensures reproducible cell-type diversity in each NTO. This dual expression state was also identified in mouse embryos, demonstrating how  in vitro models inform  in vivo biology. These findings establish a general design strategy – symmetry breaking through opposing fate determinants coupled to proportioning via signal feedback control – that may operate broadly across developmental contexts to generate tissues with predictable cellular compositions.
abstractZh: 在胚胎发育过程中，以精确比例可靠地生成多种细胞类型对于功能性组织的形成至关重要。源自多能干细胞（PSCs）的三维类器官模型为识别组织自组织的原理提供了强大的系统。神经管类器官（NTOs）由单个PSC经维甲酸（RA）脉冲启动，自组织成包含底板细胞的结构，这些细胞分泌SHH形态发生素以模式化相邻的神经组织。然而，初始细胞多样性如何产生以及适当的细胞类型比例如何分配仍不清楚。在此，利用时间分辨单细胞转录组学、定量免疫荧光和动力系统建模，我们表明RA触发转录因子PAX6和FOXA2的瞬时共表达状态，细胞从该状态异步分化为两种相反命运：PAX6⁺神经前体细胞和FOXA2⁺底板前体细胞。PAX6和FOXA2对于重建自组织既是必要的也是充分的，确立了这些转录因子作为涌现组织模式的关键决定因素。该系统并非作为一个简单的前馈系统运作，即细胞仅由RA引导，而是通过底板前体细胞介导的BMP信号在两种替代细胞命运之间进行反馈，决定细胞类型比例并确保每个NTO中可重复的细胞类型多样性。这种双重表达状态在小鼠胚胎中也得到了鉴定，展示了体外模型如何为体内生物学提供信息。这些发现确立了一种通用设计策略——通过相反命运决定因子进行对称性破缺，并通过信号反馈控制进行比例分配——该策略可能在多种发育环境中广泛运作，以生成具有可预测细胞组成的组织。

title: A human lung organoid co-culture model of early bone sarcoma metastasis reveals contact-dependent epithelial remodeling at the metastatic interface
titleZh: 人类肺类器官与早期骨肉瘤转移共培养模型揭示转移界面处接触依赖性上皮重塑
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Zylka MM, Capraz T, Moquin-Beaudry G, Hafemeister C, Bradaric N, Watzke L, Suresh V, Mann U, Ringnalda F, Wachtel M, Dettmer MS, Thuillez C, Farlik M, Sorger H, Marchais A, Sanders K, van de Wetering M, Seidel MG, Liegl-Atzwanger B, Metzelder M, Kameneva P, Halbritter F, Kovar H, Radic-Sarikas B.
abstract: Lung metastasis drives mortality across cancer types, yet how infiltrating tumor cells remodel the lung epithelium to establish metastatic niches remains poorly understood. Here we establish MESCUL (MEtastatic Sarcoma Co-CULture), a co-culture platform combining human lung organoids with patient-derived bone sarcoma cells to model early tumor–lung epithelial interactions in a physiologically relevant 3D system. MESCUL reveals that direct tumor–epithelial contact induces rapid, reproducible lung epithelial remodeling across Ewing sarcoma (ES) and osteosarcoma (OS) models and multiple organoid donor backgrounds, which is contact-dependent and not recapitulated by paracrine signaling. Single-cell RNA sequencing identifies LIMES (Lung Interface Metastasis Signature), a shared transcriptional program encompassing focal adhesion assembly, matrix metalloprotease (MMP) upregulation, and emergence of a damage-associated transitional cell state, in both ES and OS. Mechanistically, tumor-derived fibronectin (FN1) engages epithelial integrin receptors to activate focal adhesion kinase (FAK), driving amphiregulin (AREG) induction and MMP-mediated remodeling; FN1 alone phenocopies this response, and FAK inhibition attenuates it, nominating the FN1–integrin–FAK–AREG axis as a candidate therapeutic vulnerability. The LIMES program, identified through the MESCUL co-culture model, is spatially confined to the tumor–lung interface in patient metastases of both ES and OS, as demonstrated by spatial transcriptomics across nine patients. Masson’s trichrome staining of matched patient sections reveals pronounced collagen deposition in the peri-tumoral lung parenchyma, consistent with LIMES acting upstream of a wound-healing cascade that proceeds to structural fibrotic remodeling in patient tissue. Together, these findings establish the lung epithelium as an active participant in metastatic colonization, characterize a pharmacologically targetable, spatially restricted epithelial remodeling response at the bone sarcoma–lung interface across OS and ES, and introduce MESCUL as a tractable 3D platform for investigating lung metastasis, with possible implications for tumor types beyond bone sarcomas.
abstractZh: 肺转移是多种癌症类型死亡的主要原因，然而浸润性肿瘤细胞如何重塑肺上皮以建立转移微环境仍知之甚少。在此，我们建立了MESCUL（转移性肉瘤共培养）平台，该平台将人类肺类器官与患者来源的骨肉瘤细胞共培养，以在生理相关的3D系统中模拟早期肿瘤-肺上皮相互作用。MESCUL揭示，直接肿瘤-上皮接触在尤文肉瘤（ES）和骨肉瘤（OS）模型以及多个类器官供体背景下诱导快速、可重复的肺上皮重塑，这种重塑是接触依赖性的，且不能通过旁分泌信号传导重现。单细胞RNA测序鉴定了LIMES（肺界面转移特征），这是一个共享的转录程序，涵盖粘着斑组装、基质金属蛋白酶（MMP）上调以及损伤相关过渡细胞状态的出现，在ES和OS中均存在。机制上，肿瘤来源的纤连蛋白（FN1）与上皮整合素受体结合，激活粘着斑激酶（FAK），驱动双调蛋白（AREG）诱导和MMP介导的重塑；单独FN1即可模拟此反应，而FAK抑制可减弱该反应，提示FN1-整合素-FAK-AREG轴是潜在的治疗靶点。通过MESCUL共培养模型鉴定的LIMES程序，在ES和OS患者转移灶中空间上局限于肿瘤-肺界面，这一点通过九名患者的空间转录组学得到证实。匹配患者切片的Masson三色染色显示肿瘤周围肺实质中显著的胶原沉积，与LIMES在患者组织中作为伤口愈合级联反应上游、进而发展为结构性纤维化重塑的作用一致。总之，这些发现确立了肺上皮作为转移定植的积极参与者，表征了OS和ES骨肉瘤-肺界面处一种药理学上可靶向的、空间受限的上皮重塑反应，并引入MESCUL作为研究肺转移的可行3D平台，可能对骨肉瘤以外的肿瘤类型也有潜在意义。

title: Human 3D epithelioids enable continuous long-term clonal evolution studies across multiple epithelial tissues
titleZh: 人类3D上皮样体能够实现跨多种上皮组织的连续长期克隆演化研究
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Ferreira IS, Pradilla-Dieste A, Valverde-Lopez JA, Abascal F, Ishida Y, Baselga M, Przybilla M, Lawson A, Nicola P, Baez-Ortega A, Butler R, Soriano-Navarro M, Miniter M, Malasi K, Sancho-Serra C, Man C, Cameron M, Tadross JA, Bates A, Harden G, Ince W, Barnet G, Jena R, Vento-Tormo R, Martin J, Mahbubani KT, Saeb-Parsy K, Schuhmacher AJ, Martincorena I, Fernandez-Antoran D.
abstract: Modeling human epithelia in vitro remains challenging because current systems do not fully preserve the combination of architecture, heterogeneity, clonal composition, and long-term dynamics shown in vivo. While 3D approaches such as organoids and organotypic cultures capture important aspects of lineage differentiation and niche signaling, they often lose stable organization over time, limiting studies of long-lasting processes such as clonal evolution and cell competition. Here, we present human epithelioids as continuous long-term, 3D epithelial cultures efficiently derived from eight adult human epithelia, including trachea, skin, buccal mucosa, esophagus, blader, urethra, submandibular gland and endometrium. Using immunostaining, electron microscopy, single-cell RNA sequencing, functional assays and somatic mutation analyses, we deeply characterized human epithelioids and confirmed that they recapitulate native architecture and cell diversity, sustain regenerative capacity, and preserve donor-specific mutational landscapes, establishing a robust and versatile platform for longitudinal interrogation of clonal evolution, tissue dynamics and responses to clinically relevant perturbations, including radiotherapy and chemotherapy, over extended timescales.
abstractZh: 在体外模拟人类上皮组织仍具挑战性，因为当前系统未能完全保留体内所展现的结构、异质性、克隆组成及长期动态的组合。虽然类器官和器官型培养等3D方法捕捉了谱系分化和微环境信号的重要方面，但它们往往随时间失去稳定组织，限制了诸如克隆演化和细胞竞争等长期过程的研究。在此，我们提出人类上皮样体作为连续长期、3D上皮培养物，可高效地从八种成人上皮组织衍生，包括气管、皮肤、颊黏膜、食管、膀胱、尿道、下颌下腺和子宫内膜。通过免疫染色、电子显微镜、单细胞RNA测序、功能测定和体细胞突变分析，我们深入表征了人类上皮样体，并确认它们重现了天然结构和细胞多样性，维持再生能力，并保留了供体特异性的突变景观，为长期时间尺度上克隆演化、组织动态及对临床相关干预（包括放疗和化疗）反应的纵向研究建立了一个稳健且多功能的平台。

title: Epithelial stem cells in the premenopausal human vagina
titleZh: 绝经前人类阴道中的上皮干细胞
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Balough JL, Schwab KE, Stransky TM, Chu T, Cameron AR, Babu SP, Gurung S, Rytel K, Gargett CE, Orwig KE, Moalli PA.
abstract: The vagina undergoes physiologic changes across the menstrual cycle, pregnancy, birth and menopause. Most women will experience vaginal dysfunction at some point during their lives and treatment options are limited. The cyclic regeneration of the vaginal epithelium during each menstrual cycle suggests it is a stem-cell based tissue; however, human vaginal epithelial stem cells (veSCs) have not been identified. We utilized  in vitro colony forming and organoid assays to confirm that cells in the human vaginal epithelium have self-renewal and differentiation potential. Specifically, we determined that stem cell activity resides in the ITGA6+ and NGFR+ fractions of the basal epithelium. We performed single-cell RNA sequencing to identify the distinct cellular compartments of the full thickness human vagina, including spatially distinct populations comprising layers of the stratified vaginal epithelium. Markers of these cells within the vaginal epithelium were validated by immunohistochemistry. CD9+ITGA6+NGFR+ and CD9+ITGA6+NGFR- cells were capable of efficient colony formation but only the CD9+ITGA6+NGFR+ fraction produced organoids containing basal, intermediate and superficial layers of the vaginal epithelium. We characterized the premenopausal human vagina at single cell resolution, validated markers and assays to test veSC developmental potential, and identified putative stem cells that may open new avenues for treating vaginal dysfunction.
abstractZh: 阴道在月经周期、妊娠、分娩和绝经期间经历生理变化。大多数女性在生命中的某个阶段会经历阴道功能障碍，而治疗选择有限。每个月经周期中阴道上皮的周期性再生表明它是一种基于干细胞的组织；然而，人类阴道上皮干细胞（veSCs）尚未被识别。我们利用体外集落形成和类器官实验来确认人类阴道上皮中的细胞具有自我更新和分化潜能。具体来说，我们确定干细胞活性位于基底上皮的ITGA6+和NGFR+部分。我们进行了单细胞RNA测序，以识别人类全层阴道的不同细胞区室，包括构成复层阴道上皮各层的空间上不同的细胞群体。通过免疫组织化学验证了阴道上皮内这些细胞的标志物。CD9+ITGA6+NGFR+和CD9+ITGA6+NGFR-细胞能够高效形成集落，但只有CD9+ITGA6+NGFR+部分产生了包含阴道上皮基底层、中间层和表层的类器官。我们以单细胞分辨率表征了绝经前人类阴道，验证了用于测试veSC发育潜力的标志物和实验方法，并识别了可能为治疗阴道功能障碍开辟新途径的假定干细胞。

title: MLL3 adaptor function, not methyltransferase catalytic activity, is essential for breast tumor suppression
titleZh: MLL3的衔接蛋白功能，而非甲基转移酶催化活性，对乳腺肿瘤抑制至关重要
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Nishitani K, Cui J, de Miranda MC, Xie G, Couturier N, Matsuno Y, Suzuki M, Lauvau G, Ge K, Guo W.
abstract: MLL3 (Mixed-Lineage Leukemia 3), also known as KMT2C, is one of the most frequently altered epigenetic regulators in breast cancer. MLL3 loss-of-function leads to accelerated tumor onset and growth and increased metastasis. As a large multi-domain protein, MLL3 functions as a histone methyltransferase and a nuclear protein adaptor interacting with other epigenetic proteins. Since breast cancer MLL3 mutations are often truncating mutations that lead to protein degradation, whether the MLL3 tumor suppressor activity depends on its catalytic activity or non-catalytic chromatin adaptor function remains unclear. Here, using CRISPR genetically engineered mouse mammary stem cell organoid-based breast tumor models, we dissected dosage-dependent and domain-specific functions of MLL3 in breast tumor suppression. MLL3 heterozygous loss breast tumor models revealed that MLL3 is haplo-insufficient for breast tumor suppression. Interestingly, homozygous catalytic-dead MLL3-Y4792A mutation did not accelerate tumor onset, growth, or metastasis. By contrast, G367V mutation in the PHD2 domain, which disrupts the BAP1 complex binding without affecting MLL3 protein stability, accelerated tumor onset and growth, phenocopying MLL3 loss. Mechanistically, MLL3 loss impaired chromatin localization of UTX, and genetic depletion of UTX accelerated breast tumor progression in MLL3-wildtype but not MLL3-deficient cells. Integrated RNA-seq, CUT&TAG, and ATAC-seq analyses further showed that transcriptional changes induced by MLL3 loss were more closely associated with promoter-proximal alterations in H3K27Ac, H3K27me3, and chromatin accessibility than with putative MLL3-dependent enhancer regions. Together, these findings reveal that MLL3 suppresses breast tumor initiation through a dosage-sensitive, catalytic-independent adaptor function that regulates promoter-proximal epigenetic states.
abstractZh: MLL3（混合谱系白血病3），也称为KMT2C，是乳腺癌中最常发生表观遗传调控因子改变的基因之一。MLL3功能缺失导致肿瘤发生和生长加速以及转移增加。作为一个大型多结构域蛋白，MLL3作为组蛋白甲基转移酶和与其他表观遗传蛋白相互作用的核蛋白衔接蛋白发挥作用。由于乳腺癌MLL3突变通常是导致蛋白质降解的截短突变，MLL3肿瘤抑制活性是否依赖于其催化活性或非催化性染色质衔接蛋白功能仍不清楚。在此，利用基于CRISPR基因工程小鼠乳腺干细胞类器官的乳腺肿瘤模型，我们解析了MLL3在乳腺肿瘤抑制中的剂量依赖性和结构域特异性功能。MLL3杂合缺失乳腺肿瘤模型显示，MLL3对乳腺肿瘤抑制具有单倍剂量不足效应。有趣的是，纯合催化失活MLL3-Y4792A突变并未加速肿瘤发生、生长或转移。相比之下，PHD2结构域中的G367V突变破坏了BAP1复合物结合而不影响MLL3蛋白稳定性，却加速了肿瘤发生和生长，表型模拟了MLL3缺失。机制上，MLL3缺失损害了UTX的染色质定位，而UTX的基因耗竭在MLL3野生型细胞中加速了乳腺肿瘤进展，但在MLL3缺陷细胞中则没有。整合的RNA-seq、CUT&TAG和ATAC-seq分析进一步表明，MLL3缺失诱导的转录变化与启动子近端H3K27Ac、H3K27me3和染色质可及性的改变更密切相关，而非与推定的MLL3依赖性增强子区域相关。总之，这些发现揭示MLL3通过一种剂量敏感、催化非依赖的衔接蛋白功能抑制乳腺肿瘤起始，该功能调节启动子近端的表观遗传状态。

title: Dihydromyricetin Blocks SYVN1-Mediated Degradation of SLC7A11 to Suppress Ferroptosis and Promote Gastric Repair.
titleZh: 二氢杨梅素阻断SYVN1介导的SLC7A11降解以抑制铁死亡并促进胃修复。

abstract: Gastric ulcer is a prevalent clinical condition. Although current clinical management with proton pump inhibitors and Helicobacter pylori eradication is highly effective, there remains a need for early intervention strategies that directly promote gastric mucosal repair and prevent ulcer recurrence. This study demonstrates that dihydromyricetin (DHM), a natural flavonoid compound found in abundance in vine tea, alleviates gastric mucosal injury and promotes repair in rats via inhibiting ferroptosis. Mechanistically, DHM was proved to suppress oxidative stress and ferroptosis by activating the SLC7A11/GPX4 signaling pathway. Furthermore, DHM directly stabilizes SLC7A11 and promotes its membrane localization by disrupting binding with its E3 ubiquitin ligase SYVN1, thereby inhibiting SYVN1-mediated K48-linked ubiquitination at K30, K37, and K483. Moreover, DHM exerts protective effects in human-derived gastric organoid models, promoting growth and morphological repair. Collectively, DHM promotes gastric repair by suppressing ferroptosis via blocking SYVN1-dependent SLC7A11degradation.
abstractZh: 胃溃疡是一种常见的临床疾病。尽管目前使用质子泵抑制剂和根除幽门螺杆菌的临床管理非常有效，但仍需要能够直接促进胃黏膜修复并预防溃疡复发的早期干预策略。本研究表明，二氢杨梅素（DHM），一种在藤茶中含量丰富的天然黄酮类化合物，通过抑制铁死亡减轻大鼠胃黏膜损伤并促进修复。机制上，DHM被证明通过激活SLC7A11/GPX4信号通路抑制氧化应激和铁死亡。此外，DHM通过破坏其与E3泛素连接酶SYVN1的结合，直接稳定SLC7A11并促进其膜定位，从而抑制SYVN1介导的K30、K37和K483位点的K48连接泛素化。此外，DHM在人源胃类器官模型中发挥保护作用，促进生长和形态修复。总之，DHM通过阻断SYVN1依赖的SLC7A11降解来抑制铁死亡，从而促进胃修复。

abstract: Neuroendocrine prostate cancer (NEPC) is a lethal, treatment-resistant subtype that arises through lineage transdifferentiation from castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC) under selective pressure from androgen deprivation therapy. Although EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs) represent a rational therapeutic strategy, their clinical efficacy remains limited, and the underlying resistance mechanisms are poorly defined. Through integrated molecular and functional analyses, we identified the mitochondrial succinyl-CoA ligase subunit SUCLG2 as a critical driver of neuroendocrine differentiation and EGFR-TKI resistance. EGF stimulation induced SUCLG2 nuclear translocation, where it formed a complex with phosphorylated EGFR and co-activated VEGFA transcription through co-occupancy of the VEGFA promoter to drive neuroendocrine gene programs. SUCLG2 overexpression conferred erlotinib resistance in vitro, whereas its depletion restored TKI sensitivity and impaired xenograft tumor growth, effects that were rescued by VEGFA reconstitution. Through in silico drug screening, we identified phenethyl isothiocyanate (PEITC) as a compound that reverses the SUCLG2-associated transcriptional signature and synergized with erlotinib to suppress patient-derived NEPC organoid growth and reduce xenograft tumor burden in vivo. In clinical specimens from CRPC patients and NEPC patient-derived xenografts, progressive nuclear co-accumulation of SUCLG2 and EGFR alongside elevated VEGFA expression correlated with disease advancement. Collectively, these findings define a non-canonical nuclear SUCLG2/EGFR/VEGFA signaling axis that mediates NEPC progression and therapeutic resistance, providing mechanistic rationale for combined SUCLG2 and EGFR inhibition as a strategy to overcome treatment resistance in this lethal malignancy.
abstractZh: 神经内分泌前列腺癌（NEPC）是一种致命的、治疗抵抗的亚型，是在雄激素剥夺疗法的选择性压力下，通过去势抵抗性前列腺癌（CRPC）的谱系转分化而产生的。尽管EGFR酪氨酸激酶抑制剂（TKIs）代表了一种合理的治疗策略，但其临床疗效仍然有限，且潜在的耐药机制尚不清楚。通过整合分子和功能分析，我们确定了线粒体琥珀酰辅酶A连接酶亚基SUCLG2是神经内分泌分化和EGFR-TKI耐药的关键驱动因素。EGF刺激诱导SUCLG2核转位，在核内它与磷酸化EGFR形成复合物，并通过共同占据VEGFA启动子协同激活VEGFA转录，从而驱动神经内分泌基因程序。SUCLG2过表达在体外赋予厄洛替尼耐药性，而其耗竭则恢复TKI敏感性并损害异种移植肿瘤生长，这些效应可通过VEGFA重建来挽救。通过计算机药物筛选，我们确定了苯乙基异硫氰酸酯（PEITC）是一种能逆转SUCLG2相关转录特征的化合物，并与厄洛替尼协同抑制患者来源的NEPC类器官生长，并在体内减少异种移植肿瘤负荷。在CRPC患者和NEPC患者来源异种移植的临床标本中，SUCLG2和EGFR的进行性核共积累以及VEGFA表达升高与疾病进展相关。总之，这些发现定义了一个非经典的核SUCLG2/EGFR/VEGFA信号轴，该轴介导NEPC进展和治疗抵抗，为联合抑制SUCLG2和EGFR作为克服这种致命恶性肿瘤治疗抵抗的策略提供了机制依据。

title: Modeling the Clockwork of Bone: A Narrative Review of Experimental Approaches to Circadian Rhythm in Bone Metabolism.
titleZh: 骨时钟的建模：骨代谢昼夜节律实验方法的叙述性综述
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Gao X, Cai X, Nussler AK.
affiliations: Siegfried Weller Research Institute, BG Unfallklinik Tuebingen, Department of Trauma and Reconstructive Surgery, University of Tuebingen, Schnarrenbergstr. 95, D-72076 Tuebingen, Germany.
abstract: Circadian rhythms are fundamental regulators of skeletal homeostasis, coordinating osteoblast and osteoclast activity through tightly controlled temporal programs. Disruption of these rhythms, whether through environmental misalignment or genetic perturbation of core clock components, alters bone formation, enhances resorption, and contributes to skeletal fragility. This review synthesizes current knowledge on circadian regulation of bone biology across in vivo, ex vivo, and in vitro model systems, highlighting how each platform reveals distinct aspects of rhythmic gene expression, cellular function, and tissue-level remodeling. We critically evaluate the strengths and limitations of these models, outline key controversies such as the interpretation of global clock-gene knockouts, and discuss the emerging relevance of human-derived systems including iPSC-based models, organoids, and microphysiological "bone-on-chip" platforms. Integrative approaches that combine multiple model systems provide the most reliable framework for understanding circadian control of bone and for identifying targets for chronotherapeutic intervention. Advancing human-relevant models and refining temporal experimental design will be essential for translating circadian biology into clinical strategies for metabolic bone diseases.
abstractZh: 昼夜节律是骨骼稳态的基本调节因子，通过严格控制的时间程序协调成骨细胞和破骨细胞的活性。这些节律的破坏，无论是通过环境失调还是核心时钟成分的遗传扰动，都会改变骨形成、增强骨吸收，并导致骨骼脆性。本综述综合了目前关于昼夜节律调节骨生物学在体内、离体和体外模型系统中的知识，强调了每种平台如何揭示节律性基因表达、细胞功能和组织水平重塑的不同方面。我们批判性地评估了这些模型的优势和局限性，概述了关键争议，如全球时钟基因敲除的解释，并讨论了人类来源系统的新兴相关性，包括基于iPSC的模型、类器官和微生理学“骨芯片”平台。结合多种模型系统的整合方法为理解骨昼夜节律控制和识别时间治疗干预靶点提供了最可靠的框架。推进人类相关模型和完善时间实验设计对于将昼夜节律生物学转化为代谢性骨疾病的临床策略至关重要。

title: A transient epithelial plasticity state defines the developmental window for uterine gland specification
titleZh: 一种短暂的上皮可塑性状态定义了子宫腺体特化的发育窗口
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Rizo JA, Abdelhady AW, Lorenzi V, Mopure D, Pru JM, Winuthayanon S, Vento-Tormo R, Amato CM, Spencer TE, Kelleher AM.
abstract:
ABSTRACT

  Uterine gland development and function is essential for reproduction and women’s health, yet the epithelial cell states and signaling interactions that govern gland fate specification are not well understood. Here, integration of single cell and spatial transcriptomics with organoid culture, lineage tracing, and genetic and hormonal perturbation models were used to define mechanisms regulating postnatal uterine epithelial differentiation. A developmentally restricted epithelial plasticity state was identified that precedes luminal and glandular cell lineage segregation and is accompanied by dynamic reorganization of stromal-epithelial communication during uterine differentiation. Pseudotime analysis revealed progressive acquisition of gland-associated programs, including  forkhead box A2 (  Foxa2 ), retinoic acid metabolic genes, and epithelial  estrogen receptor alpha (  Esr1 ) expression. Functional studies revealed that ESR1 acquisition and retinoic acid signaling suppress the multilayered organoid phenotype associated with epithelial plasticity, thereby promoting epithelial specification and lineage commitment. Moreover, neonatal hormonal perturbation of adenogenesis and conditional deletion of  Foxa2 abolished this organoid phenotype. Together, these findings demonstrate that ESR1 acquisition, retinoic acid signaling and FOXA2-dependent glandular differentiation each restrict a transient epithelial plasticity state, coupling the loss of developmental plasticity to the emergence of the glandular lineage.
abstractZh:
摘要

  子宫腺体的发育和功能对生殖和女性健康至关重要，然而调控腺体命运特化的上皮细胞状态和信号相互作用尚不清楚。本研究整合了单细胞和空间转录组学与类器官培养、谱系追踪以及遗传和激素扰动模型，以定义调控出生后子宫上皮分化的机制。研究发现了一种发育受限的上皮可塑性状态，该状态先于腔上皮和腺上皮细胞谱系分离，并伴随子宫分化过程中基质-上皮通讯的动态重组。伪时间分析揭示了腺体相关程序的逐步获得，包括叉头框蛋白A2（Foxa2）、视黄酸代谢基因以及上皮雌激素受体α（Esr1）的表达。功能研究表明，ESR1的获得和视黄酸信号传导抑制了与上皮可塑性相关的多层类器官表型，从而促进上皮特化和谱系定型。此外，新生儿期对腺体发生的激素扰动以及Foxa2的条件性敲除消除了这种类器官表型。总之，这些发现表明，ESR1的获得、视黄酸信号传导和FOXA2依赖的腺体分化均限制了一种短暂的上皮可塑性状态，将发育可塑性的丧失与腺体谱系的出现联系起来。

title: Galectin and Myc enable cochlear progenitor expansion in vitro and in vivo
titleZh: 半乳糖凝集素和Myc在体外和体内促进耳蜗祖细胞扩增
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Kubota M, Abitbol JM, Lee PK, Matern MS, Bustos Barocio S, Jan TA, Cheng AG, Heller S.
abstract: The neonatal cochlear epithelium harbors regenerative capacity, attributable to the transient greater epithelial ridge (GER). After injury, GER cells re-enter the cell cycle, migrate into the damaged organ of Corti, and differentiate into sensory or supporting cells  in vivo ; in culture, they proliferate to form inner ear organoids. The mechanisms underlying this competence remain unclear. Here, we generated organoids from mouse GER cells and performed single-cell transcriptomics at organoid initiation. Analysis revealed extracellular matrix reorganization with prominent involvement of galectins. Functional assays combining inhibition and overexpression demonstrated that galectin-1 and Myc are both necessary and sufficient for organoid growth. Moreover, Myc overexpression conferred organoid-forming capacity in post-neonatal cochlear epithelial cells after hearing onset, thereby extending the time window for regenerative competence.  In vivo , organ of Corti ablation induced galectin-1 upregulation and GER proliferation, suppressed by galectin-1 blockade, establishing a model to rekindle proliferative potential in mature cochlear cells.
abstractZh: 新生耳蜗上皮具有再生能力，这归因于短暂存在的大上皮嵴（GER）。损伤后，GER细胞重新进入细胞周期，迁移到受损的柯蒂氏器中，并在体内分化为感觉细胞或支持细胞；在培养中，它们增殖形成内耳类器官。这种能力背后的机制尚不清楚。在这里，我们从小鼠GER细胞生成了类器官，并在类器官起始时进行了单细胞转录组学分析。分析揭示了细胞外基质重组，其中半乳糖凝集素显著参与。结合抑制和过表达的功能实验表明，半乳糖凝集素-1和Myc对于类器官生长既是必要的也是充分的。此外，Myc过表达在听力开始后的新生后耳蜗上皮细胞中赋予了类器官形成能力，从而延长了再生能力的时间窗口。在体内，柯蒂氏器消融诱导了半乳糖凝集素-1上调和GER增殖，而半乳糖凝集素-1阻断可抑制这一过程，为重新激发成熟耳蜗细胞的增殖潜力建立了一个模型。

abstract:
Background

Triple-negative breast cancer is an aggressive breast cancer subtype characterized by the absence of human epidermal growth factor receptor 2, estrogen and progesterone receptors, limiting targeted therapy options. Cisplatin, a chemotherapeutic agent, induces DNA damage and exhibits some efficacy against triple-negative breast cancer, but its effectiveness is often reduced by chemoresistance and systemic toxicity.Results

To optimize this strategy in a biocompatible and precise manner, we developed a nanoplatform based on red blood cell-derived extracellular vesicles for the combined delivery of Cetuximab and cisplatin, enabling immune evasion, and the possibility of autologous personalization and GMP-compliant production. Owing to their DNA-free lumen and lack of EGFR, RBC-EVs preserve cisplatin activity and prevent interference with cetuximab. This formulation enhances cisplatin's cytotoxicity by up to 50%, as shown in vitro and in patient-derived organoids. It effectively reduces chemoresistance by downregulating hypoxia-related genes and promoting ferroptosis, additionally, it improves cisplatin's cytotoxic effects while reducing hemotoxicity compared to the administration of free cisplatin.Conclusions

These findings highlight the potential of red blood cell-derived extracellular vesicles as a biocompatible delivery system enabling combined therapy and offering a promising strategy to overcome current limitations in TNBC treatment.
abstractZh:
背景

三阴性乳腺癌是一种侵袭性乳腺癌亚型，其特征是缺乏人表皮生长因子受体2、雌激素和孕激素受体，限制了靶向治疗的选择。顺铂是一种化疗药物，可诱导DNA损伤，并对三阴性乳腺癌表现出一定的疗效，但其有效性常因化疗耐药性和全身毒性而降低。结果

为了以生物相容性和精确的方式优化这一策略，我们开发了一种基于红细胞来源的细胞外囊泡的纳米平台，用于联合递送西妥昔单抗和顺铂，实现免疫逃逸，并具有自体个性化定制和符合GMP标准生产的可能性。由于其无DNA的腔内环境且缺乏EGFR，红细胞来源的细胞外囊泡保留了顺铂的活性，并防止了与西妥昔单抗的相互干扰。该制剂在体外和患者来源的类器官中显示出将顺铂的细胞毒性提高高达50%的效果。它通过下调缺氧相关基因和促进铁死亡，有效降低化疗耐药性，此外，与游离顺铂给药相比，它提高了顺铂的细胞毒性作用，同时降低了血液毒性。结论

这些发现凸显了红细胞来源的细胞外囊泡作为生物相容性递送系统的潜力，能够实现联合治疗，并为克服三阴性乳腺癌治疗中的当前局限性提供了一种有前景的策略。

abstract: Targeting oncogene promoter G-quadruplexes (G4s) is a compelling therapeutic strategy against human malignancies. However, clinical progress has been hindered by the lack of potent and structurally diverse G4-targeting ligands. Herein, using parallel KRAS proximal promoter G4 (KRAS-G4) as a model system, we screened an in-house natural product library and identified dehydroevodiamine (DEE) as a novel G4 stabilizer. Although DEE showed only modest anticancer activity, structural analyses determined its predominant binding mode to KRAS-G4. Leveraging these structural insights, we rationally designed and synthesized 15 DEE analogues. Among them, compound 7i emerged as the lead candidate, demonstrating a 9-fold higher binding affinity and up to 20-fold improvement in antiproliferative activity over DEE. We further determined the high-resolution NMR structure of the KRAS-G4-7i complex, uncovering a distinct dual-binding mode, featuring extensive π-π stacking interactions with outer G-tetrads and specific hydrogen bonding within groove regions. Functional analysis showed 7i effectively suppressed transcription of several G4-containing oncogenes, induced genome-wide G4 formation, and triggered DNA damage in colorectal cancer cells. Moreover, 7i significantly inhibited the growth of patient-derived colorectal tumor organoids. Overall, our findings establish a structural framework for rational design of parallel G4-targeting ligands and emphasize an alternative G4-based therapeutic strategy for KRAS-driven cancers.
abstractZh: 靶向癌基因启动子G-四链体（G4s）是对抗人类恶性肿瘤的一种引人注目的治疗策略。然而，由于缺乏有效且结构多样的G4靶向配体，临床进展一直受阻。在此，我们以平行KRAS近端启动子G4（KRAS-G4）作为模型系统，筛选了内部天然产物库，并鉴定出脱氢吴茱萸碱（DEE）作为一种新型G4稳定剂。尽管DEE仅显示出适度的抗癌活性，但结构分析确定了其与KRAS-G4的主要结合模式。利用这些结构见解，我们合理设计并合成了15种DEE类似物。其中，化合物7i成为领先候选物，其结合亲和力比DEE高9倍，抗增殖活性改善高达20倍。我们进一步确定了KRAS-G4-7i复合物的高分辨率NMR结构，揭示了一种独特的双结合模式，其特征是与外部G-四分体形成广泛的π-π堆积相互作用，以及在沟槽区域内形成特异性氢键。功能分析显示，7i有效抑制了多个含G4癌基因的转录，诱导了全基因组G4形成，并在结直肠癌细胞中触发DNA损伤。此外，7i显著抑制了患者来源的结直肠肿瘤类器官的生长。总体而言，我们的发现为平行G4靶向配体的合理设计建立了结构框架，并强调了基于G4的KRAS驱动癌症替代治疗策略。

abstract:
Background

Immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) therapy improves survival in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC), yet only some patients benefit, highlighting the need for early identification of responders and functional evaluation of tumor-immune interactions. We developed an autologous coculture platform combining patient-derived organoids (PDOs) with peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) to assess immune responses and correlate preclinical findings with clinical outcomes.Material and methods

PDOs from HNSCC specimens were expanded and cocultured with PBMCs, followed by treatment with ICIs targeting programmed cell death protein 1 (PD-1), lymphocyte-activation gene 3 (LAG-3), or their combination.Results

PBMCs were enriched for CD4+ and CD8+ T cells (∼90%) and CD16+CD56+ natural killer cells, with baseline exhaustion (LAG-3+, CTLA-4+). T cell-mediated tumor killing occurred in 44% of cases and was accompanied by Th1/Th17 cytokine signatures. ICI treatment modestly shifted T-cell phenotypes, reducing exhaustion (PD-1) and enriching cytolytic subsets (CD4+IFN-γ+, CD8+TOX+). Interleukin (IL)-17A emerged as a relevant cytokine, correlating with FasL secretion and suggesting activation of the Fas/FasL axis. High circulating IL-17A levels in treatment-naïve HNSCC patients were associated with improved survival, whereas other cytokines showed no prognostic value. In a noninterventional observational trial, increases in IL-17A positively correlated with favorable ICI responses, indicating its potential as a biomarker. PDO viability decreased in response to ICIs in a patient-specific manner, consistent with cytokine signatures and clinical outcomes.Conclusion

Collectively, this autologous PDO-PBMC coculture platform, combined with longitudinal cytokine profiling, captures patient-specific tumor-immune interactions and interpatient heterogeneity, providing a framework for real-time response prediction, biomarker discovery, and personalized immunotherapy in HNSCC.
abstractZh:
背景

免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）治疗可提高头颈部鳞状细胞癌（HNSCC）患者的生存率，但仅部分患者获益，凸显了早期识别应答者和功能评估肿瘤-免疫相互作用的需求。我们开发了一个自体共培养平台，将患者来源类器官（PDOs）与外周血单核细胞（PBMCs）结合，以评估免疫反应并将临床前发现与临床结果相关联。材料与方法

从HNSCC标本中扩增PDOs并与PBMCs共培养，随后用靶向程序性细胞死亡蛋白1（PD-1）、淋巴细胞活化基因3（LAG-3）或其组合的ICIs处理。结果

PBMCs富集了CD4+和CD8+ T细胞（约90%）以及CD16+CD56+自然杀伤细胞，具有基线耗竭（LAG-3+，CTLA-4+）。T细胞介导的肿瘤杀伤发生在44%的病例中，并伴有Th1/Th17细胞因子特征。ICI治疗适度改变了T细胞表型，减少了耗竭（PD-1）并富集了细胞溶解亚群（CD4+IFN-γ+，CD8+TOX+）。白细胞介素（IL）-17A成为相关细胞因子，与FasL分泌相关，提示Fas/FasL轴的激活。治疗初治HNSCC患者中，高循环IL-17A水平与改善的生存率相关，而其他细胞因子无预后价值。在一项非干预性观察性试验中，IL-17A的增加与良好的ICI反应正相关，表明其作为生物标志物的潜力。PDO活力以患者特异性方式响应ICIs而降低，与细胞因子特征和临床结果一致。结论

总的来说，这种自体PDO-PBMC共培养平台，结合纵向细胞因子分析，捕获了患者特异性肿瘤-免疫相互作用和患者间异质性，为HNSCC的实时反应预测、生物标志物发现和个性化免疫治疗提供了框架。

abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection affects over 250 million people worldwide, resulting in 1.3 million deaths annually. While most healthy adults clear acute HBV infection, many children and immunocompromised adults develop chronic hepatitis B, leading to liver-related complications such as cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. Current treatments, including nucleos(t)ide analogs and pegylated interferon alpha, suppress viral replication but rarely achieve a functional cure. The development and optimization of robust in vitro systems is central to the discovery of effective antiviral compounds against HBV. In this review, we examine the main cell-based models used for HBV antiviral screening, highlighting their strengths and limitations in modeling viral replication and as platforms for antiviral compound testing. We discuss DNA- and RNA-based transfection systems as controllable tools to study specific stages of the HBV replication cycle, as well as stably transfected HBV-producing cell lines that enable reproducible compound screening. Infection-based models, including HepG2-NTCP and HepaRG cells, are evaluated for their ability to support viral entry and cccDNA formation, key features for assessing entry inhibitors and post-entry antivirals. We highlight primary human hepatocytes (PHH) and mouse-passaged PHH (mpPHH), which more closely recapitulate physiological hepatocyte biology but present challenges in scalability and variability. Finally, we explore emerging three-dimensional systems, such as spheroids and organoids, which aim to mimic the complex liver architecture and microenvironment. By comparing these platforms, this review provides a framework for selecting appropriate in vitro models for HBV antiviral compound discovery. Such a framework aims to accelerate progress towards a functional cure.
abstractZh: 乙型肝炎病毒（HBV）感染影响全球超过2.5亿人，每年导致130万人死亡。虽然大多数健康成年人能够清除急性HBV感染，但许多儿童和免疫功能低下的成年人会发展为慢性乙型肝炎，进而导致肝硬化和肝细胞癌等肝脏相关并发症。目前的治疗方法，包括核苷（酸）类似物和聚乙二醇化干扰素α，能够抑制病毒复制，但很少能实现功能性治愈。开发并优化稳健的体外系统是发现针对HBV的有效抗病毒化合物的核心。在本综述中，我们考察了用于HBV抗病毒筛选的主要细胞模型，强调了它们在模拟病毒复制和作为抗病毒化合物测试平台方面的优势与局限性。我们讨论了基于DNA和RNA的转染系统，作为研究HBV复制周期特定阶段的可控工具，以及能够实现可重复化合物筛选的稳定转染HBV产生细胞系。我们评估了基于感染的模型，包括HepG2-NTCP和HepaRG细胞，它们支持病毒进入和cccDNA形成的能力，这是评估进入抑制剂和进入后抗病毒药物的关键特征。我们重点介绍了原代人肝细胞（PHH）和小鼠传代PHH（mpPHH），它们更接近地重现生理性肝细胞生物学，但在可扩展性和变异性方面存在挑战。最后，我们探讨了新兴的三维系统，如球体和类器官，旨在模拟复杂的肝脏结构和微环境。通过比较这些平台，本综述为选择用于HBV抗病毒化合物发现的合适体外模型提供了框架。这样的框架旨在加速向功能性治愈的进展。

abstract: This narrative mini-review examines how endocrine-disrupting chemicals (EDCs) induce persistent epigenetic alterations that shape endocrine, metabolic, and developmental trajectories across the lifespan. It addresses the emerging gap in integrating mechanistic epigenetic evidence with population-level vulnerability, particularly in underrepresented regions such as Latin America. These effects are especially critical during sensitive windows-including fetal development, childhood, and puberty-when DNA methylation, histone modifications, and non-coding RNA networks establish long-term molecular programming. While animal models have provided key mechanistic insights, their translational limitations highlight the need for human-relevant systems capable of capturing endocrine-specific and epigenetic endpoints under environmentally realistic conditions. We propose that epigenetic programming represents a central biological interface linking EDC exposure to context-dependent vulnerability. New Approach Methodologies (NAMs)-including organoids, micro-physiological systems, and computational models-offer a translational bridge aligned with Adverse Outcome Pathway frameworks. Importantly, susceptibility to endocrine disruption is shaped not only by biological factors but also by environmental, nutritional, and socioeconomic determinants. Evidence from Latin American populations-including altitude gradients, nutritional transitions, and structural inequalities-illustrates how these contextual factors interact with epigenetic mechanisms to influence metabolic and endocrine outcomes. This integrative perspective supports the development of more equitable and context-sensitive approaches to endocrine toxicology.
abstractZh: 这篇叙述性小型综述探讨了内分泌干扰化学物质（EDCs）如何诱导持续的表观遗传改变，从而塑造整个生命周期中的内分泌、代谢和发育轨迹。它解决了将机制性表观遗传证据与人群水平脆弱性整合起来的新兴空白，特别是在拉丁美洲等代表性不足的地区。这些效应在敏感窗口期尤为关键——包括胎儿发育、儿童期和青春期——此时DNA甲基化、组蛋白修饰和非编码RNA网络建立了长期分子编程。虽然动物模型提供了关键的机制见解，但其转化局限性凸显了对人类相关系统的需求，这些系统能够在环境现实条件下捕捉内分泌特异性和表观遗传终点。我们提出，表观遗传编程代表了连接EDC暴露与情境依赖性脆弱性的核心生物界面。新方法学（NAMs）——包括类器官、微生理系统和计算模型——提供了与不良结局通路框架一致的转化桥梁。重要的是，对内分泌干扰的易感性不仅受生物因素影响，还受环境、营养和社会经济决定因素的影响。来自拉丁美洲人群的证据——包括海拔梯度、营养转型和结构性不平等——说明了这些情境因素如何与表观遗传机制相互作用，影响代谢和内分泌结局。这种整合视角支持开发更公平和情境敏感的内分泌毒理学方法。

abstract: Oxidative stress represents a fundamental pathological driver of the secondary injury cascade following traumatic spinal cord injury (SCI). Although the pan-histone deacetylase inhibitor Trichostatin A (TSA) exhibits neuroprotective properties in various contexts, its capacity to modulate the endogenous NRF2/HO-1 antioxidant defense system within the human spinal cord microenvironment remains to be elucidated. In this study, we utilized human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived spinal cord organoids (hSCOs) as a sophisticated, human-relevant platform to investigate these mechanisms. In vitro analyses revealed that TSA preconditioning significantly bolsters the resilience of hSCOs against oxidative damage, manifesting as enhanced cellular viability, diminished accumulation of reactive oxygen species and malondialdehyde, and elevated superoxide dismutase activity. Mechanistic evaluations suggested that this protection is mediated by NRF2 nuclear translocation and subsequent HO-1 upregulation, an effect completely reversed following the pharmacological inhibition of NRF2. Furthermore, the transplantation of TSA-preconditioned hSCOs, encapsulated within a GelMA hydrogel, into a rat contusion model led to marked structural and functional restoration. Compared to untreated organoid grafts, the TSA-primed hSCOs significantly promoted motor function recovery, diminished lesion cavitation, and enhanced neuronal survival, while simultaneously attenuating glial scarring, neuroinflammation, and axonal degeneration. These findings indicate that pharmacological priming with TSA optimizes the therapeutic efficacy of organoid transplantation in a manner involving NRF2/HO-1 activation, establishing a highly promising combinatorial strategy for clinical neural regeneration.
abstractZh: 氧化应激是创伤性脊髓损伤后继发性损伤级联反应的基本病理驱动因素。尽管泛组蛋白去乙酰化酶抑制剂曲古抑菌素A在多种情境下表现出神经保护特性，但其调节人脊髓微环境内源性NRF2/HO-1抗氧化防御系统的能力仍有待阐明。在本研究中，我们利用人诱导多能干细胞来源的脊髓类器官作为复杂且与人类相关的平台来研究这些机制。体外分析显示，TSA预处理显著增强hSCOs抵抗氧化损伤的能力，表现为细胞活力提高、活性氧和丙二醛积累减少以及超氧化物歧化酶活性升高。机制评估表明，这种保护作用由NRF2核转位及随后的HO-1上调介导，而药理学抑制NRF2后该效应完全逆转。此外，将TSA预处理的hSCOs封装在GelMA水凝胶中移植到大鼠挫伤模型中，导致显著的结构和功能恢复。与未处理的类器官移植物相比，TSA预处理的hSCOs显著促进运动功能恢复、减少病变空洞形成并增强神经元存活，同时减轻胶质瘢痕形成、神经炎症和轴突变性。这些发现表明，TSA药理学预处理以涉及NRF2/HO-1激活的方式优化类器官移植的治疗效果，为临床神经再生建立了一种极具前景的组合策略。
