abstract: T cell-mediated therapies are major breakthroughs in the treatment of melanoma. However, clinical hurdles in the application of T cell-mediated therapies in melanoma persist and limit their potential. As such, preclinical research efforts remain focused on their development and optimization. Preclinical research techniques include in vivo evaluation with xenograft mouse models, ex vivo patient tumor explant culture, and in vitro tumor spheroids and melanoma/T cell co-cultures. However, these models lack the appropriate tissue context of melanoma skin cancer. Here, we describe a technique for the incorporation of primary T cells and chimeric antigen receptor (CAR)-T cells with melanoma cells in human skin organoids derived from primary epidermal keratinocytes.
abstractZh: T细胞介导的疗法是治疗黑色素瘤的重大突破。然而，T细胞介导的疗法在黑色素瘤中的应用仍存在临床障碍，限制了其潜力。因此，临床前研究工作仍集中于其开发和优化。临床前研究技术包括使用异种移植小鼠模型的体内评估、离体患者肿瘤外植体培养，以及体外肿瘤球体和黑色素瘤/T细胞共培养。然而，这些模型缺乏黑色素瘤皮肤癌的适当组织背景。在此，我们描述了一种技术，将原代T细胞和嵌合抗原受体（CAR）-T细胞与来源于原代表皮角质形成细胞的人皮肤类器官中的黑色素瘤细胞结合。

title: Spatial engineering of posterior organizers in cerebral organoids via controlled morphogen exposure within hydrogels
titleZh: 通过水凝胶内受控形态发生素暴露实现脑类器官后部组织者的空间工程
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Jeong H, Ozaki H, Tsai Y, Nie C, Shiraiwa K, Miller D, Noh MJM, Dalal JK, Salem AG, Vu CH, Foust SR, Mohraz A, Watanabe M, Ardoña HAM.
abstract: Cerebral cortex organoids are powerful  in vitro models that recapitulate key features of human development. However, conventional methods produce cortical organoids with spontaneous, spatially disorganized cortical regions due to limited control over morphogen distribution within local environments. Here, we present a spatially engineered hydrogel platform that drives localized posterior organizer formation in cortical organoids through controlled, localized exposure to morphogens. Using a combination of bulk photopolymerization, thermal crosslinking, and digital light processing (DLP) approaches, we fabricated hydrogels with stiffness-controlled layers that preferentially deliver morphogens to one side of the organoid, selectively inducing posterior organizer formation on the exposed face. We further validated this platform by delivering fluorescently tagged dextran, used as molecular weight-matched model morphogens, to visualize spatiotemporal delivery dynamics at the organoid interface. As a proof of principle, we also demonstrated that DLP fabrication enables the printing of dual morphogen hubs, serving as a model for establishing two opposing gradients within a single organoid. Together, this hydrogel platform enables systematic spatial patterning of cell populations in organoids, more faithfully recapitulating the spatial organization and cellular diversity of native tissues and advancing higher-fidelity models for studying human development and disease.
abstractZh: 大脑皮层类器官是强大的体外模型，能够重现人类发育的关键特征。然而，传统方法产生的皮层类器官由于对局部环境中形态发生素分布的控制有限，会出现自发的、空间上无组织的皮层区域。在此，我们提出了一种空间工程水凝胶平台，通过受控的、局部的形态发生素暴露，驱动皮层类器官中局部后部组织者的形成。利用本体光聚合、热交联和数字光处理（DLP）方法的组合，我们制造了具有刚度控制层的水凝胶，这些层优先将形态发生素递送到类器官的一侧，选择性地在暴露面诱导后部组织者的形成。我们通过递送荧光标记的葡聚糖（用作分子量匹配的模型形态发生素）进一步验证了该平台，以可视化类器官界面的时空递送动态。作为原理验证，我们还证明了DLP制造能够打印双形态发生素枢纽，作为在单个类器官内建立两个相反梯度的模型。总之，该水凝胶平台能够对类器官中的细胞群体进行系统的空间模式化，更忠实地重现天然组织的空间组织和细胞多样性，并推进用于研究人类发育和疾病的更高保真模型。

title: Hepatic Differentiation of Human Pluripotent Stem Cells into Functional In Vitro Models Recapitulating Native Liver Complexity for MASLD Modelling
titleZh: 人多能干细胞向功能性体外模型肝向分化，重现天然肝脏复杂性用于MASLD建模
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Sainger S, Chikara A, Kumari M, Kumari D, Jaipal P, Ranjan S, Gujjar S, Kumar Y, Kumar A, Mathapati S.
abstract: Human  in vitro hepatic models that accurately recapitulate liver function are essential for fundamental and translational research; however, currently utilised models for disease modelling and drug discovery lack physiological fidelity and require prolonged culture time. Here, we present a streamlined 10-day protocol for efficient and reproducible differentiation of human pluripotent stem cells into hepatocyte like cells (HLCs) and hepatic liver organoids (HLOs). Both models exhibited mature hepatocyte differentiation, as evidenced by albumin secretion and CYP3A4 metabolic activity. Interestingly, HLOs display enhanced multicellular complexity incorporating endothelial, stellate, and macrophage populations along with hepatocytes, thereby more closely recapitulating the native liver microenvironment than HLCs. Here, steatosis was induced in both platforms, which resulted in triglyceride accumulation and upregulated lipogenic markers (DGAT1, DGAT2). However, only HLOs recapitulated advanced disease characteristics, including inflammatory (IL-10) and fibrotic (alpha SMA, COL1A1) responses. Resmetirom, a thyroid hormone receptor-β agonist, significantly reduced steatosis and restored molecular signatures in both models. Additionally, transplanted HLOs demonstrated prolonged survival and displayed host-derived vascularization, thereby validating  in vivo maturation. Collectively, HLCs provides a rapid and physiologically relevant liver model, with HLOs offering superior utility for disease modelling, therapeutic evaluation, and regenerative applications due to their enhanced functional and physiological relevance.
abstractZh: 能够准确重现肝脏功能的人体外肝模型对于基础研究和转化研究至关重要；然而，目前用于疾病建模和药物发现的模型缺乏生理保真度，并且需要较长的培养时间。在此，我们提出了一种简化的10天方案，用于高效、可重复地将人多能干细胞分化为肝细胞样细胞（HLCs）和肝脏类器官（HLOs）。两种模型均表现出成熟的肝细胞分化，如白蛋白分泌和CYP3A4代谢活性所证明。有趣的是，HLOs显示出增强的多细胞复杂性，包含内皮细胞、星状细胞和巨噬细胞群体以及肝细胞，从而比HLCs更接近地重现天然肝脏微环境。在此，在两种平台中诱导脂肪变性，导致甘油三酯积累和脂肪生成标志物（DGAT1、DGAT2）上调。然而，只有HLOs重现了晚期疾病特征，包括炎症（IL-10）和纤维化（α-SMA、COL1A1）反应。Resmetirom，一种甲状腺激素受体-β激动剂，在两种模型中均显著减少脂肪变性并恢复分子特征。此外，移植的HLOs表现出延长的存活率并显示出宿主来源的血管化，从而验证了体内成熟。总的来说，HLCs提供了一种快速且生理相关的肝脏模型，而HLOs由于其增强的功能和生理相关性，在疾病建模、治疗评估和再生应用中提供了更优越的实用性。

title: DHDDS-related juvenile parkinsonism is caused by impaired lipid metabolism, glycosylation, and mitochondrial dysfunction, which can be rescued by NAD⁺ treatment
titleZh: DHDDS相关的青少年帕金森病由脂质代谢受损、糖基化异常和线粒体功能障碍引起，可通过NAD⁺治疗挽救
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Muffels I, Kantautas K, MacDonald G, Garapati K, Pasupuleti R, Tinker R, Shah R, Thevandavakkam M, Donnelly J, Hrstka R, Smith D, Van Klinken J, Vaz F, Pandey A, Perlstein E, Kozicz T, Morava E.
abstract:
Background

  Mono-allelic Dehydrodolichyl Diphosphate Synthase (  DHDDS) variants are associated with juvenile Parkinsonism, developmental delay and seizures. Symptoms are progressive, and various mechanisms, such as defective glycosylation, lysosomal dysfunction and cholesterol accumulation have been hypothesized to underlie disease symptoms. There is no treatment for DHDDS-related disease.  Methods

  Patient-derived cortical forebrain organoids were created to elucidate disease mechanisms and evaluate potential treatments. In these neuronal models, glycosylation, lipidomics, proteomics, cholesterol/ganglioside accumulation, mitochondrial function and electrophysiological activity were assessed. Finally, we investigated the effects of nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), identified through a yeast-based drug screen, in neuronal cell models and in six patients in an off-label, N-of-1, observational series. Results

  DHDDS-patient derived organoids showed visual signs of degeneration after four months of culturing. This was accompanied by significant cholesterol accumulation in astrocytes, decreased mitochondrial respiration and loss of deep-layer neurons. In addition, we identified glycosylation abnormalities, showing for the first time that glycosylation in human tissue is affected by monoallelic  DHDDS variants. Proteomic analysis revealed altered protein expression of proteins involved in lipid metabolism, cytoskeletal organization and neuronal development. We found that oral Nicotinamide Mononucleotide supplementation led to significant improvement in mitochondrial respiration and electrophysiological parameters in organoids, concurring with clinical improvements in all of the treated patients, particularly regarding their ataxia and tremor.  Conclusion

  Our findings reveal a progressive phenotype in DHDDS-patient-derived brain organoids, with mitochondrial dysfunction and astrocyte-specific metabolic alterations contributing to disease pathology. Notably, NMN treatment led to clinical improvements in patients with heterozygous  DHDDS variants, highlighting its potential as a therapeutic strategy.
abstractZh:
背景

  单等位基因脱氢多萜醇二磷酸合酶（DHDDS）变异与青少年帕金森病、发育迟缓和癫痫发作相关。症状呈进行性，已假设多种机制，如糖基化缺陷、溶酶体功能障碍和胆固醇积累，是疾病症状的基础。目前尚无针对DHDDS相关疾病的治疗方法。

  方法

  创建患者来源的皮层前脑类器官以阐明疾病机制并评估潜在治疗。在这些神经元模型中，评估了糖基化、脂质组学、蛋白质组学、胆固醇/神经节苷脂积累、线粒体功能和电生理活动。最后，我们研究了通过酵母药物筛选鉴定的烟酰胺单核苷酸（NMN）在神经元细胞模型和六名患者的标签外、N-of-1观察性系列中的效果。

  结果

  DHDDS患者来源的类器官在培养四个月后显示出退化的视觉迹象。这伴随着星形胶质细胞中显著的胆固醇积累、线粒体呼吸减少和深层神经元丢失。此外，我们鉴定了糖基化异常，首次表明人类组织中的糖基化受单等位基因DHDDS变异影响。蛋白质组学分析揭示了参与脂质代谢、细胞骨架组织和神经元发育的蛋白质表达改变。我们发现口服烟酰胺单核苷酸补充导致类器官中线粒体呼吸和电生理参数的显著改善，与所有接受治疗患者的临床改善一致，特别是在共济失调和震颤方面。

  结论

  我们的发现揭示了DHDDS患者来源的脑类器官中的进行性表型，线粒体功能障碍和星形胶质细胞特异性代谢改变有助于疾病病理。值得注意的是，NMN治疗导致杂合DHDDS变异患者的临床改善，突出了其作为治疗策略的潜力。

title: A unified developmental framework of the human placenta in its uterine environment in vivo and in vitro
titleZh: 人类胎盘在体内及体外子宫环境中的统一发育框架
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Li Q, Moffett A, McGovern N.
abstract: Despite advances in single-cell profiling of the human placenta, the genetic programs governing its physiological remodeling throughout gestation remain incompletely understood; this limits the interpretation of trophoblast organoid models. Here, we reconstruct the human placenta in its uterine environment across gestation by integrating public single-cell data into a unified developmental framework developed through a specialized computational strategy. We resolve 100 cell subtypes, expanding the known cellular repertoire and uncovering extensive gestational dynamics. In the placental mesenchymal core, we define a stromal-vascular niche comprising previously unresolved fibroblast heterogeneity and vascular hierarchies (capillary, arterial, and venous). This niche undergoes reprogramming from early angiogenesis to vascular maturation at term and engages signaling programs that support villous homeostasis. Within the trophoblast lineage, we uncover differential progenitor dynamics: bipotent cytotrophoblast (CTB) progenitors persist throughout gestation, whereas extravillous trophoblast (EVT)-biased progenitors are almost absent at term, coinciding with differentiation into specialized states. Benchmarking trophoblast organoids against this reference shows distinct regional identities and developmental biases. Tissue-derived models recapitulate villous CTB whilst trophoblast stem cell-derived organoids resemble smooth chorion CTB; all models capture early gestational syncytiotrophoblast and progressive EVT differentiation. Together, this work provides a resource for understanding placental remodeling across gestation and guiding the use of in vitro models.
abstractZh: 尽管人类胎盘单细胞分析取得了进展，但调控其在整个妊娠期生理重塑的遗传程序仍未被完全理解；这限制了滋养层类器官模型的解读。在此，我们通过整合公共单细胞数据，利用一种专门的计算策略构建了统一的发育框架，从而在妊娠期子宫环境中重建了人类胎盘。我们解析了100种细胞亚型，扩展了已知的细胞组成，并揭示了广泛的妊娠期动态变化。在胎盘间充质核心中，我们定义了一个基质-血管微环境，包含先前未解决的成纤维细胞异质性和血管层级（毛细血管、动脉和静脉）。该微环境经历了从早期血管生成到足月血管成熟的重新编程，并参与支持绒毛稳态的信号通路。在滋养层谱系中，我们发现了不同的祖细胞动态：双能细胞滋养层（CTB）祖细胞在整个妊娠期持续存在，而偏向绒毛外滋养层（EVT）的祖细胞在足月时几乎消失，同时分化为特化状态。将滋养层类器官与该参考图谱进行基准比较，显示出不同的区域特性和发育偏向。组织来源的模型重现了绒毛CTB，而滋养层干细胞来源的类器官则类似于平滑绒毛膜CTB；所有模型均捕获了早期妊娠合体滋养层和渐进性EVT分化。总之，这项工作为理解妊娠期胎盘重塑及指导体外模型的使用提供了资源。

title: Bioscaffold guidance drives liver periportal area tubulogenesis in hIPSC organoids.
titleZh: 生物支架引导hiPSC类器官中肝脏门静脉周围区域的小管形成。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Viasnoff V, Rajendiran H, Sahni GG, Arora A, Hepburn M, Luciani F, Ong HT, Zhu J, Marchand M, Serhrouchni S, Monet A, Mishra P, Hoon NM, Li J, Navaeipour F, Kennedy B.
abstract: Abstract  Recapitulating the liver periportal area in vitro remains a major challenge due to its complex cellular composition and the coordinated development of both ductal and endothelial networks. Most existing bile duct organoid models fail to reproduce tubular extension and multicellular organization. We present a 3D ECM micro-rods system biofunctionalized with grafted growth factors mimicking fetal liver paracrine signaling to initiate and to coordinate the development of bile ducts, parenchymal cells, and vascular structures. Our system recapitulates key developmental stages, from the formation of the ductal plate to the emergence of elongated tubular ducts. The ECM rod alone provides the biophysical cues initiating the elongation of the bile ducts and the spatial structuration of the cellular organization, while the biofunctionalization with growth factors enhance the organization and maturation of the biliary and vascular systems. We further demonstrate that this approach is scalable and amenable to quantitative analysis through label-free Optical Coherence Tomography combined with AI-driven 3D segmentation.
abstractZh: 摘要  由于肝脏门静脉周围区域复杂的细胞组成以及导管和内皮网络的协调发育，在体外重现该区域仍然是一个重大挑战。大多数现有的胆管类器官模型无法重现小管的延伸和多细胞组织。我们提出了一种3D ECM微棒系统，通过移植生长因子进行生物功能化，模拟胎儿肝脏旁分泌信号，以启动和协调胆管、实质细胞和血管结构的发育。我们的系统重现了关键发育阶段，从导管板形成到细长小管导管的出现。单独的ECM棒提供生物物理线索，启动胆管的延伸和细胞组织的空间结构化，而生长因子的生物功能化增强了胆道和血管系统的组织和成熟。我们进一步证明，这种方法具有可扩展性，并且通过无标记光学相干断层扫描结合AI驱动的3D分割，可进行定量分析。

title: Non-coding Regulatory Variants in ASD (Autism Spectrum Disorders) Disrupt CTCF Domains and Shape Cell-Type–Specific Neurodevelopmental Landscapes Revealed by Single-Cell Analyses and Cortical Organoids
titleZh: 自闭症谱系障碍中的非编码调控变异破坏CTCF结构域并塑造细胞类型特异性的神经发育景观：单细胞分析和皮层类器官揭示
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Dominguez-Alonso S, Carballo-Pacoret P, Trotta JP, Gonzalez-Peñas J, Parellada M, Arango C, Carracedo A, Rodriguez-Fontenla C.
abstract: Abstract  Background  Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a complex neurodevelopmental disorder with substantial genetic heterogeneity. While coding variants have been extensively studied, non-coding regulatory variants—which constitute approximately 99% of the human genome—remain largely underexplored. Their functional impact, particularly at the single-cell level and in organoid models, requires further characterization to better understand how these variants contribute to ASD pathogenesis. Methods  We performed targeted sequencing of 85,394 active cis-regulatory elements (cCREs) from ENCODE v2 in 600 samples (200 trios) previously negative for pathogenic coding variants. Using the Sei deep learning framework, we predicted regulatory impact scores for de novo and ultra-rare inherited variants. Gene mapping of regulatory variants was done using the T Gene tool which assigns target genes by integrating expression data. Differential gene expression was assessed using single-nucleus RNA-seq data from ASD and control brains (n = 64 individuals, ~ 600,000) from Wembley et al, 2023 and temporal gene expression dynamics was characterized in human cortical organoids scRNA seq data across four developmental stages (23 days to 6 months) from the Cortical Organoid Atlas (Broad Institute). Results  We identified 164 de novo variants in 103 probands and 53,023 ultra-rare inherited variants in 199 probands. Following Sei-based prioritization, 47 de novo variants in 44 probands and 13,258 inherited variants in 198 probands showed significant regulatory impact score > 1.1. De novo variants were enriched in promoter-like sequences (PLS) (p = 0.02), with 53.19% affecting CTCF-mediated chromatin boundaries. Inherited variants showed significant enrichment for CTCF-binding loss (p = 1.55×10⁻⁸) and demonstrated maternal transmission bias (50.85% vs 49.15%, p = 9.97×10⁻⁵). Single-cell analysis of the target predicted genes revealed distinct cellular architectures for both gene groups. De novo genes ( POGZ, ROCK2, NFIB ) showed focused dysregulation in oligodendrocytes and specific neuronal populations, while inherited genes ( SYNJ2, UBC, CLU, DLC1 ) exhibited broader effects across multiple cell types. Cortical organoid profiling demonstrated that de novo genes display progressive developmental activation with precise spatiotemporal specificity— POGZ and ROCK2 exhibited bimodal expression peaks at 1 and 6 months in outer radial glia while NFIB showed linear upregulation across progenitor populations. In contrast, inherited genes maintained constitutive expression throughout development, with the exception of CLU, which showed regulated upregulation at later stages. Remarkably, de novo regulatory genes (POGZ, NFIB) are previously identified autism risk genes in large scale sequencing studies, providing validation of dosage sensitivity mechanisms. Conclusions  Our analysis of regulatory variants in ASD indicates that non-coding mutations significantly contribute to ASD risk by disrupting CTCF domains, leading to alterations in cell type–specific gene regulation. Most de novo regulatory mutations predominantly target genes whose expression is dynamic, varying across different cell types and neurodevelopmental stages, whereas inherited regulatory variants affect constitutively expressed genes across multiple cell types, with stable expression throughout development with the exception of CLU. We also found that genes affected by de novo regulatory variants substantially overlap with those harboring pathogenic coding mutations identified in large-scale sequencing studies. These
abstractZh:
摘要
背景
自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）是一种复杂的神经发育障碍，具有显著的遗传异质性。虽然编码变异已被广泛研究，但非编码调控变异——约占人类基因组的99%——在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索。它们的功能影响，特别是在单细胞水平和类器官模型中，需要进一步表征，以更好地理解这些变异如何导致ASD发病机制。
方法
我们对来自ENCODE v2的85,394个活性顺式调控元件（cCREs）在600个样本（200个三人组）中进行了靶向测序，这些样本先前对致病性编码变异呈阴性。使用Sei深度学习框架，我们预测了新生和超罕见遗传变异的调控影响评分。调控变异的基因映射使用T Gene工具完成，该工具通过整合表达数据来分配靶基因。使用来自Wembley等人2023年的ASD和对照脑组织的单核RNA-seq数据（n = 64个体，约600,000个细胞）评估差异基因表达，并使用来自皮层类器官图谱（Broad研究所）的四个发育阶段（23天至6个月）的人类皮层类器官scRNA-seq数据表征时间基因表达动态。
结果
我们在103个先证者中鉴定出164个新生变异，在199个先证者中鉴定出53,023个超罕见遗传变异。经过基于Sei的优先级排序，44个先证者中的47个新生变异和198个先证者中的13,258个遗传变异显示出显著的调控影响评分>1.1。新生变异在启动子样序列（PLS）中富集（p = 0.02），其中53.19%影响CTCF介导的染色质边界。遗传变异显示出CTCF结合丢失的显著富集（p = 1.55×10⁻⁸），并表现出母系传递偏倚（50.85%对49.15%，p = 9.97×10⁻⁵）。对预测靶基因的单细胞分析揭示了两个基因组的独特细胞结构。新生基因（POGZ、ROCK2、NFIB）在少突胶质细胞和特定神经元群体中显示出集中的失调，而遗传基因（SYNJ2、UBC、CLU、DLC1）在多种细胞类型中表现出更广泛的影响。皮层类器官分析表明，新生基因表现出渐进的发育激活和精确的时空特异性——POGZ和ROCK2在外放射状胶质细胞中在1个月和6个月时表现出双峰表达峰值，而NFIB在祖细胞群体中表现出线性上调。相比之下，遗传基因在整个发育过程中保持组成性表达，但CLU除外，它在后期阶段表现出受调控的上调。值得注意的是，新生调控基因（POGZ、NFIB）是先前在大规模测序研究中确定的自闭症风险基因，为剂量敏感机制提供了验证。
结论
我们对ASD中调控变异的分析表明，非编码突变通过破坏CTCF结构域显著促进ASD风险，导致细胞类型特异性基因调控的改变。大多数新生调控突变主要靶向表达动态的基因，这些基因在不同细胞类型和神经发育阶段中变化，而遗传调控变异影响多种细胞类型中组成性表达的基因，在整个发育过程中表达稳定，但CLU除外。我们还发现，受新生调控变异影响的基因与大规模测序研究中鉴定的携带致病性编码突变的基因有显著重叠。

title: TREM2 blockade reprograms HER2 CAR macrophages toward inflammatory phagocytes in breast cancer models
titleZh: TREM2阻断重编程HER2 CAR巨噬细胞为乳腺癌模型中的炎症性吞噬细胞
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Jassaud M, Ziane-Chaouche L, Raffo-Romero A, Salzet M, Duhamel M.
abstract: Abstract  Tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) are key regulators of the breast tumor microenvironment and often display immunosuppressive functions that limit cellular immunotherapy efficacy. Triggering receptor expressed on myeloid cells 2 (TREM2) has emerged as a critical modulator of myeloid cell activity and a potential target to enhance the anti-tumor activity of engineered macrophages. Here, we show that TREM2 is enriched in breast cancer transcriptomic datasets and correlates with myeloid and immunoregulatory gene networks. Using HER2-directed CAR macrophages (CAR-M) generated from THP-1 cells, we found that anti-inflammatory stimulation increased TREM2 expression. Genetic or pharmacological inhibition of TREM2 reduced CAR-M anti-inflammatory polarization. Data-independent acquisition proteomics showed that TREM2 blockade attenuated IL-4/IL-13/IL-10-associated programs while enhancing inflammatory, interferon-related, cytoskeletal and metabolic signatures. Functionally, TREM2 inhibition enhanced HER2-dependent phagocytosis in both cell lines and patient-derived tumoroid models. These findings identify TREM2 as a macrophage-intrinsic immune checkpoint limiting CAR-M activity and support its targeting to improve macrophage-based immunotherapies in breast cancer.
abstractZh: 摘要 肿瘤相关巨噬细胞（TAMs）是乳腺肿瘤微环境的关键调节因子，通常表现出免疫抑制功能，限制了细胞免疫疗法的疗效。髓系细胞触发受体2（TREM2）已成为髓系细胞活性的关键调节因子，并可能是增强工程化巨噬细胞抗肿瘤活性的潜在靶点。在此，我们显示TREM2在乳腺癌转录组数据集中富集，并与髓系和免疫调节基因网络相关。使用由THP-1细胞产生的HER2定向CAR巨噬细胞（CAR-M），我们发现抗炎刺激增加了TREM2的表达。遗传或药理学抑制TREM2减少了CAR-M的抗炎极化。无数据依赖采集蛋白质组学显示，TREM2阻断减弱了IL-4/IL-13/IL-10相关程序，同时增强了炎症、干扰素相关、细胞骨架和代谢特征。功能上，TREM2抑制增强了细胞系和患者来源的肿瘤类器官模型中HER2依赖性吞噬作用。这些发现将TREM2确定为限制CAR-M活性的巨噬细胞内在免疫检查点，并支持靶向TREM2以改善乳腺癌中基于巨噬细胞的免疫疗法。

title: Superantigen-driven polyfunctional CD4+ T follicular regulatory cells impair tonsillar plasmablast function and class-switched antibody production
titleZh: 超抗原驱动的多功能CD4+ T滤泡调节细胞损害扁桃体浆母细胞功能及类别转换抗体产生
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: McLaren J, Davies K, Mathew L, Oliver E, Leane C, Carlile S, Halliday  A, McLoughlin R, Goenka A, Eberl M.
abstract: Abstract    Invasive  Staphylococcus aureus  infections have high mortality and reinfection rates, in part due to impaired development of enduring antibody-mediated immunity. The generation of pathogen-specific antibodies is typically orchestrated and counter-regulated by CD4  +  T follicular helper (T  FH  ) and T follicular regulatory (T  FR  ) cells respectively. Given their central roles in mediating adaptive immunity, these T cell subsets may form targets for  S. aureus  virulence factors, including superantigens (SAgs). SAgs force excessive production of proinflammatory cytokines which can trigger pathological cytokine ‘storms’, yet their impact on CD4  +  T  FH  and T  FR  cells, and their contribution to impaired humoral immunity during  S. aureus  infections, remains poorly characterised. In this study, we characterised the phenotype and behaviour of CD4  +  T  FH  and T  FR  cells in response to SAg stimulation, and the corresponding impact on antibody production. We found that SAgs elicited an  in vitro  expansion of circulating and tonsillar CD4  +  T  FR  cells, which were polyfunctional with co-inhibitory signatures consistent with enhanced suppressive capacity. This expansion correlated with impaired plasmablast function and class-switched immunoglobulin production in human tonsil organoids which was rescued by interleukin-21 supplementation. Furthermore, acute expansions of CD4  +  T  FR  cells were replicated during systemic  S. aureus  infection  in vivo  . Together, these findings establish CD4  +  T  FR  cells as a target for SAg-mediated immune evasion and a novel target for vaccine development.
abstractZh: 摘要  侵袭性金黄色葡萄球菌感染具有高死亡率和再感染率，部分原因在于持久性抗体介导免疫的发展受损。病原体特异性抗体的产生通常分别由CD4+ T滤泡辅助（T FH）细胞和T滤泡调节（T FR）细胞协调和反向调节。鉴于它们在介导适应性免疫中的核心作用，这些T细胞亚群可能成为金黄色葡萄球菌毒力因子（包括超抗原（SAgs））的靶点。超抗原强制过度产生促炎细胞因子，可触发病理性细胞因子“风暴”，然而它们对CD4+ T FH和T FR细胞的影响，以及它们在金黄色葡萄球菌感染期间对体液免疫受损的贡献，仍鲜有表征。在本研究中，我们表征了CD4+ T FH和T FR细胞在超抗原刺激下的表型和行为，以及对抗体产生的相应影响。我们发现超抗原在体外诱导循环和扁桃体CD4+ T FR细胞扩增，这些细胞具有多功能性，并带有与增强抑制能力一致的共抑制特征。这种扩增与人类扁桃体类器官中浆母细胞功能受损和类别转换免疫球蛋白产生减少相关，而白细胞介素-21补充可挽救这一现象。此外，在体内全身性金黄色葡萄球菌感染期间，CD4+ T FR细胞的急性扩增也得到了复制。总之，这些发现将CD4+ T FR细胞确立为超抗原介导免疫逃逸的靶点，以及疫苗开发的新靶点。

title: Human nasal organoids sustain reproducible airway epithelial differentiation and influenza virus-host innate immune interaction
titleZh: 人鼻类器官维持可重复的气道上皮分化和流感病毒-宿主先天免疫相互作用
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Jin S, Kim S, Kim M, Cha H, Chung S, Kim HJ.
abstract: Abstract  Background  The cultures of human nasal epithelial cells (NECs) are good surrogate models for studying immune responses. Three-dimensional (3D) organoids have emerged as an alternative for nasal epithelium, serving as robust platforms for modeling respiratory viral infections. We aimed to generate human NEC organoids and to determine their cellular characteristics as an in vitro model for air-liquid interface (ALI) culture and influenza A virus (IAV) infection. Methods  Primary human nasal mucosal tissues were obtained from healthy donors undergoing nasal surgery, and nasal epithelial cell (NEC) organoids were established using Matrigel-based three-dimensional culture. Differentiated NEC organoids and air–liquid interface (ALI) cultures were characterized by histology, immunostaining, electron microscopy, and quantitative real-time PCR, followed by influenza A virus (A/WSN/33 H1N1) infection assays. In addition, single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) was performed to analyze cellular heterogeneity and differentiation trajectories of NEC organoids. Results  We successfully developed human NEC organoids with using a Matrigel-based 3D culture system that recapitulates the structural characteristics and cellular composition of the human nasal epithelium. Histological results, real-time PCR, and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) revealed that the organoids consisted of seven different cell types and displayed a difference in the composition between the cells. The organoids displayed a much higher rate of basal progenitor cells whereas ciliated cells were less dominant. Unlike ALI cultures in which passage (P) 2 was the limit, the organoids exhibited successful and subsequent passages up to P5. Our data determined that NEC organoids are an adequate in vitro model for IAV infection and showed a sharp induction of mRNA levels for interferons (IFNs) and IFN-stimulated genes following IAV infection. Conclusions  This study’s results demonstrate that human NEC organoids serve as a robust in vitro model, successfully recapitulating the biological characteristics of nasal epithelium, and could be an innovative tool for exploring distinct IFN-related innate immune responses following influenza infection.
abstractZh: 摘要 背景 人鼻上皮细胞（NECs）的培养是研究免疫反应的优良替代模型。三维（3D）类器官已成为鼻上皮的替代方案，作为模拟呼吸道病毒感染的稳健平台。我们旨在生成人NEC类器官，并确定其作为气液界面（ALI）培养和甲型流感病毒（IAV）感染的体外模型的细胞特征。方法 从接受鼻部手术的健康供体获取原代人鼻黏膜组织，并使用基于Matrigel的三维培养建立鼻上皮细胞（NEC）类器官。通过组织学、免疫染色、电子显微镜和实时定量PCR对分化的NEC类器官和气液界面（ALI）培养进行表征，随后进行甲型流感病毒（A/WSN/33 H1N1）感染试验。此外，进行了单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）以分析NEC类器官的细胞异质性和分化轨迹。结果 我们成功开发了人NEC类器官，使用基于Matrigel的3D培养系统，该系统重现了人鼻上皮的结构特征和细胞组成。组织学结果、实时PCR和单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）显示，类器官由七种不同的细胞类型组成，并且细胞之间的组成存在差异。类器官显示出更高比例的基底祖细胞，而纤毛细胞则不那么占优势。与ALI培养中传代（P）2为极限不同，类器官成功进行了后续传代，直至P5。我们的数据确定NEC类器官是IAV感染的合适体外模型，并显示在IAV感染后干扰素（IFNs）和干扰素刺激基因的mRNA水平急剧诱导。结论 本研究的结果表明，人NEC类器官作为稳健的体外模型，成功重现了鼻上皮的生物学特征，并可能成为探索流感感染后不同IFN相关先天免疫反应的创新工具。

title: Droplet microfluidic fabrication of stiffness-tunable alginate-Matrigel microspheres with innovative external gelation for high-throughput tumor organoid assays.
titleZh: 基于液滴微流控的刚度可调海藻酸盐-Matrigel微球制备及其创新外凝胶法用于高通量肿瘤类器官检测
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Wang E, Feng G, Hu H, Zou J, Zheng G, Lou R, Liang S, Yu W, Jia L, Wang R.
affiliations: School of Bioengineering, Dalian University of Technology, Dalian 116024, People's Republic of China.
Affiliated Zhongshan Hospital of Dalian University, Dalian 116001, People's Republic of China.
abstract: Matrigel-based hydrogel microspheres fabricated using microfluidic technology have emerged as promising carriers for tumor organoid modeling. However, their intrinsic low stiffness limits their ability to mimic the mechanical properties of the native tumor microenvironment. To overcome this limitation, we developed an interpenetrating polymer network by incorporating alginate into Matrigel, yielding alginate-Matrigel (AM) composite hydrogel microspheres with tunable stiffness via droplet microfluidics technique. Additionally, to eliminate the cytotoxic effects associated with acidic conditions in alginate-based droplet microfluidics process by acid-driven gelation methods, a novel external gelation strategy was designed. A Ca2+preloaded gelatin substrate (contact angle > 80°) was employed to receive AM droplets, enabling rapidin situcrosslinking and solidification. Notably, cells encapsulated within AM microspheres exhibited high viability throughout the gelation process, and the resulting microspheres displayed excellent sphericity and structural uniformity. The entire workflow-spanning droplet formation, allocation, gelation, culture, and drug testing-was integrated into a streamlined single-step process optimized for high-throughput screening. The stiffness significantly increased over 7-fold, elevating from 0.6 kPa in Matrigel microsphere to 5.0 kPa in AM microsphere. Compared to Matrigel-only microspheres, both patient-derived tumor organoids and cell line spheroids in AM microspheres demonstrate enhanced chemoresistance, as indicated by elevated IC50values. Taken together, this simple, biocompatible, and reproducible fabrication strategy offers a powerful platform for organoid modeling, drug screening, and patient-relevant drug testing.
abstractZh: 利用微流控技术制备的基于Matrigel的水凝胶微球已成为肿瘤类器官建模的有前景的载体。然而，其固有的低刚度限制了其模拟天然肿瘤微环境力学特性的能力。为克服这一限制，我们通过将海藻酸盐掺入Matrigel中，构建了互穿聚合物网络，通过液滴微流控技术制备了刚度可调的海藻酸盐-Matrigel（AM）复合水凝胶微球。此外，为消除基于海藻酸盐的液滴微流控过程中酸驱动凝胶化方法带来的酸性条件相关的细胞毒性效应，设计了一种新颖的外凝胶化策略。采用预载Ca2+的明胶基底（接触角>80°）接收AM液滴，实现快速原位交联和固化。值得注意的是，封装在AM微球内的细胞在整个凝胶化过程中表现出高活力，所得微球展现出优异的球形度和结构均匀性。整个工作流程——涵盖液滴形成、分配、凝胶化、培养和药物测试——被整合为一个简化的单步过程，针对高通量筛选进行了优化。刚度显著增加超过7倍，从Matrigel微球的0.6 kPa提升至AM微球的5.0 kPa。与仅含Matrigel的微球相比，AM微球中的患者来源肿瘤类器官和细胞系球体均表现出增强的化疗耐药性，如升高的IC50值所示。总之，这种简单、生物相容且可重复的制备策略为类器官建模、药物筛选和患者相关药物测试提供了一个强大的平台。

title: Roles of histone lysine methylation in neurodevelopment and related disorders.
titleZh: 组蛋白赖氨酸甲基化在神经发育及相关疾病中的作用
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）

abstract: Neurodevelopment is a highly ordered, precisely regulated process that establishes the neurobiological foundations of cognition, thought, emotion, and behavior. Neurodevelopmental disorders (NDDs) display marked phenotypic and genetic heterogeneity and variably impair learning, daily functioning, and social adaptation. As a key epigenetic mechanism, histone lysine methylation shapes chromatin accessibility and transcriptional programs, exerting central roles in neural stem cell fate decisions, neuronal migration and circuit assembly, as well as synaptic plasticity and learning and memory. Focusing on the activating histone H3 lysine 4 (H3K4) methylation marks (H3K4me1/2/3), this review synthesizes evidence for the bidirectional regulation mediated by "writers" (the KMT2/SET/DOT1) and "erasers" (the KDM/LSD and KDM5) in NDDs, including Kabuki syndrome, Wiedemann-Steiner syndrome, autism spectrum disorder, and schizophrenia. We further outline how animal models, patient-derived brain organoids, and multi-omics atlases enhance mechanistic insight, and we discuss the translational potential of small-molecule interventions, and metabolic modulation. Together, we summarize how the precise balance of methylation writing and erasure-and its crosstalk with DNA methylation and histone acetylation-forms an epigenetic network that drives neurodevelopmental programs. Targeting this network offers testable therapeutic avenues for NDDs.
abstractZh: 神经发育是一个高度有序、精确调控的过程，奠定了认知、思维、情感和行为的神经生物学基础。神经发育障碍（NDDs）表现出显著的表型和遗传异质性，不同程度地损害学习、日常功能和社会适应能力。作为关键的表观遗传机制，组蛋白赖氨酸甲基化塑造染色质可及性和转录程序，在神经干细胞命运决定、神经元迁移和回路组装以及突触可塑性和学习记忆中发挥核心作用。本综述聚焦于激活型组蛋白H3赖氨酸4（H3K4）甲基化标记（H3K4me1/2/3），综合了由“写入器”（KMT2/SET/DOT1）和“擦除器”（KDM/LSD和KDM5）介导的双向调控在NDDs中的证据，包括歌舞伎综合征、维德曼-施泰纳综合征、自闭症谱系障碍和精神分裂症。我们进一步概述了动物模型、患者来源的脑类器官和多组学图谱如何增强机制性见解，并讨论了小分子干预和代谢调节的转化潜力。总之，我们总结了甲基化写入和擦除的精确平衡——及其与DNA甲基化和组蛋白乙酰化的串扰——如何形成驱动神经发育程序的表观遗传网络。靶向该网络为NDDs提供了可检验的治疗途径。

abstract: Photodynamic therapy (PDT) provides non-invasive precision for superficial lesions but achieves suboptimal responses in hypoxic tumors such as head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC). Spatially heterogeneous resistance mechanisms pose a major translational constraint for extending PDT applicability. To overcome this limitation, actionable targets were mapped within tumor spatial heterogeneity, circumventing conventional nanomaterial-based hypoxia-reversal strategies with inherent design complexity and protracted translation timelines. Spatial transcriptomic profiling of HNSCC specimens revealed pronounced molecular gradients along hypoxic regions, pinpointing IL1A as the most significantly upregulated transcript in hypoxic niches, which directly correlates with adverse clinical outcomes. PDT further amplified IL-1α expression, establishing a self-reinforcing resistance loop. Functional analyses confirmed that hypoxic tumor-derived IL-1α activates the NF-κB pathway to confer resistance against PDT-induced oxidative stress. Critically, the selective IL-1R1 antagonist AF12198 disrupted this resistance axis, significantly enhancing PDT efficacy across cellular models and patient-derived organoids (PDOs). Pharmacological blockade of the IL-1α/IL-1R1/NF-κB axis represents a clinically actionable strategy against intrinsic PDT resistance. By leveraging spatial heterogeneity to identify IL-1α as a druggable target, this study provides robust preclinical support for repurposing clinical IL-1 inhibitors to enhance PDT efficacy.
abstractZh: 光动力疗法（PDT）为浅表病变提供了非侵入性的精准治疗，但在缺氧肿瘤（如头颈部鳞状细胞癌（HNSCC））中疗效欠佳。空间异质性耐药机制是扩展PDT适用性的主要转化障碍。为克服这一限制，我们在肿瘤空间异质性中绘制了可干预的靶点，绕过了传统基于纳米材料的缺氧逆转策略（其设计复杂且转化周期长）。对HNSCC标本的空间转录组分析揭示了沿缺氧区域的显著分子梯度，确定IL1A是缺氧微环境中上调最显著的转录本，且与不良临床结局直接相关。PDT进一步增强了IL-1α的表达，形成了自我强化的耐药环路。功能分析证实，缺氧肿瘤来源的IL-1α激活NF-κB通路，赋予细胞对PDT诱导的氧化应激的抵抗。重要的是，选择性IL-1R1拮抗剂AF12198破坏了这一耐药轴，在细胞模型和患者来源类器官（PDOs）中显著增强了PDT疗效。药理学阻断IL-1α/IL-1R1/NF-κB轴是应对内在PDT耐药的临床可行策略。通过利用空间异质性识别IL-1α作为可成药靶点，本研究为重新利用临床IL-1抑制剂增强PDT疗效提供了坚实的临床前支持。

title: Dual inhibition of PRMT1 and SUV39H1 suppresses breast cancer progression and enhances immunotherapy response.
titleZh: PRMT1和SUV39H1的双重抑制抑制乳腺癌进展并增强免疫治疗反应。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）

abstract: Protein arginine methyltransferase 1 (PRMT1) dysregulation is frequently observed in various human cancers, including breast cancer. However, the antitumor efficacy of PRMT1 inhibitors remains limited in the treatment of breast cancer. Here, we propose a dual epigenetic inhibition strategy that effectively suppresses breast cancer growth and metastasis. We demonstrate that GSK3368715, a small-molecule inhibitor of PRMT1, downregulates the protein levels of the histone lysine methyltransferase SUV39H1 by enhancing its ubiquitination. Dual inhibition of PRMT1 and SUV39H1 results in significantly greater suppression of tumor growth and metastasis compared to either monotherapy, supporting the synergistic effects of targeting two epigenetic regulators. Consistently, dual inhibition markedly suppresses the growth of breast cancer organoids relative to single-agent treatments. Mechanistically, co-inhibition of SUV39H1 and PRMT1 enhances chromatin accessibility in promoter regions, thereby promoting the expression of key regulators involved in cell growth and migration. Furthermore, dual inhibition increases infiltration of CD8+ T cells and NK cells and upregulates PD-L1 expression. Importantly, the combination of dual inhibition with anti-PD-L1 antibody enhances the responsiveness of breast cancer to immunotherapy. Taken together, our findings indicate that co-targeting PRMT1 and SUV39H1 represents a promising therapeutic strategy for breast cancer.
abstractZh: 蛋白质精氨酸甲基转移酶1（PRMT1）的失调在多种人类癌症中经常观察到，包括乳腺癌。然而，PRMT1抑制剂在乳腺癌治疗中的抗肿瘤效果仍然有限。在此，我们提出了一种双重表观遗传抑制策略，可有效抑制乳腺癌的生长和转移。我们证明，GSK3368715，一种PRMT1的小分子抑制剂，通过增强其泛素化来下调组蛋白赖氨酸甲基转移酶SUV39H1的蛋白质水平。与任一单一疗法相比，PRMT1和SUV39H1的双重抑制导致肿瘤生长和转移的显著更大抑制，支持靶向两种表观遗传调节因子的协同效应。一致地，与单一药物治疗相比，双重抑制显著抑制乳腺癌类器官的生长。机制上，SUV39H1和PRMT1的共抑制增强了启动子区域的染色质可及性，从而促进了参与细胞生长和迁移的关键调节因子的表达。此外，双重抑制增加了CD8+ T细胞和NK细胞的浸润，并上调了PD-L1的表达。重要的是，双重抑制与抗PD-L1抗体的组合增强了乳腺癌对免疫治疗的反应性。综上所述，我们的发现表明，共同靶向PRMT1和SUV39H1代表了乳腺癌的一种有前景的治疗策略。

title: Nicotinamide riboside reduces glial inflammation and boosts mitochondrial function.
titleZh: 烟酰胺核苷减少胶质炎症并增强线粒体功能。

abstract: Astrocyte dysfunction plays a pivotal role in the pathogenesis of POLG-related mitochondrial diseases, yet the underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. Here, we employed human iPSC-derived astrocytes, cortical organoids and astrocyte-neuron co-culture systems to model POLG mutations and investigate astrocyte-mediated neurotoxicity. Single-cell transcriptomic profiling revealed a marked expansion of A1 neurotoxic astrocytes, depletion of A2 neuroprotective astrocytes, and reduction of neuronal populations in POLG organoids. A1 astrocytes exhibited transcriptional signatures of mitochondrial dysfunction, inflammatory signaling (TGF-β, JAK-STAT), impaired neuro-supportive functions, and activation of senescence, autophagy, and proteostasis stress pathways. Co-cultured dopaminergic neurons displayed impaired morphology and widespread transcriptional downregulation of mitotic, cytoskeletal, and synaptic genes, along with activation of inflammatory and ion transport pathways. Treatment with the NAD⁺ precursor nicotinamide riboside (NR) attenuated astrocyte reactivity, reduced IL-6 and CXCL1 secretion, improved neuronal structure and synaptic marker expression, and increased mtDNA copy number and ATP production in POLG astrocytes. Our study identifies NAD⁺ augmentation as a promising strategy to mitigate astrocyte-driven pathology in mitochondrial encephalopathies.
abstractZh: 星形胶质细胞功能障碍在POLG相关线粒体疾病的发病机制中起着关键作用，但其潜在机制仍知之甚少。在此，我们利用人iPSC来源的星形胶质细胞、皮层类器官和星形胶质细胞-神经元共培养系统来模拟POLG突变，并研究星形胶质细胞介导的神经毒性。单细胞转录组分析显示，在POLG类器官中，A1神经毒性星形胶质细胞显著扩增，A2神经保护性星形胶质细胞耗竭，神经元群体减少。A1星形胶质细胞表现出线粒体功能障碍、炎症信号传导（TGF-β、JAK-STAT）、神经支持功能受损以及衰老、自噬和蛋白质稳态应激通路激活的转录特征。共培养的多巴胺能神经元表现出形态受损，以及有丝分裂、细胞骨架和突触基因的广泛转录下调，同时伴有炎症和离子转运通路的激活。使用NAD⁺前体烟酰胺核苷（NR）治疗可减弱星形胶质细胞反应性，减少IL-6和CXCL1分泌，改善神经元结构和突触标志物表达，并增加POLG星形胶质细胞中的mtDNA拷贝数和ATP产生。我们的研究确定NAD⁺增强是减轻线粒体脑病中星形胶质细胞驱动病理的一种有前景的策略。

abstract:
Background

Epigenetic alterations play an increasingly recognized role in carcinogenesis and in the development of resistance to anticancer therapies. Epigenetic enzymes (writers and erasers) and effectors (readers) are largely influenced by the availability of metabolites generated through one-carbon metabolism (OCM), the tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle, and acetyl-CoA synthesis (ACS). In this study we examined the expression of epigenetic and metabolic genes to investigate their interplay in cholangiocarcinoma (CCA).Method

We examined 257 epigenetic genes (EpiGs), 96 metabolic genes (MGs), and 189 rate-limiting enzymes (RLEs) in transcriptomic data from iCCA, eCCA, and normal bile ducts, healthy liver-derived organoids, and CCA tumoroids, alongside prognostic signatures. CRISPR-Cas9 DepMap data evaluated the impact of EpiGs and MGs on cell viability. HuCCT-1 iCCA cells were exposed to hypoxia (1% O2, 24 h) to assess EpiG responses. Transcriptomic deconvolution characterized EpiGs, MGs, and RLEs expression across four tumor microenvironment (TME) subtypes. Two mouse CCA models (TAZ/Akt and NICD1/Akt) underwent RNA-seq, complemented by multi-omic profiling (transcriptomic, proteomic, metabolomic) in TAZ/Akt livers.Results

Several EpiGs were upregulated in iCCA and eCCA, including writers (DNMT1, EZH2, SUZ12), readers (CBX3, PHF20L1, SMARCA4), and erasers (HDAC1, HDAC3, KDM5C). MGs in OCM, TCA, and ACS pathways were dysregulated (up: GART, IDH2, TYMS; down: ALDH1L1, MAT1A, SHMT1). Integrated analyses identified 27 EpiGs and 8 MGs whose overexpression predicted poor survival. Subsets of EpiGs, MGs, and RLEs were linked to proliferative, high-recurrence iCCA subclasses. CRISPR screens highlighted 50 EpiGs and 23 MGs essential for CCA viability. Tumor microenvironment (TME) analyses revealed distinct immune-stromal subclasses with coherent epigenetic-metabolic signatures. In CCA cells, hypoxia induced epigenetic programs that mirrored those in CCA patients. Transcriptomic analyses in human and multi-omic analyses (transcriptomic, metabolomic, and proteomic studies) in mouse CCA livers highlighted rewiring of nucleotide, one-carbon, lipid, and mitochondrial pathways, with evidence of metabolic-epigenetic crosstalk.Conclusion

EpiGs and MGs are markedly altered in both human and experimental CCA, with several changes particularly enriched in aggressive molecular subclasses associated with poor prognosis. We observed substantial rewiring of epigenetic cofactor-related MG expression in CCAs. Functional assays validated new targets among EpiGs (e.g., CBX3, CHD4, DEK, SMARCA4, and TRIM28) and MGs (TYMS and IDH2) in CCA.
abstractZh:
背景

表观遗传改变在致癌作用和对抗癌治疗耐药性的发展中发挥着日益被认可的作用。表观遗传酶（写入器和擦除器）和效应器（读取器）在很大程度上受到一碳代谢（OCM）、三羧酸（TCA）循环和乙酰辅酶A合成（ACS）产生的代谢物可用性的影响。在本研究中，我们检测了表观遗传和代谢基因的表达，以探讨它们在胆管癌（CCA）中的相互作用。方法

我们检测了来自iCCA、eCCA和正常胆管、健康肝脏来源的类器官以及CCA肿瘤类器官的转录组数据中的257个表观遗传基因（EpiGs）、96个代谢基因（MGs）和189个限速酶（RLEs），并同时分析了预后特征。CRISPR-Cas9 DepMap数据评估了EpiGs和MGs对细胞活力的影响。将HuCCT-1 iCCA细胞暴露于低氧（1% O2，24小时）以评估EpiG反应。转录组去卷积表征了四种肿瘤微环境（TME）亚型中EpiGs、MGs和RLEs的表达。两个小鼠CCA模型（TAZ/Akt和NICD1/Akt）进行了RNA-seq，并在TAZ/Akt肝脏中进行了多组学分析（转录组学、蛋白质组学、代谢组学）。结果

多个EpiGs在iCCA和eCCA中上调，包括写入器（DNMT1、EZH2、SUZ12）、读取器（CBX3、PHF20L1、SMARCA4）和擦除器（HDAC1、HDAC3、KDM5C）。OCM、TCA和ACS通路中的MGs失调（上调：GART、IDH2、TYMS；下调：ALDH1L1、MAT1A、SHMT1）。综合分析确定了27个EpiGs和8个MGs，其过表达预测不良生存。部分EpiGs、MGs和RLEs与增殖性、高复发性的iCCA亚类相关。CRISPR筛选突出了50个EpiGs和23个MGs对CCA活力至关重要。肿瘤微环境（TME）分析揭示了具有一致表观遗传-代谢特征的独特免疫-基质亚类。在CCA细胞中，低氧诱导的表观遗传程序与CCA患者中的程序相似。人源样本的转录组分析和小鼠CCA肝脏的多组学分析（转录组学、代谢组学和蛋白质组学研究）强调了核苷酸、一碳、脂质和线粒体通路的重新布线，并提供了代谢-表观遗传串扰的证据。结论

EpiGs和MGs在人类和实验性CCA中均显著改变，其中一些变化在预后不良的侵袭性分子亚类中特别富集。我们观察到CCA中表观遗传辅因子相关的MG表达发生了大量重布线。功能测定验证了CCA中EpiGs（例如CBX3、CHD4、DEK、SMARCA4和TRIM28）和MGs（TYMS和IDH2）中的新靶点。

abstract:
Introduction

Cell-based therapies hold great promise for treating late-stage retinal degenerative diseases. However, photoreceptor cell transplantation has been limited by poor cellular integration, suggesting that an ideal population of donor cells has not yet been defined.Methods

Here, we utilized single-cell RNA-sequencing and lineage tracing to assess the heterogeneity of photoreceptor precursor cells during murine retinal development.Results

Subgroup analysis revealed three transcriptionally distinct populations of Crx + cells from postnatal day 2-6 retinas which are consistent with early (Dll1+), intermediate (Neurod4+), and late (Prom1+) photoreceptor precursor cells. Lineage tracing with subpopulation-enriched Cre mice showed that Dll1+, Neurod4+, and Prom1+ cells all generate photoreceptor cells, and captured dynamic changes in gene expression suggestive of sequential states of photoreceptor differentiation. Transcriptomic analysis revealed that similar CRX + subpopulations are present in maturing human retinal organoids.Conclusion

These findings highlight the heterogeneity of neonatal photoreceptor precursor cells, and could help inform future strategies to isolate an optimal population of cells for retinal regeneration.
abstractZh:
引言

细胞疗法在治疗晚期视网膜退行性疾病方面具有巨大潜力。然而，感光细胞移植受限于较差的细胞整合能力，这表明理想的供体细胞群体尚未被确定。方法

在本研究中，我们利用单细胞RNA测序和谱系追踪来评估小鼠视网膜发育过程中感光细胞前体细胞的异质性。结果

亚组分析揭示了出生后第2至6天视网膜中三个转录上不同的Crx+细胞群体，它们分别与早期（Dll1+）、中期（Neurod4+）和晚期（Prom1+）感光细胞前体细胞一致。使用亚群富集Cre小鼠进行的谱系追踪显示，Dll1+、Neurod4+和Prom1+细胞均能产生感光细胞，并捕获了基因表达的动态变化，提示感光细胞分化的连续状态。转录组分析显示，在成熟的人视网膜类器官中也存在类似的CRX+亚群。结论

这些发现突显了新生感光细胞前体细胞的异质性，并可能有助于为视网膜再生制定分离最佳细胞群体的未来策略。

abstract: Immune checkpoint blockade, exemplified by anti-PD-L1 antibody (αPD-L1), has revolutionized cancer immunotherapy. Nevertheless, its therapeutic potential is constrained by the inherently low tumor immunogenicity and the persistence of cancer stem cells (CSCs), which drive immune escape and tumor recurrence. Here, a CSC-targeted, pH-sensitive liposomal nano-cocktail of doxorubicin and bufalin (PSLB/D), was demonstrated to elicit robust immunogenic cell death (ICD), thereby potentiating the efficacy of αPD-L1 in immunologically 'cold' triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) models. The PSLB/D itself demonstrated potent synergistic tumor-inhibitory effects in both cell lines and 3-D tumor spheroids, and effectively eliminated CSCs, with 85-90% reductions in both primary and secondary sphere formation. Deep penetration and robust ICD-mediated immune response were observed in patient-derived organoids, highlighting its translational potential. The therapeutic efficacy was validated in immunocompromised MDA-MB-231 and immunocompetent 4T1 orthotopic mouse models. Notably, in immunocompetent 4T1 models, PSLB/D induced strong expression of calreticulin, leading to the recruitment of dendritic cells and cytotoxic CD8⁺ T cells. Activation of these immune cells converted the immunosuppressive 'cold' tumors into immunogenic 'hot' ones, substantially amplifying the effectiveness of αPD-L1. This chemo-immunotherapy also generated memory T cells, suggesting the potential for longer antitumor immune responses. STATEMENT OF SIGNIFICANCE: Cancer recurrence and immune evasion in triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) are largely driven by resilient cancer stem cells (CSCs). This study introduces a pH-sensitive liposomal nano-cocktail composed of doxorubicin and a CSC inhibitor, specifically engineered to overcome the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment. We demonstrate that this nanococktail triggers potent immunogenic cell death (ICD) in patient-derived organoids and orthotopic models, exceeding the efficacy of conventional formulations or monotherapy. By successfully converting "cold" TNBC tumors into immunologically "hot", the nano-cocktail significantly amplifies anti-PD-L1 immunotherapy outcomes. These findings offer a compelling evidence-based framework for integrating targeted nanomedicine with clinical chemo-immunotherapy protocols to prevent recurrence.
abstractZh: 免疫检查点阻断，以抗PD-L1抗体（αPD-L1）为例，已经革新了癌症免疫治疗。然而，其治疗潜力受到肿瘤固有的低免疫原性和癌症干细胞（CSCs）持续存在的限制，这些干细胞驱动免疫逃逸和肿瘤复发。在此，一种靶向CSC的、pH敏感的脂质体纳米鸡尾酒（阿霉素和蟾蜍灵，PSLB/D）被证明能引发强烈的免疫原性细胞死亡（ICD），从而增强αPD-L1在免疫学上“冷”的三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）模型中的疗效。PSLB/D本身在细胞系和3D肿瘤球体中均表现出强大的协同肿瘤抑制作用，并有效消除CSCs，原代和继代球体形成均减少85-90%。在患者来源的类器官中观察到深度渗透和强大的ICD介导的免疫反应，突显了其转化潜力。治疗疗效在免疫缺陷的MDA-MB-231和免疫健全的4T1原位小鼠模型中得到验证。值得注意的是，在免疫健全的4T1模型中，PSLB/D诱导了钙网蛋白的强烈表达，导致树突状细胞和细胞毒性CD8⁺ T细胞的募集。这些免疫细胞的激活将免疫抑制的“冷”肿瘤转化为免疫原性的“热”肿瘤，显著增强了αPD-L1的疗效。这种化学免疫治疗还产生了记忆T细胞，提示可能产生更持久的抗肿瘤免疫反应。意义声明：三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）中的癌症复发和免疫逃逸主要由具有抵抗力的癌症干细胞（CSCs）驱动。本研究介绍了一种由阿霉素和一种CSC抑制剂组成的pH敏感脂质体纳米鸡尾酒，专门设计用于克服免疫抑制的肿瘤微环境。我们证明这种纳米鸡尾酒在患者来源的类器官和原位模型中触发强烈的免疫原性细胞死亡（ICD），其疗效超过传统制剂或单一疗法。通过成功地将“冷”TNBC肿瘤转化为免疫学上的“热”肿瘤，纳米鸡尾酒显著增强了抗PD-L1免疫治疗的结果。这些发现为将靶向纳米医学与临床化学免疫治疗方案相结合以预防复发提供了有力的循证框架。

abstract: Vaccines have greatly improved public health since their proper establishment, but there are fundamental disconnects in the way that vaccines are developed, namely from cells and animals, then to humans, leading to their failure in final clinical trials. Fortunately, organoids, especially immune and tumor organoids, can replicate sophisticated insights regarding human tissue architecture and functionality in organ-like 3D structures, thereby emerging as a powerful tool to bridge the gap between animals and humans. In this review, we first highlight the mechanisms of vaccine-induced protection, then discuss the development of immune and tumor organoids as novel tools for vaccine testing, design, and reverse translation. We also indicate specific hurdles facing the application of organoids in vaccinology and offer forward-looking perspectives.
abstractZh: 疫苗自其正式建立以来极大地改善了公共卫生，但在疫苗开发方式上存在根本性的脱节，即从细胞和动物到人类，导致其在最终临床试验中失败。幸运的是，类器官，尤其是免疫类器官和肿瘤类器官，能够在类器官样3D结构中复制关于人体组织结构和功能的精细见解，从而成为弥合动物与人类之间差距的有力工具。在这篇综述中，我们首先强调疫苗诱导保护的机制，然后讨论免疫类器官和肿瘤类器官作为疫苗测试、设计和反向翻译的新型工具的发展。我们还指出了类器官在疫苗学应用中面临的具体障碍，并提供了前瞻性的观点。

abstract: Experimental animal models have historically been pivotal in molecular biology, providing insights into gene function, disease causes, and therapeutic advancements. However, their translational relevance is increasingly scrutinized due to interspecies variations, ethical dilemmas, and restricted reproducibility. The objective of this study is to critically analyze the obstacles and ethical considerations related to animal models in molecular biology, while highlighting the promise of human-relevant and combinatorial techniques to enhance translational outcomes. A narrative synthesis of literature published from 2013 to 2025 was performed via PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar. Research focusing on model development, translational obstacles, ethical implications, and disease-specific applications-encompassing neurodegenerative, metabolic, oncological, hepatic, renal, and pain models-was prioritized. Animal models are indispensable but insufficient for precisely mirroring human disease. Principal challenges include species variability, infrastructural limitations, and insufficient reproducibility. Innovative approaches such as humanized models, organoids, and CRISPR/Cas9 technologies, when combined with rigorous methodologies, controlled heterogeneity, and ethical safeguards, offer a means to improve the predictability and reliability of preclinical research. Progress in molecular biology needs to include strict planning, long-lasting infrastructure, and new ideas from interdisciplinary fields. Integrating human-relevant and combinatorial approaches can improve the scientific integrity and ethical underpinning of biomedical research.
abstractZh: 实验动物模型在历史上一直是分子生物学的关键，提供了对基因功能、疾病原因和治疗进展的见解。然而，由于物种间差异、伦理困境和可重复性受限，其转化相关性日益受到审视。本研究旨在批判性分析分子生物学中动物模型的障碍和伦理考量，同时强调人类相关和组合技术在增强转化结果方面的前景。通过PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science和Google Scholar对2013年至2025年发表的文献进行了叙述性综合。优先考虑了关注模型开发、转化障碍、伦理影响和疾病特异性应用（包括神经退行性、代谢性、肿瘤性、肝性、肾性和疼痛模型）的研究。动物模型是不可或缺的，但不足以精确模拟人类疾病。主要挑战包括物种变异性、基础设施限制和可重复性不足。创新方法如人源化模型、类器官和CRISPR/Cas9技术，结合严格的方法学、受控的异质性和伦理保障，为改善临床前研究的可预测性和可靠性提供了途径。分子生物学的进展需要包括严格规划、持久基础设施和跨学科领域的新思想。整合人类相关和组合方法可以提高生物医学研究的科学完整性和伦理基础。

abstract: The 21st Royan International Stem Cell Congress (3-5 September 2025, Tehran, Iran) convened the global stem cell community to assess the accelerating translation of regenerative medicine from bench to bedside. Over three days, 10 thematic sessions, spanning pluripotency, cancer, organoid technology, molecular biomedicine, artificial intelligence (AI), bioengineering, and clinical translation, provided a comprehensive overview of a field undergoing increasing integration. Key presentations reported recent progress in several areas: the generation of primate and human embryo models for developmental study; new strategies in cross-species reprogramming and exosome-based therapeutics; and the application of AI for patient stratification, drug repurposing, and metabolic modeling. Concurrently, sessions on bioengineering showcased developments in next-generation biomaterials, non-viral gene delivery systems, and scalable microfluidic platforms aimed at enhancing therapeutic safety and manufacturability. The congress also featured critical discussions on regulatory frameworks, bioentrepreneurship, and the ecosystem required to support clinical adoption. Collectively, the meeting underscored a continuing shift toward a multidisciplinary paradigm in which foundational biology, emerging technology, and pragmatic translation converge to advance the development of safe, effective, and accessible stem cell-based therapies worldwide.
abstractZh: 第21届罗扬国际干细胞大会（2025年9月3日至5日，伊朗德黑兰）汇聚了全球干细胞界，评估再生医学从实验室到临床的加速转化。在为期三天的会议中，10个主题会议涵盖了多能性、癌症、类器官技术、分子生物医学、人工智能（AI）、生物工程和临床转化，全面展示了这一日益整合领域的最新进展。主要报告介绍了多个领域的最新进展：用于发育研究的灵长类和人类胚胎模型的生成；跨物种重编程和外泌体治疗的新策略；以及AI在患者分层、药物再利用和代谢建模中的应用。同时，生物工程会议展示了下一代生物材料、非病毒基因递送系统和可扩展微流控平台的发展，旨在提高治疗安全性和可制造性。大会还就监管框架、生物创业以及支持临床采用所需的生态系统进行了关键讨论。总体而言，会议强调了向多学科范式的持续转变，其中基础生物学、新兴技术和务实转化相结合，以推动全球安全、有效且可及的干细胞疗法的开发。

abstract: Organoids have become mainstay tools for drug discovery and personalized medicine. High-throughput imaging readouts for drug screening of tumor organoids are of particular interest as organoid-level quantification of responses provides insights into heterogeneity, which is relevant for predicting therapeutic efficacy and anticipating emergence of resistance. However, screening extracellular matrix (ECM)-embedded organoids remains technically challenging. Standard methods with manual cell seeding in thick ECM constructs impede imaging efficiency, whereas bulk endpoint assays are easy to implement but fail to resolve single-organoid-level drug response data. Here we present a protocol to bioprint cells within a temperature-sensitive ECM in thin, flat, square-shaped patterns in 96-well plates to establish three-dimensional (3D) cultures for efficient, high-throughput, time-resolved quantitative phase imaging at single-organoid resolution. Quantitative phase imaging of 3D-bioprinted organoids using high-speed live cell interferometry coupled with machine learning analyses enables label-free quantification of biomass, growth kinetics and drug response profiles of thousands of individual organoids per experiment. We demonstrate that the protocol can be leveraged to automatically generate plates containing thousands of organoids for high-throughput imaging and drug screening experiments, quantify growth and drug response heterogeneity, resolve rare phenotypes and identify predictive features of drug response profiles for fundamental studies and therapeutic decision-making. This protocol can be completed in 2 weeks or less and can be adapted to organoids derived from a variety of cell sources and to alternative screening paradigms. The protocol requires familiarity with coding and experience with 3D cell culture, optical assembly and software installation.
abstractZh: 类器官已成为药物发现和个性化医疗的主要工具。用于肿瘤类器官药物筛选的高通量成像读数尤其受到关注，因为类器官水平的反应量化可提供对异质性的见解，这与预测治疗效果和预期耐药性的出现相关。然而，筛选嵌入细胞外基质（ECM）的类器官在技术上仍具挑战性。在厚ECM构建体中进行手动细胞接种的标准方法会妨碍成像效率，而批量终点检测虽易于实施，但无法解析单个类器官水平的药物反应数据。在此，我们提出一种方案，将细胞生物打印在温度敏感的ECM中，以薄、平、方形图案形式置于96孔板中，以建立三维（3D）培养体系，用于在单个类器官分辨率下进行高效、高通量、时间分辨的定量相位成像。使用高速活细胞干涉测量法结合机器学习分析对3D生物打印类器官进行定量相位成像，可实现每次实验对数千个单个类器官的生物量、生长动力学和药物反应谱的无标记量化。我们证明，该方案可用于自动生成包含数千个类器官的板，用于高通量成像和药物筛选实验，量化生长和药物反应异质性，解析罕见表型，并识别药物反应谱的预测特征，用于基础研究和治疗决策。该方案可在2周或更短时间内完成，并可适用于源自多种细胞来源的类器官以及替代筛选模式。该方案要求熟悉编码，并具备3D细胞培养、光学组装和软件安装的经验。

abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC)-associated pathobionts such as Enterotoxigenic Bacteroides fragilis (ETBF) and colibactin-producing (pks+) Escherichia coli disrupt epithelial barrier function, promote chronic inflammation, and induce genotoxic stress. To investigate how these pathogenic interactions with the host epithelium can be modulated, we employed patient-derived normal human colon organoids as an ex vivo model. Two lytic bacteriophages, Bac-FRP-3 (targeting ETBF) and Esc-COP-23 (targeting pks + E. coli), were applied to bacterial cultures, and the resulting phage-conditioned supernatants were used to challenge organoids. Exposure to ETBF and pks + E. coli induced strong pro-inflammatory transcriptional responses, DNA damage signaling, and epithelial disruption, whereas phage treatment attenuated these effects. Transcriptomic profiling revealed restoration of inflammatory and DNA damage-related gene expression, while confocal imaging confirmed recovery of epithelial junctional integrity and reduced DNA double-strand breaks. These findings highlight phage-mediated modulation of host-pathobiont interactions and provide mechanistic insight into how targeted viral predation can reshape pathogenic impacts within the human intestinal environment.
abstractZh: 结直肠癌（CRC）相关的病原共生菌，如产肠毒素脆弱拟杆菌（ETBF）和产大肠杆菌素（pks+）的大肠杆菌，会破坏上皮屏障功能，促进慢性炎症，并诱导基因毒性应激。为了研究这些与宿主上皮的致病性相互作用如何被调节，我们采用患者来源的正常人结肠类器官作为离体模型。将两种裂解性噬菌体Bac-FRP-3（靶向ETBF）和Esc-COP-23（靶向pks+大肠杆菌）应用于细菌培养物，并将所得的噬菌体条件上清液用于攻击类器官。暴露于ETBF和pks+大肠杆菌诱导了强烈的促炎转录反应、DNA损伤信号传导和上皮破坏，而噬菌体处理则减弱了这些效应。转录组分析显示炎症和DNA损伤相关基因表达得到恢复，而共聚焦成像证实上皮连接完整性的恢复和DNA双链断裂的减少。这些发现强调了噬菌体介导的宿主-病原共生菌相互作用的调节，并为靶向病毒捕食如何重塑人类肠道环境中的致病影响提供了机制性见解。

abstract: Hyperuricemia is a common metabolic disease and an important risk factor for low testosterone levels in men. The functional homeostasis of stem Leydig cells (SLCs) is crucial for maintaining testosterone levels. However, the potential molecular mechanism of how high uric acid (UA) levels affect SLC function remains to be elucidated. Here, we reveal that at the single-cell RNA sequencing level, SLCs exhibit senescence under high UA conditions. Mechanistically, UA binds to CCDC90B, leading to its significant accumulation within cells. This exacerbates the influx of calcium ions into mitochondria, resulting in mitochondrial quality control (MQC) imbalance. In addition, at the level of organoids and transgenic mice, we observe SLC senescence is alleviated and considerable testosterone recovery after AAV8-CCDC90B treatment. In summary, these results indicate that SLC senescence under high UA is regulated in a MQC-dependent manner, with CCDC90B being a key regulatory target. Meanwhile, AAV-mediated gene therapy may offer a promising therapeutic approach for patients with low testosterone levels.
abstractZh: 高尿酸血症是一种常见的代谢性疾病，也是男性睾酮水平降低的重要风险因素。干性Leydig细胞（SLCs）的功能稳态对于维持睾酮水平至关重要。然而，高尿酸（UA）水平影响SLC功能的潜在分子机制仍有待阐明。在此，我们揭示在单细胞RNA测序水平上，SLCs在高UA条件下表现出衰老现象。机制上，UA与CCDC90B结合，导致其在细胞内显著积累。这加剧了钙离子流入线粒体，导致线粒体质量控制（MQC）失衡。此外，在类器官和转基因小鼠水平上，我们观察到经AAV8-CCDC90B治疗后，SLC衰老得到缓解，睾酮水平显著恢复。总之，这些结果表明，高UA条件下SLC的衰老以MQC依赖的方式被调控，其中CCDC90B是一个关键的调控靶点。同时，AAV介导的基因治疗可能为睾酮水平低的患者提供一种有前景的治疗方法。

abstract: Tumor heterogeneity and drug resistance limit the efficacy of cancer therapies and highlight the need for patient-specific preclinical models. Here, we develop a microfluidic tumor-on-chip (TOC) platform that integrates patient-derived organoids with a functional endothelial barrier and utilizes liquid flow to recreate drug delivery from the vasculature into tumor tissue. This system enables evaluation of therapeutic efficacy and toxicity under physiologically relevant conditions. Additionally, the platform is utilized to assess immune cell migration induced by tumor-derived factors in the absence of an endothelial barrier. In pancreatic cancer, the TOC model captures cellular features associated with treatment resistance and pathway rewiring at single-cell resolution, with drug response patterns showing a trend toward alignment with patient clinical outcomes in a limited, retrospective, exploratory setting. By simulating vascular drug transport, the platform provides a scalable and clinically relevant tool for studying treatment response mechanisms and evaluating drug responses under physiologically constrained delivery conditions.
abstractZh: 肿瘤异质性和耐药性限制了癌症治疗的效果，并凸显了对患者特异性临床前模型的需求。在此，我们开发了一种微流控肿瘤芯片（TOC）平台，该平台将患者来源的类器官与功能性内皮屏障相结合，并利用液体流动模拟药物从血管到肿瘤组织的递送。该系统能够在生理相关条件下评估治疗效果和毒性。此外，该平台还用于评估在没有内皮屏障的情况下，由肿瘤衍生因子诱导的免疫细胞迁移。在胰腺癌中，TOC模型在单细胞分辨率下捕获了与治疗耐药性和通路重编程相关的细胞特征，药物反应模式在有限的、回顾性的、探索性环境中显示出与患者临床结果趋于一致的趋势。通过模拟血管药物转运，该平台为研究治疗反应机制和在生理受限的递送条件下评估药物反应提供了一种可扩展且临床相关的工具。

abstract: Radiation-induced enteritis (RIE), a common adverse effect after radiotherapy for pelvic, abdominal, and retroperitoneal tumors, has no effective treatment. Our previous study showed that intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIg) ameliorated radiation toxicity. Here, we investigated the role of IVIg in enhancing intestinal stem cell (ISC) regeneration to mitigate RIE and its underlying mechanism. In a mouse RIE model, IVIg improved tissue repair, reduced intestinal epithelial apoptosis and pyroptosis, decreased inflammatory factors, enhanced antioxidant capacity, and alleviated DNA damage. Notably, IVIg promoted the proliferation of OLFM4+ and LGR5+ ISCs in crypts and mitigated radiation-induced enteroid damage in vitro. Lineage tracing revealed that IVIg enhanced LGR5+ ISCs and their daughter cell survival. Mechanistically, IVIg promoted β-catenin nuclear translocation, and the β-catenin inhibitor MSAB diminished IVIg's radioprotective effects. Collectively, IVIg combats RIE by enhancing ISC regeneration via β-catenin nuclear translocation, highlighting its potential as an RIE therapeutic candidate.
abstractZh: 放射性肠炎（RIE）是盆腔、腹部和腹膜后肿瘤放疗后常见的副作用，目前尚无有效治疗方法。我们之前的研究表明，静脉注射免疫球蛋白（IVIg）可改善放射毒性。在此，我们研究了IVIg在增强肠道干细胞（ISC）再生以减轻RIE中的作用及其潜在机制。在小鼠RIE模型中，IVIg改善了组织修复，减少了肠上皮细胞凋亡和焦亡，降低了炎症因子，增强了抗氧化能力，并减轻了DNA损伤。值得注意的是，IVIg促进了隐窝中OLFM4+和LGR5+ ISC的增殖，并在体外减轻了放射引起的肠道类器官损伤。谱系追踪显示，IVIg增强了LGR5+ ISC及其子细胞的存活。机制上，IVIg促进了β-连环蛋白的核转位，而β-连环蛋白抑制剂MSAB减弱了IVIg的放射保护作用。总之，IVIg通过β-连环蛋白核转位增强ISC再生来对抗RIE，凸显了其作为RIE治疗候选药物的潜力。

abstract: Intestinal organoids are powerful tools for modeling host-pathogen interactions, yet culture-induced artifacts remain poorly defined. Here, we performed time-course transcriptomic profiling of patient-derived ileal organoids microinjected with Mycobacterium avium subsp. paratuberculosis (MAP) or treated with the swelling agent forskolin (FSK) and compared expression changes to untreated controls. Our analysis revealed that culture-associated transcriptional drift was the primary driver of gene expression changes over the 48-hour time course, likely obscuring pathogen-specific responses. This drift involved progressive downregulation of metabolic genes accompanied by the upregulation of genes with high GC content. Although FSK treatment improved. microinjection efficiency, it also introduced additional confounding effects, including transient activation of apoptotic pathways and upregulation of inflammatory genes that resolved within two days. While MAP infection did not produce significant single-gene responses, gene set analysis revealed significant infection-associated effects. Spatial transcriptomics further demonstrated that multiple enterocyte gene sets became downregulated during culture, independent of their normal crypt-villus expression pattern. Gene sets typically expressed at the crypt-villus junction showed the greatest downregulation. Notably, MAP infection selectively counteracted these culture-induced changes, preserving gene expression patterns characteristic of the upper villus epithelium. These findings indicate that both metabolic stress and pharmacological interventions can substantially confound organoid-based infection models. More broadly, they underscore the importance of spatially resolved transcriptomics and appropriate temporal controls to distinguish genuine pathogen responses from culture-related artifacts. To our knowledge, no previous studies have used human intestinal organoids to model MAP infection or characterized the epithelial transcriptomic response. This work establishes critical frameworks for investigating MAP's role in Crohn's disease pathogenesis.
abstractZh: 肠道类器官是模拟宿主-病原体相互作用的强大工具，但培养诱导的伪影仍定义不清。在此，我们对患者来源的回肠类器官进行了时间序列转录组分析，这些类器官被显微注射了鸟分枝杆菌亚种副结核杆菌（MAP）或用肿胀剂毛喉素（FSK）处理，并将表达变化与未处理对照组进行比较。我们的分析显示，培养相关的转录漂移是48小时时间过程中基因表达变化的主要驱动因素，可能掩盖了病原体特异性反应。这种漂移涉及代谢基因的逐渐下调，同时伴随高GC含量基因的上调。尽管FSK处理提高了显微注射效率，但它也引入了额外的混杂效应，包括凋亡通路的瞬时激活和炎症基因的上调，这些效应在两天内消退。虽然MAP感染未产生显著的单基因反应，但基因集分析揭示了显著的感染相关效应。空间转录组学进一步表明，多种肠上皮细胞基因集在培养过程中下调，与其正常的隐窝-绒毛表达模式无关。通常在隐窝-绒毛交界处表达的基因集显示出最大程度的下调。值得注意的是，MAP感染选择性地抵消了这些培养诱导的变化，保留了上绒毛上皮特征性的基因表达模式。这些发现表明，代谢应激和药物干预都可能显著混淆基于类器官的感染模型。更广泛地说，它们强调了空间分辨转录组学和适当的时间对照对于区分真实病原体反应与培养相关伪影的重要性。据我们所知，此前没有研究使用人类肠道类器官模拟MAP感染或表征上皮转录组反应。这项工作为研究MAP在克罗恩病发病机制中的作用建立了关键框架。

abstract: Cortical organoids (COs) derived from human induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs) provide a unique opportunity to model human neurodevelopment in vitro. Here, we present a protocol to prevent necrotic core formation without requiring organoid slicing. We describe steps for hiPSC culturing, preparation of single-cell suspension, seeding, and embryoid body (EB) and neuroectoderm formation. We then detail procedures for CO formation and maintenance without necrotic core formation. This protocol sustains long-term viability and preserves structural integrity by enhancing oxygen and nutrient diffusion.
abstractZh: 源自人诱导多能干细胞（hiPSCs）的皮层类器官（COs）为在体外模拟人类神经发育提供了独特的机会。在此，我们提出了一种无需进行类器官切片即可防止坏死核心形成的方案。我们描述了hiPSC培养、单细胞悬液制备、接种以及胚状体（EB）和神经外胚层形成的步骤。随后，我们详细介绍了CO形成和维持且不形成坏死核心的程序。该方案通过增强氧气和营养物质的扩散，维持长期活力并保持结构完整性。

abstract: A decline in specific antibody responses is a hallmark of human aging, yet the differential contributions of B and T lymphocytes remain unclear. CXCL13 is a chemokine that shapes germinal center (GC) organization, but the regulation of human-specific CXCL13+ T follicular helper (Tfh) cells during aging is not known. Using human tonsil organoids, single-cell RNA sequencing, and CRISPR perturbations, we mapped age-associated changes in Tfh cells, the cell type that provides help to B cells in GCs. Tonsil organoids from older donors generate weaker influenza-specific antibody responses, which we trace to Tfh cell defects rather than B cells. Single-cell profiling revealed a selective loss of mature CXCL13+ GC-Tfh cells accompanied by accumulation of precursor states. Trajectory analysis shows that aging arrests Tfh maturation at the early activated precursor transition, and CRISPR perturbations identify BACH2 and SOX4 as regulators of differentiation reduced with age. These findings reveal a human-specific mechanism of immune aging with implications for strategies to restore humoral immunity.
abstractZh: 特异性抗体反应的下降是人类衰老的一个标志，但B淋巴细胞和T淋巴细胞的差异性贡献仍不清楚。CXCL13是一种塑造生发中心（GC）组织的趋化因子，但人类特异性CXCL13+滤泡辅助性T细胞（Tfh）在衰老过程中的调控尚不明确。利用人类扁桃体类器官、单细胞RNA测序和CRISPR扰动，我们绘制了Tfh细胞（在生发中心为B细胞提供帮助的细胞类型）随年龄相关的变化图谱。来自老年供体的扁桃体类器官产生较弱的流感特异性抗体反应，我们将其归因于Tfh细胞缺陷而非B细胞。单细胞谱系分析揭示成熟CXCL13+ GC-Tfh细胞的选择性丢失，伴随前体状态的积累。轨迹分析表明，衰老在早期活化前体转变阶段阻滞了Tfh成熟，CRISPR扰动鉴定出BACH2和SOX4为随年龄减少的分化调节因子。这些发现揭示了一种人类特异性的免疫衰老机制，对恢复体液免疫的策略具有意义。

title: A progenitor cell population contributes to prenatal injury repair and neonatal antimicrobial defense in the small intestine.
titleZh: 一种祖细胞群体参与小肠产前损伤修复和新生儿抗菌防御。
