abstract: The specialized types and functions of epithelial cells in the adult small intestine have been well elucidated, but remain poorly understood in the embryonic small intestine. Through integrating single-cell RNA sequencing with functional studies using mouse and organoid models, we identify small intestinal sentinel progenitor cells (SISPCs), marked by Lysozyme1 (Lyz1), in the embryonic and neonatal mouse small intestine. Distinct from Lyz1+ Paneth cells, SISPCs exhibit dynamic spatiotemporal patterning and stemness features during intestinal development. Notably, embryonic SISPCs display strong stemness potential in the proximal small intestine, whereas embryonic Lgr5+ cells exhibit greater stem potency in the distal region. In addition, SISPCs play a crucial role in the prenatal intestinal injury repair via the DUSP-p38 signaling axis and contribute to the neonatal antimicrobial defense. Our findings reveal SISPCs play a pivotal role in gut homeostasis and defense during development, and suggest them as potential therapeutic targets for developmental gut disorders.
abstractZh: 成年小肠上皮细胞的特殊类型和功能已被充分阐明，但在胚胎小肠中仍知之甚少。通过整合单细胞RNA测序与小鼠和类器官模型的功能研究，我们在胚胎和新生小鼠小肠中鉴定出以溶菌酶1（Lyz1）为标志的小肠哨兵祖细胞（SISPCs）。与Lyz1+潘氏细胞不同，SISPCs在肠道发育过程中表现出动态的时空分布模式和干性特征。值得注意的是，胚胎SISPCs在近端小肠表现出强大的干性潜能，而胚胎Lgr5+细胞在远端区域表现出更强的干性能力。此外，SISPCs通过DUSP-p38信号轴在产前肠道损伤修复中发挥关键作用，并有助于新生儿抗菌防御。我们的发现揭示了SISPCs在发育过程中对肠道稳态和防御的关键作用，并提示它们可能成为发育性肠道疾病的潜在治疗靶点。

title: Hair Follicle Seedling Cryomicroneedles from Hierarchical Microfluidic Organoid on a Chip.
titleZh: 基于层级微流控芯片器官oids的毛囊幼苗冷冻微针。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Cao X, Xu D, Lu M, Zhao Y.
affiliations: Department of Rheumatology and Immunology, School of Biological Science and Medical Engineering, Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital, Southeast University, Nanjing, China.
Wenzhou Institute, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Wenzhou, China.
abstract: Hair follicle organoids (HFOs) have demonstrated revolutionary regenerative potential in hair follicle regeneration, while their high-throughput production, uniform morphology, excellent hair growth potential, and simple and efficient intradermal transplantation are still challenges. In this paper, we present novel hair follicle seedling cryomicroneedles to achieve bionic hair regeneration by using a hierarchical microfluidic organoid-on-a-chip. Our integrated chip features a fluidic channel module and a hierarchical microneedle template module, enabling microflow-guided uniform cell distribution into needle-shaped microwells to form HFOs. Cryopreservation agents (CPA)-containing pregel solutions are injected to encapsulate HFOs following UV gelation, and the final HFO-loaded cryomicroneedle (cryoMN@HFO) is obtained after freezing and demolding. We have demonstrated that the cryoMNs@HFOs could preserve homogeneous HFO morphology, favorable viability, and excellent hair growth potential. Besides, the cryoMN@HFOs possess good skin penetration ability and biosafety, enabling rapid transplantation of HFOs into the dermis. Thus, after intradermal transplantation in animal experiments, the delivered organoids develop into fully functional hair follicles with mature structures in vivo. Based on these advantages, we believe that this technology holds promise for human hair follicle reconstruction.
abstractZh: 毛囊类器官（HFOs）在毛囊再生中展现出革命性的再生潜力，但其高通量生产、形态均一、优异的毛发生长潜力以及简单高效的皮内移植仍是挑战。本文中，我们提出了一种新型毛囊幼苗冷冻微针，通过层级微流控芯片上的器官oids实现仿生毛发再生。我们的集成芯片包含流体通道模块和层级微针模板模块，能够实现微流引导的均匀细胞分布到针形微孔中，形成HFOs。注入含有冷冻保护剂（CPA）的预凝胶溶液，在紫外凝胶化后封装HFOs，经过冷冻和脱模后获得最终的载HFO冷冻微针（cryoMN@HFO）。我们已证明cryoMNs@HFOs能够保持均一的HFO形态、良好的活力和优异的毛发生长潜力。此外，cryoMN@HFOs具有良好的皮肤穿透能力和生物安全性，能够将HFOs快速移植到真皮层。因此，在动物实验中皮内移植后，递送的类器官在体内发育成具有成熟结构的完全功能性毛囊。基于这些优势，我们相信这项技术有望用于人类毛囊重建。

title: A Periosteum-Inspired Janus Piezoelectric Scaffold Using Bioenergetic-Driven H-Type Vascularization for Diabetic Bone Regeneration.
titleZh: 一种受骨膜启发的Janus压电支架，利用生物能量驱动的H型血管化促进糖尿病骨再生。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Wang K, Jiang K.
affiliations: Department of Spine Surgery, Honghui Hospital, Xi'an Jiaotong University, Xi'an, Shanxi, China.
Department of Critical Care Medicine, Sichuan Provincial People's Hospital, University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, Chengdu, China.
abstract: An imbalance in the bone-vessel-coupled regeneration process is one of the key factors hindering the effective treatment of diabetic bone defects, which are rooted in the impaired function of mitochondria. Inspired by the bilayered heterogeneous structure of the periosteum, a bilayered, biomimetic, Janus piezoelectric scaffold (JPS) with endogenous piezoelectric effects was developed to regulate energy metabolism. JPS comprises a zinc-doped apatite-gelatin-poly-L-lactic acid membrane fabricated using electrospinning and integrated with a resveratrol-loaded microsphere composite hydrogel. Without requiring an external power source, JPS is designed to respond to local micromechanical stimulation and generate electroactive cues, while synergizing with the controlled release of resveratrol to regulate angiogenesis-related signaling and endothelial metabolic reprogramming. Single-cell sequencing indicated that bone microenvironment remodeling may be associated with H-type vessels, which are bone-specific microvasculatures. JPS provides a continuous power source in a high-sugar environment, thereby reconstructing the bone-vessel coupled regeneration process. JPS treatment stimulated the vascular features associated with H-type vessel-mediated bone regeneration in vascular organoids. The JPS group showed a substantially enhanced bone volume of 21.1% vs. 8.5% in the control in a diabetic calvarial defect model. This study presents an efficient material platform for addressing clinical challenges associated with diabetic bone regeneration.
abstractZh: 骨-血管偶联再生过程失衡是阻碍糖尿病骨缺损有效治疗的关键因素之一，其根源在于线粒体功能受损。受骨膜双层异质结构的启发，开发了一种具有内源性压电效应的双层仿生Janus压电支架（JPS），用于调节能量代谢。JPS由电纺丝制备的锌掺杂磷灰石-明胶-聚L-乳酸膜与负载白藜芦醇的微球复合水凝胶整合而成。无需外部电源，JPS被设计为响应局部微机械刺激并产生电活性信号，同时与白藜芦醇的控释协同作用，调节血管生成相关信号和内皮代谢重编程。单细胞测序表明，骨微环境重塑可能与H型血管（骨特异性微血管）相关。JPS在高糖环境中提供持续的动力源，从而重建骨-血管偶联再生过程。JPS治疗在血管类器官中刺激了与H型血管介导的骨再生相关的血管特征。在糖尿病颅骨缺损模型中，JPS组的骨体积显著增加，达到21.1%，而对照组为8.5%。本研究为解决糖尿病骨再生相关的临床挑战提供了一个高效的材料平台。

title: Vascular smooth muscle cell mechanotransduction: Pathways, phenotypes and emerging technologies.
titleZh: 血管平滑肌细胞机械转导：通路、表型与新兴技术。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Kota Lakshminaraasimulu N, Smyth REA, Prakash A, Iskratsch T.
affiliations: School of Engineering and Materials Science, Queen Mary University of London, London, UK.
abstract: Vascular smooth muscle cells (VSMCs) are the predominant cell type of the tunica media and are central mediators of vascular wall integrity, governing tone, remodelling and the progression of arterial disease. Despite this, mechanobiology research has historically focused on endothelial cells, leaving VSMC-intrinsic mechanosensing comparatively unexplored. Critically, VSMC phenotypic transitions from contractile to synthetic, inflammatory, osteogenic and macrophage-like states are not merely transcriptional events but involve profound bioenergetic reprogramming, a dimension that has been largely overlooked in mechanobiology. VSMCs sense and transduce diverse mechanical stimuli including cyclic stretch, shear stress, matrix stiffness and hydrostatic pressure through specialized mechanosensors such as mechanosensitive ion channels or cell surface receptors including integrins, to orchestrate phenotypic switching and vascular remodelling. Dysregulated mechanotransduction contributes to hypertension, atherosclerosis, aneurysm formation and arterial stiffening. This review provides a unified synthesis of VSMC mechanobiology across four domains: (1) mechanical microenvironment, (2) phenotypic plasticity, (3) mechanosensing pathways and (4) emerging technologies. In parallel the review also discusses emerging technologies such as organ-on-a-chip platforms that are increasingly being used to investigate these processes. Importantly, it introduces a novel integrated framework linking VSMC mechanotransduction, metabolic reprogramming and atherogenesis, positioning VSMCs at the centre of vascular mechanobiology and identifying the mechano-metabolic signalling as a therapeutically underexplored driver of cardiovascular disease.
abstractZh: 血管平滑肌细胞（VSMCs）是血管中膜的主要细胞类型，是血管壁完整性的核心介质，调控血管张力、重塑和动脉疾病的进展。尽管如此，机械生物学研究历来聚焦于内皮细胞，导致VSMC固有的机械感知相对未被充分探索。关键的是，VSMC从收缩型向合成型、炎症型、成骨型和巨噬细胞样状态的表型转变不仅是转录事件，还涉及深刻的生物能量重编程，这一维度在机械生物学中很大程度上被忽视。VSMCs通过专门的机械传感器，如机械敏感离子通道或包括整合素在内的细胞表面受体，感知并转导多种机械刺激，包括周期性牵张、剪切应力、基质硬度和静水压力，以协调表型转换和血管重塑。失调的机械转导有助于高血压、动脉粥样硬化、动脉瘤形成和动脉硬化。本综述在四个领域对VSMC机械生物学进行了统一综合：（1）机械微环境，（2）表型可塑性，（3）机械感知通路和（4）新兴技术。同时，本综述还讨论了新兴技术，如器官芯片平台，这些技术正越来越多地用于研究这些过程。重要的是，它引入了一个新的综合框架，将VSMC机械转导、代谢重编程和动脉粥样硬化发生联系起来，将VSMCs置于血管机械生物学的中心，并确定机械-代谢信号作为心血管疾病中治疗上未被充分探索的驱动因素。

title: EZH1/2 inhibition improves immunotherapy response through MHC Class II de-repression and neutrophil reprogramming
titleZh: EZH1/2抑制通过MHC II类去抑制和中性粒细胞重编程改善免疫治疗反应
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Childress AR, Esoe D, Song X, Gosser CM, Lin Y, Plaugher DR, DuCote TJ, Naughton KJ, Skaggs EM, Yang H, Goettl R, Liu J, Hao Z, Fliss AE, Honma D, Burus T, Lei F, Huang B, Beswick EJ, Brainson CF.
abstract:
ABSTRACT

  Squamous cell carcinoma of the lung is a difficult-to-treat cancer with high prevalence in the US, and particularly in Kentucky. Here, we sought to test if the EZH1/2 inhibitor valemetostat improves anti-PD1 responses in squamous cell lung cancer models, and to develop ex vivo models to test immunotherapy drug combinations. We found that valemetostat augmented anti-tumor responses to anti-PD1 therapy, led to up-regulation of tumor cell specific Major Histocompatibility Complex Class II (MHC Class II), and drove systemic neutrophil maturation. Likewise,  Ezh2 knock-out mice produced neutrophils that were more apoptotic, less migratory, and less able to produce extracellular nets, but had similar ability to kill bacteria as  Ezh2 -WT neutrophils. To test tumor responses to differing neutrophil populations, we engineered three-dimensional air-liquid interface cultures with tumoroids, lung mesenchymal cells, and T cells, with and without bone marrow containing neutrophils and myeloid progenitors from distinct donors. Bone marrow from tumor-naïve or mice with actively growing untreated tumors boosted tumoroid growth, while bone marrow from spontaneously tumor-rejected or mice with tumors treated with valemetostat was anti-tumor. MHC Class II blockade lowered the ability of bone marrow to boost tumor growth, and reduced the ability of valemetostat with anti-PD1 to reduce tumoroid growth. Patient samples revealed a strong negative correlation between EZH2 and MHC Class II, suggesting that targeting EZH2 activity could lead to marked increase in MHC Class II and improve treatment responses in lung squamous cell carcinomas.
abstractZh:
摘要

  肺鳞状细胞癌是一种难以治疗的癌症，在美国，尤其是肯塔基州，发病率很高。在此，我们试图测试EZH1/2抑制剂valemetostat是否能改善肺鳞状细胞癌模型中的抗PD1反应，并开发体外模型以测试免疫治疗药物组合。我们发现，valemetostat增强了抗PD1疗法的抗肿瘤反应，导致肿瘤细胞特异性主要组织相容性复合体II类（MHC II类）的上调，并驱动全身性中性粒细胞成熟。同样，Ezh2基因敲除小鼠产生的中性粒细胞更容易凋亡，迁移能力更弱，产生胞外诱捕网的能力更低，但杀灭细菌的能力与Ezh2野生型中性粒细胞相似。为了测试肿瘤对不同中性粒细胞群体的反应，我们构建了三维气液界面培养体系，包含肿瘤类器官、肺间充质细胞和T细胞，并加入或不加入来自不同供体的含有中性粒细胞和髓系祖细胞的骨髓。来自未患肿瘤或患有未经治疗的活动性肿瘤小鼠的骨髓促进了肿瘤类器官的生长，而来自自发肿瘤排斥或接受valemetostat治疗的小鼠的骨髓则具有抗肿瘤作用。MHC II类阻断降低了骨髓促进肿瘤生长的能力，并降低了valemetostat联合抗PD1减少肿瘤类器官生长的能力。患者样本显示EZH2与MHC II类之间存在强烈的负相关，提示靶向EZH2活性可能导致MHC II类显著增加，并改善肺鳞状细胞癌的治疗反应。

title: Patient-Specific Vascularized Lung Tumor Organoids for Tumor-Immune Profiling
titleZh: 患者特异性血管化肺肿瘤类器官用于肿瘤免疫分析
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Natesh NR, Maity S, Kikani R, Perikamana SM, Cho G, Angel N, Ji Z, Varghese S.
abstract:
ABSTRACT

  The use of cellular systems to advance cancer therapeutics has expanded rapidly, spanning cell therapies to patient-specific tumor models. Platforms that recapitulate key features of the tumor microenvironment, including vascular and immune components, hold significant potential to improve the predictive power and translational relevance of preclinical models. Here, we report a vascularized tumor organoid platform that combines self-organizing microvascular networks with patient-derived tumor organoids and tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes. To minimize non-specific endothelial immunogenicity and enable broader compatibility across patient samples, we engineered the vasculature using β2-microglobulin-knockout endothelial cells. Leveraging this system, we established patient-specific, lymphocyte-incorporated tumor models that enabled quantitative assessment of T cell infiltration. In conjunction with immune checkpoint blockade, this platform distinguishes responder and non-responder patient samples, consistent with the clinical observations. Single-cell RNA-sequencing revealed tumor-intrinsic and immune-associated programs underlying this stratification, identifying tumor-driven hyperangiogenic signaling as a barrier to T cell extravasation. Pharmacological co-targeting of PD1 and VEGF restored T cell infiltration in non-responder organoids, shifting them from an immune-excluded to an immune-inflamed state. Together, this vascularized tumor organoid platform provides a predictive and mechanistic framework for modeling patient-specific immunotherapy responses and design of combination therapies.
abstractZh:
摘要

  利用细胞系统推进癌症治疗的应用迅速扩展，涵盖从细胞疗法到患者特异性肿瘤模型。能够重现肿瘤微环境关键特征（包括血管和免疫成分）的平台，在提高临床前模型的预测能力和转化相关性方面具有巨大潜力。在此，我们报告了一种血管化肿瘤类器官平台，该平台将自组织微血管网络与患者来源的肿瘤类器官和肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞相结合。为了最小化非特异性内皮免疫原性并实现跨患者样本的更广泛兼容性，我们使用β2-微球蛋白敲除的内皮细胞工程化血管。利用该系统，我们建立了患者特异性的、包含淋巴细胞的肿瘤模型，能够定量评估T细胞浸润。结合免疫检查点阻断，该平台能够区分应答者和无应答者患者样本，与临床观察结果一致。单细胞RNA测序揭示了这种分层背后的肿瘤内在和免疫相关程序，确定了肿瘤驱动的超血管生成信号作为T细胞外渗的屏障。PD1和VEGF的药理学联合靶向恢复了无应答者类器官中的T细胞浸润，将其从免疫排斥状态转变为免疫炎症状态。总之，这种血管化肿瘤类器官平台为模拟患者特异性免疫治疗反应和设计联合疗法提供了预测性和机制性框架。

title: Organoid-based colorectal tumor microenvironment model for immuno-oncology research
titleZh: 基于类器官的结直肠肿瘤微环境模型用于免疫肿瘤学研究
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Filip AM, Cubela I, Lavickova B, Coto-Llerena M, Danenberg E, Daniel M, Ehret B, Chevrier S, Kromer K, Harter MF, Lukonin I, Jin W, Jean-Mairet P, Cremasco F, Colombetti S, Cabon L, Gjorevski N.
abstract:
Summary

  The development of cancer immunotherapies is hindered by the lack of human-relevant models that accurately translate to patient outcomes. We combine patient-derived colorectal tumor organoids (PDOs) and cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) into floating extracellular matrix drops to form miniature colorectal tumors. These SHaking Organoid COcultures (SHOCOs) maintain immune cells in numbers, states and functional interactions that are more physiologically accurate than traditional PDO-based co-culture models. Immunocompetent SHOCOs treated with T-cell bispecific antibodies exhibited a robust anti-tumor response, in a concentration- and duration of treatment-dependent manner. By varying the stromal content, we found that fibroblasts present a physical barrier that hinders intratumoral T-cell infiltration. We also demonstrate that tumor-associated stroma can be exploited therapeutically in potentiating anti-tumor immune responses. SHOCOs could aid the battle against cancer both by providing fundamental insights into immune and stromal tumor biology, and by catalyzing the discovery of novel therapeutic approaches.   (A) Overview of the components used in creating SHOCOs and the complex tumor microenvironment they replicate. Epithelial cells (pink), CAFs (red), CD8 T cell (blue), CD4 T cell (green). Characteristics of SHOCOs:  (B) Emphasizing the role of CAFs in contracting and creating a denser microenvironment.  (C) CAFs act as a physical barrier, preventing CD8 T cells from reaching tumor niches.  (D) SHOCOs maintain a substantial myeloid population (violet) capable of performing antigen presentation.  (E) T cells within SHOCOs mount an anti-tumor cytotoxic immune response as a result of immunotherapy. Granzymes (orange), cleaved Caspase-3/7 (yellow).
abstractZh:
摘要

  癌症免疫疗法的发展受到缺乏能够准确转化为患者预后的人类相关模型的阻碍。我们将患者来源的结直肠肿瘤类器官（PDOs）和癌症相关成纤维细胞（CAFs）结合到漂浮的细胞外基质液滴中，形成微型结直肠肿瘤。这些振荡类器官共培养物（SHOCOs）在细胞数量、状态和功能相互作用方面维持免疫细胞，比传统的基于PDO的共培养模型更具生理准确性。用T细胞双特异性抗体处理的免疫活性SHOCOs表现出强烈的抗肿瘤反应，且呈浓度和治疗持续时间依赖性。通过改变基质成分，我们发现成纤维细胞构成了阻碍肿瘤内T细胞浸润的物理屏障。我们还证明，肿瘤相关基质可以在治疗上被利用来增强抗肿瘤免疫反应。SHOCOs可以通过提供对免疫和基质肿瘤生物学的基本见解，以及促进新型治疗方法的发现，来帮助对抗癌症。摘要图

title: Immune-competent apical-out airway organoids reveal distinct antiviral strategies of macrophages, neutrophils, and monocytes during influenza infection
titleZh: 免疫活性顶端朝外气道类器官揭示巨噬细胞、中性粒细胞和单核细胞在流感感染期间的不同抗病毒策略
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Beukema M, de Vries-Idema JJ, Kumar ND, Gong S, Doesburg N, Huckriede AL, Melgert BN.
abstract: The respiratory mucosa is the primary entry site for influenza virus and early antiviral immunity is governed there by interactions between epithelial cells and innate immune cells. However, mechanistic insight into these interactions in a human context is limited. Here, we established an immune-competent apical-out human airway organoid model that enables direct epithelial infection and controlled integration of innate immune cells. The organoids recapitulate key features of the human upper airway epithelium and support productive influenza virus replication. Using defined co-cultures, we uncovered distinct innate immune functions: macrophages suppress viral replication and restrict epithelial spread via production of type I and III interferons; neutrophils reduce extracellular virus levels without limiting epithelial infection, consistent with antiviral clearance mechanisms independent of interferon signaling; and monocytes exert modest, transient antiviral effects. Together, we use a human-relevant platform to define how distinct innate immune cells shape mucosal immunity at the respiratory epithelium, with direct implications for antiviral and vaccine development. abstractZh: 呼吸道黏膜是流感病毒的主要入侵部位，早期抗病毒免疫由上皮细胞与固有免疫细胞之间的相互作用在此处主导。然而，在人类背景下对这些相互作用的机制性认识仍然有限。在此，我们建立了一种免疫活性顶端朝外的人气道类器官模型，该模型能够实现直接的上皮感染以及固有免疫细胞的受控整合。这些类器官重现了人上呼吸道上皮的关键特征，并支持流感病毒的生产性复制。通过使用明确的共培养体系，我们揭示了不同的固有免疫功能：巨噬细胞通过产生I型和III型干扰素抑制病毒复制并限制上皮扩散；中性粒细胞在不限制上皮感染的情况下降低细胞外病毒水平，这与不依赖干扰素信号传导的抗病毒清除机制一致；而单核细胞则发挥适度、短暂性的抗病毒效应。综上，我们利用一个与人类相关的平台，明确了不同的固有免疫细胞如何在呼吸道上皮塑造黏膜免疫，这对抗病毒药物和疫苗的开发具有直接意义。图形摘要

abstract: Tumor heterogeneity presents a major clinical challenge. Reactivation of telomerase (hTERT) is a near-universal hallmark of cancer, yet direct inhibition of hTERT has shown limited therapeutic benefit. To uncover tractable telomerase-related vulnerabilities, we applied a synthetic dosage lethality (SDL) strategy to identify genes required only when hTERT is overexpressed. We performed genome-wide CRISPR/Cas9 and shRNA screens across multiple isogenic cell line pairs differing in hTERT expression. From these datasets, 100 high-confidence candidates were prioritized and validated using an arrayed in vitro CRISPR screen and a pooled in vivo CRISPR screen across diverse cancer models, non-malignant cells, and patient-derived organoids. Through this pipeline, we identified FTSJ3, an RNA 2'-O-methyltransferase, as a top SDL target of hTERT. Depletion of FTSJ3 selectively impaired the viability of hTERT-positive cancer cells while sparing normal cells. Mechanistically, FTSJ3 installs 2'-O-methylation on the telomeric RNA TERRA, a modification essential for TERRA stability and function. Loss of FTSJ3 destabilizes TERRA, disrupts recruitment of the histone methyltransferase SUV39H1, and diminishes H3K9 trimethylation and HP1 assembly at sub-telomeric regions. This breakdown of repressive telomeric chromatin leads to genome instability and apoptosis specifically in hTERT-positive cells. These findings highlight SDL as a powerful strategy for uncovering targetable vulnerabilities and establish FTSJ3 as a central regulator of heterochromatin stability in telomerase-active cancers. Targeting FTSJ3 enzymatic activity offers a promising therapeutic entry point, acting upstream of TERRA to eliminate telomerase-driven malignancies selectively.
abstractZh: 肿瘤异质性构成了重大的临床挑战。端粒酶（hTERT）的再激活是癌症近乎普遍的标志，然而直接抑制hTERT已显示出有限的治疗益处。为了揭示可操作的端粒酶相关脆弱性，我们应用了合成剂量致死（SDL）策略来识别仅在hTERT过表达时才需要的基因。我们在多个仅在hTERT表达上有所不同的同基因细胞系对中进行了全基因组CRISPR/Cas9和shRNA筛选。从这些数据集中，我们优先筛选出100个高置信度候选基因，并通过阵列式体外CRISPR筛选和汇集式体内CRISPR筛选在多种癌症模型、非恶性细胞和患者来源的类器官中进行了验证。通过这一流程，我们确定了FTSJ3（一种RNA 2'-O-甲基转移酶）作为hTERT的首要SDL靶点。FTSJ3的耗竭选择性地损害了hTERT阳性癌细胞的活力，同时不伤害正常细胞。机制上，FTSJ3在端粒RNA TERRA上安装2'-O-甲基化，这是TERRA稳定性和功能所必需的修饰。FTSJ3的缺失使TERRA不稳定，破坏了组蛋白甲基转移酶SUV39H1的招募，并减少了亚端粒区域的H3K9三甲基化和HP1组装。这种抑制性端粒染色质的崩溃导致基因组不稳定和细胞凋亡，特别是在hTERT阳性细胞中。这些发现强调了SDL作为揭示可靶向脆弱性的强大策略，并确立了FTSJ3作为端粒酶活性癌症中异染色质稳定性的核心调节因子。靶向FTSJ3酶活性提供了一个有前景的治疗切入点，在TERRA上游起作用，选择性地消除端粒酶驱动的恶性肿瘤。

abstract: Patient-derived organoids (PDOs) hold transformative potential for personalized medicine by recapitulating patient-specific drug responses. While Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) is ideal for monitoring these responses, its translation into high-throughput screening (HTS) is hindered by a segmentation accuracy-throughput bottleneck. Existing solutions fail to meet clinical demands: accurate 3D approaches are prohibitively slow, while emerging foundation models lack sensitivity to minute, low-contrast OCT targets. Conversely, fast 2D models suffer from background noise and unstable performance across varying scales. To bridge this gap, we propose DICE-2DSeg, a physics-informed, graph-enhanced framework. By synergizing OCT-inspired intra-slice coherent enhancement with graph-based inter-slice context aggregation, our method ensures robust quantification. Validated on 93 volumes across diverse cancer types and drugs, DICE-2DSeg demonstrates exceptional robustness. Specifically, our high-throughput variant achieves a 14-fold speedup over nnUNet3D while retaining 93.65% of its accuracy. Crucially, it exhibits superior multi-scale consistency, establishing a new state-of-the-art for challenging drug-responsive remnants (0-100 μm) while maintaining high fidelity for massive clusters (> 100 μm). By resolving the conflict between precision, scalability, and scale-invariance, DICE-2DSeg provides a technical enabling step for automated, large-scale PDO drug screening.
abstractZh: 患者来源的类器官（PDOs）通过重现患者特异性药物反应，在个性化医疗中具有变革性潜力。尽管光学相干断层扫描（OCT）是监测这些反应的理想工具，但其在高通量筛选（HTS）中的应用受到分割准确性与通量瓶颈的阻碍。现有解决方案无法满足临床需求：准确的3D方法速度过慢，而新兴的基础模型对微小、低对比度的OCT目标缺乏敏感性。相反，快速的2D模型则受背景噪声影响，且在不同尺度下性能不稳定。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了DICE-2DSeg，一种基于物理信息、图增强的框架。通过将OCT启发的切片内相干增强与基于图的切片间上下文聚合相结合，我们的方法确保了稳健的定量分析。在涵盖多种癌症类型和药物的93个体积数据上验证，DICE-2DSeg表现出卓越的稳健性。具体而言，我们的高通量变体相比nnUNet3D实现了14倍加速，同时保留了其93.65%的准确度。关键在于，它展现出优越的多尺度一致性，为具有挑战性的药物响应残留物（0-100 μm）确立了新的最先进水平，同时保持对大规模簇（>100 μm）的高保真度。通过解决精度、可扩展性和尺度不变性之间的冲突，DICE-2DSeg为自动化、大规模PDO药物筛选提供了技术上的关键推动步骤。

title: Lifespan Analysis of the Lung Epithelium Reveals Inflammatory Reprogramming and Regenerative Decline
titleZh: 肺上皮寿命分析揭示炎症重编程与再生能力下降
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Boosarpu G, Guenther EM, Steinchen C, Melo Narvaez MC, Barro C, Nazarli T, Müller A, Campi F, Bratzel FF, Twardowski L, Hu Q, Fousekis-Papakonstantinou E, Wasnick RM, Shams-Eldin H, Hilgendorff A, Jung AL, Yildirim AÖ, Piraud M, Schmeck B, Königshoff M, Stöger T, Alejandre Alcazar MA, Voss C, Lehmann M.
abstract: Aging is a major risk factor for chronic lung diseases, associated with chronic low-grade inflammation (inflammaging) and impaired epithelial regeneration. How epithelial-intrinsic aging intersects with inflammaging across the lifespan remains poorly understood. Here, we systematically analyzed lung epithelial cells from neonatal, young adult, and aged mice to define age-dependent changes in regenerative capacity. RNA sequencing revealed lifespan-associated shifts characterized by early repression of developmental and WNT/β-catenin programs and progressive activation of DNA damage, inflammation, and senescence signatures. Functionally, neonatal epithelial cells exhibited markedly enhanced organoid-forming capacity compared with young and aged cells. Aged organoids maintained a pro-inflammatory secretory profile indicative of cell-intrinsic inflammaging, and transfer of the aged secretome or TNF-α to young cultures significantly impaired regeneration. Comparison of freshly isolated cells and long-term organoid cultures revealed sustained repression of regenerative pathways with age, consistent with stable epigenetic imprinting. Pharmacological inhibition of DNA methylation and WNT signalling partially restored regenerative capacity in adult organoids. Together, these findings identify epigenetic reprogramming and epithelial-intrinsic inflammaging as key determinants of age-dependent regenerative decline.
abstractZh: 衰老是慢性肺病的主要风险因素，与慢性低度炎症（炎症性衰老）和上皮再生受损相关。上皮内在衰老如何与炎症性衰老在整个生命周期中相互作用仍知之甚少。在此，我们系统分析了新生、年轻成年和老年小鼠的肺上皮细胞，以定义再生能力随年龄变化的情况。RNA测序揭示了与寿命相关的转变，其特征是发育和WNT/β-catenin程序的早期抑制，以及DNA损伤、炎症和衰老标志物的渐进性激活。功能上，新生上皮细胞与年轻和老年细胞相比，表现出显著增强的类器官形成能力。老年类器官维持了促炎分泌谱，表明细胞内在的炎症性衰老，将老年分泌组或TNF-α转移到年轻培养物中显著损害了再生。对新鲜分离细胞和长期类器官培养物的比较显示，再生途径随年龄持续受到抑制，与稳定的表观遗传印记一致。药理学抑制DNA甲基化和WNT信号部分恢复了成年类器官的再生能力。总之，这些发现确定了表观遗传重编程和上皮内在炎症性衰老是年龄依赖性再生能力下降的关键决定因素。

title: D-alanine aminotransferase (Dat) promotes  Staphylococcus aureus  colonization fitness on human nasal respiratory epithelium
titleZh: D-丙氨酸氨基转移酶（Dat）促进金黄色葡萄球菌在人鼻呼吸道上皮上的定植适应性
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Boyd AI, Quintanilla KA, Escapa IF, Lewis MA, Kafer LA, Zeng X, Blutt SE, Ibberson CB, Lemon KP.
abstract:
ABSTRACT

  Nasal colonization by  Staphylococcus aureus is an established risk factor for invasive infection, yet bacterial determinants promoting fitness on human nasal mucosa remain incompletely defined. To identify genes required for early colonization of human nasal respiratory epithelium, we colonized human nasal epithelial organoids differentiated at air-liquid interface (HNO-ALI) with a high-density transposon (Tn) library of the methicillin-resistant USA300 strain LAC. TnSeq analysis identified 165 genes that met our threshold for candidate colonization fitness factors. Among these, genes involved in D-alanine biosynthesis and use were enriched, including two encoding the enzymes that separately synthesize D-alanine in  S. aureus : alanine racemase 1 (  alr1) and D-alanine aminotransferase (  dat) . Disruption of  dat reduced colonization fitness in competition with the parental strain by ≥ 1,000 fold across 4 different strains from clonal complexes 8, 5, and 30. In competition with the parental strain during HNO-ALI colonization, a  dat ::Tn mutant was 34-fold less fit than an  alr1 ::Tn mutant. Genetic complementation with single-copy  dat expressed from its native operon promoter restored parental colonization levels. Supplementation with exogenous D-alanine or L-alanine also rescued the  dat ::Tn colonization defect, whereas D-glutamate did not, consistent with Dat primarily producing D-alanine on nasal mucosa. Complementation with  dat under control of a putative 5’ intra-operon promoter substantially restored colonization but failed to support growth in chemically defined medium lacking L-alanine, suggesting a new layer of environment-specific regulation of  dat transcription. Together, these findings demonstrate that Dat is a major source of D-alanine during colonization of human nasal mucosa and is required for  S. aureus fitness in this environment.  AUTHOR SUMMARY

  Staphylococcus aureus is the second leading cause of death due to bacterial infection globally, and nasal colonization is a major risk factor for invasive disease. Using a physiologically relevant, host-derived model of human nasal respiratory epithelium (HNO-ALI) and TnSeq, we identified 165 candidate genes contributing to  S. aureus fitness during nasal mucosal colonization. We found that D-alanine aminotransferase (Dat) is the predominant source of D-alanine during nasal colonization, whereas alanine racemase (Alr1) predominates in rich medium, revealing an environment-specific hierarchy of D-alanine biosynthesis. Disruption of  dat caused a > 1,000-fold defect in colonization in competition with the parental strain across multiple  S. aureus clonal complexes, supporting a conserved role for  dat in nasal colonization fitness. Additionally, we provide evidence that  dat transcription from a previously cryptic promoter might be regulated by nasal mucosal conditions. Alr1 is proposed as an antimicrobial target in other bacterial pathogens; however, our data suggest that targeting Dat may be more effective for  S. aureus nasal decolonization.
abstractZh:
摘要

  金黄色葡萄球菌的鼻腔定植是侵袭性感染的一个既定风险因素，然而促进其在人鼻黏膜上适应性的细菌决定因素仍未完全明确。为了鉴定人鼻呼吸道上皮早期定植所需的基因，我们使用甲氧西林耐药USA300株LAC的高密度转座子（Tn）文库，定植了在气液界面分化的人鼻上皮类器官（HNO-ALI）。TnSeq分析鉴定出165个符合我们候选定植适应性因子阈值的基因。其中，参与D-丙氨酸生物合成和利用的基因富集，包括两个编码金黄色葡萄球菌中分别合成D-丙氨酸的酶的基因：丙氨酸消旋酶1（alr1）和D-丙氨酸氨基转移酶（dat）。在4种来自克隆复合体8、5和30的不同菌株中，dat的破坏在与亲本菌株竞争时使定植适应性降低≥1,000倍。在HNO-ALI定植过程中与亲本菌株竞争时，dat::Tn突变体的适应性比alr1::Tn突变体低34倍。用其天然操纵子启动子表达的单拷贝dat进行遗传互补，恢复了亲本定植水平。补充外源D-丙氨酸或L-丙氨酸也能挽救dat::Tn的定植缺陷，而D-谷氨酸则不能，这与Dat在鼻黏膜上主要产生D-丙氨酸一致。在推定的5'操纵子内启动子控制下进行dat互补，显著恢复了定植，但在缺乏L-丙氨酸的化学成分明确培养基中未能支持生长，提示dat转录存在新的环境特异性调控层面。总之，这些发现表明Dat是人鼻黏膜定植期间D-丙氨酸的主要来源，并且是金黄色葡萄球菌在该环境中适应性所必需的。

作者总结

  金黄色葡萄球菌是全球细菌感染致死的第二大原因，鼻腔定植是侵袭性疾病的主要风险因素。使用生理相关、宿主来源的人鼻呼吸道上皮模型（HNO-ALI）和TnSeq，我们鉴定出165个有助于金黄色葡萄球菌在鼻黏膜定植期间适应性的候选基因。我们发现D-丙氨酸氨基转移酶（Dat）是鼻腔定植期间D-丙氨酸的主要来源，而丙氨酸消旋酶（Alr1）在丰富培养基中占主导，揭示了D-丙氨酸生物合成的环境特异性层级。dat的破坏导致在多种金黄色葡萄球菌克隆复合体中与亲本菌株竞争时定植缺陷超过1,000倍，支持dat在鼻定植适应性中的保守作用。此外，我们提供了证据表明，dat从一个先前隐蔽的启动子的转录可能受鼻黏膜条件调控。Alr1被提议作为其他细菌病原体的抗菌靶点；然而，我们的数据表明，针对Dat可能对金黄色葡萄球菌鼻去定植更有效。

title: Multi-channel microfluidic chip with bilateral stripe for reconstruction of tissue barrier models in vitro.
titleZh: 具有双侧条纹的多通道微流控芯片用于体外组织屏障模型的重建。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Chong Z, Tang H, Zhang Y, Ouyang J, Zhu J, Chen Z, Liu X, Gu Z.
affiliations: State Key Laboratory of Bioelectronics, School of Biological Science and Medical Engineering, Southeast University, Nanjing 210096, People's Republic of China.
Institute of Microphysiological Systems, Southeast University, Nanjing 210096, People's Republic of China.

abstract: Organ-on-a-chip systems can replicate human physiological functionsin vitroby simulating the dynamicin vivomicroenvironment, therefore offering great potential for applications in drug screening, disease research, and personalized medicine. Multi-channel microfluidic chips are the core physical components of organ-on-a-chip systems, which often incorporate structures such as stripes, micro-pillars, and porous membranes to confine gels within specific channels, thereby providing a three-dimensional extracellular matrix environment for reconstruction of tissue barrier modelsin vitro. However, current multi-channel microfluidic chips confront challenges such as the unintended absorption of molecules, dependence on complex multi-material and multi-step fabrication processes, and instability in confining liquids. To address these challenges, we propose a multi-channel microfluidic chip with bilateral stripe structures, which can be mass-produced using single cyclic olefin copolymer material through injection molding. The bilateral stripe structures can effectively confine liquids with different wettabilities within the central channel by leveraging the edge effect. To demonstrate the versatility of the microfluidic platform, we successfully constructed tubular endothelial and renal tubule barriers on this chip, showcasing its potential for high-throughput, standardized organoid culture. This innovative microfluidic platform enables the construction of variousin vitroorgan models, offering a powerful tool for preclinical research and drug development.
abstractZh: 器官芯片系统可以通过模拟体内动态微环境来复制人体生理功能，因此在药物筛选、疾病研究和个性化医疗方面具有巨大潜力。多通道微流控芯片是器官芯片系统的核心物理组件，通常包含条纹、微柱和多孔膜等结构，以将凝胶限制在特定通道内，从而为体外组织屏障模型的重建提供三维细胞外基质环境。然而，当前的多通道微流控芯片面临着分子意外吸收、依赖复杂多材料和多步骤制造工艺以及液体限制不稳定的挑战。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种具有双侧条纹结构的多通道微流控芯片，该芯片可以使用单一环烯烃共聚物材料通过注塑成型进行批量生产。双侧条纹结构可以利用边缘效应有效地将不同润湿性的液体限制在中央通道内。为了展示该微流控平台的通用性，我们成功在该芯片上构建了管状内皮和肾小管屏障，展示了其在高通量、标准化类器官培养中的潜力。这种创新的微流控平台能够构建各种体外器官模型，为临床前研究和药物开发提供了强大的工具。

title: Spectroscopic correlation tomography (SpCT) for visualization of spatial correlations in volumetric OCT scans.
titleZh: 光谱相关断层成像（SpCT）用于体积OCT扫描中空间相关性的可视化。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: O'Kane EC, Highland RE, Thiriveedi V, Parker LE, Tata A, Tata PR, Karra R, Roper J, Miller DA, Wax A.

abstract: Spectroscopic optical coherence tomography (SOCT) allows for the targeted analysis of cell nuclei due to their spectrally distinct scattering properties. SOCT has been explored for optical biopsy based on its ability to extract structural and spectroscopic properties of a sample without the need for labels. Using the dual-window method for SOCT, spatial correlations can be computed throughout volumetric scans and analyzed to determine the size of cell nuclei. Such analysis could enable quantitative visualization of tissue boundaries that appear homogenous in structural OCT images. Here, we present spectroscopic correlation tomography (SpCT), a technique for mapping spatial correlation measurements to a hue-saturation-value (HSV) color space to help visualize relative changes in spatial correlation throughout volumetric OCT samples. SpCT B-Scans and volumes of polystyrene bead samples with diameters 5.1 μm to 11.3 μm were acquired and scatterer sizes were quantified using a Gaussian mixture model, achieving size estimates within half-wavelength accuracy. 3T3 fibroblasts were imaged and analyzed via connected component analysis, producing strong agreement with scatterer size measured via confocal microscopy, thus validating our approach. Histology versus SpCT B-Scan comparisons were performed for human colon organoids, cardiac organoids, and human lung airway explant to demonstrate this technique's ability to identify varying degrees of nuclear morphology in different regions. SpCT volumes were used to objectively discriminate between control and APC-mutated human colon organoids based on a connected component analysis, identifying regions of long spatial correlation and computing the coefficient of variation of the region volumes, which points to a potential clinical use of this technique.
abstractZh: 光谱光学相干断层成像（SOCT）能够针对细胞核进行靶向分析，这得益于其光谱上独特的散射特性。SOCT已被探索用于光学活检，因为它能够无需标记即可提取样品的结构和光谱特性。使用SOCT的双窗口方法，可以在体积扫描中计算空间相关性，并进行分析以确定细胞核的大小。这种分析能够实现组织边界的定量可视化，而这些边界在结构OCT图像中表现为均匀。在这里，我们提出了光谱相关断层成像（SpCT），一种将空间相关性测量映射到色调-饱和度-明度（HSV）颜色空间的技术，以帮助可视化整个体积OCT样品中空间相关性的相对变化。我们获取了直径为5.1 μm至11.3 μm的聚苯乙烯微珠样品的SpCT B扫描和体积图像，并使用高斯混合模型量化了散射体大小，实现了在半波长精度内的大小估计。对3T3成纤维细胞进行了成像，并通过连通成分分析进行分析，与共聚焦显微镜测量的散射体大小高度一致，从而验证了我们的方法。对人结肠类器官、心脏类器官和人肺气道外植体进行了组织学与SpCT B扫描的比较，以证明该技术在不同区域识别不同程度核形态的能力。SpCT体积被用于基于连通成分分析客观区分对照和APC突变的人结肠类器官，识别长空间相关性区域并计算区域体积的变异系数，这表明该技术具有潜在的临床应用价值。

title: HNF1B-related disease: developmental origins, molecular mechanisms, and multisystem clinical challenges.
titleZh: HNF1B相关疾病：发育起源、分子机制及多系统临床挑战。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Heneberg P.
affiliations: Third Faculty of Medicine, Charles University, Prague, Czech Republic.
abstract: Variants or deletions involving the HNF1B gene cause HNF1B-MODY. HNF1B-MODY represents a multisystem disorder extending far beyond its original classification as a monogenic form of diabetes. HNF1B's role in human development includes critical involvement in the organogenesis of the kidney, pancreas, liver, genitourinary tract, and nervous system. Approximately half of affected individuals carry large 17q12 deletions encompassing HNF1B and neighboring genes, correlating with broader syndromic features such as intellectual disability, autism spectrum traits, and psychiatric illness. The increasing availability of next-generation sequencing, coupled with copy number variant analysis, has improved diagnostic yield. Underdiagnosis remains common due to variable expressivity and phenotypic overlap with more prevalent disorders. Notable progress has been made in dissecting tissue-specific roles of HNF1B. Patient-derived iPSC models and single-cell transcriptomics offer new insights into early developmental pathways and transcriptional networks. These tools enable organoid-based studies and the potential discovery of therapeutics. Clinically, awareness of symptoms, such as renal cysts, persistent hypomagnesemia, pancreatic hypoplasia, and non-autoimmune diabetes, has led to the development of diagnostic scoring systems and multidisciplinary care algorithms. Although current treatment remains supportive, research into gene regulation, epigenetic modifiers, and pharmacologic rescue strategies is ongoing. HNF1B-related disease illustrates how pleiotropic gene dysfunction can present with diverse organ involvement. Integrating genomics, developmental biology, and targeted surveillance may help improve early diagnosis and patient outcomes.
abstractZh: 涉及HNF1B基因的变异或缺失导致HNF1B-MODY。HNF1B-MODY代表一种多系统疾病，远远超出其最初作为单基因糖尿病形式的分类。HNF1B在人类发育中的作用包括对肾脏、胰腺、肝脏、泌尿生殖道和神经系统的器官发生至关重要。大约一半的受累个体携带包含HNF1B及邻近基因的大段17q12缺失，这与更广泛的综合征特征相关，如智力障碍、自闭症谱系特征和精神疾病。下一代测序的可及性不断提高，加上拷贝数变异分析，提高了诊断率。由于表现度变异和与更常见疾病的表型重叠，漏诊仍然常见。在解析HNF1B的组织特异性作用方面取得了显著进展。患者来源的iPSC模型和单细胞转录组学为早期发育途径和转录网络提供了新的见解。这些工具使得基于类器官的研究和潜在治疗方法的发现成为可能。临床上，对症状的认识，如肾囊肿、持续性低镁血症、胰腺发育不全和非自身免疫性糖尿病，促进了诊断评分系统和多学科护理算法的发展。尽管目前的治疗仍是支持性的，但针对基因调控、表观遗传修饰剂和药理学拯救策略的研究正在进行中。HNF1B相关疾病说明了多效性基因功能障碍如何表现为多器官受累。整合基因组学、发育生物学和针对性监测可能有助于改善早期诊断和患者预后。

title: Engineering Lymphatic Vessels and Lymphoid Microenvironments In Vitro to Investigate Immune Cell Trafficking.
titleZh: 体外工程化淋巴管和淋巴微环境以研究免疫细胞运输。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Oh E, Esak Lee.
affiliations: Nancy E. and Peter C. Meinig School of Biomedical Engineering, Cornell University, Ithaca, New York, USA.
abstract: The lymphatic system is central to immune surveillance, coordinating antigen transport, and immune cell trafficking. While in vivo studies have revealed key aspects of lymphatic and lymph node biology, their complexity has motivated the development of in vitro platforms that enable controlled interrogation of specific immune processes. This review presents a tiered framework for organizing engineered lymphatic and lymph node models based on increasing architectural and functional complexity. Tier 1 models employ two-dimensional lymphatic endothelial monolayers to investigate immune cell docking, chemokine presentation, and junctional regulation. Tier 2 systems incorporate three-dimensional matrices and stromal organization to recreate lymphoid microenvironments, including lymph node scaffolds and immune organoids that support lymphocyte positioning and antigen handling under static conditions. Tier 3 platforms integrate microfluidic perfusion and compartmentalization to model lymphatic transport, flow-dependent endothelial behavior, and immune trafficking in dynamic lymphatic systems. Collectively, these models define the experimental landscape of in vitro lymphatic immunity.
abstractZh: 淋巴系统是免疫监视的核心，协调抗原运输和免疫细胞运输。虽然体内研究揭示了淋巴管和淋巴结生物学的关键方面，但其复杂性推动了体外平台的发展，这些平台能够对特定免疫过程进行受控探究。本综述提出了一个分层框架，用于根据结构和功能复杂性的递增来组织工程化淋巴管和淋巴结模型。第1层模型采用二维淋巴内皮单层来研究免疫细胞对接、趋化因子呈递和连接调控。第2层系统结合三维基质和基质细胞组织来重建淋巴微环境，包括淋巴结支架和免疫类器官，这些在静态条件下支持淋巴细胞定位和抗原处理。第3层平台整合微流体灌注和区室化，以模拟动态淋巴系统中的淋巴运输、血流依赖性内皮行为和免疫运输。总的来说，这些模型界定了体外淋巴免疫的实验格局。

title: Bridging Preclinical and Clinical Gaps in Ocular Therapeutics: Hydrogel Drug Delivery and 3D Tissue Models.
titleZh: 弥合眼科治疗学中的临床前与临床差距：水凝胶药物递送与3D组织模型。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Barar J, Aliakbari A, Omidi Y.
affiliations: Department of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Barry and Judy Silverman College of Pharmacy, Nova Southeastern University, Fort Lauderdale, FL, 33328, USA.
abstract: Affecting over 2.2 billion people globally, ocular diseases represent a profound public health challenge, with vision loss projected to increase by 55% by 2050. Ocular drug delivery is fundamentally constrained by the eye's anatomical and physiological barriers, limiting bioavailability and necessitating repeated invasive administration. Hydrogel-based drug delivery systems (DDSs) have emerged as transformative platforms offering controlled drug release, mucoadhesive precorneal retention, and stimulus-responsive phase transitions for anterior and posterior segment diseases. Formulated from natural biopolymers (e.g., hyaluronic acid, chitosan, gelatin, and alginate) and synthetic platforms (e.g., thermosensitive poloxamers, pH-responsive carbomers, and photo-crosslinked polyethylene glycol systems), these networks sustain therapeutic concentrations while reducing the burden of invasive procedures. Despite these advances, clinical translation remains critically impeded by the limited predictive capacity of conventional two-dimensional cell cultures and animal models, which fail to replicate human ocular tissue architecture, barrier integrity, and disease pathophysiology. Three-dimensional (3D) ocular organoids (e.g., corneal epithelial, lens, lacrimal gland, and retinal constructs derived from patient-specific induced pluripotent stem cells) alongside eye-on-a-chip microfluidic platforms provide human-relevant microphysiological systems for evaluating hydrogel performance, drug transport, efficacy, and biocompatibility under normal conditions. Critically, the integration of hydrogel-based DDSs with advanced 3D tissue models offers a transformative strategy to bridge the persistent preclinical-to-clinical translation gap in ocular therapeutics. Herein, we critically appraise the current landscape of hydrogel-based ocular DDSs and their integration with 3D organoid and organ-on-chip platforms, identifying key opportunities and barriers along the translational pathway toward next-generation therapeutics for vision-threatening ocular diseases.
abstractZh: 全球超过22亿人受眼病影响，眼病构成了一个深刻的公共卫生挑战，预计到2050年视力丧失将增加55%。眼部药物递送从根本上受到眼睛解剖和生理屏障的限制，导致生物利用度降低，并需要反复的侵入性给药。基于水凝胶的药物递送系统（DDSs）已成为变革性平台，为前段和后段疾病提供受控药物释放、黏附性角膜前滞留和刺激响应性相变。这些网络由天然生物聚合物（如透明质酸、壳聚糖、明胶和海藻酸盐）和合成平台（如热敏性泊洛沙姆、pH响应性卡波姆和光交联聚乙二醇系统）配制而成，能够维持治疗浓度，同时减少侵入性操作的负担。尽管取得了这些进展，临床转化仍受到传统二维细胞培养和动物模型预测能力有限的严重阻碍，这些模型无法复制人类眼部组织架构、屏障完整性和疾病病理生理学。三维（3D）眼部类器官（例如，源自患者特异性诱导多能干细胞衍生的角膜上皮、晶状体、泪腺和视网膜构建体）以及芯片上的眼睛微流控平台，提供了与人类相关的微生理系统，用于在正常条件下评估水凝胶性能、药物转运、疗效和生物相容性。关键的是，基于水凝胶的DDSs与先进3D组织模型的整合，为弥合眼科治疗学中持续存在的临床前到临床转化差距提供了一种变革性策略。在此，我们批判性地评估了基于水凝胶的眼部DDSs及其与3D类器官和器官芯片平台整合的当前格局，确定了通往下一代治疗威胁视力的眼部疾病的转化途径中的关键机遇和障碍。

abstract: Gastric cancer (GC) is an important malignancy worldwide and remains a significant cause for cancer-related mortality globally. Drug repositioning provides opportunities for drug development to reduce the cost and time inherent in the original drug development process and the risk of depletion. Bioinformatics analysis revealed that the protein and mRNA expression level of cyclin dependent kinase 4 (CDK4) in patients' tissues of gastric cancer was significantly higher than that in normal tissues. Present study found that the docking score of CDK4 protein with perphenazine was best determined through virtual screening of CDK4 protein and 511 drugs. Perphenazine inhibited the proliferation of tumor in mouse-derived tumor model, induced the death of human gastric cancer organoids. Perphenazine showed good inhibitory effect in gastric cancer AGS and HGC27 cells, with IC50 of AGS and HGC27 cells reaching 6.60 ± 0.34 μM and 12.25 ± 1.44 μM. Perphenazine inhibited colony formation, proliferation and migration of AGS and HGC27 cells. Moreover, perphenazine induced cells apoptosis by mitochondrial dysfunction of gastric cancer AGS and HGC27 cells. Besides, AGS and HGC27 cells at the G0/G1 phase were arrested after treatment of perphenazine. Palbociclib significantly enhanced this effect, while INK4C-IN-2 significantly reversed this blocking effect. In summary, we found a novel anti-tumor indication of antipsychotic drug perphenazine, which can inhibit the growth of tumor in vitro and in mouse-derived tumor model. These results suggested that perphenazine is also a promising anti-gastric cancer drug in clinical applications.
abstractZh: 胃癌（GC）是全球重要的恶性肿瘤，并且仍然是全球癌症相关死亡的重要原因。药物再利用为药物开发提供了机会，以降低原始药物开发过程中固有的成本和时间以及耗竭风险。生物信息学分析显示，胃癌患者组织中细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶4（CDK4）的蛋白质和mRNA表达水平显著高于正常组织。本研究发现，通过CDK4蛋白与511种药物的虚拟筛选，CDK4蛋白与奋乃静的对接得分最佳。奋乃静抑制了小鼠来源肿瘤模型中的肿瘤增殖，诱导了人胃癌类器官的死亡。奋乃静在胃癌AGS和HGC27细胞中显示出良好的抑制作用，AGS和HGC27细胞的IC50分别达到6.60±0.34 μM和12.25±1.44 μM。奋乃静抑制了AGS和HGC27细胞的集落形成、增殖和迁移。此外，奋乃静通过线粒体功能障碍诱导胃癌AGS和HGC27细胞凋亡。此外，经奋乃静处理后，AGS和HGC27细胞被阻滞在G0/G1期。帕博西尼显著增强了这种效应，而INK4C-IN-2显著逆转了这种阻滞效应。总之，我们发现抗精神病药物奋乃静的一种新的抗肿瘤适应症，它可以在体外和小鼠来源的肿瘤模型中抑制肿瘤生长。这些结果表明，奋乃静在临床应用中也是一种有前景的抗胃癌药物。

abstract:
Background

Articular cartilage injuries exhibit limited self-repair capacity due to avascularity and other intrinsic properties, leading to high disability rates and posing clinical challenges. In recent years, cartilaginous organoids (CORGs) have emerged as a promising tissue engineering strategy, offering new hope for cartilage regeneration and repair. However, biomaterials used in constructing CORGs still face challenges such as immunogenicity and biocompatibility during clinical translation. In particular, xenogeneic biomaterials, which contain natural antigens like the α-1,3-galactose (α-Gal) epitope, are prone to trigger severe host immune rejection. Gene editing technology, especially knocking out the gene encoding α-1,3-galactosyltransferase (GGTA1), holds promise for producing low-immunogenicity donor animals, such as α-Gal knockout pigs (α-Gal KO pigs).Main body

In this study, through in vitro and in vivo experiments, a humanized mouse subcutaneous implantation model was established to verify the low immunogenicity of cartilage tissues from α-Gal KO pigs. Subsequently, cartilage-derived particles (CDPs) were prepared from α-Gal KO pig cartilage and further used to construct CORGs. Finally, the ability of these CORGs to form new cartilaginous tissue ectopically was validated in a nude mouse subcutaneous model.Conclusions

This study explores the low immunogenicity of gene-edited porcine cartilage tissue and constructs a novel xenogeneic dECM-based cartilage organoid with ectopic chondrogenic capability. This approach is expected to overcome immune rejection barriers and pave a novel strategic avenue for the clinical translation of cartilage organoids.
abstractZh:
背景

关节软骨损伤由于无血管分布及其他内在特性，自我修复能力有限，导致高致残率，构成临床挑战。近年来，软骨类器官（CORGs）作为一种有前景的组织工程策略出现，为软骨再生与修复带来新希望。然而，用于构建CORGs的生物材料在临床转化中仍面临免疫原性和生物相容性等挑战。特别是异种生物材料，含有如α-1,3-半乳糖（α-Gal）表位等天然抗原，容易引发宿主严重的免疫排斥反应。基因编辑技术，尤其是敲除编码α-1,3-半乳糖基转移酶（GGTA1）的基因，有望产生低免疫原性的供体动物，如α-Gal基因敲除猪（α-Gal KO猪）。主体

在本研究中，通过体外和体内实验，建立了人源化小鼠皮下植入模型，以验证α-Gal KO猪软骨组织的低免疫原性。随后，从α-Gal KO猪软骨制备软骨来源颗粒（CDPs），并进一步用于构建CORGs。最后，在裸鼠皮下模型中验证了这些CORGs异位形成新生软骨组织的能力。结论

本研究探讨了基因编辑猪软骨组织的低免疫原性，并构建了一种基于异种脱细胞外基质（dECM）的新型软骨类器官，具有异位软骨形成能力。该方法有望克服免疫排斥屏障，为软骨类器官的临床转化开辟新的策略途径。

abstract: Patterning of the neural tube establishes midbrain and hindbrain structures that coordinate motor movement, process sensory input and integrate cognitive functions. Cellular impairment within these structures underlies diverse neurological disorders, and in vitro organoid models promise inroads to understanding development and modeling disease. Here, we use paired single-cell transcriptome and accessible chromatin sequencing to map cell composition and regulatory mechanisms in organoid models of midbrain and hindbrain. We find that existing midbrain organoid protocols generate ventral and dorsal cell types, covering regions including floor plate, dorsal and ventral midbrain and adjacent hindbrain regions. Gene regulatory network inference and transcription factor perturbation resolve mechanisms underlying neuronal differentiation. A single-cell multiplexed patterning screen identifies morphogen concentrations that expand existing organoid models, including conditions generating medulla glycinergic neurons and cerebellum glutamatergic subtypes. Together, the multi-omic atlas and morphogen screen reveal morphogen-regulon relationships guiding region-specific progenitor differentiation towards diverse neuron types of the posterior brain.
abstractZh: 神经管的分化建立了中脑和后脑结构，这些结构协调运动、处理感觉输入并整合认知功能。这些结构内的细胞损伤是多种神经系统疾病的基础，体外类器官模型有望为理解发育和疾病建模提供途径。在此，我们使用配对的单细胞转录组和可及染色质测序来绘制中脑和后脑类器官模型中的细胞组成和调控机制。我们发现现有的中脑类器官方案能产生腹侧和背侧细胞类型，覆盖区域包括底板、中脑背侧和腹侧以及邻近的后脑区域。基因调控网络推断和转录因子扰动解析了神经元分化背后的机制。单细胞多重模式化筛选确定了形态发生素浓度，这些浓度扩展了现有的类器官模型，包括产生延髓甘氨酸能神经元和小脑谷氨酸能亚型的条件。总之，多组学图谱和形态发生素筛选揭示了形态发生素-调节子关系，指导区域特异性祖细胞分化朝向大脑后部的多种神经元类型。

abstract: Traditional models used to study lymphoid malignancies, such as 2D cell cultures and murine systems, have significantly advanced our understanding of tumour biology and drug development. However, their limited capacity to recapitulate the tumour microenvironment and 3D anatomical structure restricts their translational relevance. In response to these challenges, three-dimensional (3D) culture systems have recently emerged as promising platforms to more accurately replicate the architecture and biological complexity of lymphoid tissues. A variety of 3D models have been developed, ranging from simple spheroids to advanced organ-on-chip technologies that allow for continuous perfusion and precise modulation of microenvironmental parameters. Current optimisation efforts aim to enhance these systems' ability to sustain lymphoma cell viability and mimic key in vivo features such as stromal integration, spatial organisation, and biomechanical cues. This review provides an overview of the current 3D models used to investigate mature lymphoid malignancies, with a particular focus on chronic lymphocytic leukaemia and lymphomas. We discuss their relevance, strengths, and limitations, especially in the context of therapeutic screening and the advancement of personalised treatment approaches.
abstractZh: 用于研究淋巴恶性肿瘤的传统模型，如二维细胞培养和小鼠系统，显著推进了我们对肿瘤生物学和药物开发的理解。然而，它们有限的重现肿瘤微环境和三维解剖结构的能力限制了其转化相关性。为应对这些挑战，三维（3D）培养系统近期作为有前景的平台出现，能更准确地复制淋巴组织的结构和生物学复杂性。已开发出多种3D模型，从简单的球体到先进的器官芯片技术，后者允许连续灌注和对微环境参数的精确调节。当前的优化工作旨在增强这些系统维持淋巴瘤细胞活力并模拟体内关键特征（如基质整合、空间组织和生物力学线索）的能力。本综述概述了当前用于研究成熟淋巴恶性肿瘤的3D模型，特别关注慢性淋巴细胞白血病和淋巴瘤。我们讨论了它们的相关性、优势和局限性，尤其是在治疗筛选和个性化治疗方法推进的背景下。

abstract: Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatohepatitis (MASH) is a severe form of Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease (MASLD), traditionally diagnosed via invasive biopsy, underscoring the need for non-invasive alternatives. This study identifies biologically relevant extracellular vesicle (EV) protein signatures associated with MASH using patient serum, primary human hepatocytes (PHH), and human liver organoids (HLO). These complementary models capture distinct aspects of disease progression-circulating EV profiles in patients, hepatic cellular responses in PHH, and multicellular interactions in HLO-providing a comprehensive view of MASH pathophysiology. Using aptamer-based technology, we assayed 6596 proteins from 38 individuals with histological confirmed MASLD and in vitro models. EVs were characterized using nano-flow cytometry, ExoView, and high-resolution microscopy (ONI), with liver-specific markers confirming their origin. Key proteins, including SLC27A5, HP, and CXCL7, were elevated in patient samples, while PHH and HLO models exhibited upregulation of ASGPR1, HP, and CXCL7 under MASH conditions. Proteomic analysis revealed shared pathways across models, with machine learning models achieving AUROC values of 0.97, supporting the diagnostic potential of these protein signatures. This integrative approach advances MASH biomarker discovery by linking localized liver dysfunction with systemic disease mechanisms. These findings highlight clinically relevant EV protein signatures that support the development of non-invasive diagnostics and personalized treatment strategies, including prediction of outcomes for bariatric surgery patients.
abstractZh: 代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝炎（MASH）是代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病（MASLD）的一种严重形式，传统上通过侵入性活检诊断，这凸显了对非侵入性替代方法的需求。本研究利用患者血清、原代人肝细胞（PHH）和人肝类器官（HLO），识别了与MASH相关的生物学相关细胞外囊泡（EV）蛋白特征。这些互补模型捕捉了疾病进展的不同方面——患者循环EV谱、PHH中的肝细胞反应以及HLO中的多细胞相互作用——提供了MASH病理生理学的全面视图。使用基于适配体的技术，我们检测了38名经组织学确诊的MASLD个体和体外模型中的6596种蛋白质。通过纳米流式细胞术、ExoView和高分辨率显微镜（ONI）对EV进行了表征，肝脏特异性标记物确认了其来源。关键蛋白，包括SLC27A5、HP和CXCL7，在患者样本中升高，而PHH和HLO模型在MASH条件下表现出ASGPR1、HP和CXCL7的上调。蛋白质组学分析揭示了各模型共有的通路，机器学习模型实现了0.97的AUROC值，支持了这些蛋白质特征的诊断潜力。这种整合方法通过将局部肝功能障碍与全身性疾病机制联系起来，推进了MASH生物标志物的发现。这些发现突出了临床相关的EV蛋白特征，支持非侵入性诊断和个性化治疗策略的开发，包括对减重手术患者结局的预测。

abstract:
Background

While chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cells have achieved encouraging remission rates in hematological malignancies, they have demonstrated limited success in treating glioblastoma (GBM), particularly due to high intratumoral and intertumorous heterogeneity. In this study, we identified a consistently expressed target antigen, podoplanin (PDPN), and evaluated the potential of a PDPN-CAR T cell and GD2-CAR T cell blend to target heterogeneous GBM.Methods

Target antigen screening included clinical samples, cell lines and healthy tissues, as well as public RNA sequencing datasets. The anti-tumor function of CAR T cells was examined in co-culture experiments with GBM cell lines and patient-derived organoids (PDOs), and in vivo after locoregional delivery in orthotopic xenograft models.Results

CAR T cells demonstrated strong anti-tumor activity against several cell lines and PDOs from multiple patients. PDPN and GD2 were expressed in all PDOs, and regardless of the antigen expression pattern, the CAR T cell blend induced significantly higher apoptosis levels in organoids compared with single-antigen targeting CAR T cells. In vivo, we observed efficient tumor regression after locoregional administration of monospecific CAR T cells. While heterogeneous orthotopic tumors eventually relapsed in these groups, therapy with the CAR T cell blend significantly increased overall survival and even achieved a cure in the majority of mice.Conclusion

This novel PDPN/GD2 CAR T cell blend demonstrated robust efficacy in advanced preclinical GBM models, suggesting its potential to treat heterogeneous GBM and address limitations associated with single-antigen CAR T cell therapies.
abstractZh:
背景

虽然嵌合抗原受体（CAR）T细胞在血液系统恶性肿瘤中取得了令人鼓舞的缓解率，但在治疗胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）方面，其成功有限，尤其是由于肿瘤内和肿瘤间的异质性高。在本研究中，我们确定了一个持续表达的靶抗原——平足蛋白（PDPN），并评估了PDPN-CAR T细胞和GD2-CAR T细胞混合物靶向异质性GBM的潜力。方法

靶抗原筛选包括临床样本、细胞系和健康组织，以及公共RNA测序数据集。通过GBM细胞系和患者来源类器官（PDOs）的共培养实验，以及在原位异种移植模型中局部递送后的体内实验，检测了CAR T细胞的抗肿瘤功能。结果

CAR T细胞对多种细胞系和来自多名患者的PDOs表现出强烈的抗肿瘤活性。PDPN和GD2在所有PDOs中均有表达，且无论抗原表达模式如何，CAR T细胞混合物在类器官中诱导的凋亡水平均显著高于单抗原靶向的CAR T细胞。在体内，我们观察到局部给予单特异性CAR T细胞后肿瘤有效消退。虽然这些组中的异质性原位肿瘤最终复发，但使用CAR T细胞混合物治疗显著提高了总生存率，甚至在大多数小鼠中实现了治愈。结论

这种新型PDPN/GD2 CAR T细胞混合物在晚期临床前GBM模型中显示出强大的疗效，表明其具有治疗异质性GBM并解决单抗原CAR T细胞疗法相关局限性的潜力。

abstract: Cholangiocarcinoma (CCA) is an adenocarcinoma of the hepatobiliary system that has recently risen in incidence and mortality with unsatisfactory treatment options. Claudin-1 (CLDN1) is a transmembrane protein expressed in tight junctions and exposed on the cell surface in liver fibrosis and cancer. Using single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) and spatial transcriptomics of tissues of patients with CCA, we show that CLDN1 expression is up-regulated in cancer cells and is associated with stemness and cell fate. Genetic gain-of-function studies in CCA orthotopic in vivo mouse models showed decreased survival and enhanced tumor growth, unraveling a functional role of CLDN1 as an oncogenic driver. Targeting exposed nonjunctional CLDN1 using highly specific CLDN1 monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) inhibited tumor growth across CCA CDX and PDX mouse models and patient-derived CCA organoids, including tumors with medium or low CLDN1 expression. Moreover, antibody treatment inhibited tumor cell migration, invasion, and extrahepatic metastasis. Mechanistically, targeting exposed cell surface CLDN1 on CCA tumors using mAbs inhibited Notch1 and TROP2/STAT3 signaling pathways, resulting in decreased cancer cell stemness and epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition. Loss-of-function studies using CRISPR-Cas9 and RNAi combined with rescue and confocal imaging studies confirmed the functional and mechanistic role of these pathways. In conclusion, these results uncover CLDN1 as a previously undiscovered CCA driver and therapeutic target, paving the way for the clinical development of CLDN1 mAbs to improve the dismal outcome of patients with advanced CCA.
abstractZh: 胆管癌（CCA）是肝胆系统的一种腺癌，近年来发病率和死亡率上升，且治疗方案不尽人意。Claudin-1（CLDN1）是一种跨膜蛋白，在紧密连接中表达，并在肝纤维化和癌症中暴露于细胞表面。通过对CCA患者组织的单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）和空间转录组学分析，我们发现CLDN1在癌细胞中表达上调，并与干性和细胞命运相关。在CCA原位体内小鼠模型中的遗传功能获得研究表明，生存期缩短且肿瘤生长增强，揭示了CLDN1作为致癌驱动因子的功能作用。使用高度特异性的CLDN1单克隆抗体（mAbs）靶向暴露的非连接性CLDN1，在CCA CDX和PDX小鼠模型以及患者来源的CCA类器官中抑制了肿瘤生长，包括中低CLDN1表达的肿瘤。此外，抗体治疗抑制了肿瘤细胞迁移、侵袭和肝外转移。机制上，使用mAbs靶向CCA肿瘤上暴露的细胞表面CLDN1抑制了Notch1和TROP2/STAT3信号通路，导致癌细胞干性和上皮-间质转化降低。使用CRISPR-Cas9和RNAi进行的功能丧失研究，结合挽救和共聚焦成像研究，确认了这些通路的功能和机制作用。总之，这些结果揭示了CLDN1作为先前未发现的CCA驱动因子和治疗靶点，为CLDN1 mAbs的临床开发铺平了道路，以改善晚期CCA患者的不良预后。

title: ViTAMIn-O: Democratizing computer vision-based machine learning for stem cell research
titleZh: ViTAMIn-O：将基于计算机视觉的机器学习民主化应用于干细胞研究
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Hamurcu F, Breunig M, Varga A, Bosch B, Lindenmayer J, Kanakappady AT, Achberger K, Pashkovskaia N, Kleger A, Liebau S, Klingenstein S, Klingenstein M.
abstract:
ABSTRACT

  Deep Learning (DL) holds exciting potential in automating the prediction of organoid differentiation results. Nevertheless, current models lack adaptability, openness, and robustness in performance. Additionally, broad employments of predictive models in wet-lab settings necessitate machine learning expertise, often not readily available in biologically oriented laboratories. To offer an intuitive solution, we present ColabViTAMIn-O, a code-free platform together with ViTAMIn-O. ViTAMIn-O is a fully open organoid-specific DL model trained and tested on a total of 34 organoid categories, incorporating annotated images across transmitted light microscopy (TLM) modalities at single-organoid resolution. It is adaptable to downstream prediction tasks of varying dataset sizes and outperforms established models even with linear-probing. It performs reliably within a few-shot framework and is even extensible to human embryo TLM imaging data at single specimen level. By releasing our platform, centralized model hub, and datasets, we hope to encourage broader deployments of specialized DL models in stem-cell laboratories.
abstractZh:
摘要

  深度学习（DL）在自动化预测类器官分化结果方面具有令人兴奋的潜力。然而，当前模型在适应性、开放性和性能稳健性方面存在不足。此外，预测模型在湿实验室环境中的广泛使用需要机器学习专业知识，而这在生物学导向的实验室中通常并不容易获得。为了提供一种直观的解决方案，我们提出了ColabViTAMIn-O，一个无代码平台，以及ViTAMIn-O。ViTAMIn-O是一个完全开放的类器官特异性深度学习模型，在总共34种类器官类别上进行了训练和测试，包含了透射光显微镜（TLM）模态下单类器官分辨率的注释图像。它适用于不同数据集大小的下游预测任务，并且即使在线性探测下也优于已建立的模型。它在少样本框架内表现可靠，甚至可以扩展到单标本水平的人类胚胎TLM成像数据。通过发布我们的平台、集中式模型中心和数据集，我们希望鼓励干细胞实验室更广泛地部署专门的深度学习模型。

title: Protein-state dysregulation and sex-specific neurodevelopmental signatures in schizophrenia forebrain organoids
titleZh: 精神分裂症前脑类器官中的蛋白质状态失调与性别特异性神经发育特征
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Bogetofte H, Schmidt SI, Sejberg Øhlenschlæger M, Elmkvist SB, Jensen P, Mohamed FA, Mikkelsen AW, Bayram E, Havelund JF, Ryding M, Criscuolo L, Jakobsen LA, Nawrocki A, Robinson P, Lancaster M, Brewer J, Færgeman NJ, Benros ME, Freude K, Larsen MR.
abstract: Schizophrenia is highly heritable, yet the molecular mechanisms linking genetic risk to abnormal human brain development remain poorly understood. To address this, we generated dorsal forebrain organoids from 17 individuals with idiopathic schizophrenia and 17 age- and sex-matched controls and profiled them across multiple molecular layers, including single-nucleus transcriptomics, quantitative proteomics, metabolomics and deep post-translational modification (PTM) analysis. The organoids reproducibly modelled early cortical development and showed largely similar cellular composition between schizophrenia and control groups. Surprisingly, transcriptomic differences were relatively limited, with the strongest cell-type-specific changes observed in Cajal–Retzius neurons. In contrast, proteomic and particularly PTM-level analyses revealed widespread molecular disruption affecting pathways involved in neuronal migration, neurite development, synaptic function, protein kinase signalling, extracellular matrix organisation and lipid metabolism. Many of the earliest disease-associated changes emerged at the level of protein phosphorylation, consistent with altered neuronal maturation and neurite dynamics. At later developmental stages, schizophrenia organoids showed reduced abundance of synaptic proteins, fewer synaptic puncta and evidence of dysregulated retinoic acid and YAP1 signalling. Notably, most disease-associated alterations occurred independently of changes in transcript or protein abundance, indicating that key aspects of schizophrenia biology are encoded in protein state rather than expression level. These findings identify sex-specific dysregulation of protein state as a major molecular feature of schizophrenia and demonstrate the value of multi-layer proteomic approaches for uncovering disease mechanisms missed by transcriptomics alone.
abstractZh: 精神分裂症具有高度遗传性，然而将遗传风险与异常人脑发育联系起来的分子机制仍知之甚少。为此，我们从17名特发性精神分裂症个体和17名年龄和性别匹配的对照者中生成了背侧前脑类器官，并在多个分子层面进行了分析，包括单核转录组学、定量蛋白质组学、代谢组学和深度翻译后修饰（PTM）分析。这些类器官可重复地模拟了早期皮层发育，并且在精神分裂症组和对照组之间显示出大体相似的细胞组成。令人惊讶的是，转录组差异相对有限，最强的细胞类型特异性变化出现在Cajal–Retzius神经元中。相比之下，蛋白质组学尤其是PTM水平的分析揭示了广泛的分子紊乱，影响涉及神经元迁移、神经突发育、突触功能、蛋白激酶信号传导、细胞外基质组织和脂质代谢的通路。许多最早的疾病相关变化出现在蛋白质磷酸化水平，这与神经元成熟和神经突动力学改变一致。在后期发育阶段，精神分裂症类器官显示出突触蛋白丰度降低、突触斑点减少，以及维甲酸和YAP1信号传导失调的证据。值得注意的是，大多数疾病相关改变独立于转录本或蛋白质丰度的变化而发生，表明精神分裂症生物学的关键方面编码在蛋白质状态而非表达水平中。这些发现确定了蛋白质状态的性别特异性失调是精神分裂症的一个主要分子特征，并证明了多层蛋白质组学方法在发现仅靠转录组学无法发现的疾病机制方面的价值。

title: Patient-Derived Air-Liquid Interface Forebrain Organoids Reveal Functional Synaptic Deficits in Schizophrenia
titleZh: 患者来源的气-液界面前脑类器官揭示精神分裂症的功能性突触缺陷
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Criscuolo L, Jensen P, Bogetofte H, Schmidt SI, Mohamed FA, Jakobsen LA, Øhlenschlæger MS, Frederiksen HRS, Li F, Bayram E, Benros ME, Brewer J, Lind BL, Robinson PJ, Freude K, Larsen MR.
abstract: Schizophrenia (SCZ) is a severe and debilitating neurodevelopmental disorder with lifelong impact on everyday life. Disruptions in synapse functions play a key role in its complex and poorly understood etiological and pathological mechanisms. Here, we investigated both the molecular composition and the spontaneous and stimulated functional properties of synapses in neural organoids from SCZ individuals. Air-liquid interface forebrain organoids (ALI-FOs) were generated from induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) derived from three individuals with SCZ and three healthy controls. At day 170 synaptosomes were enriched and analyzed by data-independent acquisition mass spectrometry to profile the proteome, alongside with TMT-labeled phosphoproteomics both before and after acute KCl-induced depolarization. In parallel, we characterized the PTMome of the surrounding cellular environment, comprising phosphorylation, peptides with free and reversibly modified cysteines, and sialylated N-linked glycopeptides. Functional glutamatergic and GABAergic activity was assessed using calcium imaging to capture spontaneous neuronal signaling. Both conditions exhibited mature synaptic structures, while growth cones were observed only in SCZ-derived ALI-FOs, indicative of ongoing or delayed synaptogenesis. Proteomic analysis of synaptosome preparations revealed 358 differentially regulated proteins between SCZ and controls and 125 phophoproteins with altered phosphorylation, which clustered into three major categories: (1) synaptogenesis and synapse signaling; (2) cytoskeleton and cell junctions; (3) growth cone dynamics and neurite outgrowth. Analysis of the PTMs in the surrounding cellular environment revealed regulation of key regulatory mechanisms in 526 proteins, supporting the synaptic alterations observed. Notably, components of the Wnt signaling pathway were consistently dysregulated across both the synaptosome preparation and the PTMome in SCZ-derived ALIFOs as compared to controls. Depolarization-induced phospho-signaling revealed SCZ-specific response enriched in synaptic vesicle trafficking pathways. Together, these findings provide new insights into early synaptic alterations in SCZ, highlighting changes not only in protein composition, but more in protein regulatory mechanisms underlying synaptic signaling.
abstractZh: 精神分裂症（SCZ）是一种严重且使人衰弱的神经发育障碍，对日常生活产生终身影响。突触功能的破坏在其复杂且了解甚少的病因和病理机制中起着关键作用。在此，我们研究了来自SCZ个体的神经类器官中突触的分子组成以及自发和刺激的功能特性。气-液界面前脑类器官（ALI-FOs）由来自三名SCZ个体和三名健康对照的诱导多能干细胞（iPSCs）生成。在第170天，富集突触体并通过数据非依赖性采集质谱分析蛋白质组，同时使用TMT标记的磷酸化蛋白质组学在急性KCl诱导去极化前后进行分析。与此同时，我们表征了周围细胞环境的PTM组，包括磷酸化、具有游离和可逆修饰半胱氨酸的肽以及唾液酸化的N-连接糖肽。使用钙成像评估功能性谷氨酸能和GABA能活性，以捕获自发的神经元信号。两种条件均表现出成熟的突触结构，而仅在SCZ来源的ALI-FOs中观察到生长锥，表明突触发生正在进行或延迟。突触体制备的蛋白质组学分析揭示了SCZ与对照之间358个差异调节蛋白和125个磷酸化改变蛋白，这些蛋白聚为三大类：（1）突触发生和突触信号传导；（2）细胞骨架和细胞连接；（3）生长锥动力学和神经突生长。对周围细胞环境中PTM的分析揭示了526个蛋白中关键调节机制的调节，支持观察到的突触改变。值得注意的是，与对照相比，在SCZ来源的ALI-FOs中，Wnt信号通路组分在突触体制备和PTM组中均持续失调。去极化诱导的磷酸化信号揭示了SCZ特异性反应，富集于突触囊泡运输通路。总之，这些发现为SCZ中早期突触改变提供了新见解，强调了不仅蛋白质组成的变化，更重要的是蛋白质调节机制的变化，这些机制是突触信号传导的基础。

title: THBS4 promotes hair regeneration by inducing dermal mechanical niche adaptation
titleZh: THBS4通过诱导真皮力学微环境适应促进毛发再生
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Lei M, Zhao Y, Wang M, Xiong N, Liu Y, Xie T, Shao S, Li Z, Li T, Zou Y, Ma R, Tang Y, Wu W, Xie Q, Xiang X, Gao X, Cao L.
abstract: Abstract  The mechanisms by which fibroblast-generated biomechanical cues guide tissue regeneration, a process spatiotemporally coordinated by stem cells and their niches, remain largely elusive. Here, using photonic crystal cellular force microscopy (PCCFM), single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq), in vivo mouse and in vitro skin organoid models, we identify a specific group of dermal fibroblasts surrounding hair follicle stem cells (HFSCs) that creates a biomechanically compliant extracellular matrix (ECM) niche to initiate hair regeneration. We first observed that the matrix stiffness of the dermal niche surrounding HFSCs is markedly decreased during hair regeneration, preceding and facilitating HFSC activation. Reduced matrix stiffness upregulates THBS4 in dermal fibroblasts, which engages integrin β1 to activate EGR1-mediated peroxisomal pathway that drives hair germ cell proliferation. This mechanical adaptation concurrently enhances epidermal-dermal crosstalk, further lowering matrix stiffness and establishing a positive feedback loop that sustains a regeneration-permissive dermal niche. In summary, our findings reveal the mechanical adaptation of the dermal niche and provide a novel mechano-chemical signaling mechanism that coordinates tissue regeneration.
abstractZh: 摘要  成纤维细胞产生的生物力学信号指导组织再生的机制，这一过程由干细胞及其微环境在时空上协调，至今仍 largely elusive。在此，我们利用光子晶体细胞力显微镜（PCCFM）、单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）、体内小鼠和体外皮肤类器官模型，识别出一组围绕毛囊干细胞（HFSCs）的特异性真皮成纤维细胞，它们创造了一个生物力学顺应性的细胞外基质（ECM）微环境以启动毛发再生。我们首先观察到，在毛发再生过程中，围绕HFSCs的真皮微环境的基质刚度显著降低，先于并促进HFSC激活。降低的基质刚度上调真皮成纤维细胞中的THBS4，后者与整合素β1结合，激活EGR1介导的过氧化物酶体途径，驱动毛胚细胞增殖。这种力学适应同时增强表皮-真皮串扰，进一步降低基质刚度，并建立正反馈回路，维持允许再生的真皮微环境。总之，我们的发现揭示了真皮微环境的力学适应，并提供了一种协调组织再生的新型机械-化学信号机制。

title: Regenerative Inflammation in IBD: How Type I Interferons and TNF Cross‐Talk Converts Epithelial Repair into Therapeutic Response
titleZh: 炎症性肠病中的再生性炎症：I型干扰素与TNF的交叉对话如何将上皮修复转化为治疗应答
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Hinton E, Kemp RA, Gadeock S.
abstract: Inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD) are increasingly recognized as disorders in which epithelial dysfunction and maladaptive regeneration are as important as immune dysregulation. Tumor necrosis factor (TNF), a key mediator of intestinal inflammation and a therapeutic target, plays a dual role in both immune activation and epithelial repair by regulating progenitor cell expansion, lineage plasticity, and chemokine signaling. During acute injury, TNF-driven responses are adaptive, promoting crypt repair, barrier restitution, and secretory remodeling pathways. However, in chronic disease, persistent TNF exposure, amplified and stabilized by type I interferons (IFN-I), locks epithelial cells into sustained regenerative pathways. IFN-I signaling reinforces chemokine networks and transcription-al imprinting, converting physiological repair into a maladaptive state of “regenerative inflammation,” in which epithelial-derived signals perpetuate immune recruitment and tissue remodeling. Such TNF-IFN imprinted epithelial states may sustain pathology independently of classical inflammatory networks, offering a mechanistic basis for anti-TNF treatment failure in certain patients. By integrating mechanistic, organoid-based, and clinical evidence, we propose that chronic TNF-IFN crosstalk establishes a self-sustaining regenerative inflammatory circuit, redefining therapeutic response in IBD and highlighting new opportunities to target epithelial-immune interactions.
abstractZh: 炎症性肠病（IBD）日益被视为上皮功能障碍和适应不良性再生与免疫失调同等重要的疾病。肿瘤坏死因子（TNF）是肠道炎症的关键介质和治疗靶点，在免疫激活和上皮修复中发挥双重作用，通过调节祖细胞扩增、谱系可塑性和趋化因子信号传导发挥作用。在急性损伤期间，TNF驱动的反应是适应性的，促进隐窝修复、屏障恢复和分泌性重塑通路。然而，在慢性疾病中，持续的TNF暴露（由I型干扰素（IFN-I）放大和稳定）将上皮细胞锁定在持续的再生通路中。IFN-I信号传导强化趋化因子网络和转录印记，将生理性修复转化为一种称为“再生性炎症”的适应不良状态，在此状态下，上皮来源的信号持续驱动免疫募集和组织重塑。这种TNF-IFN印记的上皮状态可能独立于经典炎症网络维持病理状态，为某些患者抗TNF治疗失败提供了机制基础。通过整合机制性、类器官和临床证据，我们提出慢性TNF-IFN交叉对话建立了一个自我维持的再生性炎症回路，重新定义了IBD中的治疗应答，并强调了靶向上皮-免疫相互作用的新机会。

abstract: Intrauterine adhesions (IUAs) pose a significant reproductive health challenge, often leading to infertility and complications in pregnancy owing to endometrial damage and fibrosis. Mesenchymal stem cell (MSC)-derived extracellular vesicles (EVs) therapy has emerged as a potential strategy for endometrial repair. However, traditional EVs production methods yield low quantities with limited efficacy, hindering their widespread application. In this study, we proposed an innovative approach that integrates three-dimensional (3D) bioprinted human umbilical cord MSC microfiber-derived EVs (3D-EVs) with gelatin methacrylate hydrogels for in situ delivery. Our platform achieved a 1,000-fold increase in 3D-EV particles production and superior cargo quality compared with conventional 2D cultures. In a rat endometrial organoid injury model, 3D-EVs and 2D-EVs exhibited equivalent therapeutic efficacy. 3D-EVs promoted cell activity and inhibited cell damage by transferring decorin, which inhibited LPS-induced p38 phosphorylation. In vivo, 3D-EVs improved pregnancy outcomes by reducing endometrial fibrosis and promoting endometrial proliferation. Our findings suggest that 3D-EVs derived from bioprinted human umbilical cord MSC-laden microfibers mitigate endometrial injury and fibrosis, improving pregnancy outcomes in IUAs. This study opens new avenues for the development of effective EV-based therapies for the treatment of IUAs.
abstractZh: 宫腔粘连（IUAs）构成重大的生殖健康挑战，常因子宫内膜损伤和纤维化导致不孕及妊娠并发症。间充质干细胞（MSCs）来源的细胞外囊泡（EVs）疗法已成为子宫内膜修复的潜在策略。然而，传统的EVs生产方法产量低且疗效有限，阻碍了其广泛应用。在本研究中，我们提出了一种创新方法，将三维（3D）生物打印的人脐带间充质干细胞微纤维来源的EVs（3D-EVs）与甲基丙烯酸明胶水凝胶结合，用于原位递送。我们的平台实现了3D-EV颗粒产量增加1000倍，且货物质量优于传统2D培养。在大鼠子宫内膜类器官损伤模型中，3D-EVs和2D-EVs表现出等效的治疗效果。3D-EVs通过转移核心蛋白聚糖促进细胞活性并抑制细胞损伤，该蛋白聚糖抑制LPS诱导的p38磷酸化。在体内，3D-EVs通过减少子宫内膜纤维化和促进子宫内膜增殖改善了妊娠结局。我们的研究结果表明，来源于生物打印的人脐带间充质干细胞微纤维的3D-EVs减轻了子宫内膜损伤和纤维化，改善了IUAs的妊娠结局。本研究为开发基于EVs的有效疗法治疗IUAs开辟了新途径。

abstract: Recently, we suggested the combination of chemotherapy and P2RX4 inhibition as a promising novel therapeutic approach for P2RX4-expressing epithelial tumors to prevent paracrine resistance. Here, we aimed to assess whether determining P2RX4 expression status in colorectal and pancreatic cancer patients would allow stratification of potentially responsive patients. Therefore, P2RX4 expression levels were determined by RNA sequencing and immunohistochemistry. Subcellular localization of P2RX4 isoforms was analyzed in HeLa cells and patient-derived tumor organoids. In contrast to its RNA expression profile, P2RX4 protein levels exhibited differential regulation in human colorectal and pancreatic cancer epithelia due to alternative splicing. Interpatient heterogeneity was greater in colorectal cancer than in pancreatic cancer. Notably, these variations in expression did not correlate with overall patient survival. Alternative P2RX4 transcripts gave rise to functionally distinct protein isoforms that differed in subcellular localization and total protein abundance. Only the correctly spliced, canonical P2RX4 isoform was localized to the plasma membrane and was capable of mediating downstream signaling. Accordingly, P2RX4 inhibition in combination with chemotherapy was effective exclusively in patient-derived tumor organoids expressing the canonical P2RX4 transcript. In summary, immunohistochemical, but not transcriptomic, assessment of P2RX4 expression enabled the prediction of sensitivity to combinatorial treatment and facilitated the identification of patients who may benefit from P2RX4 inhibition during chemotherapy. Given the lower degree of heterogeneity observed in pancreatic cancer, this tumor entity may represent a promising candidate for early-phase clinical evaluation of chemotherapy combined with P2RX4 inhibition. © 2026 The Author(s). abstractZh: 近期，我们提出将化疗与P2RX4抑制相结合，作为表达P2RX4的上皮性肿瘤的一种有前景的新型治疗策略，以预防旁分泌耐药。在此，我们旨在评估确定结直肠癌和胰腺癌患者中P2RX4的表达状态是否有助于对潜在应答患者进行分层。因此，通过RNA测序和免疫组织化学确定了P2RX4的表达水平。在HeLa细胞和患者来源的肿瘤类器官中分析了P2RX4亚型的亚细胞定位。与其RNA表达谱相反，由于选择性剪接，P2RX4蛋白水平在人类结直肠癌和胰腺癌上皮中表现出差异性调控。结直肠癌患者间的异质性大于胰腺癌。值得注意的是，这些表达差异与患者总生存期无关。替代性P2RX4转录本产生了功能不同的蛋白亚型，这些亚型在亚细胞定位和总蛋白丰度上存在差异。只有正确剪接的经典P2RX4亚型定位于质膜，并能够介导下游信号传导。相应地，P2RX4抑制与化疗联合仅在表达经典P2RX4转录本的患者来源肿瘤类器官中有效。总之，通过免疫组织化学而非转录组学评估P2RX4表达，能够预测对联合治疗的敏感性，并有助于识别可能在化疗期间从P2RX4抑制中获益的患者。鉴于胰腺癌中观察到的异质性程度较低，该肿瘤类型可能代表化疗联合P2RX4抑制早期临床评估的有前景的候选对象。© 2026作者。由John Wiley & Sons Ltd代表大不列颠及爱尔兰病理学会出版的《病理学杂志》。

abstract:
Background

Intestinal epithelial cells are supported by dynamic cellular heterogeneity, which is critical for maintaining intestinal homeostasis. Recently, intestinal organoid models have gained attention as in vitro platforms because they can recapitulate the structural, functional, and cellular complexity of the small intestine. In this study, we developed porcine intestinal organoids and investigated time-dependent transcriptomic changes using single-cell RNA sequencing. Furthermore, to assess their applicability as an in vitro toxicity model, the organoids were exposed to the mycotoxins deoxynivalenol and zearalenone.Results

The established organoids exhibited stable long-term culture up to passage 10 (32 d) and showed high genetic similarity to native small intestinal tissue across three regions: the duodenum, jejunum, and ileum. In various intestinal epithelial cell types, including transit-amplifying cells, enteroendocrine cells, goblet cells, Paneth cells, and other epithelial cell types, were identified in the organoids. Single-cell RNA sequencing classified the organoids into multiple distinct cell populations, including stem cells, transit-amplifying cells, secretory progenitors, enterocytes, enteroendocrine cells, goblet cells, and Paneth cells, demonstrating dynamic cellular heterogeneity. The organoids also recapitulated key intestinal functions, such as nutrient absorption and epithelial barrier formation, similar to those of the native small intestinal epithelium. Under these conditions, the cytotoxic effects of deoxynivalenol and zearalenone were evaluated. Treatment with these mycotoxins resulted in decreased cell viability, impaired intestinal barrier function, and altered rates of proliferation and differentiation, including those of enteroendocrine, goblet, and Paneth cell populations.Conclusion

This study provides fundamental insights into the growth and differentiation of small intestinal epithelial cells by analyzing timeline-specific organoids using single-cell sequencing. Additionally, it evaluates the toxicity of mycotoxins under conditions that closely resemble those of the small intestine, providing more physiologically relevant data than existing in vitro models and serving as a reliable toxicity assessment model.
abstractZh:
背景

肠道上皮细胞受到动态细胞异质性的支持，这对于维持肠道稳态至关重要。近年来，肠道类器官模型作为体外平台受到关注，因为它们能够重现小肠的结构、功能和细胞复杂性。在本研究中，我们建立了猪肠道类器官，并使用单细胞RNA测序研究了时间依赖的转录组变化。此外，为了评估其作为体外毒性模型的适用性，将类器官暴露于霉菌毒素脱氧雪腐镰刀菌烯醇和玉米赤霉烯酮。结果

所建立的类器官表现出稳定的长期培养，可传代至第10代（32天），并且在十二指肠、空肠和回肠三个区域与天然小肠组织显示出高度的遗传相似性。在类器官中鉴定出了多种肠道上皮细胞类型，包括过渡扩增细胞、肠内分泌细胞、杯状细胞、潘氏细胞和其他上皮细胞类型。单细胞RNA测序将类器官分类为多个不同的细胞群体，包括干细胞、过渡扩增细胞、分泌祖细胞、肠上皮细胞、肠内分泌细胞、杯状细胞和潘氏细胞，展示了动态的细胞异质性。类器官还重现了关键肠道功能，如营养吸收和上皮屏障形成，与天然小肠上皮相似。在这些条件下，评估了脱氧雪腐镰刀菌烯醇和玉米赤霉烯醇的细胞毒性作用。这些霉菌毒素的处理导致细胞活力下降、肠道屏障功能受损，以及增殖和分化速率改变，包括肠内分泌细胞、杯状细胞和潘氏细胞群体。结论

本研究通过使用单细胞测序分析时间特异性类器官，为小肠上皮细胞的生长和分化提供了基础见解。此外，它在与小肠高度相似的条件下评估了霉菌毒素的毒性，提供了比现有体外模型更具生理相关性的数据，并作为可靠的毒性评估模型。
