abstract: Over the past few decades, CRISPR/Cas9-mediated genome editing has transformed functional studies in cell line models by making genetic manipulation highly efficient and feasible. However, extending this technology to primary hepatocytes remains a major challenge. While cultured primary hepatocytes are indispensable for disease modeling and drug development as they retain key metabolic functions absent in cell lines, their limited in vitro lifespan and negligible proliferative capacity pose fundamental barriers to efficient genome editing. Here, we describe an effective two-step perfusion protocol that enables the isolation of primary hepatocytes with high cell viability (>90%) and high yield (approximately 1 × 107 hepatocytes per adult mouse). Following isolation, lentiviral sgRNA transduction is typically performed within 3-4 h, and genome editing outcomes are assessed 5-7 days post-infection. Using hepatocytes from transgenic LSL-Cas9-EGFP mice, in which the Cas9 cassette was activated by a lentiviral vector co-expressing Cre recombinase and sgRNA, achieving up to 80% allele-level gene knockout efficiency in monolayer cultures. In addition, we achieved approximately 12% gene KO efficiency in three-dimensional hepatocyte organoids (HEOs), which more closely recapitulate the architecture and functional characteristics of native liver tissue. In this protocol, a successful experiment is defined by three criteria: sufficient hepatocyte yield (>5 × 106 cells per mouse) with high viability (>85%), efficient single-guide RNA (sgRNA) delivery into hepatocytes, and validated target gene disruption at the genomic level. This protocol demonstrates the feasibility of efficient in vitro genome manipulation in both monolayer-cultured hepatocytes and HEOs, providing a robust platform for genetic modeling and functional studies of liver diseases.
abstractZh: 在过去的几十年里，CRISPR/Cas9介导的基因组编辑通过使基因操作变得高效且可行，彻底改变了细胞系模型中的功能研究。然而，将这项技术扩展到原代肝细胞仍然是一个重大挑战。虽然培养的原代肝细胞保留了细胞系中缺失的关键代谢功能，对于疾病建模和药物开发不可或缺，但它们有限的体外寿命和可忽略的增殖能力对高效基因组编辑构成了根本性障碍。在此，我们描述了一种有效的两步灌流方案，能够分离出高细胞活力（>90%）和高产量（每只成年小鼠约1×10^7个肝细胞）的原代肝细胞。分离后，通常在3-4小时内进行慢病毒sgRNA转导，并在感染后5-7天评估基因组编辑结果。使用来自转基因LSL-Cas9-EGFP小鼠的肝细胞，其中Cas9盒由共表达Cre重组酶和sgRNA的慢病毒载体激活，在单层培养中实现了高达80%的等位基因水平基因敲除效率。此外，我们在三维肝细胞类器官（HEOs）中实现了约12%的基因敲除效率，HEOs更接近地重现了天然肝组织的结构和功能特征。在本方案中，成功的实验由三个标准定义：足够的肝细胞产量（每只小鼠>5×10^6个细胞）且高活力（>85%），将单引导RNA（sgRNA）高效递送到肝细胞中，以及在基因组水平上验证靶基因的破坏。该方案证明了在单层培养的肝细胞和HEOs中进行高效体外基因组操作的可行性，为肝脏疾病的遗传建模和功能研究提供了一个稳健的平台。

abstract:
Background

The tumor microenvironment (TME) critically determines cancer progression, yet master regulators orchestrating microenvironmental remodeling across malignancies remain elusive. VANGL1, a core planar cell polarity component, has been implicated in tissue morphogenesis, but its pan-cancer landscape and TME regulatory mechanisms are unexplored.Methods

We conducted comprehensive pan-cancer analysis of VANGL1 across 33 tumor types using bulk transcriptomic, single-cell RNA sequencing, and spatial transcriptomic datasets. Intercellular communication was dissected using CellChat. Functional mechanisms were investigated through PPI networks, CancerSEA, and GSEA. Experimental validation employed loss-of-function studies in PC9, HCT116, and Bel7402 cells, patient-derived tumor organoids, and hepatocellular carcinoma stem cell-derived xenografts.Results

VANGL1 was significantly upregulated across solid tumors and as-sociated with poor prognosis. Single-cell analysis revealed VANGL1+ malignant cells exhibited enhanced communication with fibroblasts, endothelial cells, and immune cells through MIF, VEGF, and ANGPTL pathways. Mechanistically, VANGL1 integrated Wnt/Notch/mTOR signaling with cancer stemness and angiogenesis. VANGL1 knock-down suppressed proliferation, migration, and invasion in vitro, and attenuated tumor growth, angiogenesis, and cancer stem cell maintenance in vivo.Conclusions

Our study identifies VANGL1 as a pan-cancer master regulator integrating cancer stemness, angio-genesis, and microenvironmental remodeling, establishing therapeutic rationale for targeting the VANGL1-driven TME niche.
abstractZh:
背景

肿瘤微环境（TME）决定性地影响癌症进展，然而，跨恶性肿瘤协调微环境重塑的主调控因子仍然难以捉摸。VANGL1，一个核心的平面细胞极性组分，已被牵涉到组织形态发生中，但其泛癌景观和TME调控机制尚未被探索。方法

我们利用批量转录组、单细胞RNA测序和空间转录组数据集，对33种肿瘤类型进行了全面的VANGL1泛癌分析。使用CellChat解析细胞间通讯。通过PPI网络、CancerSEA和GSEA研究功能机制。实验验证采用PC9、HCT116和Bel7402细胞中的功能缺失研究、患者来源的肿瘤类器官以及肝细胞癌干细胞来源的异种移植。结果

VANGL1在实体瘤中显著上调，并与不良预后相关。单细胞分析显示，VANGL1+恶性细胞通过MIF、VEGF和ANGPTL通路与成纤维细胞、内皮细胞和免疫细胞表现出增强的通讯。机制上，VANGL1整合了Wnt/Notch/mTOR信号通路与癌症干性和血管生成。VANGL1敲低在体外抑制增殖、迁移和侵袭，并在体内减弱肿瘤生长、血管生成和癌症干细胞维持。结论

我们的研究将VANGL1确定为一种泛癌主调控因子，整合癌症干性、血管生成和微环境重塑，为靶向VANGL1驱动的TME微环境提供了治疗学依据。

title: A guide for establishing patient-derived organoids from bile samples obtained during endoscopic procedures and performing gene expression knockdown.
titleZh: 从内镜操作期间获取的胆汁样本中建立患者来源类器官并进行基因表达敲低的指南。

abstract: Bile represents a clinically accessible biological fluid that can mitigate major limitations associated with tissue-based sampling for the generation of organoid models to study hepatobiliary disease, including biliary tract cancers, where tissue availability is often limited. Importantly, bile can also enable the generation of non-malignant cholangiocyte organoids that are otherwise difficult to obtain. Here, we describe an operator-oriented, step-by-step protocol to generate organoids from fresh bile collected during endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP), together with two complementary workflows for siRNA delivery in 3D cultures. We detail critical control points that are often under-reported, yet considerably influence success and reproducibility. The protocol was optimized and applied in a real-world cohort of 21 patients undergoing ERCP, including benign biliary obstruction due to choledocholithiasis (n = 5) and malignant strictures (n = 16: cholangiocarcinoma; n = 13: gallbladder adenocarcinoma; n = 1: ampullary tumors; n = 2). Expandable organoids were established in 17/21 cases (81%), with establishment rates of 60% for choledocholithiasis and 85%-100% across malignant entities. The anticipated results include organoid outgrowth within ∼2-3 weeks and morphological heterogeneity in cultures derived from malignant strictures, where normal-like and tumor-like populations may initially coexist and can drift toward a cystic phenotype under routine expansion, motivating optional manual handpicking when tumor-enriched lines are required. As downstream readouts, we show the feasibility of DNA-based profiling in selected paired bile-organoid samples (targeted sequencing and ULP-WGS copy-number analysis) and demonstrate proof-of-concept gene silencing via siRNA in both dissociated cells prior to re-embedding and intact fully formed organoids while preserving the 3D architecture. Collectively, this workflow provides a practical and reproducible framework to establish, expand, characterize, and functionally perturb bile-derived organoids from routine clinical procedures, facilitating standardized implementation across laboratories.
abstractZh: 胆汁是一种临床上可获取的生物液体，可以减轻基于组织取样生成类器官模型以研究肝胆疾病（包括胆道癌，其中组织可用性通常有限）的主要限制。重要的是，胆汁还可以生成非恶性的胆管细胞类器官，而这些类器官通常难以获得。在此，我们描述了一个以操作者为导向的、逐步的协议，用于从内镜逆行胰胆管造影（ERCP）期间收集的新鲜胆汁中生成类器官，以及两种在3D培养中进行siRNA递送的互补工作流程。我们详细介绍了那些常被低估但对成功率和可重复性有显著影响的关键控制点。该协议在21名接受ERCP的真实世界队列中进行了优化和应用，包括因胆总管结石（n = 5）引起的良性胆道梗阻和恶性狭窄（n = 16：胆管癌；n = 13：胆囊腺癌；n = 1：壶腹肿瘤；n = 2）。在17/21例（81%）中建立了可扩增的类器官，其中胆总管结石的建立率为60%，恶性实体为85%-100%。预期结果包括在约2-3周内类器官生长，以及来自恶性狭窄的培养物中形态异质性，其中正常样和肿瘤样群体可能最初共存，并在常规扩增下可能向囊性表型漂移，这促使在需要肿瘤富集系时进行可选的手动挑选。作为下游读数，我们展示了在选定的配对胆汁-类器官样本中进行基于DNA的分析的可行性（靶向测序和ULP-WGS拷贝数分析），并证明了在解离细胞重新包埋前以及完整的完全形成的类器官中通过siRNA进行基因沉默的概念验证，同时保持3D结构。总的来说，该工作流程提供了一个实用且可重复的框架，用于从常规临床操作中建立、扩增、表征和功能扰动胆汁来源的类器官，促进各实验室的标准化实施。

title: Multitechnological integration advances musculoskeletal regeneration: synergistic progress of organoids, 3D/4D bioprinting, single-cell omics and artificial intelligence.
titleZh: 多技术融合推动肌肉骨骼再生：类器官、3D/4D生物打印、单细胞组学与人工智能的协同进展。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Liu Z, Fan H, Zhai T, Ma Z, Yang Y.
affiliations: Graduate School, Inner Mongolia Medical University, Hohhot, Inner Mongolia, China.
Imaging Center, Affiliated Hospital of Inner Mongolia Medical University, Hohhot, Inner Mongolia, China.
Center for Joint Surgery, The Second Affiliated Hospital of Inner Mongolia Medical University, Hohhot, Inner Mongolia, China.
abstract: Regenerative repair of injuries and degenerative diseases in the musculoskeletal system remains a paramount clinical challenge, as conventional single-modal technologies fail to recapitulate the intricate structural and functional complexity of native musculoskeletal tissues. In recent years, the rapid evolution of cutting-edge technologies-including organoids, 3D/4D bioprinting, single-cell omics and artificial intelligence (AI)-has unlocked novel opportunities for addressing this longstanding issue. This review aims to systematically elucidate how the integration of these four core technologies drives progress in musculoskeletal regeneration research. By exploring the intrinsic methodological details of each technology and their underlying synergistic mechanisms, we summarize the latest advances in multitechnological integration for fabricating highly biomimetic in vitro models, enabling precise and dynamic fabrication of tissue-engineered constructs, deciphering cellular heterogeneity during tissue development and repair at high resolution, and optimizing data-driven personalized regenerative strategies. We further explicitly distinguish the in vitro and in vivo applications of each technology with representative experimental evidence and translational implications, and provide comprehensive tabular summaries of state-of-the-art research over the past 5 years. Furthermore, we prospect the future development directions and critical challenges facing this interdisciplinary field.
abstractZh: 肌肉骨骼系统损伤和退行性疾病的再生修复仍然是临床上的重大挑战，因为传统的单一模式技术无法重现天然肌肉骨骼组织的复杂结构和功能。近年来，包括类器官、3D/4D生物打印、单细胞组学和人工智能（AI）在内的前沿技术的快速发展，为解决这一长期问题提供了新的机遇。本综述旨在系统阐述这四种核心技术的整合如何推动肌肉骨骼再生研究的发展。通过探讨每种技术的内在方法论细节及其潜在的协同机制，我们总结了多技术融合在制造高仿生体外模型、实现组织工程构建体的精确和动态制造、高分辨率解析组织发育和修复过程中的细胞异质性，以及优化数据驱动的个性化再生策略方面的最新进展。我们进一步明确区分了每种技术在体外和体内的应用，并提供了代表性的实验证据和转化意义，以及过去5年最新研究的全面表格总结。此外，我们展望了这一跨学科领域未来的发展方向和面临的关键挑战。

title: Modeling ischemic-type biliary lesion in vitro using human expandable intrahepatic cholangiocyte organoids.
titleZh: 利用人可扩增肝内胆管细胞类器官体外模拟缺血型胆道病变。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）

abstract:
Background

Ischemic-type biliary lesion (ITBL) remains one of the most common complications following liver transplantation. It is imperative to further explore the occurrence and development mechanism of ITBL. Intrahepatic cholangiocyte organoids (ICOs) derived from human liver tissue replicate the structure and function of bile ducts and serve as an innovative experimental tool for in vitro modeling of cholangiopathies.Methods

In this study, ICOs derived from human liver tissue were cultured under ischemia and hypoxia (IH) conditions to establish an in vitro model of ITBL. Immunofluorescence staining, RT-qPCR, Western blotting, and transcriptomic analysis were performed to investigate the effects of IH on ICOs and evaluate the validity of the ITBL model.Results

IH significantly reduced the diameter and cell viability of ICOs. After exposure to IH for more than 48 h, the proliferation of ICOs decreased, accompanied by increased inflammatory responses and apoptosis. Transcriptomic analysis revealed a landscape of pathophysiological genetic changes in the ITBL model in response to IH.Conclusion

We have presented a novel ITBL model constructed using expandable human ICOs, which is of great significance for exploring the molecular mechanism and potential therapeutic targets of ITBL.
abstractZh:
背景

缺血型胆道病变（ITBL）仍是肝移植术后最常见的并发症之一。深入探讨ITBL的发生发展机制至关重要。来源于人肝组织的肝内胆管细胞类器官（ICOs）能够复制胆管的结构和功能，是体外模拟胆管病变的创新实验工具。方法

本研究将来源于人肝组织的ICOs在缺血缺氧（IH）条件下培养，以建立ITBL的体外模型。采用免疫荧光染色、RT-qPCR、Western blotting和转录组学分析，研究IH对ICOs的影响，并评估ITBL模型的有效性。结果

IH显著降低了ICOs的直径和细胞活力。暴露于IH超过48小时后，ICOs的增殖减少，伴随炎症反应和凋亡增加。转录组学分析揭示了ITBL模型响应IH的病理生理遗传变化全景。结论

我们提出了一种利用可扩增人ICOs构建的新型ITBL模型，这对于探索ITBL的分子机制和潜在治疗靶点具有重要意义。

title: From molecular networks to translational intervention: current progress in the mechanisms of gemcitabine resistance in bladder cancer.
titleZh: 从分子网络到转化干预：膀胱癌吉西他滨耐药机制的研究进展
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Jin M, Cai Z, Bu M, Liu J, Zhang X.
affiliations: Heilongjiang University of Chinese Medicine, Harbin, China.
Qiqihar Medical University, Qiqihar, China.
abstract: Bladder cancer remains one of the most common malignancies of the urinary tract. Although the treatment landscape has expanded rapidly in recent years, gemcitabine still occupies a central position in intravesical treatment for non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer, in perioperative systemic therapy for muscle-invasive disease, and in platinum-based first-line regimens for advanced urothelial carcinoma. Yet the long-term benefit of gemcitabine is frequently curtailed by primary non-response or acquired resistance. In practice, this problem is often recognized only after radiographic progression or clear clinical deterioration has occurred. This review summarizes recent progress in bladder cancer therapy and translational research, with a particular emphasis on the biological basis and hierarchical evolution of gemcitabine resistance. We establish a 3-stage operational model of resistance, distinguishing: (1) early pharmacologic resistance driven by impaired drug uptake/activation or enhanced inactivation; (2) intermediate resistance driven by enhanced DNA damage repair, replication stress tolerance, and pro-survival autophagy signaling; and (3) late adaptive resistance driven by epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT), stemness maintenance, metabolic reprogramming, non-coding RNA-mediated epigenetic regulation, inflammatory microenvironmental remodeling, and extracellular vesicle-based intercellular transmission. These layers function as an interactive network, with sequential emergence under treatment pressure and parallel activation in context-dependent clinical settings. We stratify key mechanistic nodes (including the HYAL4-V1/CD44/JAK2-STAT3/CDA axis, AKR1C3, AP1M2-RAD54B, PRPF19-DDB1, AKT/mTOR signaling, Beclin-1-dependent autophagy, the MINCR/ZEB1/PHGDH axis, and IL-6-associated inflammatory states) by their clinical evidence quality and translational readiness, explicitly distinguishing preclinical discovery from clinically validated findings. Critically, most mechanistic findings remain at the preclinical or retrospective validation stage, with no markers yet approved for routine clinical use. Future work must prioritize longitudinal paired clinical samples, standardized analytic assays for dynamic biomarkers, and the integration of functional models (organoids, microfluidic systems), multi-omics technologies (single-cell sequencing, spatial transcriptomics), and liquid-biopsy approaches to translate mechanistic discoveries into clinically actionable predictive tools and therapeutic strategies.
abstractZh: 膀胱癌仍然是泌尿系统最常见的恶性肿瘤之一。尽管近年来治疗格局迅速扩展，吉西他滨在非肌层浸润性膀胱癌的膀胱内治疗、肌层浸润性疾病的围手术期全身治疗以及晚期尿路上皮癌的含铂一线方案中仍占据核心地位。然而，吉西他滨的长期获益常常因原发性无反应或获得性耐药而受限。在实践中，这一问题往往仅在影像学进展或明确的临床恶化出现后才被认识到。本综述总结了膀胱癌治疗和转化研究的最新进展，特别强调了吉西他滨耐药的生物学基础及其层级演化。我们建立了一个三阶段耐药操作模型，区分：(1) 早期药理学耐药，由药物摄取/激活受损或失活增强驱动；(2) 中期耐药，由DNA损伤修复增强、复制应激耐受和促生存自噬信号驱动；以及(3) 晚期适应性耐药，由上皮-间质转化（EMT）、干性维持、代谢重编程、非编码RNA介导的表观遗传调控、炎症微环境重塑和细胞外囊泡介导的细胞间传递驱动。这些层次作为一个交互网络发挥作用，在治疗压力下依次出现，并在依赖临床情境的环境中平行激活。我们根据临床证据质量和转化就绪程度，对关键机制节点（包括HYAL4-V1/CD44/JAK2-STAT3/CDA轴、AKR1C3、AP1M2-RAD54B、PRPF19-DDB1、AKT/mTOR信号、Beclin-1依赖性自噬、MINCR/ZEB1/PHGDH轴和IL-6相关炎症状态）进行了分层，明确区分了临床前发现与临床验证结果。关键的是，大多数机制发现仍处于临床前或回顾性验证阶段，尚无标志物被批准用于常规临床。未来的工作必须优先考虑纵向配对临床样本、动态生物标志物的标准化分析检测，以及整合功能模型（类器官、微流控系统）、多组学技术（单细胞测序、空间转录组学）和液体活检方法，以将机制发现转化为临床可操作的预测工具和治疗策略。

title: Integrated Stress Response and Necroptosis Drive Epithelial Dysfunction in Crohn's Disease: Repurposing Cancer Drugs for Permeability Barrier Healing.
titleZh: 整合应激反应和坏死性凋亡驱动克罗恩病上皮功能障碍：重新利用抗癌药物促进通透性屏障愈合。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Halder D, Lanford RB, Esmaeilniakooshkghazi A, Hou JK, Wang Y, Khurana S.
affiliations: Department of Biology and Biochemistry, The University of Houston, Houston, Texas.
Section of Gastroenterology and Hepatology, Department of Medicine, Baylor College of Medicine, Houston, Texas.
Division of Pathology-Laboratory Medicine Division, Department of Anatomical Pathology, The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center, Houston, Texas.
abstract:
Background and aims

Intestinal permeability dysfunction is a central pathogenic driver of Crohn's disease (CD), fueling microbial translocation, chronic inflammation, and progressive tissue injury. While current therapies suppress inflammation, none directly restore epithelial barrier function. Importantly, in patients with CD, epithelial barrier healing rather than mucosal healing is associated with long-term remission and a reduced risk of disease complications. Yet permeability barrier healing remains an unaddressed therapeutic target in CD. Here, we investigated whether pharmacologic inhibition of the integrated stress response (ISR) and RIPK3-mediated necroptosis, 2 convergent pathways of epithelial injury, can promote epithelial viability, regeneration, and barrier integrity in CD.Methods

We employed villin-1/gelsolin double knockout mice with epithelial-intrinsic ISR activation, Tnf ΔARE/+ mice with chronic inflammation, and CD patient-derived enteroids (PDEs). Animals and PDE were treated with integrated stress response inhibitor, RIPK3 inhibitor necrostatin-1, or US Food and Drug Administration-approved cancer drugs pazopanib and ponatinib, repurposed as potent RIPK3 inhibitors. Epithelial survival, regenerative growth (enteroid formation, budding), and barrier function (transepithelial electrical resistance) were assessed.Results

Chronic ISR activation and necroptosis were prominent in both murine models and CD PDEs, causing epithelial death, Paneth cell expansion, impaired enteroid survival, and regenerative failure. Pharmacologic inhibition with integrated stress response inhibitor, necrostatin-1, pazopanib, or ponatinib restored villus architecture, reduced inflammation, enhanced epithelial survival and regeneration, and significantly improved transepithelial electrical resistance.Conclusion

ISR activation and RIPK3-mediated necroptosis converge to drive epithelial injury and barrier dysfunction in CD. Repurposing pazopanib and ponatinib offers a potentially translatable approach to restore barrier integrity in CD.
abstractZh:
背景与目的

肠道通透性功能障碍是克罗恩病（CD）的核心致病驱动因素，促进微生物易位、慢性炎症和进行性组织损伤。虽然目前的疗法能抑制炎症，但均不能直接恢复上皮屏障功能。重要的是，在CD患者中，上皮屏障愈合而非黏膜愈合与长期缓解和疾病并发症风险降低相关。然而，通透性屏障愈合仍是CD中一个未得到解决的治疗靶点。在此，我们研究了整合应激反应（ISR）和RIPK3介导的坏死性凋亡（两种上皮损伤的汇聚通路）的药理学抑制是否能促进CD中的上皮活力、再生和屏障完整性。方法

我们使用了具有上皮内在ISR激活的villin-1/gelsolin双敲除小鼠、具有慢性炎症的Tnf ΔARE/+小鼠以及CD患者来源的肠类器官（PDEs）。动物和PDE分别用整合应激反应抑制剂、RIPK3抑制剂necrostatin-1或美国食品药品监督管理局批准的抗癌药物帕唑帕尼和普纳替尼（被重新用作强效RIPK3抑制剂）处理。评估了上皮存活、再生生长（类器官形成、出芽）和屏障功能（跨上皮电阻）。结果

慢性ISR激活和坏死性凋亡在两种小鼠模型和CD PDEs中均显著，导致上皮死亡、潘氏细胞扩增、类器官存活受损和再生失败。使用整合应激反应抑制剂、necrostatin-1、帕唑帕尼或普纳替尼进行药理学抑制可恢复绒毛结构、减少炎症、增强上皮存活和再生，并显著改善跨上皮电阻。结论

ISR激活和RIPK3介导的坏死性凋亡汇聚驱动CD中的上皮损伤和屏障功能障碍。重新利用帕唑帕尼和普纳替尼为恢复CD中的屏障完整性提供了一种潜在可转化的方法。

title: Flytrap-Inspired Mesh-Trap Bioelectronics for Full Spherical Electrophysiological Interrogation of 3D Tissues
titleZh: 受捕蝇草启发的网笼式生物电子装置用于三维组织的全球形电生理探测
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Li H, Wang X, Song Y, Hu X, Yao J.
abstract:
ABSTRACT

  Three-dimensional (3D) in vitro tissue models are emerging as powerful platforms for studying development, disease, and therapeutic responses, where close monitoring of electrophysiological activity is essential. However, existing probing methods remain limited in accessibility or spatiotemporal resolution for comprehensive electrophysiological mapping of suspended 3D tissues that closely mimic the native environments. Here we introduce a Venus flytrap-inspired bioelectronic mesh system that enables the full spherical enclosure of 3D tissues in a suspended configuration. The system consists of two hemispherical meshes that envelop the tissue, constructed from highly flexible, stretchable, cell-scale ribbons interconnected into a tissue-compliant network with integrated recording electrode arrays. This architecture enables intimate, conformal tissue integration and supports stable electrophysiological recordings over 300 days. The high-resolution recordings allow precise tracking of local dynamics and correlated global signaling, enabling comprehensive assessment of tissue development as well as detailed evaluation of drug responses for disease modeling. Beyond single tissues, the mesh architecture is extended to fully enclose assembloids composed of multiple tissues, enabling characterization of cross-tissue signaling relevant to advanced heterogenous tissue modeling. Furthermore, the system is translated into array-based platforms, demonstrated by a 4×4 array integrating 1024 electrodes, for high-throughput tissue sampling and cross-study analysis. The developed bioelectronic system and integration method provide a broadly applicable platform to advance electrophysiological studies across diverse tissues and organoids.
abstractZh:
摘要

  三维（3D）体外组织模型正成为研究发育、疾病和治疗反应的有力平台，其中对电生理活动的密切监测至关重要。然而，现有的探测方法在可及性或时空分辨率方面仍存在局限，难以对紧密模拟天然环境的悬浮3D组织进行全面的电生理映射。在此，我们介绍一种受捕蝇草启发的生物电子网笼系统，该系统能够在悬浮构型中实现3D组织的全球形包裹。该系统由两个半球形网笼组成，包裹组织，由高度柔韧、可拉伸的细胞尺度条带互连成组织顺应性网络，并集成记录电极阵列。这种架构实现了紧密、共形的组织整合，并支持超过300天的稳定电生理记录。高分辨率记录能够精确追踪局部动态和相关的全局信号，从而全面评估组织发育以及详细评估疾病建模中的药物反应。超越单个组织，该网笼架构被扩展为完全包裹由多个组织组成的组装体，从而能够表征与先进异质组织建模相关的跨组织信号。此外，该系统被转化为基于阵列的平台，通过一个集成1024个电极的4×4阵列进行演示，用于高通量组织采样和跨研究分析。所开发的生物电子系统和集成方法为推进跨多种组织和类器官的电生理研究提供了一个广泛适用的平台。

title: Protein arginine-methyltransferase 1 (PRMT1): a new pharmacological target in cholangiocarcinoma
titleZh: 蛋白质精氨酸甲基转移酶1（PRMT1）：胆管癌的新药理学靶点
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Valbuena-Goiricelaya E, Elurbide J, Latasa MU, Lopez-Pascual A, Uriarte I, Colyn L, Inacio P, Arnes-Benito R, Adan-Villaescusa E, Castello-Uribe B, Franceschini B, Milana F, Strnad P, Frankova S, Sticová E, Fabian O, Amat I, Urman J, Lleo A, Huch M, Arechederra M, Berasain C, Fernandez-Barrena MG, Avila MA.
abstract: Cholangiocarcinoma (CCA) is a highly aggressive malignancy characterized by poor prognosis, limited therapeutic options, and a predominantly immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment. Protein arginine methyltransferase 1 (PRMT1), the major mediator of asymmetric arginine dimethylation, has been implicated in multiple oncogenic processes, although its role in CCA remains unknown. Here, we demonstrate that PRMT1 is frequently overexpressed in human CCA and is associated with aggressive molecular subtypes and immune-desert tumors. Genetic dependency analyses and pharmacological inhibition using type I PRMT inhibitors markedly impaired CCA cell proliferation, clonogenicity, and tumoroid growth. Transcriptomic profiling revealed that PRMT1 inhibition induces broad alterations in gene expression and alternative splicing, affecting pathways involved in proliferation, apoptosis, DNA damage response, metabolism, and immune signaling. Mechanistically, PRMT1 targeting promoted genomic stress, accumulation of cytosolic double-stranded DNA, and activation of the cGAS-STING-TBK1-IRF3 signaling axis, resulting in enhanced interferon signaling and increased expression of T cell-recruiting chemokines, including CXCL9 and CXCL10. PRMT1 inhibition also synergized with cisplatin, poly-ADP-ribose polymerase (PARP) inhibition, and PRMT5 blockade in vitro and in patient-derived tumoroids. Importantly, in an aggressive orthotopic murine model of intrahepatic CCA, combined treatment with the PRMT1 inhibitor GSK3368715 and anti-PD-1 antibodies significantly reduced tumor burden and increased CD4+ and CD8+ T-cell infiltration compared with monotherapies. Collectively, these findings identify PRMT1 as a critical regulator of CCA growth and immune evasion and support the therapeutic potential of PRMT1 inhibition, particularly in combination with immunotherapy.
abstractZh: 胆管癌（CCA）是一种高度侵袭性的恶性肿瘤，以预后差、治疗选择有限和以免疫抑制性肿瘤微环境为主为特征。蛋白质精氨酸甲基转移酶1（PRMT1）是不对称精氨酸二甲基化的主要介导者，已被认为参与多种致癌过程，尽管其在胆管癌中的作用仍不清楚。在此，我们证明PRMT1在人类胆管癌中频繁过表达，并与侵袭性分子亚型和免疫荒漠型肿瘤相关。遗传依赖性分析和使用I型PRMT抑制剂的药理学抑制显著损害了胆管癌细胞的增殖、克隆形成能力和类肿瘤生长。转录组分析显示，PRMT1抑制诱导基因表达和选择性剪接的广泛改变，影响涉及增殖、凋亡、DNA损伤反应、代谢和免疫信号传导的途径。机制上，靶向PRMT1促进了基因组应激、胞质双链DNA的积累以及cGAS-STING-TBK1-IRF3信号轴的激活，导致干扰素信号增强和T细胞募集趋化因子（包括CXCL9和CXCL10）表达增加。PRMT1抑制还与顺铂、聚ADP-核糖聚合酶（PARP）抑制和PRMT5阻断在体外和患者来源的类肿瘤中具有协同作用。重要的是，在侵袭性肝内胆管癌原位小鼠模型中，PRMT1抑制剂GSK3368715与抗PD-1抗体联合治疗与单一疗法相比显著减少了肿瘤负荷并增加了CD4+和CD8+ T细胞浸润。总的来说，这些发现将PRMT1确定为胆管癌生长和免疫逃逸的关键调节因子，并支持PRMT1抑制的治疗潜力，特别是与免疫治疗联合使用时。

title: Human hindbrain organoids with segment-specific 5-HT neurons for motor modulation
titleZh: 具有节段特异性5-HT神经元的人后脑类器官用于运动调节
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Zhu J, Pang W, Liu Y, Yin Y, Lu X, Wei J, Jiang L, Zhou W, Cao Y, Zhang Q, Chen S, Chu S, Ji Z, Hong D, Li Y, Tao Y, Zhang X, Chen C, Xiang Y.
abstract: The serotonergic system regulates human mood, reward, and motor control, and its impairment contributes to debilitating psychiatric disorders. Serotonergic neurons (SNs) arise predominantly in the hindbrain and acquire segment-specific identities and functions; however, the lack of human models remains a challenge to understanding the human serotonergic system. Here, we generate human serotonergic-enriched rostral and caudal hindbrain organoids (hsrHOs and hscHOs) that produce segment-specific SNs with regional identities corresponding to rhombomeres r2–r3 and r5–r8, respectively. hsrHOs and hscHOs produce SNs that recapitulate their  in vivo counterparts in transcriptomic profiles, function, and ascending or descending projection preferences. Assembly with human neuromusculoskeletal organoids enables modeling of serotonergic modulation of motor control. This system further reveals that deficiency of the schizophrenia risk gene DISC1 disrupts human serotonergic development and impairs motor modulation. Together, our study establishes a human organoid platform for modeling development, circuit function and disease-associated dysfunction of the serotonergic modulatory system.
abstractZh: 血清素能系统调节人类情绪、奖赏和运动控制，其损伤会导致致残性精神疾病。血清素能神经元（SNs）主要产生于后脑，并获得节段特异性的身份和功能；然而，缺乏人类模型仍然是理解人类血清素能系统的挑战。在此，我们生成了富含血清素能的人嘴侧和尾侧后脑类器官（hsrHOs和hscHOs），它们产生具有区域身份的节段特异性SNs，分别对应于菱脑节r2–r3和r5–r8。hsrHOs和hscHOs产生的SNs在转录组谱、功能以及上行或下行投射偏好方面重现了其体内对应物。与人类神经肌肉骨骼类器官的组装使得能够模拟血清素能对运动控制的调节。该系统进一步揭示，精神分裂症风险基因DISC1的缺陷破坏了人类血清素能发育并损害运动调节。总之，我们的研究建立了一个人类类器官平台，用于模拟血清素能调节系统的发育、回路功能以及疾病相关的功能障碍。

title: Granular Extracellular Matrix (gECM) Hydrogel Wafers as Shelf-Stable 2.5D Substrates for Microphysiological Modeling
titleZh: 颗粒状细胞外基质（gECM）水凝胶薄片作为微生理建模的货架稳定2.5D基底
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Heye JO, Blanco SA, Schneider SE, Gallegos S, Barthold JE, Floren M, Acosta V, Avril S, Neu CP.
abstract:
ABSTRACT

  Understanding disease pathology and evaluating emerging therapeutics require  in vitro models that accurately recapitulate human tissue environments. However, existing microphysiological systems often compromise either biomimicry or ease-of-use, limiting widespread adoption and scalability. Here, we present lyophilized granular extracellular matrix (gECM) hydrogel wafers as shelf-stable, humanized 2.5D substrates that enable physiologically relevant modeling while simplifying integration into experimental workflows. Derived from decellularized human cartilage and bone, gECM hydrogel wafers retain tissue-specific architecture while introducing microporosity and surface topography through lyophilization. These wafers maintain swelling behavior, structural integrity, and mechanical properties over three months of room-temperature storage, allowing pre-fabrication and on-demand use without loss of function. gECM hydrogel wafers support direct cell seeding without encapsulation and sustain viability and proliferation of human adipose-derived mesenchymal stromal cells over 21 days, with gene expression trends comparable to 3D gECM hydrogels. Furthermore, wafers can be readily integrated into microfluidic systems with  in situ hydration and transport of large biomolecules. Together, this platform bridges the gap between conventional 2D culture ease-of-use and 3D biomaterial biomimicry, providing a scalable and physiologically relevant  in vitro model approach for high-throughput disease studies and therapeutic screening.
abstractZh:
摘要

理解疾病病理和评估新兴疗法需要能够准确再现人体组织环境的体外模型。然而，现有的微生理系统常常在仿生性或易用性之间做出妥协，限制了广泛采用和可扩展性。在此，我们提出了冻干的颗粒状细胞外基质（gECM）水凝胶薄片，作为货架稳定、人源化的2.5D基底，能够实现生理相关建模，同时简化与实验工作流程的整合。源自脱细胞的人软骨和骨，gECM水凝胶薄片保留了组织特异性结构，同时通过冻干引入了微孔性和表面形貌。这些薄片在室温储存三个月后仍保持溶胀行为、结构完整性和机械性能，允许预制备和按需使用而不损失功能。gECM水凝胶薄片支持直接细胞接种而无需封装，并在21天内维持人脂肪来源的间充质基质细胞的活力和增殖，其基因表达趋势与3D gECM水凝胶相当。此外，薄片可以轻松整合到微流体系统中，实现原位水化和大生物分子的运输。总之，该平台弥合了传统2D培养易用性与3D生物材料仿生性之间的差距，为高通量疾病研究和治疗筛选提供了一种可扩展且生理相关的体外模型方法。

title: Fibroblast-derived thrombospondin-1 shapes macrophage polarization in advanced human co-culture models
titleZh: 成纤维细胞来源的血小板反应蛋白-1在晚期人共培养模型中塑造巨噬细胞极化
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Draganić K, Isaev S, Pototschnig I, Valcanover D, Pfneissl J, Stadler M, Hocevar M, Lotz V, Wasinger G, Pisibon C, Grader L, Ho ASY, Małys MS, Saha P, Kain R, Weichhart T, Bergmann M, Berger W, Schweiger M, Adameyko I, Egger G.
abstract:
Background

  Tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) are key drivers of the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME), supporting tumor progression through diverse functions. However, mechanistic studies of TAM polarization remain limited by the lack of physiologically relevant human model systems that capture stromal-immune interactions and macrophage heterogeneity. Methods

  We established advanced human co-culture systems that integrate healthy donor-derived macrophages with patient-derived organoids and tumoroids (PDOs and PDTs), as well as matched normal fibroblasts (NFs) and cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs). These multicellular models enabled the investigation of interactions among stromal, epithelial, and immune cells within tumor and adjacent normal tissue environments. Results

  The co-culture systems recapitulated distinct macrophage states associated with tumor and adjacent normal environments and identified fibroblasts as major regulators of macrophage phenotypes. CAFs promoted macrophage metabolic remodeling characterized by altered lipid handling and enrichment of TAM-like signatures. Mechanistically, we identified thrombospondin 1 (TSP1) as a CAF-secreted factor linked to metabolic priming. Recombinant TSP1 induced transient lipid accumulation followed by mitochondrial remodeling. In tumor co-culture conditions, CD36 inhibition reduced lipid accumulation in macrophages, supporting a role for TSP1-linked lipid crosstalk in stromal-immune interactions. Conclusion

  Our study establishes advanced patient-derived co-culture models as a platform to investigate human TAM biology and stromal-immune interactions in CRC. Using these systems, we identify a fibroblast-associated TSP1-lipid axis linked to macrophage metabolic remodeling and TAM-like polarization, highlighting stromal metabolic communication as a potential targetable feature of the CRC microenvironment. abstractZh:
背景

  肿瘤相关巨噬细胞（TAMs）是免疫抑制性肿瘤微环境（TME）的关键驱动因素，通过多种功能支持肿瘤进展。然而，由于缺乏能够捕捉基质-免疫相互作用和巨噬细胞异质性的生理相关人模型系统，TAM极化的机制研究仍然受限。方法

  我们建立了先进的人共培养系统，将健康供体来源的巨噬细胞与患者来源的类器官和肿瘤类器官（PDOs和PDTs）以及匹配的正常成纤维细胞（NFs）和癌症相关成纤维细胞（CAFs）整合。这些多细胞模型使得在肿瘤和邻近正常组织环境中研究基质细胞、上皮细胞和免疫细胞之间的相互作用成为可能。结果

  共培养系统重现了与肿瘤和邻近正常环境相关的不同巨噬细胞状态，并确定成纤维细胞是巨噬细胞表型的主要调节因子。CAFs促进了巨噬细胞代谢重塑，其特征是脂质处理改变和TAM样特征的富集。机制上，我们确定了血小板反应蛋白1（TSP1）是一种与代谢启动相关的CAF分泌因子。重组TSP1诱导了短暂的脂质积累，随后是线粒体重塑。在肿瘤共培养条件下，CD36抑制减少了巨噬细胞中的脂质积累，支持TSP1相关的脂质串扰在基质-免疫相互作用中的作用。结论

  我们的研究建立了先进的患者来源共培养模型作为研究人类TAM生物学和结直肠癌（CRC）中基质-免疫相互作用的平台。利用这些系统，我们确定了与巨噬细胞代谢重塑和TAM样极化相关的成纤维细胞相关TSP1-脂质轴，强调了基质代谢通讯作为CRC微环境中潜在的可靶向特征。图形摘要

title: Enterovirus-driven interferon signaling induces epithelial TG2 via JAK-STAT: Implications for the onset of celiac disease
titleZh: 肠道病毒驱动的干扰素信号通过JAK-STAT诱导上皮TG2：对乳糜泻发病的影响
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Le HH, Räkköläinen V, Davidsson R, Dotsenko V, Diaz LM, Khojine AS, Virtanen A, Laiho JE, Khosla C, Silvennoinen O, Hyöty H, Viiri K, the HEDIMED Investigator group.
abstract:
ABSTRACT

  Background & Aims

  Celiac disease (CeD) is an autoimmune disorder triggered by dietary gluten in genetically predisposed individuals, but environmental factors contributing to disease onset remain incompletely defined. Epidemiological studies implicate enterovirus infections as potential triggers. Here, we investigated the epithelial-intrinsic mechanisms by which coxsackievirus B1 (CVB1) infection may prime the intestine for CeD. Methods

  Human intestinal organoids were infected with CVB1 and analyzed using single-cell RNA sequencing to resolve lineage-specific responses. Interferon signaling and transglutaminase 2 (TG2) regulation were interrogated using type I interferon stimulation and pharmacologic JAK inhibition. Results

  CVB1 infection induced a robust epithelial antiviral program dominated by type I interferon signaling. This response was accompanied by marked upregulation of TG2 expression and enzymatic activity. Single-cell analysis localized TG2 induction to immature goblet-lineage cells, which exhibited strong interferon-stimulated gene activation and epithelial stress signatures. Mechanistically, IFN-α/β stimulation was sufficient to induce TG2 via JAK–STAT signaling, while JAK inhibition effectively suppressed both TG2 expression and activity. In parallel, CVB1 infection triggered coordinated mucin remodeling, including induction of MUC5AC, indicating interferon-linked epithelial reprogramming. Notably, these effects occurred independently of immune cell involvement, highlighting a cell-intrinsic pathway. Conclusion

  Our findings identify a direct epithelial mechanism linking enterovirus infection to TG2 activation via interferon-driven JAK–STAT signaling. This pathway provides a mechanistic bridge between viral infection and gluten peptide modification, a critical step in the onset of CeD. The reversibility of TG2 induction by JAK inhibition suggests a potential strategy to prevent virus-mediated priming of celiac disease.
abstractZh:
摘要

  背景与目的

  乳糜泻（CeD）是一种由遗传易感个体摄入膳食麸质引发的自身免疫性疾病，但导致疾病发生的环境因素仍未完全明确。流行病学研究提示肠道病毒感染是潜在诱因。在此，我们研究了柯萨奇病毒B1（CVB1）感染可能通过上皮内在机制为肠道发生CeD做准备。方法

  用人肠道类器官感染CVB1，并使用单细胞RNA测序分析以解析谱系特异性反应。通过I型干扰素刺激和药理学JAK抑制，探究干扰素信号和转谷氨酰胺酶2（TG2）的调控。结果

  CVB1感染诱导了以I型干扰素信号为主的上皮抗病毒程序的强烈激活。该反应伴随TG2表达和酶活性的显著上调。单细胞分析将TG2诱导定位至未成熟杯状细胞谱系细胞，这些细胞表现出强烈的干扰素刺激基因激活和上皮应激特征。机制上，IFN-α/β刺激足以通过JAK–STAT信号诱导TG2，而JAK抑制可有效抑制TG2的表达和活性。同时，CVB1感染触发了协调的黏蛋白重塑，包括MUC5AC的诱导，表明干扰素相关的上皮重编程。值得注意的是，这些效应在无免疫细胞参与的情况下发生，凸显了细胞内在通路。结论

  我们的发现确定了一种直接的上皮机制，将肠道病毒感染与通过干扰素驱动的JAK–STAT信号激活TG2联系起来。该通路为病毒感染与麸质肽修饰之间提供了机制桥梁，这是CeD发病的关键步骤。JAK抑制对TG2诱导的可逆性提示了一种预防病毒介导的乳糜泻启动的潜在策略。

title: Human models of GLE1-associated LCCS1 reveal neural crest deficiency and multisystem developmental failure accompanied by altered RNA metabolism
titleZh: GLE1相关LCCS1的人类模型揭示神经嵴缺陷和多系统发育失败伴随RNA代谢改变
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Zárybnický T, Mäkelä OJ, Balatsou A, Yalcin SR, Lindfors S, Metso S, Sartori Maldonado R, Gregorová P, Väänänen J, Rekonen L, Bůtorová K, Sarin PL, Wartiovaara K, Tyynismaa H, Pakkasjärvi N, Kuure S.
abstract: Lethal congenital contracture syndrome 1 (LCCS1) is a neurodevelopmental disorder caused by  GLE1 c.432-10A>G variant and presenting fetal akinesia, defects in anterior horn spinal cord, skin, skull, and skeletal muscle development. The uniform prenatal lethality of LCCS1 limits access to patient material, thereby hindering mechanistic studies in physiologically relevant models. To overcome this, human embryonic stem cells (hESCs) carrying the LCCS1 variant, patient-derived fetal fibroblasts, and transcriptomic and proteomic profiling were utilized to examine early GLE1 dysfunction in human cells and tissues. Across LCCS1 cell types, reduced global transcription and translation were observed, while nucleocytoplasmic poly(A)+ RNA distribution was unchanged. Despite its context-dependent effects on proliferation, LCCS1 variant altered mRNA decay kinetics and increased stress granule formation in differentiated cells. LCCS1 hESCs retained core pluripotency but reduced choline acetyltransferase and β tubulin III levels, together with increased neurofilament inclusion incidence, indicate functional immaturity in differentiated spinal motor neurons. Differentiation of LCCS1 hESC-derived gastruloids uncovered broad perturbations in neuromuscular and neural crest derivative development, results which were supported by phenotypes detected in ectodermal organoids and fetal LCCS1 tissue. These findings provide new mechanistic insight into LCCS1 pathogenesis and establish a robust human model framework for studying neurodevelopmental disorders.
abstractZh: 致死性先天性挛缩综合征1型（LCCS1）是一种由GLE1 c.432-10A>G变异引起的神经发育障碍，表现为胎儿运动不能、脊髓前角、皮肤、颅骨和骨骼肌发育缺陷。LCCS1的均匀产前致死性限制了患者材料的获取，从而阻碍了在生理相关模型中的机制研究。为了克服这一点，利用携带LCCS1变异的人类胚胎干细胞（hESCs）、患者来源的胎儿成纤维细胞以及转录组和蛋白质组分析，来检查人类细胞和组织中早期GLE1功能障碍。在所有LCCS1细胞类型中，观察到整体转录和翻译减少，而核质poly(A)+ RNA分布未改变。尽管其对增殖有情境依赖性影响，LCCS1变异改变了mRNA decay动力学，并增加了分化细胞中应激颗粒的形成。LCCS1 hESCs保留了核心多能性，但降低了胆碱乙酰转移酶和β微管蛋白III水平，同时增加了神经丝包涵体的发生率，表明分化的脊髓运动神经元功能不成熟。LCCS1 hESC来源的胃泌素样结构分化揭示了神经肌肉和神经嵴衍生物发育的广泛扰动，这些结果得到了外胚层类器官和胎儿LCCS1组织中检测到的表型的支持。这些发现为LCCS1发病机制提供了新的机制见解，并为研究神经发育障碍建立了一个稳健的人类模型框架。

abstract: Single-cell transcriptomics has revolutionized our understanding of embryonic liver development by enabling high-resolution dissection of lineage specification and cellular interactions. In this review, we synthesize recent advances from scRNA sequencing, spatial transcriptomics, multi-omics integration, and organoid modeling, with attention to both human and mouse embryonic contexts. These studies have delineated the bifurcation of hepatoblasts into hepatocytes and cholangiocytes, uncovered Hepatobiliary hybrid progenitors (HHyPs), and highlighted signaling axes, such as Notch/TGF-β, WNT, and HGF, as key regulators of fate decisions. Importantly, non-parenchymal cells-including endothelial and stellate lineages-emerge as critical microenvironmental instructors, acting through ligand-receptor networks and spatial gradients. A new paradigm is thus emerging in which cell atlas construction, intercellular communication analysis, spatial validation, and organoid-based functional modeling form an iterative loop to decode developmental programs. Taken together, these insights mark a shift from descriptive cataloging to mechanistic dissection of liver organogenesis, providing a conceptual and methodological foundation for translational applications in congenital liver disease, tumor stratification, and regenerative medicine.
abstractZh: 单细胞转录组学通过实现谱系规范和细胞相互作用的高分辨率解析，彻底改变了我们对胚胎肝脏发育的理解。在这篇综述中，我们综合了来自单细胞RNA测序、空间转录组学、多组学整合和类器官建模的最新进展，并关注人类和小鼠胚胎背景。这些研究描绘了肝母细胞分化为肝细胞和胆管细胞的分叉，发现了肝胆混合祖细胞（HHyPs），并强调了Notch/TGF-β、WNT和HGF等信号轴作为命运决定的关键调节因子。重要的是，非实质细胞——包括内皮和星状谱系——作为关键的微环境指导者出现，通过配体-受体网络和空间梯度发挥作用。因此，一种新的范式正在出现，其中细胞图谱构建、细胞间通讯分析、空间验证和基于类器官的功能建模形成一个迭代循环，以解码发育程序。综上所述，这些见解标志着从描述性编目向肝脏器官发生的机制解析的转变，为先天性肝病、肿瘤分层和再生医学的转化应用提供了概念和方法学基础。

abstract: Tris(1,3-dichloro-2-propyl) phosphate (TDCPP) is a widely used organophosphate flame retardant that is ubiquitously detected in environmental matrices and human biological samples, raising concerns about its potential health risks. However, the mechanisms underlying TDCPP-induced hepatotoxicity remain incompletely understood. Here, we investigated the hepatic effects of TDCPP using an integrated in vivo-in vitro approach combining a mouse exposure model, human-derived 3D liver organoids, and network toxicology analysis. Sub-chronic oral exposure to TDCPP in mice induced evident liver injury, characterized by histopathological alterations, elevated serum aminotransferase activities, and hepatic triglyceride accumulation accompanied by systemic lipid metabolism disorders. TDCPP exposure also disrupted hepatic redox homeostasis, as evidenced by glutathione depletion, enhanced lipid peroxidation, and downregulation of glutathione peroxidase 4, a key suppressor of ferroptosis. Consistently, TDCPP exposure reduced cell viability, promoted lipid droplet accumulation, increased reactive oxygen species levels, and suppressed GPX4 expression in human 3D liver organoids, recapitulating the major pathological features observed in vivo. Network toxicology analysis identified peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARG) as a central node potentially involved in TDCPP-induced hepatotoxicity and ferroptosis, which was further supported by molecular docking analysis. Experimental validation confirmed that TDCPP exposure significantly upregulated PPARG expression in both mouse liver tissues and liver organoids. Overall, these findings indicate that TDCPP induces hepatic injury and lipid metabolic disturbance in association with ferroptosis, potentially mediated through a PPARG-GPX4 regulatory axis, providing human-relevant mechanistic insight into the hepatotoxic risk of this environmental contaminant.
abstractZh: 三(1,3-二氯-2-丙基)磷酸酯（TDCPP）是一种广泛使用的有机磷阻燃剂，在环境介质和人体生物样本中普遍存在，引发对其潜在健康风险的担忧。然而，TDCPP诱导肝毒性的机制仍未完全阐明。本研究采用体内-体外相结合的综合方法，结合小鼠暴露模型、人源3D肝类器官和网络毒理学分析，探讨了TDCPP的肝脏效应。小鼠亚慢性口服暴露于TDCPP可诱导明显的肝损伤，表现为组织病理学改变、血清转氨酶活性升高、肝脏甘油三酯蓄积，并伴随全身性脂质代谢紊乱。TDCPP暴露还破坏了肝脏氧化还原稳态，表现为谷胱甘肽耗竭、脂质过氧化增强，以及铁死亡关键抑制因子谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4（GPX4）的下调。一致地，TDCPP暴露降低了人3D肝类器官的细胞活力，促进了脂滴蓄积，增加了活性氧水平，并抑制了GPX4表达，重现了体内观察到的主要病理特征。网络毒理学分析确定过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（PPARG）为可能参与TDCPP诱导肝毒性和铁死亡的中心节点，分子对接分析进一步支持了这一发现。实验验证证实，TDCPP暴露在小鼠肝组织和肝类器官中均显著上调PPARG表达。总体而言，这些发现表明TDCPP诱导肝损伤和脂质代谢紊乱与铁死亡相关，可能通过PPARG-GPX4调控轴介导，为该环境污染物对人类的肝毒性风险提供了机制上的见解。

abstract: Current three-dimensional (3D) in vitro models fail to recapitulate the complexity and heterogeneity of the tumor microenvironment (TME), particularly the dynamic architecture of the extracellular matrix (ECM) and cell-matrix interactions critical to tumor progression. To address this, we have designed nanofibrous composite hydrogels by co-assembling peptide amphiphiles (PAs) with tumor-specific ECM macromolecules, including collagen type I, hyaluronan, laminin alpha 4, and fibronectin, enabling control over composition and nanofibre organization, including either randomly oriented (rPA) or aligned (aPA) nanofibers. These hydrogels recapitulate key biochemical composition, fibrillar architecture, and mechanical properties of the colorectal cancer TME (CRC-TME). Using colorectal cancer cell lines and patient-derived organoids (PDOs), we demonstrate that rPA-based hydrogels support long-term organoid growth (21 days), preserving tumor-specific morphology (compact, cystic structures) and transcriptional profiles characteristic of cell-ECM interactions compared to aPA hydrogels. Transcriptomic analysis revealed rPA-ECM hydrogels upregulate ECM remodeling genes while maintaining lineage-specific differentiation, enabling precise interrogation of matrix-driven signaling. By integrating tumor-specific ECM macromolecules with architecturally defined nanofibers, this platform bridges the gap between simplistic in vitro models and clinical tumor complexity. This approach offers a complex, yet defined and reproducible, platform with significant potential to recapitulate TMEs for personalized medicine.
abstractZh: 当前的三维（3D）体外模型未能重现肿瘤微环境（TME）的复杂性和异质性，尤其是对肿瘤进展至关重要的细胞外基质（ECM）的动态结构和细胞-基质相互作用。为解决这一问题，我们通过将肽两亲物（PAs）与肿瘤特异性ECM大分子（包括I型胶原、透明质酸、层粘连蛋白α4和纤连蛋白）共组装，设计了纳米纤维复合水凝胶，从而能够控制组成和纳米纤维组织，包括随机取向（rPA）或对齐（aPA）的纳米纤维。这些水凝胶重现了结直肠癌TME（CRC-TME）的关键生化组成、纤维结构和力学性能。使用结直肠癌细胞系和患者来源的类器官（PDOs），我们证明基于rPA的水凝胶支持长期类器官生长（21天），与aPA水凝胶相比，保留了肿瘤特异性形态（致密、囊性结构）以及细胞-ECM相互作用的转录特征。转录组分析显示，rPA-ECM水凝胶上调ECM重塑基因，同时维持谱系特异性分化，从而能够精确研究基质驱动的信号传导。通过将肿瘤特异性ECM大分子与结构明确的纳米纤维相结合，该平台弥合了简单体外模型与临床肿瘤复杂性之间的差距。这种方法提供了一个复杂但明确且可重复的平台，在重现TME用于个性化医疗方面具有巨大潜力。

abstract: On November 2025, AAPS PharmSci 360 convened a symposium that included experts in the application of various types of New Approach Methodologies (NAMs). They shared their experiences and insights on topics that included microphysiological systems (MPS), the use of 3D organoids, and in silico tools. MPS systems were explored from the perspective of their testing and qualification through an academia-industry-government tissue chip testing consortium whose mission is to perform context-of-use-based testing of MPS and conduct comparative evaluations to support the use of MPS systems in safety assessments. 3D organoids were described and insights shared on how and when they may provide an appropriate tool for evaluating drug safety and effectiveness, and their use in supporting personalized medicine. Regarding in silico tools, examples were provided to describe their growing utility in predicting drug toxicity, population variability, and its potential benefits over traditional evidence-based toxicology. These tools include in silico models (e.g., physiologically based pharmacokinetic models), Artificial Intelligence (AI), and Machine Learning (ML) which, unlike other aspects of model informed drug development, reduce reliance on predefined models and allows for the integration of diverse sources of data. Computationally, these tools can generate predictions in hours where it would otherwise have taken weeks or months (and extensive experimentation). Within this meeting report, we highlight the key issues discussed during that symposium and share additional aspects to consider when developing a NAMs-based roadmap for specific contexts of use.
abstractZh: 2025年11月，AAPS PharmSci 360召开了一次研讨会，邀请了在应用各种类型新方法学（NAMs）方面的专家参加。他们分享了在微生理系统（MPS）、3D类器官的使用以及计算机模拟工具等主题上的经验和见解。从学术界-工业界-政府组织组成的组织芯片测试联盟的角度探讨了MPS系统的测试和资格认证，该联盟的使命是基于使用情境对MPS进行测试，并进行比较评估以支持MPS系统在安全性评估中的应用。描述了3D类器官，并分享了关于它们如何以及何时可以作为评估药物安全性和有效性的适当工具，以及它们在支持个性化医疗中的使用的见解。关于计算机模拟工具，提供了示例来描述它们在预测药物毒性、人群变异性方面的日益增长的实用性，以及相对于传统循证毒理学的潜在优势。这些工具包括计算机模拟模型（例如，基于生理的药代动力学模型）、人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML），与模型引导的药物开发的其他方面不同，它们减少了对预定义模型的依赖，并允许整合多种数据来源。在计算上，这些工具可以在几小时内生成预测，而传统方法可能需要数周或数月（以及大量实验）。在本会议报告中，我们重点介绍了该研讨会期间讨论的关键问题，并分享了在针对特定使用情境制定基于NAMs的路线图时需要考虑的其他方面。

abstract: Emerging evidence demonstrates the pivotal role played by the tumor microenvironment, particularly cancer-associated fibroblasts, during the development of castration-resistant prostate cancer. In this study, the molecular composition of the tumor microenvironment of androgen-sensitive and castration-resistant metastatic prostate cancer is investigated by utilizing patient-derived xenograft models. Transcriptomic and histological analysis identify the presence of a pro-fibrotic stroma in the castration-resistant (LAPC9) versus the castration-sensitive (PNPCa, BM18) models, characterized by high levels of collagen and tenascin C deposition and upregulation of inflammatory markers. Intra-tumoral collagen- and tenascin-positive stromal areas specifically correlate with higher tumor invasiveness. Master regulator analysis identifies the transcription factor PU.1 as a mediator of the LAPC9 pro-fibrotic phenotype, whose transcriptional activity can be specifically inhibited by the small molecule DB1976. To test the effect of pharmacologic PU.1 inhibition a novel organoid-fibroblast 3D co-culture system, able to mimic features of the in vivo tumor microenvironment, is established. Inhibition of stromal PU.1 activity reverts the pro-fibrotic phenotype and, in turn, reduces tumor organoid growth. Besides identifying a novel molecular player of the pro-fibrotic stromal phenotype in prostate cancer, this study highlights the applicability of 3D tumor organoid-fibroblast co-cultures as in vitro tools to test the effect of stromal-targeting compounds.
abstractZh: 新兴证据表明，肿瘤微环境，特别是癌症相关成纤维细胞，在去势抵抗性前列腺癌的发展过程中发挥着关键作用。本研究利用患者来源的异种移植模型，研究了雄激素敏感性和去势抵抗性转移性前列腺癌的肿瘤微环境的分子组成。转录组学和组织学分析确定了去势抵抗性（LAPC9）与去势敏感性（PNPCa，BM18）模型中促纤维化基质的存在，其特征是高水平的胶原蛋白和腱生蛋白C沉积以及炎症标志物的上调。肿瘤内胶原蛋白和腱生蛋白阳性的基质区域与更高的肿瘤侵袭性特异性相关。主调控因子分析确定了转录因子PU.1是LAPC9促纤维化表型的介导因子，其转录活性可被小分子DB1976特异性抑制。为了测试药理学抑制PU.1的效果，建立了一种新型的类器官-成纤维细胞3D共培养系统，该系统能够模拟体内肿瘤微环境的特征。抑制基质PU.1活性可逆转促纤维化表型，进而减少肿瘤类器官的生长。除了确定前列腺癌促纤维化基质表型的一个新的分子参与者外，本研究还强调了3D肿瘤类器官-成纤维细胞共培养作为体外工具来测试靶向基质化合物效果的适用性。

abstract: Suppressed NMDA receptor (NMDAR) function contributes to multiple brain disorders, including schizophrenia, autism spectrum disorder (ASD), and NMDAR encephalitis. Previous attempts to restore NMDAR activity by increasing ambient glycine, a critical co-agonist, through GlyT1 inhibition have yielded mixed outcomes, partly due to GlyT1's extensive expression in essential brainstem regions. Slc6a20a, a glycine transporter widely expressed in cognition-relevant regions such as the cortex and hippocampus, offers a targeted alternative. Here we show that antisense oligonucleotide (ASO)-mediated Slc6a20a inhibition (Slc6a20a-ASO) normalizes ASD-related phenotypes in male Shank2- and Shank3-mutant mice, with model-dependent rescue profiles. Slc6a20a-ASO rescues NMDAR hypofunction and synaptic phospho-proteomic profiles in the prefrontal cortex. Furthermore, ASO targeting human SLC6A20 rescues suppressed NMDAR function in cortical organoids harboring SHANK2 or SHANK3 mutations. These findings underscore the potential and limitations of Slc6a20a/SLC6A20-ASO for treating disorders characterized by NMDAR hypofunction.
abstractZh: NMDA受体（NMDAR）功能受抑制与多种脑部疾病有关，包括精神分裂症、自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）和NMDAR脑炎。以往通过抑制GlyT1来增加环境甘氨酸（一种关键的共激动剂）以恢复NMDAR活性的尝试结果不一，部分原因是GlyT1在脑干关键区域广泛表达。Slc6a20a是一种在皮层和海马等认知相关区域广泛表达的甘氨酸转运体，提供了一个靶向替代方案。在此我们显示，反义寡核苷酸（ASO）介导的Slc6a20a抑制（Slc6a20a-ASO）可正常化雄性Shank2和Shank3突变小鼠的ASD相关表型，且具有模型依赖性的拯救特征。Slc6a20a-ASO可拯救前额叶皮层中的NMDAR功能低下和突触磷酸化蛋白质组谱。此外，靶向人类SLC6A20的ASO可拯救携带SHANK2或SHANK3突变的皮层类器官中受抑制的NMDAR功能。这些发现强调了Slc6a20a/SLC6A20-ASO在治疗以NMDAR功能低下为特征的疾病中的潜力和局限性。

abstract: The fovea is a region of the human retina specialized for high-acuity vision, with a high density of cones and no rod photoreceptors. Recent studies using retinal organoids indicate that retinoic acid (RA) may play a key role in foveal development: low RA levels in the fovea, maintained by CYP26A1, lead to early cell cycle exit for progenitors and a low rod-to-cone ratio. To test this model in fetal human development, we studied human fetal retina in 3D cultures in the presence of RA and RA inhibitors. We find that inhibition of RA reduces retinal progenitor proliferation and rod development, while a high concentration of RA promotes rod fate and represses cone opsin expression. Moreover, inhibition of RA signaling promotes expression of M/L-opsins over S-opsin, a feature of the fovea. Our results demonstrate that RA levels control several key features of foveal development in human fetal retina.
abstractZh: 中央凹是人类视网膜中专门用于高敏锐度视觉的区域，具有高密度的视锥细胞且没有视杆细胞。最近使用视网膜类器官的研究表明，维甲酸（RA）可能在中央凹发育中发挥关键作用：由CYP26A1维持的中央凹低RA水平导致祖细胞提前退出细胞周期，并产生低视杆细胞与视锥细胞比例。为了在胎儿人类发育中测试该模型，我们在3D培养中研究了存在RA和RA抑制剂的人类胎儿视网膜。我们发现，抑制RA会减少视网膜祖细胞增殖和视杆细胞发育，而高浓度RA则促进视杆细胞命运并抑制视锥细胞视蛋白表达。此外，抑制RA信号传导可促进M/L视蛋白而非S视蛋白的表达，这是中央凹的一个特征。我们的结果表明，RA水平控制人类胎儿视网膜中央凹发育的几个关键特征。

title: Outer membrane vesicles secreted by Bacteroides fragilis inhibit CFTR chloride secretion by human colon organoids.

abstract: The goals of this study were to develop a model to study host-pathogen interactions in primary human colon organoids and to test the hypothesis that Bacteroides fragilis toxin (BFT-2) secreted in outer membrane vesicles (OMVs) modulates mucosal immunity and CFTR Cl⁻ secretion. Since Bacteroides species reside in mucus, OMVs are likely to represent a mechanism of communication between Bacteroides and the host. Two strains of Bacteroides were studied: enterotoxigenic Bacteroides fragilis (ETBF), which produces BFT-2, and the non-toxigenic Bacteroides fragilis strain NCTC 9343 (NTBF), which does not produce BFT-2. We also utilized two additional strains of Bacteroides fragilis: one in which bft-2 was knocked out (ETBF Δbft) and one that was engineered to contain bft-2 (NTBF+bft). We report that Bacteroides fragilis OMVs reduced CFTR Cl⁻ secretion, but had no effect on tight junction or cell adhesion proteins, transepithelial resistance (TER), or cytokine secretion by primary human colon organoids. NTBF OMVs containing BFT-2 were more effective in reducing CFTR Cl- secretion than NTBF lacking BFT-2. By contrast, deletion of bft in ETBF did not have a significant effect on CFTR Cl⁻ secretion compared to ETBF. We conclude that OMVs secreted by Bacteroides can be an important mechanism of host-pathogen interactions in the colon by reducing CFTR Cl⁻ secretion, and that the effect of BFT-2 on CFTR Cl⁻ secretion is dependent on the strain of Bacteroides fragilis.
abstractZh: 本研究的目标是建立模型以研究原代人结肠类器官中的宿主-病原体相互作用，并检验脆弱拟杆菌毒素（BFT-2）在外膜囊泡（OMVs）中分泌是否调节黏膜免疫和CFTR Cl⁻分泌的假设。由于拟杆菌属物种存在于黏液中，OMVs可能代表了拟杆菌与宿主之间的一种通讯机制。研究了两种拟杆菌菌株：产肠毒素脆弱拟杆菌（ETBF），其产生BFT-2，以及不产生BFT-2的非产毒脆弱拟杆菌菌株NCTC 9343（NTBF）。我们还使用了另外两种脆弱拟杆菌菌株：一种敲除了bft-2（ETBF Δbft），另一种经工程改造含有bft-2（NTBF+bft）。我们报告，脆弱拟杆菌OMVs减少了CFTR Cl⁻分泌，但对原代人结肠类器官的紧密连接或细胞黏附蛋白、跨上皮电阻（TER）或细胞因子分泌没有影响。含有BFT-2的NTBF OMVs在减少CFTR Cl⁻分泌方面比不含BFT-2的NTBF更有效。相比之下，与ETBF相比，ETBF中bft的缺失对CFTR Cl⁻分泌没有显著影响。我们得出结论，拟杆菌分泌的OMVs通过减少CFTR Cl⁻分泌，可能是结肠中宿主-病原体相互作用的重要机制，且BFT-2对CFTR Cl⁻分泌的影响取决于脆弱拟杆菌的菌株。

title: Modeling Fabry nephropathy: insights from experimental systems towards precision nephrology.

abstract: Fabry nephropathy is a major cause of kidney failure in Fabry disease, caused by pathogenic GLA variants that reduce α-galactosidase A activity and lead to globotriaosylceramide (Gb3) accumulation. In recent years, rapid advances in experimental modeling and emerging therapeutic strategies have dramatically reshaped understanding and treatment prospects for Fabry nephropathy. Experimental models - including cellular systems, patient-derived kidney organoids, and animal models such as zebrafish, Drosophila, mice and rats - have been pivotal in elucidating classic Gb3-dependent and novel Gb3-independent pathogenic mechanisms. These insights challenge the traditional Gb3-centric paradigm by highlighting other contributors, such as its metabolite lyso-Gb3, as well as α-synuclein accumulation and endothelial dysfunction. Despite established therapies for Fabry nephropathy, such as enzyme replacement and pharmacological chaperones, disease progression remains a clinical challenge, underscoring the urgent need for deeper mechanistic understanding and precision medicine approaches. This timely Review summarizes diverse model systems' unique strengths, limitations and translational potential to guide future research and therapeutic development for this complex disease.
abstractZh: 法布里肾病是法布里病导致肾功能衰竭的主要原因，由致病性GLA变异引起，这些变异降低α-半乳糖苷酶A活性并导致球三糖神经酰胺（Gb3）积累。近年来，实验建模和新兴治疗策略的快速进展极大地重塑了对法布里肾病的理解和治疗前景。实验模型——包括细胞系统、患者来源的肾脏类器官以及斑马鱼、果蝇、小鼠和大鼠等动物模型——在阐明经典的Gb3依赖性和新型Gb3非依赖性致病机制方面发挥了关键作用。这些见解通过强调其他因素，如其代谢物lyso-Gb3，以及α-突触核蛋白积累和内皮功能障碍，挑战了传统的以Gb3为中心的范式。尽管法布里肾病已有既定疗法，如酶替代疗法和药理学伴侣，但疾病进展仍然是临床挑战，强调了对更深入机制理解和精准医学方法的迫切需求。这篇及时的综述总结了不同模型系统的独特优势、局限性和转化潜力，以指导未来针对这种复杂疾病的研究和治疗开发。

title: Breathing life into fibrosis research: precision-cut lung slices, organoids, and organs-on-chip as transformative models.

abstract: Pulmonary fibrosis represents one of the most challenging frontiers in respiratory medicine, characterized by progressive scarring that ultimately leads to respiratory failure and death. Despite decades of research, therapeutic options remain frustratingly limited, with only three Food and Drug Administration-approved agents that merely slow disease progression without reversing established fibrosis. This therapeutic impasse stems largely from the translational disconnect between traditional preclinical models and human disease complexity. Animal models fail to recapitulate the chronic, progressive nature of human fibrosis, while conventional cell culture systems cannot capture the intricate three-dimensional architecture and multicellular interactions that drive fibrotic remodeling. The emergence of new approach methodologies has catalyzed a paradigm shift in pulmonary fibrosis research, offering unprecedented opportunities to model human disease with greater fidelity. This review examines three revolutionary platforms that are reshaping our understanding of fibrotic mechanisms: precision-cut lung slices that preserve native tissue architecture, self-organizing lung organoids that enable patient-specific disease modeling, and microfluidic lung-on-chip systems that recreate physiological breathing mechanics. We critically evaluate the unique capabilities and inherent limitations of each technology, explore their applications in mechanistic studies and drug discovery, and discuss emerging hybrid approaches that promise to accelerate therapeutic development. By synthesizing current evidence and identifying future directions, this review provides a roadmap for leveraging these innovative technologies to finally break through the therapeutic ceiling in pulmonary fibrosis.
abstractZh: 肺纤维化是呼吸医学中最具挑战性的前沿领域之一，其特征是进行性瘢痕形成，最终导致呼吸衰竭和死亡。尽管经过数十年的研究，治疗选择仍然非常有限，只有三种美国食品药品监督管理局批准的药物，它们仅能减缓疾病进展，而不能逆转已形成的纤维化。这种治疗僵局主要源于传统临床前模型与人类疾病复杂性之间的转化脱节。动物模型无法重现人类纤维化的慢性、进行性特征，而传统细胞培养系统无法捕捉驱动纤维化重塑的复杂三维结构和多细胞相互作用。新方法学的出现催化了肺纤维化研究的范式转变，为以更高保真度模拟人类疾病提供了前所未有的机会。本综述探讨了三个正在重塑我们对纤维化机制理解的革命性平台：保留天然组织结构的精密切片肺片、能够实现患者特异性疾病建模的自组织肺类器官，以及重现生理呼吸力学的微流控肺芯片系统。我们批判性地评估了每种技术的独特能力和固有局限性，探讨了它们在机制研究和药物发现中的应用，并讨论了有望加速治疗开发的新兴混合方法。通过综合现有证据并确定未来方向，本综述为利用这些创新技术最终突破肺纤维化治疗上限提供了路线图。

abstract: Hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy (HIPEC) is widely performed for treating peritoneal malignancies, yet its clinical application remains limited by insufficient efficacies and risks in chemotherapy-associated side effects. This study demonstrates that mild hyperthermia enhances cancer cell sensitivity to hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) and Ca2+ exposure while sparing normal cells at both elevated and physiological temperatures. Mechanistically, mild hyperthermia promotes H2O2 cellular entry, synergistically activating calcium channels in the plasma membrane and endoplasmic reticulum to induce Ca2+-overload-dependent cancer cell necroptosis. Using H2O2 and Ca2+ solution as a thermo-sensitive necroptosis-inducing perfusate (TNIP), peritoneal perfusion at 43°C demonstrates stronger suppressive effects on the growth of multiple peritoneal tumors in mice compared to conventional HIPEC using various chemotherapeutics. TNIP-mediated hyperthermic intraperitoneal treatment also elicits robust antitumor immunity in syngeneic murine models, with enhanced therapeutic efficacy when combined with postoperative immune checkpoint blockade therapy. The superior immune activation capacities of this strategy are further validated in patient-derived organoids. This work establishes a chemo-free, thermo-activated immunogenic perfusion strategy to selectively trigger cancer cell necroptosis, demonstrating a translatable hyperthermic intraperitoneal immunotherapy with improved therapeutic efficacy and safety.
abstractZh: 腹腔热灌注化疗（HIPEC）广泛用于治疗腹膜恶性肿瘤，但其临床应用仍受限于疗效不足和化疗相关副作用的风险。本研究表明，温和热疗可增强癌细胞对过氧化氢（H2O2）和Ca2+暴露的敏感性，同时在升高的温度和生理温度下均不损伤正常细胞。机制上，温和热疗促进H2O2进入细胞，协同激活质膜和内质网中的钙通道，诱导Ca2+超载依赖性癌细胞坏死性凋亡。使用H2O2和Ca2+溶液作为热敏感坏死性诱导灌注液（TNIP），在43°C下进行腹腔灌注，对小鼠多种腹膜肿瘤生长的抑制作用强于使用多种化疗药物的常规HIPEC。TNIP介导的腹腔热灌注治疗在同基因小鼠模型中也引发了强大的抗肿瘤免疫，与术后免疫检查点阻断疗法联合使用时，治疗效果进一步增强。该策略优越的免疫激活能力在患者来源的类器官中得到了进一步验证。这项工作建立了一种无化疗、热激活的免疫原性灌注策略，选择性触发癌细胞坏死性凋亡，展示了一种可转化的腹腔热灌注免疫治疗，具有更高的疗效和安全性。

abstract: The novel models represented by organoids are becoming the key approach to solve the ethical and efficiency problems in drug development, but the effective and low-cost models are still urgently needed. The breakthrough development of artificial cell (AC) technology and synthetic biology has made it possible. In this study, a novel AC for evaluating the efficacy of various antitumor drugs is fabricated by combining cell membrane bionic technology and in situ synthetic biology. After entering ACs, antitumor drugs targeting nucleic acid affect the gene transcription of an artificially designed ribozyme that can catalyze the cleavage of molecular beacons and generate fluorescence signals in situ, indicating the efficacy of antitumor drugs at the cellular level. Specifically, ACs constructed with cell membranes containing drug-resistant proteins show significant drug inhibition, and the 3D coded ACs established based on this method are capable of classifying cell-specific characteristics more accurately to provide support for targeted drug therapy. This platform for in situ pharmacodynamic analysis not only demonstrates the individualized penetration ability of tumor heterogeneous packaging membranes in response to tumor drugs but also fills the gap between non-living and living experiments as a supplementary strategy.
abstractZh: 以类器官为代表的新型模型正成为解决药物开发中伦理和效率问题的关键途径，但仍迫切需要有效且低成本的模型。人工细胞（AC）技术和合成生物学的突破性发展使这成为可能。本研究通过结合细胞膜仿生技术和原位合成生物学，制造了一种用于评估各种抗肿瘤药物疗效的新型AC。进入AC后，靶向核酸的抗肿瘤药物影响人工设计的核酶基因转录，该核酶可催化分子信标的切割并在原位产生荧光信号，从而在细胞水平上指示抗肿瘤药物的疗效。具体而言，用含有耐药蛋白的细胞膜构建的AC显示出显著的药物抑制作用，基于该方法建立的三维编码AC能够更准确地对细胞特异性特征进行分类，为靶向药物治疗提供支持。这种原位药效分析平台不仅展示了肿瘤异质性包装膜对肿瘤药物反应的个体化渗透能力，而且作为补充策略填补了非活体与活体实验之间的空白。

abstract: Lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) is a leading cause of cancer-related mortality, driven by extensive tumor heterogeneity and therapy resistance. Conventional models fail to capture the dynamic interactions between cancer cells and the tumor microenvironment (TME), limiting therapeutic advancements. Here, we present a tricomponent organoid platform integrating patient-derived lung cancer tumoroids (LCTs), normal lung organoids (LOs), and field-cancerized fibroblasts to dissect LUAD heterogeneity and treatment resistance mechanisms. This platform uniquely enables the simultaneous investigation of tumor-specific vulnerabilities, stromal contributions to drug resistance, and normal tissue toxicity. Spatial and bulk transcriptomic analyses reveal LUAD-specific gene signatures and highlight cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) as key drivers of a pro-tumorigenic TME, reinforcing tumor survival and recurrence. Functional drug screening demonstrates that LCTs exhibit selective sensitivity to pemetrexed while fibroblasts remain universally resistant, underscoring stromal barriers to therapy. The inclusion of LOs allows direct assessment of drug toxicity on healthy lung tissue, bridging a critical gap in preclinical modeling. By capturing the tumor-stroma interplay with patient specificity, this organoid platform advances precision oncology, paving the way for more effective therapeutic strategies targeting both LUAD cells and the supportive microenvironment.
abstractZh: 肺腺癌（LUAD）是癌症相关死亡的主要原因，由广泛的肿瘤异质性和治疗耐药性驱动。传统模型无法捕捉癌细胞与肿瘤微环境（TME）之间的动态相互作用，限制了治疗进展。在此，我们提出一个三组分器官平台，整合患者来源的肺癌类肿瘤（LCTs）、正常肺类器官（LOs）和场癌化成纤维细胞，以剖析LUAD异质性和治疗耐药机制。该平台独特地能够同时研究肿瘤特异性脆弱性、基质对耐药性的贡献以及正常组织毒性。空间和批量转录组分析揭示了LUAD特异性基因特征，并强调癌症相关成纤维细胞（CAFs）是促肿瘤TME的关键驱动因素，增强肿瘤存活和复发。功能性药物筛选表明，LCTs对培美曲塞表现出选择性敏感性，而成纤维细胞普遍耐药，强调了基质对治疗的屏障。包含LOs允许直接评估药物对健康肺组织的毒性，弥合了临床前建模中的关键差距。通过以患者特异性捕捉肿瘤-基质相互作用，该器官平台推进了精准肿瘤学，为针对LUAD细胞和支持性微环境的更有效治疗策略铺平了道路。

title: Enterovirus D68 VP1 and VP3 Determine Neurotropism in Human Spinal Cord Organoids.
titleZh: 肠道病毒D68 VP1和VP3决定人脊髓类器官中的嗜神经性。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）

abstract: Enterovirus D68 (EV-D68) is a non-polio enterovirus that can cause a polio-like paralysis condition, acute flaccid myelitis (AFM). EV-D68-associated AFM cases waned in the US after 2018, and the reasons for this are unknown. It has recently been demonstrated that EV-D68 containing point mutations in viral structural proteins VP1 and VP3 resulted in decreased paralysis in different neonatal mouse models. However, phenotypes of these mutations in a human multicellular central nervous system (CNS) model are unknown. We hypothesize that mutations in VP1 and VP3 will similarly direct neurotropism in human spinal cord organoids (hSCOs). To investigate this, we recreated viruses with mutations in VP3 (I88V) or VP1 (L1I/N2D/T98A/E283K or L1P/V148A/K282R) and infected hSCOs. We found that VP3 I88V and VP1 L1I/N2D/T98A/E283K resulted in decreased titer and viral protein staining, consistent with attenuated neurovirulence in previously published murine models. We also found through immunofluorescence that VP1 L1P/V148/K282R mutations altered cellular tropism, primarily infecting glial cells rather than neuronal cells. When these mutations were combined, their effects on neurotropism were not additive. Sequence analysis of recently circulating EV-D68 strains reveals that VP3 I88 and VP1 E283 have remained the dominant amino acid residues since 2014, whereas VP1 sites 1, 2, and 98 have higher population diversity, indicating that these residues may be contributing to newly reduced neurovirulence after 2018.
abstractZh: 肠道病毒D68（EV-D68）是一种非脊髓灰质炎肠道病毒，可引起类似脊髓灰质炎的麻痹性疾病，即急性弛缓性脊髓炎（AFM）。2018年后，美国与EV-D68相关的AFM病例减少，其原因尚不清楚。最近的研究表明，含有病毒结构蛋白VP1和VP3点突变的EV-D68在不同新生小鼠模型中导致麻痹症状减轻。然而，这些突变在人类多细胞中枢神经系统（CNS）模型中的表型尚不清楚。我们假设VP1和VP3中的突变同样会引导人脊髓类器官（hSCOs）中的嗜神经性。为了研究这一点，我们构建了带有VP3（I88V）或VP1（L1I/N2D/T98A/E283K或L1P/V148A/K282R）突变的病毒，并感染了hSCOs。我们发现VP3 I88V和VP1 L1I/N2D/T98A/E283K导致病毒滴度和病毒蛋白染色降低，与先前发表的鼠模型中神经毒力减弱一致。我们还通过免疫荧光发现，VP1 L1P/V148/K282R突变改变了细胞嗜性，主要感染胶质细胞而非神经元细胞。当这些突变组合时，它们对嗜神经性的影响并非叠加。对近期流行的EV-D68毒株的序列分析显示，自2014年以来，VP3 I88和VP1 E283一直是主要氨基酸残基，而VP1位点1、2和98具有更高的群体多样性，表明这些残基可能促成了2018年后新出现的神经毒力降低。

title: The role of NAD<sup>+</sup> metabolic reprogramming in colorectal cancer chemoresistance: mechanistic insights, clinical translation challenges and opportunities.
titleZh: NAD<sup>+</sup>代谢重编程在结直肠癌化疗耐药中的作用：机制见解、临床转化挑战与机遇。

authors: Ma Z, Gong X, Liu F.

abstract: As a pivotal hub of cellular metabolism, NAD+ metabolic reprogramming exerts a core role in colorectal cancer chemoresistance by regulating energy metabolism, DNA repair, and the immune microenvironment. The dysregulation of synthetic and catabolic pathways mediated by key molecules such as NAMPT, SIRT1, and PARP constitutes a crucial mechanism underlying chemoresistance development. Targeted intervention strategies against NAD+ metabolism, including precursor supplementation, inhibitor administration, and combination therapy, have exhibited remarkable anti-cancer potential and represent promising translational strategies for reversing chemoresistance. However, clinical translation of these strategies is severely impeded by tumor metabolic heterogeneity, the lack of dynamic NAD+ monitoring technologies and insufficient tissue specificity of targeted drugs. By leveraging emerging techniques including multi-omics integration, organoid models, nano-delivery systems, and dynamic imaging, in-depth dissection of metabolic heterogeneity and development of personalized intervention regimens can provide novel and effective avenues to overcome the predicament of colorectal cancer chemoresistance, which holds important translational research value and clinical application significance.
abstractZh: 作为细胞代谢的关键枢纽，NAD+代谢重编程通过调节能量代谢、DNA修复和免疫微环境，在结直肠癌化疗耐药中发挥核心作用。由NAMPT、SIRT1和PARP等关键分子介导的合成和分解代谢途径的失调，是化疗耐药发生的关键机制。针对NAD+代谢的靶向干预策略，包括前体补充、抑制剂给药和联合治疗，已展现出显著的抗癌潜力，并代表了逆转化疗耐药的有前景的转化策略。然而，这些策略的临床转化受到肿瘤代谢异质性、缺乏动态NAD+监测技术以及靶向药物组织特异性不足的严重阻碍。通过利用多组学整合、类器官模型、纳米递送系统和动态成像等新兴技术，深入解析代谢异质性并制定个性化干预方案，可为克服结直肠癌化疗耐药的困境提供新颖有效的途径，这具有重要的转化研究价值和临床应用意义。

title: Hair follicle organoids: advances in construction, applications, and translational challenges.
titleZh: 毛囊类器官：构建、应用及转化挑战的进展。

abstract: Hair follicles (HFs) are complex mini-organs characterized by a highly organized structure and cyclic regeneration. In recent years, hair follicle organoids (HFOs) have emerged as promising three-dimensional in vitro models that partially recapitulate the architecture and function of native hair follicles, providing new opportunities for studying hair biology and related disorders. This review first outlines the key biological features of HFs and highlights the essential role of epithelial-mesenchymal interactions in folliculogenesis, which serve as the foundation for organoid construction. We then summarize the fundamental principles of organoid technology and systematically compare current strategies for HFO generation, including primary cell-based co-culture systems and induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived approaches, with an emphasis on their advantages and limitations. Furthermore, we discuss the applications of HFOs in disease modeling, drug screening, and regenerative medicine, while critically addressing current challenges such as difficulties in large-scale cultivation, limited maturity, and lack of standardization. Overall, HFOs represent a promising platform bridging basic research and clinical translation. Future efforts integrating biomaterials, microfluidic systems, and bioengineering technologies are expected to enhance their physiological relevance and accelerate their translational potential.
abstractZh: 毛囊（HFs）是复杂的微型器官，具有高度有序的结构和周期性再生的特点。近年来，毛囊类器官（HFOs）已成为有前景的三维体外模型，能够部分重现天然毛囊的结构和功能，为研究毛发生物学及相关疾病提供了新的机会。本综述首先概述了毛囊的关键生物学特征，并强调了上皮-间充质相互作用在毛囊发生中的重要作用，这构成了类器官构建的基础。随后，我们总结了类器官技术的基本原则，并系统比较了当前生成HFOs的策略，包括基于原代细胞的共培养系统和诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）来源的方法，重点阐述了它们的优势和局限性。此外，我们讨论了HFOs在疾病建模、药物筛选和再生医学中的应用，同时批判性地指出了当前面临的挑战，如大规模培养困难、成熟度有限和缺乏标准化。总体而言，HFOs代表了一个连接基础研究和临床转化的有前景的平台。未来整合生物材料、微流体系统和生物工程技术的努力有望增强其生理相关性并加速其转化潜力。

title: A microfluidic bone marrow model combining CFD and organ-on-a-chip technologies to study leukemia niche dynamics.

abstract:
Introduction

B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (B-ALL) disrupts the architecture and function of the bone marrow niche. However, current in vitro and in vivo models fail to fully capture the spatial, biochemical, and mechanical complexity of the native microenvironment. Here, we present a biomimetic bone marrow on-a-chip that integrates organ-on-a-chip technology, 3D hydrogel culture, and computational modeling to recreate the perivascular, central, and endosteal niches of human bone marrow.Methods

The Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) was used to guide the design and operation of the microdevice by predicting physiological interstitial flow within the culture system, enabling consistent mechanical stimuli as in vivo under conditions compatible with bone marrow physiology. The microdevice was fabricated using high-resolution 3D printing and soft lithography, and incorporates phaseguide structures for hydrogel confinement, the establishment of three distinct niches and continuous perfusion. Co-cultures of endothelial, stromal, osteoblast, and leukemic cells were maintained in a type I collagen matrix under dynamic conditions.Results/discussion

The platform supported high cell viability and enabled compartmentalized spatial organization of multicellular co-cultures. The presence of leukemic cells was associated with changes in soluble signaling molecules within the microenvironment, including increased levels of cytokines, chemokines, and growth factors such as IL-10, IL-13, TNF-α, CCL2, CCL3, CCL5, FGF, G-CSF, and GM-CSF. These patterns are consistent with signaling processes linked to immunoregulation, leukemic supportive signaling, and therapeutic resistance in B-ALL.Conclusion

Together, these findings indicate that the bone-marrow-on-a-chip captures relevant aspects of niche-associated signaling and provides a versatile platform for investigating leukemia microenvironment interactions, with potential in drug screening and preclinical model development.
abstractZh:
引言

B细胞急性淋巴细胞白血病（B-ALL）会破坏骨髓微环境的结构和功能。然而，目前的体外和体内模型未能完全捕捉天然微环境的空间、生化和机械复杂性。在此，我们提出了一种仿生骨髓芯片，该芯片整合了器官芯片技术、3D水凝胶培养和计算建模，以重建人骨髓的血管周围、中央和骨内膜微环境。方法

计算流体动力学（CFD）被用于指导微装置的设计和操作，通过预测培养系统内的生理性间质流动，在与骨髓生理学兼容的条件下提供与体内一致的机械刺激。该微装置采用高分辨率3D打印和软光刻技术制造，并包含用于水凝胶限制的相导结构、三个不同微环境的建立以及持续灌注。在内皮细胞、基质细胞、成骨细胞和白血病细胞的共培养中，使用I型胶原基质在动态条件下维持。结果/讨论

该平台支持高细胞活力，并实现了多细胞共培养的区室化空间组织。白血病细胞的存在与微环境内可溶性信号分子的变化相关，包括细胞因子、趋化因子和生长因子水平的升高，如IL-10、IL-13、TNF-α、CCL2、CCL3、CCL5、FGF、G-CSF和GM-CSF。这些模式与B-ALL中与免疫调节、白血病支持信号和治疗耐药相关的信号过程一致。结论

综合来看，这些发现表明骨髓芯片捕捉了微环境相关信号的相关方面，并为研究白血病微环境相互作用提供了一个多功能平台，在药物筛选和临床前模型开发中具有潜在应用价值。

title: A bibliometric analysis of resistance to PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors.
titleZh: PD-1/PD-L1抑制剂耐药性的文献计量分析

abstract:
Background

Programmed cell death protein 1 (PD-1) or Programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) inhibitors have already reformed cancer treatment by inhibiting tumor immune escape. However, as drug resistance emerges, their clinical application is limited. Numerous studies have explored mechanisms and methods to address resistance, yet an explicit bibliometric analysis of this field remains lacking.Methods

We systematically retrieved documents from the Web of Science Core Collection database and Scopus database. The timeline spans from January 1, 2006, to November 29, 2025. A comprehensive analysis was conducted using bibliometric tools. In addition, a secondary screening of the included studies was conducted to classify and analyze them based on their experimental models.Results

The bibliometric analysis of 2,122 studies shows a significant increase in research on resistance to PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors from 2006 to 2025. China leads in publication volume, while the United States ranks second but has more international collaboration. Institutions such as Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center are at the forefront of this research. The Journal of Clinical Oncology and Stephen L. Topalian were the most influential journal and author in this field, respectively. Keywords and reference analysis identify prospective hotspots, including "tumor microenvironment", "combination strategy", and "biomarker". Research on resistance to PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors is primarily based on observational cohort studies.Conclusion

This study examines the academic background and hotspots in PD-1/PD-L1 resistance. In the future, the tumor microenvironment will be explored to uncover novel mechanisms of resistance and to identify predictive biomarkers for patient stratification, while combination therapy strategies will be applied to overcome therapeutic resistance. More randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and research on patient-derived organoid systems are needed to accelerate clinical translation. By illuminating future trends, this study will serve as a crucial reference for scholars seeking to advance the field.
abstractZh:
背景

程序性细胞死亡蛋白1（PD-1）或程序性死亡配体1（PD-L1）抑制剂通过抑制肿瘤免疫逃逸，已经革新了癌症治疗。然而，随着耐药性的出现，其临床应用受到限制。大量研究探索了耐药机制和解决方法，但该领域仍缺乏明确的文献计量分析。方法

我们系统检索了Web of Science核心合集数据库和Scopus数据库中的文献。时间跨度为2006年1月1日至2025年11月29日。使用文献计量工具进行了全面分析。此外，对纳入的研究进行了二次筛选，并根据其实验模型进行分类和分析。结果

对2,122项研究的文献计量分析显示，2006年至2025年间，关于PD-1/PD-L1抑制剂耐药性的研究显著增加。中国在发表数量上领先，而美国排名第二，但国际合作更多。纪念斯隆凯特琳癌症中心等机构处于该研究的前沿。《临床肿瘤学杂志》和Stephen L. Topalian分别是该领域最具影响力的期刊和作者。关键词和参考文献分析确定了潜在的研究热点，包括“肿瘤微环境”、“联合策略”和“生物标志物”。关于PD-1/PD-L1抑制剂耐药性的研究主要基于观察性队列研究。结论

本研究考察了PD-1/PD-L1耐药性的学术背景和热点。未来，将探索肿瘤微环境以揭示新的耐药机制，并确定用于患者分层预测的生物标志物，同时应用联合治疗策略来克服治疗耐药性。需要更多随机对照试验（RCT）和基于患者来源类器官系统的研究，以加速临床转化。通过阐明未来趋势，本研究将为推动该领域发展的学者提供重要参考。

abstract:
Background

Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is one of the common causes of lower respiratory infections in infants. Cell lines and animals are major models for studying RSV, but single cell type and species differences make them difficult to mimic human physiological features. Stem cell-derived organoids contain multiple cell types similar to native organs and model the physiological conditions of native organs.Methods

We used human lung organoids (HLOs) to investigate RSV infection. Immunofluorescent (IF) staining performed at 48 and 96 h post-infection to verified RSV target cells. Pro-inflammatory factor expression was assessed by RT-qPCR and ELISA. TUNEL+ apoptotic cells, Ki67+ proliferating cells, filopodia-like structures, and CDH1 (E-cadherin) expression were quantified at 96 h post-infection.Results

RSV-infected cells included epithelial cells and PDGFRβ+ cells. RSV induced pro-inflammatory factors and elicited significant changes in cell fate: increased TUNEL+ cells indicating enhanced apoptosis, and decreased Ki67+ cells reflecting impaired cell proliferation. Furthermore, morphological changes were evident in the infected HLOs. F-actin staining revealed a marked increase in filopodia-like structures, whereas CDH1 expression was significantly reduced. These observations indicate that RSV infection affects both cytoskeletal integrity and cadherin-mediated cell junctions in HLOs.Conclusion

Our findings confirm HLOs provide a valuable model for studying RSV infection in vitro. HLOs infected with RSV have a similar cell distribution to native lung and provide evidence of actin cytoskeleton remodeling and impaired cell adhesion.
abstractZh:
背景

呼吸道合胞病毒（RSV）是婴儿下呼吸道感染的常见原因之一。细胞系和动物是研究RSV的主要模型，但单细胞类型和物种差异使其难以模拟人类生理特征。干细胞来源的类器官包含与天然器官相似的多种细胞类型，并模拟天然器官的生理条件。方法

我们使用人肺类器官（HLOs）研究RSV感染。在感染后48和96小时进行免疫荧光（IF）染色以验证RSV靶细胞。通过RT-qPCR和ELISA评估促炎因子的表达。在感染后96小时定量TUNEL+凋亡细胞、Ki67+增殖细胞、丝状伪足样结构和CDH1（E-钙黏蛋白）表达。结果

RSV感染的细胞包括上皮细胞和PDGFRβ+细胞。RSV诱导促炎因子并引起细胞命运的显著变化：TUNEL+细胞增加表明凋亡增强，Ki67+细胞减少反映细胞增殖受损。此外，感染HLOs中形态学变化明显。F-肌动蛋白染色显示丝状伪足样结构显著增加，而CDH1表达显著降低。这些观察结果表明RSV感染影响HLOs中的细胞骨架完整性和钙黏蛋白介导的细胞连接。结论

我们的发现证实HLOs为体外研究RSV感染提供了有价值的模型。感染RSV的HLOs具有与天然肺相似的细胞分布，并提供肌动蛋白细胞骨架重塑和细胞粘附受损的证据。

abstract: The dynamic crosstalk between pancreatic islets and the heart plays a critical yet poorly understood role in diabetic cardiomyopathy (DCM). Here, we present a vascularized multi-organoid-on-a-chip platform that enables the perfusion co-culture of human iPSC-derived vascularized cardiac organoids (VCOs) and vascularized islet organoids (VIOs). Under a gradient of hyperglycemic stress, this system recapitulated key features of DCM, including cardiomyocyte structural disassembly and vascular dysfunction. Crucially, co-culture with functional VIOs provided substantial protection against hyperglycemia, mitigating cardiac damage by restoring metabolic and contractile gene programs. Our study establishes a modular and physiologically relevant model to dissect the dose-dependent protective role of islets in diabetic heart disease and to screen for interventions targeting inter-organ communication.
abstractZh: 胰岛与心脏之间的动态串扰在糖尿病心肌病（DCM）中起着关键但尚未被充分理解的作用。在此，我们提出一个血管化多类器官芯片平台，该平台能够实现人iPSC来源的血管化心脏类器官（VCOs）和血管化胰岛类器官（VIOs）的灌注共培养。在高血糖应激梯度下，该系统重现了DCM的关键特征，包括心肌细胞结构解体和血管功能障碍。至关重要的是，与功能性VIOs的共培养提供了针对高血糖的实质性保护，通过恢复代谢和收缩基因程序来减轻心脏损伤。我们的研究建立了一个模块化且生理相关的模型，用以剖析胰岛在糖尿病心脏病中的剂量依赖性保护作用，并筛选针对器官间通讯的干预措施。
