abstract:
Background

Gastric cancer remains a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, with chemotherapy resistance and severe side effects posing significant challenges. Metabolic reprogramming, particularly lactate-driven histone lactylation, plays a crucial role in tumor progression. Cryptotanshinone (CTS), a bioactive compound from Salvia miltiorrhiza, has demonstrated anti-tumor properties, yet its mechanisms in regulating lactate metabolism and lactylation in gastric cancer remain unclear.Purpose

This study aimed to elucidate the molecular mechanisms by which CTS inhibits gastric cancer progression, focusing on its effects on enolase activity, lactate production, histone lactylation, and downstream metabolic-epigenetic regulation.Methods

We screened Salvia miltiorrhiza ethanol extract (SME) and identified CTS as a key component targeting enolase. Molecular docking, surface plasmon resonance, and limited proteolysis-mass spectrometry were used to confirm CTS-ENO1 interaction. In vitro and in vivo models, including cell lines, xenografts, and patient-derived organoids, were employed to assess anti-tumor effects. Glycolytic function, histone lactylation, and gene expression were evaluated via seahorse assay, western blot, Cut&Tag, and RNA-seq.Results

CTS directly binds to and inhibits enolase ENO1, reducing phosphoenolpyruvate (PEP) and lactate production. Decreased lactate levels led to reduced global histone lactylation, particularly at H3K18. CTS also enhanced HDAC2-mediated de-lactylation by lowering PEP, which otherwise inhibits HDAC2. Downregulation of H3K18la suppressed MGAT4A expression, impairing GLUT1 membrane localization and glucose uptake, thereby forming a feedback loop that inhibits glycolysis. CTS significantly suppressed tumor growth in xenograft and patient-derived organoid models, effects reversible by exogenous lactate.
abstractZh:
背景

胃癌仍然是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一，化疗耐药和严重副作用构成了重大挑战。代谢重编程，特别是乳酸驱动的组蛋白乳酸化，在肿瘤进展中起着关键作用。隐丹参酮（CTS）是丹参中的一种生物活性化合物，已显示出抗肿瘤特性，但其在胃癌中调节乳酸代谢和乳酸化的机制仍不清楚。目的

本研究旨在阐明CTS抑制胃癌进展的分子机制，重点关注其对烯醇化酶活性、乳酸产生、组蛋白乳酸化以及下游代谢-表观遗传调控的影响。方法

我们筛选了丹参乙醇提取物（SME），并确定CTS为靶向烯醇化酶的关键成分。使用分子对接、表面等离子体共振和限制性蛋白水解-质谱法确认CTS-ENO1相互作用。采用体外和体内模型，包括细胞系、异种移植瘤和患者来源类器官，评估抗肿瘤效果。通过海马分析、蛋白质印迹、Cut&Tag和RNA-seq评估糖酵解功能、组蛋白乳酸化和基因表达。结果

CTS直接结合并抑制烯醇化酶ENO1，减少磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸（PEP）和乳酸的产生。乳酸水平降低导致整体组蛋白乳酸化减少，特别是在H3K18位点。CTS还通过降低PEP（否则会抑制HDAC2）来增强HDAC2介导的去乳酸化。H3K18la的下调抑制了MGAT4A表达，损害GLUT1膜定位和葡萄糖摄取，从而形成抑制糖酵解的反馈回路。CTS在异种移植瘤和患者来源类器官模型中显著抑制肿瘤生长，这些效应可通过外源性乳酸逆转。

title: Modeling Prenatal Immune Activation in Human Brain Organoids Uncovers IL-6–Dependent Interneuron Dysmaturation
titleZh: 人脑类器官中的产前免疫激活建模揭示IL-6依赖性中间神经元成熟障碍
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Papetti AV, Ma Z, Ng M, Jin M, Levison SW, Jiang P.
abstract: Prenatal inflammation has been associated with an increased likelihood of the child developing neurodevelopmental conditions, such as autism spectrum disorder (ASD). Several pro-inflammatory cytokines are significantly upregulated and play critical roles during immune activation, with interleukin-6 (IL-6) being particularly prominent. However, the specific impact of elevated IL-6 levels on human neural development remains to be elucidated. To address this, we established a human pluripotent stem cell-based forebrain organoid model enriched for multiple interneuron lineages, validated through immunohistochemistry and transcriptomic alignment with human fetal reference datasets. We showed IL-6 responsiveness via the activation of the JAK/STAT pathway and characterized downstream effects using bulk and single-nucleus RNA sequencing (RNA-seq). Bulk RNA-seq at the end of IL-6 exposure uncovered activation of inflammatory pathways, upregulation of MHC-I machinery, and early disruption of GABAergic signaling programs. Notably, single-nucleus RNA-sequencing performed one month after IL-6 withdrawal revealed a persistent inflammatory transcriptional signature across interneuron development, accompanied by accelerated progression through maturation stages and altered interneuron subtype output. Together, these findings demonstrate that transient prenatal IL-6 exposure is sufficient to reshape human interneuron fate specification and maturation trajectories, providing mechanistic insights into neuroimmune contributions to ASD.
abstractZh: 产前炎症与儿童患神经发育疾病（如自闭症谱系障碍（ASD））的可能性增加有关。在免疫激活过程中，多种促炎细胞因子显著上调并发挥关键作用，其中白细胞介素-6（IL-6）尤为突出。然而，IL-6水平升高对人类神经发育的具体影响仍有待阐明。为解决这一问题，我们建立了一种基于人多能干细胞的前脑类器官模型，该模型富集了多种中间神经元谱系，并通过免疫组织化学和与人类胎儿参考数据集的转录组比对进行了验证。我们通过JAK/STAT通路的激活证明了IL-6反应性，并利用批量及单核RNA测序（RNA-seq）表征了下游效应。IL-6暴露结束时的批量RNA-seq揭示了炎症通路的激活、MHC-I机制的 upregulated 以及GABA能信号程序的早期破坏。值得注意的是，在IL-6撤除一个月后进行的单核RNA测序显示，中间神经元发育过程中存在持续的炎症转录特征，同时伴随成熟阶段的加速进展和中间神经元亚型输出的改变。综上所述，这些发现表明，短暂的产前IL-6暴露足以重塑人类中间神经元的命运规范和成熟轨迹，为神经免疫对ASD的贡献提供了机制性见解。

title: FOXP3-engineered regulatory T cells restore intestinal barrier integrity in Crohn’s disease enteroids via PDGF-AA
titleZh: FOXP3工程化调节性T细胞通过PDGF-AA恢复克罗恩病类器官的肠道屏障完整性
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Saini N, Ojo BA, Bozza N, Ramachandran A, Gahlot P, López-Rivera JA, Tran T, Sokzini P, Meyer H, Dunn JC, Roncarolo MG, Rosen MJ, Bacchetta R.
abstract:
Epithelial regeneration and barrier integrity are impaired in inflammatory bowel diseases, including Crohn’s disease (CD), yet current therapies largely target immune inflammation without directly promoting mucosal repair. While regulatory T cells are classically immunomodulatory, their capacity to directly support human intestinal stem cells (ISCs) and barrier function remains unclear. In this study, we tested the hypothesis that FOXP3-expressing regulatory T cells—engineered CD4  LVFOXP3 and thymic-derived T  reg (tT  reg )—directly support human ISC maintenance and restore epithelial barrier function independent of their immunomodulatory function. Using CD patient ISCs-derived enteroids that display disease-associated damage, we established co-culture with FOXP3-engineered T  reg cell-CD4  LVFOXP3 or thymic-derived T  reg (tT  reg ). The presence of either CD4  LVFOXP3 or tT  reg cells enhanced enteroid growth, improved epithelial barrier function, and restored apical-basal polarity of ISCs, indicating reparative capacity. Conversely, activated conventional CD4  + T cells reduced barrier function and abrogated apical-basal polarity. Integrating secretome profiling with ligand add-back and receptor or ligand blockade, we identify the PDGF-AA–PDGFRα axis as a key regulator of T  reg -mediated intestinal epithelial barrier integrity, but dispensable for T  reg suppressive capacity. Collectively, our data delineate a direct, human tissue-intrinsic role of FOXP3-driven Treg in the interaction with ISCs via PDGF-AA-PDGFRα, enhancing epithelial barrier function and positioning CD4  LVFOXP3 as a treatment approach coupling immunoregulation with epithelial repair.  One Sentence Summary

  Regulatory T cells improve the intestinal epithelial barrier function, primarily, through the PDGF-AA–PDGFRα axis
abstractZh:
在炎症性肠病（包括克罗恩病，CD）中，上皮再生和屏障完整性受损，然而目前的治疗主要针对免疫炎症，并未直接促进黏膜修复。虽然调节性T细胞经典上具有免疫调节功能，但它们直接支持人类肠道干细胞（ISCs）和屏障功能的能力仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们检验了以下假设：表达FOXP3的调节性T细胞——工程化的CD4 LVFOXP3和胸腺来源的T reg（tT reg）——直接支持人类ISC维持并恢复上皮屏障功能，且独立于其免疫调节功能。利用表现出疾病相关损伤的CD患者ISC来源的类器官，我们建立了与FOXP3工程化T reg细胞-CD4 LVFOXP3或胸腺来源的T reg（tT reg）的共培养体系。CD4 LVFOXP3或tT reg细胞的存在增强了类器官的生长，改善了上皮屏障功能，并恢复了ISC的顶端-基底极性，表明其具有修复能力。相反，活化的常规CD4+ T细胞降低了屏障功能并破坏了顶端-基底极性。将分泌组分析与配体回补及受体或配体阻断相结合，我们确定PDGF-AA–PDGFRα轴是T reg介导的肠道上皮屏障完整性的关键调节因子，但对T reg的抑制功能并非必需。总的来说，我们的数据描绘了FOXP3驱动的Treg通过PDGF-AA-PDGFRα与ISC直接相互作用、增强上皮屏障功能的人类组织内在作用，并将CD4 LVFOXP3定位为一种将免疫调节与上皮修复相结合的治疗方法。

一句话总结

调节性T细胞主要通过PDGF-AA–PDGFRα轴改善肠道上皮屏障功能。

title: Biological Computing as a Translational Platform for Delirium and Adaptive Network Failure: A Perspective from Anesthesia and Critical Care Medicine
titleZh: 生物计算作为谵妄与适应性网络衰竭的转化平台：来自麻醉与重症医学的视角
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Romanelli A.
abstract: Delirium remains one of the most pervasive yet least understood forms of acute brain dysfunction in perioperative and intensive care medicine, associated with substantial short-term mortality, prolonged intensive care unit stays, and persistent long-term cognitive impairment in survivors. Despite decades of clinical observation, no single experimental model has bridged the mechanistic gap between molecular neurochemistry, network-level electrophysiology, and the clinical phenomenology of acute brain failure. Animal paradigms incompletely recapitulate human cortical dynamics, whereas bedside neurophysiological monitoring provides only an indirect, downstream representation of the underlying network state. Recent advances in biological computing and organoid intelligence have introduced platforms in which living human-derived neuronal networks, cultured on microelectrode arrays and coupled to computational interfaces, exhibit measurable adaptive electrophysiological behavior and, in some configurations, acquire simple task-related functions through closed-loop feedback. In this perspective, such systems may offer a conceptually informative, although structurally reductive, experimental substrate for mechanistically dissecting delirium, conceived as a paradigmatic failure of adaptive network function. This perspective outlines three perturbational paradigms relevant to anesthesia and intensive care: pharmacological challenge, inflammatory challenge, and a combined-hit model designed to approximate the hypoactive delirium of the septic, critically ill patient. A complementary paradigm is then introduced, based on pharmacologically perturbing acquired network-level functions, and proposed as a substrate for in vitro cognitive pharmacodynamics. Recovery trajectories, network resilience, and the long-term horizon of patient-specific induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cultures for personalized risk stratification are also discussed. The substantial structural, biological, and ethical limitations of current platforms are explicitly acknowledged. These systems lack laminar cortical architecture, thalamo-cortical reciprocal loops, and ascending neuromodulatory systems central to anesthetic pharmacology and to several leading neuropathogenetic theories of delirium. Nonetheless, biological computing systems may eventually serve as a translationally meaningful intermediate layer between molecular neuroscience and whole-brain clinical physiology, with delirium serving as a paradigmatic and clinically urgent test case.
abstractZh: 谵妄仍然是围手术期和重症医学中最普遍但最不为人理解的急性脑功能障碍形式之一，与显著的短期死亡率、重症监护病房住院时间延长以及幸存者持续的长期认知障碍相关。尽管经过数十年的临床观察，尚无单一实验模型能够弥合分子神经化学、网络水平电生理学与急性脑衰竭临床现象学之间的机制鸿沟。动物模型不能完全重现人类皮层动力学，而床旁神经生理监测仅提供对潜在网络状态的间接、下游表征。生物计算和类器官智能的最新进展引入了这样的平台：培养在微电极阵列上并与计算接口耦合的活体人源神经元网络，表现出可测量的适应性电生理行为，并且在某些配置中，通过闭环反馈获得简单的任务相关功能。从这一视角来看，此类系统可能提供一个概念上具有启发性、尽管结构上简化的实验基质，用于机制性解析谵妄——一种适应性网络功能衰竭的典型范例。本视角概述了与麻醉和重症监护相关的三种扰动范式：药理学挑战、炎症挑战，以及旨在近似脓毒症危重患者低活动性谵妄的联合打击模型。随后引入一种补充范式，基于药理学扰动已获得的网络水平功能，并提出将其作为体外认知药效学的基质。还讨论了恢复轨迹、网络韧性以及患者特异性诱导多能干细胞来源培养物用于个体化风险分层的长期前景。当前平台的重大结构性、生物学和伦理局限性被明确承认。这些系统缺乏与麻醉药理学以及若干谵妄神经病理发生主要理论相关的层状皮层结构、丘脑-皮层相互回路和上行神经调节系统。尽管如此，生物计算系统最终可能作为分子神经科学与全脑临床生理学之间具有转化意义的中介层，而谵妄则作为一个典型且临床紧迫的检验案例。

title: Brain Organoids, Lessons from Fetal Neocortex Formation, and Rational Design for Quality Control
titleZh: 脑类器官、胎儿新皮层形成的经验教训以及质量控制的合理设计
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Fitzgerald MQ, Zhou T, Hemati H, Labelle D, Momtaz A, Harris E, Patil S, Prabhakar G, Hu H, Pareddy N, Jegadheesh V, Cui J, Muotri AR, Khojah R, Subramaniam S.
abstract:
Recent widespread adoption of cerebral organoid protocols has led to many new studies assessing the human-specific features of neural diseases. However, not all organoid studies employ proper quality control, which limits the physiological relevance of their findings. Here, we discuss the stages of in vivo neocortex formation and how those stages are recapitulated in organoid protocols. We then present the first guide for real-time operator removal of maldeveloped organoids in shaking culture. Finally, we show preliminary work on an organoid imaging and mesofluidic control platform for automated quality control of organoid development. Taken together, this approach for assessing the morphological features of organoids will improve the rigor and reproducibility of organoid studies, increase effect sizes of physiologically relevant disease etiology, and pave the way for cortical organoid GMP in high-throughput. Clinical Relevance

  This establishes high-throughput, visual brain organoid quality control for disease studies and preclinical testing.
abstractZh: 近年来，脑类器官培养方案的广泛采用催生了许多评估神经疾病人类特异性特征的新研究。然而，并非所有类器官研究都采用了适当的质量控制，这限制了其研究结果的生理相关性。在此，我们讨论了体内新皮层形成的各个阶段，以及这些阶段如何在类器官培养方案中被重现。随后，我们提出了首个在振荡培养中实时操作者移除发育不良类器官的指南。最后，我们展示了一项关于类器官成像和介流控控制平台的初步工作，该平台用于类器官发育的自动化质量控制。综合来看，这种评估类器官形态特征的方法将提高类器官研究的严谨性和可重复性，增加生理相关疾病病因学的效应量，并为高通量下的皮层类器官GMP铺平道路。临床相关性：这为疾病研究和临床前测试建立了高通量的视觉脑类器官质量控制方法。

title: An integrated human forebrain organoid reveals microglia-mediated CD8⁺ T cell recruitment and neuroimmune dysfunction in Alzheimer’s disease pathology
titleZh: 一种整合的人类前脑类器官揭示小胶质细胞介导的CD8⁺ T细胞募集及阿尔茨海默病病理中的神经免疫功能障碍
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Feng Y, Yu F, Tang J, Zheng H, Wang Z, Ma S.
abstract:
Genetic evidence implicates immune dysfunction in Alzheimer’s disease (AD), yet the neuroimmune mechanisms operating in human tissue remain poorly defined. Here, we establish a modular human forebrain organoid platform that systematically integrates iPSC-derived microglia and CD8  + T cells to reconstitute multicellular Alzheimer’s disease pathology. This system enables functional interrogation of both innate and adaptive immune components in a human-relevant context. Using this platform, we demonstrate that microglia mediate amyloid-β clearance and neuronal maturation but also drive inflammatory activation and recruit CD8  + T cells through CCL4/5 signaling via CCR1/5 and CXCR3, establishing a neuroinflammatory feedback loop. Pharmacological targeting of CCR5 or CXCR3 blocks T cell recruitment and modulates autophagy in a microglia-dependent manner. This modular organoid platform provides a versatile tool for dissecting neuron–immune interactions and enables cell-type-specific therapeutic screening in human neuroinflammatory disease models.  Highlights

  1) A modular human forebrain organoid platform integrating innate (microglia) and adaptive (CD8  + T cells) immunity recapitulates key features of the human neuroimmune environment  2) Enables mechanistic dissection of multicellular interactions underlying Alzheimer’s disease pathology 3) Overcomes limitations of traditional animal models by resolving human-specific, cell-type-specific neuroimmune mechanisms 4) Establishes a new approach methodology for studying neuroimmune disorders and advancing drug discovery
abstractZh:
遗传学证据提示免疫功能障碍与阿尔茨海默病（AD）相关，但人类组织中运作的神经免疫机制仍知之甚少。在此，我们建立了一个模块化的人类前脑类器官平台，系统性地整合iPSC来源的小胶质细胞和CD8⁺ T细胞，以重建多细胞阿尔茨海默病病理。该系统能够在与人类相关的背景下对先天性和适应性免疫成分进行功能性研究。利用该平台，我们证明小胶质细胞介导淀粉样蛋白-β清除和神经元成熟，但也驱动炎症激活并通过CCL4/5信号经由CCR1/5和CXCR3募集CD8⁺ T细胞，从而建立神经炎症反馈回路。药理学靶向CCR5或CXCR3可阻断T细胞募集并以小胶质细胞依赖性方式调节自噬。该模块化类器官平台为剖析神经元-免疫相互作用提供了一种多功能工具，并在人类神经炎症疾病模型中实现细胞类型特异性治疗筛选。

亮点

1) 一个整合先天免疫（小胶质细胞）和适应性免疫（CD8⁺ T细胞）的模块化人类前脑类器官平台，重现了人类神经免疫环境的关键特征。
2) 能够对阿尔茨海默病病理基础的多细胞相互作用进行机制剖析。
3) 通过解析人类特异性、细胞类型特异性的神经免疫机制，克服了传统动物模型的局限性。
4) 为研究神经免疫疾病和推进药物发现建立了一种新的方法论。

abstract:
Aims

Resistance to oxaliplatin treatment limits therapeutic benefit in gastric cancer (GC) and remains difficult to predict from bulk biomarkers. We aimed to identify oxaliplatin resistance-driving malignant tumor states at single-cell resolution and translate them into clinically tractable predictors.Methods

Differential expression in oxaliplatin-resistant versus sensitive GC organoids was used to derive a resistance signature, which was evaluated in bulk GC organoid cohorts alongside computational estimate on oxaliplatin sensitivity. Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) was used to localize resistance programs to malignant epithelial states. A multi-constraint integration framework (Clinical-Transcriptomic Integration for Validation - Consensus Resistance Program, CTIV-CRP) was developed to prioritize candidates based on tumor enrichment, pharmacologic association, and reproducible prognostic relevance. Radiation sensitive1(RAD1) was further validated using public protein data, an independent neoadjuvant cohort assessed by tumor regression, and patient-derived organoid and xenograft models.Results

Resistance-associated activity associated with a malignant epithelial state (C2). CTIV-CRP distilled a core program in which RAD1 emerged as a consistent surrogate, aligning with resistance signatures and oxaliplatin sensitivity estimates. Clinical and experimental validations supported the association between RAD1 and poor therapeutic response.Conclusions

CTIV-CRP connects single-cell malignant states to clinically relevant resistance phenotypes and nominates RAD1 as a candidate resistance biomarker in GC.
abstractZh:
目的

对奥沙利铂治疗的耐药性限制了胃癌（GC）的治疗获益，且难以从整体生物标志物中预测。我们旨在单细胞分辨率下识别驱动奥沙利铂耐药的恶性肿瘤状态，并将其转化为临床可行的预测因子。方法

利用奥沙利铂耐药与敏感胃癌类器官的差异表达推导耐药特征，并在整体胃癌类器官队列中结合奥沙利铂敏感性的计算估计进行评估。使用单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）将耐药程序定位到恶性上皮状态。开发了多约束整合框架（临床-转录组整合验证-共识耐药程序，CTIV-CRP），基于肿瘤富集、药理学关联和可重复的预后相关性优先筛选候选基因。辐射敏感1（RAD1）进一步通过公共蛋白质数据、通过肿瘤消退评估的独立新辅助队列以及患者来源的类器官和异种移植模型进行验证。结果

耐药相关活性与恶性上皮状态（C2）相关。CTIV-CRP提炼出一个核心程序，其中RAD1作为一致的替代标志物，与耐药特征和奥沙利铂敏感性估计一致。临床和实验验证支持RAD1与不良治疗反应之间的关联。结论

CTIV-CRP将单细胞恶性状态与临床相关的耐药表型联系起来，并提名RAD1作为胃癌耐药的候选生物标志物。

abstract: Cancer stem cells (CSCs) are intrinsically resistant to conventional therapies and play a pivotal role in cancer metastasis and recurrence. Eradication of CSCs requires combination strategies that simultaneously target multiple pathways at therapeutical concentrations throughout tumours. This study investigated the potential of a fusogenic pH-sensitive liposomal (pSL) nanococktail comprising doxorubicin and bufalin for targeting CSCs in clinically relevant HER2-positive breast cancer models, including cell lines (CD44high HCC1954 and CD44low BT474), homotypic and heterotypic spheroids, patient-derived organoids, and orthotopic HCC1954 mouse xenografts. At the optimal doxorubicin: bufalin ratio (10:1), the pSL-cocktail demonstrated pronounced synergistic efficacy and significantly outperformed all control formulations, including monodrug-loaded pSLs, non-pH-sensitive (DOXIL-like) liposomes, and free drugs. It significantly suppressed tumour proliferation and stemness, including CSC-associated migration, mammosphere formation, and self-renewal. In spheroids, the nanococktail rapidly penetrated to the spheroid core (≥100 µm within 1 h) and suppressed invasive dissemination. Similarly, it disrupted patient-derived organoids, achieving > 90% reduction in ATP levels and > 90% cell death. In vivo, the pSL-cocktail was well-tolerated and achieved significant tumour shrinkage, whereas DOXIL-like liposomes and free drugs showed minimal activity or severe adverse effects. Overall, this pSL-cocktail demonstrates strong potential for CSC-elimination and tumour clearance through synergistic drug combination, superior tumour penetration, and endosomal pH-triggered intracellular drug release.
abstractZh: 癌症干细胞（CSCs）对常规治疗具有内在耐药性，并在癌症转移和复发中发挥关键作用。根除CSCs需要联合策略，在治疗浓度下同时靶向肿瘤内的多条通路。本研究探讨了由多柔比星和蟾蜍灵组成的融合性pH敏感脂质体（pSL）纳米鸡尾酒在临床相关的HER2阳性乳腺癌模型（包括细胞系（CD44高表达HCC1954和CD44低表达BT474）、同型和异型球体、患者来源类器官以及原位HCC1954小鼠异种移植瘤）中靶向CSCs的潜力。在最佳多柔比星：蟾蜍灵比例（10：1）下，pSL-鸡尾酒表现出显著的协同功效，并显著优于所有对照制剂，包括单药负载的pSL、非pH敏感（类DOXIL）脂质体和游离药物。它显著抑制了肿瘤增殖和干性，包括CSC相关的迁移、微球体形成和自我更新。在球体中，纳米鸡尾酒迅速渗透到球体核心（1小时内≥100微米）并抑制侵袭性播散。同样，它破坏了患者来源的类器官，ATP水平降低>90%，细胞死亡>90%。在体内，pSL-鸡尾酒耐受性良好，并实现了显著的肿瘤缩小，而类DOXIL脂质体和游离药物显示出最小活性或严重不良反应。总体而言，这种pSL-鸡尾酒通过协同药物组合、卓越的肿瘤渗透和内体pH触发的细胞内药物释放，展示了消除CSCs和清除肿瘤的强大潜力。

abstract: Neonatal short bowel syndrome (SBS) often leads to intestinal failure and dependence on parenteral nutrition (PN). Given the role of liver X receptor (LXR) activation in lipid metabolism and mucosal repair, this study was designed to examine the effects of LXR agonist GW3965 on early adaptive responses in neonatal piglets with SBS. Seven-day-old Bama mini-piglets underwent 75% jejunoileal resection and were randomized into a control group (n = 6) and a GW3965-treated group (n = 4; 2 mg/kg/day administered via jugular vein). The effects of GW3965 on postresection intestinal responses and key molecular pathways were investigated using a combination of in vivo (piglets) and in vitro (human intestinal organoid) models. Administration of the LXR agonist GW3965 promoted significant improvements in gut barrier integrity and mucosal structure in the total parenteral nutrition-supported small-nowel resection piglet model during the 7-day postoperative period. GW3965 significantly increased villus height in the jejunum and ileum (both P < 0.05) and crypt depth throughout the remnant intestine and colon (all P < 0.05). Consistent with enhanced barrier function, treated piglets exhibited significantly lower serum lipopolysaccharide levels (P < 0.01) and elevated expression of tight junction proteins. GW3965 also promoted intestinal epithelial cell proliferation. Complementary in vitro studies confirmed that GW3965 directly stimulated the growth of human intestinal organoids. Notably, GW3965 altered colonic gene expression, upregulating markers typically associated with ileal identity. These findings suggest that targeting the LXR pathway may hold therapeutic potential for augmenting the intestinal regeneration.
abstractZh: 新生儿短肠综合征（SBS）常导致肠衰竭和对肠外营养（PN）的依赖。鉴于肝X受体（LXR）激活在脂质代谢和黏膜修复中的作用，本研究旨在探讨LXR激动剂GW3965对SBS新生猪仔早期适应性反应的影响。7日龄巴马小型猪接受75%空回肠切除后，随机分为对照组（n = 6）和GW3965治疗组（n = 4；通过颈静脉给予2 mg/kg/天）。结合体内（猪仔）和体外（人肠道类器官）模型，研究了GW3965对切除后肠道反应及关键分子通路的影响。在术后7天期间，LXR激动剂GW3965的给药显著改善了全肠外营养支持的小肠切除猪仔模型的肠道屏障完整性和黏膜结构。GW3965显著增加了空肠和回肠的绒毛高度（均P < 0.05），并增加了残余肠道和结肠的隐窝深度（均P < 0.05）。与屏障功能增强一致，治疗组猪仔的血清脂多糖水平显著降低（P < 0.01），紧密连接蛋白表达升高。GW3965还促进了肠道上皮细胞增殖。补充的体外研究证实，GW3965直接刺激了人肠道类器官的生长。值得注意的是，GW3965改变了结肠基因表达，上调了通常与回肠身份相关的标志物。这些发现表明，靶向LXR通路可能具有增强肠道再生的治疗潜力。

abstract: Tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) pose a significant obstacle to successful cancer immunotherapy in colorectal cancer (CRC). Herein, we demonstrate that genetic deletion of PGE2 receptors EP2/EP4 markedly sensitizes CRC tumors to anti-PD-1 therapy. We then report the development of TP-18, a potent and orally available dual EP2/EP4 antagonist. TP-18 treatment effectively depletes a highly immunosuppressive VSIG4high TAM subset and enhances cytotoxic CD8+ T cell-mediated CRC tumor elimination. Mechanistically, TP-18 dampens the expression of VSIG4 by blunting EP2/EP4-Gαs-PKA signaling. Notably, VSIG4high TAMs from CRC-tumor-bearing mice display robust immunosuppressive features, and similar VSIG4high populations are also detected in patients with CRC and other cancers. Importantly, TP-18 improves the therapeutic efficacy of anti-PD-1 therapy in CRC mouse models and in patient-derived tumor immune organoids. Collectively, our findings establish targeting of EP2/EP4-driven expansion of VSIG4high TAMs as a promising therapeutic strategy to overcome immunotherapy resistance.
abstractZh: 肿瘤相关巨噬细胞（TAMs）是结直肠癌（CRC）成功免疫治疗的重大障碍。在此，我们证明PGE2受体EP2/EP4的基因缺失显著提高了CRC肿瘤对抗PD-1治疗的敏感性。随后，我们报告了TP-18的开发，这是一种强效且可口服的双重EP2/EP4拮抗剂。TP-18治疗有效清除高度免疫抑制的VSIG4高表达TAM亚群，并增强细胞毒性CD8+ T细胞介导的CRC肿瘤消除。机制上，TP-18通过减弱EP2/EP4-Gαs-PKA信号传导来抑制VSIG4的表达。值得注意的是，来自荷瘤小鼠CRC的VSIG4高表达TAMs表现出强大的免疫抑制特征，并且在CRC患者和其他癌症患者中也检测到类似的VSIG4高表达群体。重要的是，TP-18在CRC小鼠模型和患者来源的肿瘤免疫类器官中提高了抗PD-1治疗的疗效。总的来说，我们的发现将靶向EP2/EP4驱动的VSIG4高表达TAMs扩增确立为克服免疫治疗耐药的一种有前景的治疗策略。

abstract: Understanding how the human brain develops and functions requires direct analysis of human cells. Single-cell atlases open unprecedented opportunities to survey cell physiological molecular states as the brain develops. However, technical challenges limit their potential. We present NeuRoDev, a computational resource with highly curated transcriptomic data and novel analytical tools to investigate neuronal and glial development in the human cortex. NeuRoDev compresses ∼1M single-cell transcriptomes into integrative summary networks of reproducible cell clusters that capture temporal and cellular variation across all stages of human brain development. It provides a reference framework to directly interrogate cellular maturation dynamics, contextualize gene function, and interpret experimental organoid models. We use NeuRoDev to investigate developmental variation in cell physiology, reconstruct genesis and maturation dynamics in neuronal and glial cells, and interpret time-series data from human organoids. NeuRoDev is provided as a freely available software package and web applications for interactive data analysis.
abstractZh: 理解人脑的发育和功能需要直接分析人类细胞。单细胞图谱为调查大脑发育过程中的细胞生理分子状态提供了前所未有的机会。然而，技术挑战限制了其潜力。我们提出了NeuRoDev，一个计算资源，包含高度精选的转录组数据和新颖的分析工具，用于研究人脑皮层中的神经元和胶质细胞发育。NeuRoDev将约100万个单细胞转录组压缩成可重复细胞簇的整合性总结网络，这些网络捕捉了人脑发育所有阶段的时间与细胞变异。它提供了一个参考框架，用于直接探究细胞成熟动态、情境化基因功能以及解释实验性类器官模型。我们利用NeuRoDev来研究细胞生理的发育变异，重建神经元和胶质细胞的生成与成熟动态，并解释人类类器官的时间序列数据。NeuRoDev作为免费可用的软件包和用于交互式数据分析的网络应用程序提供。

abstract: This study reports the pharmacogenomic analysis of tumor heterogeneity in a living biobank of 213 organoids derived from liver metastases of 102 patients with metastatic colorectal cancer. Successful organoid establishment reflects poorer chemosensitivity and patient survival. Molecular fidelity is confirmed in tumor-organoid pairs, and multi-modal phenotypes are defined based on organoid morphology. Cystic morphology associates with intestinal stem cell markers and greater drug sensitivity, while solid morphology is linked to markers of plasticity and aggressiveness. The potential to identify treatments less affected by tumor heterogeneity is supported by multi-lesion analyses in 65 patients. Clinical translation is illustrated in two prospective cases of pharmacogenomics-guided treatment, including successful chemotherapy rechallenge and targeted therapy resistance in cancers with low and high heterogeneity. All pharmacogenomic data are openly available as a functional oncology resource to support interpretation of ex vivo drug sensitivities into clinical "actionability."
abstractZh: 本研究报道了来自102名转移性结直肠癌患者的213个来源于肝转移的类器官活体生物库中肿瘤异质性的药物基因组学分析。类器官建立成功反映了较差的化疗敏感性和患者生存。在肿瘤-类器官对中确认了分子保真度，并根据类器官形态定义了多模态表型。囊性形态与肠道干细胞标志物和更高的药物敏感性相关，而实性形态与可塑性和侵袭性标志物相关。在65名患者的多病灶分析中支持了识别受肿瘤异质性影响较小的治疗方案的潜力。临床转化通过两个前瞻性药物基因组学指导治疗案例得以说明，包括在低和高异质性癌症中成功的化疗再挑战和靶向治疗耐药。所有药物基因组学数据作为功能性肿瘤学资源公开可用，以支持将体外药物敏感性解释为临床“可操作性”。

abstract: Immune evasion remains a major challenge in colorectal cancer (CRC) treatment. Here, we identify that druggable β-catenin palmitoylation at cysteine 466 (C466) by ZDHHC5 acts as a competitive switch, displacing S-nitrosylation and coordinating an immunosuppressive program. The palmitoylated state stabilizes the β-catenin/TCF4 complex, which simultaneously upregulates SLC7A11 to suppress immunogenic ferroptosis, critical for CD8+ T cell priming, and PD-L1 to inhibit cytotoxic CD8+ T cells, thereby impairing both the initiation and effector phases of anti-tumor immunity. Clinically, ZDHHC5 expression predicts poor survival and resistance to anti-PD-L1 therapy. Silencing ZDHHC5 reduced tumor growth in patient-derived organoids and xenografts, while Zdhhc5 ablation in mice inhibited CRC progression by reversing immunogenic ferroptosis suppression and alleviating PD-L1-mediated T cell inhibition. Importantly, β-cat-oxazole, a first-in-class inhibitor, disrupts ZDHHC5-β-catenin binding, thereby restoring immunogenic ferroptosis and blocking PD-L1-mediated immunosuppression, ultimately suppressing tumor growth. Our findings establish targeting of this palmitoyl-switch as a precision strategy to overcome therapeutic resistance.
abstractZh: 免疫逃逸仍然是结直肠癌（CRC）治疗中的重大挑战。在此，我们鉴定出ZDHHC5对β-连环蛋白半胱氨酸466（C466）位点的可成药性棕榈酰化作用作为一个竞争性开关，取代S-亚硝基化并协调免疫抑制程序。棕榈酰化状态稳定了β-连环蛋白/TCF4复合物，该复合物同时上调SLC7A11以抑制对CD8+ T细胞启动至关重要的免疫原性铁死亡，并上调PD-L1以抑制细胞毒性CD8+ T细胞，从而损害抗肿瘤免疫的起始和效应阶段。临床上，ZDHHC5表达可预测不良生存和对抗PD-L1治疗的耐药性。沉默ZDHHC5可减少患者来源类器官和异种移植瘤中的肿瘤生长，而小鼠中Zdhhc5的敲除通过逆转免疫原性铁死亡抑制和缓解PD-L1介导的T细胞抑制来抑制CRC进展。重要的是，β-cat-oxazole作为一种首创抑制剂，可破坏ZDHHC5-β-连环蛋白结合，从而恢复免疫原性铁死亡并阻断PD-L1介导的免疫抑制，最终抑制肿瘤生长。我们的发现确立了靶向该棕榈酰化开关作为克服治疗耐药的精准策略。

abstract:
Background

Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains a leading cause of cancer-related mortality, with resistance to oxaliplatin (Oxa) and its associated side effects posing major therapeutic challenges. Natural flavonoids have shown potential in the prevention and treatment of CRC.Purpose

This study aimed to investigate whether combining Oxa with the bioactive flavonoid licoisoflavone A (LA) derived from Glycyrrhiza species could exert enhanced antitumor effects against CRC and to explore the underlying mechanisms.Methods

A CT26 tumor-bearing mouse model was established to evaluate the therapeutic efficacy of Oxa in combination with LA in vivo. Mass spectrometry-based proteomics and metabolomics analyses were performed to identify differentially expressed proteins and metabolites between the Oxa group and the Oxa plus LA group. Differential expressed proteins and associated pathways were subsequently validated in HCT116 cells, SW480 cells, and patient-derived organoids. Furthermore, two complex organoid models-an organoid-lymphocyte co-culture system and an air-liquid interface organoid system-were developed to investigate the underlying mechanisms. Flow cytometry and Western blot analyses were employed in both in vitro and in vivo settings.Results

The combination of LA and Oxa significantly inhibited tumor growth in CT26 tumor-bearing mice. Arginine metabolism was significantly reduced following LA treatment. Arginase-1 (ARG1) was identified as a potential target of LA. LA significantly downregulated ARG1 expression, which was associated with an increased proportion of CD8⁺ T cells and reduced expression of CD69⁺ and PD-1, suggesting a potential alleviation of T cell exhaustion-related features. Moreover, LA inhibited CRC cell proliferation by suppressing ARG1-mediated activation of the PI3K/Akt/mTOR signaling pathway.Conclusions

LA is a natural flavonoid that targets arginine metabolism and enhances the therapeutic efficacy of Oxa in CRC treatment.
abstractZh:
背景

结直肠癌（CRC）仍然是癌症相关死亡的主要原因，对奥沙利铂（Oxa）的耐药性及其相关副作用构成了主要的治疗挑战。天然黄酮类化合物在CRC的预防和治疗中显示出潜力。目的

本研究旨在探讨将Oxa与源自甘草属的生物活性黄酮类化合物甘草异黄酮A（LA）联合使用是否能增强对CRC的抗肿瘤效果，并探索其潜在机制。方法

建立CT26荷瘤小鼠模型，评估Oxa联合LA在体内的治疗效果。采用基于质谱的蛋白质组学和代谢组学分析，鉴定Oxa组与Oxa联合LA组之间差异表达的蛋白质和代谢物。随后在HCT116细胞、SW480细胞和患者来源的类器官中验证差异表达蛋白及相关通路。此外，开发了两种复杂的类器官模型——类器官-淋巴细胞共培养系统和气液界面类器官系统——以研究潜在机制。在体外和体内环境中均采用流式细胞术和Western blot分析。结果

LA与Oxa联合使用显著抑制了CT26荷瘤小鼠的肿瘤生长。LA处理后精氨酸代谢显著降低。精氨酸酶-1（ARG1）被确定为LA的潜在靶点。LA显著下调ARG1表达，这与CD8⁺ T细胞比例增加以及CD69⁺和PD-1表达降低相关，表明可能缓解T细胞耗竭相关特征。此外，LA通过抑制ARG1介导的PI3K/Akt/mTOR信号通路激活来抑制CRC细胞增殖。结论

LA是一种天然黄酮类化合物，靶向精氨酸代谢并增强Oxa在CRC治疗中的疗效。

abstract: In recent years, patient-derived organoid models have become increasingly valuable for studying cancer biology and guiding personalized therapies. Unlike traditional homotypic cell cultures, these three-dimensional organoids closely replicate the structural, genetic, and functional characteristics of primary tumors, making them a more physiologically relevant in vitro model. To further enhance the accuracy and efficiency of tumor modeling, we report a novel approach to expedite preclinical anticancer drug screening using vessel-supported patient-established tumor organoids. Our method involves a standardized and speedy mechanical microsectioning process to produce hundreds to thousands of patient tissue fragments from tumorous surgical discards, enabling a fast formation of the tumor organoids. These established organoids could be further integrated into a bilayer microfluidic vascular-mimic endothelium-interface platform, simulating the tumor microenvironment with dynamic culture. The significance of the endothelium becomes evident during chemotherapy drug screening, as different types of drugs are administered to patients through the system. Under this dynamic condition, the dose-dependent effect on viability is less impactful compared to traditional static conditions. The combination of patient-derived tumor organoids, established through mechanical methods, with a cost-effective microfluidic system holds great promise for personalized medicine. By closely replicating patient-specific drug responses in a dynamic tumor microenvironment, this approach could advance preclinical drug screening, thus potentially improving treatments for patients with lung cancer and beyond.
abstractZh: 近年来，患者来源的类器官模型在研究癌症生物学和指导个性化治疗方面变得越来越有价值。与传统的同型细胞培养不同，这些三维类器官紧密复制了原发肿瘤的结构、遗传和功能特征，使其成为更具生理相关性的体外模型。为了进一步提高肿瘤建模的准确性和效率，我们报告了一种新方法，利用血管支持的病人建立的肿瘤类器官来加速临床前抗癌药物筛选。我们的方法包括一个标准化且快速的机械显微切片过程，从肿瘤手术废弃组织中产生数百至数千个患者组织片段，从而实现肿瘤类器官的快速形成。这些已建立的类器官可以进一步整合到双层微流控血管模拟内皮界面平台中，模拟动态培养下的肿瘤微环境。在内皮细胞在化疗药物筛选过程中的重要性变得明显，因为不同类型的药物通过系统给予患者。在这种动态条件下，剂量依赖性对活力的影响与传统静态条件相比不那么显著。通过机械方法建立的源自患者的肿瘤类器官与成本效益高的微流控系统的结合，为个性化医学带来了巨大希望。通过在动态肿瘤微环境中紧密复制患者特异性药物反应，这种方法可以推进临床前药物筛选，从而可能改善肺癌及其他癌症患者的治疗。

abstract:
Background

Bladder cancer (BCa) displays interpatient heterogeneity and epigenetic plasticity that may limit treatment efficacy.Objective

To investigate whether inhibition of Enhancer of zeste homolog 2 (EZH2) remodels tumor cell states and creates therapeutic vulnerabilities in BCa.Design, setting, and participants

We integrated single-nucleus ribonucleic acid sequencing (snRNA-seq) of formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) primary tumors with single-cell ribonucleic acid sequencing (scRNA-seq) of matched patient-derived organoids (PDOs) from four BCas spanning stages Ta-T3.Intervention

PDOs were treated with the EZH2 inhibitor tazemetostat. Sequential tazemetostat pretreatment followed by afatinib treatment was used to evaluate whether EZH2 inhibition enhanced sensitivity to epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)-targeted therapy.Outcome measurements and statistical analysis

Transcriptional responses to EZH2 inhibition were profiled by scRNA-seq. Trimethylation of histone H3 lysine 27 (H3K27me3) chromatin immunoprecipitation sequencing (ChIP-seq) was performed in PDOs and EZH2 ChIP-seq in HT1376 cells to assess epigenomic changes associated with treatment. Gene set enrichment analysis was used to evaluate treatment-associated pathway alterations, including EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance-related signatures. Functional relevance was assessed using afatinib sensitivity assays after sequential tazemetostat pretreatment.Results and limitations

Native tumors showed heterogeneity in epithelial, stromal, and immune composition, whereas matched PDOs selectively retained and expanded tumor-intrinsic stress- and plasticity-associated epithelial states. EZH2 inhibition induced model-specific reprogramming, including inflammatory, proliferative, hypoxic/glycolytic, and neural/neuroendocrine (NE)-like programs. EZH2-bound regions were preferentially associated with treatment-related H3K27me3 loss, and loci with both EZH2 occupancy and reduced H3K27me3 were enriched for neural and NE developmental processes. Despite these heterogeneous responses, gene set enrichment analysis showed downregulation of EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance-related signatures across all PDOs, and sequential tazemetostat pretreatment increased afatinib sensitivity in all four models. Limitations include the small cohort, ex vivo design, and use of a cell line for EZH2 ChIP-seq.Conclusions

EZH2 is a context-dependent regulator of cell-state plasticity in BCa. Although EZH2 inhibition alone induced heterogeneous adaptive responses, it also suppressed EGFR inhibitor resistance-related programs and enhanced subsequent afatinib sensitivity, supporting further evaluation of sequential epigenetic priming before EGFR-targeted therapy in BCa.
abstractZh:
背景

膀胱癌（BCa）表现出患者间异质性和表观遗传可塑性，这可能限制治疗效果。目的

探讨抑制zeste同源物2增强子（EZH2）是否重塑肿瘤细胞状态并在BCa中产生治疗脆弱性。设计、设置和参与者

我们整合了来自四个跨越Ta-T3分期的BCa的福尔马林固定石蜡包埋（FFPE）原发肿瘤的单核核糖核酸测序（snRNA-seq）与匹配的患者来源类器官（PDOs）的单细胞核糖核酸测序（scRNA-seq）。干预

PDOs用EZH2抑制剂他泽美司他治疗。采用他泽美司他预处理后阿法替尼治疗的序贯方案，以评估EZH2抑制是否增强对表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）靶向治疗的敏感性。结果测量和统计分析

通过scRNA-seq分析EZH2抑制的转录反应。在PDOs中进行组蛋白H3赖氨酸27三甲基化（H3K27me3）染色质免疫沉淀测序（ChIP-seq），在HT1376细胞中进行EZH2 ChIP-seq，以评估与治疗相关的表观基因组变化。使用基因集富集分析评估治疗相关的通路改变，包括EGFR酪氨酸激酶抑制剂耐药相关特征。通过他泽美司他预处理后的阿法替尼敏感性实验评估功能相关性。结果和局限性

原发肿瘤在上皮、基质和免疫组成方面表现出异质性，而匹配的PDOs选择性地保留并扩展了肿瘤内在的应激和可塑性相关的上皮状态。EZH2抑制诱导了模型特异性的重编程，包括炎症、增殖、缺氧/糖酵解和神经/神经内分泌（NE）样程序。EZH2结合区域优先与治疗相关的H3K27me3丢失相关，同时具有EZH2占据和H3K27me3减少的位点富集于神经和NE发育过程。尽管存在这些异质性反应，基因集富集分析显示所有PDOs中EGFR酪氨酸激酶抑制剂耐药相关特征下调，且他泽美司他预处理后序贯阿法替尼治疗在所有四个模型中均增加了阿法替尼敏感性。局限性包括队列规模小、离体设计以及使用细胞系进行EZH2 ChIP-seq。结论

EZH2是BCa中细胞状态可塑性的背景依赖性调节因子。尽管EZH2抑制单独诱导了异质性适应反应，但它也抑制了EGFR抑制剂耐药相关程序并增强了后续阿法替尼敏感性，支持在BCa中EGFR靶向治疗前进一步评估序贯表观遗传预处理的策略。

abstract:
Introduction

Human foetal kidneys contain macrophages, innate immune cells postulated to enhance their development. Macrophages have also been implicated in the pathobiology of human kidney malformations and Wilms tumour. Human pluripotent stem cell (hPSC)-derived kidney organoids contain nephrons but lack macrophages.Methods

We hypothesised that combining hPSC-derived macrophages with hPSC-derived kidney precursors would modify nephrogenesis. Macrophages were added in numbers of 1%, 5%, or 20% relative to a constant number of nephrogenic cells.Results

As assessed by CD68 immunostaining, no macrophages were detected in organoids derived from MAN13 hPSCs without added hPSC-derived macrophages. Composite organoids contained macrophages between tubules, mimicking native human foetal kidneys. Quantification of macrophages in histology sections positively correlated with numbers of macrophages added. Assessed by CD31/PECAM-1 and CD68 co-immunostaining, macrophages were scattered through organoids, with some near endothelia. Added macrophages, however, did not alter the extent of CD31/PECAM-1 immunostaining. Macrophages added at 5% were associated with increases in the percentage cross-sectional areas occupied by immunostaining for the glomerular markers synaptopodin and nephrin. Higher numbers (20%) of macrophages disrupted organoid growth.Conclusion

This preliminary study demonstrates that it is technically feasible to populate hPSC-derived nephron organoids with hPSC-derived maturing macrophages. The study also suggests that, depending on their quantity, added macrophages may have beneficial or harmful effects on nephron organoids. These insights support the proposition that macrophages play roles in normal and abnormal development of human kidneys. Further studies are needed to discover the molecular mechanisms of these effects and to replicate findings using other hPSC lines.
abstractZh:
引言

人类胎儿肾脏含有巨噬细胞，这些先天免疫细胞被认为能促进肾脏发育。巨噬细胞也被认为与人类肾脏畸形和肾母细胞瘤的病理生物学有关。人类多能干细胞（hPSC）来源的肾脏类器官包含肾单位，但缺乏巨噬细胞。方法

我们假设将hPSC来源的巨噬细胞与hPSC来源的肾脏前体细胞结合会改变肾发生。巨噬细胞以相对于恒定数量肾源性细胞的1%、5%或20%的比例添加。结果

通过CD68免疫染色评估，在未添加hPSC来源巨噬细胞的MAN13 hPSC来源的类器官中未检测到巨噬细胞。复合类器官在肾小管之间含有巨噬细胞，模拟了天然人类胎儿肾脏。组织学切片中巨噬细胞的定量与添加的巨噬细胞数量呈正相关。通过CD31/PECAM-1和CD68双重免疫染色评估，巨噬细胞散布在类器官中，部分靠近内皮。然而，添加的巨噬细胞并未改变CD31/PECAM-1免疫染色的程度。添加5%的巨噬细胞与肾小球标志物synaptopodin和nephrin免疫染色所占横截面积百分比增加相关。较高数量（20%）的巨噬细胞破坏了类器官的生长。结论

这项初步研究表明，用hPSC来源的成熟巨噬细胞填充hPSC来源的肾单位类器官在技术上是可行的。该研究还提示，根据其数量，添加的巨噬细胞可能对肾单位类器官产生有益或有害的影响。这些见解支持了巨噬细胞在人类肾脏正常和异常发育中发挥作用的观点。需要进一步研究来发现这些效应的分子机制，并使用其他hPSC细胞系重复这些发现。

title: The impact of gut microbiota and metabolite-driven immune cell spatiotemporal dynamics on tumors.
titleZh: 肠道微生物群及代谢物驱动的免疫细胞时空动态对肿瘤的影响。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Ding JB, Lin MX, Zang D, Chen J.

abstract: Cancer poses a significant threat to human health. The immune response plays a pivotal role in tumor cell elimination, with increasing attention given to the spatiotemporal dynamics of immune cells across temporal, spatial, and functional dimensions. The gut microbiota, which constitutes the majority of the human microbiome, contributes to tumor initiation and progression. The tumor microenvironment (TME) serves as the primary site for immune cell-mediated anti-tumor responses, with the gut microbiota and its metabolites driving immune cell activation and spatiotemporal remodeling. This review explores the mechanisms by which the gut microbiota and its metabolites influence anti-tumor immunity, alongside the impact of immune cell dynamics on tumors. Furthermore, it proposes novel research strategies, including the "gut microbiota-immune cell dynamic monitoring model" and the "organoid-microbe co-culture platform." This work lays a theoretical foundation for advancing our understanding of the underlying mechanisms and developing innovative therapeutic approaches.
abstractZh: 癌症对人类健康构成重大威胁。免疫反应在肿瘤细胞清除中起着关键作用，免疫细胞在时间、空间和功能维度上的时空动态日益受到关注。肠道微生物群构成了人体微生物组的大部分，参与肿瘤的发生和发展。肿瘤微环境（TME）是免疫细胞介导的抗肿瘤反应的主要场所，肠道微生物群及其代谢物驱动免疫细胞的活化和时空重塑。本综述探讨了肠道微生物群及其代谢物影响抗肿瘤免疫的机制，以及免疫细胞动态对肿瘤的影响。此外，它提出了新的研究策略，包括“肠道微生物群-免疫细胞动态监测模型”和“类器官-微生物共培养平台”。这项工作为加深我们对潜在机制的理解和开发创新治疗方法奠定了理论基础。

abstract: Although most prostate tumors are relatively indolent, advanced disease can progress to aggressive, often lethal variants, including neuroendocrine prostate cancer (NEPC). To identify drivers of aggressive prostate cancer, we used Sleeping Beauty (SB) transposon mutagenesis in a mouse model having prostate-specific loss of Pten and Tp53 (NPp53 mice). Compared with control NPp53-SB(-) mice, experimental NPp53-SB(+) mice developed more aggressive tumors with increased metastasis. Notably, NPp53-SB(+) mice exhibited NEPC phenotypes with transcriptomic features that recapitulate human NEPC. Analysis of recurrent common insertion sites (CIS) and associated genes (CIS genes) identified genes differentially expressed between NEPC and non-NEPC tumors. Analysis of NEPC-enriched CIS genes by cross-species integration of genomic and transcriptomic data prioritized sirtuin 1 (Sirt1) as a candidate mechanistic determinant of NEPC. Gain- and loss-of-function studies in human prostate cancer cells and mouse NEPC organoids confirmed that SIRT1 promotes NEPC, while pharmacological inhibition suppresses it. Thus, integration of cross-species analyses with an unbiased forward genetic screen uncovered novel drivers of NEPC.
abstractZh: 尽管大多数前列腺肿瘤相对惰性，但晚期疾病可进展为侵袭性、通常致命的变异型，包括神经内分泌前列腺癌（NEPC）。为了鉴定侵袭性前列腺癌的驱动因子，我们在具有前列腺特异性Pten和Tp53缺失的小鼠模型（NPp53小鼠）中使用了睡美人（SB）转座子诱变。与对照NPp53-SB(-)小鼠相比，实验性NPp53-SB(+)小鼠发展为更具侵袭性的肿瘤，且转移增加。值得注意的是，NPp53-SB(+)小鼠表现出NEPC表型，其转录组特征重现了人类NEPC。对反复出现的共同插入位点（CIS）及相关基因（CIS基因）的分析，鉴定了NEPC与非NEPC肿瘤之间差异表达的基因。通过跨物种整合基因组和转录组数据对NEPC富集的CIS基因进行分析，将sirtuin 1（Sirt1）优先列为NEPC的候选机制决定因素。在人类前列腺癌细胞和小鼠NEPC类器官中的功能获得和丧失研究证实，SIRT1促进NEPC，而药理学抑制则抑制NEPC。因此，将跨物种分析与无偏正向遗传筛选相结合，发现了NEPC的新驱动因子。

abstract: Long-term, low-dose rate (LDR) ionising radiation has been found to increase the risk of leukaemia and other haematological effects. Understanding the mechanisms underlying these effects can be useful for guiding radiation protection policies. This study explores the utility of an organ-on-a-chip (OOC) system as a platform for prolonged LDR studies on haematopoietic stem cells (HSCs). Control samples exhibited a higher population of cells in the primitive state than irradiated samples, revealing a nuanced impact of prolonged LDR exposure on HSC behaviour. RNA profiling further identified differential expression in 166 genes between these samples, offering insights into molecular mechanisms underlying the radiation response. This study underscores the usefulness of OOC systems in advancing our understanding of longer-term responses to LDR irradiation.
abstractZh: 长期低剂量率（LDR）电离辐射已被发现会增加白血病和其他血液学效应的风险。理解这些效应背后的机制有助于指导辐射防护政策。本研究探讨了器官芯片（OOC）系统作为长期LDR研究造血干细胞（HSCs）平台的实用性。对照样本中处于原始状态的细胞数量高于受照射样本，揭示了长期LDR暴露对HSC行为的细微影响。RNA分析进一步鉴定了这些样本之间166个基因的差异表达，为辐射反应的分子机制提供了见解。本研究强调了OOC系统在增进我们对LDR照射长期反应理解方面的实用性。

abstract: Human adenovirus (HAdV) is one of the most infectious pathogens that can cause diseases affecting multiple organ systems, posing a significant threat to public health. Currently, there are no specific antiviral therapies available for HAdV infection. In this study, three folate antagonists aminopterin (AMT), pralatrexate (PDX), and methotrexate (MTX) with potent antiviral activity against HAdV infection have been identified through a drug repurposing screening strategy. The three drugs showed broad and potent antiviral efficiency against multiple clinically prevalent HAdV serotypes, including HAdV-B3, HAdV-B7, HAdV-B55, HAdV-C2, and HAdV-C5 with half-maximal effective concentration (EC50) values ranging from 0.31 to 79.74 nM, and PDX further showed similar antiviral efficiency against HAdV-B55 in a 3D lung organoid model (EC50 = 0.51 nM). Mechanistic studies revealed that PDX achieved its antiviral activity through suppression of dihydrofolate reductase (DHFR). These findings support the potential of folate antagonists as repurposed therapeutic agents against HAdV infection and provide a rationale for the development of host-directed antiviral strategies.
abstractZh: 人腺病毒（HAdV）是最具传染性的病原体之一，可引起影响多个器官系统的疾病，对公共卫生构成重大威胁。目前，尚无针对HAdV感染的特异性抗病毒疗法。在本研究中，通过药物重定位筛选策略，鉴定出三种叶酸拮抗剂——氨基蝶呤（AMT）、普拉曲沙（PDX）和甲氨蝶呤（MTX），它们对HAdV感染具有强效抗病毒活性。这三种药物对多种临床流行的HAdV血清型（包括HAdV-B3、HAdV-B7、HAdV-B55、HAdV-C2和HAdV-C5）表现出广谱且强效的抗病毒效率，半数有效浓度（EC50）值范围为0.31至79.74 nM，且PDX在3D肺类器官模型中对HAdV-B55也表现出类似的抗病毒效率（EC50 = 0.51 nM）。机制研究表明，PDX通过抑制二氢叶酸还原酶（DHFR）实现其抗病毒活性。这些发现支持叶酸拮抗剂作为针对HAdV感染的重新定位治疗药物的潜力，并为开发宿主导向的抗病毒策略提供了依据。

title: The Gut Microbiome in HIV Pathogenesis: Interconnections Between Dysbiosis, Immune Dysfunction, and Viral Persistence.
titleZh: HIV发病机制中的肠道微生物组：菌群失调、免疫功能障碍与病毒持续存在之间的相互联系。

abstract: The human gut microbiome is essential for immune regulation and mucosal homeostasis, functions that are profoundly disrupted during HIV infection. Early viral replication in the gut-associated lymphoid tissue (GALT) triggers a self-reinforcing cycle of CD4+ T-cell depletion, epithelial barrier breakdown, and increased microbial translocation. This persistent immune activation continues even under effective antiretroviral therapy (ART). A growing body of evidence indicates that HIV infection is consistently associated with alterations in gut microbial communities. This dysbiosis is typically characterized by fewer beneficial butyrate-producing commensal bacteria and an enrichment of pro-inflammatory microbial taxa. It also involves disturbances in key microbial metabolites, including short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) and tryptophan catabolites. Such changes not only exacerbate systemic inflammation but may also contribute to incomplete immune reconstitution and the persistence of latent viral reservoirs despite long-term ART. In this review, we summarize current knowledge of microbiome-HIV interactions, with particular emphasis on the mechanisms through which gut dysbiosis contributes to immune dysfunction and viral persistence. We discuss recent advances in multi-omics technologies, as well as experimental systems such as gnotobiotic and humanized mouse models and intestinal organoid platforms that are helping to elucidate these complex interactions. Furthermore, we evaluate emerging microbiome-targeted interventions-including probiotics, prebiotics, fecal microbiota transplantation, and engineered bacterial therapeutics-and consider their potential role as adjunctive strategies in HIV treatment and cure research. By integrating microbiological, immunological, and clinical perspectives, this review highlights key knowledge gaps and outlines future research directions aimed at harnessing the gut microbiome as a novel therapeutic avenue in HIV management and eradication.
abstractZh: 人类肠道微生物组对免疫调节和黏膜稳态至关重要，而这些功能在HIV感染期间受到严重破坏。早期病毒在肠道相关淋巴组织（GALT）中的复制会触发一个自我强化的循环，包括CD4+ T细胞耗竭、上皮屏障破坏和微生物易位增加。即使在有效的抗逆转录病毒治疗（ART）下，这种持续的免疫激活仍在继续。越来越多的证据表明，HIV感染与肠道微生物群落的改变始终相关。这种菌群失调通常表现为有益的产丁酸盐共生菌减少，而促炎微生物类群富集。它还涉及关键微生物代谢物的紊乱，包括短链脂肪酸（SCFAs）和色氨酸分解代谢物。这些变化不仅加剧全身性炎症，还可能促进不完全的免疫重建以及尽管长期接受ART仍存在的潜伏病毒库的持续存在。在本综述中，我们总结了目前关于微生物组与HIV相互作用的知识，特别强调了肠道菌群失调导致免疫功能障碍和病毒持续存在的机制。我们讨论了多组学技术的最新进展，以及诸如无菌和人类化小鼠模型以及肠道类器官平台等实验系统，这些系统有助于阐明这些复杂的相互作用。此外，我们评估了新兴的针对微生物组的干预措施——包括益生菌、益生元、粪便微生物群移植和工程化细菌疗法——并考虑它们作为HIV治疗和治愈研究中辅助策略的潜在作用。通过整合微生物学、免疫学和临床视角，本综述强调了关键的知识空白，并概述了旨在利用肠道微生物组作为HIV管理和根除的新治疗途径的未来研究方向。

title: Cerebral Cortical-Like Organoid Model of PPP2R5D Induced Genetic Intellectual Disability Displays Variant-Specific Disease Severity Phenotype
titleZh: PPP2R5D诱导的遗传性智力障碍的脑皮层样类器官模型显示变异特异性疾病严重程度表型
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Du Y, Singh M, Patil M, Villegas I, Portillo A, Shang K, Ben-Shalom R, Halmai J, Fink K.
abstract: Jordan’s Syndrome (JS) is a rare, neurodevelopmental disorder caused by de novo missense mutations in protein phosphatase 2 regulatory subunit B’delta (  PPP2R5D ). JS is characterized by severe neurological impairments starting in early life.  PPP2R5D encodes for B56δ, one of the regulatory subunits of protein phosphatase 2A (PP2A). PP2A is a heterotrimeric protein serine/threonine phosphatase that is highly expressed in the brain and the liver. Past studies have focused on PP2A’s role in liver and little is known about the holoenzyme’s behavior in neuronal cells. Although B56δ is known to play an important role in the substrate specificity of PP2A, the identification of validated downstream substrates in JS remains unclear. To better understand how the mutations affect neuronal cells, we developed cerebral cortical-like organoids from an engineered allele series of the most common JS mutations to characterize the physiological changes throughout different stages of neurodevelopment. Organoids were assessed for transcriptomic, protein, and electrophysiological changes utilizing bulk RNA sequencing, immunocytochemistry, Western Blot, and high-density MicroElectrode Array. The results identify differentially expressed genes and translated proteins, potential neuronal substrates, and significant electrophysiological signatures that suggest mutations in B56δ lead to variant-specific dysfunction of PP2A. Overexpression of  PPP2R5D through AAV transduction of organoids rescued several phenotypes in the variants, suggesting different pathogenetic etiology underneath. Our findings successfully characterized cerebral cortical-like organoids in JS cell lines and demonstrated its potential as a model for studying neurodevelopmental disorder and for screening therapeutic approaches.
abstractZh: 乔丹综合征（JS）是一种罕见的神经发育障碍，由蛋白磷酸酶2调节亚基B'δ（PPP2R5D）的从头错义突变引起。JS的特征是生命早期开始的严重神经损伤。PPP2R5D编码B56δ，这是蛋白磷酸酶2A（PP2A）的调节亚基之一。PP2A是一种异源三聚体蛋白丝氨酸/苏氨酸磷酸酶，在大脑和肝脏中高表达。过去的研究集中在PP2A在肝脏中的作用，而对全酶在神经元细胞中的行为知之甚少。尽管已知B56δ在PP2A的底物特异性中发挥重要作用，但在JS中验证的下游底物的鉴定仍不清楚。为了更好地理解突变如何影响神经元细胞，我们从最常见的JS突变的工程化等位基因系列中开发了脑皮层样类器官，以表征神经发育不同阶段的生理变化。利用批量RNA测序、免疫细胞化学、Western Blot和高密度微电极阵列评估类器官的转录组、蛋白质和电生理变化。结果确定了差异表达基因和翻译蛋白、潜在的神经元底物以及显著的电生理特征，表明B56δ的突变导致PP2A的变异特异性功能障碍。通过AAV转导类器官过表达PPP2R5D，挽救了变异体中的几种表型，表明其下存在不同的致病病因。我们的研究成功表征了JS细胞系中的脑皮层样类器官，并证明了其作为研究神经发育障碍和筛选治疗方法的模型的潜力。

title: Dysregulation of miRNAs Drives Premature GABAergic Maturation and Early Neurodevelopmental Defects in Schizophrenia
titleZh: miRNA失调驱动精神分裂症中GABA能神经元过早成熟和早期神经发育缺陷
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Mohamed FA, Søkilde R, Bayram E, Nawrocki A, Jensen P, Kadlecova M, Wathikthinnakon M, Cirera S, Møller T, Brasch-Andersen C, Benros M, Larsen MR, Nielsen BS, Freude K.
abstract:
ABSTRACT

  Background

  Schizophrenia (SCZ) is a severe neurodevelopmental disorder with numerous genetic risk loci. However, little is known about the molecular alterations that occur during brain development in SCZ, particularly regarding the role of microRNA (miRNA) mediated regulatory mechanisms. This gap in knowledge is largely due to the limited availability of developing human brain tissue. Patient-derived brain organoids offer a promising alternative model. Here we use 3D dorsal forebrain organoids (DFOs) to investigate miRNA dysregulation in SCZ. Methods

  DFOs were generated from human induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs) derived from six SCZ patients and five matched controls and cultured for 120 days. Multi-omics analyses, immunohistochemistry, and in situ hybridization were employed to characterize molecular and spatial features. Results

  DFOs recapitulated key molecular hallmarks of human cortical development. Nineteen miRNAs were differentially expressed in SCZ: nine associated with neural progenitor proliferation were downregulated and ten linked to neuronal differentiation and synaptic maturation were upregulated, reflecting a compressed developmental timeline. Among 77 dysregulated mRNAs, 55 were predicted miRNA targets. SCZ DFOs exhibited significant upregulation of GABAergic pathway genes accompanied by altered expression of their regulatory miRNAs, indicating premature GABAergic lineage specification. The disrupted miRNA–mRNA network converged on glutamatergic and dopaminergic development, synaptic organization, and extracellular matrix remodeling. Conclusion

  Dysregulated miRNAs in SCZ DFOs disrupt neuronal differentiation, excitatory–inhibitory balance, and early circuit formation, implicating miRNA-mediated post-transcriptional regulation as a key mechanism linking molecular alterations to cellular and network-level deficits in SCZ.
abstractZh:
摘要

  背景

  精神分裂症（SCZ）是一种严重的神经发育障碍，具有众多遗传风险位点。然而，关于SCZ大脑发育过程中发生的分子改变知之甚少，尤其是microRNA（miRNA）介导的调控机制的作用。这一知识空白主要由于发育中人类脑组织的有限可用性。患者来源的脑类器官提供了一种有前景的替代模型。在这里，我们使用3D背侧前脑类器官（DFOs）来研究SCZ中的miRNA失调。方法

  DFOs由来自六名SCZ患者和五名匹配对照的人类诱导多能干细胞（hiPSCs）生成，并培养120天。采用多组学分析、免疫组织化学和原位杂交来表征分子和空间特征。结果

  DFOs重现了人类皮层发育的关键分子标志。在SCZ中，19个miRNA差异表达：与神经祖细胞增殖相关的9个下调，与神经元分化和突触成熟相关的10个上调，反映了压缩的发育时间线。在77个失调的mRNA中，55个是预测的miRNA靶标。SCZ DFOs表现出GABA能通路基因的显著上调，伴随其调控miRNA的表达改变，表明GABA能谱系过早特化。 disrupted miRNA–mRNA网络汇聚于谷氨酸能和多巴胺能发育、突触组织和细胞外基质重塑。结论

  SCZ DFOs中失调的miRNA破坏神经元分化、兴奋-抑制平衡和早期回路形成，暗示miRNA介导的转录后调控是将分子改变与SCZ中细胞和网络水平缺陷联系起来的关键机制。

title: Inter-organ communication shapes human metabolic tissue states and resolves anti-diabetic drug response modes in a six-tissue microphysiological system
titleZh: 器官间通讯塑造人类代谢组织状态，并在六组织微生理系统中解析抗糖尿病药物反应模式
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: McGilvrey M, Chew S, Siddiqui MF, Bronson R, Uslu M, Ye S, Ospina O, McPherson A, Diel K, Dogsa M, Raechal L, Trapecar M.
abstract:
Systemic glucose regulation depends on coordinated signaling among metabolically specialized tissues, yet most human  in vitro models capture only limited portions of this network. Here, we developed and benchmarked a perfused human six-tissue MPS by combining AnthroHive, a recirculating perfusion platform, with MOTIVE-6, a six-compartment Multiorgan Tissue Interaction Vessel, to culture human gut epithelium, pancreatic islets, liver organoids, adipocytes, skeletal muscle, and midbrain-patterned brain organoids in a microphysiological system. Shared perfusion redirected engineered tissue states toward tissue-aligned metabolic, endocrine, absorptive, contractile, and neural-associated programs while reducing selected isolation-associated stress and remodeling signatures. Under High nutrient conditions, however, multi-tissue interaction shifted liver and islet responses toward inflammatory and nutrient-stress-associated gene expression, indicating context-dependent effects of cross-compartment signaling. Graded nutrient exposure resolved a staged circuit trajectory: Low nutrient conditions supported maintenance-associated programs, Mid nutrient exposure induced compensatory endocrine and anabolic remodeling with declining net glucose depletion, and High nutrient exposure shifted the system toward stress-associated metabolic dysfunction. Under High conditions, metformin and semaglutide produced distinct response modes. Metformin preserved circuit-level glucose handling without increasing insulin or C-peptide accumulation, while semaglutide remodeled gut, brain organoid, islet, and liver organoid transcriptional programs linked to nutrient sensing, epithelial maintenance, endocrine signaling, and neurometabolic state. Together, this study establishes a benchmarked human six-tissue MPS resource, paired with tissue-resolved transcriptomic, shared-media metabolomic, functional, endocrine, and inflammatory datasets, for investigating how tissue interaction, nutrient availability, and metabolic therapies reshape glucose-regulatory networks. abstractZh:
系统性血糖调节依赖于代谢特化组织间的协调信号传导，然而大多数人类体外模型仅能捕捉该网络的有限部分。在此，我们开发并验证了一种灌注式人类六组织MPS，将再循环灌注平台AnthroHive与六室多器官组织相互作用容器MOTIVE-6相结合，在微生理系统中培养人肠道上皮、胰岛、肝脏类器官、脂肪细胞、骨骼肌和中脑模式脑类器官。共享灌注将工程化组织状态重新导向组织对齐的代谢、内分泌、吸收、收缩和神经相关程序，同时减少选定的分离相关应激和重塑特征。然而，在高营养条件下，多组织相互作用将肝脏和胰岛反应转向炎症和营养应激相关基因表达，表明跨区室信号传导的上下文依赖性效应。分级营养暴露解析了一个阶段性回路轨迹：低营养条件支持维持相关程序，中营养暴露诱导代偿性内分泌和合成代谢重塑，伴随净葡萄糖消耗下降，而高营养暴露将系统转向应激相关的代谢功能障碍。在高条件下，二甲双胍和司美格鲁肽产生不同的反应模式。二甲双胍在不增加胰岛素或C肽积累的情况下保持回路水平的葡萄糖处理，而司美格鲁肽重塑了与营养感知、上皮维持、内分泌信号传导和神经代谢状态相关的肠道、脑类器官、胰岛和肝脏类器官转录程序。总之，本研究建立了一个经过验证的人类六组织MPS资源，并配以组织分辨的转录组学、共享培养基代谢组学、功能性、内分泌和炎症数据集，用于研究组织相互作用、营养可用性和代谢疗法如何重塑血糖调节网络。图形摘要

title: Immunomodulatory impact of  PTPN11  /SHP2-based vertical RAS-MAPK pathway inhibition in pancreatic cancer
titleZh: 基于PTPN11/SHP2的纵向RAS-MAPK通路抑制在胰腺癌中的免疫调节影响
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Alrawashdeh AY, Chen X, Hafner P, Keller SJ, Das T, Jumaa H, Avery TY, Besson S, Hempel S, Mewes S, Meyer K, Al Shhab M, Schneider M, Lettner JD, Elverfeldt Dv, Reichardt W, Boerries M, Fichtner-Feigl S, Andrieux G, Ruess DA.
abstract: Protein tyrosine phosphatase non-receptor 11 (  PTPN11 /SHP2) is a critical upstream mediator of RAS-MAPK signaling and a central node in adaptive resistance mechanisms evolving with RAS and MEK/ERK inhibition. Accordingly, clinical trials are currently evaluating allosteric SHP2 inhibitors in vertical RAS pathway combination therapies for various KRAS-mutant malignancies, including pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC).  Here, we aimed to delineate the immunomodulatory effects of SHP2-based vertical RAS pathway inhibition in notoriously immunotherapy-refractory PDAC, spanning from early treatment response to invariably evolving adaptive resistance. Employing human and murine  PTPN11 knockout and wild-type PDAC cell lines, an autochthonous murine PDAC model (KPC), and patient-derived PDAC organoids, we find that short term dual MEK/SHP2 inhibition induces increased T cell infiltration and a reduction in immunosuppressive M2-like macrophages. However, these effects are accompanied by a decrease in mature dendritic cells and a concomitant expansion of monocytic myeloid-derived suppressor cells, indicative of a mixed immunological response with both immune-activating and immune-suppressing features. These changes are associated with tumor cell-intrinsic upregulation of CXCR3 ligands and TGF-β, as well as increased expression of checkpoint ligands for TIGIT and TIM-3 across molecular subtypes and species. With prolonged treatment and transition to an adaptive resistant tumor cell state, the initial immune-sensitizing effects are lost and the immune-suppressive features prevail. M2-like macrophages re-accumulate, dendritic cell maturation remains impaired, TGF-β expression persists, and TIGIT and TIM-3 ligand expression is further enhanced. Notably, dual SHP2/RAS inhibition recapitulates the observed induction of TGF-β and checkpoint ligands.  Collectively, these findings identify a dynamic but ultimately immunosuppressive remodeling of the tumor microenvironment in response to SHP2-based vertical RAS pathway inhibition in PDAC and provide a rationale for combinatorial immunotherapy strategies. In particular, concurrent targeting of TGF-β, combined TIGIT/TIM-3 checkpoint blockade, and likely CD40 agonism may help sustain early immune activation while counteracting emerging suppressive features, thereby improving the durability of tumor control.
abstractZh: 蛋白酪氨酸磷酸酶非受体11型（PTPN11/SHP2）是RAS-MAPK信号传导的关键上游介质，也是随着RAS和MEK/ERK抑制而演变的适应性耐药机制中的中心节点。因此，目前临床试验正在评估变构SHP2抑制剂在多种KRAS突变恶性肿瘤（包括胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC））的纵向RAS通路联合治疗中的应用。在此，我们旨在描述基于SHP2的纵向RAS通路抑制在众所周知的免疫治疗难治性PDAC中的免疫调节效应，涵盖从早期治疗反应到不可避免演变的适应性耐药。利用人源和鼠源PTPN11敲除及野生型PDAC细胞系、自发性鼠PDAC模型（KPC）以及患者来源的PDAC类器官，我们发现短期双重MEK/SHP2抑制可诱导T细胞浸润增加，并减少免疫抑制性M2样巨噬细胞。然而，这些效应伴随着成熟树突状细胞的减少和单核细胞性髓源性抑制细胞的同步扩增，表明存在一种混合免疫反应，兼具免疫激活和免疫抑制特征。这些变化与肿瘤细胞内在的CXCR3配体和TGF-β上调，以及跨分子亚型和物种的TIGIT和TIM-3检查点配体表达增加相关。随着长期治疗和向适应性耐药肿瘤细胞状态的转变，最初的免疫致敏效应消失，免疫抑制特征占主导。M2样巨噬细胞重新积聚，树突状细胞成熟仍受损，TGF-β表达持续存在，TIGIT和TIM-3配体表达进一步增强。值得注意的是，双重SHP2/RAS抑制重现了观察到的TGF-β和检查点配体诱导。总的来说，这些发现确定了PDAC中基于SHP2的纵向RAS通路抑制对肿瘤微环境的动态但最终免疫抑制性重塑，并为联合免疫治疗策略提供了依据。特别是，同时靶向TGF-β、联合TIGIT/TIM-3检查点阻断，以及可能的CD40激动剂，可能有助于维持早期免疫激活，同时抵消新出现的抑制特征，从而提高肿瘤控制的持久性。

title: Epithelial stem cell-derived chemokines track clinical remission in inflammatory bowel disease in a disease-specific manner
titleZh: 上皮干细胞来源的趋化因子以疾病特异性方式追踪炎症性肠病的临床缓解
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Alake S, Kadam A, Jester T, Maynard CL, Ojo BA.
abstract:
Background and Aims

  Stem cell-derived organoids are promising platforms for therapeutic screening in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), but identifying functional organoid readouts with translational utility is challenging. Colon epithelial organoids from patients with ulcerative colitis (UC) overexpress chemokines CXCL1, CXCL11, CCL2, and CCL28, yet whether these inflammatory signatures correlate with disease activity and treatment response is unknown. This short report investigates whether organoid-retained chemokines correlate with disease activity and therapeutic outcomes. Methods

  We interrogated three bulk and two single-cell transcriptomic datasets from IBD clinical trials encompassing anti-TNFα and anti-integrin therapies to determine whether epithelial chemokines retained in UC organoids track clinical response and distinguish treatment responders from non-responders to biologic therapy across multiple IBD patient cohorts. Results

  In bulk transcriptomic data, CXCL1, CXCL11, and CCL2 were elevated in active UC and normalized only in patients achieving clinical remission, independent of therapy class, with persistent chemokine overexpression in non-responders. Single-cell analysis demonstrated widespread chemokine overexpression in UC epithelial clusters, with consistent normalization of CXCL1, CXCL11, and CCL28 in LGR5-positive stem compartment of patients who achieved clinical remission, but not in non-responders. In Crohn’s disease, the resolution of these epithelial chemokines was not associated with clinical response. Conclusions

  Epithelial chemokines, particularly CXCL1, CXCL11, and CCL28, track clinical remission in UC and represent candidate biomarkers and functional endpoints for epithelial-directed therapeutic strategies using stem cell-derived UC organoid models.
abstractZh:
背景与目的

  干细胞来源的类器官是炎症性肠病（IBD）治疗筛选的有前景平台，但识别具有转化效用的功能性类器官读数具有挑战性。来自溃疡性结肠炎（UC）患者的结肠上皮类器官过表达趋化因子CXCL1、CXCL11、CCL2和CCL28，但这些炎症特征是否与疾病活动度和治疗反应相关尚不清楚。本短篇报告探讨类器官保留的趋化因子是否与疾病活动度和治疗结局相关。方法

  我们查询了来自IBD临床试验的三个批量转录组数据集和两个单细胞转录组数据集，涵盖抗TNFα和抗整合素治疗，以确定UC类器官中保留的上皮趋化因子是否追踪临床反应，并在多个IBD患者队列中区分生物治疗应答者与无应答者。结果

  在批量转录组数据中，CXCL1、CXCL11和CCL2在活动性UC中升高，且仅在达到临床缓解的患者中恢复正常，与治疗类别无关，而无应答者中趋化因子持续过表达。单细胞分析显示UC上皮簇中趋化因子广泛过表达，在达到临床缓解的患者中，LGR5阳性干细胞区室的CXCL1、CXCL11和CCL28持续正常化，但在无应答者中未观察到。在克罗恩病中，这些上皮趋化因子的消退与临床反应无关。结论

  上皮趋化因子，特别是CXCL1、CXCL11和CCL28，追踪UC的临床缓解，并代表使用干细胞来源的UC类器官模型进行上皮定向治疗策略的候选生物标志物和功能性终点。

title: A finite-dimensional weighted affine framework for multimodal biological measurements
titleZh: 有限维加权仿射框架用于多模态生物测量
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Patel VP.
abstract: Abstract  Modern biological studies often measure the same biological carrier---for example a single cell, spatial tissue region, organoid, biopsy specimen, or patient---using several assays. The resulting modalities may include RNA abundance, chromatin accessibility, protein-marker intensity, metabolite abundance, microscopy-derived morphology, spatial location, or clinical biomarkers. These measurements live in different feature spaces and have different error structures, but they are intended to describe one underlying biological state. This raises a mathematical question: how should cross-modal consistency be represented and quantified? We develop a finite-dimensional weighted affine framework for this question. Each modality is assigned an observation space, and a linear consistency operator $U$ with target $c$ defines the biologically admissible joint measurements as an affine subspace $H=\{x:Ux=c\}$ of the product space. The residual $Ux-c$ measures cross-modal discordance under the chosen biological or calibration model; orthogonal projection onto $H$ gives the nearest reconciled joint measurement; and covariance-weighted projection accounts for assay-specific noise and uncertainty. We prove existence, uniqueness, and explicit formulas for these projections, show how affine consistency sets arise from common latent-state models with modality-specific observation maps, and derive consequences for missing-modality completion and familiar linear reductions such as PCA and CCA. As a concrete biological interpretation, consider spatial tumor multi-omics, where transcriptomic, protein-imaging, metabolic, and morphology-derived features are measured from the same local tissue region. A high residual in this setting can mark technical misregistration, assay noise, model misspecification, or a genuine transition region. The framework is therefore not proposed as a replacement for integration algorithms, but as an interpretable mathematical layer for defining, testing, and regularizing agreement among multimodal biological measurements.
abstractZh: 摘要 现代生物学研究通常使用多种检测方法测量同一生物载体——例如单个细胞、空间组织区域、类器官、活检标本或患者。由此产生的模态可能包括RNA丰度、染色质可及性、蛋白标志物强度、代谢物丰度、显微镜衍生的形态学、空间位置或临床生物标志物。这些测量存在于不同的特征空间，具有不同的误差结构，但旨在描述一个潜在的生物学状态。这引出了一个数学问题：跨模态一致性应如何表示和量化？我们针对这一问题开发了一个有限维加权仿射框架。每种模态被赋予一个观测空间，线性一致性算子$U$及其目标$c$将生物学上可接受的联合测量定义为乘积空间中的仿射子空间$H=\{x:Ux=c\}$。残差$Ux-c$在所选生物学或校准模型下衡量跨模态不一致性；正交投影到$H$上给出最近的和解联合测量；协方差加权投影则考虑检测特异性噪声和不确定性。我们证明了这些投影的存在性、唯一性和显式公式，展示了仿射一致性集合如何从具有模态特异性观测映射的常见潜在状态模型中产生，并推导了缺失模态补全以及PCA和CCA等常见线性降维方法的推论。作为具体的生物学解释，考虑空间肿瘤多组学，其中转录组、蛋白质成像、代谢和形态学衍生的特征从同一局部组织区域测量。在此设置中，高残差可能标志着技术配准错误、检测噪声、模型误设或真实的过渡区域。因此，该框架并非作为整合算法的替代品，而是作为定义、测试和正则化多模态生物测量间一致性的可解释数学层。

title: Arrhythmia Drug Responses in Cardiac Spheroids: Insights from the Mera Microphysiological System
titleZh: 心脏球体中的心律失常药物反应：来自Mera微生理系统的见解
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Almeida N, Sum-Coffey V, Costello P, Madden C, Devitt S, Mukkunda SR, Keshava BB, Sunil S, Riley LG, Deely S, de Benedictis CA, Lyons M, Cliffe FE.
abstract: Abstract  Cardiac rhythm is a critical clinical indicator for cardiac arrhythmias and adverse events during drug toxicity studies. In vivo, cardiomyocyte responses to pharmacological agents occur within minutes and are strongly influenced by dynamic drug delivery through blood flow. However, conventional 2D and 3D static culture systems fail to replicate these fluid flow kinetics, limiting their physiological relevance for assessing beat rate responses. Here, we present Mera, an advanced microphysiological system (MPS) developed by Hooke Bio, designed for high-throughput, long-term culture and functional analysis of 3D cardiac spheroids composed of human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes and cardiac fibroblasts. Mera enables dynamic perfusion, allowing investigation of cardiomyocyte beat rates under physiologically relevant flow conditions. The platform supports up to 640 spheroids per run and integrates automated imaging, fluid handling, and user-friendly software, operating under controlled physiological conditions (37°C, 5% CO₂). Flow rates are tunable between 0 and 12.5 mL/min to mimic in vivo environments. Pharmacological testing with verapamil, isoproterenol, calcium chloride, and propranolol demonstrated real-time, reversible modulation of beat rate under flow, including recovery following drug-induced suppression. System variability was comparable to a temperature-controlled reference platform, supporting robust statistical analysis. Dose-response studies yielded IC₅₀ values consistent with literature, confirming physiological relevance. Collectively, these results demonstrate that Mera provides a reproducible, scalable, and human-relevant platform for cardiac drug testing. By enabling dynamic drug exposure and automated analysis, Mera represents a powerful new approach methodology (NAM) for improving the predictive assessment of cardiac safety and beat-rate modulation drug responses.
abstractZh: 摘要 心脏节律是药物毒性研究中评估心律失常和不良事件的关键临床指标。在体内，心肌细胞对药理剂的反应在几分钟内发生，并受到通过血流进行的动态药物输送的强烈影响。然而，传统的2D和3D静态培养系统无法复制这些流体流动动力学，限制了它们在评估搏动率反应方面的生理相关性。在此，我们介绍了Mera，一种由Hooke Bio开发的高级微生理系统（MPS），专为高通量、长期培养和功能分析由人诱导多能干细胞来源的心肌细胞和心脏成纤维细胞组成的3D心脏球体而设计。Mera能够进行动态灌注，允许在生理相关的流动条件下研究心肌细胞搏动率。该平台每次运行支持多达640个球体，并集成了自动化成像、流体处理和用户友好的软件，在受控的生理条件（37°C，5% CO₂）下运行。流速可在0至12.5 mL/min之间调节，以模拟体内环境。使用维拉帕米、异丙肾上腺素、氯化钙和普萘洛尔进行的药理学测试表明，在流动条件下，搏动率可实时、可逆地调节，包括药物诱导抑制后的恢复。系统变异性与温度控制的参考平台相当，支持稳健的统计分析。剂量反应研究得出的IC₅₀值与文献一致，证实了其生理相关性。总的来说，这些结果表明Mera为心脏药物测试提供了一个可重复、可扩展且与人类相关的平台。通过实现动态药物暴露和自动化分析，Mera代表了一种强大的新方法（NAM），用于提高心脏安全性和搏动率调节药物反应的预测性评估。

title: Physiopharmacology of Liver Regeneration from Molecules to Trials
titleZh: 肝再生的生理药理学：从分子到临床试验
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Lonardo A, Weiskirchen R.
abstract: Liver regeneration is a tightly orchestrated compensatory response in which the remaining liver regains mass and function after liver injury, or surgical resection. However, it does not fully restore its original anatomy. This process involves sequential priming, proliferative, and termination phases that are controlled by inflammatory cytokines, growth factor signaling, metabolic regulation, and extracellular matrix remodeling. Clinically, regenerative capacity plays a crucial role in situations such as partial hepatectomy, acute liver failure, and chronic liver disease. Unfortunately, it can be compromised by conditions like cirrhosis, steatosis, diabetes, and other systemic or local issues. Current strategies to improve regeneration, such as portal vein modulation, cell-based therapies, organoid technology, and bioartificial liver support, show promise. However, they are limited by challenges like impaired engraftment, functional immaturity, technical complexity, and scalability restrictions. This review explores the pathophysiological basis of liver regeneration and evaluates the clinical evidence on nutritional and pharmacological interventions aimed at enhancing the natural liver repair mechanisms of the body.
abstractZh: 肝再生是一个紧密协调的代偿性反应，在此过程中，剩余的肝脏在肝损伤或手术切除后恢复其质量和功能。然而，它并不能完全恢复其原有的解剖结构。这一过程涉及由炎症细胞因子、生长因子信号传导、代谢调节和细胞外基质重塑所控制的连续启动、增殖和终止阶段。临床上，再生能力在部分肝切除术、急性肝衰竭和慢性肝病等情况下起着至关重要的作用。不幸的是，它可能因肝硬化、脂肪变性、糖尿病以及其他系统性或局部问题而受损。目前改善再生的策略，如门静脉调节、细胞疗法、类器官技术和生物人工肝支持，显示出前景。然而，它们受到植入受损、功能不成熟、技术复杂性和可扩展性限制等挑战的制约。本综述探讨了肝再生的病理生理基础，并评估了旨在增强身体自然肝脏修复机制的营养和药物干预的临床证据。

abstract: Efficient activation of peroxymonosulfate (PMS) by cobalt-based catalysts is often limited by metal leaching, non-selective radical pathways, and associated biotoxicity, hindering their practical application in water purification. Here, cobalt atoms are embedded into the La2Ti2O7 perovskite lattice (Co-LTO), forming asymmetric Co-O-La coordination motifs that create a polarized electronic microenvironment. Airway organoid assays demonstrate that lattice confinement significantly suppresses cobalt associated biotoxicity compared to free cobalt ions. Experimental evidence and density functional theory reveal that the asymmetric Co-O-La coordination redistributes electron density at Co sites, lowers the energy barrier for PMS adsorption and activation, and promotes the selective generation of high-valent cobalt-oxo species via non-radical pathway. Consequently, Co-LTO achieves 99% sulfamethoxazole degradation within 4 min (k = 0.79 min-1), exhibiting 9.87- and 79-fold higher activity than Co3O4 (0.08 min-1) and pristine LTO (0.01 min-1), respectively. Continuous-flow experiments further confirm its structural stability and sustained catalytic performance. This work established lattice-confined asymmetric coordination as an effective strategy to modulate electronic structure, enabling efficient and biologically safer PMS activation for advanced water treatment.
abstractZh: 钴基催化剂对过氧单硫酸盐（PMS）的高效活化常受金属浸出、非选择性自由基途径及相关生物毒性的限制，阻碍了其在水净化中的实际应用。本文将钴原子嵌入La2Ti2O7钙钛矿晶格（Co-LTO）中，形成不对称的Co-O-La配位结构，从而产生极化电子微环境。气道类器官实验表明，与游离钴离子相比，晶格限域显著抑制了钴相关的生物毒性。实验证据和密度泛函理论表明，不对称的Co-O-La配位重新分布了Co位点的电子密度，降低了PMS吸附和活化的能垒，并通过非自由基途径促进了高价钴氧物种的选择性生成。因此，Co-LTO在4分钟内实现了99%的磺胺甲恶唑降解（k = 0.79 min⁻¹），其活性分别是Co3O4（0.08 min⁻¹）和原始LTO（0.01 min⁻¹）的9.87倍和79倍。连续流实验进一步证实了其结构稳定性和持续的催化性能。本研究确立了晶格限域不对称配位作为调节电子结构的有效策略，为高级水处理提供了高效且生物安全性更高的PMS活化方法。

abstract: Myxoid inflammatory myofibroblastic sarcoma (MIMS) is a recently described aggressive sarcoma with deceptively bland spindled cells with a myofibroblastic phenotype and myxoid stroma. These tumors are negative for ALK gene rearrangements, but have been shown to harbor gene fusions involving PDGFRA/B , JAK1 , and PML and/or mutations involving KRAS . Only one uterine case has been previously reported. Here we report the second case of uterine MIMS. This tumor arose in a 40-yr-old woman patient and showed a conspicuously whorled architecture with myxoid stroma and so-called organoid aggregates. By immunohistochemistry, the tumor was positive for CD10, estrogen receptor (ER), and progesterone receptor (PR) with focal smooth muscle actin expression and no staining for ALK, desmin, h-caldesmon, HMB-45, or cathepsin-K. Next-generation sequencing analysis revealed the presence of 2 pathogenic mutations in KRAS , as well as pathogenic mutations in RAD51B and LATS1 . No gene fusions in PDGFRA/B , JAK1 , PML , ALK, ROS1, PLAG1 , or any other gene were identified by whole transcriptomic RNA sequencing. Given its deceptively bland appearance and its propensity, at least in the uterus, to express both CD10 and ER with only focal SMA expression, MIMS can be mistaken for an endometrial stromal tumor, an ALK and ROS1 -negative uterine inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor, or other cytologically bland fusion-driven uterine mesenchymal neoplasms.
abstractZh: 黏液样炎性肌纤维母细胞肉瘤（MIMS）是一种最近被描述的侵袭性肉瘤，具有看似良性的梭形细胞，呈肌纤维母细胞表型，伴有黏液样间质。这些肿瘤ALK基因重排阴性，但已显示携带涉及PDGFRA/B、JAK1和PML的基因融合和/或涉及KRAS的突变。此前仅报道过一例子宫病例。在此我们报道第二例子宫MIMS。该肿瘤发生于一名40岁女性患者，表现出显著的旋涡状结构，伴有黏液样间质和所谓的器官样聚集。免疫组化显示，肿瘤CD10、雌激素受体（ER）和孕激素受体（PR）阳性，局灶性平滑肌肌动蛋白表达，ALK、desmin、h-caldesmon、HMB-45或cathepsin-K染色阴性。下一代测序分析显示存在2个KRAS致病性突变，以及RAD51B和LATS1的致病性突变。全转录组RNA测序未发现PDGFRA/B、JAK1、PML、ALK、ROS1、PLAG1或任何其他基因的基因融合。鉴于其看似良性的外观及其在子宫中至少倾向于同时表达CD10和ER且仅局灶性表达SMA的特性，MIMS可能被误诊为子宫内膜间质肿瘤、ALK和ROS1阴性的子宫炎性肌纤维母细胞肿瘤，或其他细胞学上良性的融合驱动的子宫间叶性肿瘤。

abstract: Tertiary lymphoid structures (TLSs) are immune cell aggregates that emerge in nonlymphoid tissues during various disease states, including chronic inflammation, autoimmunity, and cancer. TLSs are structurally and functionally analogous to secondary lymphoid organs, and exhibit a maturation continuum (progressing from initial aggregation to mature structures with germinal centers). TLS formation is synergistically regulated by local chemokine networks (e.g. CXCL13, CCL19, and CCL21), lymphotoxin signaling axes, stromal cells, metabolic reprogramming, and the microbiome. This review comprehensively elucidates the biological foundations of TLSs, including their cellular composition, spatial architecture, and developmental dynamics of maturation. We explore the crucial roles of TLSs as favorable prognostic factors and predictors of the immunotherapy response in various solid tumors, including melanoma, breast cancer, lung cancer, hepatocellular carcinoma, and colorectal cancer. Additionally, we analyze their "pathogenic" role in causing tissue damage and disease progression in autoimmune disorders such as rheumatoid arthritis and Sjögren's syndrome, as well as chronic inflammatory diseases such as COPD, IgA nephropathy, and atherosclerosis. In addition, we thoroughly examine TLS research methodologies, covering a wide range of approaches from conventional hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) and immunohistochemical staining to advanced multiplex fluorescence staining, imaging mass cytometry, and spatial transcriptomic techniques. We summarize multiple gene expression signatures (e.g. the 12-chemokine signature and TLS score) for TLS identification and quantification. Finally, we highlight multiple strategies for artificially inducing TLS formation, including cytokine delivery, immunotherapy, engineered scaffolds, microbiome modulation, and organoid technologies, designed to enhance antitumor immunity or reverse immunopathology. This review provides a comprehensive framework for understanding the complex functions of TLSs in human disease and explores their clinical translation potential as biomarkers and therapeutic targets.
abstractZh: 三级淋巴结构（TLSs）是在多种疾病状态下（包括慢性炎症、自身免疫和癌症）于非淋巴组织中出现的免疫细胞聚集体。TLSs在结构和功能上与次级淋巴器官相似，并表现出一个成熟连续体（从初始聚集进展到具有生发中心的成熟结构）。TLS的形成受局部趋化因子网络（如CXCL13、CCL19和CCL21）、淋巴毒素信号轴、基质细胞、代谢重编程和微生物组的协同调控。本综述全面阐明了TLSs的生物学基础，包括其细胞组成、空间结构和成熟的发育动态。我们探讨了TLSs作为多种实体瘤（包括黑色素瘤、乳腺癌、肺癌、肝细胞癌和结直肠癌）中有利的预后因素和免疫治疗反应预测因子的关键作用。此外，我们分析了它们在自身免疫性疾病（如类风湿关节炎和干燥综合征）以及慢性炎症性疾病（如慢性阻塞性肺疾病、IgA肾病和动脉粥样硬化）中导致组织损伤和疾病进展的“致病性”作用。此外，我们深入探讨了TLS研究方法，涵盖了从常规苏木精-伊红（H&E）和免疫组织化学染色到先进的多重荧光染色、成像质谱流式细胞术和空间转录组学技术等一系列广泛方法。我们总结了多种基因表达特征（如12-趋化因子特征和TLS评分）用于TLS的识别和量化。最后，我们强调了多种人工诱导TLS形成的策略，包括细胞因子递送、免疫治疗、工程化支架、微生物组调节和类器官技术，旨在增强抗肿瘤免疫或逆转免疫病理。本综述为理解TLSs在人类疾病中的复杂功能提供了一个全面的框架，并探讨了它们作为生物标志物和治疗靶点的临床转化潜力。

abstract:
Background

AXIN1 is a central regulatory hub of many oncogenic pathways in colorectal cancer (CRC). As the main scaffold protein and least abundant component of the beta-catenin destruction complex, changes in AXIN1 levels tightly control Wnt signaling activity. How other cancer pathways beyond Wnt signaling regulate cellular AXIN1 levels is incompletely understood.Methods

Colorectal cancer cell lines, murine and patient-derived intestinal and cancer organoids were used as model systems. Changes in AXIN1 levels upon drug perturbation were profiled by immunoblot, qPCR and RNA-seq. Ubiquitin-affinity immunoprecipitation assays and mass spectrometry were used to determine mechanisms of AXIN1 loss. To characterize effects on protein synthesis, we performed polysome and ribosome profiling (Ribo-seq).Results

We show that targeting the Ras-MAPK pathway using clinically approved MEK1/2 inhibitors induces AXIN1 loss across a panel of CRC cell lines and patient-derived organoids. In contrast to GSK3 inhibitors, MEK1/2 inhibition neither affects protein stability nor post-translational modifications of AXIN1 and only caused a minor reduction of AXIN1 transcript levels. Co-treatment with tankyrase inhibitors could partially prevent loss of AXIN1 upon MEK1/2 inhibition. Using isogenic CRC cell lines and murine intestinal organoids, we show that APC truncations strongly reduce basal cellular AXIN1 levels, but do not alter dynamics of AXIN1 loss after MEK1/2 inhibition. Polysome profiling and Ribo-seq revealed that MEK1/2 inhibitors reduce global protein synthesis via an mTOR associated pathway. This translational repression is sufficient to cause significant AXIN1 loss, as treatment with mTOR or S6K inhibitors phenocopies the effect of MEK1/2 inhibitors.Conclusion

Our study demonstrates that AXIN1 protein homeostasis is critically controlled by Ras-MAPK signaling at the level of protein synthesis, and that MEK1/2 inhibitors cause AXIN1 loss by global translational repression.
abstractZh:
背景

AXIN1是结直肠癌（CRC）中许多致癌途径的中心调控枢纽。作为β-连环蛋白破坏复合物的主要支架蛋白和含量最少的组分，AXIN1水平的变化紧密调控Wnt信号活性。除Wnt信号外，其他癌症途径如何调控细胞AXIN1水平尚不完全清楚。方法

使用结直肠癌细胞系、小鼠和患者来源的肠道及癌症类器官作为模型系统。通过免疫印迹、qPCR和RNA-seq分析药物扰动后AXIN1水平的变化。使用泛素亲和免疫沉淀实验和质谱法确定AXIN1缺失的机制。为了表征对蛋白质合成的影响，我们进行了多聚核糖体分析和核糖体分析（Ribo-seq）。结果

我们表明，使用临床批准的MEK1/2抑制剂靶向Ras-MAPK通路，在一组CRC细胞系和患者来源的类器官中诱导AXIN1缺失。与GSK3抑制剂不同，MEK1/2抑制既不影响AXIN1的蛋白质稳定性，也不影响其翻译后修饰，仅导致AXIN1转录本水平轻微降低。与他克瑞斯抑制剂联合治疗可部分阻止MEK1/2抑制后AXIN1的缺失。使用同基因CRC细胞系和小鼠肠道类器官，我们表明APC截短突变强烈降低基础细胞AXIN1水平，但不改变MEK1/2抑制后AXIN1缺失的动态。多聚核糖体分析和Ribo-seq显示，MEK1/2抑制剂通过mTOR相关通路减少整体蛋白质合成。这种翻译抑制足以导致显著的AXIN1缺失，因为mTOR或S6K抑制剂处理可模拟MEK1/2抑制剂的效果。结论

我们的研究表明，AXIN1蛋白稳态在蛋白质合成水平上受Ras-MAPK信号的关键调控，且MEK1/2抑制剂通过整体翻译抑制导致AXIN1缺失。
