abstract: The bone marrow niche (BMN) plays a central role in regulating hematopoietic stem-cell (HSC) maintenance, lineage commitment, and immune homeostasis, while also supporting osteogenesis and maintaining skeletal integrity. Once considered static, the BMN is now recognized as a dynamic and responsive microenvironment that integrates local signals and systemic cues to meet physiological demands and respond to stress. Aging causes profound and progressive changes to this niche, leading to functional decline across both hematopoietic and stromal compartments. Recent advances in high-resolution imaging, single-cell and spatial transcriptomics, and in vivo lineage tracing have revealed remarkable heterogeneity and plasticity within the vascular and mesenchymal elements of this niche. Yet, key questions remain unresolved, including the identity and hierarchy of mesenchymal and osteolineage cells, the specialization of subsets of endothelial cells, the integration of systemic regulation, and whether the aging bone marrow acts as a driver or a passenger in malignancy and chronic inflammation. This review revisits current models of the BMN, with a focus on the reciprocal interactions between osteogenic cells and specialized vasculature, and how their disruption during aging impairs hematopoietic output and skeletal remodeling. We also examine how systemic factors such as neural input, metabolic status, and inflammatory signaling influence the aging of the BMN. Finally, we highlight emerging translational platforms, including iPSC-derived bone marrow organoids, engineered niches/hydrogels, and vascularized organ-on-chip systems, that enable mechanistic testing of rejuvenation strategies. Together, these insights have the potential to pave the way toward targeted interventions that restore the function of the BMN and promote healthy aging of the bone and blood systems.
abstractZh: 骨髓微环境（BMN）在调节造血干细胞（HSC）维持、谱系定向和免疫稳态中发挥核心作用，同时支持成骨并维持骨骼完整性。骨髓微环境曾被认为是静态的，现在被认为是一个动态且响应性的微环境，它整合局部信号和全身性线索以满足生理需求并应对应激。衰老导致该微环境发生深刻而进行性的变化，导致造血和基质区室的功能衰退。高分辨率成像、单细胞和空间转录组学以及体内谱系示踪的最新进展揭示了该微环境内血管和间充质成分的显著异质性和可塑性。然而，关键问题仍未解决，包括间充质和成骨谱系细胞的同一性和层级结构、内皮细胞亚群的特化、全身性调控的整合，以及衰老骨髓是恶性肿瘤和慢性炎症的驱动因素还是伴随因素。本综述重新审视了BMN的当前模型，重点关注成骨细胞与特化血管之间的相互作用，以及它们在衰老过程中的破坏如何损害造血输出和骨骼重塑。我们还探讨了神经输入、代谢状态和炎症信号等全身性因素如何影响BMN的衰老。最后，我们强调了新兴的转化平台，包括iPSC来源的骨髓类器官、工程化微环境/水凝胶和血管化器官芯片系统，这些平台能够对再生策略进行机制性测试。总之，这些见解有可能为恢复BMN功能和促进骨骼及血液系统健康衰老的靶向干预措施铺平道路。

title: Circulating Tumor DNA and Precision Biomarkers in Colorectal Cancer: Implications for Diagnosis, Monitoring, and Management of Advanced Disease.
titleZh: 循环肿瘤DNA与结直肠癌精准生物标志物：对晚期疾病诊断、监测和管理的影响。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Srinivasalu VK, Subramaniam N, Ibrahim M, Das M.
affiliations: Molecular Immunology, Mazumdar Shaw Medical Foundation, Bangalore, India.
MAHE, Manipal, India.
Department of Medical Oncology, Sakra World Hospital, Bangalore, India.
CPDTRI, Bangalore, India.
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains one of the leading causes of cancer-related mortality worldwide, with outcomes critically dependent on timely diagnosis, accurate risk stratification, and individualized treatment. Traditional markers such as CEA, KRAS/NRAS, BRAF, and MSI status, while foundational, are insufficient to address the full complexity of CRC biology. Over the past decade, a new generation of biomarkers has emerged spanning liquid biopsy, stool-based methylation, genomics, epigenomics, immune profiling, microbiome analysis, radiomics, patient-derived organoids, and multiomics integration-collectively redefining how CRC is detected, classified, and treated. This narrative review synthesizes evidence from 73 human studies published between 2010 and 2024, identified through structured searches of PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library, and quality-assessed using QUADAS-2 and Newcastle-Ottawa tools. Circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) emerged as the most clinically validated biomarker, demonstrating superior performance in minimal residual disease (MRD) detection, recurrence prediction, and real-time therapy monitoring. Stool DNA methylation assays showed strong sensitivity for early CRC and advanced adenoma detection. Genomic markers including BRAF V600E, POLE/POLD1, HER2, and KRAS G12C now directly inform targeted therapy selection, while immune biomarkers-MSI-H, TMB, and Immunoscore-guide immunotherapy decisions and stratify prognosis beyond TNM staging. Microbiome signatures, particularly Fusobacterium nucleatum and colibactin-producing Escherichia coli, were associated with chemo resistance and tumor progression. Radiomics and AI-driven imaging models provided noninvasive assessment of nodal involvement and neo-adjuvant therapy response. Patient-derived organoids demonstrated capacity to predict individual drug sensitivity, and multiomic integration enabled refined molecular subtyping. Despite this progress, widespread clinical adoption remains limited by assay variability, lack of prospective multicenter validation, and implementation barriers including cost and infrastructure. As these technologies mature, their integration into standardized, multidisciplinary workflows will be essential to translating biomarker innovation into improved patient outcomes across all stages of CRC care.
abstractZh: 结直肠癌（CRC）仍然是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一，其预后关键取决于及时诊断、准确的风险分层和个体化治疗。传统标志物如CEA、KRAS/NRAS、BRAF和MSI状态虽然具有基础性作用，但不足以应对CRC生物学的全部复杂性。在过去十年中，新一代生物标志物应运而生，涵盖液体活检、粪便甲基化、基因组学、表观基因组学、免疫谱分析、微生物组分析、放射组学、患者来源类器官以及多组学整合——共同重新定义了CRC的检测、分类和治疗方式。本叙述性综述综合了2010年至2024年间发表的73项人类研究的证据，这些研究通过结构化检索PubMed、Embase、Web of Science和Cochrane Library获得，并使用QUADAS-2和纽卡斯尔-渥太华工具进行质量评估。循环肿瘤DNA（ctDNA）成为临床验证最充分的生物标志物，在微小残留病（MRD）检测、复发预测和实时治疗监测方面表现出优越性能。粪便DNA甲基化检测在早期CRC和晚期腺瘤检测中显示出较高的敏感性。包括BRAF V600E、POLE/POLD1、HER2和KRAS G12C在内的基因组标志物现已直接指导靶向治疗选择，而免疫生物标志物——MSI-H、TMB和Immunoscore——则指导免疫治疗决策并在TNM分期之外进行预后分层。微生物组特征，特别是具核梭杆菌和产colibactin的大肠杆菌，与化疗耐药和肿瘤进展相关。放射组学和人工智能驱动的影像模型为淋巴结受累和新辅助治疗反应提供了无创评估。患者来源类器官展示了预测个体药物敏感性的能力，多组学整合则实现了更精细的分子分型。尽管取得了这些进展，但广泛的临床采用仍受限于检测变异性、缺乏前瞻性多中心验证，以及包括成本和基础设施在内的实施障碍。随着这些技术的成熟，将其整合到标准化、多学科工作流程中，对于将生物标志物创新转化为改善CRC各阶段护理的患者预后至关重要。

title: Establishment and application in ovary research of porcine three dimensional ovarian organoids.
titleZh: 猪三维卵巢类器官的建立及其在卵巢研究中的应用。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）

abstract: The porcine ovary is an invaluable model for human ovarian research and critical for agricultural reproductive efficiency. Traditional two-dimensional (2D) models fail to recapitulate the native ovary's 3D structure and functions, limiting their utility. This study aimed to establish a stable 3D porcine ovarian organoid model, evaluate its utility, and explore melatonin's regulatory effects. Porcine ovarian tissues from prepubertal gilts were digested, cultured in Matrigel® with optimized medium. Organoids were characterized via microscopy, qRT-PCR, and H&E/IF staining. Lentivirus-GFP was used to verify infectivity; while melatonin (1-20 μM) effects were tested via Cell Titer-Glo and qRT-PCR analysis. Typical round organoids formed on day 7, maintaining stability up to passage 10, expressing ovarian biomarkers (EPACM, CDH1, FSH, DDX4, etc.), and mimicking in vivo histology. Lentivirus infected organoids dose-dependently. Melatonin enhanced viability/size and upregulated FOXL2, FIGLA, and AMH genes in a dose-dependent manner. Thus, a stable and functional 3D porcine ovarian organoid model was established for gene perturbation. Melatonin benefits organoid growth via key gene upregulation, providing a novel tool for ovarian research and translational studies.
abstractZh: 猪卵巢是人类卵巢研究的宝贵模型，对农业繁殖效率至关重要。传统的二维（2D）模型无法重现天然卵巢的三维结构和功能，限制了其应用。本研究旨在建立稳定的三维猪卵巢类器官模型，评估其效用，并探讨褪黑素的调节作用。将青春期前母猪的猪卵巢组织消化后，在Matrigel®中用优化培养基培养。通过显微镜、qRT-PCR和H&E/IF染色对类器官进行表征。使用慢病毒-GFP验证感染性；通过Cell Titer-Glo和qRT-PCR分析测试褪黑素（1-20 μM）的效果。第7天形成典型的圆形类器官，稳定维持至第10代，表达卵巢生物标志物（EPACM、CDH1、FSH、DDX4等），并模拟体内组织学。慢病毒感染类器官呈剂量依赖性。褪黑素以剂量依赖性方式增强活力/大小，并上调FOXL2、FIGLA和AMH基因。因此，建立了稳定且功能性的三维猪卵巢类器官模型，用于基因干扰。褪黑素通过上调关键基因促进类器官生长，为卵巢研究和转化研究提供了新工具。

title: NGFR/Ngfr-marked basal duct progenitors drive ductal–acinar regeneration in injured salivary glands
titleZh: NGFR/Ngfr标记的基底导管祖细胞驱动受损唾液腺中的导管-腺泡再生
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Jeon SG, Bae DH, Park J, Yong M, Nguyen TVT, Lee KJ, Lee S, Lim YC, Bae EJ, Son M, Yoo J.
abstract: Severe salivary gland injury can cause chronic xerostomia and persistent secretory dysfunction, yet the epithelial populations that support repair remain poorly defined. Here, we identify NGFR/Ngfr as a conserved surface marker for isolating organoid-forming epithelial stem/progenitor cells from human and mouse salivary glands and show that mouse Ngfr-lineage cells contribute to ductal–acinar regeneration after injury. Single-cell transcriptomic analysis of human salivary gland tissue identified a restricted NGFR-expressing basal duct epithelial subpopulation with progenitor-like features and early positions along inferred epithelial differentiation trajectories. Functionally, NGFR-expressing cells showed enhanced primary and secondary organoid-forming capacity, and NGFR-enriched human organoids engrafted after transplantation into injured salivary glands of immunodeficient mice. In mouse salivary glands, isolated Ngfr-expressing cells showed enriched organoid-forming activity, and Ngfr expression localized to injury-associated ductal regions after duct ligation and local inflammatory injury. Ngfr-CreERT2 lineage tracing further showed that Ngfr-lineage cells contribute to ductal and acinar compartments during post-injury regeneration. Together, these findings establish NGFR/Ngfr as a conserved surface marker for prospectively isolating basal duct epithelial stem/progenitor populations with organoid-forming activity and injury-responsive ductal–acinar regenerative potential.
abstractZh: 严重的唾液腺损伤可导致慢性口干症和持续性分泌功能障碍，然而支持修复的上皮细胞群体仍未被充分定义。在此，我们确定NGFR/Ngfr为一种保守的表面标志物，用于从人类和小鼠唾液腺中分离具有类器官形成能力的上皮干细胞/祖细胞，并证明小鼠Ngfr谱系细胞在损伤后有助于导管-腺泡再生。对人类唾液腺组织的单细胞转录组分析识别出一个受限的NGFR表达基底导管上皮亚群，该亚群具有祖细胞样特征，并位于推断的上皮分化轨迹的早期位置。功能上，表达NGFR的细胞显示出增强的原代和继代类器官形成能力，并且NGFR富集的人类类器官在移植到免疫缺陷小鼠受损唾液腺后能够成功植入。在小鼠唾液腺中，分离的Ngfr表达细胞显示出富集的类器官形成活性，且Ngfr表达定位于导管结扎和局部炎症损伤后的损伤相关导管区域。Ngfr-CreERT2谱系追踪进一步表明，Ngfr谱系细胞在损伤后再生过程中有助于导管和腺泡区室。总之，这些发现确立了NGFR/Ngfr作为一种保守的表面标志物，用于前瞻性分离具有类器官形成活性和损伤响应性导管-腺泡再生潜力的基底导管上皮干细胞/祖细胞群体。

title: Stage-specific exposure to an activity-permissive media enhances neuronal maturation in oligodendrocyte-enriched cortical organoids
titleZh: 阶段特异性暴露于活动允许培养基可增强富含少突胶质细胞的皮质类器官中的神经元成熟
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Chung C, Kim MJ, Field G, Pilarinos K, Kharitonova EK, Campbell NB, Gabel CV, Orofino JL, Zeldich E.
abstract:
Summary

  Oligodendrocyte-enriched cortical organoids (OCOs) are a powerful platform for modeling oligodendrogenesis in a human cellular context. However, neuronal activity is impaired in conventional culture media, limiting assessment of neuronal function in conjunction with oligodendrocyte biology. To address this, we used a modified BrainPhys medium termed neuronal activity medium (NAM) and defined the optimal developmental window for NAM exposure to generate OCOs with robust neuronal activity (NAM-OCOs). Stage-specific exposure to NAM, prior to oligodendrocyte expansion, leads to enhanced structural maturation, as evidenced by increased organoid size, heightened synaptogenesis, and upregulation of transcripts associated with neuronal complexity. Further, NAM-OCOs display increased cellular heterogeneity, including greater representation of GABAergic interneurons while preserving oligodendrocyte development and maturation. Altogether, our studies demonstrate that stage-specific exposure to an activity-permissive environment enhances neuronal activity, establishing an OCO model which integrates neuronal activity with oligodendrocyte development and maturation. Highlights

  Increased neuronal activity in oligodendrocyte-enriched cortical organoids (OCOs) Stage-specific Neuronal Activity Medium (NAM) optimizes activity NAM-OCOs display increased cellular heterogeneity and neuronal maturation Oligodendrogenesis is preserved in NAM-OCOs eTOC blurb

  In this article, Chung et al enhance neuronal activity in oligodendrocyte-enriched cortical organoids (OCOs) through stage-specific exposure to Neuronal Activity Medium (NAM). OCOs exposed to NAM display elevated cellular heterogeneity, structural maturation, and synaptogenesis, while preserving oligodendrocyte development and maturation. These results establish an increasingly comprehensive OCO model for studying neuronal function and oligodendrogenesis.
abstractZh:
摘要

  富含少突胶质细胞的皮质类器官（OCOs）是在人类细胞背景下模拟少突胶质细胞生成的强大平台。然而，在常规培养基中，神经元活动受损，限制了与少突胶质细胞生物学相关的神经元功能的评估。为解决这一问题，我们使用了一种改良的BrainPhys培养基，称为神经元活动培养基（NAM），并确定了NAM暴露的最佳发育窗口，以生成具有强健神经元活动的OCOs（NAM-OCOs）。在少突胶质细胞扩增之前，阶段特异性暴露于NAM可增强结构成熟，表现为类器官尺寸增大、突触发生增强以及与神经元复杂性相关的转录本上调。此外，NAM-OCOs显示出增加的细胞异质性，包括GABA能中间神经元的比例增加，同时保留了少突胶质细胞的发育和成熟。总之，我们的研究表明，阶段特异性暴露于活动允许的环境可增强神经元活动，建立了一个将神经元活动与少突胶质细胞发育和成熟相结合的OCO模型。亮点

  富含少突胶质细胞的皮质类器官（OCOs）中神经元活动增加 阶段特异性神经元活动培养基（NAM）优化活动 NAM-OCOs显示出增加的细胞异质性和神经元成熟 NAM-OCOs中保留了少突胶质细胞生成 eTOC简介

  在本文中，Chung等人通过阶段特异性暴露于神经元活动培养基（NAM）增强了富含少突胶质细胞的皮质类器官（OCOs）中的神经元活动。暴露于NAM的OCOs显示出更高的细胞异质性、结构成熟和突触发生，同时保留了少突胶质细胞的发育和成熟。这些结果为研究神经元功能和少突胶质细胞生成建立了一个日益全面的OCO模型。

title: Nerve growth factor receptor identifies a basal subpopulation linked to poor prognosis and reduced immunotherapy responses in bladder cancer
titleZh: 神经生长因子受体识别膀胱癌中与不良预后及免疫治疗反应降低相关的基底亚群
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: García-Agulló J, Santos V, Kalisz M, Marqués M, Andrada E, Berca C, Ramal M, Martínez de Villarreal J, Pérez-Martínez M, Eckstein M, Benítez R, Caleiras E, Malats N, Real FX, Peinado H.
abstract:
Purpose

  Bladder cancer (BLCA) is a heterogeneous tumor type. Only one third of muscle-invasive (MIBC) patients respond to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs). Reliable resistance markers are needed to guide clinical decisions. We investigated the nerve growth factor receptor (NGFR) in BLCA and analyzed its correlation with disease progression and response to immunotherapy. Experimental Design

  We analyzed NGFR expression in BLCA cell lines, organoids, mouse models and patient samples. The cohorts used were The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), enriched in muscle-invasive bladder cancer (MIBC) (n=407); IMvigor210, representing MIBC patients treated with ICIs (n=348); and UROMOL2, as a non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC)-specific cohort (n=535). IMvigor010 was also included (n=728). Patients were stratified by NGFR expression quartiles. We analyzed survival and tumor subtypes and performed stromal deconvolution and functional profiling. We assessed stemness- and invasion-related features in SCaBER cells. Results

  NGFR marks a basal tumor cell subcluster and is independently associated with poor prognosis in TCGA and IMvigor210. NGFR-high tumors show stromal content enriched in cancer-associated fibroblasts, lower neoantigen burden, higher CD8  + T effector signature together with an immune-excluded phenotype, and a CAF-specific TGFβ signature. In the immunotherapy-treated cohort, high NGFR expression was also associated with poorer outcome. Functionally, NGFR appears to promote a stem-like/pro-invasive program in BLCA cells.  Conclusions

  NGFR identifies a basal-like BLCA subpopulation linked to poor survival, while its association with immunotherapy response requires further validation. In addition, our in vitro analyses support a role of NGFR in stem-like and invasive traits, highlighting its relevance as a biomarker in BLCA.
abstractZh:
目的

  膀胱癌（BLCA）是一种异质性肿瘤类型。只有三分之一的肌层浸润性膀胱癌（MIBC）患者对免疫检查点抑制剂（ICIs）有反应。需要可靠的耐药标志物来指导临床决策。我们研究了膀胱癌中的神经生长因子受体（NGFR），并分析了其与疾病进展和免疫治疗反应的相关性。实验设计

  我们分析了膀胱癌细胞系、类器官、小鼠模型和患者样本中的NGFR表达。使用的队列包括：癌症基因组图谱（TCGA），富含肌层浸润性膀胱癌（MIBC）（n=407）；IMvigor210，代表接受ICIs治疗的MIBC患者（n=348）；以及UROMOL2，作为非肌层浸润性膀胱癌（NMIBC）特异性队列（n=535）。还包括IMvigor010（n=728）。患者按NGFR表达四分位数进行分层。我们分析了生存率和肿瘤亚型，并进行了基质解卷积和功能分析。我们评估了SCaBER细胞中与干性和侵袭相关的特征。结果

  NGFR标记一个基底肿瘤细胞亚群，并在TCGA和IMvigor210中与不良预后独立相关。NGFR高表达肿瘤显示出富含癌症相关成纤维细胞的基质成分、较低的新抗原负荷、较高的CD8+ T效应特征以及免疫排斥表型，并伴有CAF特异性TGFβ特征。在接受免疫治疗的队列中，高NGFR表达也与较差的结果相关。在功能上，NGFR似乎促进膀胱癌细胞中的干样/促侵袭程序。结论

  NGFR识别出一个与较差生存相关的基底样膀胱癌亚群，而其与免疫治疗反应的相关性需要进一步验证。此外，我们的体外分析支持NGFR在干样和侵袭特征中的作用，突显其作为膀胱癌生物标志物的相关性。

title: The interconnection of cryobiology and tissue engineering.
titleZh: 低温生物学与组织工程的相互联系。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Mutsenko V, Kuleshova L, Glasmacher B, Petrenko AY.
affiliations: Institute for Multiphase Processes, Leibniz University Hannover, Garbsen, Germany; Institute for Problems of Cryobiology and Cryomedicine, National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine, Kharkiv, Ukraine.
National University Medical Institutes Yong Loo Lin School of Medicine, National University of Singapore, Singapore. Electronic address: kuleshova@imp.uni-hannover.de.
Institute for Multiphase Processes, Leibniz University Hannover, Garbsen, Germany.
Institute for Problems of Cryobiology and Cryomedicine, National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine, Kharkiv, Ukraine.
abstract: Over the past decades, cryobiology has become increasingly integrated across a variety of domains. With broad intersection, this discipline has recently also emerged as a cornerstone for advancing and clinically translating tissue-engineered constructs (TECs). This review provides a comprehensive overview of recent advances at the intersection of cryobiology and tissue engineering. Vitrification of both scaffold-based and scaffold-free TECs as well as approaches of its upscaling including benefits of polymers and technical devices are comprehensibly discussed. The development of biologically inspired nanoscale materials is outlined as an integral part of this research. Success in vitrification of organoids is also discussed. Developments in controlled-rate slow-cooling/freezing protocols are then examined, with particular attention to xeno-free and Me2SO-free cryoprotective systems that enhance cell viability and biocompatibility. Preclinical studies utilizing cryopreserved TECs in animal models are further outlined as key milestones toward clinical translation. Furthermore, this review introduces emerging synergistic approaches that make TECs more adaptable to cryopreservation by incorporating cryoprotective agents (CPAs), nanoparticles, cold-responsive polymers and ice recrystallization/devitrification inhibitors at the scaffold design stage. Finally, cryobioprinting as an emerging approach that unites cryobiology and tissue engineering, offering new opportunities for the fabrication, storage, and on-demand deployment of viable tissue constructs is reviewed. Overall, the overviewed experimental evidence underscores the transformative role of cryobiology in driving recent advances in the field of tissue engineering and fostering innovative and forward-looking strategies in this field. Ultimately, a closer convergence of cryobiology, tissue engineering, and transplantation science will be essential to advance TECs toward scalable, off-the-shelf availability.
abstractZh: 在过去的几十年里，低温生物学已日益融入各个领域。随着广泛的交叉，这门学科最近也已成为推进和组织工程构建物（TECs）临床转化的基石。本综述全面概述了低温生物学与组织工程交叉领域的最新进展。文中全面讨论了基于支架和无支架TECs的玻璃化保存及其放大方法，包括聚合物和技术设备的优势。生物启发的纳米尺度材料的开发被概述为这项研究的一个组成部分。类器官玻璃化保存的成功也得到讨论。随后审视了受控速率慢速冷却/冷冻方案的发展，特别关注无异源和无二甲基亚砜（Me2SO）的冷冻保护系统，这些系统可提高细胞活力和生物相容性。利用冷冻保存的TECs在动物模型中进行的临床前研究被进一步概述为迈向临床转化的关键里程碑。此外，本综述介绍了新兴的协同方法，通过在支架设计阶段加入冷冻保护剂（CPAs）、纳米颗粒、冷响应聚合物和冰重结晶/脱玻璃化抑制剂，使TECs更能适应冷冻保存。最后，综述了低温生物打印作为一种新兴方法，它结合了低温生物学和组织工程，为可行组织构建物的制造、储存和按需部署提供了新的机会。总体而言，所概述的实验证据强调了低温生物学在推动组织工程领域近期进展和促进该领域创新及前瞻性策略方面的变革性作用。最终，低温生物学、组织工程和移植科学的更紧密融合将对推动TECs实现可扩展的、即用型可用性至关重要。

title: Quercetin Alleviates Intestinal and Liver Dysfunction Induced by Hypoxia in a Microphysiological System.
titleZh: 槲皮素在微生理系统中缓解缺氧诱导的肠道和肝脏功能障碍。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Liu Z, Li L, Yang T, Qin J, Wang Y.
affiliations: School of Biomedical Engineering, Division of Life Sciences and Medicine, University of Science and Technology of China, Hefei, Anhui 230026, China.

abstract: Pathological hypoxia such as high-altitude exposure is harmful to the human body system and multiply organs. However, the systemic damage effects of hypoxia on the intestine and liver tissue remain unclear due to the limitations of traditional 2D cell cultures and animal models. Here, we establish a biomimetic gut-liver microphysiological system (GLMPS) as a human model of the gut-liver axis by coculturing human gut and liver cell lines interconnected under circulating fluid flow, for investigating the mechanisms of hypoxia-induced injury in the intestine and liver. By treatment with 1% O2 for 48 h, cocultured Caco-2/HT29 gut cells and HepG2 hepatocyte-like cells exhibit increased intestinal barrier permeability, inflammatory responses, and cellular apoptosis. Transcriptomic analysis reveals similar activated pathways associated with endoplasmic reticulum stress and apoptosis in the gut and liver cells. Furthermore, quercetin effectively attenuates hypoxia-induced oxidative stress and apoptosis by enhancing autophagy. The GLMPS provides a biomimetic in vitro platform for studying hypoxia-related pathologies of gut and liver and facilitating the exploration of therapeutic targets.
abstractZh: 病理性缺氧，如高海拔暴露，对人体系统和多个器官有害。然而，由于传统二维细胞培养和动物模型的局限性，缺氧对肠道和肝脏组织的系统性损伤效应仍不清楚。在此，我们通过在人肠道和肝细胞系在循环流体流动下相互连接共培养，建立了一个仿生肠-肝微生理系统（GLMPS），作为肠-肝轴的人类模型，用于研究缺氧诱导的肠道和肝脏损伤机制。通过1% O2处理48小时，共培养的Caco-2/HT29肠道细胞和HepG2肝细胞样细胞表现出肠道屏障通透性增加、炎症反应和细胞凋亡。转录组分析揭示了肠道和肝脏细胞中与内质网应激和凋亡相关的相似激活通路。此外，槲皮素通过增强自噬有效减轻缺氧诱导的氧化应激和凋亡。GLMPS为研究肠道和肝脏的缺氧相关病理提供了一个仿生体外平台，并有助于探索治疗靶点。

title: Human Kidney Organoids to Uncover Preterm Birth-Associated Low Nephron Endowment.
titleZh: 人类肾脏类器官揭示早产相关的低肾单位 endowment。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: van den Berge BT, Smeets B, Schreuder MF, Jansen J.

abstract:
Background

Preterm birth disrupts kidney development, resulting in reduced nephron number and structural immaturity of glomeruli and podocytes that increases the risk of hypertension, proteinuria, and subsequently chronic kidney disease (CKD) later in life. Since nephrogenesis ceases around 36 weeks of gestation, preterm infants cannot generate new nephrons after birth, making them vulnerable to long-term renal dysfunction. Unravelling the mechanisms behind this impaired development has been limited by the complexity of human nephrogenesis and the lack of physiologically relevant experimental models.Summary

Recent advances in human-induced pluripotent stem cell-derived kidney organoids have made it possible to model nephrogenesis in vitro. These organoids replicate key processes such as nephron differentiation, ureteric bud branching, and kidney vascularization, allowing detailed study of kidney development and injury. Moreover, molecular interventions - including retinoic acid (RA), glial-cell-line-derived neurotrophic factor (GDNF), and insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF1) - show the potential to enhance nephron formation and protect against kidney injury.Key messages

(1) Kidney organoids provide a powerful, human-relevant system to study nephrogenesis and CKD mechanisms. (2) Integration of the ureteric bud and enhanced vascularization significantly improves organoid maturity towards a more in vivo-like state. (3) Targeted molecular interventions such as RA, GDNF, and IGF1 offer potential strategies to enhance nephron endowment and mitigate CKD risk in preterm-born individuals and may be studied using kidney organoids.
abstractZh:
背景

早产会破坏肾脏发育，导致肾单位数量减少以及肾小球和足细胞的结构不成熟，从而增加日后患高血压、蛋白尿以及随后慢性肾脏病（CKD）的风险。由于肾发生大约在妊娠36周时停止，早产儿出生后无法生成新的肾单位，使其易受长期肾功能障碍的影响。由于人类肾发生的复杂性和缺乏生理相关的实验模型，阐明这种发育受损背后的机制一直受到限制。

摘要

近年来，人类诱导多能干细胞来源的肾脏类器官的进展使得在体外模拟肾发生成为可能。这些类器官复制了肾单位分化、输尿管芽分支和肾脏血管化等关键过程，从而能够详细研究肾脏发育和损伤。此外，分子干预——包括维甲酸（RA）、胶质细胞源性神经营养因子（GDNF）和胰岛素样生长因子1（IGF1）——显示出增强肾单位形成和预防肾脏损伤的潜力。

关键信息

(1) 肾脏类器官提供了一个强大且与人类相关的系统，用于研究肾发生和CKD机制。(2) 输尿管芽的整合和增强的血管化显著提高了类器官的成熟度，使其更接近体内状态。(3) 靶向分子干预如RA、GDNF和IGF1提供了增强肾单位 endowment 并减轻早产个体CKD风险的潜在策略，并且可以使用肾脏类器官进行研究。

title: Identification of secondary microglial formation centers in the human fetal brain.

abstract: Microglia migrate from the yolk sac and populate the developing brain. How microglia expand rapidly to meet the microglial demand in fast-expanding human fetal brains remains uncharted. Using thick sections in 5-22-gestational week (gw) brains and super-resolution scanning, we identified a large proliferative microglial aggregate (2.129 mm2) near the lateral ganglionic eminence (>12.5 gw), expanding in Down's syndrome (DS) (4.767 mm2) and Edwards syndrome (ES) (3.437 mm2) fetal brains. Ki67+ microglia within the aggregates accounted for 26.65% (DS: 38.9%; ES: 46.3%) compared with 6.32% (DS: 6.01%; ES: 5.2%) in scattered microglia. This aggregate region contained a distinct microglial population characterized by the absence of phagocytic structures and complex processes, high CSF-1R expression, abundant IL-34+ cells, and some SPP1+ bipolar microglia. We termed this structure the secondary microglial formation center (SMFC). Chimeric microglia-human cortical organoids recapitulated the SMFC in an IL-34- and CSF-1R-dependent manner, indicating that the human SMFC may compensate for the microglial shortage during the fastest expansion period.
abstractZh: 小胶质细胞从卵黄囊迁移并定植于发育中的大脑。在快速扩张的人胎儿脑中，小胶质细胞如何迅速扩增以满足其需求仍属未知。利用5-22孕周（gw）脑的厚切片和超分辨扫描，我们在外侧神经节隆起附近（>12.5 gw）鉴定出一个大型增殖性小胶质细胞聚集体（2.129 mm²），该聚集体在唐氏综合征（DS）（4.767 mm²）和爱德华兹综合征（ES）（3.437 mm²）胎儿脑中扩大。聚集体内的Ki67+小胶质细胞占26.65%（DS：38.9%；ES：46.3%），而散在分布的小胶质细胞中仅占6.32%（DS：6.01%；ES：5.2%）。该聚集体区域包含一个独特的小胶质细胞群体，其特征为缺乏吞噬结构和复杂突起、高表达CSF-1R、富含IL-34+细胞，以及部分SPP1+双极小胶质细胞。我们将此结构命名为次级小胶质细胞形成中心（SMFC）。嵌合体小胶质细胞-人皮层类器官以IL-34和CSF-1R依赖的方式重现了SMFC，表明人SMFC可能在最快扩张期补偿小胶质细胞的短缺。

title: Morphine potentiates HIV infection and receptor expression in 3d brain organoids.
titleZh: 吗啡在3D脑类器官中增强HIV感染和受体表达。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）

abstract: Opioid abuse is a major comorbidity of HIV, yet its direct effects on the brain remain unclear. Using iPSC-derived 3D human cerebral organoids (hCOs), we show that morphine directly upregulates HIV receptors CD4, CCR5, and CXCR4 in the absence of peripheral immune cells or a blood-brain barrier. This receptor induction drives a significant increase in HIV viral load within the CNS, revealing a brain-intrinsic mechanisms of opioid-mediated viral enhancement. These findings establish hCOs as a unique platform to investigate neuroHIV and provide critical insight into how opioids amplify CNS infection independently of peripheral factors.
abstractZh: 阿片类药物滥用是HIV的主要合并症，但其对大脑的直接作用仍不清楚。利用iPSC来源的3D人脑类器官（hCOs），我们表明吗啡在缺乏外周免疫细胞或血脑屏障的情况下直接上调HIV受体CD4、CCR5和CXCR4。这种受体诱导导致中枢神经系统内HIV病毒载量显著增加，揭示了阿片类药物介导的病毒增强的脑内在机制。这些发现确立了hCOs作为研究神经HIV的独特平台，并为阿片类药物如何独立于外周因素放大中枢神经系统感染提供了关键见解。

title: Human iPSC‑based translational and reverse translational research for neurodegenerative diseases: emphasis on ALS and key advances.
titleZh: 基于人诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）的神经退行性疾病转化与反向转化研究：重点聚焦肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）及关键进展。

abstract: Neurodegenerative diseases such as amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), Alzheimer's disease (AD), Parkinson's disease (PD) and Huntington's disease (HD) cause progressive loss of specific neuronal populations and currently lack curative therapies. Animal models and immortalized cell lines incompletely recapitulate human pathology and genetic heterogeneity, limiting drug discovery. Human induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) provide a patient‑specific platform for disease modelling, drug screening and studying individual responses. Translational research (TR) uses iPSC models to identify candidate therapies that are subsequently tested in clinical trials, while reverse translational research (rTR) feeds clinical observations back to the bench by analyzing iPSCs derived from trial participants and integrating molecular data with patient phenotypes. This review summarizes recent advances in iPSC‑based TR and rTR for ALS and extends the discussion to other neurodegenerative diseases. Key clinical trials launched from iPSC screens-ropinirole, retigabine and bosutinib-are reviewed alongside emerging rTR efforts that use patient‑derived iPSCs to identify biomarkers and therapeutic mechanisms. We also survey iPSC models for AD, PD and HD, highlighting applications of three‑dimensional (3D) brain organoids and gene‑editing technologies. Finally, we discuss future directions for precision medicine, multimodal integration and technological challenges, with particular attention to how imaging biomarkers may complement iPSC-based TR/rTR frameworks in neurodegenerative diseases.
abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病，如肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）、阿尔茨海默病（AD）、帕金森病（PD）和亨廷顿病（HD），会导致特定神经元群体的进行性丧失，目前缺乏治愈性疗法。动物模型和永生化细胞系不能完全重现人类病理学和遗传异质性，限制了药物发现。人诱导多能干细胞（iPSCs）为疾病建模、药物筛选和研究个体反应提供了一个患者特异性的平台。转化研究（TR）利用iPSC模型来识别候选疗法，随后在临床试验中进行测试，而反向转化研究（rTR）则通过分析来自试验参与者的iPSCs，并将分子数据与患者表型整合，将临床观察反馈到实验室。本综述总结了基于iPSC的TR和rTR在ALS中的最新进展，并将讨论扩展到其他神经退行性疾病。从iPSC筛选中启动的关键临床试验——罗匹尼罗、瑞替加滨和博舒替尼——与新兴的rTR工作一起被回顾，这些工作利用患者来源的iPSCs来识别生物标志物和治疗机制。我们还调查了针对AD、PD和HD的iPSC模型，重点介绍了三维（3D）脑类器官和基因编辑技术的应用。最后，我们讨论了精准医学、多模态整合和技术挑战的未来方向，特别关注影像生物标志物如何可能补充基于iPSC的TR/rTR框架在神经退行性疾病中的应用。

title: Multiscale Convergence of Signaling, Epigenetic, and Environmental Networks in Mammalian Palatogenesis and Cleft Palate Pathogenesis.
titleZh: 哺乳动物腭发育与腭裂发病机制中信号、表观遗传和环境网络的多尺度汇聚。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Won HJ, Song B, Song Y, Shin JO.
affiliations: Department of Anatomy, College of Medicine, Kangwon National University, Chuncheon, Korea.

abstract: Palatogenesis is tightly regulated at cellular and molecular levels. Cranial neural crest cells (CNCCs), multipotent stem cells that generate most palatal mesenchyme, self-renew, decide fate, and differentiate under cues from their stem cell niche. Orofacial clefts (OFC), among the most common congenital birth defects, arise when CNCC-mediated palate formation is disturbed. Here we review genes, epigenetic machineries, and environmental insults regulating secondary palate development, focusing on CNCC stem cell biology and translational perspectives in tissue engineering, gene therapy, and regenerative medicine for OFC. Canonical signaling pathways regulating palatal shelf proliferation, growth, elevation, and fusion, including Tgf-beta superfamily and Bmp, Fgf, Wnt, and Shh, function as morphogens directing tissue morphogenesis and as regulators of the progenitor niche derived from neural crest cells, balancing proliferation and differentiation. We also overview debated topics such as signaling crosstalk and dissolution of MES. DNA methylation, histone marks, and noncoding RNAs comprise the epigenetic machinery preserving CNCC identity and plasticity. Environmental exposures including smoking, alcohol consumption, and folate deficiency disrupt genetic and epigenetic programs, perturb normal palate development, and elevate OFC risk. Finally, we discuss emerging technologies including single-cell multi-omics, organoids, and CRISPR-based epigenome editing. We propose an integrative conceptual model that places CNCC state transitions at the center of a complex regulatory network. This model emphasizes that disruption at any level, whether arising from niche interactions, epigenetic programming, or environmental exposures, can precipitate cleft palate pathogenesis.
abstractZh: 腭发育在细胞和分子水平上受到严格调控。颅神经嵴细胞（CNCCs）是多能干细胞，产生大部分腭间充质，它们在干细胞微环境的信号下自我更新、决定命运并分化。口面部裂（OFC）是最常见的先天性出生缺陷之一，当CNCC介导的腭形成受到干扰时就会发生。本文综述了调控次级腭发育的基因、表观遗传机制和环境损伤，重点关注CNCC干细胞生物学以及组织工程、基因治疗和再生医学在OFC中的转化前景。调控腭突增殖、生长、上抬和融合的经典信号通路，包括Tgf-β超家族和Bmp、Fgf、Wnt和Shh，既作为指导组织形态发生的形态发生素，也作为调节神经嵴细胞来源祖细胞微环境的调节因子，平衡增殖和分化。我们还概述了有争议的话题，如信号串扰和MES的溶解。DNA甲基化、组蛋白标记和非编码RNA构成了保持CNCC身份和可塑性的表观遗传机制。环境暴露，包括吸烟、饮酒和叶酸缺乏，会破坏遗传和表观遗传程序，干扰正常腭发育，并增加OFC风险。最后，我们讨论了新兴技术，包括单细胞多组学、类器官和基于CRISPR的表观基因组编辑。我们提出了一个整合的概念模型，将CNCC状态转变置于复杂调控网络的中心。该模型强调，任何层面的破坏，无论是来自微环境相互作用、表观遗传编程还是环境暴露，都可能诱发腭裂发病。

abstract: 5-Fluorouracil (5-FU) is a first-line chemotherapy commonly used to treat colorectal cancer (CRC). However, the development of acquired resistance to 5-FU remains a significant clinical challenge, and the underlying epigenetic mechanisms are not fully understood. In this study, we demonstrate that euchromatic histone lysine methyltransferase 2 (EHMT2) is significantly upregulated in CRC patients with poor responses to 5-FU, directly correlating with lower overall survival rates. Using established 5-FU resistant (5-FUR) HCT116 and HT29 cell lines, RNA-sequencing confirmed robust EHMT2 overexpression compared with wild-type cells. Mechanistically, siRNA-mediated knockdown of EHMT2 restored 5-FU sensitivity by upregulating protein phosphatase 1B (PPM1B), a key downstream target. This EHMT2-PPM1B axis disruption effectively induced G1 phase cell cycle arrest and triggered apoptosis in 5-FUR cells, fundamentally impairing their proliferation. Furthermore, we validated the therapeutic potential of targeting this pathway using in vivo and ex vivo models. Combination treatment with 5-FU and the specific pharmacological EHMT2 inhibitor (BIX-01294) synergistically suppressed tumor growth in a 5-FUR cell-derived xenograft mouse model. Importantly, these therapeutic effects were faithfully recapitulated in 5-FUR patient-derived colorectal cancer organoid (PDO) models. Together, our findings elucidate a critical epigenetic mechanism where EHMT2 promotes 5-FU drug resistance. Targeting EHMT2 represents a promising and translatable therapeutic strategy for overcoming chemoresistance and improving clinical outcomes in CRC patients.
abstractZh: 5-氟尿嘧啶（5-FU）是常用于治疗结直肠癌（CRC）的一线化疗药物。然而，获得性5-FU耐药的发展仍然是一个重大的临床挑战，其潜在的表观遗传机制尚未完全阐明。在本研究中，我们证明常染色质组蛋白赖氨酸甲基转移酶2（EHMT2）在对5-FU反应不佳的CRC患者中显著上调，与较低的总生存率直接相关。使用已建立的5-FU耐药（5-FUR）HCT116和HT29细胞系，RNA测序证实与野生型细胞相比，EHMT2过表达明显。机制上，siRNA介导的EHMT2敲低通过上调关键下游靶点蛋白磷酸酶1B（PPM1B）恢复了5-FU敏感性。这种EHMT2-PPM1B轴的破坏有效诱导5-FUR细胞G1期细胞周期阻滞并触发凋亡，从根本上损害其增殖。此外，我们使用体内和离体模型验证了靶向该通路的治疗潜力。5-FU与特异性药理学EHMT2抑制剂（BIX-01294）联合治疗在5-FUR细胞来源的异种移植小鼠模型中协同抑制肿瘤生长。重要的是，这些治疗效果在5-FUR患者来源的结直肠癌类器官（PDO）模型中得到忠实重现。总之，我们的发现阐明了一个关键的表观遗传机制，其中EHMT2促进5-FU耐药。靶向EHMT2代表了一种有前景且可转化的治疗策略，用于克服化疗耐药并改善CRC患者的临床结局。

title: Fibronectin and laminin differentially affect the inflammatory environment in microphysiological systems
titleZh: 纤连蛋白和层粘连蛋白在微生理系统中差异性地影响炎症环境
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Radke M, Calo CJ, Hind LE.
abstract:
Tissue engineered constructs are increasingly used for both modeling organs and disease  in vitro as well as for therapeutic intervention. In addition to collagen, these constructs commonly include native extracellular matrix proteins (ECM), such as fibronectin and laminin. Given the critical role of inflammatory pathways in disease and in response to implanted materials, it is important to understand the role these proteins play in regulating the inflammatory environment. Fibronectin and laminin influence neutrophil function and endothelial activation in 2D, but their regulation of the inflammatory environment in 3D engineered constructs is not clear. For this study, we used an inflammation-on-a-chip device that includes a model blood vessel surrounded by a collagen I hydrogel with fibronectin and/or laminin. We investigated the additive effects of both proteins and a range of concentrations for each protein to determine concentration dependence. Both fibronectin and laminin have concertation dependent effects on neutrophils and the endothelium. High concentrations (50 µg/mL) of fibronectin reduced neutrophil migration, while 20 µg/mL laminin reduced neutrophil extravasation and migration, potentially due to lower ICAM-1 expression by the endothelium. Interestingly, 50 µg/mL of laminin significantly disrupted endothelial vessel formation and reduced ICAM-1 and VE-cadherin expression, likely due to significant changes in the collagen architecture. The inclusion of fibronectin and laminin, even at physiological levels, results in significant effects on neutrophil behavior, endothelial vessel formation, and collagen architecture. These proteins impact the inflammatory environment and thus need to be considered when modeling diseases and designing therapeutics, especially when neutrophils or an endothelium are involved.  Translational Impact Statement

  This work uses an inflammation-on-a-chip device to study how fibronectin and laminin impact neutrophil behavior and vascular inflammation as these proteins are commonly used in engineered constructs. We found that fibronectin impairs neutrophil migration, while laminin decreases neutrophil extravasation and migration and at higher concentrations also prevents endothelial vessel formation. Therefore, researchers should be aware that these proteins will alter the inflammatory environment when including them in engineered constructs.
abstractZh:
组织工程构建物越来越多地用于体外模拟器官和疾病以及治疗干预。除了胶原蛋白，这些构建物通常包含天然细胞外基质蛋白（ECM），如纤连蛋白和层粘连蛋白。鉴于炎症通路在疾病和对植入材料反应中的关键作用，了解这些蛋白在调节炎症环境中的作用非常重要。纤连蛋白和层粘连蛋白在二维环境中影响中性粒细胞功能和内皮激活，但它们在三维工程构建物中对炎症环境的调节尚不清楚。在本研究中，我们使用了一种炎症芯片装置，该装置包含一个模型血管，周围是含有纤连蛋白和/或层粘连蛋白的I型胶原水凝胶。我们研究了两种蛋白的叠加效应以及每种蛋白的一系列浓度，以确定浓度依赖性。纤连蛋白和层粘连蛋白对中性粒细胞和内皮均有浓度依赖性效应。高浓度（50 µg/mL）的纤连蛋白减少了中性粒细胞迁移，而20 µg/mL的层粘连蛋白减少了中性粒细胞外渗和迁移，这可能是由于内皮细胞ICAM-1表达降低所致。有趣的是，50 µg/mL的层粘连蛋白显著破坏了内皮血管形成并降低了ICAM-1和VE-钙黏蛋白的表达，这可能是由于胶原蛋白结构的显著变化。即使处于生理水平，纤连蛋白和层粘连蛋白的加入也会对中性粒细胞行为、内皮血管形成和胶原蛋白结构产生显著影响。这些蛋白影响炎症环境，因此在模拟疾病和设计治疗方法时需要考虑，尤其是涉及中性粒细胞或内皮时。转化影响声明

  这项工作使用炎症芯片装置研究纤连蛋白和层粘连蛋白如何影响中性粒细胞行为和血管炎症，因为这些蛋白常用于工程构建物中。我们发现纤连蛋白损害中性粒细胞迁移，而层粘连蛋白减少中性粒细胞外渗和迁移，并且在较高浓度下还阻止内皮血管形成。因此，研究人员在将工程构建物中包含这些蛋白时，应意识到它们会改变炎症环境。

title: Applications of adeno-associated virus for 3D single-cell morphometric analysis in iPSC-derived midbrain organoids
titleZh: 腺相关病毒在iPSC来源中脑类器官三维单细胞形态计量分析中的应用
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Baeza Trallero M, Villeneuve E, Lépine P, Krahn A, Chen C, Reintsch W, Castellanos-Montiel M, Durcan T, Berryer M.
abstract: Human midbrain organoids (hMBOs) are emerging  in vitro models to mirror the cellular diversity and the structural complexity of the developing human brain. However, the dense neural network, limits the investigation of individual cells’ morphology or cell-cell connectivity, which is mostly restricted to fixed organoids following extensive optical clearing techniques. To better resolve individual cells within a brain organoid and for longitudinal tracking of its growth and development, we turned to adeno-associated virus (AAVs) for targeted gene delivery. In particular, we applied AAVs for expressing specific markers that provide the foundation to image individual cells within 3D hMBOs. Thus, we developed a phenotypic platform to specifically inspect the neuronal and astrocytic cytoarchitecture and to examine their connectivity in living hMBOs derived from two genetically unrelated control iPSC lines. We demonstrate that through AAV transduction, we could capture and reconstruct the 3D architecture of both neurons and astrocytes within the hMBO as a whole. Transduced cells exhibited an intrinsic heterogeneity in term of soma volume, arbor complexity and territory covered, regardless of both genetic background, age, and cell-type. Yet, these cellular morphometrics remained equivalent between the two cell lines, indicative of homogeneity in hMBO cellular development. We were able to establish longitudinal profiling of transduced cells, demonstrating how neurons and astrocytes could expand their network over time. Lastly, we describe time-lapse studies to track cellular motility and morphology fluctuations in neurons and astrocytes over time, highlighting the dynamic nature of these cells within the ramified architecture of the neural network in the developing hMBOs. Overall, our platform underscores the versatility of AAVs in studying single cell-morphometrics and cellular connectivity for longitudinal monitoring of cellular dynamics in live 3D hMBOs instead of a static snapshot.
abstractZh: 人类中脑类器官（hMBOs）是新兴的体外模型，用于模拟发育中人类大脑的细胞多样性和结构复杂性。然而，致密的神经网络限制了对单个细胞形态或细胞间连接的研究，这主要局限于经过广泛光学透明化处理的固定类器官。为了更好地解析脑类器官内的单个细胞并纵向追踪其生长和发育，我们转向使用腺相关病毒（AAVs）进行靶向基因递送。特别是，我们应用AAVs表达特定标记物，为在三维hMBOs中成像单个细胞提供基础。因此，我们开发了一个表型平台，专门检查来自两个遗传无关的对照iPSC系的活体hMBOs中神经元和星形胶质细胞的细胞结构，并检查它们的连接性。我们证明，通过AAV转导，我们能够捕获并重建整个hMBO内神经元和星形胶质细胞的三维结构。转导细胞在胞体体积、树突复杂性和覆盖区域方面表现出内在异质性，无论遗传背景、年龄和细胞类型如何。然而，这些细胞形态计量学参数在两个细胞系之间保持等效，表明hMBO细胞发育的均一性。我们能够建立转导细胞的纵向分析，展示神经元和星形胶质细胞如何随时间扩展其网络。最后，我们描述了延时研究，以追踪神经元和星形胶质细胞随时间的细胞运动性和形态波动，突出了这些细胞在发育中hMBOs神经网络分支结构中的动态特性。总体而言，我们的平台强调了AAVs在研究单细胞形态计量学和细胞连接性方面的多功能性，用于活体三维hMBOs中细胞动力学的纵向监测，而非静态快照。

abstract: Human enteric α-defensin 5 (HD5) is an antimicrobial peptide and a key effector of intestinal mucosal innate immunity. Paradoxically, HD5 has also been shown to enhance Shigella infection by inducing filopodia-like extensions via activation of the P2Y11 receptor. However, the broader physiological significance of the HD5-P2Y11 interaction remains poorly understood. Here, using primary human colonic epithelial cells, human colonic organoids, and a gut-on-a-chip model, we uncover a previously unappreciated role of HD5 in establishing and preserving the human intestinal barrier by promoting epithelial cell adhesion under stress conditions. Mechanistically, HD5 activates a previously unrecognized P2Y11-FAK signaling axis, leading to phosphorylation of FAK and paxillin and promoting focal adhesion formation, with Rac1 acting downstream to support epithelial adhesion and barrier integrity. Strikingly, this FAK-centered signaling operates independently of PKA, revealing a cell state-dependent bifurcation in HD5-P2Y11 signaling: in well-adhered epithelial cells, HD5 engages PKA to induce exploratory protrusions, whereas in suspended or injured epithelial cells, HD5 preferentially engages FAK to restore adhesion and reinforce barrier integrity. Together, these results identify HD5 as a human-specific epithelial signaling molecule that links innate immune defense to epithelial adhesion dynamics and contributes to mucosal barrier homeostasis.
abstractZh: 人肠α-防御素5（HD5）是一种抗菌肽，也是肠道黏膜先天免疫的关键效应分子。矛盾的是，HD5也被证明通过激活P2Y11受体诱导丝状伪足样延伸，从而增强志贺氏菌感染。然而，HD5-P2Y11相互作用的更广泛生理意义仍知之甚少。在此，我们利用原代人结肠上皮细胞、人结肠类器官和肠芯片模型，揭示了HD5在应激条件下通过促进上皮细胞粘附来建立和维持人肠道屏障的新作用。机制上，HD5激活了先前未被识别的P2Y11-FAK信号轴，导致FAK和桩蛋白磷酸化并促进粘着斑形成，其中Rac1作为下游效应分子支持上皮粘附和屏障完整性。引人注目的是，这种以FAK为中心的信号独立于PKA发挥作用，揭示了HD5-P2Y11信号中细胞状态依赖的分叉：在粘附良好的上皮细胞中，HD5激活PKA以诱导探索性突起，而在悬浮或受损的上皮细胞中，HD5优先激活FAK以恢复粘附并增强屏障完整性。总之，这些结果将HD5鉴定为一种人特异性上皮信号分子，将先天免疫防御与上皮粘附动力学联系起来，并有助于黏膜屏障稳态。

abstract: Down syndrome (DS) features impaired cortical neurogenesis and excess gliogenesis, yet the temporal regulatory events driving this imbalance remain unclear. Here, we combine multi-timepoint transcriptomic analyses from publicly available datasets, network modelling, and machine-learning prioritization, with validation in isogenic human iPSC-derived cerebral organoids, to identify a discrete pathogenic window at 90 days in vitro (DIV 90). Across five developmental stages, REST target genes were preferentially dysregulated in DS organoids. WGCNA revealed a DS-associated module at DIV-90 that strongly overlapped with REST targets, and two orthogonal machine-learning approaches converged on six REST-regulated hub genes-CSTB, MCM3AP, PFKL, POFUT2, PRMT2, and RWDD2B. In trisomic organoids, REST mRNA and nuclear protein were markedly reduced at DIV-90, accompanied by diminished DCX expression and activation of NFIA and STAT3, suggesting a neurogenic-to-gliogenic fate transition. These findings suggest REST dysfunction as a potential temporal regulator of lineage imbalance in DS and highlight REST-linked networks as potential targets for early developmental intervention.
abstractZh: 唐氏综合征（DS）的特征是皮层神经发生受损和胶质发生过度，然而驱动这种失衡的时间调控事件仍不清楚。在此，我们结合来自公开数据集的多个时间点转录组分析、网络建模和机器学习优先级排序，并在同基因人类iPSC来源的脑类器官中进行验证，以确定体外第90天（DIV 90）的一个离散致病窗口。在五个发育阶段中，REST靶基因在DS类器官中优先失调。WGCNA揭示了一个与DS相关的模块，在DIV-90时与REST靶标强烈重叠，两种正交的机器学习方法汇聚于六个REST调控的枢纽基因——CSTB、MCM3AP、PFKL、POFUT2、PRMT2和RWDD2B。在三体类器官中，REST mRNA和核蛋白在DIV-90时显著减少，伴随DCX表达降低以及NFIA和STAT3的激活，提示神经发生向胶质发生的命运转变。这些发现表明REST功能障碍可能是DS中谱系失衡的潜在时间调控因子，并强调REST相关网络作为早期发育干预的潜在靶点。

abstract:
Background

BRAF-altered pediatric high-grade gliomas (pHGG) harbor a dismal prognosis. Although targeted therapy with BRAF and MEK inhibitors provides initial benefit, resistance emerges rapidly in clinical practice indicating an urgent need for improved therapeutic strategies. As BRAF mutations frequently co-occur with homozygous CDKN2A/B loss, we investigated CDK4/6 inhibition as a rational therapeutic strategy.Methods

Using BRAF-mutant cell and human-to-organoid transplant (HOT) models, we assessed the impact of CDK4/6 and MEK inhibitors as mono- or combination therapies on viability, apoptosis, senescence, and molecular signaling. Activation of signaling pathways in primary and recurrent matched samples pre- and post-combined MEK and BRAF treatment was examined by RNA sequencing. In vivo efficacy was evaluated in orthotopic and subcutaneous patient-derived xenograft (PDX) models, as well as in one clinical case.Results

BRAF-mutant, CDKN2A/B-deficient pHGGs displayed strong sensitivity to the CDK4/6 inhibitor abemaciclib in addition to the MEK inhibitor trametinib. These tumors were particularly vulnerable to combined abemaciclib and trametinib treatment, which induced senescence and apoptosis, and uniquely suppressed mTOR activity. Both HOT and PDX models exhibited tumor regression, prolonged survival and sustained response even after therapy discontinuation. These effects were accompanied by a decreased mesenchymal-like cellular phenotype, as indicated by lower CD44 expression and a shift toward a more rounded cell morphology. Interestingly, trametinib- and dabrafenib post-treatment samples exhibited further increase in CD44 levels, along with upregulation of PI3K and hypoxia signaling, indicating therapy-associated reinforcement of mesenchymal transition. The combination of trametinib and ribociclib was translated into clinical application, by showing good response of a patient with BRAF-altered and therapy-refractory pHGG.Conclusion

Our study demonstrated enhanced and prolonged effects of combined CDK4/6 and MEK inhibition in BRAF/CDKN2A-co-altered recurrent pHGG. We further provide evidence that the aggressive mesenchymal cell compartment is particularly targeted by this treatment combination, warranting further preclinical and clinical investigation.
abstractZh:
背景

BRAF突变的儿童高级别胶质瘤（pHGG）预后极差。尽管BRAF和MEK抑制剂的靶向治疗提供了初步获益，但耐药性在临床实践中迅速出现，表明迫切需要改进治疗策略。由于BRAF突变常与纯合性CDKN2A/B缺失共存，我们研究了CDK4/6抑制作为一种合理的治疗策略。方法

使用BRAF突变细胞和人源类器官移植（HOT）模型，我们评估了CDK4/6和MEK抑制剂作为单药或联合治疗对活力、凋亡、衰老和分子信号传导的影响。通过RNA测序检测了原发和复发配对样本在联合MEK和BRAF治疗前后的信号通路激活情况。在原位和皮下患者来源异种移植（PDX）模型以及一个临床病例中评估了体内疗效。结果

BRAF突变、CDKN2A/B缺陷的pHGG对CDK4/6抑制剂abemaciclib以及MEK抑制剂trametinib表现出强敏感性。这些肿瘤对abemaciclib和trametinib联合治疗特别脆弱，该治疗诱导衰老和凋亡，并独特地抑制mTOR活性。HOT和PDX模型均表现出肿瘤消退、生存期延长以及即使在治疗停止后仍持续的反应。这些效应伴随着间充质样细胞表型的减少，表现为CD44表达降低和细胞形态向更圆形转变。有趣的是，trametinib和dabrafenib治疗后的样本显示CD44水平进一步升高，同时PI3K和缺氧信号上调，表明治疗相关的间充质转化增强。trametinib和ribociclib的联合应用已转化为临床应用，对一名BRAF突变且治疗难治性pHGG患者显示出良好反应。结论

我们的研究证明了在BRAF/CDKN2A共改变的复发性pHGG中，联合CDK4/6和MEK抑制具有增强和延长的作用。我们进一步提供证据表明，侵袭性间充质细胞群体特别受到这种治疗组合的靶向，值得进一步的临床前和临床研究。

abstract: Non-coding RNAs play essential roles during liver regeneration, however, their functions in cholangiocyte-to-hepatocyte differentiation is still unclear. Emerging liver ductal organoids offer a powerful model to replicate the molecular mechanisms of the in vivo cholangiocyte-to-immature hepatocyte transition, potentially accelerating advancements in liver regenerative medicine. Here, we established the liver ductal organoids from three C57BL/6 mice, and induced the differentiation of cholangiocyte into immature hepatocyte to carry out the transcriptome sequencing. Then, the expression profiles of lncRNA, miRNA and mRNA in expansion (EM) and differentiation medium (DM) samples were explored. A total of 529,049,578 and 61,266,130 clean reads were generated from 6 RNA-seq and 6 miRNA-seq libraries, respectively. Through stringent filtering, we identified 24,676 lncRNAs, 1,018 miRNAs and 38,689 mRNAs transcripts. This dataset will contribute to the elucidation of the underlying molecular mechanisms associated with cholangiocyte-to-immature hepatocyte differentiation during liver regeneration, and provides clues for liver regenerative medicine.
abstractZh: 非编码RNA在肝再生过程中发挥重要作用，然而，它们在胆管细胞向肝细胞分化中的功能仍不清楚。新兴的肝导管类器官提供了一个强大的模型，可以复制体内胆管细胞向未成熟肝细胞转变的分子机制，可能加速肝脏再生医学的进展。在此，我们从三只C57BL/6小鼠中建立了肝导管类器官，并诱导胆管细胞向未成熟肝细胞分化以进行转录组测序。然后，我们探讨了扩增培养基（EM）和分化培养基（DM）样本中lncRNA、miRNA和mRNA的表达谱。从6个RNA-seq和6个miRNA-seq文库中分别产生了总计529,049,578和61,266,130个干净读段。通过严格筛选，我们鉴定了24,676个lncRNA、1,018个miRNA和38,689个mRNA转录本。该数据集将有助于阐明肝再生过程中与胆管细胞向未成熟肝细胞分化相关的潜在分子机制，并为肝脏再生医学提供线索。

title: An orthotopic organoid-based model to study early CD8⁺ T cell dysfunction and immunotherapy response in colorectal cancer.

abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) treatment represents a major clinical challenge, with immunotherapy providing durable responses only in a minority of patients. A deeper understanding of CD8⁺ T cell exhaustion and its contribution to immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) responsiveness is essential for the development of more effective therapeutic strategies. Preclinical models that faithfully reproduce the immune landscape of human CRC are therefore critical to address these challenges. Here, we established a syngeneic organoid-based orthotopic CRC mouse model by transplanting quadruple mutant Apc⁻/⁻KrasG12D/+Trp53R172H/⁻Smad4⁻/⁻ (AKPS) intestinal organoids into the rectal submucosa of immunocompetent mice. Single-cell transcriptomic profiling revealed that CD8⁺ T cells represent the predominant leukocyte population within the tumor infiltrate and comprise populations transitioning toward dysfunction. Functionally, CD8⁺ T cell depletion led to increased tumor burden in orthotopic AKPS implants, underscoring their antitumor activity. Importantly, anti-PD-1 treatment increased the abundance of dysfunctional CD8⁺ T cell populations within AKPS tumors and reduced tumor growth, demonstrating the responsiveness of this model to ICIs. In contrast, subcutaneous implants of AKPS were infiltrated by mixed CD4⁺ and CD8⁺ T cell subsets, with CD8⁺ T cells exhibiting a markedly less dysfunctional profile, highlighting the limitations of heterotopic tumor models for studying antitumor immune responses. Together, our findings establish the AKPS orthotopic CRC model as a platform to dissect the molecular mechanisms of early CD8⁺ T cell dysfunction and to preclinically evaluate novel immunotherapeutic interventions in CRC.
abstractZh: 结直肠癌（CRC）的治疗是一个重大的临床挑战，免疫治疗仅在少数患者中产生持久反应。更深入地了解CD8⁺ T细胞耗竭及其对免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）反应性的贡献，对于制定更有效的治疗策略至关重要。因此，能够忠实再现人类CRC免疫微环境的临床前模型对于应对这些挑战至关重要。在此，我们通过将四重突变Apc⁻/⁻KrasG12D/+Trp53R172H/⁻Smad4⁻/⁻（AKPS）肠道类器官移植到免疫活性小鼠的直肠黏膜下层，建立了一种同基因、基于类器官的原位CRC小鼠模型。单细胞转录组分析显示，CD8⁺ T细胞是肿瘤浸润中的主要白细胞群体，并包含向功能障碍转变的细胞群体。在功能上，CD8⁺ T细胞耗竭导致原位AKPS植入物中肿瘤负荷增加，凸显了其抗肿瘤活性。重要的是，抗PD-1治疗增加了AKPS肿瘤内功能障碍CD8⁺ T细胞群体的丰度，并减少了肿瘤生长，证明了该模型对ICI的反应性。相比之下，皮下植入的AKPS肿瘤浸润有混合的CD4⁺和CD8⁺ T细胞亚群，其中CD8⁺ T细胞表现出明显较低的功能障碍特征，这凸显了异位肿瘤模型在研究抗肿瘤免疫反应方面的局限性。总之，我们的研究结果确立了AKPS原位CRC模型作为一个平台，用于剖析早期CD8⁺ T细胞功能障碍的分子机制，并在临床前评估CRC的新型免疫治疗干预措施。

abstract: Tumor-derived extracellular vesicles (EVs) contribute to tumor progression and metastasis. We recently reported that EVs derived from normal kidney tissues (N-EVs) suppress sterile cardiac inflammation in myocardial ischemic injury models. However, whether N-EVs affect the progression of renal cancer remains elusive. In the present study, we demonstrated that N-EVs inhibit the proliferation and invasion of clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) in vitro. When administered intravenously, N-EVs were mainly retained within the tumors and suppressed ccRCC progression in cancer-bearing murine models. Further miRNA sequencing revealed that the target genes of the top 20 miRNAs in N-EVs were primarily enriched in signaling pathways, including the MAPK and Ras pathways. Moreover, N-EVs treatment modulated the tumor microenvironment and inhibited cancer cell proliferation and angiogenesis through the transfer of their inhibitory miRNAs. Therefore, manipulating normal tissue-derived EVs (including those from cultured kidney organoids) or their miRNA cargo may represent a promising potential strategy for treating ccRCC in clinical settings.
abstractZh: 肿瘤来源的细胞外囊泡（EVs）促进肿瘤进展和转移。我们最近报道，在心肌缺血损伤模型中，来源于正常肾组织的EVs（N-EVs）抑制无菌性心脏炎症。然而，N-EVs是否影响肾癌的进展仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们证明N-EVs在体外抑制透明细胞肾细胞癌（ccRCC）的增殖和侵袭。静脉注射时，N-EVs主要滞留在肿瘤内，并在荷瘤小鼠模型中抑制ccRCC的进展。进一步的miRNA测序显示，N-EVs中前20个miRNA的靶基因主要富集在信号通路中，包括MAPK和Ras通路。此外，N-EVs治疗通过转移其抑制性miRNA调节肿瘤微环境，抑制癌细胞增殖和血管生成。因此，操纵正常组织来源的EVs（包括来自培养的肾类器官）或其miRNA货物可能代表临床治疗ccRCC的一种有前景的潜在策略。

title: Modeling gliomas with organoids: reconstructing the human neural microenvironment for translational neuro-oncology.
titleZh: 利用类器官模拟胶质瘤：重建人类神经微环境以推动转化神经肿瘤学研究。

abstract: Gliomas represent some of the most lethal and biologically complex tumors of the central nervous system, with poor outcomes across both adult and pediatric populations. Beyond tumor-intrinsic genetic alterations, glioma progression is increasingly recognized to be driven by dynamic interactions with the neural microenvironment, particularly through direct tumor-neuron communication. Studies of adult and pediatric gliomas, including glioblastoma (GBM) and diffuse midline glioma (DMG), using single-cell profiling and multi-omics technologies have revealed extensive tumor intrinsic and extrinsic heterogeneity, with phenotypically and genetically plastic tumor cells actively engaged with neurons, glia, vasculature, and immune compartments that collectively reshape the neural microenvironment to promote tumor growth, invasion, and therapy resistance. Conventional two-dimensional in vitro culture systems and in vivo animal models incompletely recapitulate these interactions, limiting mechanistic insights and constraining clinical translation to human patients. Recent advances in organoid technologies have addressed this gap, enabling the development of three-dimensional human-specific models of glioma-microenvironment interactions. Platforms such as iPSC-derived cerebral organoids, regionally patterned neural organoids, patient-derived glioma organoids and tumor-organoid co-culture systems capture essential features of these human diseases. These systems recapitulate tumor-neuron synaptic integration, diffuse invasion programs, activity-dependent tumor growth, hypoxia-structured niches, vascular interactions, and patient-specific therapeutic responses. In this review, we synthesize recent advances and biological insights gleaned across glioma organoid model systems and evaluate their strengths and limitations, including neurovascular and multi-lineage systems. We further highlight emerging innovations that enhance the physiological fidelity, reproducibility, and scalability of these models. Collectively, these platforms establish tumor microenvironment interactions as a central organizing principle of glioma biology and provide a strong foundation for mechanistic discovery, therapeutic development, and personalized neuro-oncology.
abstractZh: 胶质瘤是中枢神经系统中一些最致命且生物学上最复杂的肿瘤，在成人和儿童群体中预后均较差。除了肿瘤固有的遗传改变外，胶质瘤的进展越来越被认为是由与神经微环境的动态相互作用驱动的，特别是通过直接的肿瘤-神经元通讯。利用单细胞分析和多组学技术对成人和儿童胶质瘤（包括胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）和弥漫性中线胶质瘤（DMG））的研究揭示了广泛的肿瘤内在和外在异质性，其中表型和遗传上可塑的肿瘤细胞与神经元、胶质细胞、血管和免疫区室积极互动，共同重塑神经微环境以促进肿瘤生长、侵袭和治疗抵抗。传统的二维体外培养系统和体内动物模型不能完全重现这些相互作用，限制了机制洞察并制约了向人类患者的临床转化。最近类器官技术的进展填补了这一空白，使得开发三维人类特异性的胶质瘤-微环境相互作用模型成为可能。诸如iPSC来源的大脑类器官、区域模式化神经类器官、患者来源的胶质瘤类器官以及肿瘤-类器官共培养系统等平台，捕获了这些人类疾病的基本特征。这些系统重现了肿瘤-神经元突触整合、弥漫性侵袭程序、活动依赖性肿瘤生长、缺氧结构生态位、血管相互作用以及患者特异性治疗反应。在这篇综述中，我们综合了跨胶质瘤类器官模型系统的最新进展和生物学见解，并评估了它们的优势和局限性，包括神经血管和多谱系系统。我们进一步强调了增强这些模型生理保真度、可重复性和可扩展性的新兴创新。总的来说，这些平台将肿瘤微环境相互作用确立为胶质瘤生物学的核心组织原则，并为机制发现、治疗开发和个性化神经肿瘤学提供了坚实基础。

abstract:
Introduction

Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is an aggressive malignancy driven by KRAS mutations in ~90% of cases, with high heterogeneity and limited efficacy of single targeted agents. Patient-derived organoids (PDOs) and xenografts (PDXs) offer promising platforms for personalized therapy by replicating tumor characteristics.Methods

We established a PDAC biobank with 69% PDO and 31% PDX success rates from 66 patient samples. Next-generation sequencing (NGS) of 425 oncogenes was performed, followed by 32-drugs in vitro screening in PDOs. The synergistic effects of the MEK inhibitor trametinib combined with the mTOR inhibitor AZD8055 or the pan-CDK inhibitor flavopiridol were evaluated in PDOs and validated in matched PDXs. We also validated PDOs in predicting clinical gemcitabine/paclitaxel (Gem/PTX) responses.Results

PDOs preserved tumor histological and genetic feature, with consistent drug responses across early and late passages. Trametini/AZD8055 exerted robust synergistic antitumor effects in all tested PDO and PDX models, while trametinib/flavopiridol failed in PDO/PDX-099. The Gem/PTX regimen achieved 75 -95% growth inhibition in PDOs, and the in vitro results were highly consistent with the in vivo efficacy in PDXs and the clinical CA19-9 remission of patients.Discussion

This study effectively integrated two preclinical models, PDOs and PDXs, both in vitro and in vivo, which are highly regarded in the fields of drug discovery and personalized medicine. The trametinib/AZD8055 combination is a promising precision therapeutic strategy, and PDOs can serve as a reliable tool to guide clinical therapy selection. Despite limitations such as small sample size, lack of tumor microenvironment and immune components in the model system, this work provides important preclinical evidence for the clinical translation of PDOs in the personalized therapy of PDAC.
abstractZh:
引言

胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）是一种侵袭性恶性肿瘤，约90%的病例由KRAS突变驱动，具有高度异质性，单一靶向药物疗效有限。患者来源类器官（PDOs）和异种移植瘤（PDXs）通过复制肿瘤特征，为个性化治疗提供了有前景的平台。方法

我们建立了PDAC生物样本库，从66例患者样本中PDO和PDX成功率分别为69%和31%。对425个致癌基因进行了下一代测序（NGS），随后在PDO中进行了32种药物的体外筛选。在PDO中评估了MEK抑制剂曲美替尼联合mTOR抑制剂AZD8055或泛CDK抑制剂夫拉平度的协同效应，并在匹配的PDX中进行了验证。我们还验证了PDO在预测临床吉西他滨/紫杉醇（Gem/PTX）反应中的作用。结果

PDO保留了肿瘤的组织学和遗传学特征，早期和晚期传代之间的药物反应一致。曲美替尼/AZD8055在所有测试的PDO和PDX模型中均表现出强大的协同抗肿瘤作用，而曲美替尼/夫拉平度在PDO/PDX-099中失败。Gem/PTX方案在PDO中实现了75%-95%的生长抑制，体外结果与PDX中的体内疗效以及患者的临床CA19-9缓解高度一致。讨论

这项研究有效地整合了两种临床前模型，PDO和PDX，在体外和体内均如此，这些模型在药物发现和个性化医学领域备受推崇。曲美替尼/AZD8055联合是一种有前景的精准治疗策略，PDO可以作为指导临床治疗选择的可靠工具。尽管存在样本量小、模型系统中缺乏肿瘤微环境和免疫成分等局限性，但这项工作为PDO在PDAC个性化治疗中的临床转化提供了重要的临床前证据。

title: Engineering skin microphysiological systems for transdermal drug screening based on strategic model selection and quantitative prediction roadmaps.

abstract: As transdermal drug delivery systems (TDDS) gain increasing importance, the need for screening platforms that accurately recapitulate human skin physiology has become essential. Conventional static evaluation methods, such as Franz diffusion cells, remain limited in their ability to recapitulate in vivo dynamic transport, metabolism, and clearance processes. This review examines the technical significance and emerging applicability of skin microphysiological systems (MPS) as next-generation platforms for transdermal drug screening. We first outline the multilayered structure of the skin, principal permeation pathways, and key physiological determinants governing transdermal absorption, while critically assessing the limitations of conventional ex vivo and in vitro methods. We then systematically present the design principles, evaluation metrics, and representative applications of diverse skin MPS, classified by vascularization and flow conditions. Through this analysis, we highlight how skin MPS improve the accuracy of permeability assessment and enable more physiologically relevant evaluation of drug efficacy and toxicity. Importantly, we emphasize that the primary value of skin MPS lies not in maximal complexity, but in the strategic selection of model architecture tailored to specific research objectives. Finally, we discuss future directions toward quantitative prediction, including integration of skin MPS data with physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) models via in vitro-in vivo extrapolation (IVIVE), alongside key challenges related to structural fidelity, standardization, and regulatory translation.
abstractZh: 随着透皮给药系统（TDDS）的重要性日益增加，能够准确再现人体皮肤生理学的筛选平台变得至关重要。传统的静态评估方法，如Franz扩散池，在再现体内动态转运、代谢和清除过程方面仍存在局限性。本综述探讨了皮肤微生理系统（MPS）作为下一代透皮药物筛选平台的技术意义和新兴应用。我们首先概述了皮肤的多层结构、主要渗透途径以及控制透皮吸收的关键生理决定因素，同时批判性评估了传统离体和体外方法的局限性。然后，我们系统性地介绍了不同皮肤MPS的设计原则、评估指标和代表性应用，并根据血管化和流动条件进行分类。通过这一分析，我们强调了皮肤MPS如何提高渗透性评估的准确性，并实现更符合生理学的药物疗效和毒性评估。重要的是，我们强调皮肤MPS的主要价值不在于最大程度的复杂性，而在于根据特定研究目标策略性地选择模型架构。最后，我们讨论了迈向定量预测的未来方向，包括通过体外-体内外推（IVIVE）将皮肤MPS数据与基于生理的药代动力学（PBPK）模型整合，以及涉及结构保真度、标准化和监管转化方面的关键挑战。

abstract:
Background

Xenotransplantation of pluripotent stem cell-derived human intestinal organoids (HIOs) into animal hosts models early human small intestinal development. However, traditional methods to assess HIO engraftment and expansion involve invasive, non-survival procedures. We developed a novel HIO platform featuring stable intestinal epithelial expression of a red-shifted luciferase, enabling sensitive, longitudinal in vivo tracking of HIO xenografts.Methods

Human embryonic stem cell (hESC) line H9 was lentivirus-transduced with a plasmid encoding red-shifted luciferase under a ubiquitin C promoter. After positive selection, cells were differentiated into endoderm, mid/hindgut spheroids, and HIOs. HIO maturation and luciferase expression were confirmed by immunofluorescence prior to kidney capsule implantation in 10 adult immunodeficient SCID mice. We performed serial in vivo bioluminescent imaging over 12-weeks, comparing radiance across time points using the Kruskal-Wallis test. Following euthanasia, HIO grafts were explanted to assess size and tissue architecture.Results

Stable transduction did not compromise the genome integrity of hESCs, pluripotency, or maturation of hESCs into HIOs. In 9 of 10 mice, HIO radiance was detectable within two weeks of implantation. Mean radiance significantly increased over time (p = 0.03). Bioluminescence correlated with the mass of explanted HIOs upon euthanasia (ρ = 0.923, p Conclusions

We successfully generated transplantable bioluminescent HIOs from pluripotent stem cells, setting the stage for dynamic monitoring of HIOs to further elucidate human intestinal development and injury response across the lifespan and other diverse applications.
abstractZh:
背景

将多能干细胞来源的人肠道类器官（HIOs）异种移植到动物宿主中，可模拟人类早期小肠发育。然而，评估HIO植入和扩增的传统方法涉及侵入性、非生存性操作。我们开发了一种新型HIO平台，其特点是肠道上皮稳定表达红移荧光素酶，能够对HIO异种移植物进行灵敏的纵向体内追踪。方法

人胚胎干细胞（hESC）系H9经慢病毒转导，携带在泛素C启动子下编码红移荧光素酶的质粒。阳性选择后，细胞分化为内胚层、中/后肠球体和HIOs。在将HIOs植入10只成年免疫缺陷SCID小鼠的肾囊下之前，通过免疫荧光确认HIO成熟和荧光素酶表达。我们在12周内进行系列体内生物发光成像，使用Kruskal-Wallis检验比较不同时间点的辐射度。安乐死后，取出HIO移植物以评估大小和组织结构。结果

稳定转导未损害hESCs的基因组完整性、多能性或向HIOs的成熟。在10只小鼠中的9只中，HIO辐射度在植入后两周内可检测到。平均辐射度随时间显著增加（p = 0.03）。生物发光与安乐死时取出的HIO质量相关（ρ = 0.923，p < 0.001）。移植物表现出预期的组织结构，包括上皮、间充质和上皮-间充质相互作用。结论

我们成功地从多能干细胞生成了可移植的生物发光HIOs，为动态监测HIOs奠定了基础，以进一步阐明人类肠道发育和损伤反应在整个生命周期及其他多种应用中的机制。

abstract: Organoids have emerged as a powerful strategy to recapitulate tissue architecture and function, opening new avenues for regenerative medicine. However, clinical translation is hindered by limited control over the assembly of heterogeneous organoid units and the resulting loss of spatial organization at the tissue scale. In addition, macroscale organoid constructs face diffusion-limited oxygen and nutrient transport, leading to central necrosis. The poor vascular integration can hinder the further development and maturation of the organoids, ultimately preventing functional integration. To address these limitations, we developed Neo-Organoid Visualization and Assembly (NOVA), a living assembly strategy that integrates bioprinting with hydrogel-based bio-adhesive assembly to enable high-throughput modular assembly of bone organoids. Using this strategy, we generate a tissue-scale tubular bone organoid graft formed with in situ unidirectional guided vascularization. This structure enables the spatiotemporal coupling of angiogenesis and osteogenesis, enhances the maturation and function of bone organoids, and holds potential for one-step surgical transplantation with rapid perfusion to repair defects.
abstractZh: 类器官已成为重现组织结构和功能的有力策略，为再生医学开辟了新途径。然而，临床转化受到对异质类器官单元组装控制有限以及由此导致的组织尺度空间组织丧失的阻碍。此外，宏观尺度的类器官构建体面临扩散限制的氧气和营养运输，导致中心坏死。血管整合不良可能阻碍类器官的进一步发育和成熟，最终阻止功能性整合。为解决这些限制，我们开发了新类器官可视化与组装（NOVA）技术，这是一种活体组装策略，将生物打印与水凝胶基生物粘附组装相结合，以实现骨类器官的高通量模块化组装。利用该策略，我们生成了组织尺度的管状骨类器官移植物，并形成原位单向引导血管化。该结构能够实现血管生成和骨生成在时空上的耦合，增强骨类器官的成熟和功能，并具有一步手术移植和快速灌注修复缺损的潜力。

title: Hepatocyte Models for Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease: A Comparative Analysis of Non-HepG2 Cell Models.

abstract: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is a widespread condition with a complex pathogenesis. Cell-based models are important tools for studying the mechanisms underlying its development and progression. The aim of this review is to analyze the HepaRG, Huh-7, immortalized human hepatocyte (IHH), and primary human hepatocyte (PHH) cell lines for modeling and studying MASLD. HepaRG represents the most metabolically competent immortalized hepatocyte model with preserved biotransformation activity and a physiological bioenergetic response to lipid loading, making it valuable for pharmacological and toxicological studies. Huh-7 is distinguished by its accessibility and suitability for studying steatosis, lipotoxicity, insulin resistance, and paracrine mechanisms of fibrogenesis; however, its use is limited by its tumor origin, impaired carbohydrate metabolism, and low activity of xenobiotic-metabolizing enzymes. The IHH model occupies an intermediate position because of its non-tumor origin and is of interest for studies of senescence, epigenetic regulation, and signaling pathways involved in steatosis, although interpretation of results requires consideration of immortalization-related effects and specific metabolic limitations. PHH remains the most physiologically relevant platform for MASLD modeling, particularly in three-dimensional (3D) and microphysiological formats; however, its use is limited by high cost, interindividual variability, and the limited duration of the differentiated phenotype. Increasing model complexity-from two-dimensional (2D) monocultures to co-cultures, spheroids, and organ-on-chip systems-enhances physiological relevance and enables reproduction not only of steatosis but also of the inflammatory and fibrogenic components of MASLD progression, yet it reduces reproducibility and complicates standardization. Overall, none of the existing models is universal, and the optimal strategy is to select models according to the specific research question. A key direction for future research is the standardization of steatosis induction protocols and the unification of criteria for evaluating results.
abstractZh: 代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病（MASLD）是一种广泛存在的疾病，其发病机制复杂。基于细胞的模型是研究其发生和发展机制的重要工具。本综述旨在分析HepaRG、Huh-7、永生化人肝细胞（IHH）和原代人肝细胞（PHH）细胞系在MASLD建模和研究中的应用。HepaRG代表了代谢能力最强的永生化肝细胞模型，保留了生物转化活性和对脂质负荷的生理性生物能量反应，使其在药理学和毒理学研究中具有重要价值。Huh-7因其易获得性和适用于研究脂肪变性、脂毒性、胰岛素抵抗和纤维化的旁分泌机制而著称；然而，其使用受到肿瘤来源、碳水化合物代谢受损以及外源物代谢酶活性低的限制。IHH模型因其非肿瘤来源而处于中间位置，对于衰老、表观遗传调控以及参与脂肪变性的信号通路研究具有意义，但结果解读需考虑永生化相关效应和特定的代谢局限性。PHH仍然是MASLD建模中最具生理相关性的平台，特别是在三维（3D）和微生理系统中；然而，其使用受到高成本、个体间差异以及分化表型持续时间有限的限制。增加模型复杂性——从二维（2D）单培养到共培养、球体和器官芯片系统——增强了生理相关性，并能够再现不仅包括脂肪变性，还包括MASLD进展中的炎症和纤维化成分，但降低了可重复性并使标准化复杂化。总体而言，现有模型中没有一个是通用的，最佳策略是根据具体研究问题选择模型。未来研究的一个关键方向是标准化脂肪变性诱导方案和统一结果评估标准。

abstract: We present a modular microfluidic platform for constructing miniaturized, compartmentalized cell culture systems that support monoculture, co-culture, and organ-on-a-chip models of human tissues. The devices provide architecturally defined three-dimensional microenvironments in which heterogeneous cell populations can be cultured in close proximity while maintaining precise spatial organization and independent access to each compartment. In vivo-like perfusion into, from, and between adjacent chambers is achieved via micro-engineered porous barriers that act as perfusion microchannels, enabling controlled convective and diffusive transport and recapitulating paracrine signaling between tissue units. As a proof of concept, we implement an adipose-immune co-culture model that reproduces key features of inflamed, insulin-resistant adipose tissue, including altered cytokine secretion and glucose uptake. Together, these features establish a versatile platform for the biofabrication of customizable single-organ and multi-organ in vitro models that more faithfully recapitulate human tissue structure and function for applications in disease modeling, immunometabolic studies, and preclinical drug testing.
abstractZh: 我们提出了一种模块化微流控平台，用于构建小型化、隔室化的细胞培养系统，支持人类组织的单培养、共培养和器官芯片模型。这些设备提供了架构上明确的三维微环境，其中异质细胞群体可以在紧密接近的情况下培养，同时保持精确的空间组织和每个隔室的独立访问。通过微工程化的多孔屏障实现体内样灌注，这些屏障作为灌注微通道，实现控制的对流和扩散传输，并重现组织单元之间的旁分泌信号传导。作为概念验证，我们实现了一个脂肪-免疫共培养模型，该模型重现了发炎、胰岛素抵抗脂肪组织的关键特征，包括改变的细胞因子分泌和葡萄糖摄取。总之，这些特征建立了一个多功能平台，用于生物制造可定制的单器官和多器官体外模型，这些模型更忠实地重现人类组织结构和功能，适用于疾病建模、免疫代谢研究和临床前药物测试。

abstract: High-density microelectrode arrays (HDMEAs) have become increasingly important tools in neuroscience and biomedical engineering because of their high spatial and temporal resolution for recording and modulating electrical activity across diverse biological systems. Initially developed for in vitro studies of cultured cells, HDMEAs are now being applied to increasingly complex models, including organoids, animal systems, and even human neural systems. These advancements enable a deeper investigation of cellular interactions, network dynamics, and disease mechanisms, as well as providing novel therapeutic and diagnostic tools for neurological disorders. This review explores the evolution of HDMEAs, emphasizing recent innovations in their design, fabrication, and functionalization. We discuss their applications across cellular models, organoid systems, animal studies, and human electrophysiology, and highlight current challenges such as biocompatibility, long-term stability, scalability, and translational deployment. Finally, we outline future directions for advancing HDMEA technologies in both research and clinical settings.
abstractZh: 高密度微电极阵列（HDMEAs）因其在记录和调节多种生物系统电活动方面的高空间和时间分辨率，已成为神经科学和生物医学工程中日益重要的工具。HDMEAs最初为培养细胞的体外研究而开发，现在正被应用于越来越复杂的模型，包括类器官、动物系统，甚至人类神经系统。这些进展使得对细胞相互作用、网络动力学和疾病机制的更深入研究成为可能，并为神经系统疾病提供了新的治疗和诊断工具。本综述探讨了HDMEAs的演变，重点介绍了其设计、制造和功能化方面的最新创新。我们讨论了它们在细胞模型、类器官系统、动物研究和人类电生理学中的应用，并强调了当前的挑战，如生物相容性、长期稳定性、可扩展性和转化部署。最后，我们概述了在研究和临床环境中推进HDMEA技术的未来方向。

abstract:
Background

Natural products from traditional medicinal plants represent an important source of anti-cancer agents and lead compounds for drug development. Saikosaponin D (SSD), a triterpenoid saponin isolated from Radix Bupleuri, exhibits anti-tumor activity but is limited by a narrow therapeutic window and cytotoxicity.Objective

This study aimed to evaluate the anti-tumor activity of 6''-O-acetylsaikosaponin D (6''-O-acSSD), a naturally occurring acetylated derivative of Saikosaponin D that is identified in Radix Bupleuri, and to elucidate its underlying molecular mechanisms.Methods

The anti-cancer effects of 6''-O-acSSD were assessed using multiple cancer cell models, three-dimensional tumor spheroids, and patient-derived tumor organoids. Transcriptomic and bioinformatic analyses were performed to identify regulated cell death pathways. Molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation, cellular thermal shift assays, western blotting, and CUT&Tag profiling were used to identify molecular targets and define transcriptional reprogramming.Results

6''-O-acSSD markedly suppressed cancer cell proliferation, migration, and invasion and elicited a transcriptional program distinct from that induced by SSD. Transcriptomic and biochemical analyses revealed preferential activation of ferroptosis-associated signatures, including enhanced lipid peroxidation. Mechanistically, 6''-O-acSSD engaged STAT3, inhibited its phosphorylation, and extensively remodeled STAT3 chromatin occupancy. Functional analyses showed that STAT3 inhibition was required for the full anti-tumor activity of 6''-O-acSSD. Notably, blockade of ferroptosis only partially rescued cell viability, whereas STAT3 targeting additionally triggered apoptosis-associated transcriptional and biochemical changes. The anti-tumor effects of 6''-O-acSSD were further validated in patient-derived tumor organoids.Conclusion

6''-O-acSSD exerts potent anti-tumor effects by targeting STAT3-dependent transcriptional programs and inducing coordinated ferroptosis and apoptosis. These findings highlight the therapeutic potential of structurally optimized natural products for anti-cancer treatment.
abstractZh:
背景

来自传统药用植物的天然产物是抗癌药物和药物开发先导化合物的重要来源。柴胡皂苷D（SSD）是从柴胡中分离得到的一种三萜皂苷，具有抗肿瘤活性，但受限于较窄的治疗窗口和细胞毒性。目的

本研究旨在评估6''-O-乙酰柴胡皂苷D（6''-O-acSSD）的抗肿瘤活性，该化合物是在柴胡中鉴定出的柴胡皂苷D的天然乙酰化衍生物，并阐明其潜在的分子机制。方法

使用多种癌细胞模型、三维肿瘤球体和患者来源的肿瘤类器官评估6''-O-acSSD的抗癌效果。进行转录组学和生物信息学分析以鉴定受调控的细胞死亡通路。使用分子对接、分子动力学模拟、细胞热位移分析、蛋白质印迹和CUT&Tag分析来鉴定分子靶点并定义转录重编程。结果

6''-O-acSSD显著抑制癌细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭，并引发与SSD诱导的转录程序不同的转录程序。转录组学和生化分析揭示其优先激活铁死亡相关特征，包括增强的脂质过氧化。机制上，6''-O-acSSD与STAT3结合，抑制其磷酸化，并广泛重塑STAT3染色质占据。功能分析表明，STAT3抑制是6''-O-acSSD完全抗肿瘤活性所必需的。值得注意的是，阻断铁死亡仅部分挽救细胞活力，而靶向STAT3还额外触发凋亡相关的转录和生化变化。6''-O-acSSD的抗肿瘤作用在患者来源的肿瘤类器官中得到进一步验证。结论

6''-O-acSSD通过靶向STAT3依赖性转录程序并诱导铁死亡和凋亡的协同作用发挥强效抗肿瘤作用。这些发现凸显了结构优化的天然产物在抗癌治疗中的治疗潜力。

title: Advances and Challenges in 3D Bioprinting of Cartilage Organoids: From Material Innovation to Functional Regeneration.
